subject: IfcActuator
rule: actuator must be connected to a compatible control or sensing element
conditions: when the actuator is part of a building automation or control system
exceptions: standalone manual actuators with no electronic control connection

subject: IfcActuator
rule: actuator must not be assigned a material that impedes its mechanical movement
conditions: when the material assignment affects the actuator's moving parts or mechanism
exceptions: protective coatings or lubricants that do not impede movement

subject: IfcAirTerminalBoxType
rule: Air terminal box must be connected to an air distribution system (ductwork) on both inlet and outlet sides

subject: IfcAirTerminalBoxType
rule: Air terminal box must not have both inlet and outlet ports blocked or capped simultaneously

subject: IfcAirTerminalBoxType
rule: Air terminal box must have a control mechanism or interface (e.g., damper actuator) to modulate airflow

subject: IfcAlarmType
rule: alarm device must be located where its alert signal can be perceived by occupants in the protected zone
conditions: alarm is audible or visual type
zone is normally occupied

subject: IfcAlarmType
rule: alarm type must be assigned to a valid alarm occurrence type from the recognized classification

subject: IfcAlarm
rule: An IfcAlarm must be connected to a power source (e.g., via IfcFlowTerminal or IfcDistributionPort) to be operable
conditions: The alarm is not self-powered (e.g., no internal battery)
exceptions: The alarm is a purely mechanical alarm (e.g., manual bell) that requires no external power

subject: IfcAlarm
rule: An IfcAlarm must have a communication path to a control or monitoring system (e.g., via IfcCableSegment or IfcWire) to be capable of signaling
conditions: The alarm is not a standalone local device with no remote notification requirement
exceptions: The alarm is an independent local warning device (e.g., a local horn/strobe not tied to any panel or network)

subject: IfcAlarm
rule: An IfcAlarm must_not be placed in a location where its audible or visual output is completely obstructed by physical elements from the intended occupants or area
conditions: The alarm provides an audible or visual notification to building occupants
exceptions: The alarm is only for remote signaling and has no local notification function

subject: IfcAsymmetricIShapeProfileDef
rule: The bottom flange width must be greater than the web thickness
conditions: IfcAsymmetricIShapeProfileDef is used as a load-bearing structural profile

subject: IfcAsymmetricIShapeProfileDef
rule: The top flange thickness must be positive

subject: IfcAsymmetricIShapeProfileDef
rule: The bottom flange thickness must be positive

subject: IfcAsymmetricIShapeProfileDef
rule: The web thickness must be positive

subject: IfcAsymmetricIShapeProfileDef
rule: The depth of the profile must be positive

subject: IfcAsymmetricIShapeProfileDef
rule: The top flange width must be greater than the web thickness
conditions: IfcAsymmetricIShapeProfileDef is used as a load-bearing structural profile

subject: IfcAudioVisualAppliance
rule: Audio-visual appliance must be connected to a compatible power supply with appropriate voltage and current rating
conditions: Appliance requires external power to operate
exceptions: Battery-powered or self-powered devices that do not rely on building electrical system

subject: IfcAudioVisualAppliance
rule: Audio-visual appliance must not be installed in a location that exposes it to direct water spray or immersion
conditions: Appliance is not rated for wet or damp locations
exceptions: Appliances specifically rated with appropriate IP (ingress protection) rating for wet locations

subject: IfcAudioVisualAppliance
rule: Audio-visual appliance must have adequate ventilation clearance around heat-dissipating surfaces
conditions: Appliance generates heat during operation and has passive cooling vents
exceptions: Appliances with active cooling that ducts exhaust externally or devices that are convection-cooled by design with zero-clearance rating

subject: IfcBeamStandardCase
rule: beam must have a defined structural connection at both ends to transfer loads
conditions: when used as a load-bearing structural member
exceptions: cantilever beams fixed at one end

subject: IfcBeamStandardCase
rule: beam must not have a cross-section aspect ratio that causes lateral-torsional buckling under design loads
conditions: when beam is slender and unrestrained along its length
exceptions: beams with full lateral restraint (e.g., embedded in concrete slab)
beams with verified bracing per code

subject: IfcBeamStandardCase
rule: beam must have material strength sufficient to resist maximum bending moment and shear force from load combinations
conditions: for all load-bearing beams
exceptions: non-structural decorative beams explicitly modeled as non-load-bearing

subject: IfcBeam
rule: beam must have a defined structural connection at both ends to transfer loads to supports
conditions: beam is load-bearing
beam is part of a structural frame
exceptions: non-structural decorative beams
cantilevered beams with fixed-end connection at one end only

subject: IfcBeam
rule: beam must not have a span-to-depth ratio that exceeds the material-specific limit without deflection verification
conditions: beam is simply supported
beam spans between two supports

subject: IfcBeam
rule: beam must not be placed such that its self-weight causes tensile stress exceeding the material tensile strength in unreinforced masonry or plain concrete beams
conditions: beam material is unreinforced masonry
beam material is plain concrete
exceptions: beams with post-tensioning or embedded reinforcement

subject: IfcBuilding
rule: building must have a primary load path to transfer gravity and lateral loads to the ground
exceptions: temporary structures

subject: IfcBuilding
rule: building must have at least one means of egress (exit) from each occupied floor
conditions: building is occupied by people
exceptions: unoccupied ancillary structures such as small storage sheds

subject: IfcBuilding
rule: building must be separated from adjacent buildings or property lines by fire-rated construction or minimum clear distance
conditions: building is intended for human occupancy
building is in a jurisdiction with fire codes
exceptions: free-standing buildings not near property lines in low-fire-risk areas where code allows exceptions

subject: IfcBuilding
rule: building floor assemblies must be capable of supporting design live loads without collapse
conditions: building has floors intended for occupancy or storage

subject: IfcBuilding
rule: building envelope must be weathertight (prevent bulk water intrusion)
conditions: building is enclosed and intended for conditioned or dry occupancy
exceptions: open-sided structures such as carports or pergolas

subject: IfcBuildingElementProxy
rule: IfcBuildingElementProxy must be assigned a valid PredefinedType or ObjectType to indicate its intended function
conditions: When the proxy is used as a placeholder in a building model
exceptions: Proxies used solely as temporary references in early design phases where functional type is intentionally undefined

subject: IfcBuildingElementType
rule: IfcBuildingElementType must have a predefined type that is consistent with the element's functional role
conditions: When mapped to an IfcBuildingElement occurrence
exceptions: IfcBuildingElementType is used as an abstract base type without instantiation

subject: IfcBuildingElementType
rule: IfcBuildingElementType must have its material assignment consistent with the element category
conditions: When material information is assigned via IfcRelAssociatesMaterial
exceptions: Abstract or placeholder type definitions with no physical realization

subject: IfcBurnerType
rule: burner must have a fuel supply connection

subject: IfcBurnerType
rule: burner must have a combustion air supply or flue gas exhaust path

subject: IfcBurnerType
rule: burner must not have zero nominal heating capacity

subject: IfcCableFitting
rule: cable fitting must have adequate electrical clearance to prevent arcing or short circuits
conditions: when installed in electrical power systems
when conductors are exposed
exceptions: fittings designed for low-voltage or intrinsically safe circuits where clearance requirements are negligible

subject: IfcCableFitting
rule: cable fitting must not exceed its rated operating temperature
conditions: during continuous rated current flow
exceptions: fault conditions lasting less than the thermal time constant as permitted by the standard

subject: IfcCableFitting
rule: cable fitting must be mechanically compatible with the cable diameter and type it is intended to terminate or connect
conditions: when used as a cable gland, connector, or junction fitting
exceptions: universal fittings with adjustable ranges that accommodate multiple diameters while maintaining seal and grip

subject: IfcCableFitting
rule: cable fitting must not be installed in tension or bending beyond its specified limits
conditions: when used as a support or anchorage fitting

subject: IfcCableSegment
rule: Cable segment must have a minimum bending radius that is not exceeded during installation or operation
conditions: The cable segment is bent during installation or service
exceptions: Cables specifically designed as 'flexible' or 'continuous-flex' cables that have different bending radius specifications

subject: IfcCableSegment
rule: Cable segment must not be subjected to tensile stress exceeding its rated pulling tension
conditions: The cable is being pulled during installation
exceptions: Cables with integrated strength members or self-supporting catenary cables designed for higher tension

subject: IfcCableSegment
rule: Cable segment must have continuous electrical continuity of its conductor
conditions: The cable segment is part of a power or signal circuit
exceptions: Cables intentionally terminated or cut at junction points

subject: IfcCableSegment
rule: Cable segment must not have insulation resistance below the specified minimum value
conditions: The cable is installed and in service

subject: IfcChillerType
rule: IfcChillerType must have a refrigerant circuit designed to contain the working fluid without leakage under normal operating pressure
conditions: IfcChillerType is used for vapor-compression refrigeration
exceptions: Absorption chiller types that do not use a refrigerant vapor-compression circuit

subject: IfcChillerType
rule: IfcChillerType must not have evaporator operating temperature below the freezing point of the heat-transfer fluid without appropriate freeze protection
conditions: IfcChillerType uses water or water-glycol as the chilled fluid medium
exceptions: Chillers designed specifically for ice thermal storage where controlled freezing is intentional

subject: IfcChillerType
rule: IfcChillerType must have a condenser heat rejection mechanism capable of rejecting at least the sum of evaporator cooling capacity plus compressor work input

subject: IfcChiller
rule: IfcChiller must be connected to a chilled water loop on its inlet and outlet to transfer heat
conditions: when functioning as a vapor-compression or absorption chiller in an HVAC system

subject: IfcChiller
rule: IfcChiller must not operate without sufficient refrigerant charge in its closed refrigerant circuit
conditions: when the chiller uses a vapor-compression cycle

subject: IfcChiller
rule: IfcChiller must be installed on a level base capable of supporting its operating weight

subject: IfcChiller
rule: IfcChiller must have adequate clearance around it for airflow over condenser coils
conditions: when the chiller is air-cooled
exceptions: water-cooled chillers that reject heat via a cooling tower and do not rely on ambient air over local coils

subject: IfcChimney
rule: chimney must have a minimum height above the roof ridge to ensure proper draft
conditions: chimney is attached to a building with a roof
exceptions: chimney is a decorative/false chimney not intended for exhaust

subject: IfcChimney
rule: chimney flue must not be blocked or obstructed
conditions: chimney is functional (used for exhaust of combustion products)
exceptions: chimney is decorative and has no flue

subject: IfcChimney
rule: chimney must be made of non-combustible material
conditions: chimney conveys hot combustion gases
exceptions: chimney is purely decorative with no heat source

subject: IfcChimney
rule: chimney must have adequate thermal separation from combustible building elements
conditions: chimney conveys hot combustion gases
chimney passes through or adjacent to combustible materials

subject: IfcChimneyType
rule: chimney flue must have a continuous unobstructed path from appliance to exterior
conditions: IfcChimneyType is used for exhaust of combustion appliances

subject: IfcChimneyType
rule: chimney must be constructed of non-combustible material
conditions: IfcChimneyType is connected to a solid-fuel, gas, or oil appliance

subject: IfcChimneyType
rule: chimney interior surface must not be permeable to flue gases

subject: IfcChimneyType
rule: chimney must extend above roof surface by minimum code-required height

subject: IfcCoil
rule: IfcCoil must have a valid connection to a fluid distribution system (duct or pipe) at both inlet and outlet ports for the coil to function in heat exchange
conditions: coil is used for heating, cooling, or condensing
exceptions: coil is a standalone test unit not connected to any system

subject: IfcCoil
rule: IfcCoil must have a rated capacity (nominal thermal capacity) defined that matches or exceeds the design load in its zone
conditions: coil is specified for a conditioned space or process load
exceptions: coil is a catalog placeholder with capacity to be determined later

subject: IfcCoil
rule: IfcCoil must not be placed where ambient temperature exceeds the coil's maximum operating temperature
conditions: coil is installed in an outdoor or high-temperature environment such as boiler room
exceptions: coil is specifically rated for high-temperature service

subject: IfcCoilType
rule: coil must have a minimum fin spacing to prevent condensate bridging and airflow blockage
conditions: when coil is a finned-tube type
when coil is used for sensible cooling or dehumidification
exceptions: non-finned coil types (e.g., bare tube, microchannel with no fins)

subject: IfcCoilType
rule: coil must have a working pressure rating at or above the design system pressure
conditions: when coil is part of a pressurized hydronic or refrigerant circuit
exceptions: gravity-drain or open-loop coils not subject to pressurization

subject: IfcCoilType
rule: coil tube material must not be incompatible with the working fluid chemistry
conditions: when coil is exposed to corrosive fluids (e.g., seawater, untreated glycol, acidic condensate)
exceptions: coils with adequate protective coating or cathodic protection verified for the specific chemistry

subject: IfcCoilType
rule: coil face velocity must not exceed the manufacturer's maximum to avoid moisture carryover
conditions: when coil is a wet-coil (dehumidifying) application
exceptions: coils specifically designed with integral moisture eliminators that are rated for higher velocities

subject: IfcCoilType
rule: coil freeze protection medium must remain liquid at the lowest anticipated ambient temperature
conditions: when coil is located outdoors or in an unconditioned space
when coil is not drained for winter
exceptions: steam coils or coils using a drained/freezeless design
coils in climate zones where temperature never reaches freezing

subject: IfcCompressor
rule: compressor must have a refrigerant suction line connected to the inlet port
conditions: If the compressor is part of a vapor-compression refrigeration or HVAC system
exceptions: Compressors used solely for pneumatic power (air compressors) that do not handle refrigerant

subject: IfcCompressor
rule: compressor must not operate against a blocked discharge line
conditions: When the compressor is running

subject: IfcCompressor
rule: compressor must have oil in the crankcase before startup
conditions: For reciprocating or scroll compressors with an oil-lubricated crankcase
exceptions: Hermetic compressors with oil-less bearing design
Oil-free centrifugal compressors

subject: IfcCompressor
rule: compressor electrical supply voltage must match the motor nameplate rating within ±10%
conditions: When the compressor is electrically powered

subject: IfcCondenser
rule: condenser must be located where it can reject heat to outdoor air or a cooling water source
conditions: IfcCondenser is air-cooled
IfcCondenser is water-cooled
exceptions: Condenser serving a heat pump in heating mode where heat is rejected to indoor space

subject: IfcCondenser
rule: condenser must be installed with proper clearance for airflow
conditions: IfcCondenser is air-cooled

subject: IfcCondenser
rule: refrigerant piping between condenser and compressor must not exceed maximum allowable length
conditions: IfcCondenser is part of a split HVAC system

subject: IfcController
rule: IfcController must be connected to a controlled device or system via IfcRelFlowControlElements or IfcRelAssignsToControl
conditions: When the controller is part of a building automation or control system
exceptions: If the controller is a placeholder or unassigned in early design stages

subject: IfcController
rule: IfcController must have a valid control type (e.g., IfcControllerTypeEnum) that matches the type of element it controls
conditions: When the controller is fully specified in the model

subject: IfcCoolingTower
rule: Cooling tower must have an unobstructed air intake and exhaust path to reject heat
conditions: When cooling tower relies on ambient air for heat rejection (natural draft or mechanical draft)
exceptions: Closed-loop fluid coolers with integral heat exchangers that do not require direct air contact for heat rejection

subject: IfcCoolingTower
rule: Cooling tower must not have standing water that exceeds the designed basin capacity or overflows
conditions: When cooling tower includes a collection basin or sump for recirculating water
exceptions: Towers designed with continuous bleed-and-fill systems where overflow is intentional and safely drained

subject: IfcCoolingTower
rule: Cooling tower must be located outside or in a space with sufficient ventilation to prevent accumulation of warm moist exhaust air
conditions: When cooling tower is of the open-circuit (wet) type that discharges saturated air
exceptions: Towers specifically designed with ducted exhaust connections to outside

subject: IfcCoveringType
rule: coverings must be positively attached to their host substrate
conditions: when applied as cladding, lining, or roofing
when permanent installation is intended
exceptions: temporary or demountable coverings

subject: IfcCoveringType
rule: covering materials must not create a concealed condensation risk that leads to material degradation
conditions: when the covering is on the cold side of a thermal envelope assembly
when the covering is vapor-impermeable
exceptions: when a dedicated ventilation or drainage cavity is provided behind the covering
when a vapor-permeable membrane separates the covering from the substrate

subject: IfcCoveringType
rule: exterior coverings must shed water away from the building interior
conditions: when the covering is on an exterior surface (rainscreen, cladding, roof covering)
exceptions: when the covering is purely interior (wall lining, ceiling covering)
when the covering is intentionally water-permeable and backed by a drained cavity

subject: IfcCovering
rule: IfcCovering must be attached to or supported by a structural building element (e.g., wall, slab, roof, ceiling)
exceptions: Free-standing coverings that are structurally self-supporting (e.g., freestanding cladding panels with own framing)

subject: IfcCovering
rule: IfcCovering must not create a gap or discontinuity that exposes the underlying building element to weather or damage in exterior applications
conditions: covering is classified as an exterior covering (e.g., external cladding, roofing, weatherproofing)
exceptions: Intentional ventilation gaps with appropriate flashing or drainage provisions

subject: IfcCovering
rule: IfcCovering must have a means of drainage or moisture evacuation if installed on a horizontal or near-horizontal surface exposed to precipitation
conditions: covering is on a roof, balcony, terrace, or other horizontal exterior surface
exceptions: Coverings that are fully permeable and do not trap water (e.g., loose-laid gravel or decking with open joints)

subject: IfcCsgSolid
rule: IfcCsgSolid must have a valid, non-self-intersecting CSG tree representation
conditions: when used as a shape representation for an element

subject: IfcCsgSolid
rule: IfcCsgSolid must not contain dangling or unconnected sub-shapes in its Boolean expression
conditions: when the CSG tree includes union, intersection, or difference operations

subject: IfcDistributionChamberElement
rule: IfcDistributionChamberElement must provide structural enclosure capable of withstanding surrounding soil and live loads
conditions: when buried underground
when installed in areas with vehicular or pedestrian traffic above
exceptions: when element is fully prefabricated and structural capacity is provided by separate external structure

subject: IfcDistributionChamberElement
rule: IfcDistributionChamberElement must be watertight to prevent groundwater ingress
conditions: when installed below the water table
when located in saturated soil conditions
exceptions: when chamber is designed for drainage or intentional water infiltration

subject: IfcDistributionChamberElement
rule: IfcDistributionChamberElement must provide safe personnel access for inspection and maintenance
conditions: when chamber depth exceeds 1.2 meters
when chamber contains active mechanical or electrical equipment requiring periodic servicing
exceptions: when chamber is classified as confined-space entry with no routine human entry required

subject: IfcDistributionChamberElement
rule: IfcDistributionChamberElement must not have sharp protrusions or tripping hazards at entry points
conditions: when chamber is designed for personnel entry
exceptions: when chamber is closed-system with no human entry ever intended

subject: IfcDistributionFlowElementType
rule: IfcDistributionFlowElementType must not be used to represent physical objects that already exist in a building
conditions: When the distribution flow element type is instantiated in a project model
exceptions: When the element type is being used as a placeholder during early design stages

subject: IfcDistributionFlowElementType
rule: IfcDistributionFlowElementType must define properties that are common to all occurrences of that type
conditions: When instantiated for a specific type catalog entry

subject: IfcDistributionPort
rule: IfcDistributionPort must have a connected port type (e.g., SOCKET, PLUG) to enable valid connectivity with other distribution elements
conditions: The port is used in a distribution system (e.g., electrical, HVAC, plumbing)
exceptions: Virtual or terminal ports used solely for boundary representation without intended physical connection

subject: IfcDistributionPort
rule: IfcDistributionPort must not be assigned to more than one IfcDistributionFlowElement at the same time
conditions: The port is modeled as part of a physical distribution system requiring unambiguous connectivity
exceptions: Abstract or logical ports used in analysis models where symbolic connectivity is allowed

subject: IfcDoor
rule: Door must have a clear opening width of at least 750 mm for egress
conditions: Door serves as an exit or egress path in a building
Door is in a building subject to accessibility or life safety codes
exceptions: Door is to a non-habitable space such as a small closet (less than 2 m²)
Door is service-only and not used for occupant egress

subject: IfcDoor
rule: Door must open in the direction of egress travel when serving a space with an occupant load of 50 or more
conditions: Door serves a room or area with occupant load ≥ 50
Door is on an egress path
exceptions: Door serving a single-occupancy residential unit
Door in a private office

subject: IfcDoor
rule: Door leaf must not swing into a required means of egress such that the clear width of the egress path is reduced below the minimum
conditions: Door is adjacent to a corridor or passage that is a required means of egress
exceptions: Door serves a closet or utility space with no egress function
Door swing arc can be fully contained within the door's own recess or pocket

subject: IfcDoor
rule: Door must have a latching mechanism that can be operated with a single, simple action without requiring tight grasping, pinching, or twisting of the wrist
conditions: Door is on a means of egress
Door is accessible to building occupants
exceptions: Door serving a security-controlled area where special operation is required and alternative egress is provided

subject: IfcDoor
rule: Door must have a minimum fire-resistance rating when located in a fire-rated wall assembly
conditions: Door is installed in a wall assembly that is required to have a fire-resistance rating
exceptions: Door is in a smoke barrier rather than a fire barrier
Local code permits a lower rating based on sprinkler system installation

subject: IfcDoorStandardCase
rule: door leaf must fit within the door opening frame
conditions: IfcDoorStandardCase represents a swing, sliding, or folding door

subject: IfcDoorStandardCase
rule: door must have a clear opening width not less than the minimum required for the assigned occupancy type
conditions: IfcDoorStandardCase is used as a means of egress or accessible route
exceptions: Doors not required for egress or accessibility (e.g., purely decorative doors) may have no minimum width requirement

subject: IfcDoorStandardCase
rule: door must not have hinges or hardware that interfere with the required clear opening width
conditions: IfcDoorStandardCase has hinges or hardware projecting into the opening

subject: IfcDoorStandardCase
rule: door leaf thickness must not exceed the depth of the frame rebate

subject: IfcDoorStyle
rule: IfcDoorStyle must have a defined overall width (OverallWidth) greater than zero

subject: IfcDoorStyle
rule: IfcDoorStyle must have a defined overall height (OverallHeight) greater than zero

subject: IfcDoorStyle
rule: IfcDoorStyle must have an OperationType that is physically realizable (e.g., single swing, double swing, sliding, folding, etc.)

subject: IfcDoorStyle
rule: IfcDoorStyle must not have a ConstructionType that contradicts the OperationType (e.g., 'swinging' operation with a 'sliding' construction type)

subject: IfcDuctFitting
rule: duct fitting must withstand internal operating pressure without leakage
conditions: system is pressurized
exceptions: non-pressurized gravity drainage systems

subject: IfcDuctFitting
rule: duct fitting must not obstruct airflow beyond its designed pressure drop rating
conditions: duct system is in operation

subject: IfcDuctFitting
rule: duct fitting must be made of material with fire resistance rating meeting applicable building code requirements
conditions: fitting is part of a fire-rated duct enclosure or penetrates a fire-rated assembly
exceptions: installations entirely outside fire-resistance-rated zones

subject: IfcDuctSegment
rule: duct segment must have a cross-sectional flow area sufficient to convey the design airflow without exceeding maximum allowed velocity
conditions: duct is part of an active HVAC system
exceptions: duct segment used only as a placeholder or for clash detection in early design

subject: IfcDuctSegment
rule: duct segment must maintain minimum gauge thickness for its pressure class and material
conditions: duct is fabricated from sheet metal
duct is part of a pressure-rated air distribution system
exceptions: flexible duct segments
non-metallic duct segments rated by manufacturer for equivalent structural performance

subject: IfcDuctSegment
rule: duct segment must not have an aspect ratio that exceeds manufacturer or code limits for the given material and reinforcement
conditions: rectangular duct cross-section

subject: IfcDuctSegment
rule: duct segment must be connected at both ends to compatible fittings or equipment unless it is a terminal section
conditions: duct segment is part of a continuous air distribution network
exceptions: duct segment terminates at an air terminal device (diffuser, grille, register)
duct segment is a capped stub-out for future connection

subject: IfcElectricTimeControl
rule: IfcElectricTimeControl must be installed within its rated environmental conditions (temperature, humidity, and ingress protection)
conditions: When the device is in service

subject: IfcElectricTimeControl
rule: IfcElectricTimeControl must not be subjected to voltage or current exceeding its rated electrical specifications
conditions: When the device is energized

subject: IfcElectricTimeControl
rule: IfcElectricTimeControl must have its enclosure properly grounded (earthed) if the enclosure is metallic and the device operates at hazardous voltage levels
conditions: When the device enclosure is metallic
When the operating voltage exceeds safe extra-low voltage (typically >50V AC or >120V DC)
exceptions: Double-insulated devices with non-conductive enclosures

subject: IfcElementAssemblyType
rule: An IfcElementAssemblyType must have a valid predefined type defined in the schema enumeration (e.g., STRING, USERDEFINED, NOTDEFINED).
conditions: When the PredefinedType attribute is set to a non-null value
exceptions: If the PredefinedType is NOTDEFINED, the assembly may have its type defined elsewhere or left intentionally abstract

subject: IfcEnergyConversionDevice
rule: IfcEnergyConversionDevice must be connected to a valid energy source or energy distribution system
conditions: When the device is installed and intended to be operational
exceptions: Devices installed purely for demonstration or decommissioned devices

subject: IfcEnergyConversionDevice
rule: IfcEnergyConversionDevice must not have conflicting flow directions that prevent intended energy transfer
conditions: When the device has defined inlet and outlet ports for fluid or energy flow
exceptions: Bidirectional devices specifically designed for reversible operation (e.g., reversible heat pumps)

subject: IfcEngine
rule: Engine must have an air intake and exhaust path to surrounding environment or ventilation system
conditions: Engine is internal combustion type
Engine is installed in enclosed space
exceptions: Engine is purely electric (no combustion cycle)
Engine is designed for submerged/underwater operation with closed-loop breathing apparatus

subject: IfcEngine
rule: Engine must not operate without adequate lubrication oil
conditions: Engine has moving mechanical parts that require lubrication
exceptions: Hermetically sealed magnetic bearing engines with no contact surfaces

subject: IfcEngine
rule: Engine must not exceed its rated maximum operating temperature
conditions: Engine is in operation
exceptions: Engine is designed with sacrificial thermal shutdown mechanisms that are part of normal operation

subject: IfcEngine
rule: Engine fuel supply must be compatible with engine design specifications
conditions: Engine is combustion-based (internal or external)

subject: IfcEvaporativeCooler
rule: Evaporative cooler must have a continuous water supply connection
conditions: If the cooler uses water-based evaporative cooling medium
exceptions: Direct evaporative coolers that use disposable media pads and are manually refilled

subject: IfcEvaporativeCooler
rule: Evaporative cooler must not have air intake located in a confined space lacking fresh air
conditions: If the cooler draws outdoor air for ventilation
exceptions: Recirculating units that only condition indoor air without fresh air intake

subject: IfcEvaporativeCooler
rule: Evaporative cooler sump must contain water during operation
conditions: If the cooler is a recirculating evaporative cooler with a sump tank

subject: IfcEvaporativeCooler
rule: Evaporative cooler bleed-off or drain line must not be blocked
conditions: If the cooler has a continuous bleed system to control mineral buildup

subject: IfcExtrudedAreaSolid
rule: IfcExtrudedAreaSolid must have a non-zero extrusion depth

subject: IfcExtrudedAreaSolid
rule: IfcExtrudedAreaSolid's ExtrudedDirection must not be parallel to the plane of the SweptArea

subject: IfcFanType
rule: IfcFanType must have a defined Performance (e.g., pressure and flow rate) that matches the design requirements of the air distribution system
conditions: When the fan is part of an HVAC system intended to move air

subject: IfcFanType
rule: IfcFanType must not have an assigned motor power rating less than the minimum required to drive the fan at its design operating point
conditions: When motor power is specified in the model

subject: IfcFanType
rule: IfcFanType must have airflow direction that is physically consistent with the connected ductwork and terminal devices
conditions: When connected to duct segments or air terminals in the model

subject: IfcFanType
rule: IfcFanType must not have a rotational speed (RPM) that exceeds the structural limit of the fan impeller material
conditions: When rotational speed is specified

subject: IfcFilter
rule: IfcFilter must be installed in the correct orientation (flow direction arrows must align with intended flow path)
conditions: filter is directional (e.g., in-line strainer or Y-filter)
exceptions: non-directional filter types (e.g., some basket strainers with symmetrical design)

subject: IfcFilter
rule: IfcFilter must have a mesh or strainer element rated for the operating pressure and temperature of the system
conditions: filter is installed in a pressurized piping system

subject: IfcFilter
rule: IfcFilter must not be installed in a location where it is inaccessible for cleaning or replacement
exceptions: filters designed for permanent/sealed service with no maintenance requirement

subject: IfcFireSuppressionTerminal
rule: IfcFireSuppressionTerminal must be connected to a fire suppression piping network
conditions: When the terminal is installed and intended to be operational

subject: IfcFireSuppressionTerminal
rule: IfcFireSuppressionTerminal must not be obstructed by building elements or finishes within its designed discharge pattern
conditions: When the terminal is active and intended to provide coverage
exceptions: Obstructions explicitly accounted for in the hydraulic design and coverage calculation with adjusted terminal placement or type

subject: IfcFireSuppressionTerminal
rule: IfcFireSuppressionTerminal must have a clear thermal activation zone (for fusible-link or glass-bulb types)
conditions: When the terminal is a thermally activated type (sprinkler head with fusible element)
exceptions: Terminals that are not thermally activated (e.g., pre-action or deluge nozzles, gaseous agent nozzles)

subject: IfcFlowFitting
rule: IfcFlowFitting must preserve continuity of flow through its connected ports
conditions: when the flow fitting is part of a piping or ducting system
exceptions: when the flow fitting is explicitly designed as a blanking cap, plug, or closed valve that intentionally blocks flow

subject: IfcFlowFitting
rule: IfcFlowFitting must maintain pressure integrity at all joints and connections
conditions: when the fitting is installed in a pressure-containing system (fluid, gas, or air)
exceptions: vents or drain fittings specifically designed to be open to atmosphere

subject: IfcFlowFitting
rule: IfcFlowFitting must not have conflicting port directions that prevent physical connection to adjacent elements
conditions: when the fitting has more than one port

subject: IfcFlowMeter
rule: IfcFlowMeter must be installed in a pipe or duct segment where the flow direction is clearly defined and matches the meter's rated direction
conditions: The flow meter is installed in a piping or ducting system
exceptions: Flow meters designed for bidirectional measurement

subject: IfcFlowMeter
rule: IfcFlowMeter must not be installed at a location where the flow profile is severely disturbed by upstream fittings (e.g., elbows, valves, reducers) without adequate straight pipe run
conditions: The flow meter uses a technology sensitive to velocity profile (e.g., turbine, ultrasonic, differential pressure)
exceptions: Flow meters with built-in flow conditioners or those specifically rated for zero straight-run installation

subject: IfcFlowMeter
rule: IfcFlowMeter must be rated for the maximum operating pressure and temperature of the fluid in the system

subject: IfcFlowMovingDeviceType
rule: IfcFlowMovingDeviceType must not be assigned a material that is incompatible with the fluid it moves
conditions: Material assignment exists

subject: IfcFlowMovingDeviceType
rule: IfcFlowMovingDeviceType must have a pressure rating that covers the maximum system operating pressure
conditions: Pressure rating is specified

subject: IfcFlowSegment
rule: IfcFlowSegment must have a defined flow direction (e.g., via its placement or connected port orientation) to ensure fluid or energy flow continuity
conditions: When the flow segment is connected in a distribution system (e.g., piping, ducting, cable carrier)
exceptions: Segments that serve only as placeholder or conceptual representations without intended operation

subject: IfcFlowSegment
rule: IfcFlowSegment must not have conflicting connectivity (e.g., both ends connected to supply without a return path in a closed-loop system)
conditions: When the segment is part of a closed-loop fluid distribution system
exceptions: Open-ended segments such as drains or vents where one end is intentionally unconnected

subject: IfcFlowSegmentType
rule: IfcFlowSegmentType must have a predefined type that is consistent with its assigned flow direction
conditions: entity is used in a flow distribution system
exceptions: when the flow segment is bidirectional by design (e.g., a pipe that can carry flow in either direction)

subject: IfcFlowSegmentType
rule: IfcFlowSegmentType must not have a nominal diameter or cross-section dimension of zero or negative value
conditions: entity has a nominal diameter or cross-sectional width/height defined

subject: IfcFlowSegmentType
rule: IfcFlowSegmentType must be assigned a material that is physically capable of containing or conveying the intended flow medium
conditions: the flow medium (fluid, gas, solid) is specified or can be inferred from the system type
exceptions: when the segment is a placeholder or undefined type during early design stages with no medium assigned

subject: IfcFlowTerminal
rule: IfcFlowTerminal must be connected to a distribution flow system (e.g., piping, ductwork, or cable tray) to convey the intended fluid, air, or signal
conditions: When the IfcFlowTerminal is part of a building services system
exceptions: IfcFlowTerminal used purely as a decorative element not intended to convey any substance or energy

subject: IfcFlowTerminal
rule: IfcFlowTerminal must not have its flow path fully blocked by solid construction that prevents any substance or energy transfer
conditions: When the terminal is specified as active (not blanked-off or capped for future use)
exceptions: Temporary caps or blanks explicitly intended for future connection

subject: IfcFlowTreatmentDevice
rule: Flow treatment device must be connected to a piping or ductwork system at its inlet and outlet ports
conditions: device is designed for fluid or gas flow
device has defined inlet/outlet ports
exceptions: device is a standalone portable unit with no permanent connections

subject: IfcFlowTreatmentDevice
rule: Flow treatment device must not have its flow direction reversed relative to its designed orientation
conditions: device has a manufacturer-specified directional orientation
device is installed inline
exceptions: device is explicitly designed as bi-directional

subject: IfcFlowTreatmentDevice
rule: Flow treatment device must be installed in a location physically accessible for maintenance and replacement
conditions: device contains serviceable components such as replaceable media, moving parts, or access panels
exceptions: device is a disposable non-serviceable component designed for full replacement without access

subject: IfcFooting
rule: IfcFooting must be placed on soil or engineered ground capable of supporting its design load without excessive settlement or bearing failure
conditions: When footing is cast in situ or placed directly on ground
exceptions: Footings on pile caps or deep foundations where load is transferred to deeper strata

subject: IfcFooting
rule: IfcFooting must have minimum dimensions and reinforcement sufficient to resist tensile and shear forces from applied loads
conditions: When the footing is made of reinforced concrete
exceptions: Plain concrete footings in very light, low-rise construction where tensile stresses are negligible per code

subject: IfcFooting
rule: IfcFooting must not be founded on frozen ground or ground subject to freeze-thaw without being placed below frost depth
conditions: In climates where seasonal ground freezing occurs
exceptions: Where ground is artificially stabilized or insulated to prevent frost heave

subject: IfcFooting
rule: IfcFooting must have a thickness sufficient to spread the concentrated load from column or wall to the soil at an angle not steeper than the allowable load spread
conditions: For isolated spread footings or strip footings
exceptions: Deep pile caps where load transfer mechanism does not rely on soil bearing angle

subject: IfcFootingType
rule: footing must be founded on load-bearing soil or engineered fill with adequate bearing capacity
conditions: IfcFootingType is used as a structural foundation element

subject: IfcFootingType
rule: footing must extend below the frost depth in frost-susceptible climates
conditions: site is located in a climate with seasonal ground freezing
exceptions: site uses frost-protected shallow foundation design with insulation per engineered design

subject: IfcFootingType
rule: footing must have minimum dimensions and reinforcement proportioned to resist the applied loads and moments

subject: IfcFootingType
rule: footing must not be placed on organic or uncompacted fill without engineered remediation
exceptions: organic soil or uncompacted fill is removed and replaced with engineered structural fill

subject: IfcHalfSpaceSolid
rule: IfcHalfSpaceSolid must be planar
conditions: entity is used as a solid representation in boolean operations

subject: IfcHeatExchanger
rule: Heat exchanger coils and fins must not be blocked or fouled to the extent that adequate heat transfer is prevented
conditions: when installed in HVAC system
when used for heating or cooling transfer
exceptions: temporary conditions during commissioning or testing

subject: IfcHeatExchanger
rule: Heat exchanger must maintain separation between fluid streams to prevent cross-contamination
conditions: when fluids are of different types (e.g. water and refrigerant, or potable and non-potable water)
exceptions: intentional heat recovery configurations where controlled mixing is part of design

subject: IfcHeatExchanger
rule: Heat exchanger must not be operated at temperatures or pressures exceeding its rated design limits
conditions: during normal continuous operation
exceptions: short-duration transient conditions within safety factors per applicable code

subject: IfcHeatExchangerType
rule: A heat exchanger must have at least one fluid inlet and one fluid outlet connection to allow thermal energy transfer between fluids
conditions: Used as a standalone unit in an HVAC system
exceptions: Factory-sealed and pre-charged units where connections are internalized

subject: IfcHeatExchangerType
rule: Heat exchanger tubes or plates must be made of materials with sufficient thermal conductivity to enable heat transfer

subject: IfcHeatExchangerType
rule: Heat exchanger must maintain a pressure boundary between the two fluid streams to prevent cross-contamination
conditions: The two fluids must not mix (non-contact heat exchanger)
exceptions: Direct contact heat exchangers where mixing is intentional

subject: IfcIShapeProfileDef
rule: For an I-shape profile, the web thickness must be less than the flange width to maintain structural stability under bending
conditions: IfcIShapeProfileDef is used as a structural member cross-section

subject: IfcIShapeProfileDef
rule: The overall depth of the I-shape profile must be greater than the flange thickness
conditions: IfcIShapeProfileDef is used as a load-bearing cross-section

subject: IfcHumidifier
rule: IfcHumidifier must have a water supply connection
conditions: The humidifier is not a steam-to-steam type

subject: IfcHumidifier
rule: IfcHumidifier must have a drain connection for condensate or excess water
conditions: The humidifier uses liquid water or produces condensate during operation
exceptions: Direct steam injection humidifiers that introduce dry steam without condensation may not need a drain

subject: IfcHumidifier
rule: IfcHumidifier must be installed in a location where ambient temperature is above freezing
conditions: The humidifier uses liquid water
exceptions: Humidifiers with built-in freeze protection or designed for outdoor cold climates with heated enclosures

subject: IfcHumidifier
rule: IfcHumidifier must not be installed directly upstream of duct-mounted smoke detectors without adequate distance or air mixing
conditions: The humidifier discharges visible moisture droplets or steam into an air duct

subject: IfcHumidifier
rule: IfcHumidifier must have access clearance for maintenance (filter change, scale removal, component replacement)
conditions: The humidifier has consumable or serviceable components (e.g., pads, cylinders, electrodes)

subject: IfcJunctionBox
rule: IfcJunctionBox must provide adequate electrical continuity across all connected conductors
conditions: when used in electrical power or grounding circuits
exceptions: junction boxes used solely as pull boxes with no intention of maintaining continuity

subject: IfcJunctionBox
rule: IfcJunctionBox must not allow ingress of water or moisture beyond rated IP level
conditions: when installed in damp, wet, or outdoor environments
exceptions: junction boxes explicitly rated for wet locations that allow controlled drainage

subject: IfcJunctionBox
rule: IfcJunctionBox must have a removable cover that provides access to internal terminations
exceptions: factory-sealed junction boxes where terminations are not intended to be field-accessible

subject: IfcJunctionBox
rule: IfcJunctionBox must be constructed of material (metal or non-metallic) rated for the maximum operating temperature and environment

subject: IfcLamp
rule: IfcLamp must be connected to an electrical circuit providing appropriate voltage and current
conditions: when the lamp is intended to be electrically powered
exceptions: self-powered lamps with integrated batteries
solar-powered lamps with integrated photovoltaic cells and energy storage

subject: IfcLamp
rule: IfcLamp must have a rated power that does not exceed the maximum capacity of its connected electrical circuit
conditions: when connected to a building electrical distribution system
exceptions: lamps with dedicated independent circuits designed for that specific load

subject: IfcLamp
rule: IfcLamp must be installed at a location that does not create a fire hazard due to heat emission
conditions: when the lamp type emits significant heat (e.g., incandescent, halogen, high-intensity discharge)
exceptions: lamps with integrated thermal protection and listed for installation in close proximity to combustible materials

subject: IfcLamp
rule: IfcLamp must be rated for the environmental conditions of its installation location
conditions: when installed outdoors
when installed in wet or damp locations
when installed in hazardous (classified) locations

subject: IfcLamp
rule: IfcLamp must have a secure mechanical attachment to its supporting structure
conditions: when the lamp is not a portable/freestanding type
exceptions: portable lamps and task lights that are designed to rest on surfaces without permanent attachment

subject: IfcLightFixture
rule: IfcLightFixture must be securely attached to a supporting structure (e.g., ceiling, wall, pole, or mounting bracket)

subject: IfcLightFixture
rule: IfcLightFixture must not have electrical live parts exposed to inadvertent human contact

subject: IfcLightFixture
rule: IfcLightFixture must not exceed its rated maximum wattage / power load

subject: IfcLightFixture
rule: IfcLightFixture must be connected to an electrical supply circuit that matches its voltage and current rating

subject: IfcMaterialLayerSet
rule: Material layers in an IfcMaterialLayerSet must not have zero or negative thickness values
conditions: When the IfcMaterialLayerSet is used in a building element requiring physical layers (e.g., walls, slabs, roofs)
exceptions: Conceptual design phases where thickness is not yet determined (though typically then the layer would be omitted or set to a placeholder value, not zero thickness in a physical sense)

subject: IfcMaterialLayerSet
rule: Material layers within an IfcMaterialLayerSet must be ordered sequentially from the outer side to the inner side of the element they belong to
conditions: When the IfcMaterialLayerSet is assigned to an element with a defined interior and exterior orientation (e.g., walls, roofs, floors)
exceptions: Elements where layer ordering is not semantically meaningful (e.g., a homogeneous block where layers are purely informational and have no spatial ordering)

subject: IfcMaterialLayerSet
rule: IfcMaterialLayerSet must not contain duplicate material layer definitions that conflict in position or thickness within the same layer set
conditions: When the IfcMaterialLayerSet describes a physical building element assembly

subject: IfcMechanicalFastener
rule: IfcMechanicalFastener must have a defined nominal diameter or thread size consistent with its intended use
conditions: fastener type is threaded (e.g., bolt, screw)
exceptions: non-threaded fasteners such as nails, pins, or clips

subject: IfcMechanicalFastener
rule: IfcMechanicalFastener must not have a nominal length shorter than the total thickness of the materials it joins
conditions: fastener penetrates multiple layers of material
exceptions: fasteners designed for partial penetration such as set screws or dowels

subject: IfcMember
rule: IfcMember must transfer structural loads between connected elements
conditions: ifc_member is used in load-bearing context
exceptions: non-structural decorative members explicitly classified as such

subject: IfcMember
rule: IfcMember must not have abrupt cross-section changes that cause stress concentrations exceeding material capacity
conditions: ifc_member is subjected to significant axial or bending loads

subject: IfcMember
rule: IfcMember must have its local placement and axis aligned with its structural function
conditions: ifc_member participates in an analytical structural model

subject: IfcMemberStandardCase
rule: IfcMemberStandardCase must have a defined cross-section profile (MaterialProfileSetUsage) consistent with its structural analysis model
conditions: When the member is used in a load-bearing context
When the member participates in structural analysis

subject: IfcMemberStandardCase
rule: IfcMemberStandardCase must not have a varying cross-section along its length (it must be prismatic)

subject: IfcMemberStandardCase
rule: IfcMemberStandardCase must have its axis representation as a curve (IfcCurve) defining the member's structural line

subject: IfcMemberType
rule: IfcMemberType must have a defined cross-section profile
conditions: If the member is used in a load-bearing context
exceptions: Non-structural decorative members

subject: IfcMemberType
rule: IfcMemberType must not have a zero-length or negative-length definition

subject: IfcMemberType
rule: IfcMemberType assigned to an element must have material assignment compatible with structural loading
conditions: If the member is part of a load-bearing structure
exceptions: Members used solely for spatial demarcation or architectural finish

subject: IfcObjectDefinition
rule: Each IfcObjectDefinition that is a direct or indirect subtype of IfcProduct and has a placement (ObjectPlacement) must have a consistent coordinate system without conflicting placement definitions
conditions: The IfcObjectDefinition is a subtype of IfcProduct
The IfcObjectDefinition has an ObjectPlacement attribute defined
exceptions: IfcObjectDefinition instances that do not have physical placement (e.g., IfcProcess, IfcActor, IfcControl subtypes)

subject: IfcObjectDefinition
rule: Any IfcObjectDefinition that specializes as IfcElement (subtype) in a spatial containment relationship must have exactly one container (ContainedInStructure) or be declared as being in a spatial structure
conditions: The IfcObjectDefinition is a subtype of IfcElement
The IfcObjectDefinition participates in a spatial decomposition
exceptions: IfcElement subtypes used as standalone or aggregated without spatial context (conceptual elements not placed in a project)

subject: IfcObjectDefinition
rule: IfcObjectDefinition subtypes that define an object identity (via Name or GlobalId) must not have duplicate GlobalId values within the same model
conditions: The IfcObjectDefinition has a defined GlobalId attribute

subject: IfcOpeningElement
rule: IfcOpeningElement must not eliminate the structural load-bearing capacity of the host element
conditions: Host element is load-bearing
exceptions: The opening is specifically designed as part of a structural system that redistributes loads around it (e.g., a planned door or window opening in a shear wall with lintels/headers)

subject: IfcOpeningElement
rule: IfcOpeningElement must have a clear height and width that allow intended passage or function
conditions: Opening is intended for occupancy egress, accessibility, or equipment access
exceptions: Decorative or purely visual openings that are not intended for physical passage

subject: IfcOpeningElement
rule: IfcOpeningElement must not create an unprotected edge fall hazard
conditions: Opening is in a horizontal or sloped floor/roof assembly
Opening is at a height above grade where a fall could cause injury
exceptions: Opening is fitted with a guardrail, balustrade, or cover that permanently prevents falls

subject: IfcPileType
rule: pile must have load-bearing capacity sufficient for its design load
conditions: pile is structural

subject: IfcPileType
rule: pile material must be compatible with ground conditions (e.g., no untreated timber in perpetually wet conditions that cause rot unless chemically treated)
conditions: pile uses timber
exceptions: pile uses chemically treated timber rated for wet ground conditions

subject: IfcPileType
rule: pile must not extend above the cutoff elevation without a structural connection to the pile cap or foundation element
conditions: pile is a structural pile
exceptions: pile is designed as a batter pile that terminates above cutoff for a specific structural purpose

subject: IfcPile
rule: pile must transfer load to a bearing stratum (rock or dense soil) capable of supporting the design load without excessive settlement
conditions: pile is end-bearing or friction pile

subject: IfcPile
rule: pile must not be installed with a deviation from vertical alignment exceeding the structural design tolerance (typically 1:75 for vertical piles)
conditions: pile is designed as vertical
exceptions: piles specifically designed as battered (raked) piles where intentional inclination is part of the design

subject: IfcPile
rule: pile material (concrete, steel, timber) must have sufficient strength and durability for the in-service exposure conditions (e.g., sulphate attack, corrosion, freeze-thaw)
exceptions: piles with protective coatings or cathodic protection designed to mitigate exposure

subject: IfcPile
rule: pile length must be sufficient to develop the required geotechnical resistance (skin friction and/or end bearing) per the geotechnical design

subject: IfcPile
rule: pile spacing (center-to-center) must not be less than the minimum specified in the applicable standard (typically 2.5 × pile diameter or 1.0 m minimum) to avoid group interaction effects that reduce individual pile capacity
conditions: pile group with two or more piles
exceptions: spacing reduced per specific geotechnical analysis confirming acceptable group efficiency

subject: IfcPipeFittingType
rule: Pipe fitting connections must be compatible with the connected pipe system's pressure rating
conditions: fitting is part of a pressure-rated piping system
exceptions: non-pressure applications such as gravity drainage

subject: IfcPipeFittingType
rule: Pipe fitting nominal diameter must match the connected pipes' nominal diameter
exceptions: use of reducer or increaser fittings explicitly designed for diameter transitions

subject: IfcPipeFittingType
rule: Pipe fitting end type must be compatible with the adjacent pipe end type
exceptions: use of adaptor fittings explicitly designed to transition between end types

subject: IfcPipeFittingType
rule: Pipe fitting must not exceed the maximum operating temperature of its material
conditions: fitting material has a known temperature limit

subject: IfcPipeFitting
rule: IfcPipeFitting must have its nominal diameter (NominalDiameter or OverallDiameter) defined and match connected pipe diameters of the same system
conditions: The pipe fitting is part of a connected piping system with at least one adjacent pipe segment
exceptions: Fittings used as blanks/caps with no flow through
Fittings with explicit reducer/transition classification where diameter change is intended

subject: IfcPipeFitting
rule: IfcPipeFitting must not have a flow direction assigned that is physically impossible given its geometry type
conditions: The fitting is an elbow, tee, cross, or wye type where internal geometry directs flow
exceptions: Multi-purpose fittings with symmetric internal passages where any direction is valid

subject: IfcPipeFitting
rule: IfcPipeFitting must have at least one port/connector defined when it is not a void/plug type
conditions: The fitting is installed in an active piping system meaning it is not stored/unplaced
exceptions: Fittings classified explicitly as caps, plugs, or blind flanges that terminate a line with no further connection

subject: IfcPipeSegment
rule: IfcPipeSegment must have a continuous open internal bore along its entire length to allow fluid flow
exceptions: Plugs or caps designed to block flow

subject: IfcPipeSegment
rule: IfcPipeSegment must be leak-tight under its rated internal pressure
exceptions: Open drains or unpressised vent lines where leakage to atmosphere is intentional

subject: IfcPipeSegment
rule: IfcPipeSegment must_not have a nominal diameter smaller than the minimum required for its intended flow capacity
conditions: When the pipe segment is part of a pressure or gravity flow system
exceptions: Temporary bypass lines where flow is not the primary function

subject: IfcPlateStandardCase
rule: IfcPlateStandardCase must have a valid defined geometry (e.g., extrusion or swept solid) consistent with its reference to an IfcMaterialLayerSetUsage or IfcPlateType
conditions: When the plate is used in a building element assembly such as a wall, floor, or roof
exceptions: If the plate is defined only as a footprint outline without extruded shape in early design stages, where the geometry representation remains undefined or 'NotDefined'

subject: IfcPlateStandardCase
rule: IfcPlateStandardCase must have an associated material via IfcMaterialLayerSetUsage or directly through its type definition
conditions: When the building model requires material quantification, structural analysis, or thermal simulation
exceptions: Conceptual design models where material assignment is deferred

subject: IfcPlateStandardCase
rule: IfcPlateStandardCase must not be assigned a non-linear/curved geometric profile that conflicts with its 'StandardCase' layered semantics
conditions: When the plate is intended to represent a planar building element in a layered assembly
exceptions: Curved plates explicitly modeled as IfcPlate (not StandardCase) or where the layered material can conform to the curvature per manufacturer specifications

subject: IfcPolyLoop
rule: IfcPolyLoop must have at least 3 distinct points to form a closed polygon in 3D space
conditions: The entity is used as a vertex-based boundary representation

subject: IfcProject
rule: project must have a valid unit of measure assigned
conditions: if the project involves physical quantities

subject: IfcProject
rule: project must have a valid coordinate system / georeferencing
conditions: if the project contains spatially located elements

subject: IfcProtectiveDeviceType
rule: A protective device must have a rated breaking capacity that exceeds the maximum prospective fault current at its installation point
conditions: Device is a circuit breaker or fuse
Device is installed in an electrical power system
exceptions: Devices installed in series with current-limiting upstream devices where coordinated selectivity is documented

subject: IfcProtectiveDeviceType
rule: A protective device must not be installed in a circuit where its continuous current rating is lower than the maximum continuous load current
conditions: Device is used for overcurrent protection
exceptions: Devices designed specifically for motor starting or inrush-tolerant applications where time-delay characteristics accommodate short-duration overloads

subject: IfcProtectiveDeviceType
rule: A protective device must have its short-circuit current rating (SCCR) equal to or greater than the available fault current at the point of installation
conditions: Device is installed in a panelboard or load center
Installation follows UL/IEC standards

subject: IfcPump
rule: Pump must have a discharge outlet to allow fluid ejection
conditions: IfcPump is used for fluid transport
exceptions: Circulator pumps in closed loops where discharge is internal to the system

subject: IfcPump
rule: Pump must have a suction (inlet) connection
conditions: IfcPump is used for fluid transport

subject: IfcPump
rule: Pump must not operate without fluid (dry run)
conditions: IfcPump is a centrifugal or positive-displacement pump
exceptions: Self-priming or specially designed dry-run pumps with lubrication-seal cooling

subject: IfcPump
rule: Pump impeller must rotate within the casing without contact
conditions: IfcPump has an impeller

subject: IfcRailing
rule: IfcRailing must have handrails when serving as a stair or ramp guard
conditions: railing serves as a stair guard
railing serves as a ramp guard
open-sided walking surface with drop exceeding 600 mm
exceptions: private single-family dwelling stair with total rise less than 600 mm

subject: IfcRailing
rule: IfcRailing must have infill (balusters, mesh, or panels) preventing passage of a 100 mm sphere
conditions: railing height exceeds 300 mm above adjacent walking surface
railing is located on a stair, balcony, or mezzanine
exceptions: railing with solid knee wall or parapet that substitutes infill
railing entirely within a dwelling unit where 100 mm sphere rule does not apply per local code

subject: IfcRailing
rule: IfcRailing must be continuous for the full extent of the open side it guards
conditions: railing guards a floor or roof opening
railing guards a stairway edge
exceptions: intentional gate or access opening where alternative safety barrier is provided

subject: IfcRailing
rule: IfcRailing must not project into required egress path width
conditions: railing is adjacent to an egress corridor, stair landing, or exit passageway
exceptions: handrail projections up to 90 mm into the clear width are permitted by egress codes

subject: IfcRamp
rule: ramp slope must not exceed 1:12 (8.33%) for accessible pedestrian ramps
conditions: ramp is intended for pedestrian accessibility
exceptions: ramps in existing buildings where structural constraints prevent compliance, subject to local code variance

subject: IfcRamp
rule: ramp must have landings at top and bottom with length at least 1.5m (60in)
conditions: ramp rise exceeds 150mm (6in)

subject: IfcRamp
rule: ramp surface must be slip-resistant

subject: IfcRamp
rule: ramp must have handrails on both sides when rise exceeds 150mm
conditions: ramp rise exceeds 150mm
exceptions: single-step ramps or curb ramps where handrails would obstruct use

subject: IfcRamp
rule: ramp must not have a slope steeper than 1:6 for vehicular ramps
conditions: ramp is intended for vehicle traffic

subject: IfcRampFlight
rule: Ramp flight must have a non-slip walking surface
conditions: If the ramp flight is intended for pedestrian use
exceptions: Service ramps or maintenance-only ramps where pedestrian traffic is prohibited

subject: IfcRampFlight
rule: Ramp flight must have a maximum slope not exceeding the code-prespecified angle (typically 1:12 for accessible routes)
conditions: If the ramp flight is part of an accessible pedestrian path of travel

subject: IfcRampFlight
rule: Ramp flight must have handrails on at least one side when the rise exceeds a threshold (typically 150 mm)
conditions: If the ramp flight has a total rise greater than the applicable building code threshold

subject: IfcRampFlight
rule: Ramp flight must not have a change in cross-slope that creates a tripping hazard

subject: IfcRampFlightType
rule: ramp flight must have a slope that does not exceed the maximum allowable gradient for accessible egress
conditions: when used as an accessible means of egress
when designed for wheelchair accessibility
exceptions: service ramps not intended for public or accessible use

subject: IfcRampFlightType
rule: ramp flight must have a minimum clear width adequate for passage of a wheelchair
conditions: when used for accessible pedestrian circulation

subject: IfcRampFlightType
rule: ramp flight must not have a change in slope direction without an intermediate landing
conditions: when the ramp flight turns or changes direction

subject: IfcRampFlightType
rule: ramp flight must have a slip-resistant surface

subject: IfcRampType
rule: ramp slope must not exceed the maximum allowable gradient for accessibility
conditions: when used for pedestrian access
when required to comply with accessibility standards
exceptions: when专用的车辆坡道有不同坡度要求

subject: IfcRampType
rule: ramp must have landings at top and bottom
conditions: when ramp length exceeds the maximum run without a landing
exceptions: very short ramps of less than one full step height

subject: IfcRampType
rule: ramp must have handrails on both sides
conditions: when ramp rise exceeds a threshold (typically 150mm or more)
exceptions: residential ramps serving a single dwelling in some jurisdictions

subject: IfcRampType
rule: ramp surface must be slip-resistant
conditions: when ramp is exposed to weather or moisture

subject: IfcRampType
rule: ramp width must meet minimum clear width requirements
conditions: when ramp is intended for wheelchair access

subject: IfcReinforcingBar
rule: Reinforcing bar must have a minimum concrete cover to prevent corrosion and ensure fire resistance
conditions: Bar is embedded in concrete
Bar is exposed to environmental conditions or required to have fire rating
exceptions: Stainless steel or galvanized bars used in non-corrosive environments with specific engineering approval
Bars in non-structural applications with documented justification

subject: IfcReinforcingBar
rule: Reinforcing bar must not be bent or re-straightened in the field at diameters or radii below the minimum bend diameter specified by code
conditions: Bar is load-bearing reinforcement
Bar diameter exceeds minimum thresholds set by applicable code
exceptions: Factory-controlled bending per approved shop drawings at specified radii

subject: IfcReinforcingBar
rule: Reinforcing bar must have adequate lap splice length or mechanical/ welded connection to develop full tensile strength
conditions: Bars are spliced to transfer tensile forces
Splice is not a pre-approved full-tension mechanical coupler with documented capacity
exceptions: Bars detailed as compression-only where lap lengths may be reduced per code
Bars with certified full-tension mechanical couplers approved by engineer

subject: IfcReinforcingElement
rule: Reinforcing element must have a defined material grade (e.g., steel grade) for structural design
conditions: Used in load-bearing structural concrete or masonry
exceptions: Temporary or non-structural reinforcement that is not required to carry design loads

subject: IfcReinforcingElement
rule: Reinforcing element must not have a cross-sectional area of zero or undefined
conditions: When represented as a bar, wire, mesh, or tendon for structural analysis

subject: IfcReinforcingElement
rule: Reinforcing element must have its axis/alignment defined in relation to the host element
conditions: When the element is embedded in concrete or masonry and expected to resist structural forces
exceptions: Non-directional elements such as fibers in fiber-reinforced concrete

subject: IfcReinforcingMesh
rule: IfcReinforcingMesh must have a defined cross-sectional area and material properties to perform structural reinforcement
conditions: when used as structural reinforcement in concrete elements
exceptions: when the mesh is defined as a placeholder or proxy in an early design stage

subject: IfcReinforcingMesh
rule: IfcReinforcingMesh must not have overlapping or conflicting placement that would cause physical interference with other reinforcement or embedments
conditions: when multiple reinforcing meshes are placed in the same concrete element
exceptions: when the overlap is intentional and accounted for in design (e.g., lapped mesh sheets)

subject: IfcReinforcingElementType
rule: The reinforcement cross-sectional area must meet or exceed the minimum required by structural design codes for the given loading conditions
conditions: When used as primary load-bearing reinforcement

subject: IfcReinforcingElementType
rule: Reinforcing elements must be fabricated from materials with sufficient yield strength and ductility to resist design loads without brittle fracture

subject: IfcReinforcingElementType
rule: Concrete cover over the reinforcing element must not be less than the minimum specified by structural codes for fire resistance and corrosion protection
conditions: When embedded in concrete
exceptions: Stainless steel or galvanized reinforcement where reduced cover is permitted by code

subject: IfcReinforcingElementType
rule: The spacing between adjacent reinforcing bars must not exceed the maximum allowable spacing for crack control as specified by structural design codes
conditions: When used in tension zones of concrete members

subject: IfcRelConnectsPortToElement
rule: IfcRelConnectsPortToElement must connect a port to a distribution element or building element

subject: IfcRightCircularCylinder
rule: IfcRightCircularCylinder must not be used as a structural column without defining its material and cross-section properties
conditions: when used in a structural context
when assigned to a structural column occurrence

subject: IfcRoof
rule: roof must have a drainage path
conditions: roof has a horizontal or low-slope surface
roof is exposed to precipitation
exceptions: fully indoor roof structures not exposed to weather
temporary protective roofs that are manually drained

subject: IfcRoof
rule: roof must be able to support design loads (dead, live, snow, wind)
conditions: roof is part of a permanent building structure
exceptions: non-structural decorative roofs that carry no load beyond self-weight and are not accessible

subject: IfcRoof
rule: roof slope or waterproofing must prevent water ingress into the building interior
conditions: roof encloses conditioned or occupied space
exceptions: uncovered open roofs such as roof terraces designed as exterior space with below-deck drainage

subject: IfcRoof
rule: roof must not have standing water after 48 hours under normal weather conditions
conditions: roof is a low-slope or flat roof designed for drainage
exceptions: roofs specifically designed as ponds or water features for rainwater harvesting or cooling

subject: IfcRoofType
rule: roof must have a drainage path to prevent water accumulation
conditions: roof has a flat or low-slope geometry
roof is exposed to precipitation
exceptions: roof is an interior/atrium roof not exposed to weather
roof is designed as a green roof with integrated drainage layer

subject: IfcRoofType
rule: roof must be capable of resisting imposed loads (dead, live, snow, wind) without structural failure

subject: IfcRoofType
rule: roof must not allow uncontrolled water penetration into the building interior
conditions: roof forms the building envelope
exceptions: roof is a non-envelope element such as a decorative canopy with no occupied space below

subject: IfcRoofType
rule: roof must have sufficient thermal insulation to prevent condensation on interior surfaces
conditions: roof separates conditioned interior space from exterior climate
exceptions: roof covers unconditioned space such as an unheated porch or parking structure

subject: IfcSanitaryTerminalType
rule: sanitary terminal must have a water supply connection to function as a sanitary appliance
conditions: if the terminal is water-operated (e.g., toilet, urinal, sink, bidet)
exceptions: dry sanitary terminals such as waterless urinals that use trap seal alternatives or chemical toilets without permanent water supply

subject: IfcSanitaryTerminalType
rule: sanitary terminal must have a waste outlet connection to a drainage system
conditions: if the terminal collects and discharges liquid or solid waste
exceptions: portable or temporary sanitary units not connected to permanent drainage

subject: IfcSanitaryTerminalType
rule: sanitary terminal must not be installed without adequate ventilation for soil/ waste pipe systems
conditions: when the sanitary terminal is connected to a building drainage system that relies on venting to prevent siphonage and maintain trap seals
exceptions: terminals connected to vented drainage stacks where the appliance itself does not require independent venting

subject: IfcSanitaryTerminal
rule: Sanitary terminal must be connected to a drainage/waste water piping system
conditions: When installed and intended for use
exceptions: Temporary installation for construction phase
Decorative sanitary terminal not intended for functional use

subject: IfcSanitaryTerminal
rule: Sanitary terminal must be water-supplied or able to receive flushing water if it is a water-flush type
conditions: When the terminal type requires water for flushing or operation (e.g., water closet, urinal with flush valve, bidet)
exceptions: Dry sanitary terminals such as composting toilets or waterless urinals

subject: IfcSanitaryTerminal
rule: Sanitary terminal must not be installed in a location where its trap seal can be continuously siphoned or evaporated without provision for resealing
conditions: When the terminal includes a P-trap or S-trap as part of its design
exceptions: Terminals without an integral trap (e.g., some floor drains configured differently)

subject: IfcSimplePropertyTemplate
rule: IfcSimplePropertyTemplate must have a well-defined PropertyType and PrimaryMeasureType to enable proper property value assignment
conditions: when the template is used in a property set
exceptions: abstract or base templates that are meant for specialization only

subject: IfcSite
rule: IfcSite must have a defined elevation relative to a datum (e.g., site level or finished floor level) to prevent flooding and ensure drainage
conditions: Site is located in a flood-prone area or below adjacent grade
exceptions: Site is floating/offshore platform where elevation is not referenced to a fixed datum

subject: IfcSite
rule: IfcSite must have a valid site boundary (closed polyline or surface) for land-use, setback, and footprint compliance
conditions: Site is used for building placement and not an abstract reference point
exceptions: Site is an abstract geolocation marker (e.g., lat/lng point) with no intended cadastral boundary

subject: IfcSlab
rule: slab must have structural edge support or be designed as a two-way spanning slab
conditions: slab is horizontally spanning
slab is load-bearing
exceptions: slab is a non-structural topping/leveling screed
slab is a pre-cast plank with integral edge support

subject: IfcSlab
rule: slab must have minimum concrete cover to reinforcement per exposure class
conditions: slab is reinforced concrete
exceptions: slab is unreinforced mass concrete
slab is protected by permanent waterproofing membrane in design

subject: IfcSlab
rule: slab on grade must have a properly compacted sub-base with adequate bearing capacity
conditions: slab is a slab-on-grade or ground-bearing slab
exceptions: slab is suspended
slab is a structural raft foundation designed for poor soil

subject: IfcSlabType
rule: IfcSlabType must have a structural load path to its supports
conditions: When used as a load-bearing horizontal member (e.g., floor slab or roof slab)
exceptions: Non-load-bearing slabs such as finishes, topping screeds, or cladding panels

subject: IfcSlabType
rule: IfcSlabType must not have a zero or negative thickness in the load-bearing direction
conditions: When the slab type is structural (e.g., cast-in-place concrete slab, precast slab, composite deck)
exceptions: Non-structural slab types such as finish layers or floating floors

subject: IfcSlabStandardCase
rule: IfcSlabStandardCase used as a floor slab must have load-bearing capacity to support its intended design loads (dead, live, and environmental loads) without structural failure
conditions: The slab is used as a floor
exceptions: Slabs that are explicitly non-structural (e.g., decorative toppings) and not part of the load-bearing system

subject: IfcSlabStandardCase
rule: IfcSlabStandardCase used as a roof slab must provide a weathertight barrier that prevents water ingress into the building interior
conditions: The slab is used as a roof

subject: IfcSlabStandardCase
rule: IfcSlabStandardCase must not have a thickness of zero or negative value

subject: IfcSlabStandardCase
rule: IfcSlabStandardCase must have a material assignment that is physically feasible (e.g., concrete, steel, timber) and not assigned a non-physical material

subject: IfcSolarDevice
rule: IfcSolarDevice must not be fully shaded during peak solar hours
conditions: when installed on a roof or ground array
when designed for electricity generation
exceptions: if the device is a solar thermal collector for heating only (not PV)
if the system includes micro-inverters or power optimizers that mitigate partial shading

subject: IfcSolarDevice
rule: IfcSolarDevice must have a tilt angle that allows debris and water runoff
conditions: when installed in a fixed orientation
when located in a climate with precipitation or dust accumulation
exceptions: if the device is mounted on a vertical facade where self-cleaning is not expected
if the device has an active cleaning system

subject: IfcSolarDevice
rule: IfcSolarDevice must have electrical connectors rated for the device's maximum current and voltage
conditions: when the device produces electrical output
