exceptions: solar thermal collectors that do not produce electricity

subject: IfcSolarDevice
rule: IfcSolarDevice surface temperature must not exceed the rated operating temperature of its materials
conditions: when exposed to direct sunlight

subject: IfcSpace
rule: IfcSpace must have a minimum clear height for occupancy
conditions: IfcSpace is intended for human occupancy
exceptions: Plenum spaces
Crawl spaces
Service voids

subject: IfcSpace
rule: IfcSpace must not have a floor area of zero or negative

subject: IfcSpace
rule: IfcSpace must have at least one access opening
conditions: IfcSpace is a closed room or enclosed area
exceptions: Void spaces that are purely visual/analytical
Unenclosed outdoor spaces

subject: IfcSpace
rule: IfcSpace must not overlap geometrically with another IfcSpace
conditions: Spaces are defined in the same building storey
exceptions: Atrium spaces that intentionally share volume with adjacent spaces
Conceptual or analytical overlapping zone definitions

subject: IfcSpatialElement
rule: IfcSpatialElement must have a valid containment relationship (e.g., IfcRelContainedInSpatialStructure) that places it within exactly one spatial structure parent
conditions: when used in a building model context where spatial hierarchy is defined
exceptions: IfcSpatialElement subtypes that serve as top-level site or project containers

subject: IfcSpatialElement
rule: IfcSpatialElement must not have contradictory placement (e.g., zero-length or self-intersecting object placement) relative to its parent spatial structure
conditions: when the IfcSpatialElement has an ObjectPlacement defined

subject: IfcSpatialStructureElement
rule: IfcSpatialStructureElement must have a valid spatial containment relationship (e.g., building storey must contain spaces, or building must contain storeys) to remain logically consistent in the building model
conditions: When the element participates in a spatial decomposition hierarchy
When used in a valid IFC model
exceptions: If the element is a root-level spatial structure (e.g., 'IfcSite' or 'IfcBuilding' at the top of hierarchy with no parent container)

subject: IfcSpatialStructureElement
rule: IfcSpatialStructureElement must not contain circular spatial containment (a space cannot contain itself, directly or transitively)
conditions: When the spatial hierarchy contains more than one level

subject: IfcStackTerminal
rule: IfcStackTerminal must be open at the top to allow flue gas exit
conditions: when used as a chimney or flue terminal
exceptions: when serving a mechanical ventilation system that exhausts at low level through a side wall grille

subject: IfcStackTerminal
rule: IfcStackTerminal must not be installed below the minimum flue outlet height relative to adjacent roof surfaces
conditions: when serving a combustion appliance flue
exceptions: when explicitly designed with a powered exhaust fan and manufacturer-stated clearance distances

subject: IfcStackTerminalType
rule: IfcStackTerminalType must provide a clear unobstructed opening for stack exhaust or intake
conditions: When used as a termination for a plumbing or ventilation stack
exceptions: Systems where the stack terminal is designed as a sealed flue gas dilution device with dedicated forced draft

subject: IfcStackTerminalType
rule: IfcStackTerminalType must not have an internal geometry that creates a local trap or water-collecting pocket below the frost line
conditions: When installed in climates subject to freezing temperatures
exceptions: Terminals explicitly designed with freeze-prevention heating elements or self-draining geometry

subject: IfcStackTerminalType
rule: IfcStackTerminalType must be able to withstand wind-induced negative pressure without collapsing or permanently deforming
conditions: When the terminal projects above the roof surface and is exposed to external wind loads
exceptions: Terminals installed in fully sheltered positions where peak wind pressure is structurally negligible

subject: IfcStair
rule: IfcStair must have a minimum clear width of at least 800 mm for egress under building codes
conditions: stair is used as a means of egress
building occupancy type requires egress stairs
exceptions: private stairs within a single dwelling unit may have reduced width per local code

subject: IfcStair
rule: IfcStair must have riser heights between 100 mm and 200 mm (typical max 190 mm or 178 mm per code)
conditions: stair is intended for regular pedestrian use
exceptions: monumental stairs not used for routine circulation
service stairs with restricted access

subject: IfcStair
rule: IfcStair must have tread depths (going) of at least 250 mm (typical minimum 280 mm per code)
conditions: stair is intended for regular pedestrian use
exceptions: monumental stairs not used for routine circulation
service stairs with restricted access

subject: IfcStair
rule: IfcStair must have consistent riser height and tread depth within a single flight (variation ≤ 5 mm)
conditions: stair is intended for regular pedestrian use

subject: IfcStair
rule: IfcStair must have handrails on at least one side when total rise exceeds 0.5 m
conditions: stair is intended for regular pedestrian use
exceptions: private stairs within a single dwelling unit may have exceptions per local code

subject: IfcStair
rule: IfcStair must not have open risers where the opening between treads exceeds 100 mm
conditions: stair is in a building accessible to children under 5 years old
exceptions: stairs in areas not accessible to children (e.g., certain service areas)

subject: IfcStairFlight
rule: Stair flight must have a minimum tread depth of at least 200mm (for indoor service stairs) or 250mm (for main stairs) to provide safe foot placement
conditions: entity is used as an occupied stair for human circulation
exceptions: service ladders
catwalks not intended for regular pedestrian use
emergency escape stairs with special approval

subject: IfcStairFlight
rule: Stair flight must have a maximum riser height of 200mm (for indoor service stairs) or 180mm (for main stairs) to ensure safe ascent/descent
conditions: entity is used as an occupied stair for human circulation
exceptions: service ladders
catwalks not intended for regular pedestrian use

subject: IfcStairFlight
rule: Stair flight must have a minimum number of treads (at least 2 risers) to constitute a stair rather than a single step
conditions: entity is classified as a stair flight

subject: IfcStairFlight
rule: Stair flight must not have slopes steeper than 50 degrees from horizontal when used for pedestrian circulation
conditions: entity is used as an occupied stair for human circulation
exceptions: fixed ladders
ship ladders
dedicated service access only

subject: IfcStairFlight
rule: Stair flight must have nosings or contrasting edge marking on treads when used in public/commercial buildings
conditions: entity is part of a public or commercial building
entity is used for human circulation
exceptions: single-family residential stairs
private dwelling stairs

subject: IfcStairFlightType
rule: stair flight tread depth and riser height must satisfy the building code's dimensional relationship (2R + T within allowable range)
conditions: When used for means of egress
When serving occupied floors
exceptions: Monumental stairs not part of required egress
Servicing only machinery/equipment rooms

subject: IfcStairFlightType
rule: stair flight must not have inconsistent riser heights within the same flight
conditions: When flight serves as a required means of egress
exceptions: First or last riser may have a slight variation where local code allows (e.g., up to 3/8 inch)

subject: IfcStairFlightType
rule: stair flight must have minimum clear width as required by building code for occupant load served
conditions: When flight is part of an egress path
When serving more than a very small occupant load
exceptions: Stairs within a single dwelling unit

subject: IfcStairFlightType
rule: stair flight must have a landing if the total vertical rise exceeds the code-specified maximum (typically 12 feet)
conditions: When flight is a continuous run without intermediate landing

subject: IfcStructuralAnalysisModel
rule: IfcStructuralAnalysisModel must reference at least one IfcStructuralMember, IfcStructuralConnection, or IfcStructuralActivity via its assigned structural items
conditions: The model is intended to represent an analytical structural system
exceptions: When the analysis model is used only as a grouping container without physical structural elements (e.g., for documentation purposes)

subject: IfcStructuralAnalysisModel
rule: Loads assigned to an IfcStructuralAnalysisModel must be compatible with the analysis type specified in PredefinedType
conditions: The IfcStructuralAnalysisModel has a specified PredefinedType (e.g., LOADING_3D, LOADING_2D)
exceptions: When the PredefinedType is set to NOTDEFINED or NOTYETKNOWN

subject: IfcStructuralConnection
rule: IfcStructuralConnection must have its connectivity dimensionality defined (point, curve, or surface) to enable valid load transfer analysis
conditions: When used in structural analysis models
exceptions: Conceptual design stages where only topology is relevant

subject: IfcStructuralConnection
rule: IfcStructuralConnection must not have zero area or zero length definition when assigned to structural members with non-zero cross-sections
conditions: When the connection joins elements with defined physical cross-sections and is expected to transfer stress
exceptions: Point supports in idealized analysis models (e.g., pinned supports with no physical extent)

subject: IfcStructuralConnection
rule: IfcStructuralConnection must have its topological connectivity to adjacent structural members explicitly defined via IfcRelConnectsStructuralMember
conditions: When used in a structural analysis model where load paths are required
exceptions: Standalone structural connection elements not yet assigned to any member

subject: IfcStructuralMember
rule: IfcStructuralMember must be able to transfer applied loads without exceeding its material strength limits
conditions: when the member is subjected to design loads

subject: IfcStructuralMember
rule: IfcStructuralMember must have defined connection points or supports that provide kinematic stability (prevent rigid-body motion)
conditions: when the member is part of a load-bearing structural system

subject: IfcStructuralPointAction
rule: IfcStructuralPointAction must have a non-zero magnitude value assigned via a StructuralLoad or load values
conditions: When the action represents an actual load case
When used in structural analysis models
exceptions: Conceptual or placeholder definitions where load is defined later

subject: IfcStructuralPointAction
rule: IfcStructuralPointAction must be assigned to a structural member or element via a structural connection (e.g., IfcRelConnectsStructuralActivity)
conditions: When the point action is part of a load-bearing analysis
exceptions: Actions defined in a global load library not yet assigned to specific elements

subject: IfcStructuralPointAction
rule: IfcStructuralPointAction must not have a load area or load distribution defined as line or surface loads
conditions: When the PredefinedType or representation indicates point application

subject: IfcStructuralSurfaceAction
rule: IfcStructuralSurfaceAction's assigned load values must be physically self-consistent (e.g., resultant force vector must be statically equivalent to the specified distribution)
conditions: IfcStructuralSurfaceAction is used in a structural analysis model

subject: IfcStructuralSurfaceAction
rule: IfcStructuralSurfaceAction must not define a load with zero or negative projected area on a non-trivial surface
conditions: The action is applied to a planar or curved surface element
exceptions: Concentrated line loads along an edge may have zero area projection (these should use IfcStructuralCurveAction instead)

subject: IfcStructuralSurfaceAction
rule: IfcStructuralSurfaceAction must not have inconsistent load orientation relative to the referenced surface's local coordinate system
conditions: The action has a defined orientation via 'OrientationOfSurface' or local placement

subject: IfcSweptAreaSolid
rule: IfcSweptAreaSolid must be defined with a valid cross-sectional area greater than zero
conditions: When used to represent a physical solid in a building model
exceptions: If used only as a placeholder or abstract reference with no physical intent

subject: IfcSweptAreaSolid
rule: IfcSweptAreaSolid must be defined with a non-degenerate extrusion path (swept direction and distance) that produces a valid volume
conditions: When the extrusion direction is defined and the swept area is non-zero

subject: IfcSweptAreaSolid
rule: The swept area of IfcSweptAreaSolid must not self-intersect along the extrusion path
conditions: When the swept area is a planar profile and the extrusion is linear or along a directrix

subject: IfcTable
rule: table must have four legs or a central pedestal base to be freestanding
conditions: IfcTable is used as a freestanding piece of furniture
exceptions: tables designed to be wall-mounted or cantilevered from a structure

subject: IfcTShapeProfileDef
rule: The web and flange must not intersect themselves or each other in an invalid topology (e.g., overlapping in the same plane without clear boundaries)
conditions: When IfcTShapeProfileDef is used in a structural profile definition
exceptions: Non-planar or parametric profiles where self-intersection is explicitly resolved

subject: IfcTShapeProfileDef
rule: The web thickness must be less than the flange width
conditions: In standard structural steel T-shape profiles
exceptions: Custom fabricated non-standard profiles where web thickness exceeds flange width

subject: IfcTShapeProfileDef
rule: The overall depth (web height + flange thickness) must be positive
conditions: Always applicable

subject: IfcTank
rule: Tank must be watertight to contain its intended fluid
conditions: tank is used for liquid storage
exceptions: tank is designed for gas or dry storage only

subject: IfcTank
rule: Tank must have a vent or pressure relief mechanism if it is closed and subject to pressure or temperature change
conditions: tank is a closed (sealed) type
exceptions: tank is open to atmosphere
tank is designed only for static non-pressurized storage at constant temperature

subject: IfcTank
rule: Tank must not have an outlet at the bottom if it stores fluid that is hazardous when leaked without containment
conditions: tank contains hazardous or polluting liquid
exceptions: outlet is fitted with a normally-closed valve and secondary containment
tank is above a containment basin

subject: IfcTankType
rule: Tank roof must support internal fluid pressure without collapse or leakage under design conditions
conditions: tank contains any fluid at above-atmospheric pressure
tank is not open-topped

subject: IfcTankType
rule: Tank must contain a leak-tight enclosure (no uncontrolled openings below maximum liquid level)
conditions: tank is designed to hold liquid
exceptions: drains with normally closed valves that are rated for the design pressure and are part of the engineered system

subject: IfcTankType
rule: Tank must not be subject to external pressure exceeding its design collapse resistance (vacuum or soil/water backfill)
conditions: tank is installed underground or in a vacuum service
exceptions: tanks specifically designed and rated for external pressure (e.g., vacuum-rated tanks)

subject: IfcTendon
rule: tendon must be entirely contained within its host IfcTendonAnchor or IfcReinforcingElement
conditions: IfcTendon is assigned to a host element via IfcRelConnectsElements
exceptions: Tendons used as unbonded post-tensioning where strands are free to move within ducts are still geometrically contained, but the duct itself defines the boundary — this is still a containment rule.

subject: IfcTendon
rule: tendon must not have zero length or zero cross-sectional area

subject: IfcTendon
rule: tendon must not intersect itself (no self-intersecting geometry)

subject: IfcTendonAnchor
rule: tendon anchor must be capable of transferring post-tensioning force from tendon to concrete without exceeding material stress limits
conditions: when used in post-tensioned concrete structures
exceptions: temporary or non-structural installations

subject: IfcTendonAnchor
rule: tendon anchor must not exhibit visible cracking or deformation during proof-stressing or stressing operations
conditions: during stressing or proof-stressing operations
exceptions: minor surface blemishes that do not affect structural capacity

subject: IfcTendonAnchor
rule: tendon anchor must have a positive locking mechanism to prevent tendon slip after seating
conditions: in permanent post-tensioning installations where the tendon is stressed and anchored
exceptions: temporary stressing operations where slip is monitored and controlled

subject: IfcTransformer
rule: Transformer must not operate above its rated temperature rise limit
conditions: When electrical load is applied
Under rated ambient temperature conditions
exceptions: Short-duration emergency overload per applicable standards

subject: IfcTransformer
rule: Transformer must have a physical enclosure that prevents direct contact with live energized parts
conditions: When transformer is energized

subject: IfcTransformer
rule: Transformer cooling system must be capable of dissipating the full-load heat losses
conditions: When transformer operates at rated load

subject: IfcTransformer
rule: Transformer must not have its dielectric oil level drop below the minimum required level
conditions: For oil-filled transformers
exceptions: Dry-type transformers are exempted

subject: IfcTransportElementType
rule: IfcTransportElementType must define a predefined type that is one of the enumerated valid transport element types
exceptions: If the transport element type is user-defined, the PredefinedType attribute shall be set to USERDEFINED and a custom ObjectType must be provided

subject: IfcTransportElementType
rule: IfcTransportElementType must not have contradictory composition types
conditions: When the element type is used in an aggregation relationship

subject: IfcTransportElementType
rule: IfcTransportElementType must have an assigned material when intended for physical construction
conditions: If the type is intended for actual fabrication/construction (not an abstract or placeholder type)
exceptions: IfcTransportElementType defined purely for classification or catalog reference without material assignment

subject: IfcUShapeProfileDef
rule: The web thickness of the U-shape profile must be less than the flange thickness
conditions: IfcUShapeProfileDef defines a structural steel or aluminium profile

subject: IfcUShapeProfileDef
rule: The profile depth must be greater than the flange width
conditions: IfcUShapeProfileDef defines a standard structural channel section
exceptions: Custom fabricated U-shapes not conforming to standard rolled section geometry

subject: IfcUnitaryControlElement
rule: IfcUnitaryControlElement must be connected to a power source
conditions: when used for active control functions (e.g., thermostat, humidistat, sensor/actuator unit)
exceptions: self-powered or energy-harvesting units (e.g., passive temperature sensors)

subject: IfcUnitaryControlElement
rule: IfcUnitaryControlElement must be installed in an accessible location for maintenance
conditions: when permanently mounted in a building
exceptions: devices embedded in sealed assemblies with no user-serviceable parts (e.g., encapsulated sensors)

subject: IfcUnitaryEquipmentType
rule: IfcUnitaryEquipmentType must be connected to an appropriate utility service (e.g., electrical power, refrigerant, or water supply) to operate
conditions: When the equipment type requires utility input to function

subject: IfcUnitaryEquipmentType
rule: IfcUnitaryEquipmentType must have adequate clearance for maintenance and airflow
conditions: When the equipment type requires air circulation (e.g., condenser coils, air intake/exhaust)
exceptions: Fully ducted equipment with remote air intake

subject: IfcValve
rule: IfcValve must not leak fluid to the external environment under normal operating pressure
conditions: valve is installed in a closed position
system is pressurized
exceptions: safety relief valves during overpressure event

subject: IfcValve
rule: IfcValve must be capable of achieving and maintaining complete shutoff (zero leakage) when in closed position
conditions: valve type is classified as a shutoff/isolating valve (e.g., gate valve, ball valve)
exceptions: control/regulating valves where minimal leakage is permitted by design specification

subject: IfcValve
rule: IfcValve must not fail in a position that causes uncontrolled flow or pressure loss in a safety-critical system
conditions: valve is part of a fire protection, emergency shutdown, or pressure safety system

subject: IfcVibrationIsolator
rule: IfcVibrationIsolator must be placed between a vibrating source and a supporting structure
conditions: The isolator is installed in a mechanical system with rotating or reciprocating equipment

subject: IfcVibrationIsolator
rule: IfcVibrationIsolator must have its load-bearing axis aligned with the direction of the applied load
conditions: The isolator is of a compression-type or spring-type design
exceptions: Tension-only or shear-only isolators where the primary load direction is explicitly different

subject: IfcVibrationIsolator
rule: IfcVibrationIsolator must not be installed in direct contact with combustible materials without a thermal barrier
conditions: The isolator contains elastomeric or polymeric components

subject: IfcWall
rule: IfcWall must have a structural connection to the building's foundation or load-bearing structure
conditions: Wall is load-bearing
Wall is part of a structural system
exceptions: Non-load-bearing partition walls
Temporary walls

subject: IfcWall
rule: IfcWall must not have openings that exceed the structural capacity of the remaining wall segments
conditions: Wall is load-bearing
Wall contains doors, windows, or other openings

subject: IfcWall
rule: IfcWall must have a fire resistance rating consistent with its location and building code requirements
conditions: Wall is a fire-rated wall
Wall separates fire compartments
Wall is a means of egress enclosure
exceptions: Non-rated interior partition walls in low-risk occupancies

subject: IfcWallStandardCase
rule: IfcWallStandardCase must be vertically load-bearing
conditions: When the wall is part of a load-bearing structural system
When the wall supports slabs, roofs, or other structural elements above it
exceptions: When the wall is explicitly designed as non-load-bearing (e.g., partition wall in a framed structure)

subject: IfcWallStandardCase
rule: IfcWallStandardCase must have a non-zero thickness
conditions: In all cases where the wall is instantiated

subject: IfcWallStandardCase
rule: IfcWallStandardCase must not have open gaps that fully disconnect its structural continuity along its load path
conditions: When the wall is load-bearing
When the wall provides lateral stability (shear wall or bracing function)
exceptions: Intentional openings (doors, windows) that are structurally detailed with lintels or headers above them

subject: IfcWallStandardCase
rule: IfcWallStandardCase must be placed on a supporting element (slab, beam, or foundation) capable of bearing its load
conditions: When the wall is instantiated in a model where gravity loads apply
exceptions: Curtain walls or non-load-bearing walls in steel-framed structures that are anchored only at discrete points and do not require continuous support below

subject: IfcWallType
rule: IfcWallType must have a defined Material property (e.g., masonry, concrete, timber, steel) that specifies its load-bearing or non-load-bearing composition

subject: IfcWallType
rule: IfcWallType must be associated with a valid shape representation (e.g., SweptSolid, Clipping, BRep) that defines its geometric extent and thickness

subject: IfcWallType
rule: IfcWallType must not have zero or negative thickness in its material layer set
conditions: IfcMaterialLayerSet or IfcMaterialLayerSetUsage is associated with this type

subject: IfcWasteTerminal
rule: waste terminal must have a continuous trap seal to prevent sewer gas ingress
conditions: connected to soil/waste pipe system
exceptions: dry traps designed for intermittent use with mechanical seals

subject: IfcWasteTerminal
rule: waste terminal must have a minimum slope on its drain connection
conditions: connected to gravity drainage system

subject: IfcWasteTerminal
rule: waste terminal must not have an airtight seal that prevents venting
conditions: terminal is a floor drain, roof drain, or other drainage fixture
exceptions: certain sealed sump or pump terminals with dedicated vent piping

subject: IfcWasteTerminal
rule: waste terminal must be rated for the maximum expected fluid temperature
conditions: receives discharge from high-temperature sources (e.g., commercial kitchen, laundry, boiler blowdown)

subject: IfcWasteTerminal
rule: waste terminal must have a debris strainer or sediment bucket when installed in floor drains receiving solids
conditions: installed as a floor drain in areas with potential debris (garages, industrial, kitchens)
exceptions: terminals designed with integral sediment collection without removable strainer

subject: IfcWindow

subject: IfcWindow

subject: IfcWindow
rule: IfcWindow must not have glazing that cannot withstand design wind loads

subject: IfcWindowType
rule: Window type must have a valid overall width attribute (OverallWidth) that is greater than zero

subject: Roof

subject: Roof

subject: Roof
rule: roof must be wind-resistant relative to local design wind speeds

subject: Roof
rule: roof must not have ponding water that exceeds structural capacity

subject: Roof

subject: Wall

subject: Wall

subject: Wall

wall height exceeds allowable unbraced limit per code

subject: Wall

subject: Beam

conditions: beam is structural
beam supports other elements

subject: Beam
rule: beam must not exceed its maximum allowable deflection under service loads
conditions: beam spans between supports
beam supports occupancy or equipment

subject: Beam
rule: beam must have sufficient shear capacity at supports
conditions: beam is simply supported or continuous
beam carries transverse loads

subject: Beam
rule: beam must be laterally braced against buckling at intervals not exceeding the unbraced length limit
conditions: beam is made of steel or other slender material
beam has a long unsupported compression flange
exceptions: beam is fully encased in concrete or otherwise continuously restrained

subject: Beam
rule: beam material must not be stressed beyond its yield strength under factored loads

subject: Column
rule: column must be capable of transferring vertical loads from supported elements to the foundation without structural failure

subject: Column
rule: column must have adequate slenderness ratio to prevent buckling under design loads
conditions: when column is subjected to compressive axial loads
exceptions: columns designed as tension-only members such as在某些 tensile bracing systems where buckling is not the failure mode

subject: Column

subject: Slab

subject: Slab

subject: Slab

subject: Slab

exceptions: Interior slabs not exposed to precipitation

subject: Slab
rule: Slab must be adequately reinforced for temperature and shrinkage cracking control
conditions: Concrete slabs with large exposed surface area
exceptions: Very short-span slabs where code exempts minimum reinforcement

subject: Window
rule: window must have a weathertight seal between frame and wall opening

window is operable or fixed

subject: Window
rule: window must be structurally supported by the wall framing or rough opening

subject: Window
rule: window must not have glass that cannot withstand design wind loads
conditions: window is in an exterior wall subject to wind pressure

floor height does not exceed code limit for egress windows

subject: Door

conditions: door serves as an accessible entrance or egress

subject: Door
rule: door must not obstruct the required means of egress

subject: Door

exceptions: building is fully enclosed and curtain wall is not on a wind-exposed face

subject: Curtain Wall
rule: curtain wall must accommodate building movements (thermal, seismic, inter-story drift) through its connections and joints

subject: Curtain Wall
rule: curtain wall must provide a continuous air and water barrier

subject: Curtain Wall
rule: curtain wall must not be the primary vertical load-bearing structure of the building

subject: Curtain Wall
rule: curtain wall glass must not be fully tempered if located within 18 inches of floor or in areas subject to human impact without laminated or heat-strengthened alternative
conditions: glazing is within 18 inches of finished floor
glazing is in a location subject to human impact (doors, side lights, low sills)
exceptions: laminated glass is used instead
heat-strengthened glass with plastic interlayer is used

subject: Stair
rule: stair tread depth and riser height must comply with building code dimensional limits
conditions: stair is part of a building
stair is intended for occupant use
exceptions: serviced/utility stairs not intended for regular occupant use

subject: Stair
rule: stair must have a handrail on at least one side if the total rise exceeds a code-specified threshold
conditions: stair has more than a minimum number of risers (typically 3-4 risers)

alternate means of egress provisions in certain occupancy types

subject: Stair
rule: stair must have uniform riser heights within a single flight

subject: Stair
rule: stair must not have a tread surface that is excessively slippery
conditions: stair is located in an area subject to water, ice, or moisture

subject: Stair
rule: stair must have minimum headroom clearance as specified by code

subject: Stair
rule: stair tread nosing must not present a tripping hazard via excessive projection or abrupt change

conditions: when the ramp is intended for pedestrian use
when the ramp is required to be accessible under applicable codes

rule: ramp must have a landing or level platform at the top and bottom of each run
conditions: when the ramp is used for pedestrian movement

subject: Ramp
rule: ramp must have handrails on both sides when the rise exceeds the code-specified threshold (typically 150 mm or 6 inches)
conditions: when the ramp is for pedestrian use
when total rise exceeds the local building code threshold
exceptions: ramps serving only vehicular or equipment access
ramps in jurisdictions with different handrail requirements

subject: Ramp
rule: ramp surface must be slip-resistant
conditions: when the ramp is in a location subject to wet conditions
when the ramp is used by pedestrians
exceptions: temporary construction ramps used only by personnel with fall protection

subject: Ramp
rule: ramp must not have a cross slope exceeding 1:50 (2%)
conditions: when the ramp is for pedestrian or wheelchair use

subject: Ceiling
rule: ceiling must be securely attached to structural framing above
conditions: when ceiling is a finished surface
in habitable spaces
exceptions: suspended/dropped ceilings that rest on grid systems may use gravity and interlocking instead of direct fastening

subject: Ceiling
rule: ceiling materials must have a fire-resistance rating meeting local code for the occupancy type
conditions: in buildings with multiple stories
in occupancies requiring fire-rated separations
where ceiling forms part of a fire-resistance-rated floor/ceiling assembly
exceptions: single-story buildings with non-combustible construction where code does not mandate rated ceilings
sprinklered buildings where trade-offs are permitted per applicable code

subject: Ceiling
rule: ceiling must not trap water above it
conditions: where a roof or plumbing exists above ceiling plane
exceptions: intentionally designed water-collection ceiling systems with proper drainage and waterproofing

subject: Ceiling
rule: ceiling finish must not shed hazardous particles or fibers into occupied space
conditions: in occupied indoor spaces
when ceiling is in an air-handling plenum
exceptions: encapsulated or sealed surfaces where fiber release is prevented

subject: Partition

conditions: Partition is vertical
Partition is not a structural wall
exceptions: Partition height is less than 2.4 m and is not in a seismic zone

subject: Partition
rule: Partition must not block required means of egress or exit paths
conditions: Partition is located in an occupied building
Building is subject to fire/life-safety codes
exceptions: Partition is a fire-rated enclosure that protects the egress path

rule: Partition must not interrupt fire-rated smoke or fire compartment boundaries without maintaining the required rating
conditions: Partition intersects a fire compartment boundary

subject: Plumbing System
rule: potable water piping must not be cross-connected with non-potable or sewage piping
conditions: system includes any potable water supply

subject: Plumbing System
rule: sanitary drainage piping must maintain a minimum slope toward the building sewer
conditions: system includes gravity sanitary drainage piping
exceptions: where approved pneumatic ejector or pumped systems convey waste to a higher elevation then drain by gravity

subject: Plumbing System
rule: backflow prevention device must be installed on the potable water supply at the service entrance
conditions: system connects potable water supply to a public water main
exceptions: buildings entirely on private well systems without any cross-connection hazard

conditions: system handles air cooling or dehumidification
system includes evaporator coil producing condensation
exceptions: airside-only system with no cooling coils or dehumidification function

conditions: system includes combustion equipment (furnace, boiler, water heater, generator)
system vents products of combustion outdoors
exceptions: all-electric system with no combustion equipment

rule: HVAC system must have at least one outdoor air intake path for combustion air and/or ventilation
conditions: system is not 100% recirculation-only with no outdoor air requirement

systems in buildings with no ventilation code requirement (rare storage-only) if no combustion occurs indoors

rule: HVAC system refrigerant circuit must be a closed, sealed loop with no intentional openings to atmosphere during operation
conditions: system uses vapor-compression refrigeration cycle

conditions: system is connected to a power source capable of supplying current exceeding conductor ampacity

systems designed and listed for use without overcurrent protection per applicable code

equipment specifically designed and listed with finger-safe live parts behind barriers or enclosures

subject: Lift/Elevator System

subject: Escalator

subject: Escalator
rule: escalator truss must be designed to support dead load plus live load (passengers) with a minimum factor of safety per code

subject: Security System

subject: Structural Framing System
rule: structural framing system must provide stability against buckling in all compression members

room contains HVAC equipment with condensate production

subject: Stairwell

subject: Stairwell
rule: stairwell must have a maximum riser height not exceeding 7 inches

subject: Stairwell
rule: stairwell must have a minimum tread depth of at least 11 inches

subject: Stairwell

subject: Stairwell
rule: stairwell must have a landing at every floor level

subject: Stairwell
rule: stairwell must not have a door that swings into the stairwell without a landing area sufficient to avoid obstructing the path of egress

subject: Stairwell
rule: stairwell must be enclosed with fire-resistance-rated construction

subject: Car Park

subject: Office

Enclosed space

subject: Office

subject: Office
rule: An office door swing must not block the required egress path width when opened

Occupied by more than one person

subject: Toilet/Restroom

subject: Toilet/Restroom

subject: Toilet/Restroom

subject: Atrium

enclosed space

subject: Auditorium

subject: Auditorium

space is designed for performances or presentations

subject: Auditorium

subject: Auditorium

subject: Auditorium
rule: auditorium must have a fire alarm system with audible and visible notification appliances

or space is part of a building with fire alarm requirement

rule: Floor must provide a fire-resistance rating not less than that required by code for the building type and occupancy separation
conditions: The floor separates different occupancies or tenancies
The floor is part of a fire-resistance-rated horizontal assembly

subject: Roof Layout
rule: roof layout must have a drainage path to prevent water accumulation
conditions: roof is not designed as a green/vegetated roof with controlled retention
exceptions: roofs designed as permanent water features (e.g., reflecting pools on occupied roofs with engineered waterproofing and drainage systems)

subject: Roof Layout
rule: roof layout must not have any areas where water can pond indefinitely (zero-slope catchment zones without drainage outlets)
conditions: roof is a sloped or flat roof designed for runoff
exceptions: roofs specifically designed as detention/retention systems with controlled outlets and waterproof membranes rated for standing water

subject: Roof Layout
rule: roof layout must provide a minimum slope (1/4 inch per foot for flat roofs) toward drainage points
conditions: roof is classified as 'low-slope' or 'flat' (slope less than 2:12)
exceptions: roofs using tapered insulation systems that achieve equivalent positive drainage through insulation thickness variation

subject: Columns At The Corners
rule: columns at the corners must be vertically aligned with the building's foundation load path to transfer gravity loads
conditions: building has a roof or upper floors supported by columns

subject: Columns At The Corners
rule: columns at the corners must not be placed where they obstruct required means of egress paths at the building perimeter
conditions: the building is occupied and subject to fire/life-safety codes
exceptions: where columns are fire-protected to the same rating as the egress wall and do not reduce the clear egress width below code minimum

subject: Ground Floor Slab
rule: ground floor slab must be supported on compacted subgrade or structural fill with adequate bearing capacity
conditions: slab is ground-bearing (not suspended)
exceptions: suspended slabs where load is transferred to piles or columns

subject: Ground Floor Slab
rule: ground floor slab must have a minimum thickness to span between supports without excessive deflection or failure
conditions: slab is reinforced concrete

subject: Ground Floor Slab
rule: ground floor slab must not be placed directly on expansive clay without a moisture barrier or engineered fill
conditions: site has expansive (reactive) soil
exceptions: soil has been chemically treated or replaced with non-expansive fill

subject: Ground Floor Slab
rule: ground floor slab must have a vapor barrier or retarder below the slab when moisture-sensitive flooring is installed above
conditions: interior finish is moisture-sensitive (e.g., wood, carpet, vinyl)
exceptions: slab is in an unconditioned exterior space where moisture is not a concern
slab is designed as a 'breathing' slab with no finish

subject: Perimeter Beams
rule: perimeter beams must be continuous around the building perimeter to effectively distribute loads and provide lateral stability
conditions: structural frame building
multi-story building
exceptions: buildings with expansion joints where the perimeter beam is intentionally broken at the joint location

subject: Perimeter Beams
rule: perimeter beams must not have their structural depth reduced below the minimum required by structural analysis for the given span and loading
conditions: gravity load-bearing perimeter beam

subject: Perimeter Beams
rule: perimeter beams must be supported at each end by a column, load-bearing wall, or other structural element capable of transferring their reactions to the foundation
exceptions: cantilevered perimeter beams where the fixed end connection is designed for the cantilever moment and shear

subject: Wall Membranes
rule: wall membranes must be continuous and unbroken across the building envelope to provide a complete air and moisture barrier
conditions: wall membranes are used as part of the building envelope assembly
exceptions: intentional gaps for controlled ventilation openings that are detailed to prevent bulk water entry

subject: Wall Membranes
rule: wall membranes must not be installed with reversed orientation or lapping that allows water to drain behind the membrane
conditions: the membrane is an exterior weather-resistive barrier or water-resistive barrier
exceptions: self-adhered membranes designed for reverse-lap detailing at certain transitions per manufacturer instructions

subject: Wall Membranes
rule: wall membranes must be lapped shingle-fashion (top over bottom) at horizontal seams
conditions: the membrane is applied in horizontal strips on a vertical wall

subject: Wall Membranes
rule: wall membrane penetrations must be sealed watertight at all through-wall elements
conditions: pipes, ducts, conduits, or structural members penetrate the membrane plane

subject: Floor-ceiling Vaults
rule: floor-ceiling vault must have a structurally sound arch or curved geometry to resist thrust forces
conditions: vault spans a space
vault is constructed of masonry or unreinforced material
exceptions: modern reinforced concrete vaults with tied rods or buttresses may deviate from pure arch geometry

subject: Floor-ceiling Vaults
rule: floor-ceiling vault must not have tensile stress exceeding the material's capacity in its unreinforced cross-section
conditions: vault is constructed of stone, brick, or unreinforced masonry
exceptions: vaults with embedded steel reinforcement or post-tensioning can accommodate tension

subject: Floor-ceiling Vaults
rule: floor-ceiling vault must have adequate abutment or lateral bracing at springing points to resist horizontal thrust
conditions: vault is self-supporting (not suspended or hung from a superstructure)
exceptions: vaults tied with steel tension rods at the springing line
vaults integrated into a monolithic reinforced concrete diaphragm

subject: Floor-ceiling Vaults
rule: floor-ceiling vault must not have load-bearing elements removed or altered without temporary shoring and structural analysis
conditions: vault is load-bearing
modifications are proposed to the vault or its supporting structure
exceptions: vault is purely decorative and independently supported by a separate structure

subject: Roof Vaults
rule: roof vault must have a continuous drainage path to shed water
conditions: vault is exposed to precipitation
exceptions: fully enclosed interior vault with no weather exposure

subject: Roof Vaults
rule: roof vault must not rely on a single discrete point load to transfer vertical forces to lateral restraint
conditions: vault is constructed of unreinforced masonry or non-ductile material

subject: Roof Vaults
rule: roof vault must have a minimum crown thickness adequate to resist compressive buckling
conditions: vault spans more than 6 m
vault is of masonry or thin-shell concrete

subject: Roof Vaults
rule: roof vault must not have a rise-to-span ratio below 1:5
conditions: vault is unreinforced
exceptions: vault includes post-tensioning or steel tie-rods

subject: Natural Doors And Windows
rule: A door or window opening that connects a conditioned interior space to the exterior must have a seal or gasket between the frame and the rough opening to prevent uncontrolled air and water infiltration
conditions: Opening connects conditioned interior to exterior
Opening is installed in an exterior wall
exceptions: Fully interior doors/windows not separating conditioned and unconditioned space

subject: Natural Doors And Windows
rule: An operable window or door must not open in a direction that places the hinge or pivot on the side where wind-driven rain is expected to enter the building (e.g., out-swinging door hinged on the windward jamb in a high-rain climate)
conditions: Operable window or door installed in an exterior wall
Building is located in a region with prevailing wind-driven rain

subject: Natural Doors And Windows
rule: A door or window frame must be anchored to the rough opening at intervals that prevent the assembly from sagging or rotating under its own weight and wind load
conditions: Frame spans a rough opening in a wall
exceptions: Frames less than 600 mm in any dimension that are designed as single-pane fixed lites may rely on perimeter sealant alone

subject: Low Doorway
rule: doorway height must be at least as tall as the tallest person expected to pass through
conditions: for accessible pedestrian routes
exceptions: non-accessible service access points

subject: Low Doorway
rule: doorway width must accommodate the widest person or object expected to pass through
conditions: for primary egress paths
exceptions: secondary/non-egress openings

subject: Low Doorway
rule: low doorway headroom must not cause impact hazard for standing users
conditions: where headroom is below 2.0 m (approx 6'7")
exceptions: areas clearly marked with warning signage and not on egress paths

subject: Column Place
rule: column placement must align with structural grid
conditions: when columns are used for vertical load-bearing
exceptions: cantilevered or non-structural decorative columns

subject: Column Place
rule: column spacing must not exceed structural span capacity of supported members
conditions: when columns support beams or slabs

subject: Column Place
rule: columns must be placed on capable load-bearing foundation or footings
conditions: when columns transfer gravity loads to ground
exceptions: temporary construction shoring

subject: Column Connection
rule: column connection must transfer axial load from the column to the supporting element without slip or excessive deformation
conditions: any structural column connection

subject: Column Connection
rule: column connection must maintain its load capacity under the design fire duration without sudden failure
conditions: building where fire resistance rating is specified for the structural frame
exceptions: connections protected by a separate fire-rated enclosure or intumescent coating that is not part of the connection itself

subject: Column Connection
rule: column connection must not permit lateral movement beyond the structural drift limits specified by the applicable building code
conditions: seismic or wind load-resisting system where the column participates in lateral force resistance
exceptions: connections designed as pinned (non-moment) connections where specified lateral drift is accommodated elsewhere in the lateral system

subject: Column Connection
rule: column connection must not have a net tension capacity less than the required uplift force when the column is part of a wind or seismic load path
conditions: column subject to net uplift forces from wind or seismic loading

subject: Stair Vault
rule: stair vault must have a fire-rated enclosure
conditions: building exceeds 3 stories in height
stair serves as required means of egress

subject: Stair Vault
rule: stair vault treads and risers must be of uniform dimensions within a flight
conditions: stair is used for occupant egress

subject: Stair Vault
rule: stair vault must have a minimum clear width of at least 36 inches (for occupancy loads up to 49) or 44 inches (for higher loads)
conditions: stair serves as required means of egress

subject: Stair Vault
rule: stair vault must not have a headroom clearance less than 80 inches

subject: Dormer Windows
rule: A dormer window must have a weathertight flashing connection where it intersects the roof plane
conditions: dormer is installed on a sloped roof

subject: Dormer Windows
rule: A dormer window must have a minimum headroom height that allows safe egress
conditions: dormer is used as an occupied space
building code requires egress from the space
exceptions: dormer is purely decorative and not part of an occupiable space

subject: Dormer Windows
rule: A dormer window must not compromise the structural integrity of the roof framing
conditions: roof rafters are cut or modified to accommodate the dormer

subject: Radiant Heat
rule: radiant heating system must have a dedicated thermal expansion relief path (e.g., expansion tank or bellow) in a closed-loop hydronic circuit
conditions: closed-loop hydronic radiant system
water-based radiant heating
exceptions: open-loop systems that discharge to drain
electric radiant systems with no fluid

subject: Radiant Heat
rule: radiant heating tubing embedded in a concrete slab must not be placed within 2 inches of the slab surface
conditions: tubing embedded in a concrete slab on grade or structural slab
exceptions: thin-slab (gypcrete) systems designed specifically for low coverage (< 2 inches) with engineered protection

subject: Radiant Heat
rule: radiant heating system must have a means to vent trapped air from the highest point of the piping loop
conditions: closed-loop hydronic radiant system
exceptions: fully self-purging systems designed with adequate flow velocity and downward-sloping piping

subject: Roof Caps
rule: roof cap must provide a positive drainage slope
conditions: roof cap is exposed to precipitation
exceptions: roof cap is designed as a planter or water-retention feature

subject: Roof Caps
rule: roof cap must not have penetrations that breach the waterproofing membrane without proper flashing
conditions: roof cap assembly includes a waterproof membrane
exceptions: penetration is part of a pre-manufactured curb with integral flashing

subject: Roof Caps
rule: roof cap must be secured against wind uplift forces
conditions: roof cap is located in a region with design wind speeds above 100 mph
roof cap is not a fully adhered single-ply membrane system
exceptions: roof cap is a temporary cap with short design life under continuous monitoring

subject: Windows Which Open Wide
rule: operable window must have an unobstructed path of egress in accordance with building code
conditions: window is used as an emergency egress opening
window is located in a habitable room
exceptions: window is not required for egress per local code (e.g., sprinklered building with alternative egress)

subject: Windows Which Open Wide
rule: operable window must have a functioning locking mechanism to ensure security and prevent accidental opening
conditions: window is accessible from grade, balcony, or fire escape

subject: Windows Which Open Wide
rule: window must not project into or obstruct required means of egress clearance when open
conditions: window swings outward into a path of egress (e.g., hallway, stair landing, exit corridor)
exceptions: building code allows projection if clear width is maintained per code (typically 36 inches minimum)

subject: Windows Which Open Wide
rule: operable window must have fall protection where the sill is below a specified height above the finished floor
conditions: sill height is less than 36 inches above the floor
window is located above the first story
exceptions: window serves as an emergency egress opening and is exempted by code

subject: Solid Doors With Glass
rule: glass in door must be safety glazing (tempered or laminated) where the glazing is within 600 mm of a door opening or within 300 mm of the floor on the hinge side
conditions: door contains glass panels
glass is within 600 mm of door opening
glass is within 300 mm of floor on hinge side
exceptions: glass is decorative only and does not form part of the vision panel

subject: Solid Doors With Glass
rule: door frame must be capable of supporting the weight of the solid door and glass inlay without sagging or racking
conditions: door construction includes both solid material and glass panels

subject: Solid Doors With Glass
rule: glass panel edges must be protected or set back from the door edge to prevent contact with metal or masonry jambs during swing
conditions: glass extends near the perimeter of the door
exceptions: door has rubber or resilient edge bumpers that prevent glass-to-frame contact

subject: Canvas Roofs
rule: canvas roof must be tensioned to remain stable under wind loads

subject: Canvas Roofs
rule: canvas roof must have a minimum slope for water runoff to prevent ponding

subject: Canvas Roofs
rule: canvas roof must not be installed in locations with permanent fire-exposure risk without fire-retardant treatment
conditions: where building code requires fire-rated assemblies
or where canopy is within 10 ft of a property line or building opening
exceptions: when the canvas has been treated with a certified fire-retardant coating that meets local code requirements

subject: Seat Spots
rule: seat spots must have a minimum depth of 600 mm from front to back to accommodate a seated person's thighs and buttocks
conditions: fixed seating
bench seating
individual seats
exceptions: shallow decorative ledges not intended for sitting
standing-only areas with signage

subject: Seat Spots
rule: seat spots must have a minimum seat height between 380 mm and 510 mm from finished floor
conditions: fixed seating
bench seating
individual seats intended for typical adult users
exceptions: child-scale seating areas explicitly designated for children aged 2-5
floor cushions or floor-level seating zones without seat structure

subject: Seat Spots
rule: seat spots must not have a seat slope exceeding 5 degrees from horizontal
conditions: any seating intended for sitting for longer than 2 minutes
exceptions: theatre or amphitheatre stepped seating where forward tilt is by design for sightlines and uses anti-slip surface

subject: Seat Spots
rule: seat spots must have a minimum clear width of 450 mm per person
conditions: individual seat spots
bench seating with defined per-person allocation
exceptions: temporary event seating where reduced dimensions are accepted for short duration and clearly signed

subject: Seat Spots
rule: seat spots must have a backrest if seat height exceeds 600 mm from finished floor
conditions: fixed seating
any seat where feet cannot rest flat on floor or footrest
exceptions: stools at bar counters where leaning is not the primary posture
perch seats designed for brief resting (< 5 minutes)

subject: Roof Structure
rule: roof must have a drainage path
conditions: roof collects precipitation
exceptions: fully enclosed interior roof with no precipitation exposure

subject: Roof Structure
rule: roof must resist upward (uplift) wind forces
conditions: roof is exposed to wind

subject: Roof Structure
rule: roof must not have a slope lower than the minimum required for the roofing material
conditions: roof is sloped
exceptions: roof uses a membrane system specifically rated for zero-slope application

subject: Roof Structure
rule: roof must support its own dead load plus applicable live loads without collapse

subject: Roof Structure
rule: roof must provide a continuous weather barrier (no gaps or breaches)
exceptions: intentional penetrations fitted with code-compliant flashings

subject: Roof Decking
rule: roof decking must provide a continuous surface to support roofing membrane or weatherproofing layer
conditions: when roof assembly is exposed to precipitation
exceptions: when roof decking is used only as a structural diaphragm with separate waterproofing system

subject: Roof Decking
rule: roof decking must have a minimum slope for water drainage
conditions: when roof decking serves as the water-shedding surface or substrate of a low-slope roof
exceptions: when roof decking is part of a steep-slope assembly where slope is provided by roof framing rather than decking itself

subject: Roof Decking
rule: roof decking must not have gaps or openings that allow water infiltration directly to the conditioned interior
conditions: when roof decking forms the outermost structural layer beneath the weather barrier
exceptions: when intentional openings are part of a designed drainage or ventilation system with appropriate flashing

subject: Roof Insulation
rule: roof insulation must have a vapor retarder on the warm side of the assembly
conditions: in conditioned buildings in climate zones with significant heating degree days
exceptions: unconditioned buildings
buildings in hot-humid climates where vapor diffusion is inward

subject: Roof Insulation
rule: roof insulation must not be compressed when installed

subject: Roof Insulation
rule: roof insulation must not be installed wet

subject: Roof Insulation
rule: roof insulation must maintain continuous contact with the roof deck or air barrier system
exceptions: intentionally ventilated roof assemblies designed with a drainage or ventilation cavity

subject: Roof Covering
rule: roof covering must shed water to prevent ponding
conditions: roof is exposed to precipitation
exceptions: roof covering is designed as a green/vegetated roof with controlled drainage layer

subject: Roof Covering
rule: roof covering must be water-shedding or watertight under expected weather conditions
conditions: building is enclosed and occupied
exceptions: open structures not requiring weather enclosure

subject: Roof Covering
rule: roof covering must have adequate underlayment or secondary barrier when required by climate and roof slope
conditions: roof slope is less than 2:12
climate has freeze-thaw cycles or heavy rain
exceptions: listed assembly with equivalent performance documented

subject: Roof Covering
rule: roof covering must not allow flame spread or contribute to fire propagation beyond code limits
conditions: building is within a wildfire-prone zone
building is subject to fire code
exceptions: building is fully non-combustible and exempt from roof-covering fire classification

subject: Roof Underlayment
rule: Roof underlayment must be installed with proper overlap (headlap) as specified by manufacturer to prevent water infiltration
conditions: Used on slopes less than the membrane manufacturer's minimum recommended slope
exceptions: Self-adhered membranes designed for low-slope applications may have different overlap requirements

subject: Roof Underlayment
rule: Roof underlayment must not be left exposed to UV radiation beyond the manufacturer's specified time limit
conditions: Underlayment is not rated for UV exposure (i.e., standard felt or synthetic non-UV-stable underlayment)
exceptions: Underlayments specifically rated for prolonged UV exposure per manufacturer specifications

subject: Roof Underlayment
rule: Roof underlayment must be installed from eave to ridge (bottom-up) so that upper courses overlap lower courses
conditions: Sloped roof application

subject: Roof Flashing
rule: Roof flashing must be sealed at all joints and overlap points to prevent water intrusion
conditions: flashing is installed at roof penetrations
flashing is installed at roof-to-wall intersections
flashing is installed at roof valleys or changes in plane

subject: Roof Flashing
rule: Roof flashing material must be compatible with adjacent roofing and wall materials to prevent galvanic corrosion
conditions: metal flashing is used
adjacent materials include dissimilar metals
exceptions: non-metallic flashing materials (e.g., rubber, PVC) are used

subject: Roof Flashing
rule: Roof flashing must be positively sloped (or stepped) to shed water away from the joint it protects
conditions: flashing is installed on a sloped roof
exceptions: flashing on a flat roof with a different primary waterproofing system (e.g., membrane extending up the wall)

subject: Roof Flashing
rule: Roof flashing must not be installed in a way that creates a dam or back-up of water behind the flashing
conditions: counterflashing or reglets are used

subject: Roof Edge Trim & Fascia
rule: roof edge trim must be securely fastened to prevent wind uplift
conditions: roof edge trim is installed in a region subject to wind loads
exceptions: temporary installation during construction

subject: Roof Edge Trim & Fascia
rule: fascia must overlap the gutter or provide a drip edge to direct water away from the building
conditions: fascia is installed above or adjacent to a gutter system
exceptions: building has no rainwater management system (e.g., unoccupied shed without gutters)

subject: Roof Edge Trim & Fascia
rule: fascia material must be compatible with adjacent roofing and flashing materials to prevent galvanic corrosion
conditions: fascia is metal and is in direct contact with a dissimilar metal flashing or roof edge
exceptions: materials are electrically isolated by a non-conductive spacer or membrane

subject: Roof Drainage System
rule: roof drainage system must have a continuous gravity-driven drainage path from every roof surface to a safe discharge point
conditions: building has any roof area exposed to precipitation
exceptions: roofs designed as intentionally ponding (e.g., recreational pools, water retention roofs) where the structural design accounts for standing water

subject: Roof Drainage System
rule: roof drainage system must not discharge onto pedestrian walkways, building entrances, or adjacent properties in a concentrated manner that causes erosion, ice formation, or safety hazard
conditions: building is located in a climate with annual precipitation exceeding 250 mm
building has occupants or neighboring occupied buildings
exceptions: discharge point is specifically designed as a controlled water feature with splash-mitigation and drainage provisions

subject: Roof Drainage System
rule: roof drainage system must have overflow or secondary drainage capacity at a higher elevation than the primary drains
conditions: roof is classified as a flat roof (slope less than 2%)
roof serves as the primary weather barrier for occupied space below

subject: Roof Drainage System
rule: roof drainage system must not route through interior habitable spaces without secondary containment and leak detection
conditions: drainage system includes interior leaders or downspouts
exceptions: pipes are routed through dedicated shafts with waterproof lining and drainage at shaft base

subject: Roof Ventilation
rule: roof ventilation must allow airflow passage through the ventilation opening
conditions: any roof ventilation system

subject: Roof Ventilation
rule: roof ventilation must not allow water ingress through the vent opening during rain
conditions: roof ventilation is exposed to exterior rainfall

subject: Roof Ventilation
rule: roof ventilation must have a net free vent area that meets minimum building code requirements based on attic floor area
conditions: roof ventilation serves an enclosed attic or roof cavity

subject: Roof Curbs & Supports
rule: roof curb must be securely fastened to resist wind uplift and dead loads
conditions: curb supports roof-mounted equipment

subject: Roof Curbs & Supports
rule: roof curb must be weather-sealed where it meets the roof membrane
conditions: curb penetrates roof membrane

subject: Roof Curbs & Supports
rule: roof curb must not create a ponding zone that traps water on the roof
conditions: curb is installed on a low-slope roof

subject: Rooflight / Skylight
rule: rooflight must be installed with a weatherproof seal between the rooflight frame and the roof structure
conditions: when installed in a roof assembly that separates interior conditioned space from exterior environment

subject: Rooflight / Skylight
rule: rooflight must have a minimum slope for drainage
conditions: when used in a location with anticipated precipitation (rain or snow)
exceptions: static rooflights installed on vertical or near-vertical surfaces that do not accumulate precipitation

subject: Rooflight / Skylight
rule: rooflight must not be installed directly above a fire escape route unless constructed of fire-rated glazing
conditions: when the building code requires fire-resistance rating for the roof assembly above means of egress
exceptions: where sprinkler protection or alternative compliance path is provided per applicable building code

subject: Rooflight / Skylight
rule: rooflight must be structurally capable of supporting design snow load and live load
conditions: when the rooflight is load-bearing and exposed to environmental loads

subject: Rooflight / Skylight
rule: rooflight must not project below the roof deck plane such that it creates a water-collecting pocket
conditions: when the rooflight is installed as a raised or domed unit above the roof plane

subject: Roof Parapet
rule: roof parapet must have minimum height above the roof surface as required by building code
conditions: when the parapet is on a roof accessible to occupants
when local building code specifies a minimum parapet height
exceptions: when the roof is designed with fall protection systems other than a parapet

subject: Roof Parapet
rule: roof parapet must not block required roof drainage paths
conditions: when the parapet is continuous around the roof perimeter
exceptions: when scuppers or overflow drains are specifically designed through the parapet wall

subject: Roof Parapet
rule: roof parapet must be adequately anchored to resist wind uplift and lateral loads
conditions: when the parapet exceeds typical height dimensions (e.g., >18 inches above roof surface)

subject: Roof Access Hatch
rule: roof access hatch must be weathertight when closed
conditions: hatch is installed on an exterior roof

subject: Roof Access Hatch
rule: roof access hatch must resist wind uplift equal to or greater than the surrounding roof assembly
conditions: hatch is located on an wind-exposed roof surface

subject: Roof Access Hatch
rule: roof access hatch must not open inward into a means of egress path
conditions: hatch serves as an egress route from the roof

subject: Roof Access Hatch
rule: roof access hatch must have a clear opening dimension no less than 22 inches clear width and 24 inches clear height
conditions: hatch provides access for maintenance personnel
exceptions: hatch is for emergency escape only and meets alternative code requirements

subject: Roof Access Hatch
rule: roof access hatch must include a locking mechanism that prevents unauthorized access from the roof side
conditions: building requires security against intruder entry from the roof

subject: Green Roof System
rule: green roof system must have an effective waterproofing membrane beneath all growing media
conditions: any green roof system with growing media depth greater than 2 inches
exceptions: sedum mat systems installed directly on single-ply membranes certified for root penetration resistance

subject: Green Roof System
rule: green roof system must have a drainage layer capable of removing excess water within 24 hours of a design storm event
conditions: any intensive or semi-intensive green roof system with growing media depth greater than 4 inches

subject: Green Roof System
rule: green roof system must not have soil or growing media in direct contact with building roof deck without a root barrier
conditions: green roof with planted vegetation having aggressive root systems
exceptions: extensive sedum roofs with shallow-root sedums on root-resistant membrane assemblies

subject: Green Roof System
rule: green roof system must have a fall-arrest or edge protection system where roof edge is more than 2 meters above adjacent grade
conditions: green roof accessible for maintenance personnel
roof edge parapet height less than 1 meter
exceptions: roofs with permanent parapet walls at least 1 meter tall serving as guardrail

subject: Roof Snow Guard / Snow Fence
rule: snow guard must be attached to structural substrate (e.g., roof deck, rafter, or purlin), not solely to roofing membrane or insulation
conditions: applies to all snow guard/fence installations

subject: Roof Snow Guard / Snow Fence
rule: snow guard must be installed above all roof penetrations and critical egress points (e.g., doors, walkways, vents)
conditions: roof has occupied egress areas below
exceptions: building has no roof access or occupied zones below the drip line

subject: Roof Snow Guard / Snow Fence
rule: snow guard must not create an ice dam by trapping water behind it
conditions: roof slope is low to moderate (≤ 7:12)
snow guard is a continuous bar or fence type (not discrete pads)
exceptions: roof has a fully adhered membrane or ice-and-water shield extending at least 2 ft behind the guard

subject: Roof Snow Guard / Snow Fence
rule: snow guard load rating must equal or exceed design snow load for the roof zone where installed
conditions: snow guard is load-rated by manufacturer

subject: Load-Bearing Wall
rule: load-bearing wall must be vertically continuous from foundation to supported elements
conditions: when wall supports vertical structural loads (e.g., floors, roof, other walls)
exceptions: wall supported by a transfer beam or structure that redistributes loads horizontally

subject: Load-Bearing Wall
rule: load-bearing wall must not have its structural capacity reduced by uncontrolled openings
conditions: when wall contains doors, windows, or other penetrations
exceptions: openings are designed with appropriate lintels, headers, or reinforced framing that preserve load path continuity

subject: Load-Bearing Wall
rule: load-bearing wall must have material strength adequate for the imposed axial and lateral loads
conditions: under all design load combinations including dead, live, wind, and seismic loads

subject: Non-Load-Bearing Wall
rule: non-load-bearing wall must not carry vertical loads from structure above
conditions: when installed below a structural floor, roof, or beam
exceptions: if the wall is specifically designed as a shear wall or load-bearing partition

subject: Non-Load-Bearing Wall
rule: non-load-bearing wall must be attached to the structure in a manner that accommodates differential movement
conditions: when the wall abuts a primary structural frame (steel, concrete, or timber)
exceptions: if the wall is completely isolated from the structure by a full separation joint

subject: Non-Load-Bearing Wall
rule: non-load-bearing wall must not substitute for required lateral bracing of the primary structure
conditions: when the structural design relies on a dedicated lateral force-resisting system (e.g., braced frames, shear walls, moment frames)
exceptions: if the non-load-bearing wall is intentionally designed and detailed as a lateral bracing element

subject: Retaining Wall
rule: retaining wall must be designed to resist overturning
conditions: wall retains earth or other granular material

subject: Retaining Wall
rule: retaining wall must include a drainage system behind the wall
conditions: wall retains soil
exceptions: walls designed as 'weephole-free' systems with waterproof membrane and gravel backfill only if explicitly engineered for full hydrostatic pressure

subject: Retaining Wall
rule: retaining wall must be designed to resist sliding
conditions: wall retains earth or other granular material

subject: Retaining Wall
rule: retaining wall must not be constructed with backfill that exerts undrained lateral pressure exceeding design assumptions
conditions: wall retains cohesive soil
no drainage system is provided

subject: Retaining Wall
rule: retaining wall footing must be placed below frost line
conditions: wall is located in a climate with seasonal freezing
wall supports structural loads
exceptions: walls founded on non-frost-susceptible soils with drainage preventing ice lens formation

subject: Retaining Wall
rule: retaining wall must not exceed its maximum unsupported height without engineered reinforcement
conditions: wall is a cantilever or gravity type
exceptions: walls using mechanically stabilized earth (MSE) reinforcement or tiebacks

subject: Cavity Wall
rule: Cavity wall must have wall ties connecting the inner and outer leaves
conditions: The cavity wall is of masonry construction with two separate leaves
exceptions: Ties may be omitted if the wall is designed as structurally independent leaves with other means of lateral restraint demonstrated

subject: Cavity Wall
rule: Cavity wall must maintain a minimum clear cavity width of at least 50 mm
conditions: The wall is a standard masonry cavity wall with thermal insulation
exceptions: Proprietary thin-joint or insulated block systems may have narrower cavities if specifically tested and approved

subject: Cavity Wall
rule: Cavity wall must not have mortar droppings or debris bridging the cavity
conditions: During construction

subject: Cavity Wall
rule: Cavity wall must have weep holes at the base of the outer leaf above flashings
conditions: The cavity wall is exposed to rain and has a cavity that can collect water
exceptions: Walls with drained cavity systems or where the cavity is fully filled with non-absorbent insulation designed to drain may have alternative drainage provisions

subject: Cavity Wall
rule: Cavity wall insulation must not bridge the cavity completely in a way that creates a continuous path for moisture transfer
conditions: The cavity is partially filled with insulation rather than fully filled
exceptions: Full-fill cavity insulation systems that are specifically designed and certified as water-tight

subject: Shear Wall
rule: shear wall must be continuous from foundation to top of building
conditions: lateral load resisting system includes shear walls
exceptions: walls that terminate at a transfer structure designed to redistribute lateral loads

subject: Shear Wall
rule: shear wall must have minimum length-to-thickness ratio
conditions: concrete or masonry shear wall

subject: Shear Wall
rule: shear wall must not have openings that reduce its effective cross-section below code-required minimum
conditions: shear wall is part of primary lateral load path
exceptions: openings that are fully detailed with boundary elements and diagonal reinforcement to maintain equivalent strength and stiffness

subject: Firewall
rule: firewall must extend from foundation through roof deck to achieve complete separation
conditions: building exceeds allowable area per floor
building is of combustible construction
exceptions: where parapet or roof assembly provides equivalent fire resistance

subject: Firewall
rule: firewall must have a fire-resistance rating of at least 2 hours
conditions: firewall separates buildings
firewall is in a structure of Type I, II, or III construction
exceptions: 1-hour rating permitted for firewalls in one- and two-family dwellings under some codes
4-hour rating required where adjacent building walls have higher rating

subject: Firewall
rule: firewall must not have openings that exceed the maximum aggregate area permitted by code
conditions: firewall contains doors, windows, or penetrations
exceptions: protected openings with approved fire doors or dampers may be permitted but still limited

subject: Firewall
rule: firewall must be self-supporting or supported independently of the structure it separates
conditions: firewall is a party wall or separates two buildings
exceptions: firewall may be supported on a structural frame only if frame maintains stability when structure on either side collapses

subject: Party Wall
rule: Party wall must be continuous from foundation to roof (or up to the roof covering) to provide fire separation
conditions: Building contains attached units or is semi-detached
exceptions: Where the roof is constructed of non-combustible materials and fire-resistance rating is achieved by other means

subject: Party Wall
rule: Party wall must not be removed or structurally altered without mutual consent of both adjoining property owners
conditions: Party wall exists between two separately owned properties

subject: Party Wall
rule: Party wall must have a fire-resistance rating meeting the applicable building code requirement for the building type and occupancy
exceptions: Where local code permits reduced rating due to sprinkler systems or other active fire protection

subject: Party Wall
rule: Party wall must not contain openings that reduce the required fire-resistance rating unless protected by fire-rated doors or assemblies
exceptions: Openings protected by listed fire door assemblies with equivalent fire-resistance rating
Openings permitted by code for specific occupancy conditions

subject: Bearing Wall
rule: bearing wall must transfer vertical loads continuously to the foundation
conditions: wall is load-bearing

subject: Bearing Wall
rule: bearing wall must have adequate compressive strength to resist applied axial loads

subject: Bearing Wall
rule: bearing wall must not be removed or have its cross-section reduced without structural replacement (e.g., beam, column, or header)

subject: Bearing Wall
rule: bearing wall stack must be vertically aligned through consecutive floors to avoid eccentric loading
conditions: multi-story building

subject: Bearing Wall
rule: bearing wall must have lateral bracing or diaphragm connection to prevent out-of-plane buckling
conditions: wall height-to-thickness ratio exceeds code limits

subject: Wall Finishes
rule: exterior wall finishes must provide a weather-resistive barrier to prevent water infiltration
conditions: finish is applied to exterior wall
building is exposed to weather
exceptions: interior wall finishes only
finishes applied over a separately specified weather-resistive barrier system

subject: Wall Finishes
rule: wall finishes must not trap moisture against the substrate
conditions: finish is applied to a moisture-sensitive substrate
finish has low vapor permeability
exceptions: substrate is vapor-permeable and assembly is designed to dry to the interior

subject: Wall Finishes
rule: combustible wall finishes must not be used on means of egress walls unless they meet flame-spread and smoke-development index requirements
conditions: finish is rated combustible (Class C or lower under applicable code)
finish is installed in a means of egress corridor or stair enclosure
exceptions: finish meets required Class A or Class B flame-spread/smoke-development ratings per building code

subject: Wall Insulation
rule: Wall insulation must not obstruct the air gap in cavity walls
conditions: when used in cavity wall construction
where ventilation of the cavity is required by design
exceptions: when the insulation is specifically designed as full-fill cavity insulation and the system has been tested/approved for that purpose

subject: Wall Insulation
rule: Wall insulation must maintain a continuous thermal barrier without gaps
conditions: when installed between studs or framing members
exceptions: areas around windows, doors, and penetrations where structural elements necessarily interrupt the plane

subject: Wall Insulation
rule: Wall insulation must not be compressed beyond its designed thickness
conditions: when using fibrous batt or blanket insulation

subject: Wall Framing
rule: wall framing must resist all imposed vertical loads (dead, live, snow) and transfer them to the foundation without excessive deflection or structural failure
conditions: building is load-bearing wall construction
exceptions: wall framing that is non-structural (curtain wall or infill) where loads are carried by separate structural frame

subject: Wall Framing
rule: wall framing must resist lateral loads (wind, seismic) and transfer them to the diaphragm or foundation to prevent collapse
conditions: building is subject to wind or seismic loading

subject: Wall Framing
