rule: Shower stall enclosure must have waterproof membrane extending minimum 2 inches above finished threshold or curb
conditions: shower stall has a threshold or curb at its entry
exceptions: curbless/barrier-free shower where entire bathroom floor is sloped and waterproofed as a wet room

subject: Shower Stall
rule: Shower stall must not have floor substrate (e.g., plywood, gypsum) directly under tile/membrane without proper slope and waterproofing
conditions: shower stall uses tile mortar bed or thin-set installation over wood-framed subfloor
exceptions: proprietary shower pans with integrated waterproofing rated for direct substrate contact

subject: Toilet Exhaust Fan / Ventilation Grille
rule: Toilet exhaust fan / ventilation grille must be ducted directly to the exterior of the building (not into an attic, ceiling plenum, or interior space)
conditions: fan is not a recirculating type
fan is not a heat-recovery ventilator configured for indoor discharge
exceptions: the grille is part of a ductless recirculating fan with charcoal filter and no moisture removal requirement

subject: Toilet Exhaust Fan / Ventilation Grille
rule: Toilet exhaust fan / ventilation grille must not terminate within 3 ft (0.9 m) of any property boundary, operable window, or fresh-air intake
conditions: duct termination is on an exterior wall or roof
exceptions: termination is through a roof stack with a listed cap that directs air vertically upward at least 2 ft above the roof plane

subject: Toilet Exhaust Fan / Ventilation Grille
rule: Toilet exhaust fan / ventilation grille duct must have a backdraft damper installed at the fan or within the duct run
conditions: fan is served by a common duct or connects to a shared exhaust riser
exceptions: fan is a dedicated single-fan system terminating independently to outdoors with no shared duct path

subject: Toilet Exhaust Fan / Ventilation Grille
rule: Toilet exhaust fan / ventilation grille must have a minimum duct slope of 1/4 inch per foot toward the termination point when passing through unconditioned space
conditions: duct runs through an unconditioned attic, crawlspace, or exterior wall cavity
exceptions: duct is routed entirely through conditioned space
duct is a vertical riser

subject: Toilet Exhaust Fan / Ventilation Grille
rule: Toilet exhaust fan / ventilation grille duct must be airtight and made of smooth, non-porous, corrosion-resistant material (minimum 26 gauge galvanized steel or equivalent)
conditions: duct length exceeds 3 feet or passes through a concealed space
exceptions: fan is a through-wall unit with integral louver and no separate ductwork

subject: Toilet Exhaust Fan / Ventilation Grille
rule: Toilet exhaust fan / ventilation grille must not share a common duct with a kitchen exhaust or combustion appliance flue
conditions: any duct connection exists to another system
exceptions: none

subject: Floor Drain
rule: floor drain must be installed at the lowest point of the floor surface to ensure complete drainage
conditions: floor drain is part of a drainage system for a wet or wash-down area
exceptions: drain serves an overflow-only function where standing water is acceptable

subject: Floor Drain
rule: floor drain must have a trap seal (water seal) to prevent sewer gas ingress
conditions: floor drain is connected to a sanitary sewer or wastewater system
exceptions: drain is a 'dry floor drain' explicitly designed for stormwater-only and not connected to a sanitary sewer

subject: Floor Drain
rule: floor drain must not be installed in locations where the trap seal will evaporate due to infrequent use without a trap primer or other seal-maintenance device
conditions: floor drain is in a low-traffic or intermittently used area
drain is connected to a sanitary sewer
exceptions: drain is equipped with a trap primer, a deep-seal trap, or a mechanical seal that prevents gas passage even when dry

subject: Floor Drain
rule: floor drain must have a strainer or grate with openings small enough to prevent solid objects that could cause blockage from entering the drain
conditions: floor drain is accessible to occupants or debris sources
exceptions: drain is a cleanout-only drain not intended for floor drainage

subject: Floor Drain
rule: floor drain must slope towards the drain at a minimum gradient (typically 1-2%) across the surrounding floor surface
conditions: floor surface is intended to drain to the floor drain

subject: Sanitary Plumbing Rough-In
rule: Sanitary plumbing rough-in waste piping must slope continuously downward toward the main drain at a minimum of 1/4 inch per foot (2% grade) for pipes 3 inches or smaller in diameter
conditions: Waste pipe diameter is 3 inches or less
exceptions: Where conditions prevent achieving 1/4 inch per foot slope, 1/8 inch per foot may be permitted for pipes 4 inches and larger (per some codes)

subject: Sanitary Plumbing Rough-In
rule: Sanitary plumbing rough-in vent pipes must terminate outdoors above the roof level and not within 10 feet of any openable window, door, or air intake
conditions: Vent pipe serves a sanitary plumbing system
exceptions: Vent terminations may be installed at a distance as low as 3 feet if the termination point is at least 2 feet above the opening per some model codes

subject: Sanitary Plumbing Rough-In
rule: Sanitary plumbing rough-in cleanouts must be installed at every change of direction greater than 45 degrees in the horizontal waste piping
conditions: Horizontal waste pipe has a directional change exceeding 45 degrees

subject: Sanitary Plumbing Rough-In
rule: Sanitary plumbing rough-in waste pipe must not connect to a storm drainage system or combine with storm water piping
exceptions: Combined sewer systems exist in some older municipalities, but this is a separate design scenario generally not permitted in modern separate-sanitary systems

subject: Sanitary Plumbing Rough-In
rule: Sanitary plumbing rough-in water closet (toilet) waste connection must be a minimum 3-inch diameter pipe
conditions: Fixture is a water closet (toilet)

subject: Sanitary Plumbing Rough-In
rule: Sanitary plumbing rough-in trap seal for each fixture must be maintained at a minimum depth of 2 inches (or as specified by code) and the trap must not be placed more than 24 inches vertically below the fixture outlet
conditions: Fixture has an integral or separate P-trap

subject: Hot/Cold Water Supply Piping
rule: hot/cold water supply piping must maintain minimum pressure at all fixtures
conditions: system is in use
fixtures are connected to the system
exceptions: during planned maintenance shutdowns with prior notification

subject: Hot/Cold Water Supply Piping
rule: hot/cold water supply piping must be protected from freezing
conditions: piping is located in climate zones subject to freezing temperatures
piping is exposed to ambient temperatures below 0°C / 32°F
exceptions: piping is entirely within conditioned building envelope
piping in non-freezing climates

subject: Hot/Cold Water Supply Piping
rule: hot/cold water supply piping must not be directly connected to a sewage or drainage system without an air gap or backflow preventer
conditions: piping is part of a potable water system

subject: Hot/Cold Water Supply Piping
rule: hot water supply piping must be rated for the maximum operating temperature of the water heater
conditions: piping carries hot water from a water heating appliance

subject: Hot/Cold Water Supply Piping
rule: hot/cold water supply piping must have a shutoff valve at the building entrance
conditions: piping is the main supply line entering a building
exceptions: temporary construction connections where a valve is installed immediately downstream
very small buildings with a single fixture where the meter valve serves this function per local code

subject: Waterproofing / Tile Finish System
rule: Waterproofing / Tile Finish System must form a continuous, unbroken barrier across the entire substrate surface to prevent water ingress
conditions: Applied as a waterproofing layer
exceptions: Intentional weeps or drainage openings are permitted at low points

subject: Waterproofing / Tile Finish System
rule: Tile finish must be installed over a fully cured and properly prepared waterproofing membrane
conditions: Tile installed over a liquid-applied or sheet waterproofing membrane

subject: Waterproofing / Tile Finish System
rule: Waterproofing membrane must not be installed on a frozen or frost-covered substrate
conditions: Exterior or unconditioned interior application

subject: Waterproofing / Tile Finish System
rule: Drainage plane or sloped substrate must exist beneath the waterproofing layer to prevent hydrostatic pressure buildup
conditions: Horizontal or low-slope application (roof, deck, balcony, plaza)
exceptions: Vertically applied waterproofing where runoff is purely by gravity down the face

subject: Accessible / ADA-Compliant Stall
rule: accessible / ADA-compliant stall must have a clear floor space of at least 60 inches (1525 mm) in diameter for a turning circle or a T-shaped turning space per ADA standards
conditions: the stall is required to be accessible under applicable building code or ADA

subject: Accessible / ADA-Compliant Stall
rule: accessible / ADA-compliant stall must have a door that provides a minimum clear opening width of 32 inches (815 mm) when the door is open 90 degrees
conditions: the stall includes a door

subject: Accessible / ADA-Compliant Stall
rule: accessible / ADA-compliant stall must have a water closet (toilet) centered 16–18 inches (405–455 mm) from the side wall
conditions: the stall contains a water closet

subject: Accessible / ADA-Compliant Stall
rule: accessible / ADA-compliant stall must have grab bars on the side wall and rear wall behind the water closet
conditions: the stall contains a water closet

subject: Accessible / ADA-Compliant Stall
rule: accessible / ADA-compliant stall must_not have a door that swings into the required clear floor space at the water closet
conditions: the stall includes a door
the stall contains a water closet

subject: Family / Unisex Restroom
rule: Family/Unisex Restroom must have a locking door mechanism or occupancy indicator to prevent unintended entry during use
conditions: door provides access to the restroom
exceptions: restroom is designed as open to the public with no door (e.g., curtain or maze entry not used in these typologies)

subject: Family / Unisex Restroom
rule: Family/Unisex Restroom must have at least one toilet fixture accessible from a clear floor space meeting minimum ADA/accessible clearances
conditions: facility is subject to accessibility code requirements (e.g., ADA, local building code)
exceptions: facility is explicitly exempt from accessibility codes (extremely rare; usually not legally permissible in new construction)

subject: Family / Unisex Restroom
rule: Family/Unisex Restroom must_not have direct view from the public corridor or adjacent space into the fixture area (privacy zone) when door is closed
conditions: restroom is adjacent to a public corridor or publicly accessible space
exceptions: a visually obstructive entry vestibule or privacy screen eliminates the sightline violation

subject: Restroom Signage
rule: Restroom signage must include a standardized pictogram (e.g., wheelchair symbol) when the restroom is designated as accessible
conditions: restroom is designated as accessible per building code

subject: Restroom Signage
rule: Restroom signage must not use tactile characters that are less than the minimum specified height (typically 1/32 inch raised, minimum 5/8 inch nominal height per ADA scoping)
conditions: signage is required to be tactile per applicable building code
exceptions: sign is mounted at a height where tactile characters are not required (e.g., overhead directional signs not serving as permanent room identification)

subject: Restroom Signage
rule: Restroom signage must be located on the latch side of the door or on the nearest adjacent wall when latch-side mounting is not feasible
conditions: signage is required to be tactile and serves as permanent room identification

subject: Restroom Signage
rule: Restroom signage must have a non-glare finish
conditions: signage is required as permanent identification per building code

subject: Lobby Floor Finish
rule: lobby floor finish must be slip-resistant when wet
conditions: lobby is an entry/exit point
lobby is accessible to the public
exceptions: lobby is never exposed to water or moisture

subject: Lobby Floor Finish
rule: lobby floor finish must have a coefficient of friction (COF) of at least 0.5 under dry and wet conditions
conditions: lobby serves as a primary building entrance

subject: Lobby Floor Finish
rule: lobby floor finish must not be highly polished or glossy
conditions: floor is exposed to direct sunlight
lobby is an entrance zone
exceptions: glare can be mitigated by controlled lighting or matte sealers

subject: Lobby Lighting System
rule: lobby lighting system must be connected to a suitable electrical power source

subject: Lobby Lighting System
rule: lobby lighting system must not exceed the rated voltage of its components

subject: Lobby Lighting System
rule: lobby lighting system must be installed with proper thermal management for heat-generating components
conditions: system includes non-LED light sources or high-power LED drivers
exceptions: system uses only low-heat LED sources with passive cooling certified by manufacturer

subject: Lobby Partition Walls
rule: Lobby partition walls must be non-load-bearing
conditions: When used as interior partitions in a lobby
exceptions: If specifically designed as structural shear walls per engineering design

subject: Lobby Partition Walls
rule: Lobby partition walls must provide fire resistance rating as required by building code
conditions: When lobby serves as an exit access or fire-rated corridor separation
exceptions: When lobby is open-plan and sprinklered with code-approved tradeoffs per IBC

subject: Lobby Partition Walls
rule: Lobby partition walls must not obstruct required means of egress width
conditions: When located along or within an egress path

subject: Lobby HVAC Diffusers
rule: Lobby HVAC diffusers must have a minimum clearance from walls, ceilings, and other obstructions to allow proper airflow and prevent short-circuiting
conditions: diffuser is installed in a conditioned space
diffuser is used for supply air
exceptions: diffusers specifically designed for flush or zero-clearance mounting per manufacturer specifications

subject: Lobby HVAC Diffusers
rule: Lobby HVAC diffusers must be oriented such that supply air does not directly impinge on occupants in seated or standing positions at velocities exceeding local code limits
conditions: lobby is an occupied space
diffusers are located within 15 ft of seating or standing areas
exceptions: lobbies where transient occupancy allows higher velocities per ASHRAE or local code

subject: Lobby HVAC Diffusers
rule: Lobby HVAC diffusers must not be installed without coordination with fire/smoke damper locations in fire-rated partitions
conditions: diffuser penetrates a fire-rated wall
diffuser serves a smoke compartment boundary
exceptions: diffuser is part of a listed through-penetration firestop system

subject: Lobby HVAC Diffusers
rule: Lobby HVAC diffusers must have a minimum distance from sprinkler heads to avoid obstructing sprinkler spray patterns
conditions: lobby has automatic fire sprinkler system
exceptions: diffuser and sprinkler have been modeled and approved through a performance-based fire engineering analysis

subject: Lobby Security Turnstile
rule: Lobby Security Turnstile must physically block unauthorized passage (e.g., via flaps, gates, or barriers) when a valid credential is not presented
conditions: The turnstile is installed in a secured entry path
exceptions: Emergency egress override — barriers must fail-open or retract automatically upon fire alarm or power loss to allow free egress

subject: Lobby Security Turnstile
rule: Lobby Security Turnstile must not trap or injure a person during normal operation or power loss
conditions: The turnstile uses moving barriers (flaps, arms, or gates)

subject: Lobby Security Turnstile
rule: Lobby Security Turnstile must allow unobstructed emergency egress (fail-safe) when fire alarm is activated or main power is lost
conditions: The turnstile is situated on an exit path required by building code
The turnstile has motorized or electrically locked barriers
exceptions: Facilities where a separate emergency exit door immediately adjacent exempts the turnstile from egress duty

subject: Lobby Reception Back Wall
rule: Lobby reception back wall must be non-combustible or fire-rated if it separates the lobby from an adjacent occupied space or means of egress
conditions: The wall separates lobby from another occupiable space
The building is classified as commercial, institutional, or multi-family residential
exceptions: Sprinklered buildings where code allows reduced fire-resistance rating

subject: Lobby Reception Back Wall
rule: Lobby reception back wall must not have any opening that allows untreated air transfer directly between a garage or hazardous area and the lobby
conditions: The back wall is adjacent to a parking garage, loading dock, or hazardous storage room
exceptions: Opening is protected by a self-closing fire/smoke damper and the assembly maintains the required fire rating

subject: Lobby Reception Back Wall
rule: Lobby reception back wall must be laterally braced or self-supporting to resist design wind and seismic loads
conditions: The wall is full-height (extends from floor to structure above)
The wall is not a curtain wall attached to an independent structural frame
exceptions: The wall is purely non-structural infill within a structural frame that carries all lateral loads

subject: Lobby Atrium
rule: atrium floor surface must be slip-resistant under wet conditions
conditions: atrium is accessible to the public
atrium contains water features, plantings, or is adjacent to building entries where water is tracked in
exceptions: atrium is not open to the public and has restricted maintenance-only access

subject: Lobby Atrium
rule: atrium must have a means of natural or mechanical smoke exhaust at the top of the atrium space
conditions: atrium connects more than two floors
atrium exceeds the building code threshold for unprotected vertical openings
exceptions: atrium is single-story with direct exterior egress from all adjacent spaces
atrium is fully sprinklered and uses a dedicated engineered smoke control system that meets local code

subject: Lobby Atrium
rule: atrium must not have unprotected openings between the atrium and occupied floors that would allow fire or smoke spread without rated barriers or active protection
conditions: atrium connects three or more floors
exceptions: atrium is protected by a compliant engineered smoke control system and full automatic sprinkler coverage

subject: Atrium Floor
rule: atrium floor must be rated for the live load of assembly/occupancy
conditions: atrium is accessible to occupants

subject: Atrium Floor
rule: atrium floor must not have an unguarded floor opening greater than 30 inches above the adjacent level
conditions: floor contains openings or is multi-level
exceptions: when guarded by code-compliant railings or barriers

subject: Atrium Floor
rule: atrium floor must provide a clear egress path width compliant with occupancy and travel-distance requirements
conditions: atrium is part of the means of egress

subject: Atrium Roof / Glazed Canopy
rule: glazed roof panels must be laminated or heat-strengthened safety glass
conditions: roof is overhead glazing accessible for cleaning or maintenance
exceptions: fully tempered glass if fully protected by a catch screen or structural grid below

subject: Atrium Roof / Glazed Canopy
rule: roof must have a continuous drainage path with minimum slope of 1/4 inch per foot toward drains or gutters
conditions: roof is horizontal or sloped less than 1/2 inch per foot

subject: Atrium Roof / Glazed Canopy
rule: glazing must not be fully moisture-sealed without provision for thermal expansion and condensation drainage
conditions: atrium roof uses sealed insulating glass units

subject: Atrium Roof / Glazed Canopy
rule: atrium roof structure must not rely on glass panels as primary lateral bracing without ductile backup frame
conditions: glass is structural (e.g., fins, beams) rather than infill

subject: Atrium Glazed Wall / Curtain Wall
rule: Atrium glazed wall / curtain wall must have structurally rated framing and supporting anchors capable of resisting wind load, dead load, and thermal movement
conditions: Where the wall forms part of the building envelope
exceptions: Interior (non-envelope) decorative glazed partitions not subject to wind or weather

subject: Atrium Glazed Wall / Curtain Wall
rule: Atrium glazed wall / curtain wall must include a continuous air barrier and vapour control layer at the perimeter to prevent condensation and air leakage
conditions: Where the wall separates conditioned interior space from exterior or from a non-conditioned atrium void
exceptions: Where the atrium is intentionally unconditioned and natural ventilation is relied upon as a design strategy

subject: Atrium Glazed Wall / Curtain Wall
rule: Atrium glazed wall / curtain wall must have a thermal break in all thermally conductive framing members where it separates interior conditioned space from exterior
conditions: Where the wall is part of the thermal envelope separating conditioned from unconditioned spaces
Where the framing material is aluminium, steel, or other thermally conductive material
exceptions: Where the entire atrium is unconditioned and no thermal separation is required

subject: Atrium Glazed Wall / Curtain Wall
rule: Atrium glazed wall / curtain wall glazing must not be fully monolithic annealed glass without heat treatment or lamination where human impact risk exists
conditions: Where the glazing is at low level (below 1.0 m from floor)
Where the glazing is adjacent to walking surfaces, seating areas, or circulation paths in the atrium
exceptions: Where the glass is protected by a permanent physical guardrail or balustrade at least 1.1 m high that prevents human contact

subject: Atrium Structural Frame
rule: Atrium structural frame must support combined dead, live, wind, and seismic loads without exceeding allowable stress or deflection limits
conditions: All occupied buildings

subject: Atrium Structural Frame
rule: Atrium structural frame must not have unprotected steel or combustible structural elements within the atrium volume unless protected by an automatic sprinkler system and compliant with fire-resistance rating requirements
conditions: Atrium connecting two or more stories
Building requiring fire-resistance-rated construction
exceptions: Where an engineered smoke control system and sprinkler system are provided per building code

subject: Atrium Structural Frame
rule: Atrium structural frame must be designed to accommodate thermal expansion and contraction of glazing and roof elements without causing overstress or glass breakage
conditions: Atrium includes glazed roof or curtain wall enclosure

subject: Atrium Structural Frame
rule: Atrium structural frame must not create a path for vertical fire or smoke spread that bypasses required compartmentation
conditions: Atrium penetrates multiple floor levels
exceptions: Where atrium is separated from adjacent spaces by fire-resistance-rated construction or active smoke control system is provided

subject: Atrium Floor Slab Openings / Balcony Edges
rule: Atrium floor slab openings must have guarding (guardrails or barriers) at all open edges where the drop exceeds 500 mm
conditions: open edge adjacent to atrium void
vertical drop greater than 500 mm below floor level
exceptions: openings used solely for maintenance access with temporary guarding
stage or platform edges where performance/activity requires intentional absence of guarding and alternative safety measures are in place

subject: Atrium Floor Slab Openings / Balcony Edges
rule: Balcony edges must not have openings or gaps large enough to allow a 100 mm sphere to pass through
conditions: balcony edge is accessible to occupants
railing or balustrade is present
exceptions: balcony is inaccessible (decorative only, no floor loading)

subject: Atrium Floor Slab Openings / Balcony Edges
rule: Atrium floor slab openings must be covered or protected to prevent tools or debris from falling onto occupied spaces below
conditions: opening is within a construction or maintenance zone
space below is occupied or accessible to the public
exceptions: opening is directly above a designated drop zone where falling objects are expected and controlled

subject: Atrium Balcony / Catwalk
rule: atrium balcony / catwalk must have a minimum load capacity of 100 psf (4.79 kN/m²) for assembly occupancy
conditions: serves as means of egress
occupant load exceeds 50 people
exceptions: private atrium balcony not accessible to the public

subject: Atrium Balcony / Catwalk
rule: atrium balcony / catwalk must have guardrails with minimum height of 42 inches (1067 mm)
conditions: located more than 30 inches above the floor or grade below
exceptions: front of a seat in a fixed- seating row

subject: Atrium Balcony / Catwalk
rule: atrium balcony / catwalk must have guards that prevent passage of a sphere 4 inches (102 mm) in diameter
conditions: guardrail infill is present
balcony or catwalk is accessible to children under 6 years old
exceptions: at stairs the sphere diameter increases to 4⅜ inches

subject: Atrium Balcony / Catwalk
rule: atrium balcony / catwalk must not have a walking surface slope exceeding 1:20 (5%) unless designed as a ramp
conditions: used as an accessible route

subject: Atrium Balcony / Catwalk
rule: atrium balcony / catwalk must maintain minimum egress width of 36 inches (914 mm) clear
conditions: serves as a means of egress
exceptions: existing buildings under certain historic preservation allowances

subject: Atrium Balcony / Catwalk
rule: atrium balcony / catwalk must not reduce the required smoke control volume of the atrium space
conditions: atrium is required to have a smoke control system

subject: Atrium Railing / Balustrade
rule: atrium railing / balustrade must have a top rail or handrail capable of resisting a concentrated load of at least 0.5 kN applied in any direction
conditions: railing is at change in floor elevation
railing is adjacent to an open atrium void

subject: Atrium Railing / Balustrade
rule: atrium railing / balustrade must have infill that prevents passage of a sphere 100 mm or larger through any opening
conditions: railing serves as a guard at a drop of more than 300 mm
exceptions: handrails on stairs where the triangular opening near the tread/riser may exceed 100 mm up to 150 mm

subject: Atrium Railing / Balustrade
rule: atrium railing / balustrade must not have horizontal elements or patterns that could serve as a ladder
conditions: railing height exceeds 760 mm
railing is in a location accessible to children
exceptions: intermediate rails that are part of an approved balustrade system where climbing is prevented by other design features

subject: Atrium Railing / Balustrade
rule: atrium railing / balustrade must have a minimum height of 1067 mm (42 inches) when located at an open atrium edge with a drop of more than 2 stories
conditions: adjacent void drop exceeds 2 stories

subject: Atrium Bridge / Skywalk
rule: atrium bridge/skywalk must have a minimum structural load capacity for its intended occupancy and use
conditions: when used as an occupied walkway
when spanning between separate building structures

subject: Atrium Bridge / Skywalk
rule: atrium bridge/skywalk must have fall protection at open sides
conditions: when elevated above the atrium floor
when sides are unenclosed or have openings
exceptions: if the bridge is at grade level with no drop hazard

subject: Atrium Bridge / Skywalk
rule: atrium bridge/skywalk must not obstruct required smoke exhaust or fire protection systems in the atrium
conditions: when the atrium is designed with smoke management systems
when the bridge/skywalk is located within the atrium volume
exceptions: if the bridge is specifically designed and tested to not interfere with smoke exhaust performance

subject: Atrium Bridge / Skywalk
rule: atrium bridge/skywalk must have a fire-resistance rating if providing a means of egress between separate fire compartments
conditions: when the bridge connects two separate buildings or fire zones
when used as an exit passageway or egress component
exceptions: if sprinklered and code allows unprotected opening between buildings

subject: Atrium Smoke Control System
rule: Atrium smoke control system must be designed to maintain tenable conditions (temperature, visibility, and gas concentration) at the atrium floor and any means of egress during the design fire duration
conditions: for buildings with an atrium exceeding 23 meters (75 ft) in height measured from the lowest level of fire department vehicle access to the highest occupant floor
exceptions: if the atrium is protected by an approved engineered smoke control system that meets alternative performance-based design criteria

subject: Atrium Smoke Control System
rule: Atrium smoke exhaust rate must be at least equal to the smoke production rate of the design fire at the time of smoke layer descent to the design smoke layer interface height
conditions: for mechanically ventilated atria

subject: Atrium Smoke Control System
rule: Atrium smoke control system must not use recirculation of smoke exhaust air back into any occupied zone of the building

subject: Atrium Smoke Control System
rule: Make-up air for atrium smoke exhaust must be provided from low-level intakes located at or near the atrium floor, with velocity not exceeding 1.0 m/s (200 ft/min) through any opening used for egress
conditions: for mechanically ventilated atria requiring make-up air

subject: Atrium Smoke Control System
rule: Atrium smoke exhaust fans must be rated for the highest expected smoke temperature they will encounter during the design fire scenario
exceptions: where smoke temperature is below the fan's ambient temperature rating for the full fire duration based on a verified analysis

subject: Atrium Fire Suppression System
rule: atrium fire suppression system must deliver extinguishing agent to the highest point of the atrium space
conditions: atrium height exceeds sprinkler system reach limits
exceptions: atrium has a non-combustible roof assembly with no fire load within the space

subject: Atrium Fire Suppression System
rule: water supply for the atrium fire suppression system must be sized to meet the simultaneous demand of the atrium system plus any other connected systems
conditions: system is hydraulically connected to a shared water supply

subject: Atrium Fire Suppression System
rule: atrium smoke exhaust system must not be obstructed by the fire suppression system piping or components
conditions: smoke exhaust system is present in the atrium

subject: Atrium Fire Suppression System
rule: fire suppression system piping in the atrium must be seismically braced in accordance with code
conditions: atrium is located in a seismic design category requiring bracing

subject: Atrium Lighting System
rule: atrium lighting system must be protected from direct water ingress
conditions: atrium roof or glazing is present above
system is located within the atrium volume
exceptions: system is specifically rated and certified for wet/damp locations (e.g., IP65+)

subject: Atrium Lighting System
rule: atrium lighting system must not obstruct required means of egress or emergency lighting paths
conditions: atrium is part of a building occupied by people
exceptions: fixtures are recessed or mounted above 8 ft clearance and do not encroach on egress width

subject: Atrium Lighting System
rule: atrium lighting system must have a maximum operating temperature that does not exceed the fire rating of adjacent materials
conditions: fixtures are mounted on or near combustible construction
exceptions: all adjacent materials are non-combustible or rated for the fixture's maximum surface temperature

subject: Atrium Sun Control / Shading Devices
rule: Atrium sun control/shading devices must be structurally attached to the building frame or primary structure
conditions: Applies to all fixed or operable shading devices mounted on the atrium envelope
exceptions: Freestanding interior light-diffusing screens not connected to structure

subject: Atrium Sun Control / Shading Devices
rule: Shading devices must not collect and retain water
conditions: Applies to all exterior shading louvres, fins, baffles, screens, or overhangs
exceptions: Devices specifically designed as integrated rainwater collection channels

subject: Atrium Sun Control / Shading Devices
rule: Operable shading devices must not be placed where they bind, jam, or collide with adjacent building elements during full range of motion
conditions: Applies to any shading device with moving parts (adjustable louvres, retractable awnings, rotating panels)

subject: Atrium Interior Landscaping / Planters
rule: atrium interior landscaping planters must include a functioning irrigation system to deliver water to plant roots
conditions: planter contains live plants
planter is located in an indoor atrium environment
exceptions: planter contains only artificial plants
planter is designed as a self-contained hydroponic or wicking system that delivers water passively

subject: Atrium Interior Landscaping / Planters
rule: atrium interior landscaping planters must have drainage to prevent water accumulation at the root zone
conditions: planter contains live plants
planter is irrigated or exposed to water
exceptions: planter uses a sealed hydroponic or aeroponic system where water is recirculated and roots are not submerged in standing water

subject: Atrium Interior Landscaping / Planters
rule: atrium interior landscaping planters must not allow water to leak onto atrium floor surfaces or adjacent building elements
conditions: planter is located above finished floor surfaces
planter contains water or irrigated soil
exceptions: planter is integrally waterproofed and has a dedicated overflow routed to building drainage

subject: Atrium Interior Landscaping / Planters
rule: atrium interior landscaping planters must be structurally supported to carry the full weight of saturated soil, plants, and standing water without exceeding floor load capacity
conditions: planter is of significant size/depth
planter is not a lightweight self-contained unit on a structurally rated floor
exceptions: planter is part of the original structural design and floor slab is designed for the load

subject: Atrium Water Feature
rule: Atrium water feature's water containment must have a continuous waterproof liner or sealed basin
conditions: water is present in the atrium water feature
exceptions: the feature is a dry stream bed or rain garden without standing water

subject: Atrium Water Feature
rule: Atrium water feature must have a primary and secondary overflow path to building drainage
conditions: the feature contains recirculating or standing water

subject: Atrium Water Feature
rule: Atrium water feature must not have electrical components located within or directly above the water basin unless properly rated for wet locations
conditions: the feature includes pumps, lights, or other electrical equipment
exceptions: electrical components are IP68 rated and installed with GFCI protection per code

subject: Auditorium Seating
rule: Seating rows must have a minimum clear aisle width of at least the local code requirement (typically 36 inches) from any seat to an exit
conditions: Auditorium has fixed seating
Auditorium is used for public assembly
exceptions: Seating with more than one aisle on each side may reduce width where code allows

subject: Auditorium Seating
rule: The row-to-row spacing (seat pitch) must be at least the minimum required for the seat type to allow for safe occupant egress without tripping
conditions: Seats are fixed in place
Rows are arranged one behind another

subject: Auditorium Seating
rule: Seats must be securely anchored to the floor or supporting structure to prevent tipping or sliding under design loads
conditions: Seats are fixed seating in a public auditorium
exceptions: Temporary or portable seating that is interlocked and complies with anti-tip requirements

subject: Atrium Vertical Transportation
rule: Atrium vertical transportation (elevators, escalators, stairs) must have a structurally independent path to ground that does not rely solely on the atrium enclosure for lateral or vertical support
conditions: Atrium is enclosed
Atrium is taller than one story
Vertical transportation core is located within the atrium volume
exceptions: When the atrium is designed as a single structural tube and the core is integral to its structural system

subject: Atrium Vertical Transportation
rule: Atrium vertical transportation must be enclosed in a fire-rated shaft as required by local building code (typically 1–2 hour rating) when the atrium connects three or more occupied stories
conditions: Atrium connects more than two occupied floors
Vertical transportation passes through the atrium space
exceptions: When the atrium incorporates an automatic sprinkler system and smoke control system meeting code exceptions for open atrium design

subject: Atrium Vertical Transportation
rule: Escalators or stairs within an atrium must not be the sole means of egress from any occupied floor
conditions: Atrium serves as part of the egress path
Occupied floor area exceeds code maximum for single exit
exceptions: When the atrium floor is at grade and opens directly to the exterior

subject: Atrium Vertical Transportation
rule: Atrium vertical transportation must not create a smoke conduit that bypasses floor-to-floor smoke separation
conditions: Atrium has an open floor plan without floor-to-floor smoke barriers
Vertical transportation shaft opens directly into the atrium at multiple levels
exceptions: When a dedicated atrium smoke-exhaust system maintains negative pressure relative to adjacent floors

subject: Stage / Platform
rule: stage/platform surface must have a minimum load capacity of 5.0 kN/m² (or per applicable building code)
conditions: when used for public assembly or performance
exceptions: stages designed exclusively for lightweight/non-load-bearing decorative purposes with restricted access

subject: Stage / Platform
rule: stage/platform must have guarded edges where the drop height exceeds 300 mm on sides accessible to occupants
conditions: when the stage is elevated more than 300 mm above adjacent surfaces
and when the edge is not a performance edge used intentionally as part of the show
exceptions: performance edges explicitly designed for audience sightlines where alternative safety measures (crash mats, harness points) are provided

subject: Stage / Platform
rule: stage/platform surface must not have tripping hazards exceeding 6 mm in height change across the walking/performance surface
conditions: when the stage is used for walking, dancing, or similar occupant movement
exceptions: intentional architectural steps or level changes clearly demarcated and designed as part of the performance space

subject: Stage / Platform
rule: stage/platform must have a means of egress (exit access) that meets the occupant load egress width and travel distance requirements of the applicable building code
conditions: when the stage occupant load exceeds the threshold requiring a second means of egress (typically 50 occupants)
exceptions: platforms serving single performers with direct ground-level exit within travel distance limits

subject: Stage Lighting System
rule: stage lighting system must be electrically grounded
conditions: system is connected to mains power supply
exceptions: battery-powered portable fixtures operating at extra-low voltage (SELV)

subject: Stage Lighting System
rule: stage lighting system must not exceed the rated electrical load of the supply circuit
conditions: any installation
exceptions: when a dedicated distribution system with higher capacity is installed specifically for the lighting rig

subject: Stage Lighting System
rule: stage lighting system must have all cable runs physically secured away from walking surfaces and fire exits
conditions: cables are laid in areas accessible to performers, crew, or audience
exceptions: cables installed inside enclosed troughs or under permanent staging decking rated for foot traffic

subject: Stage Lighting System
rule: stage lighting fixtures must be positively attached to the rigging structure with secondary safety bonds
conditions: fixtures are hung overhead above any occupied area
exceptions: fixtures less than 2 kg mounted in fixed low-level positions where no personnel pass underneath

subject: Stage Lighting System
rule: stage lighting system must not produce sustained surface temperatures exceeding combustibility thresholds on adjacent scenic materials
conditions: fixtures are positioned near drapery, soft goods, or other combustible set pieces
exceptions: when scenic materials have a certified fire-retardant rating for the specific temperature range of the fixture type

subject: Projection Screen & AV System
rule: Projection screen must have a continuous, unobstructed line of sight from all intended viewing positions
conditions: fixed installation
room with designated seating

subject: Projection Screen & AV System
rule: Projection screen must not be installed in a location where ambient light directly strikes the screen surface at a glare-inducing angle
conditions: projection-based system (not self-emissive display)
exceptions: screens with measured ambient-light-rejection rating sufficient for the measured light levels at installation angle

subject: Projection Screen & AV System
rule: AV system power supply must be connected to an electrical circuit with sufficient rated capacity for the total continuous load of all AV components

subject: Projection Screen & AV System
rule: Projection screen must be mounted on a structural surface capable of supporting the screen's dead load with appropriate safety factor
conditions: ceiling-mounted or wall-mounted screen

subject: Projection Screen & AV System
rule: AV equipment must not block or be installed within the minimum clearance zones of fire suppression sprinklers
conditions: room equipped with automatic fire sprinkler system

subject: Acoustic Wall Panels
rule: Acoustic wall panels must be installed with a minimum air gap behind them for acoustic performance
conditions: When panels are mounted on a rigid backing wall
When peak sound absorption is required
exceptions: When panels are designed as direct-bond (no air gap) by manufacturer specification

subject: Acoustic Wall Panels
rule: Acoustic wall panels must not have continuous rigid bridges between panel face and backing substrate that bypass the resilient layer
conditions: When panels incorporate a resilient or sound-isolating layer

subject: Acoustic Wall Panels
rule: Acoustic wall panels must be installed with staggered joints or a sealed lap joint to prevent acoustic flanking paths
conditions: When multiple panels abut edge-to-edge
When the panel system is part of a rated sound barrier assembly
exceptions: When panels are designed with integral edge seals that maintain continuity

subject: Acoustic Ceiling Treatment
rule: Acoustic ceiling treatment must have an air gap or decoupling from the structure above to function as a sound isolator
conditions: when used for sound isolation (STC rating) purposes
when installed as a suspended or dropped ceiling system
exceptions: when used solely for sound absorption (NRC rating) within a room rather than sound isolation between spaces

subject: Acoustic Ceiling Treatment
rule: Acoustic ceiling tile material must not be installed in direct contact with water sources or in continuously saturated conditions
conditions: when tiles are made of mineral fiber, fiberglass, or other porous acoustic materials
exceptions: when using purpose-designed water-resistant acoustic panels (e.g., PVC-faced or cementitious boards)

subject: Raked Floor Structure
rule: raked floor must have a minimum slope of 1:80 to ensure positive drainage
conditions: used in outdoor or semi-enclosed areas
exposed to rain or wash-down water
exceptions: floor is designed as a level overflow or containment slab with separate drainage infrastructure

subject: Raked Floor Structure
rule: raked floor must have a non-slip surface finish
conditions: intended for pedestrian traffic
slope exceeds 1:20
exceptions: floor is solely a structural soffit with no occupiable access

subject: Raked Floor Structure
rule: raked floor must not have step changes that create tripping hazards across the sloped surface
conditions: continuous seating or viewing area
slope is uninterrupted
exceptions: step changes are part of designed tiered seating (not a raked floor)

subject: Auditorium Entry Doors
rule: Auditorium entry doors must swing in the direction of egress travel
conditions: door serves an occupant load of 50 or more
door is in a means of egress
exceptions: door is a horizontal sliding door complying with egress provisions
door is a revolving door

subject: Auditorium Entry Doors
rule: Auditorium entry doors must have a minimum clear width of 32 inches when open
conditions: door is part of a means of egress
door is an accessible route

subject: Auditorium Entry Doors
rule: Auditorium entry doors must not lock in a manner that prevents egress from the inside without special knowledge or effort
conditions: door is in a means of egress
exceptions: egress doors in places of detention/restraint
electromagnetically locked doors with approved release upon fire alarm or power failure

subject: Auditorium Entry Doors
rule: Auditorium entry doors must have a maximum opening force of 5 lbf (22 N) to operate
conditions: door serves an accessible route
door is not a fire door

subject: Auditorium Entry Doors
rule: Auditorium entry doors must not project more than 4 inches into the path of egress travel when fully open
conditions: door opens into a corridor or aisle used for egress
exceptions: door opens into a stair enclosure where projection does not reduce required width below minimum

subject: Emergency Exit Signs & Lighting
rule: Emergency exit signs must remain continuously illuminated (or immediately self-illuminate upon power loss) whenever the building is occupied
conditions: Building is occupied
Exit signs are installed

subject: Emergency Exit Signs & Lighting
rule: Emergency exit signs must not be obstructed by any building element, furnishings, or decorative features
conditions: Exit signs are installed

subject: Emergency Exit Signs & Lighting
rule: Emergency lighting must provide a minimum of 1 foot-candle (10.8 lux) illumination along the egress path at floor level
conditions: Building is classified as a place of assembly, educational, institutional, or other occupancy where emergency lighting is required

subject: Emergency Exit Signs & Lighting
rule: Emergency exit signs and lighting must be powered from a source that automatically activates within 10 seconds of normal power failure
conditions: Emergency signage/lighting is installed

subject: Emergency Exit Signs & Lighting
rule: Emergency exit signs must not be installed where they can be confused with non-emergency decorative or advertising signage
conditions: Exit signs are installed in a public or occupant-accessible area

subject: Auditorium HVAC System
rule: auditorium HVAC system air handling units must have unobstructed outdoor air intake paths
conditions: system includes outdoor air intake for ventilation

subject: Auditorium HVAC System
rule: auditorium HVAC system condensate drain lines must have positive gravity slope with no traps or blockages that prevent free drainage
conditions: system includes cooling coils that generate condensate
exceptions: system uses a pumped condensate removal system with properly designed lift mechanism

subject: Auditorium HVAC System
rule: auditorium HVAC system must not have return air paths that create short-circuiting between supply and return before air reaches occupant zone
conditions: system operates in mixing ventilation mode with ceiling supply and return

subject: Control Room / Booth
rule: control room or booth must have an uninterrupted line of sight to the controlled area or equipment
conditions: when serving as an observation or supervisory post
exceptions: when monitoring is performed solely via closed-circuit displays or remote instrumentation

subject: Control Room / Booth
rule: control room or booth must have a door that opens outward or is side-sliding
conditions: when the booth is occupied during normal operation

subject: Control Room / Booth
rule: control room or booth must not have any window or glazing that faces directly into an IECEx/ATEX Zone 0 or Class I Division 1 hazardous area without a fire-rated and explosion-rated assembly
conditions: when located adjacent to classified hazardous zones

subject: Control Room / Booth
rule: control room or booth must maintain a minimum sound transmission class (STC) of 45 between the booth interior and adjacent high-noise process areas
conditions: when located in or adjacent to process areas exceeding 85 dBA
exceptions: when operator communication relies solely on visual/electronic signals, not voice

subject: Backstage Area / Wings
rule: backstage areas must have at least one direct exit to an exterior or a public corridor that leads to an exterior, independent of the main audience entrance
conditions: the building includes a performance or assembly space that holds audiences
the backstage area serves performers or crew
exceptions: fire code equivalent path of egress is provided through alternative rated routes

subject: Backstage Area / Wings
rule: backstage wings must provide a minimum clear width of 1.2 m (4 ft) for passage of scenery and personnel
conditions: the wings are used for scenery storage or movement
the performance type involves set changes

subject: Backstage Area / Wings
rule: backstage area floors must be level within a maximum slope of 1:50 for safe movement of rolling scenery and equipment
conditions: the backstage area is used for wheeled scenery or equipment carts
exceptions: ramped transitions at doorways may exceed this locally

subject: Backstage Area / Wings
rule: backstage areas must not contain unprotected openings directly into the stage house without fire-rated closures
conditions: the backstage wings connect directly to a stage with fire curtains or safety systems
exceptions: openings protected by automatic fire shutters or rated doors are acceptable

subject: Orchestra Pit
rule: Orchestra pit must have a minimum clear floor area adequate for the intended number of musicians and their instruments
conditions: the space is intended to accommodate live musicians during a performance
exceptions: purely mechanical/recorded performances with no live musicians

subject: Orchestra Pit
rule: Orchestra pit must have a means of egress (exit path) that meets life safety code requirements for occupancy load
conditions: the pit is occupied by performers during a performance

subject: Orchestra Pit
rule: Orchestra pit must not be completely enclosed without ventilation to the occupied zone
conditions: the pit is below stage level and occupied by people
exceptions: space is mechanically ventilated to code-compliant air-exchange rates

subject: Handrails & Guardrails
rule: handrails and guardrails must have a minimum height of 1.07 m (42 inches) for guardrails and 0.86 m (34 inches) for handrails on stairs
conditions: applies to guards protecting open sides of walking surfaces
applies to handrails on stairways
exceptions: private single-family residences may have different local code requirements

subject: Handrails & Guardrails
rule: handrails and guardrails must withstand a concentrated load of 0.5 kN (100 lbf) applied at any point
exceptions: guardrails in assembly occupancies may require higher loads per code

subject: Handrails & Guardrails
rule: openings in guardrails must not allow passage of a 100 mm (4 inch) sphere
exceptions: existing historic construction may be grandfathered

subject: Handrails & Guardrails
rule: handrails must have a cross-sectional dimension between 32 mm and 51 mm (1.25 to 2 inches)
conditions: applies to circular or rectangular gripping surfaces

subject: Handrails & Guardrails
rule: handrails must provide continuous support from the top to the bottom of the stair flight
exceptions: handrails may be interrupted at building entrances or doors where required by code

subject: Auditorium Floor Finish
rule: Auditorium floor finish must be slip-resistant under expected use conditions
conditions: floor is accessible to occupants during performances or events
exceptions: areas not intended for occupant traffic (e.g., sealed storage zones)

subject: Auditorium Floor Finish
rule: Auditorium floor finish must meet a minimum Flame Spread Index (FSI) and Smoke Developed Index (SDI) per applicable building code
conditions: finish is applied to floor surfaces within the auditorium

subject: Auditorium Floor Finish
rule: Auditorium floor finish must not produce offensive or irritating odors under normal occupancy conditions
conditions: finish is installed and the space is occupied for performances
exceptions: finish is temporary and removed before occupancy

subject: Blackout Curtains / Drapes
rule: Blackout curtains/drapes must fully cover the window opening with no light gaps when closed
conditions: When installed for light control purposes
When closed position is intended to block external light
exceptions: Decorative curtains not intended for light blocking
Curtains with intentional light-leaking design features

subject: Blackout Curtains / Drapes
rule: Blackout curtain fabric must have a light transmission coefficient of less than 1%
conditions: When the product is labeled or sold as 'blackout' grade
exceptions: Products labeled as 'room-darkening' rather than 'blackout' (higher transmission allowed)

subject: Blackout Curtains / Drapes
rule: Blackout curtains/drapes must not be installed in a manner that obstructs required egress openings
conditions: When installed in a room with a window that serves as a required emergency egress
exceptions: If the curtain system is designed to fully clear the egress opening when opened
If local building codes exempt the specific installation

subject: Lobby Flooring
rule: lobby flooring must be slip-resistant
conditions: lobby is accessible to the public
flooring is wet or polished
exceptions: flooring is exclusively a decorative surface not meant for pedestrian traffic

subject: Lobby Flooring
rule: lobby flooring must withstand high foot traffic without structural failure
conditions: lobby serves as a primary building entrance or main circulation space
exceptions: lobby is a private or non-public space with negligible traffic

subject: Lobby Flooring
rule: lobby flooring must not create a tripping hazard at transitions
conditions: flooring material changes at doorways, elevator thresholds, or adjacent rooms
exceptions: transition height difference is designed to comply with accessibility standards (e.g., ≤ 1/4 inch with bevel)

subject: Reception Ceiling
rule: Reception ceiling must have a minimum clear height that allows safe and comfortable standing for occupants (typically ≥ 2.4 m / 8 ft)
conditions: The space is intended for occupancy
The ceiling is a finished interior ceiling in a public or staff-accessible reception area
exceptions: Historic building retrofit where minimum height cannot be achieved and alternative safety measures are provided

subject: Reception Ceiling
rule: Reception ceiling must be free of protruding objects or sharp edges within the head impact zone (typically below 2.1 m)
conditions: The ceiling is in a circulation or waiting area where occupants could walk beneath it
exceptions: Protrusions that are protected by crash rails or padding compliant with impact safety standards

subject: Reception Ceiling
rule: Reception ceiling must support the self-weight of its finish materials and any directly attached services (lighting, signage, AV equipment) without risk of collapse
conditions: The ceiling is a suspended or attached ceiling system (not a structural slab finished as ceiling)

subject: Reception Ceiling
rule: Reception ceiling must not enclose an unvented space where moisture can accumulate, leading to condensation and mold growth that compromises indoor air quality
conditions: The ceiling construction creates a closed plenum or cavity above the ceiling plane
exceptions: When the cavity is designed as a sealed, conditioned space with appropriate vapor control and is part of the building's HVAC design

subject: Entry Door Assembly
rule: entry door assembly must have a means of latching or locking
conditions: when assembly includes a door that is intended to be closed and secured
exceptions: decorative or non-operable doors that are fixed in place permanently

subject: Entry Door Assembly
rule: entry door assembly must not have openings that permit passage of vermin or uncontrolled air infiltration beyond code limits
conditions: when the assembly is part of an occupied, conditioned building envelope

subject: Entry Door Assembly
rule: entry door assembly must be capable of swinging or opening without binding against frame, floor, or adjacent structure
conditions: when the door is a swinging or sliding operational type
exceptions: fixed panels within the assembly that are not intended to move

subject: Entry Door Assembly
rule: entry door assembly must have a threshold or weatherstrip that provides a seal at the bottom edge
conditions: when the assembly is exposed to exterior weather conditions
exceptions: interior entry door assemblies not separating conditioned from unconditioned space

subject: Countertop
rule: countertop must be installed on a level and structurally adequate supporting base (cabinet, bracket, or frame)
conditions: Any permanent countertop installation

subject: Countertop
rule: countertop must be made of a material that is non-porous or sealed to prevent liquid absorption in food preparation areas
conditions: Countertop is used in a kitchen or food-preparation zone
exceptions: Decorative or non-food-contact countertops such as those in a display-only setting

subject: Countertop
rule: countertop must not have unsupported spans exceeding the material's maximum allowable span ratio
conditions: Countertop overhangs beyond supporting cabinetry or structure

subject: Wall Cabinets
rule: wall cabinets must be securely fastened to wall structure

subject: Wall Cabinets
rule: wall cabinets must not obstruct required clearances for adjacent operable equipment or doors
conditions: when located near doors
when located near operable equipment requiring clearance

subject: Wall Cabinets
rule: wall cabinet doors must have a means of staying open while accessing contents
conditions: when doors are hinged and swing downward or outward
exceptions: sliding doors
roll-up doors

subject: Wall Cabinets
rule: wall cabinets must not exceed the load rating of the supporting wall or mounting system

subject: Base Cabinets
rule: base cabinets must be securely anchored to the floor or wall structure
conditions: cabinet height exceeds width
cabinet is freestanding and not counter-mounted
exceptions: base cabinets designed as rolling islands with manufacturer-rated locking casters that are engaged during use

subject: Base Cabinets
rule: base cabinets must have a minimum toe-kick recess depth of 50 mm (2 inches) and height of 75 mm (3 inches) at the bottom front
conditions: cabinet is floor-mounted in a residential or commercial occupied space
exceptions: cabinets installed on raised platforms where foot space is provided by the platform itself

subject: Base Cabinets
rule: base cabinets must not block or impinge upon required egress pathways or door swing clearances
conditions: cabinet is installed in a circulation path or adjacent to a doorway

subject: Base Cabinets
rule: base cabinets must not bear vertical loads unless they have a continuous load-bearing deck or structural frame rated for the intended dead plus live load
conditions: cabinet is intended to support countertop, sink, or appliance loads

subject: Base Cabinets
rule: base cabinets must provide a minimum clearance of 300 mm (12 inches) between the top of the cabinet box and the underside of any countertop overhang to allow for plumbing and electrical rough-in
conditions: cabinet is installed under a countertop that contains a sink or requires electrical receptacles
exceptions: custom millwork with integrated pre-routed service channels verified to accommodate rough-in dimensions

subject: Sink with Faucet
rule: Sink with faucet must have a water supply connection
conditions: sink with faucet is installed for use

subject: Sink with Faucet
rule: Sink with faucet must have a drain/waste pipe connection
conditions: sink with faucet is installed for use

subject: Sink with Faucet
rule: Sink with faucet must be installed on a watertight basin or counter surface

subject: Sink with Faucet
rule: Faucet water outlet must not be positioned below the flood rim of the sink basin
conditions: faucet is a standard stationary or gooseneck type
exceptions: pot-filler faucets mounted above a separate sink
deck-mounted faucets designed with vacuum breaker in jurisdictions permitting certain configurations

subject: Built-in Microwave
rule: Built-in microwave must have at least 50 mm (2 in) clearance above the appliance for ventilation exhaust
conditions: Unit is a recirculating or vented microwave
Unit is installed under a cabinet or in a cutout
exceptions: Manufacturer explicitly specifies reduced clearance in installation instructions

subject: Built-in Microwave
rule: Built-in microwave must not have its power cord routed through the front ventilation grille or obstructing side/back cooling vents
conditions: Unit has a rear-wall or side-wall venting design

subject: Built-in Microwave
rule: Built-in microwave cavity interior must be free of sharp edges, burrs, or exposed metal that can cause arcing
conditions: Microwave is designed for food heating (magnetron-based)

subject: Built-in Microwave
rule: Built-in microwave door interlock switches must all engage before the magnetron can operate

subject: Built-in Refrigerator/Under-counter Fridge
rule: must have unobstructed ventilation airflow path (front grille or rear clearance zone)
conditions: built-in/under-counter installation

subject: Built-in Refrigerator/Under-counter Fridge
rule: must have a dedicated electrical supply circuit matching manufacturer nameplate rating
conditions: permanent installation as built-in

subject: Built-in Refrigerator/Under-counter Fridge
rule: must not be installed in a location where ambient temperature falls below the manufacturer's minimum rated temperature
conditions: outdoor or unheated space installation
garage or porch installation
exceptions: unit specifically rated and listed for that ambient temperature range

subject: Built-in Refrigerator/Under-counter Fridge
rule: must have a code-compliant water supply line and drain connection if equipped with automatic ice maker or water dispenser
conditions: model includes ice maker or water dispenser

subject: Built-in Refrigerator/Under-counter Fridge
rule: must be installed on a level, structurally adequate floor capable of supporting the unit's fully loaded weight
conditions: installation

subject: Dishwasher (Under-counter)
rule: Dishwasher must be connected to a hot water supply line
conditions: standard residential installation
exceptions: commercial cold-water-only sanitizing dishwashers

subject: Dishwasher (Under-counter)
rule: Dishwasher must be connected to a drain line that discharges into the household drainage system or a garbage disposal
exceptions: portable/ countertop dishwashers that drain into a sink

subject: Dishwasher (Under-counter)
rule: Dishwasher must have an electrical power supply (typically 120V dedicated circuit)

subject: Dishwasher (Under-counter)
rule: Dishwasher must not be installed in a location where ambient temperatures can drop below freezing
conditions: installations in unconditioned spaces (garages, cabins)

subject: Dishwasher (Under-counter)
rule: Dishwasher must be installed with an air gap or high-loop drain line to prevent backflow of wastewater
conditions: plumbing code jurisdictions in North America
exceptions: some jurisdictions allow alternative backflow prevention devices

subject: Overhead Microwave/Exhaust Hood
rule: Overhead microwave/exhaust hood must be ducted to the exterior of the building
conditions: hood is installed in a residential kitchen
hood is installed in a commercial kitchen
exceptions: recirculating hoods that use charcoal filters and are specifically designed for non-ducted operation

subject: Overhead Microwave/Exhaust Hood
rule: Overhead microwave/exhaust hood must be installed at a minimum clearance above the cooking surface
conditions: hood is installed above a range or cooktop
exceptions: manufacturer specifications may permit a different distance, but must be followed exactly

subject: Overhead Microwave/Exhaust Hood
rule: Overhead microwave/exhaust hood electrical supply must be on a dedicated circuit
conditions: hood includes a microwave oven component
installation is in the United States under NEC

subject: Overhead Microwave/Exhaust Hood
rule: Overhead microwave/exhaust hood must not have the exhaust duct terminate in an attic or crawl space
conditions: hood is ducted (not recirculating)

subject: Overhead Microwave/Exhaust Hood
rule: Overhead microwave/exhaust hood duct must be made of smooth metal material
conditions: hood is ducted to exterior
exceptions: flexible duct listed and labeled for the specific application is permitted by some codes

subject: Overhead Microwave/Exhaust Hood
rule: Overhead microwave/exhaust hood must be securely fastened to wall or bottom of cabinet structure

subject: Kitchenette Plumbing Rough-in
rule: Kitchenette plumbing rough-in must have a dedicated hot water supply line
conditions: kitchenette includes a sink
kitchenette includes a faucet requiring hot water
exceptions: kitchenette is designed for cold-water-only use with no hot water demand whatsoever

subject: Kitchenette Plumbing Rough-in
rule: Kitchenette plumbing rough-in must include a trap on the drain line
conditions: kitchenette includes a sink or other drainable fixture

subject: Kitchenette Plumbing Rough-in
rule: Kitchenette plumbing rough-in must not have a drain line smaller than 1.5 inches in diameter
conditions: drain serves a kitchen sink

subject: Kitchenette Plumbing Rough-in
rule: Kitchenette plumbing rough-in must have a vent connection for the drain system
conditions: kitchenette includes a sink or other drainable fixture
exceptions: installation uses an approved air admittance valve (AAV) as an alternative to a traditional vent

subject: Kitchenette Plumbing Rough-in
rule: Kitchenette plumbing rough-in must have a shut-off valve on the hot and cold water supply lines
conditions: kitchenette has both hot and cold water supply connections

subject: Undercabinet Lighting
rule: Undercabinet lighting must be rated for damp or humid locations when installed above a sink or dishwasher
conditions: installed above a sink or dishwasher
exceptions: fixture is specifically rated for dry locations only and is installed with a GFCI-protected circuit and splash guard

subject: Undercabinet Lighting
rule: Undercabinet lighting must not be installed where it obstructs the operation of a range hood, exhaust vent, or fire suppression nozzle
conditions: installed in a cooking area with overhead exhaust or suppression equipment

subject: Undercabinet Lighting
rule: Undercabinet lighting fixture must have a clearance gap from the cabinet bottom to allow heat dissipation if it is a non-LED (incandescent/halogen) type
conditions: fixture type is incandescent or halogen
exceptions: fixture is certified for zero-clearance contact with cabinetry

subject: Ceiling Light Fixture
rule: ceiling light fixture must be securely attached to a structural ceiling or framing member
conditions: surface-mounted installation
pendant or suspended installation
exceptions: glued or adhesive-mounted fixtures that do not rely on structural attachment for safety may follow manufacturer's adhesive specifications instead

subject: Ceiling Light Fixture
rule: ceiling light fixture must not have electrical wiring exposed between the junction box and the fixture body
conditions: hardwired installation
exceptions: fixtures designed with decorative exposed wiring per listing and manufacturer instructions (e.g., certain industrial or vintage styles with UL-listed exposed wiring)

subject: Ceiling Light Fixture
rule: ceiling light fixture must be rated for the enclosure or environment in which it is installed
conditions: installation in a damp location
installation in a wet location
installation in a fire-rated ceiling assembly

subject: Ceiling Light Fixture
rule: ceiling light fixture must not exceed the maximum wattage or load rating of its sockets and wiring

subject: Wall Finish (Paint/Tile)
rule: Wall finish must not be applied to wet or damp substrate
conditions: Any wall substrate (plaster, concrete, drywall)
exceptions: Specially formulated moisture-curing coatings designed for damp surfaces

subject: Wall Finish (Paint/Tile)
rule: Wall finish (tile) must be installed on a substrate that can bear the tile weight without deflection
conditions: Tile finish
Vertical wall application
exceptions: Very thin lightweight tile (e.g., thin porcelain panels) on adequately braced framing; adhesive-only attachment without mechanical support

subject: Wall Finish (Paint/Tile)
rule: Wall finish (paint) must not be applied over unprimered bare gypsum board
conditions: Paint finish
New/unpainted gypsum wallboard
exceptions: Paint formulations specifically labeled as self-priming and compatible with bare gypsum

subject: Wall Finish (Paint/Tile)
rule: Tile wall finish must include waterproofing membrane in wet areas
conditions: Tile finish
Location is a wet area (shower, bath, pool surround)
exceptions: Areas not subject to standing water or high moisture exposure (e.g., dry kitchen backsplash)

subject: Floor Finish (Resilient/Tile)
rule: resilient or tile floor finish must be installed on a substrate that is clean, dry, smooth, and free of cracks or debris
conditions: when installed over concrete subfloor
when installed over wood subfloor
exceptions: when manufacturer's instructions explicitly allow installation over a prepared crack isolation membrane

subject: Floor Finish (Resilient/Tile)
rule: resilient or tile floor finish must not be installed where the floor will be subject to continuous standing water or ponding
conditions: for non-waterproof resilient products (e.g., standard vinyl composition tile, linoleum)
exceptions: when the product is specifically rated and warranted for wet-area use (e.g., porcelain tile with waterproof grout, sealed sheet vinyl with welded seams)

subject: Floor Finish (Resilient/Tile)
rule: resilient or tile floor finish must have a minimum substrate flatness tolerance (typically 1/8" in 10' or as specified by manufacturer)
conditions: for thin-set tile installations
for loose-lay or glue-down resilient sheet and plank
exceptions: when a thick-bed mortar installation is used for tile

subject: Floor Finish (Resilient/Tile)
rule: resilient or tile floor finish installation temperature must be within the range specified by the manufacturer (generally 65-85°F ambient and substrate)
conditions: during installation
for at least 48 hours before and after installation
exceptions: when manufacturer specifically provides low-temperature or high-temperature adhesive products

subject: Floor Finish (Resilient/Tile)
rule: resilient or tile floor finish must not be installed over a substrate with high moisture emission (above manufacturer's limit, typically 3-5 lbs/1000 sqft/24hrs for resilient)
conditions: over concrete slabs on grade or below grade
exceptions: when a moisture vapor retarder and approved epoxy or moisture-tolerant adhesive system is used

subject: Coffee/ Beverage Station Niche
rule: Coffee/Beverage Station Niche must have a minimum clearance of 30 inches (762 mm) in front of the station for access and operation
conditions: Station is intended for use by staff or customers
exceptions: Station is designed as a pass-through or service window type with access from opposite side

subject: Coffee/ Beverage Station Niche
rule: Coffee/Beverage Station Niche must have a floor drain or sealed, cleanable flooring with water-resistant finish
conditions: Station includes a sink, ice machine, or plumbed beverage equipment
exceptions: Station is a dry-prep-only area with no water source or drain lines

subject: Coffee/ Beverage Station Niche
rule: Coffee/Beverage Station Niche must not have electrical outlets or switches located directly above or within 6 inches horizontally of a sink basin
conditions: Station includes a sink or handwashing basin
exceptions: Outlets are GFCI-protected and listed for use near sinks by manufacturer specifications

subject: Coffee/ Beverage Station Niche
rule: Coffee/Beverage Station Niche must have a backsplash that extends at least 4 inches above countertop and is made of non-absorbent, cleanable material
conditions: Station has a countertop used for beverage preparation

subject: Kickplate / Toe-kick
rule: Kickplate / toe-kick must provide a minimum clearance of at least 4 inches (100 mm) from the finished floor to allow for toe space and prevent foot impact
conditions: installed in kitchen or bathroom cabinetry
installed at base of wall or cabinet where standing user approaches
exceptions: barrier-free/ADA-compliant designs where clearance is increased to 6-9 inches
fully sealed continuous base where no foot space is needed (e.g., cleanroom or laboratory)

subject: Kickplate / Toe-kick
rule: Kickplate must be securely fastened to prevent detachment under expected lateral foot contact loads
conditions: used in high-traffic or commercial settings
exceptions: temporary or display installations not subject to occupant use

subject: Kickplate / Toe-kick
rule: Kickplate / toe-kick must not have sharp exposed edges or corners at foot-contact height
conditions: accessible to occupants

subject: Countertop Outlet Strip (Pop-up)
rule: Countertop Outlet Strip (Pop-up) must be UL/ETL listed for the intended electrical load and application
conditions: when installed in a wet or damp location (e.g., kitchen countertop)
when serving countertop appliances with total current draw up to the device's rated capacity
exceptions: when installed in a dry location only and local code permits unlisted devices

subject: Countertop Outlet Strip (Pop-up)
rule: Countertop Outlet Strip (Pop-up) must have a grounded (3-prong) plug or be hardwired with proper equipment grounding
conditions: when the device is connected to a building's branch circuit

subject: Countertop Outlet Strip (Pop-up)
rule: Countertop Outlet Strip (Pop-up) must not have its pop-up mechanism obstructed by countertop material, trim, or adjacent objects
conditions: when the device is recessed-mounted into the countertop surface

subject: Countertop Outlet Strip (Pop-up)
rule: Countertop Outlet Strip (Pop-up) must have a means of water drainage or sealing (e.g., gasket, drip tray, or drain holes) when installed in a wet location
conditions: when installed in a wet location (e.g., kitchen island, bar, outdoor countertop)

subject: Video Conferencing Camera
rule: camera lens must have an unobstructed optical path to the scene being captured
conditions: during normal operation
exceptions: when camera is intentionally covered or stored

subject: Video Conferencing Camera
rule: camera must have a continuous power supply within its rated voltage range
conditions: during active use
exceptions: when camera is battery-powered and battery is sufficiently charged

subject: Video Conferencing Camera
rule: camera image sensor must not exceed maximum rated operating temperature
conditions: during continuous operation

subject: Whiteboard / Marker Board
rule: Marker board surface must be non-porous and impermeable to dry-erase marker ink
conditions: when used with standard dry-erase markers
exceptions: specialty porous-surface marker boards designed for wet-erase or chalk use

subject: Whiteboard / Marker Board
rule: Marker board must not have a glossy or highly reflective surface
conditions: when installed in a space with overhead or directional lighting

subject: Whiteboard / Marker Board
rule: Marker board writing surface must be compatible with dry-erase markers and permit clean erasure without ghosting after normal use

subject: Room Scheduling Panel
rule: A Room Scheduling Panel must be installed on a wall surface that is accessible to end users without requiring a ladder or stool
conditions: Panel is wall-mounted

subject: Room Scheduling Panel
rule: A Room Scheduling Panel must not be installed in a location where it is exposed to direct water spray (e.g., sprinkler head directly above, hose-down cleaning zone)
conditions: Panel is indoors but in a space with cleaning hoses or fire sprinklers

subject: Ceiling Mounted Projector
rule: projector must be mounted to a structurally adequate ceiling support (e.g., structural beam or reinforced slab)
conditions: ceiling-mounted installation

subject: Ceiling Mounted Projector
rule: projector must have an unobstructed line of sight between its lens and the projection screen/surface
conditions: projector is in use

subject: Ceiling Mounted Projector
rule: projector must not be installed where ambient heat or lack of ventilation causes internal temperature to exceed manufacturer rated operating range
conditions: projector is powered on

subject: Ceiling Mounted Projector
rule: projector must be supplied with electrical power matching its rated voltage and current specifications

subject: Ceiling Mounted Projector
rule: projector must not be positioned such that the lens is aimed directly at occupants' eyes at close range in sustained viewing situations
conditions: occupants are present during projector operation
exceptions: brief incidental exposure during adjustment

subject: Projection Screen
rule: Projection screen must have a rigid structural frame or housing to maintain its flat/curved shape under gravity and tension
conditions: screens larger than approximately 100 inches diagonal
non-self-supporting flexible screen material
exceptions: ultra-small portable screens that rely on a tensioned fabric within a compact roll-up casing — the casing itself serves as the rigid frame

subject: Projection Screen
rule: Projection screen surface must be opaque and non-translucent to the projected light wavelength (visible spectrum)
conditions: front-projection screens
exceptions: rear-projection screens where the screen material is specifically designed to be translucent and is illuminated from behind

subject: Projection Screen
rule: Projection screen must not have a specular (mirror-like) reflective surface
conditions: front-projection screens for general audience viewing
