rule: Bioretention planter must maintain positive drainage (minimum slope or freeboard) to prevent overflow onto adjacent structures or pedestrian areas
conditions: planter is located adjacent to building foundations or walkways
exceptions: planter is intentionally designed as a ponding feature with overflow routed safely away

subject: Drainage Layer Assembly
rule: Drainage layer assembly must have a continuous positive slope toward outlets
conditions: The assembly is installed on a roof or horizontal surface requiring water removal
exceptions: When assembly is designed as a flat roof with internal drains and tapered insulation providing the slope

subject: Drainage Layer Assembly
rule: Drainage layer assembly must not be installed directly below a vapor-impermeable layer without a means for drying
conditions: The assembly is part of a below-grade or low-slope roofing system
exceptions: When a fully adhered vapor-permeable air barrier separates the drainage layer from the impermeable layer above

subject: Drainage Layer Assembly
rule: Drainage layer material must have hydraulic conductivity sufficient to prevent hydrostatic pressure buildup under the design flow rate
conditions: The drainage layer is the primary means of water evacuation in the assembly

subject: Growing Medium (Engineered Soil)
rule: growing medium (engineered soil) must have sufficient load-bearing capacity to support intended plant growth and maintain stability under saturated conditions
conditions: when used in a green roof assembly
when used in a planter or growing bed

subject: Growing Medium (Engineered Soil)
rule: growing medium (engineered soil) must not contain contaminants or phytotoxic substances that inhibit plant growth
conditions: when used as a plant growth substrate
exceptions: if the medium is explicitly designed for non-vegetative applications such as filtration only

subject: Growing Medium (Engineered Soil)
rule: growing medium (engineered soil) must have adequate drainage and aeration porosity to prevent waterlogging and root anoxia
conditions: when used as a plant growth substrate in a contained assembly

subject: Growing Medium (Engineered Soil)
rule: growing medium (engineered soil) must not detach, erode, or wash away from sloped surfaces under design rainfall events
conditions: when installed on slopes greater than 2:1
when exposed to direct rainfall without a surface covering/erosion blanket
exceptions: if the medium is fully encapsulated within a geotextile or containment mesh system

subject: Root Barrier Membrane
rule: root barrier membrane must be continuous across all joints and seams to prevent root penetration
conditions: when used as part of a green roof assembly
when in direct contact with growing medium or soil
exceptions: temporary installation prior to seaming

subject: Root Barrier Membrane
rule: root barrier membrane must be chemically resistant to root exudates and soil-borne microorganisms
conditions: when installed below growing medium in a vegetated roof assembly

subject: Root Barrier Membrane
rule: root barrier membrane must not be installed with tensile stress exceeding its rated puncture resistance under overburden load
conditions: when covered by growing medium and vegetation

subject: Green Roof Vegetation Mat
rule: vegetation mat must be underlain by a root-resistant waterproof membrane
conditions: when installed as part of a vegetated (green) roof assembly

subject: Green Roof Vegetation Mat
rule: vegetation mat must not be installed on a roof slope exceeding the substrate's angle of repose without mechanical retention
conditions: when the roof slope exceeds the angle of repose of the growing medium (typically > 10–15° for loose substrate)
exceptions: if mechanical retention (e.g., battens,网格, or compartmentalisation) is provided to prevent slippage

subject: Green Roof Vegetation Mat
rule: vegetation mat must not be fully submerged in standing water for prolonged periods
conditions: unless the mat is specifically designed as a saturated/wetland system

subject: Green Roof Protection Layer
rule: The protection layer must be physically separate from the waterproofing membrane by a slip sheet or separation layer
conditions: When the protection layer is installed directly above the waterproofing membrane
exceptions: If the protection layer material is chemically compatible and permanently bonded to the waterproofing membrane

subject: Green Roof Protection Layer
rule: The protection layer must be continuous across the entire roof surface without gaps that expose the underlying waterproofing
exceptions: At intentional drainage points or roof drains where gaps are required for water ingress

subject: Green Roof Protection Layer
rule: The protection layer must not trap moisture against the waterproofing membrane
exceptions: When the protection layer material is hygroscopic and actively wicks moisture to the drainage layer

subject: Zone
rule: A zone that is a habitable space must have at least one means of egress (door or window) to a circulation path or exterior
conditions: zone is a habitable space (e.g., office, bedroom, living room)
exceptions: uninhabitable zones such as storage closets, mechanical rooms
zones with approved alternative egress via fire-rated passage

subject: Zone
rule: A zone of use type 'plenum' or 'air-handling' must not contain unenclosed combustion sources or untreated building materials that can off-gas
conditions: zone is designated as a plenum or air-handling space per mechanical code

subject: Zone
rule: A zone containing a water-closet or urinal must have a finished, cleanable, non-absorbent floor surface
conditions: zone is a toilet room or bathroom containing a water-closet or urinal

subject: Zone
rule: A zone that is a sleeping room in a residential occupancy must have a window that meets minimum net clear opening for emergency escape and rescue
conditions: zone is a bedroom in a Group R occupancy (residential)
exceptions: sprinklered buildings where code may allow reduction or alternate path

subject: Sector
rule: Sector boundaries must be physically enclosed or demarcated to separate it from adjacent spaces
conditions: Sector is a physically defined sub-zone within a larger space
exceptions: Virtual or conceptual sectors that exist only in data models

subject: Sector
rule: Sector must have a means of access/egress that connects to a circulation path or adjacent space
conditions: Sector is intended for occupancy
exceptions: Sectors used exclusively for mechanical or service functions with no occupancy requirement

subject: Sector
rule: Sector floor area must not exceed the structural load capacity of the supporting slab or foundation system
conditions: Sector is located above grade or on a suspended floor
exceptions: Sectors at grade on properly compacted soil

subject: Sector
rule: Sector must not omit fire-resistance rated separations where required by code between adjacent sectors or between sector and means of egress
conditions: Sector is part of a building with multiple occupancy groups or exceeds area thresholds requiring compartmentation
exceptions: Sectors within a single fire zone where code does not mandate separation

subject: Courtyard
rule: courtyard must have a free-draining positive slope away from the building foundation
conditions: courtyard is paved or impermeable
exceptions: courtyard is designed as a rain garden or bio-retention basin with controlled infiltration

subject: Courtyard
rule: courtyard must not be enclosed on all sides by occupied building wings without an accessible egress path
conditions: courtyard is bounded by building walls on all sides
courtyard serves as an outdoor assembly or circulation space
exceptions: courtyard has a minimum 1-hour fire-rated opening or passageway to a public way

subject: Courtyard
rule: courtyard surface must be slip-resistant under wet conditions
conditions: courtyard is accessible to the public or building occupants
courtyard is exposed to rain or irrigation
exceptions: courtyard is decorative-only with no pedestrian access

subject: Separation Wall Assembly
rule: Separation wall assembly must have a fire-resistance rating appropriate to the building code occupancy and construction type
conditions: When serving as a fire separation between adjacent buildings or tenancies
When required by local building code
exceptions: Non-separated occupancies where code permits mixed use without fire separation

subject: Separation Wall Assembly
rule: Separation wall assembly must be structurally self-supporting or independently supported
conditions: When required by building code to be a true fire wall (not just a fire partition)
exceptions: Fire partitions that are permitted to rely on the building frame for support

subject: Separation Wall Assembly
rule: Separation wall assembly must extend from the foundation to or through the roof covering
conditions: When classified as a fire wall per IBC or equivalent code
exceptions: Where code permits a fire wall to terminate at the underside of a non-combustible roof deck with specific draft-stop conditions

subject: Separation Wall Assembly
rule: Separation wall assembly must not have through-penetrations that compromise the fire-resistance rating unless properly firestopped
conditions: Any time the wall is required to have a fire-resistance rating
exceptions: Penetrations protected by approved firestop systems tested to the same rating

subject: Demarcation Floor Finish
rule: Demarcation floor finish must be visually distinct from adjacent floor finishes
conditions: when used to indicate a change in level
when used to indicate a transition between different occupancy zones
when used to indicate a hazard boundary
exceptions: when the building code or accessibility standard specifically permits tactile-only cues without visual contrast

subject: Demarcation Floor Finish
rule: Demarcation floor finish must not create a tripping hazard at its edge
conditions: when the demarcation finish is raised or applied as a surface-mounted strip

subject: Residential District
rule: residential district must have adequate drainage infrastructure to prevent flooding of building sites and roadways

subject: Threshold
rule: Threshold bottom edge must be flush with finished floor on both sides
conditions: Threshold installed at doorway between interior and exterior
Threshold installed between two interior finished floor surfaces
exceptions: Sloped thresholds for accessibility ramps where flush transition is not geometrically possible

subject: Threshold
rule: Threshold must provide a continuous seal across the full width of the door opening when the door is closed
conditions: Threshold is installed in an exterior door assembly
exceptions: Interior doors where no environmental separation is required

subject: Threshold
rule: Threshold must not have a vertical face higher than the maximum allowed by applicable accessibility code
conditions: Threshold is in a publicly accessible or ADA-compliant building
exceptions: Historic buildings with documented waivers
Residential thresholds where no accessibility code applies

subject: Threshold
rule: Threshold must be anchored to prevent displacement under expected foot traffic and wheel loads
conditions: Threshold is subject to pedestrian traffic

subject: Commercial Zone
rule: Commercial zone must have direct vehicular access to a public road or dedicated service road

subject: Commercial Zone
rule: Commercial zone must have a minimum fire-access clear width (e.g., 6 m) for emergency vehicles on at least one facade
conditions: If the zone contains any building with a floor above ground level

subject: Commercial Zone
rule: Commercial zone must not be located within a regulatory floodway where construction is prohibited
conditions: If the jurisdiction enforces floodplain management regulations

subject: Commercial Zone
rule: Commercial zone must include an accessible pedestrian route from the public sidewalk or parking area to each principal building entrance
conditions: If the zone contains buildings intended for public occupancy

subject: Commercial Zone
rule: Commercial zone must have a minimum lot area that satisfies the applicable zoning bylaw minimum for the designated commercial use
conditions: If local zoning code specifies a minimum lot area for the commercial district

subject: Industrial Quarter
rule: Industrial Quarter floors must be designed to support heavy static and dynamic industrial loads (e.g., machinery, storage racks, forklift traffic) without failure

subject: Industrial Quarter
rule: Industrial Quarter must have at least one egress path that remains unobstructed and meets minimum width and travel-distance requirements for industrial occupancy

subject: Industrial Quarter
rule: Industrial Quarter must not have floor drains or pits located where they could allow flammable or hazardous liquid spills to spread to other areas or ignition sources

subject: Industrial Quarter
rule: Industrial Quarter ceilings or overhead structures must provide minimum clear height required by served equipment and applicable building codes

subject: Industrial Quarter
rule: Industrial Quarter ventilation must be adequate to prevent accumulation of hazardous airborne contaminants (dusts, fumes, vapors) to concentrations above permissible exposure limits

subject: Civic Plaza
rule: Civic Plaza must have a minimum of two means of egress
conditions: occupied by more than 50 people at any time
exceptions: single-story structure with occupant load under 50

subject: Civic Plaza
rule: Civic Plaza must have fire-rated enclosures around any vertical shaft openings
conditions: building is more than two stories in height

subject: Civic Plaza
rule: Civic Plaza must have an accessible route from the public way to all primary entrances and common areas
exceptions: historic structures where providing access would threaten historic significance

subject: Civic Plaza
rule: Civic Plaza must not have door openings narrower than 32 inches clear width at accessible entrances
conditions: door serves an accessible entrance or path of travel

subject: Civic Plaza
rule: Civic Plaza must have a roof drainage system capable of handling a 100-year storm event
conditions: located in a region subject to rainfall

subject: Civic Plaza
rule: Civic Plaza must have a sprinkler system if the building exceeds the allowable area for non-sprinklered construction
conditions: building area exceeds threshold per IBC Table 506.2 for non-sprinklered construction

subject: Marketplace
rule: Marketplace roof must have a drainage path
conditions: if marketplace has a roof

subject: Marketplace
rule: Marketplace floor must support expected live loads (occupant, display, and circulation loads)

subject: Marketplace
rule: Marketplace must have at least one accessible egress path meeting minimum width requirements

subject: Marketplace
rule: Marketplace must not block natural airflow or ventilation paths if relying on natural ventilation
conditions: if marketplace relies on natural ventilation (no mechanical system)

subject: Park & Recreation Area
rule: Park & Recreation Area must have a minimum of 0.6 m (2 ft) of unobstructed clear space around all sides of any fixed play structure or recreation equipment
conditions: when containing fixed play structures or recreation equipment
exceptions: equipment specifically designed to be installed flush against a wall or barrier (e.g., rock-climbing wall, certain fitness stations)

subject: Park & Recreation Area
rule: Park & Recreation Area must have a slip-resistant, even walking surface on all primary pedestrian circulation paths within the area
conditions: when the area is intended for public use
exceptions: designated natural trails where uneven terrain is intentional and signed

subject: Park & Recreation Area
rule: Park & Recreation Area must not have any drainage point, irrigation outlet, or water-spray feature that discharges directly into an adjacent building's foundation zone or enclosed occupied space
conditions: when the park is adjacent to a building with an occupied interior
exceptions: properly engineered drainage systems routed away via subsurface piping

subject: Utility Corridor
rule: utility corridor must have a minimum clear width of at least 900 mm (36 in) for service access and maintenance
conditions: corridor provides access to mechanical, electrical, or plumbing equipment
exceptions: corridor serves only cabling/raceways with no equipment requiring personnel access

subject: Utility Corridor
rule: utility corridor must have a fire-resistance-rated enclosure if it passes through fire compartments
conditions: corridor penetrates a fire-rated wall or floor assembly
corridor connects separate fire zones
exceptions: corridor is fully sprinklered and local code allows omission of rating

subject: Utility Corridor
rule: utility corridor must not contain occupied workspaces or habitable rooms
conditions: corridor is designated as a utility/mechanical chase or service corridor

subject: Utility Corridor
rule: utility corridor must have a minimum headroom of 2000 mm (79 in) for service personnel
conditions: corridor is intended for personnel access for inspection or maintenance
exceptions: corridor is a crawlspace or plenum with restricted access only for cable pulling, not human occupancy

subject: Utility Corridor
rule: utility corridor must have a non-combustible lining if it contains combustible utilities (e.g., fuel gas piping)
conditions: corridor contains fuel-gas piping, oil lines, or other combustible-service conduits
exceptions: all piping is encased in a fire-rated chase with no exposed combustible surfaces

subject: Town Hall
rule: main public entrance must be at grade or via an accessible ramp (not stairs alone)
conditions: building has a public entrance
entrance serves as primary accessible route
exceptions: historic landmark exemption where structural modification is prohibited

subject: Town Hall
rule: assembly or council chamber must have at least two separate means of egress
conditions: chamber has an occupant load greater than 49 people

subject: Town Hall
rule: emergency exits must not be locked or obstructed during occupancy
conditions: building is occupied
exceptions: delayed-egress locks permitted on certain doors if approved by fire marshal and meeting specific code requirements

subject: Parking Structure
rule: parking structure floor surfaces must have a minimum slope of 1% for drainage
conditions: floor is exposed to weather or wash-down operations
exceptions: indoor/covered parking levels without wash-down requirements

subject: Parking Structure
rule: parking structure must not have a roof slope less than 1/4 inch per foot (approximately 2%)
conditions: roof is a conventional flat or low-slope membrane roof over occupied or usable space
exceptions: roof is designed as a green roof with engineered drainage layer and overflow scuppers

subject: Parking Structure
rule: ramp slopes in parking structure must not exceed 6.67% (1:15) for passenger vehicle access
conditions: ramp is used by passenger vehicles
exceptions: express ramps or truck-specific ramps designed to local building code exceptions

subject: Parking Structure
rule: parking structure must have a minimum vertical clearance of 7 feet (2.13 m) at all vehicular paths
conditions: parking structure serves standard passenger vehicles
exceptions: structures explicitly designated for compact cars only with posted restrictions, per local code

subject: Parking Structure
rule: parking structure must have continuous guardrails or barriers at all open edges where vertical drop exceeds 30 inches
conditions: parking structure has open edges on ramps, drive aisles, or perimeter of upper floors

subject: Perimeter Wall
rule: Perimeter wall must be structurally stable under its own weight and lateral loads
conditions: when wall is self-supporting
exceptions: walls that are purely decorative and non-structural

subject: Perimeter Wall
rule: Perimeter wall must have a continuous load path to the foundation
conditions: when wall supports any vertical load

subject: Perimeter Wall
rule: Perimeter wall must not exceed its material's allowable stress limits under design loads

subject: Perimeter Wall
rule: Perimeter wall must be adequately laterally restrained or braced to prevent out-of-plane buckling
conditions: when wall height exceeds slenderness limits for its material
exceptions: thick or monolithic walls that are self-bracing by geometry

subject: Perimeter Wall
rule: Perimeter wall must not impede required egress paths from the building
conditions: when wall encloses occupied spaces with exit routes
exceptions: walls that include properly rated fire doors or exit openings

subject: Entry Gate
rule: Entry gate must provide a clear opening width that accommodates the required egress or access width per applicable code
conditions: When the gate is part of a means of egress
or when it serves as a primary vehicular access point
exceptions: Gates not serving egress or primary access

subject: Entry Gate
rule: Entry gate must not swing outward over public right-of-way or pedestrian circulation path unless the swing area is physically protected or allowable by code
conditions: When the gate opens outward toward a sidewalk, street, or public path
exceptions: Where local code permits outward swing with protective barriers
or where the gate serves a private drive with no pedestrian exposure

subject: Entry Gate
rule: Entry gate must have a latching or locking mechanism that can be operated from the egress side without special knowledge, tools, or excessive force
conditions: When the gate is on a means of egress
exceptions: Gates on secured areas such as prisons or high-security facilities where alternative egress is provided

subject: Entry Gate
rule: Entry gate must not obstruct or reduce the required width of the means of egress when in any open position
conditions: When the gate is part of an egress path
exceptions: Gates that fully recess, slide, or fold clear of the egress width

subject: Street Lighting System
rule: street lighting system must be electrically grounded
conditions: system is connected to mains power supply
exceptions: battery-powered or solar standalone systems with no metallic exposed parts and certified double insulation

subject: Street Lighting System
rule: street lighting system must not have exposed live electrical parts accessible at touch height
conditions: any part of the system carrying line voltage (>50 V AC)
exceptions: enclosed junction boxes with tool-required access located above 2.5 m

subject: Street Lighting System
rule: street lighting luminaire must have an IP rating of at least IP65
conditions: luminaire is installed outdoors exposed to weather
exceptions: luminaire mounted under a canopy providing equivalent weather protection and verified by manufacturer

subject: Town Drainage Network
rule: the drainage network must have continuous gravity flow (no reverse slope) from collection points to the outfall
conditions: system is not a pumped network
exceptions: where a lift station or pump is explicitly designed into the system

subject: Town Drainage Network
rule: pipe minimum velocity must be at least 0.6 m/s at design flow to prevent sedimentation
conditions: pipe is part of a sanitary sewer system
exceptions: short force main sections with turbulent inlet conditions that prevent settling

subject: Town Drainage Network
rule: pipe diameter must not decrease in the direction of flow
conditions: system is a gravity sewer
exceptions: where a flow control device or drop manhole is designed to manage hydraulic jump

subject: Town Drainage Network
rule: manholes must be accessible from the surface for inspection and maintenance
conditions: manhole is part of a buried sewer network
exceptions: sewer is constructed by trenchless methods with no requirement for direct access (e.g., certain deep tunnel sections)

subject: Town Water Supply System
rule: water source must have sufficient yield to meet design demand
conditions: system is operational
serves a populated area
exceptions: emergency or temporary systems with alternative supply arrangements

subject: Town Water Supply System
rule: water must be potable at the point of delivery
conditions: system supplies water for human consumption
exceptions: systems explicitly designated for non-potable uses only, such as fire fighting or irrigation

subject: Town Water Supply System
rule: system must maintain positive pressure at all points under normal operation
conditions: system is a pressurized piped network

subject: Town Water Supply System
rule: storage tank overflow must not be blocked or sealed
conditions: system includes atmospheric storage tanks

subject: Road Pavement
rule: road pavement surface must have a minimum cross-slope of 1.5% for drainage
conditions: applies to paved roads with impervious surface
applies to roads in open or cut sections
exceptions: roads in superelevated curves where cross-slope follows the superelevation rate

subject: Road Pavement
rule: road pavement subgrade must be compacted to at least 95% of maximum dry density per standard Proctor
conditions: applies to all flexible and rigid road pavements

subject: Road Pavement
rule: road pavement surface must not retain standing water beyond 30 minutes after rainfall cessation
conditions: applies to roadways with design speed ≥ 50 km/h
exceptions: temporary ponding in designated detention areas within the roadway cross-section

subject: Road Pavement
rule: road pavement thickness must not be less than the minimum structural number required by the design traffic loading
conditions: applies to all vehicular road pavements
exceptions: temporary haul roads with limited service life and reduced traffic loading

subject: District Energy Plant
rule: must have a minimum separation distance from adjacent buildings or combustible structures to prevent fire spread
conditions: when located near other structures
exceptions: when all adjacent structures are constructed of non-combustible materials and have appropriate fire ratings

subject: District Energy Plant
rule: must have a secondary containment or spill control system around fuel storage tanks and chemical storage areas
conditions: when storing liquid fuels or chemicals on-site
exceptions: when no liquid fuels or chemicals are stored on-site in quantities above threshold limits

subject: District Energy Plant
rule: must have emergency ventilation and gas detection systems in enclosed areas where combustible gases may accumulate
conditions: when using natural gas or other combustible gases as fuel source
exceptions: when only electric or non-combustible fuel sources are used with no gas handling

subject: District Energy Plant
rule: must have a rated fire separation between the energy plant and any occupied spaces or adjacent buildings
conditions: when the plant is attached to or integrated within a building containing occupied spaces
exceptions: when the plant is a standalone detached building with no shared occupancy

subject: District Energy Plant
rule: must have a dedicated means of emergency shutdown (e-stop) for all major energy conversion equipment

subject: Curb & Gutter Assembly
rule: curb and gutter assembly must have a continuous longitudinal slope of at least 0.5% to drain stormwater
conditions: when designed for stormwater conveyance
when installed adjacent to paved surfaces
exceptions: when system uses alternative drainage such as underground collectors at each inlet point

subject: Curb & Gutter Assembly
rule: curb and gutter assembly must maintain a minimum height differential between curb top and gutter flowline of at least 150 mm (6 inches)
conditions: when designed to contain vehicular traffic and prevent encroachment onto pedestrian areas
exceptions: mountable curb designs for driveways or low-speed shared streets where vehicular crossing is intended

subject: Curb & Gutter Assembly
rule: curb and gutter assembly must not have joints spaced greater than 6 m (20 ft) for unreinforced concrete to prevent uncontrolled cracking
conditions: when constructed of plain Portland cement concrete without reinforcement
exceptions: when using fiber-reinforced concrete or steel reinforcement designed to control crack spacing

subject: Finger Corridor
rule: A finger corridor must have a minimum clear width of 44 inches (1118 mm) for accessibility along its entire accessible path
conditions: corridor serves as an accessible means of egress
corridor is part of an ADA-compliant facility
exceptions: existing historic buildings where altering corridor width is structurally infeasible and an alternate accessible path is provided

subject: Finger Corridor
rule: A finger corridor must not have a dead-end exceeding 20 feet in length unless it is protected by an automatic sprinkler system
conditions: corridor serves as a means of egress path
exceptions: fully sprinklered buildings where dead-end length may extend up to 50 feet per IBC

subject: Finger Corridor
rule: A finger corridor must have a maximum egress travel distance of 250 feet (unsprinklered) or 400 feet (sprinklered) measured from the most remote point to an exit
conditions: corridor is part of a means of egress system
exceptions: buildings fully protected by an approved automatic sprinkler system as permitted by IBC Chapter 10

subject: Finger Corridor
rule: A finger corridor must have a minimum ceiling height of 7 feet 6 inches (2286 mm) along the accessible path
conditions: corridor is occupied space
corridor provides a required means of egress
exceptions: beams, ducts, or other obstructions projecting from the ceiling provided they do not reduce headroom below 6 feet 8 inches over a minimum 36-inch width

subject: Nursing Station (Finger Wing)
rule: nursing station must have direct visual access to patient corridor(s) from the workstation
conditions: Finger Wing configuration
inpatient unit

subject: Nursing Station (Finger Wing)
rule: nursing station must be located to allow egress path from patient rooms to exits without passing behind the station
conditions: Finger Wing configuration
multiple patient rooms
exceptions: if station is an alcove with a clear bypass path at least 44 inches wide

subject: Nursing Station (Finger Wing)
rule: nursing station must not block or reduce corridor clear width below the fire code minimum (typically 8 ft in inpatient wings)
conditions: Finger Wing corridor
exceptions: if alcove or recessed station keeps corridor obstruction-free

subject: Central Core / Hub
rule: Central core / hub must contain vertical circulation (stairs, elevators, or ramps) connecting all served floors
conditions: building has more than one story
central core is the primary circulation zone
exceptions: single-story buildings where core serves only horizontal distribution

subject: Central Core / Hub
rule: Central core / hub must have minimum clear width sufficient for egress capacity required by building code
conditions: core serves as means of egress

subject: Central Core / Hub
rule: Central core / hub must not have floor openings that create an unprotected vertical shaft without proper fire/smoke separation
conditions: core contains through-floor openings such as atriums, escalators, or open stairs
exceptions: fully sprinklered buildings where code allows open atrium connections with smoke management

subject: Finger Wing Structural Frame
rule: The finger wing structural frame must be designed to transfer all gravity loads (dead, live, snow) continuously to the foundation without exceeding allowable stress or deflection limits
conditions: When supporting any roof or floor loads

subject: Finger Wing Structural Frame
rule: The finger wing structural frame must resist all lateral loads (wind, seismic) and transfer them to the lateral load-resisting system without causing global instability
conditions: In any region subject to wind or seismic loads

subject: Finger Wing Structural Frame
rule: Structural frame members must not be spaced beyond the spanning capacity of the supported roof/floor deck or cladding system
conditions: When the frame supports a deck or cladding with a known maximum span rating

subject: Finger Wing Structural Frame
rule: All steel-to-steel connections in the structural frame must be capable of developing the full design strength of the connected members
conditions: For welded or bolted connections in a steel finger wing frame

subject: Finger Wing Exterior Wall
rule: Finger Wing exterior wall must be vertically load-bearing to support the roof and upper floor structure
conditions: Finger Wing is a multi-storey building component
exterior wall is structural (non-curtainwall)
exceptions: If Finger Wing is a single-storey structure with a separate structural frame completely independent of the wall

subject: Finger Wing Exterior Wall
rule: Finger Wing exterior wall must resist lateral wind loads and transfer them to the foundation
conditions: Wall is exposed to exterior environment
local wind loads are applicable

subject: Finger Wing Exterior Wall
rule: Finger Wing exterior wall must not have uncontrolled openings that bypass the building envelope air barrier
conditions: Wall separates conditioned interior from exterior environment
exceptions: Purpose-provided ventilation openings with dampers/controls are allowed

subject: Finger Wing Exterior Wall
rule: Finger Wing exterior wall must provide a continuous water-shedding surface that prevents rainwater ingress into the interior
conditions: Wall is exposed to precipitation

subject: Finger Wing Roof Assembly
rule: roof must have a continuous drainage path from any point to a controlled outlet
conditions: when roof has any flat or low-slope surface
when roof is exposed to precipitation
exceptions: roof designed as a water-harvesting cistern with controlled overflow
roof that is entirely enclosed by a larger structure and not exposed to weather

subject: Finger Wing Roof Assembly
rule: roof membrane must form a continuous water barrier with all penetrations sealed
conditions: when roof is intended to be weathertight

subject: Finger Wing Roof Assembly
rule: roof assembly must not trap moisture within its layers
conditions: when roof includes insulation, deck, or vapor-impermeable layers
exceptions: roofs designed specifically as 'warm roofs' where all insulation is above the vapor barrier and condensation risk is engineered out

subject: Finger Wing Roof Assembly
rule: roof slope must be sufficient for the selected roofing material
conditions: when roof uses material with a minimum slope requirement (e.g., asphalt shingles, slate, clay tiles)
exceptions: materials specifically rated for low-slope or flat applications (e.g., membrane roofing, modified bitumen)

subject: Greenhouse Enclosure
rule: enclosure must be glazed or transparent to permit photosynthetically active radiation transmission
conditions: intended for plant cultivation
exceptions: non-photosynthetic plant production using artificial lighting only

subject: Greenhouse Enclosure
rule: enclosure must have operable ventilation openings or mechanical ventilation system
conditions: contains living plants
exceptions: sealed environment greenhouse with active CO2 and climate control systems

subject: Greenhouse Enclosure
rule: glazing material must not create concentrated solar hot-spots on plants or structure
conditions: glazing has lensing geometry such as acrylic/glass with curvature or large water droplets on surface

subject: Greenhouse Enclosure
rule: enclosure structure must withstand static and wind snow loads plus self-weight without collapse

subject: Hydroponic Growing System
rule: hydroponic growing system must have a water-tight reservoir or containment to prevent leaks

subject: Hydroponic Growing System
rule: hydroponic growing system must have a circulation pump to deliver nutrient solution to plant roots
conditions: if the system uses deep water culture, nutrient film technique, or any method requiring active flow
exceptions: systems that rely solely on passive wicking or static aeroponics where no active circulation is required

subject: Hydroponic Growing System
rule: hydroponic growing system must not have standing water that is stagnant for more than 24 hours without aeration
conditions: if the system uses deep water culture or any method with a static reservoir
exceptions: system designs that have been proven to operate anaerobically (e.g., some specialized experimental setups)

subject: Hydroponic Growing System
rule: hydroponic growing system must have root zone lighting that prevents algae growth in the nutrient reservoir
conditions: if the reservoir or root zone is exposed to light
exceptions: systems using opaque reservoirs or light-proof covers that fully block light

subject: Hydroponic Growing System
rule: hydroponic growing system must have structural support capable of bearing the full weight of the nutrient solution plus plants
conditions: if the system is elevated or suspended above ground level
exceptions: ground-level systems where the load is directly transferred to the floor

subject: Irrigation Distribution Network
rule: Irrigation distribution network must maintain positive pressure at all emitters during operation
conditions: system is pressurized type
system is in operation
exceptions: gravity-fed systems designed specifically for zero-pressure operation

subject: Irrigation Distribution Network
rule: Irrigation distribution network pipe diameter must not be smaller than the minimum required to maintain design flow velocity below erosive limits
conditions: pipe material has a defined maximum erosive velocity

subject: Irrigation Distribution Network
rule: Irrigation distribution network must have backflow prevention at connection to potable water supply
conditions: network is connected to a potable water source
exceptions: network is supplied exclusively from non-potable sources (e.g., reclaimed water, rainwater)

subject: Supplemental Lighting Array
rule: Supplemental lighting array must be electrically bonded and grounded in accordance with applicable electrical code
conditions: when connected to building electrical supply
when installed in a building with metallic structural components
exceptions: battery-powered portable lighting arrays not connected to mains power

subject: Supplemental Lighting Array
rule: Supplemental lighting array must not exceed the rated maximum branch circuit ampacity of the circuit supplying it
conditions: when hardwired or plugged into a branch circuit
exceptions: if the array has its own dedicated overcurrent-protected feeder

subject: Supplemental Lighting Array
rule: Supplemental lighting array must have adequate thermal management to prevent component temperature exceeding manufacturer rated maximum
conditions: for LED or high-intensity discharge luminaires producing significant heat

subject: Growing Media Bed
rule: growing media bed must be contained by a perimeter structure (e.g., a frame, wall, or curb) on all sides to prevent lateral spillage of the growing media
exceptions: beds designed as free-standing mounds on grade are exempt provided the media has sufficient internal cohesion to maintain its slope without erosion

subject: Growing Media Bed
rule: growing media bed must not be placed directly against a building wall without a waterproof membrane and a drainage plane between the media and the wall
conditions: when the bed abuts an occupied or conditioned building enclosure
exceptions: planter beds entirely separated from the building structure by a minimum 300 mm air gap or a robust drainage cavity

subject: Growing Media Bed
rule: growing media bed must have a drainage path (e.g., weep holes, perforated underdrain, gravel blanket) to remove excess water and prevent saturation of the root zone
conditions: for beds in any container, planter, or roof-top assembly that has an impermeable bottom or side
exceptions: beds that are open to the ground below (i.e., in-grade beds with natural soil subgrade)

subject: Growing Media Bed
rule: growing media depth must be sufficient to support the intended plant root system — a minimum of 150 mm for sedum/groundcover, 300 mm for perennials/grasses, 600 mm for shrubs, and 900 mm for trees
conditions: when plants are specified as part of the growing media bed design

subject: Shading Screen System
rule: shading screen system must have structurally adequate connection points at its interface with the building structure
conditions: when attached to a building facade or structure
exceptions: freestanding shading screens with independent structural support

subject: Shading Screen System
rule: shading screen system must not obstruct required emergency egress or escape routes
conditions: when installed near doors, windows serving as egress, or along exterior exit paths

subject: Shading Screen System
rule: shading screen system must be designed to resist wind loads per applicable building code

subject: Climate Control System
rule: climate control system must not have refrigerant leaks to the atmosphere
conditions: if system uses vapor-compression refrigeration cycle
if system contains CFC, HCFC, or HFC refrigerants
exceptions: systems using natural refrigerants (e.g., CO2, ammonia, propane) with no ODP or high GWP — though ammonia leaks still require safety containment

subject: Climate Control System
rule: climate control system must maintain minimum clearances around outdoor condensing units for airflow
conditions: for air-cooled condenser or heat pump systems
for rooftop or ground-mounted outdoor units
exceptions: water-cooled or evaporative-cooled systems that reject heat via fluid loops rather than ambient air

subject: Climate Control System
rule: climate control system must not have condensate drain lines that are trapped or blocked
conditions: for systems with cooling coils that produce condensate
for fan coil units, air handlers, or packaged units with drain pans

subject: Climate Control System
rule: climate control system must have electrical disconnect within sight of the equipment
conditions: for permanently installed HVAC equipment with line-voltage connections

subject: Vertical Growing Rack
rule: vertical growing rack must have structural load capacity to bear the weight of fully saturated growing media, plants, and irrigation water
conditions: rack is loaded with growing media and plants

subject: Vertical Growing Rack
rule: vertical growing rack must have a drainage system that removes excess water from each growing tier
conditions: rack uses soil-based or hydroponic growing media requiring irrigation
exceptions: aeroponic systems where water is atomized and fully absorbed or recycled without pooling

subject: Vertical Growing Rack
rule: vertical growing rack must not allow irrigation water to leak onto areas or equipment not designed for water exposure
conditions: rack is located indoors or above sensitive equipment/finishes

subject: Vertical Growing Rack
rule: vertical growing rack must maintain stability against overturning under expected live loads and any foreseeable lateral forces
conditions: rack is freestanding and not permanently anchored to structure

subject: Vertical Growing Rack
rule: vertical growing rack must provide safe access (ladder, step, or reach height) for maintenance of all tiers
conditions: highest growing surface exceeds 1.8 m (typical arm reach height)

subject: Crop Support Trellis System
rule: crop support trellis system must be grounded or anchored to resist overturning and wind uplift
conditions: when used in outdoor/field environments
when supporting climbing crops such as vines, beans, or tomatoes
exceptions: temporary lightweight trellises used indoors and fully sheltered from wind

subject: Crop Support Trellis System
rule: trellis material must not degrade or fail under sustained outdoor exposure and wet conditions within a single growing season
conditions: when used outdoors or in humid greenhouse environments
exceptions: disposable trellises designed for single-season use and replaced annually

subject: Crop Support Trellis System
rule: trellis system must have a load capacity sufficient to support the mature weight of the intended crop plus anticipated wind and rain loading
conditions: when the trellis is expected to remain in place for the full growing season or longer
exceptions: ornamental trellises not intended to bear significant plant weight

subject: Gravel or Sloped Floor Drainage
rule: A gravel or sloped floor drainage surface must have a continuous slope of at least 1% toward the drain outlet
conditions: The surface is intended to drain by gravity
exceptions: Drainage is fully mechanical (e.g., pumped) with no reliance on gravity flow

subject: Gravel or Sloped Floor Drainage
rule: The drainage path from the gravel or sloped floor must not be blocked by any solid obstruction that prevents water from reaching the outlet
exceptions: Temporary blockages during maintenance that are removed before return to service

subject: Gravel or Sloped Floor Drainage
rule: Gravel used for floor drainage must be free-draining (e.g., clean crushed stone or gravel with minimal fines)
conditions: Gravel is the drainage medium
exceptions: A geotextile wrap with engineered flow capacity is used to compensate for fines content

subject: Water Recycling & Filtration Plant
rule: Water Recycling & Filtration Plant must have a leak-proof containment system for all process vessels, pipes, and tanks carrying untreated or partially treated water

subject: Water Recycling & Filtration Plant
rule: Water Recycling & Filtration Plant must have backflow prevention devices on all potable water connections
conditions: where the plant connects to a potable water supply

subject: Water Recycling & Filtration Plant
rule: Water Recycling & Filtration Plant must have an emergency overflow or bypass system for peak flow events

subject: Water Recycling & Filtration Plant
rule: Water Recycling & Filtration Plant must not have discharge pipes that exit below the flood level of the surrounding site
exceptions: if the discharge is pumped and flood-protected with check valves and backup power

subject: Harvest Preparation Zone
rule: Harvest preparation zone must have a dedicated washable floor surface with drainage to allow cleaning and prevent standing water
conditions: zone is used for washing or rinsing harvested produce
exceptions: zone is used exclusively for dry processing (e.g., sorting, drying, curing) with no water exposure

subject: Harvest Preparation Zone
rule: Harvest preparation zone floor must not have untreated porous surfaces (e.g., bare earth, unsealed wood) in areas exposed to organic matter or moisture
conditions: zone handles fresh produce, organic debris, or is subject to wet cleaning
exceptions: temporary field-side sorting station used for less than one harvest shift

subject: Harvest Preparation Zone
rule: Harvest preparation zone must have a dedicated handwashing station with potable water within direct access if workers handle ready-to-eat produce
conditions: the zone is used for preparing produce that will be consumed raw

subject: Entry Air Lock / Vestibule
rule: Entry air lock / vestibule must have two doors that are not simultaneously openable in normal operation

subject: Entry Air Lock / Vestibule
rule: Entry air lock / vestibule must have an enclosed volume that physically separates the two doors
conditions: space is designated as an air lock or vestibule

subject: Entry Air Lock / Vestibule
rule: Entry air lock / vestibule must not have direct openings to habitable spaces other than the two controlled doors
conditions: space serves as a pressure/thermal air lock between two zones
exceptions: small observation window that is fixed and sealed

subject: Insulated Thermal Curtain Wall
rule: Insulated thermal curtain wall must have a continuous vapor barrier on the warm side of the insulation layer
conditions: Curtain wall is installed in a conditioned building envelope
Insulation layer is present

subject: Insulated Thermal Curtain Wall
rule: Insulated thermal curtain wall must have a properly drained and ventilated cavity between the insulation and the outer cladding
conditions: Curtain wall includes an outer cladding layer over the insulation

subject: Insulated Thermal Curtain Wall
rule: Insulated thermal curtain wall must not have thermal bridges that bypass the insulation layer at connections and penetrations

subject: Insulated Thermal Curtain Wall
rule: Insulated thermal curtain wall must have airtight seals at all joints, edges, and penetrations

subject: Street Grid Layout
rule: street grid layout must maintain orthogonal intersection angles at all junctions
conditions: grid is rectilinear
exceptions: roundabout or traffic circle termini
cul-de-sac ends

subject: Street Grid Layout

subject: Street Grid Layout

subject: Street Grid Layout
rule: street grid spacing must allow block sizes that fit the minimum turning radius of standard fire apparatus

subject: Pedestrian Pathways
rule: pedestrian pathway cross-slope (camber) must not exceed 1:50 (2%)

subject: Pedestrian Pathways
rule: pedestrian pathway surface must be firm, stable and slip-resistant under wet conditions

subject: Pedestrian Pathways

subject: Pedestrian Pathways

conditions: Where adjacent to vehicular traffic lanes
Where pedestrians may access the sidewalk
exceptions: Driveway aprons where vehicles must cross the curb
Drop curbs/ramps at pedestrian crossings where the curb height must transition to 0 inches

exceptions: Permeable pavement systems specifically designed for infiltration without surface drainage

subject: Street Curbs/Edges

conditions: Where the curb is within the public right-of-way and adjacent to a sidewalk or pedestrian area
exceptions: Temporary construction zone curbs with warning barriers
Curbs in fully fenced-off areas inaccessible to the public

subject: Street Lighting

conditions: when luminaire output exceeds 1000 lumens
in roadways or pedestrian paths
exceptions: temporary emergency lighting during power outages or incidents

subject: Street Lighting

subject: Street Lighting

Signage is intended for wayfinding purposes

subject: Street Signage & Wayfinding
rule: Street signage must not create glare that impairs driver or pedestrian visibility

Signage is located near vehicular traffic areas

In public right-of-way zones

any retail occupancy open to the public

accessible to children under 6 years old

rule: schoolhouse must have fire alarm system with manual pull stations and automatic detection

subject: Schoolhouse

subject: Church

conditions: building has a roof

subject: Church

exceptions: building is never occupied

subject: Church
rule: church sanctuary floor load capacity must support assembly-level live loads

subject: Church

subject: Cemetery

ground burial is practiced

subject: Cemetery
rule: headstones and monuments must not obstruct emergency vehicle access paths

subject: Cemetery
rule: grave shafts must not intersect existing underground utilities

in-ground burial is practiced

well provides water for public consumption

subject: Septic tank

subject: Timber verandah

subject: Corrugated metal roof

exposed to weather

subject: Corrugated metal roof

subject: Freight loading dock
rule: Freight loading dock must have a minimum load capacity rated for the intended maximum vehicle and cargo weight
conditions: when supporting powered industrial trucks (forklifts, pallet jacks) on the dock surface
exceptions: light-duty manual loading docks designed only for hand-carry operations

subject: Freight loading dock
rule: Freight loading dock must have edge protection (dock bumpers) at the vehicle approach edge
conditions: when vehicular traffic backs into the dock
exceptions: docks where vehicles always approach parallel and never contact the dock edge

subject: Freight loading dock
rule: Freight loading dock must have fall protection at any unguarded edge where the drop exceeds 4 feet
conditions: when the dock is elevated above grade by 4 feet or more
when personnel access the dock edge for loading/unloading operations
exceptions: docks where an enclosed loading pit or flush configuration eliminates the exposed edge

subject: Freight loading dock
rule: Freight loading dock must not have standing water on its surface
conditions: during normal operation
exceptions: during active rainfall where drainage is temporarily overwhelmed but drains within 15 minutes after rain stops

subject: Barn
rule: roof must have a drainage path
conditions: Barn has a roof

subject: Barn
rule: foundation must support vertical load of barn structure and contents
conditions: Barn is a permanent structure
exceptions: Barn is designed as a temporary or movable structure on skids

subject: Barn
rule: must_not have fully enclosed impermeable walls that prevent cross-ventilation
conditions: Barn houses livestock or hay storage
exceptions: Barn is used exclusively for equipment storage and does not house animals or hay

subject: Barn
rule: ground floor must be above exterior grade to prevent water ingress
conditions: Barn is on a site with precipitation
exceptions: Barn has an engineered drainage system that actively manages water away from the floor level

subject: Rural Structural Frame
rule: frame must be self-supporting and stable without reliance on non-structural cladding or infill
conditions: when used as primary load-bearing structure
exceptions: temporary or non-load-bearing decorative frames

subject: Rural Structural Frame
rule: connections between frame members must be able to resist the forces transferred at each joint

subject: Rural Structural Frame
rule: frame must not have tension-only bracing without corresponding compression elements to maintain stability under load reversal
conditions: when lateral loads such as wind or seismic forces are present
exceptions: structures with proven capacity for load reversal through alternate load paths

subject: Thatched Roof
rule: thatched roof must have a minimum pitch (slope) of at least 40 degrees to shed water effectively
conditions: roof is located in a region with precipitation
exceptions: roof is a purely decorative interior element not exposed to weather

subject: Thatched Roof
rule: thatched roof must not have gutters or other water-collecting fixtures attached that dam water flow at the eaves
conditions: roof uses organic thatch material

subject: Thatched Roof
rule: thatched roof must have a fire-resistant barrier or treatment applied to the underside or between thatch layers
conditions: roof is part of an occupied building
exceptions: building is located in a jurisdiction where fire codes explicitly exempt thatch

subject: Thatched Roof
rule: thatched roof must not have ridge details that create upward-facing crevices or flat horizontal surfaces

subject: Clay or Slate Roof Tiles
rule: Clay or slate roof tiles must be laid with a minimum headlap (overlap) to prevent water ingress
conditions: Roof pitch is less than the tile manufacturer's recommended minimum for the specific tile profile
exceptions: Roofs with a fully sealed underlayment system that provides the primary weatherproofing layer

subject: Clay or Slate Roof Tiles
rule: Clay or slate roof tiles must not be fixed to battens that are spaced wider than the tile gauge allows

subject: Clay or Slate Roof Tiles
rule: Clay or slate roof tiles must not be installed on a roof pitch below the minimum pitch specified by the manufacturer for that tile type
exceptions: Roofs where a continuous fully bonded waterproof membrane is installed as the primary weatherproof layer and tiles are purely aesthetic

subject: Clay or Slate Roof Tiles
rule: Clay roof tiles must not be installed in climates where the number of freeze-thaw cycles exceeds the tile's frost-resistance rating
conditions: The tiles are not classified as frost-resistant (e.g., are 'semi-vitrified' or 'terracotta' grade)

subject: Stone or Brick Masonry Wall
rule: Stone or brick masonry wall must have proper foundation or footing to support its weight
conditions: wall is load-bearing
wall height exceeds 1 meter
exceptions: free-standing garden walls under 1m height on stable ground

subject: Stone or Brick Masonry Wall
rule: Stone or brick masonry wall must not be constructed without proper bonding between wythes/leaves
conditions: wall is more than one wythe thick
wall is load-bearing

subject: Stone or Brick Masonry Wall
rule: Stone or brick masonry wall must have lateral bracing or stiffening elements at maximum intervals determined by slenderness ratio
conditions: wall is load-bearing
wall height-to-thickness ratio exceeds 12:1
exceptions: reinforced masonry walls with engineered design

subject: Stone or Brick Masonry Wall
rule: Stone or brick masonry wall must not be built with frozen or excessively wet mortar
conditions: ambient temperature is below 4°C (40°F)
construction is in progress
exceptions: enclosed heated construction environment maintaining above-freezing conditions

subject: Lime Plaster / Render
rule: Lime plaster/render must not be applied in freezing temperatures (below 0°C / 32°F)
conditions: applied externally
applied during cold weather
exceptions: enclosed heated environment maintained above freezing during cure

subject: Lime Plaster / Render
rule: Lime plaster/render must be allowed to cure with adequate access to carbon dioxide (CO₂)
conditions: applied as a natural hydraulic or non-hydraulic lime render

subject: Lime Plaster / Render
rule: Lime plaster/render must not be applied over an impermeable barrier that traps moisture behind it
conditions: applied to solid masonry walls of historic or pre-1919 buildings
exceptions: where a compatible vapour-permeable system is explicitly designed and detailed by a specialist

subject: Timber Cladding
rule: Timber cladding must have a ventilation gap behind it (typically ≥ 10mm) when installed over a weathertight membrane or solid substrate
conditions: Installed over a weathertight membrane
Installed on a solid substrate such as plywood sheathing or OSB
exceptions: Direct-fixed to openable/breathable construction such as a drained and vented rainscreen system where the cavity is designed as primary drainage plane
Historically applied directly to masonry where moisture storage and drying occurs within the wall assembly (not modern practice)

subject: Timber Cladding
rule: Timber cladding must have preservative treatment or be of naturally durable species (heartwood) when used in ground contact or exposed locations with high moisture risk
conditions: Cladding in ground contact
Cladding less than 300 mm above ground level
Cladding in locations with high rainfall or splash zone exposure
exceptions: Non-durable species used with a fully ventilated rainscreen cavity and capillary break that entirely prevents moisture accumulation

subject: Timber Cladding
rule: Timber cladding must not be fixed in direct contact with concrete, masonry, or steel without an isolating membrane or drainage plane
conditions: Cladding abuts concrete foundations or masonry walls
Cladding is fixed through steel brackets/girts without separation
exceptions: Use of pressure-treated timber rated for contact with these materials with documented compatibility

subject: Rural Drainage System
rule: drainage conveyance channels must maintain continuous positive slope (no reverse grade or sag points)
conditions: system includes open channels or ditches
exceptions: where a pump station is installed to overcome hydraulic low points

subject: Rural Drainage System
rule: pipe and culvert diameters must be sized to convey the design storm peak flow without surcharging above the pipe crown
conditions: system includes closed conduits (pipes, culverts)
exceptions: where controlled surcharge is explicitly designed into a detention/storage system

subject: Rural Drainage System
rule: outlet discharge must not cause erosion, scour, or instability at the receiving watercourse or drainageway
conditions: system discharges to a natural watercourse or unlined channel
exceptions: where outlet energy dissipation structures (riprap, stilling basin) are provided

subject: Rural Drainage System
rule: drainage system must have a freeboard of at least 0.3 m (or local regulatory minimum) from design water surface to top of bank or road surface
conditions: system includes open channels adjacent to roads or structures
exceptions: where contained within a closed conduit system

subject: Rural Water Supply System
rule: pump must be primed before operation
conditions: if the pump is a centrifugal pump located above the water source
exceptions: self-priming pumps
submersible pumps
pumps with automatic priming mechanisms

subject: Rural Water Supply System
rule: pipelines must not have continuous entrapped air pockets at high points without air release valves
conditions: if the pipeline transports water by gravity or pumped flow
exceptions: very short segments where air can be flushed manually
systems with intermittent operation where air is released at outlets

subject: Rural Water Supply System
rule: storage tank overflow must be at least 50 mm below the inlet pipe invert
conditions: if a storage tank with a float-controlled or automatic shutoff valve is used
exceptions: tanks with no inlet control valve (overflow sizing becomes a design choice)

subject: Rural Water Supply System
rule: water source intake must be positioned below the lowest recorded seasonal water level
conditions: if surface water (river, lake, reservoir) is the source
exceptions: sources with guaranteed perennial flow above intake elevation

subject: Countryside Insulation
rule: Countryside Insulation must not be used as a load-bearing structural element
conditions: When installed as part of a building envelope

subject: Countryside Insulation
rule: Countryside Insulation must maintain a minimum air gap of 25 mm when installed against a breathable membrane on a cold roof
conditions: When installed in a ventilated cold roof construction
When adjacent to a breathable membrane
exceptions: When manufacturer's technical datasheet specifies a different clearance distance

subject: Wood-Burning Stove / Fireplace
rule: Wood-burning stove/fireplace flue or chimney must extend at least 2 feet higher than any portion of the roof within 10 feet
conditions: stove or fireplace is installed in a building with a roof
the chimney terminates through the roof

subject: Wood-Burning Stove / Fireplace
rule: Wood-burning stove/fireplace must have a non-combustible hearth or floor protection extending in front of and to the sides of the appliance opening
conditions: stove or fireplace is installed on a combustible floor
exceptions: appliance is listed and labeled for zero-clearance installation directly on a combustible floor without additional protection

subject: Wood-Burning Stove / Fireplace
rule: Wood-burning stove/fireplace must not be installed in a building without an adequate combustion air supply to the room
conditions: the building envelope is tight or airtight (e.g., modern energy-efficient construction)
exceptions: a dedicated outside combustion air duct is provided

subject: Wood-Burning Stove / Fireplace
rule: Wood-burning stove/fireplace chimney must be lined with a material rated for continuous use at flue gas temperatures
conditions: chimney is masonry (not a factory-built metal chimney system)

subject: Rural Floor Construction
rule: ground-contact floor construction in rural areas must have a damp-proof membrane (DPM) to prevent rising damp
conditions: floor is in direct contact with the ground
rural location with no sealed ground cover
exceptions: floor is suspended with ventilated void of at least 150 mm

subject: Rural Floor Construction
rule: rural floor construction must not use untreated timber in direct ground contact
conditions: timber is used as part of the floor structure
timber element touches the ground
exceptions: timber is pressure-treated to a suitable use class (e.g., Use Class 4 or 5)

subject: Rural Floor Construction
rule: floor structure in rural areas must be designed to resist moisture vapor migration from the ground
conditions: floor is at or below ground level
exceptions: floor is fully suspended with a clear ventilated void and adequate sub-floor ventilation

subject: Porch / Mudroom
rule: porch / mudroom floor must be sloped away from the building or have a positive drainage system
conditions: porch/mudroom is covered and exposed to rain
floor is at grade or on a slab
exceptions: enclosed unconditioned space with sealed floor

subject: Porch / Mudroom
rule: porch / mudroom roof or cover must have a minimum slope for drainage
conditions: porch/mudroom has a solid roof

subject: Porch / Mudroom
rule: porch / mudroom must not obstruct required egress path from dwelling
conditions: porch/mudroom is attached to a primary exit door
exceptions: if porch/mudroom provides an alternative compliant egress path

subject: Porch / Mudroom
rule: porch / mudroom floor assembly must be pressure-treated or decay-resistant material when in contact with ground or concrete slab
conditions: wood-framed floor
floor is at grade or within 6 inches of grade
located in a climate with termite risk
exceptions: floor is fully enclosed and conditioned space
floor uses steel or concrete construction

subject: Hayloft
rule: hayloft floor must be structurally adequate to support stored hay loads and prevent collapse
conditions: hayloft is used for hay storage

subject: Hayloft
rule: hayloft must have adequate ventilation to prevent moisture buildup and spontaneous combustion of hay
conditions: hayloft contains stored hay

subject: Hayloft
rule: hayloft must not have unprotected openings that allow direct ignition source contact with stored hay
conditions: hayloft contains stored hay

subject: Farm Track / Hardstanding
rule: Farm track / hardstanding must be free-draining or have a designed drainage path to prevent surface water accumulation
conditions: when located in an area with any rainfall exposure or groundwater interaction
exceptions: when the track/hardstanding is intentionally designed as a water retention feature (e.g., attenuation basin)

subject: Farm Track / Hardstanding
rule: Farm track / hardstanding must not be constructed with a binder (e.g., asphalt, concrete) if a pervious surface is required for agricultural use or runoff management
conditions: when the surface is intended for vehicular use in an agricultural setting where groundwater recharge or runoff control is critical
exceptions: when local regulations or specific operational needs require an impervious surface with drainage controls

subject: Stable / Livestock Stall
rule: stable or livestock stall floor must be sloped for liquid drainage
conditions: floor is impermeable
floor is used for housing livestock
exceptions: stall uses deep bedding management system with absorbent materials that negate need for floor drainage

subject: Stable / Livestock Stall
rule: stable or livestock stall walls and flooring must be cleanable and non-absorbent in areas exposed to animal waste
conditions: walls or floors are in contact zones for urine/feces
exceptions: temporary or portable stalls used only for short-duration confinement

subject: Stable / Livestock Stall
rule: stable or livestock stall must not have gaps or openings large enough for an animal's leg to pass through
conditions: stall is used for hoofed livestock such as horses, cattle, sheep, or goats

subject: Stable / Livestock Stall
rule: stable or livestock stall must provide a minimum clear height above the animal's head for standing
conditions: space is enclosed with a roof or ceiling

subject: Stable / Livestock Stall
rule: stable or livestock stall must have adequate ventilation for the number and type of animals housed
conditions: stall is fully or partially enclosed

subject: Stable / Livestock Stall
rule: stable or livestock stall must not contain toxic or injurious protrusions at animal height

subject: Root Cellar
rule: roof or cover must be sloped or crowned to provide a positive drainage path for rainwater and snowmelt
conditions: roof or cover is earth-covered or buried
root cellar is located in a climate with precipitation
exceptions: root cellar is entirely below the frost line with a permeable drainage layer above that prevents water pooling

subject: Root Cellar
rule: root cellar must have ventilation openings that allow passive air exchange to the exterior
conditions: root cellar is used for food storage
cellar is enclosed (has a door or hatch)
exceptions: cellar is a temporary emergency shelter with no stored produce

subject: Root Cellar
rule: root cellar must not be located where the seasonal high water table rises above the cellar floor level
conditions: cellar is excavated below grade
exceptions: cellar has an active sump pump system and waterproof membrane rated for continuous hydrostatic pressure

subject: Rural Fencing and Hedging
rule: fence posts must be embedded in the ground to a depth sufficient for stability
conditions: when used as standalone fence posts (not hedge supports)
exceptions: when posts are mounted on concrete footings or ground screws as an alternative foundation system

subject: Rural Fencing and Hedging
rule: hedging plants must be living vegetation capable of sustained growth in the local climate
conditions: when the entity functions as a hedge (living fence)

subject: Rural Fencing and Hedging
rule: fencing must not obstruct public rights of way or designated access routes
conditions: when installed along public footpaths, bridleways, or common land boundaries
exceptions: when specific legal easement or access agreement permits such obstruction

subject: Rural Fencing and Hedging
rule: barbed wire or electrified fencing must not be placed where it poses imminent harm to unaware pedestrians or livestock
conditions: when the fence is adjacent to public paths, road verges, or shared grazing
exceptions: where clear warning signs are installed and local regulations permit

subject: Workshop / Tractor Shed
rule: workshop / tractor shed roof must have continuous drainage path to ground
conditions: roof is present
roof surface is not fully permeable
exceptions: roof is designed as a green/living roof with integrated drainage layer

subject: Workshop / Tractor Shed
rule: workshop / tractor shed floor must be load-rated for stored equipment weight
conditions: tractors or heavy machinery are stored or driven inside
exceptions: space is used exclusively as a woodworking hand-tool workshop with no wheeled equipment

subject: Workshop / Tractor Shed
rule: workshop / tractor shed must not have enclosed fuel storage without ventilation
conditions: the shed contains fuel-powered equipment (tractors, generators) or fuel containers
exceptions: fuel is stored in approved sealed safety cans and the shed has natural cross-ventilation openings at both low and high levels

subject: Adaptable Partition Walls
rule: Adaptable partition walls must not be load-bearing
conditions: intended to be movable, demountable, or reconfigurable

subject: Adaptable Partition Walls
rule: Adaptable partition walls must be securely anchored at head and base to prevent toppling
conditions: wall height exceeds 2.4 meters
or wall is in a seismic zone
exceptions: free-standing temporary screens shorter than 1.2 m with broad base

subject: Adaptable Partition Walls
rule: Adaptable partition wall finishes must not create rigid bonds that prevent disassembly
conditions: wall is designed for reusability or reconfiguration

subject: Adaptable Partition Walls
rule: Adaptable partition walls must accommodate differential building movement without structural failure
conditions: building has more than two stories
or building is in a region with expansive soils

subject: Multi-Faith / Multi-Purpose Ritual Space
rule: floor surface must be cleanable and resistant to staining from spilled liquids (water, oils, incense, drinks)

subject: Multi-Faith / Multi-Purpose Ritual Space
rule: lighting system must provide controllable dimming or zoning to accommodate varied ritual luminance requirements

subject: Multi-Faith / Multi-Purpose Ritual Space
rule: floor surface must not be made of materials that are ritually unclean or prohibited by major faith groups (e.g., pig-derived leather, cow-derived products where applicable)

subject: Multi-Faith / Multi-Purpose Ritual Space
rule: movable furniture must have soft or rounded edges and be tip-resistant

subject: Multi-Faith / Multi-Purpose Ritual Space
rule: the space must have a dedicated, ventilated storage area for ritual items and cleaning supplies

subject: Integrated Performance Platform
rule: Integrated Performance Platform must have a physical mounting or anchoring system that secures it to the building structure
conditions: when used as a roof-mounted component
when the platform is subjected to wind loads
exceptions: if the platform is freestanding and not attached to the building

subject: Integrated Performance Platform
rule: Integrated Performance Platform must not obstruct required egress paths or emergency access routes
conditions: when installed on or adjacent to occupied building areas
when located near exit pathways
exceptions: if the platform is installed in a non-accessible zone with alternative egress provided

subject: Integrated Performance Platform
rule: Integrated Performance Platform must not exceed the load-bearing capacity of its supporting structure
conditions: when the platform is in use with full operational load
exceptions: if the supporting structure is specifically reinforced or designed for the platform load

subject: Acoustic Separation Systems
rule: acoustic separation system must achieve a minimum sound transmission class (STC) rating appropriate for the partition type and occupancy
conditions: when separating occupiable spaces from other occupiable spaces
when serving as a demising wall, floor-ceiling assembly, or corridor partition
exceptions: when the separation is purely decorative and does not separate occupiable spaces

subject: Acoustic Separation Systems
rule: acoustic separation system must not have continuous rigid structural connections (sound bridges) between separated sides
conditions: when the assembly is designed as a double-stud or staggered-stud wall
when a resilient channel or decoupling clip system is specified
exceptions: when the assembly relies on a single mass layer with no decoupling requirement

subject: Acoustic Separation Systems
rule: acoustic separation system must seal all perimeter gaps and penetrations with an acoustically rated sealant
conditions: when the assembly is required to meet a specified STC or NIC rating

subject: Subculture Artwork Mounting Systems
rule: Subculture artwork mounting system must be securely attached to a structurally adequate substrate (wall, ceiling, or dedicated support frame)
conditions: system is in use and supporting artwork
exceptions: free-standing floor-mounted display systems

subject: Subculture Artwork Mounting Systems
rule: Subculture artwork mounting system must not exceed the load capacity of its substrate or supporting structure
conditions: artwork weight is applied to the system

subject: Subculture Artwork Mounting Systems
rule: Subculture artwork mounting system must be installed on a surface that is free of active moisture or water infiltration
conditions: system is installed indoors or within a conditioned envelope
exceptions: systems explicitly designed for damp/wet locations with corrosion-resistant materials and sealed substrate

subject: Subculture Artwork Mounting Systems
rule: Subculture artwork mounting system must not rely on drywall or plaster alone as the sole attachment substrate for any load-bearing fastener
conditions: system supports artwork weight
exceptions: systems using toggle bolts or molly bolts specifically rated for the applied load in known wall assembly types

subject: Cultural Kitchen / Food Preparation Hub
rule: kitchen exhaust hoods must be vented to the exterior
conditions: space contains cooking equipment that produces grease, smoke, steam, or heat
exceptions: space is classified as a demonstration kitchen with no commercial cooking equipment
space uses recirculating hoods with appropriate filtration for light-duty cooking only and local code permits it

subject: Cultural Kitchen / Food Preparation Hub
rule: kitchen floor surface must be slip-resistant and sealed impervious to moisture and grease
conditions: space contains food preparation or cooking areas

subject: Cultural Kitchen / Food Preparation Hub
rule: handwashing sink must be provided within the food preparation area
conditions: space is used for commercial food preparation or cooking

subject: Cultural Kitchen / Food Preparation Hub
rule: materials in contact with food must be non-toxic, smooth, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable
conditions: surfaces are used for food contact (counters, cutting boards, utensils)
exceptions: single-use disposable items meeting safety standards

subject: Cultural Kitchen / Food Preparation Hub
rule: grease-producing cooking equipment must be separated from fire sources or be protected by an automatic fire suppression system
conditions: space contains deep-fat fryers, griddles, or other grease-producing cooking appliances

subject: Dedicated Storage Cubbies
rule: dedicated storage cubbies must be accessible without moving other stored items
conditions: cubbies are used for active storage
cubbies are enclosed on at least three sides
exceptions: cubbies designated as long-term archival storage where sequential unloading is acceptable

subject: Dedicated Storage Cubbies
rule: dedicated storage cubbies must have a solid load-bearing bottom surface rated for the intended stored load
conditions: cubbies are installed above floor level
cubbies are intended to hold physical items

subject: Dedicated Storage Cubbies
rule: dedicated storage cubbies must not block required egress paths or fire-rated corridors
conditions: cubbies are located in or adjacent to circulation paths
building occupancy classification requires clear egress
exceptions: cubbies that are fully recessed into walls and do not project into the required clear width

subject: Focus Booth
rule: focus booth must have at least one operable door for occupant egress
conditions: occupied by people

subject: Focus Booth
rule: focus booth interior must be free of sharp protrusions at head height
conditions: occupied by standing or seated people

subject: Focus Booth
rule: focus booth must not have a fully sealed air-tight enclosure without ventilation
conditions: enclosed on all sides with a door/hatch
occupied by people
exceptions: has active mechanical ventilation system providing fresh air

subject: Focus Booth
rule: focus booth floor surface must be slip-resistant
conditions: standing occupants
floor surface exists

subject: Library / Quiet Zone
rule: Library quiet zone must maintain ambient noise level at or below 40 dB(A)
conditions: When designated as a quiet zone
During operating hours
exceptions: During approved programming events that may have higher noise levels

subject: Library / Quiet Zone
rule: Library quiet zone must not have sound-amplifying equipment or live audio systems
conditions: When designated as a quiet zone
exceptions: Assistive listening devices for hearing-impaired patrons

subject: Acoustic Phone Booth
rule: enclosure must be acoustically sealed to prevent sound leakage
conditions: phone booth is used for private conversations
booth is located in a noisy environment
exceptions: booth is explicitly designed as an open-plan acoustic partition only

subject: Acoustic Phone Booth
