exceptions: the ceiling is sprinklered and local code permits reduced rating

subject: Shopping Street Floor
rule: shopping street floor must be level with adjacent sidewalks or store entrances
conditions: when the street floor provides pedestrian access to stores
exceptions: when a ramp or step is explicitly designed for accessibility per code

subject: Shopping Street Floor
rule: shopping street floor must have a minimum clear height that accommodates retail occupancy
conditions: when the space is intended for commercial/retail use

subject: Shopping Street Floor
rule: shopping street floor must not have structural columns that block the required minimum clear width of the public pedestrian path
conditions: when a continuous accessible path of travel is required through the street-level area
exceptions: columns that are within demising walls or that leave at least the code-required clear width unobstructed

subject: Storefront Glazing
rule: Storefront glazing must be constructed of tempered or laminated safety glass
conditions: Glass is within 18 inches of a walking surface or door
Glass pane area exceeds 9 square feet
exceptions: Glass protected by a guard or handrail that prevents impact

subject: Storefront Glazing
rule: Storefront glazing horizontal mullions must not obstruct required egress sightlines
conditions: Storefront is adjacent to an exit or egress path
Mullion is placed between 36 and 72 inches above finished floor
exceptions: Building is sprinklered and approved by authority having jurisdiction

subject: Storefront Glazing
rule: Storefront glazing system must accommodate thermal expansion and contraction of glass and framing
conditions: Glazing run exceeds 12 feet in length
Exterior exposure to temperature differential greater than 50°F
exceptions: System is explicitly tested and rated for zero-expansion assembly

subject: Storefront Glazing
rule: Storefront glazing must be sloped or weeped to prevent water accumulation at the sill
conditions: Sill is horizontal or near-horizontal
exceptions: Interior storefront with no exterior moisture exposure

subject: Storefront Glazing
rule: Storefront glazing must have a minimum design load capacity per ASCE 7 wind load requirements for the building's exposure category
conditions: Storefront is part of the building envelope

subject: Shopping Street HVAC
rule: HVAC outdoor units must maintain minimum clearance distances from building walls, other units, and obstructions to ensure adequate airflow for heat rejection
conditions: Shopping street HVAC systems typically use packaged or split-system units located at street level or on rooftops
exceptions: Manufacturer specifications may allow reduced clearances with alternative airflow arrangements

subject: Shopping Street HVAC
rule: HVAC condensate drainage must have a positive slope and unobstructed path to an approved disposal point
conditions: Air conditioning mode produces condensate water
exceptions: Dry climates where condensate volume is negligible may allow evaporative dissipation if code permits

subject: Shopping Street HVAC
rule: HVAC systems must not recirculate exhaust air back into the occupied shopping street space
conditions: System includes mechanical ventilation with return air ductwork
exceptions: Heat recovery ventilators with dedicated energy recovery components designed for safe transfer

subject: Shopping Street HVAC
rule: HVAC supply air temperature must not cause condensation on supply duct exterior surfaces within unconditioned spaces
conditions: Supply ducts pass through unconditioned or semi-conditioned spaces
Ducts are not vapor-sealed or insulated
exceptions: All duct surfaces in the path are either vapor-sealed, located in conditioned space, or have an approved condensation management strategy

subject: Shopping Street Fire Safety System
rule: fire detection and alarm system must cover all public areas of the shopping street
conditions: shopping street is enclosed or roofed
public access is permitted

subject: Shopping Street Fire Safety System
rule: fire suppression system (sprinklers) must serve all tenant retail units and common corridors
conditions: building exceeds fire-code floor-area threshold
combustible contents are present in tenant spaces
exceptions: code-approved alternative suppression (e.g., clean-agent system) in electrical/IT rooms where water is prohibited

subject: Shopping Street Fire Safety System
rule: smoke control system must maintain tenable conditions in means of egress for the calculated evacuation time
conditions: shopping street has a occupied floor more than 12 m above or below grade
building is sprinklered
exceptions: alternative performance-based smoke management design approved by authority having jurisdiction

subject: Shopping Street Fire Safety System
rule: fire alarm notification appliances must produce signals audible and visible in all occupiable spaces
exceptions: private offices that are not part of the means of egress path where occupants are individually notified

subject: Shopping Street Fire Safety System
rule: fire hydrant and standpipe system must not be obstructed by permanent fixtures, kiosks, or landscaping
conditions: hydrant or standpipe connection is installed on the street level or within the shopping street

subject: Shopping Street Fire Safety System
rule: fire-resistance-rated enclosures (shafts, stairwells) must not be breached by fire safety system penetrations without approved fire-stopping
conditions: penetrations pass through a fire-resistance-rated barrier
exceptions: fire-stop system listed for the specific penetration type is installed per listing

subject: Public Art or Feature Display
rule: Public art or feature display must be securely anchored or structurally attached to its supporting surface or foundation
conditions: Display is attached to a building surface, structure, or freestanding foundation
exceptions: Temporary displays that are monitored by security personnel during the entire installation period
Displays that are inherently stable by self-weight and located in areas with no wind exposure or human contact risk

subject: Public Art or Feature Display
rule: Public art or feature display must not project into or obstruct egress paths, exit doors, fire lanes, or accessible routes
conditions: Display is located within or adjacent to any circulation path, egress route, or ADA-required accessible pathway
exceptions: Displays that maintain clear width and height clearances per applicable building and fire codes (typically 36-inch clear width and 80-inch clear height)

subject: Public Art or Feature Display
rule: Public art or feature display must not conceal or obstruct fire suppression equipment, fire alarm devices, emergency lighting, or exit signage
conditions: The display is located in the same space or on the same wall as emergency equipment or signage

subject: Public Art or Feature Display
rule: Public art or feature display that incorporates electrical components must comply with applicable electrical code for wet or damp locations if exposed to weather or condensation
conditions: Display includes lighting, moving parts, electronics, or any electrical connection
Display is located outdoors or in an unconditioned space where moisture exposure is possible
exceptions: Battery-operated devices with no line-voltage connections that are fully sealed and listed for the environment

subject: Public Art or Feature Display
rule: Public art or feature display must not exceed the structural load capacity of the supporting surface, wall, or structure
conditions: Display is mounted to, hung from, or supported by a building structure (wall, ceiling, roof, or frame)

subject: Shopping Street Signage and Wayfinding
rule: Signage must not obstruct emergency egress paths
conditions: signage is floor-mounted or projecting into circulation space

subject: Shopping Street Signage and Wayfinding
rule: Signage must not conceal or block fire safety equipment (fire extinguishers, alarms, sprinklers, hose reels)

subject: Shopping Street Signage and Wayfinding
rule: Projecting signage must have a minimum headroom clearance of 2.1 m (or local code minimum) above finished floor
conditions: signage projects into pedestrian walkway or circulation zone

subject: Shopping Street Signage and Wayfinding
rule: Signage structural fixings must be rated to support the sign's dead load plus applicable wind loads
conditions: signage is suspended, projecting, or freestanding

subject: Shopping Street Signage and Wayfinding
rule: Illuminated signage must comply with maximum luminance limits to avoid disabling glare for pedestrians and drivers
conditions: signage is illuminated (internally lit, backlit, or externally lit at night)

subject: Shopping Street Signage and Wayfinding
rule: Signage electrical components must be weatherproofed to IP rating appropriate for exposure (minimum IP65 in uncovered outdoor locations)
conditions: signage includes electrical/lighting components and is located outdoors or in semi-enclosed areas

subject: Shopping Street Floor Drainage
rule: floor drainage must have a minimum slope of 1-2% toward drainage inlets
conditions: shopping street floor is a hard paved surface

subject: Shopping Street Floor Drainage
rule: drainage inlets must be positioned at low points of the floor surface
conditions: shopping street floor is a hard paved surface

subject: Shopping Street Floor Drainage
rule: floor drainage system must not allow backflow of sewage or stormwater into the shopping street
conditions: drainage connects to combined or sanitary sewer

subject: Shopping Street Floor Drainage
rule: drainage channel/grate covers must be load-rated for pedestrian and light vehicular traffic expected on a shopping street
conditions: drainage channels are exposed on the walking/paving surface

subject: Shopping Street Kiosk or Cart Station
rule: kiosk or cart station must have a stable, level base or footing on the ground surface to prevent tipping
conditions: freestanding unit on ground
exceptions: unit designed to be mobile and secured by weight or tie-downs

subject: Shopping Street Kiosk or Cart Station
rule: kiosk or cart station must have a minimum clear opening for service access that allows an operator to enter and exit safely
conditions: occupied by a vendor

subject: Shopping Street Kiosk or Cart Station
rule: kiosk or cart station must not have unguarded electrical connections exposed to rain or public contact
conditions: contains electrical equipment or lighting

subject: Retail Unit Entry Door
rule: Retail unit entry door must open in the direction of egress travel
conditions: Door serves a retail occupancy with an occupant load of 50 or more
exceptions: Door is a screen door or security grille that is not the primary means of egress
Door serves a dwelling unit

subject: Retail Unit Entry Door
rule: Retail unit entry door must have a clear opening width of at least 32 inches
conditions: Door serves as a means of egress
exceptions: Existing buildings under specific grandfathering provisions

subject: Retail Unit Entry Door
rule: Retail unit entry door must not have a threshold that exceeds 1/2 inch in height
conditions: Door serves as an accessible means of egress or accessible entrance
exceptions: Thresholds up to 3/4 inch are permitted if beveled at 1:2 slope

subject: Nightclub
rule: nightclub must have at least two means of egress (exits) that comply with building code occupancy limits
conditions: occupant load exceeds 50 persons
any occupancy
exceptions: single-story buildings with occupant load under 50 and door opens directly to exterior grade

subject: Nightclub
rule: nightclub must have fire-rated wall and ceiling assemblies separating it from adjacent spaces when occupant load exceeds code threshold
conditions: building has multiple tenants or mixed uses
occupant load exceeds code threshold for the fire-resistance rating
exceptions: standalone single-occupancy building fully sprinklered with code-approved alternative

subject: Nightclub
rule: nightclub must not have exit doors that are locked, chained, barred, or blocked during hours of operation
conditions: any time the nightclub is open to patrons

subject: Nightclub
rule: nightclub must have an automatic fire sprinkler system designed for the hazard classification
conditions: occupant load exceeds IBC threshold for Group A occupancy
building area exceeds sprinkler exemption thresholds
exceptions: very small nightclubs under code area/occupancy thresholds where local code permits

subject: Bar/Lounge
rule: Bar/Lounge must have at least one means of egress to a public way or exit discharge
conditions: Occupied by more than one person
Enclosed space
exceptions: Space with direct ground-level exit door to exterior

subject: Bar/Lounge
rule: Bar/Lounge must have a minimum ceiling height of at least 7 feet 6 inches (2.29 m) in occupied areas
conditions: Space is enclosed with a ceiling
exceptions: Existing buildings under certain historical preservation allowances where code grandfathering applies

subject: Bar/Lounge
rule: Bar/Lounge must not have floor surfaces that become dangerously slippery when wet at the bar service area
conditions: Area immediately adjacent to bar counter where drinks are served
Floor finish is hard and smooth (e.g., tile, stone, polished concrete)
exceptions: Flooring certified with a coefficient of friction >= 0.6 when wet per ANSI A137.1/A326.3

subject: Cinema/Theater
rule: Cinema/theater auditorium must have a means of egress (exits) that meets minimum width and number requirements based on occupant load
conditions: Space designated as auditorium
Occupant load exceeds threshold

subject: Cinema/Theater
rule: Cinema/theater floor slope (rake) must provide unobstructed sightlines from every seat to the screen or performance area
conditions: Space contains fixed seating in rows

subject: Cinema/Theater
rule: Cinema/theater projection room or projection equipment location must be positioned such that the projection beam path is unobstructed between projector and screen
conditions: Space includes a film/digital projection system

subject: Cinema/Theater
rule: Cinema/theater must not have uncontrolled ambient light falling on the projection screen during operation
conditions: Space is used for放映 (projection-based viewing)
exceptions: Design includes high-gain screen technology specifically rated for lit-room use

subject: Cinema/Theater
rule: Cinema/theater must have adequate ventilation and air conditioning to prevent CO₂ buildup and overheating at full occupancy
conditions: Space is enclosed and mechanically ventilated

subject: Live Music Venue
rule: live music venue must have adequate emergency egress capacity for maximum occupancy
conditions: venue capacity exceeds 100 persons

subject: Live Music Venue
rule: live music venue must have sound attenuation between performance space and adjoining occupied spaces
conditions: venue shares walls/floors/ceilings with other occupancies
exceptions: standalone detached building with no adjacent occupied spaces

subject: Live Music Venue
rule: live music venue must not have floor structure that produces resonant vibration under rhythmic audience movement
conditions: venue includes standing general admission area
expected audience density exceeds 2 persons/m²

subject: Live Music Venue
rule: live music venue must have electrical system capacity sufficient for professional audio-visual and stage lighting loads
conditions: venue hosts amplified performances
exceptions: venue exclusively hosts acoustic-only performances with no amplification

subject: Live Music Venue
rule: live music venue must have ventilation system capable of removing heat load from audience occupancy and stage lighting
conditions: venue occupancy exceeds 50 persons

subject: Karaoke Room
rule: Karaoke room must have sound isolation from adjacent spaces
conditions: room shares walls, floor, or ceiling with other occupied spaces
room is used simultaneously with adjacent spaces
exceptions: room is in a standalone structure with no adjacent occupied spaces

subject: Karaoke Room
rule: Karaoke room must not have sound-reflective parallel hard surfaces facing each other without acoustic treatment
conditions: room is used for amplified singing
room has roughly rectangular floor plan
exceptions: room is designed exclusively for headphone-based karaoke with no room audio

subject: Casino/Gaming Floor
rule: Casino/gaming floor must have a minimum ceiling height of 12 feet (3.66 m) to accommodate lighting grids, signage, and ventilation systems

subject: Casino/Gaming Floor
rule: Casino/gaming floor must have a smoke control system with minimum 20 air changes per hour
conditions: jurisdiction adopts IBC or equivalent high-hazard smoke management provisions

subject: Casino/Gaming Floor
rule: Casino/gaming floor must not have direct egress path length exceeding 75 feet (23 m) to an exit
conditions: sprinklered building

subject: Casino/Gaming Floor
rule: Casino/gaming floor must have a floor load capacity of at least 100 psf (4.8 kPa) live load

subject: Dance Floor
rule: dance floor surface must be flat, level, and free of tripping hazards
conditions: intended for social dancing, performance, or rehearsal
exceptions: temporary ramps or step units designed as part of a stage set

subject: Dance Floor
rule: dance floor must have a slip-resistant finish appropriate for intended footwear (e.g., leather-soled shoes, bare feet, or dance sneakers)
conditions: floor is used for active dancing rather than as a static display surface
exceptions: floors specifically designed for wet/water activities (e.g., splash dance)

subject: Dance Floor
rule: dance floor must not have abrupt changes in level within the active dancing area
conditions: floor is used for partnered or group dancing with spatial movement
exceptions: staged choreography that intentionally uses level changes as a design element, with appropriate safety padding and rehearsal

subject: Dance Floor
rule: dance floor must be structurally rated for dynamic live loads (dancing, jumping, etc.) and not only static occupancy loads
conditions: floor is elevated above grade or over a void/crawlspace
exceptions: slab-on-grade construction

subject: VIP Lounge
rule: VIP Lounge must be adjacent to or directly accessible from the main circulation core or primary event space
conditions: the building contains a VIP Lounge
the venue has main circulation cores or primary event spaces

subject: VIP Lounge
rule: VIP Lounge must have a dedicated egress path meeting local fire code requirements for assembly occupancy
conditions: the VIP Lounge is an enclosed room
occupant load exceeds thresholds defined by code

subject: VIP Lounge
rule: VIP Lounge must not be located below grade without at least one direct exit to the exterior at grade
conditions: the VIP Lounge is partially or fully below grade

subject: VIP Lounge
rule: VIP Lounge envelope (walls, floor, ceiling) must provide sound isolation meeting a minimum STC of 50 from adjacent loud spaces (e.g., main arena, nightclub, mechanical rooms)
conditions: adjacent spaces generate noise levels exceeding 85 dBA

subject: Pool/Billiards Room
rule: Pool/billiards room floor must be slip-resistant when wet
conditions: room contains a pool
floor is subject to water splashing
exceptions: room is a dry billiards-only space with no pool

subject: Pool/Billiards Room
rule: Pool/billiards room must have floor drainage if the pool is an in-ground or above-ground swimming pool
conditions: room contains a swimming pool (not a billiards/pool table only)
exceptions: room contains only a billiards table with no swimming pool

subject: Pool/Billiards Room
rule: Billiards table area must have adequate overhead clearance for standard cue stroke
conditions: room contains a regulation-size billiards/pool table

subject: DJ Booth
rule: DJ booth must have a clear line of sight to the dance floor or stage area
conditions: when DJ is actively performing
exceptions: when video feed or monitor system is provided as alternative

subject: DJ Booth
rule: DJ booth must have a dedicated, isolated power supply circuit

subject: DJ Booth
rule: DJ booth must not have acoustically reflective surfaces directly behind the DJ position
conditions: when booth is designed for live sound monitoring rather than headphones-only mixing
exceptions: if rear wall is treated with acoustic absorption material

subject: DJ Booth
rule: DJ booth must have a minimum clear floor area of at least 2.5 m²

subject: DJ Booth
rule: DJ booth table/desk surface must be at a height between 850 mm and 950 mm from the floor

subject: Disco Ball Hoist
rule: The disco ball hoist must be rated for the full weight of the disco ball and any dynamic loading during movement

subject: Disco Ball Hoist
rule: The hoist must have a secondary safety latch or cable to prevent the disco ball from falling if the primary lifting mechanism fails
conditions: hoist is installed above occupied area

subject: Disco Ball Hoist
rule: The hoist's attachment point to the building structure must be secured to a structural member capable of supporting the hoist and ball load

subject: Nightlife Lighting Rig
rule: Nightlife Lighting Rig must be supplied with electrical power within its rated voltage, current, and frequency range
conditions: when the rig is in operation

subject: Nightlife Lighting Rig
rule: Nightlife Lighting Rig must not be installed in locations where it will be exposed to water, rain, or condensing moisture unless specifically rated for wet location use
conditions: standard (non-wet-rated) lighting fixtures
exceptions: fixtures that carry an IP rating suitable for wet locations (e.g., IP65 or higher)

subject: Nightlife Lighting Rig
rule: Nightlife Lighting Rig must have all structural mounting points (truss clamps, hooks, brackets) rated for at least the total static and dynamic load of the attached fixtures
conditions: when any fixture is suspended overhead

subject: Nightlife Lighting Rig
rule: Nightlife Lighting Rig must not exceed the maximum ambient temperature rating of any component in its intended operating environment
conditions: when all fixtures are operating at full output

subject: Built-in Bar Counter
rule: Built-in bar counter must have a continuous solid surface (e.g., stone, solid wood, laminate) that is impervious to liquid penetration
conditions: Counter is intended for serving drinks or food

subject: Built-in Bar Counter
rule: Built-in bar counter must be supported by a structure capable of sustaining a minimum live load of at least 300 N (approx. 30 kg) per linear metre at the front edge
conditions: Counter is designed for standing patrons to lean on or place drinks
exceptions: Decorative-only bar counters not intended for any loading

subject: Built-in Bar Counter
rule: Built-in bar counter must not have sharp, unrounded edges or corners on the patron-facing side at a height between 700 mm and 1200 mm above finished floor
conditions: Counter is in a public or commercial occupancy where patrons stand or sit at the bar

subject: Smoke/Fog Machine System
rule: smoke/fog machine system must have a dedicated electrical circuit with GFCI protection
conditions: system is electrically powered
system is installed in a fixed location
exceptions: battery-powered portable units that are not hardwired

subject: Smoke/Fog Machine System
rule: smoke/fog machine system must not be installed within 3 feet (1 meter) of any heat detector or smoke detector
conditions: system is installed indoors
fire alarm system is present
exceptions: facility has aspirating smoke detection (very early warning) that is designed to differentiate fog from smoke

subject: Smoke/Fog Machine System
rule: smoke/fog machine system must have a thermal cutoff or over-temperature protection that automatically shuts off heating
conditions: unit uses a heated element to generate fog

subject: Smoke/Fog Machine System
rule: smoke/fog machine system must use fluid that is non-toxic and non-flammable per manufacturer specifications
conditions: system is used in occupied spaces
exceptions: use in unoccupied test chambers with appropriate ventilation and PPE

subject: Bottle Display Racking
rule: bottle display racking must have a stable base with a width-to-height ratio sufficient to prevent tipping when loaded
conditions: freestanding racking not secured to wall or floor

subject: Bottle Display Racking
rule: shelves must be level to prevent bottles from rolling or sliding off
conditions: shelves are flat (not designed with bottle-neck holders or individual cup recesses)
exceptions: shelves designed with individual bottle holders/cups that secure each bottle regardless of tilt

subject: Bottle Display Racking
rule: shelf lip or retaining bar must be present on open-front shelves
conditions: shelves are open-front (no doors) and located above reach-in height or in a retail environment with customer access
exceptions: shelves specifically designed as gravity-feed with front-stops integrated into the track system

subject: Bottle Display Racking
rule: shelf material must not chemically react with bottle contents if leakage occurs
conditions: racking is used for food/ beverage bottles where leaking contents contact the shelf surface
exceptions: shelves have sealed surface or drip tray that prevents liquid contact with structural material

subject: Coat Check Room
rule: coat check room must have a dedicated means of exhaust ventilation to the outdoors or a mechanical ventilation system
conditions: room is enclosed
room is used for storing wet or soiled coats
exceptions: room is unenclosed and open to adjacent occupied space
room is used only for dry storage of clean items

subject: Coat Check Room
rule: coat check room must not have floor drains that connect to the sanitary sewer without an air gap or trap primer
conditions: floor drain is present
room is used for melting snow or wet coats
exceptions: drain connects only to stormwater system
no floor drain is installed

subject: Nightlife Restroom
rule: nightlife restroom must have a floor drain or sloped floor to a drain to permit liquid waste cleanup
conditions: the restroom is used by patrons consuming alcohol
the restroom is used for mixed-gender or high-traffic nightlife settings
exceptions: the restroom is a single-occupancy unisex room with a mop-sink cabinet and no floor drain code requirement
local code explicitly exempts nightlife venues under a certain occupancy threshold

subject: Nightlife Restroom
rule: nightlife restroom must have at least one toilet fixture per gender or per occupancy-permitted unisex count
conditions: the nightlife venue is open to the general public
the venue serves alcohol
exceptions: the venue operates under a private-event-only license with no public access

subject: Nightlife Restroom
rule: nightlife restroom must not have a direct doorway opening into the main bar or dining area without a vestibule or self-closing door
conditions: the nightlife venue is in a jurisdiction requiring odour/sound separation between restrooms and food-service areas
exceptions: the jurisdiction has no such separation requirement
the restroom is located in a corridor not directly adjacent to food prep or dining

subject: Concourse
rule: a concourse must have a minimum clear width to accommodate expected pedestrian flow and emergency egress
conditions: when designed for public occupancy

subject: Concourse
rule: concourse floor must be slip-resistant under foreseeable wet or dry conditions

subject: Concourse
rule: concourse must not have any unguarded drop-offs or level changes that exceed the threshold for a fall hazard
exceptions: when the drop-off is protected by code-compliant guardrails, handrails, or barriers

subject: Platform
rule: platform must have sufficient load-bearing capacity for its intended use
conditions: platform is elevated above grade
platform supports occupiable loads
exceptions: platform is purely decorative and not load-bearing

subject: Platform
rule: platform surface must have a slip-resistant finish where subject to pedestrian traffic
conditions: platform is accessible to pedestrians
platform is exposed to moisture or contaminants
exceptions: platform is designed for vehicular-only use

subject: Platform
rule: platform must not have unguarded edges exceeding 30 inches in height
conditions: platform is elevated more than 30 inches above adjacent surface
platform is intended for occupancy
exceptions: platform is a loading dock with active vehicle interface

subject: Interchange Enclosure
rule: Interchange Enclosure must have a gasketed or sealed joint at every panel penetration to maintain environmental seal
conditions: enclosure is exposed to outdoor environment
enclosure contains electronic equipment
exceptions: enclosure is purely mechanical with no environmental rating

subject: Interchange Enclosure
rule: Interchange Enclosure must not have openings larger than the specified ingress protection (IP) rating allows
conditions: enclosure is rated for outdoor use with an IP or NEMA rating
exceptions: openings are covered by rated breathers or drains

subject: Interchange Enclosure
rule: Interchange Enclosure must have a bonding conductor connecting all metallic parts to the grounding electrode
conditions: enclosure is constructed of metal
enclosure contains electrical or electronic equipment
exceptions: enclosure is made entirely of non-conductive materials and contains no metallic conductive paths

subject: Interchange Enclosure
rule: Interchange Enclosure must have a means of heat dissipation for internally generated heat loads
conditions: enclosure houses active electronic equipment that generates heat
exceptions: the equipment inside is passive with negligible heat dissipation

subject: Waiting Area
rule: waiting area must have an accessible egress path to a public way or exit
conditions: the waiting area is occupied by the public
the waiting area is enclosed
exceptions: waiting areas that are open to the exterior at grade level with direct exit

subject: Waiting Area
rule: waiting area must have a minimum floor-to-ceiling height of at least 2.1 m (7 ft)
conditions: the waiting area is an interior habitable space

subject: Waiting Area
rule: waiting area must not have a floor slope exceeding 1:20 unless stepped seating is provided
conditions: the waiting area is intended for standing or seated waiting without fixed stepped seating

subject: Waiting Area
rule: waiting area must have a minimum clear floor area per occupant for egress capacity
conditions: the waiting area has a calculated occupant load

subject: Waiting Area
rule: waiting area must have fire-resistance-rated separation from adjacent hazardous areas
conditions: the waiting area adjoins a room classified as a high-hazard occupancy or hazardous materials storage
exceptions: when the waiting area is not required to be separated per code by virtue of an automatic fire suppression system and fire alarm

subject: Fare Control Gates
rule: Fare control gates must provide a clear physical opening wide enough for the maximum wheelchair width specified by accessibility codes (e.g., 32 inches clear width minimum)
conditions: When installed in a station requiring ADA or equivalent accessibility compliance
exceptions: When a wider accessible gate is provided adjacent to the standard gate

subject: Fare Control Gates
rule: Fare control gates must not close or trap a passenger while the gate passage is occupied
conditions: During normal operation with passenger detection sensors active

subject: Fare Control Gates
rule: Each fare control gate must have a fail-safe mode that opens (or remains open) upon loss of power or detection of an emergency condition
conditions: When installed in any public transit station

subject: Fare Control Gates
rule: Fare control gates must accept the valid fare media type(s) designated for the transit system
conditions: When configured to control paid-area access

subject: Wayfinding System
rule: wayfinding system must provide unambiguous directional information at every decision point along a path
conditions: when a route contains a junction or fork
when the system is designed for egress or emergency evacuation
exceptions: single-segment paths with no turns require no directional signage

subject: Wayfinding System
rule: wayfinding system must maintain consistent visual language (same terminology, symbol set, color coding, and hierarchy) throughout the entire facility
conditions: when the system spans multiple zones, floors, or buildings

subject: Wayfinding System
rule: wayfinding system must_not present information that conflicts with or contradicts the actual building layout or room numbering
exceptions: temporary signage for construction or renovation that is explicitly marked as temporary and clearly distinguishable from permanent signage

subject: Interchange Flooring
rule: Interchange Flooring must be installed over a structurally sound, clean, and dry substrate
conditions: When used as a finished flooring surface
In any installation context

subject: Interchange Flooring
rule: Interchange Flooring must not be installed over an uneven substrate exceeding the manufacturer's specified tolerance
conditions: When used as a finished flooring surface

subject: Passenger Information Display System
rule: The Passenger Information Display System must be powered by an electrical source with adequate voltage and current ratings to operate all display elements simultaneously at maximum brightness
conditions: When installed in a transit environment

subject: Passenger Information Display System
rule: The display panel and all electronic components must be weather-sealed to at least IP54 (ingress protection) when installed outdoors or in unconditioned environments
conditions: When the display is installed outdoors or in a location exposed to rain, dust, or condensation
exceptions: When the display is installed in a fully climate-controlled indoor environment with no moisture risk

subject: Passenger Information Display System
rule: The display must not generate surface temperatures exceeding the touch-safety limit defined by applicable safety standards (typically 60°C for metal surfaces accessible to passengers)
conditions: When the display is installed within passenger reach

subject: Security Screening Checkpoint
rule: must have a minimum clear width of at least 36 inches (914 mm) for accessible passage
conditions: serves as an accessible route
located in a facility subject to ADA or equivalent accessibility codes
exceptions: historic facilities where alteration would threaten significance (with alternative measures)

subject: Security Screening Checkpoint
rule: must have a clear height of at least 80 inches (2032 mm) in the pedestrian passage path
conditions: the checkpoint includes an overhead structure or archway

subject: Security Screening Checkpoint
rule: must not allow any sharp edges or protrusions within the pedestrian passage zone below 80 inches that could snag clothing or injure a person

subject: Security Screening Checkpoint
rule: must have a means of emergency egress through or around the checkpoint that does not require passing through the screening device
conditions: the checkpoint is located on a required means of egress path
exceptions: where supplemental exits provide equivalent egress capacity without using the checkpoint path

subject: Security Screening Checkpoint
rule: must be positioned such that the immediate floor surface is slip-resistant and free of tripping hazards (e.g., exposed cables, unsecured mats)

subject: Vertical Transportation Core
rule: vertical transportation core must have at least one fire-rated enclosure separating it from occupied floors
conditions: building has more than one story
vertical transportation core serves occupied floors
exceptions: open stair concept buildings where local code permits

subject: Vertical Transportation Core
rule: vertical transportation core must not have unprotected openings to corridors on different floors within the same smoke compartment
conditions: building is sprinklered and has smoke compartmentation
core contains elevator hoistways or stair shafts

subject: Vertical Transportation Core
rule: vertical transportation core must have a minimum width that accommodates the required egress width for the population served
conditions: core contains egress stairs

subject: Vertical Transportation Core
rule: vertical transportation core must have a smoke-proof enclosure or pressurization system if stair exceeds the maximum permitted travel distance without such protection
conditions: core contains exit stairs
building height exceeds limits for unprotected stairs per code
exceptions: buildings where all stairs are exterior

subject: Vertical Transportation Core
rule: vertical transportation core must have structural capacity to support the dead load of its enclosing walls and any equipment (elevator machinery, tanks) mounted within or on it

subject: Interchange HVAC System
rule: Interchange HVAC system must maintain minimum clearances to combustible materials as specified by applicable building and mechanical codes
conditions: system contains gas-fired equipment
system contains oil-fired equipment
exceptions: equipment listed and labeled for reduced clearance

subject: Interchange HVAC System
rule: Interchange HVAC system condensate drain lines must be trapped, sloped, and terminated at an approved disposal point, not directly connected to a sanitary sewer without an air gap or air break
conditions: system produces condensate
exceptions: condensate pump with proper check valve and air gap is used

subject: Interchange HVAC System
rule: Interchange HVAC system must not be operated without proof that all refrigeration circuit joints and components are leak-tight to applicable refrigerant-specific limits
conditions: system contains a refrigeration circuit with HFC, HFO, or natural refrigerant charge
exceptions: factory-sealed hermetic systems with no field-made joints

subject: Multi-Family Mix
rule: Multi-Family Mix dwelling units must have at least one means of egress that leads directly to a public way, exit passageway, or exit enclosure
conditions: when the unit is occupied

subject: Multi-Family Mix
rule: Multi-Family Mix corridor serving dwelling units must have a minimum clear width of 36 inches (914 mm) when serving 10 or fewer occupants, and 44 inches (1118 mm) otherwise
conditions: when the corridor serves as a means of egress

subject: Multi-Family Mix
rule: Multi-Family Mix must not have a dwelling unit or sleeping room that lacks an operable exterior window or automatic sprinkler head for emergency escape and rescue
conditions: when the unit is located in a story at or below the fourth story above grade plane
exceptions: when the building is fully sprinklered per NFPA 13

subject: Multi-Family Mix
rule: Multi-Fish Mix must have a fire-resistance-rated separation between adjacent dwelling units and between dwelling units and public/common corridors

subject: Single-Family Mix
rule: roof must have a minimum slope for drainage
conditions: location has precipitation
exceptions: roof is flat with an internal drainage system

subject: Single-Family Mix
rule: habitable spaces must have at least one means of egress to the exterior
conditions: space is occupied or habitable

subject: Single-Family Mix
rule: structural load path must be continuous from roof to foundation

subject: Single-Family Mix
rule: combustible materials must not be placed within a defined clearance of a heat-producing appliance
conditions: appliance produces heat (e.g., furnace, water heater, stove)
exceptions: non-combustible barrier is installed between appliance and material

subject: Rubbish Chute Installation
rule: rubbish chute must have a continuous, smooth internal surface with no sharp edges or protrusions

subject: Rubbish Chute Installation
rule: rubbish chute must be sealed against air leakage along its entire length

subject: Rubbish Chute Installation
rule: rubbish chute must have a minimum slope (gradient) to ensure gravitational flow of refuse

subject: Rubbish Chute Installation
rule: rubbish chute must be constructed of non-combustible material

subject: Rubbish Chute Installation
rule: rubbish chute must have a fire-rated enclosure or be separated from combustible construction

subject: Senior Living Mix
rule: floor areas designated as senior living must have slip-resistant (non-slip) flooring
conditions: in wet areas such as bathrooms and kitchens
in common circulation paths
exceptions: private bedrooms with carpeting that meets friction coefficient standards

subject: Senior Living Mix
rule: door openings to senior living units must have a minimum clear width of 32 inches (813 mm)
conditions: when the unit is occupied
exceptions: existing structures undergoing non-structural renovation where full widening is structurally impossible and alternative compliance is granted via local authority

subject: Senior Living Mix
rule: grab bars must be installed adjacent to toilets and within shower/bath zones in senior living units
conditions: in all senior living dwelling units and common accessible toilet rooms

subject: Senior Living Mix
rule: senior living units must have visual fire alarms (strobes) in addition to audible alarms
conditions: in common areas and within each dwelling unit
exceptions: if the building is fully sprinklered and all occupants are verified to have no hearing impairment via building policy

subject: Central Mailbox Array
rule: Central Mailbox Array must be securely anchored to prevent tipping or displacement under design loads
conditions: when located outdoors
when freestanding
exceptions: when the array is designed as a fully recessed or below-grade installation

subject: Central Mailbox Array
rule: Central Mailbox Array must have a weatherproof enclosure or cover for all mail compartments
conditions: when installed outdoors or in unconditioned spaces

subject: Central Mailbox Array
rule: Central Mailbox Array must not have doors or panels that open in a way that obstructs adjacent circulation paths or public right-of-way below minimum clear width
conditions: when located adjacent to pedestrian pathways or roadways
exceptions: when the array is positioned such that no door swing can encroach into the required clear zone

subject: Unit Entry Door Assembly
rule: unit entry door assembly must be side-hinged (not sliding, rotating, or overhead) for rated egress paths
conditions: when the door serves as a required means of egress
when the assembly is part of a rated fire/smoke compartment
exceptions: sliding doors are permitted if they are power-operated and fail-safe in the open position per code
revolving doors are permitted in non-egress locations when accompanied by a side-hinged swing door within 10 ft

subject: Unit Entry Door Assembly
rule: unit entry door assembly must swing in the direction of egress travel
conditions: when the door serves an occupant load of 50 or more
when the door is at the exit discharge or at the top of a stair
exceptions: residential dwelling unit entry doors serving fewer than 50 occupants may swing inward

subject: Unit Entry Door Assembly
rule: unit entry door leaf must have a minimum clear opening width of 32 inches (813 mm)
conditions: when the door is part of an accessible path of travel
exceptions: existing buildings under certain grandfathering provisions

subject: Unit Entry Door Assembly
rule: unit entry door must not have a threshold exceeding 1/2 inch (13 mm) in height
conditions: when the door is on an accessible route
exceptions: existing thresholds may be up to 3/4 inch if beveled

subject: Unit Entry Door Assembly
rule: unit entry door must be self-closing and self-latching when required as part of a fire-rated assembly
conditions: when the door is in a fire-resistance-rated wall (e.g., corridor, stair enclosure)
exceptions: doors to dwelling units in sprinklered buildings may be exempt per some codes

subject: Unit Entry Door Assembly
rule: unit entry door must not have vision panels smaller than the required fire-rated glazing size or without appropriate fire-rated glazing
conditions: when the door is fire-rated
exceptions: no exceptions for required fire-rated doors

subject: Intercom and Access Control Distribution
rule: Intercom and Access Control Distribution system must have a continuously available electrical power source (e.g., mains with battery backup or UPS) to maintain access control functionality during mains failure
conditions: System is configured to control door locks or gate access
exceptions: System is purely passive intercom (no electric strike or maglock control)

subject: Intercom and Access Control Distribution
rule: Wiring from intercom stations to access control panels must not exceed the manufacturer-specified maximum distance without repeater or network extender
conditions: Wiring is analog audio/video or RS-485 bus topology
exceptions: System uses fully IP-based (TCP/IP) devices where the LAN infrastructure handles distance limits

subject: Intercom and Access Control Distribution
rule: Access control distribution panels must be installed in a secured, weather-protected enclosure when located outdoors
conditions: Panel is mounted outside a conditioned building interior

subject: Intercom and Access Control Distribution
rule: Fail-secure/fail-safe wiring configuration for electronic locks must match the fire and life-safety egress plan of the building
conditions: System controls doors on egress paths

subject: Semi-Public Zone
rule: Semi-Public Zone must have at least one accessible entrance from a public thoroughfare or public zone
conditions: The zone is located on the ground floor
The zone is intended for visitor or non-staff use
exceptions: The building has a separate publicly accessible circulation route that connects to the semi-public zone via an internal path

subject: Semi-Public Zone
rule: Semi-Public Zone must not be located behind a lockable door that requires staff credentials to pass
conditions: The zone is intended for unescorted public or visitor access
exceptions: The lockable door is normally held open during operating hours and locks only after hours

subject: Semi-Public Zone
rule: Semi-Public Zone must have a floor-to-ceiling height of at least 2.1 m (or applicable local building code minimum) for occupied spaces
conditions: The zone contains areas intended for occupancy by the public or visitors
exceptions: Local building code expressly permits reduced clear height for the specific occupancy classification (e.g., mezzanine, storage-adjacent)

subject: Semi-Public Zone
rule: Semi-Public Zone must comply with local fire-code egress travel distance limits for the occupancy classification
conditions: The zone has a floor area exceeding the code threshold for single-exit allowance
The zone is occupied by visitors unfamiliar with the building layout
exceptions: The zone is sprinklered and local code permits increased travel distance

subject: Public Entrance
rule: Public entrance must provide a minimum clear opening width of at least 32 inches (813 mm) when the door is open 90 degrees
conditions: Applicable to any building with a public entrance
exceptions: Historic buildings where compliance would alter the historic character and an alternative means of access is provided

subject: Public Entrance
rule: Public entrance must have a level landing or threshold with a maximum vertical rise of 1/2 inch (13 mm) at the door
conditions: Applicable to any building with a public entrance
exceptions: Existing buildings where modification is structurally infeasible, provided signage directs to an accessible alternative entrance

subject: Public Entrance
rule: Public entrance door must be operable with a single effort requiring no tight grasping, pinching, or twisting of the wrist
conditions: Public entrance equipped with a door (not a permanently open opening)
exceptions: Automatic doors that open upon approach without manual operation

subject: Public Entrance
rule: Public entrance must not have a revolving door as the only means of access without an adjacent swinging door
conditions: Building required to be accessible by code

subject: Public Entrance
rule: Public entrance must be illuminated to a minimum of 10 foot-candles (108 lux) at the door landing
conditions: Public entrance used during hours of darkness

subject: Reception/Information Desk
rule: Reception/Information Desk must be located on the ground floor or within the primary accessible path of arrival
conditions: A building has multiple floors
The desk serves as the primary point of initial contact for visitors
exceptions: The building has only one floor

subject: Reception/Information Desk
rule: Reception/Information Desk must have a clear, unobstructed visual connection to the main entrance
conditions: The desk is staffed
The main entrance is used as the primary public entry
exceptions: A separate electronic or signage-based information system is provided at the entrance
The desk is a secondary information kiosk not serving as the primary reception point

subject: Reception/Information Desk
rule: Reception/Information Desk must not be enclosed in a room with a closed door that blocks visual and auditory access from the public circulation zone
conditions: The desk is intended to provide in-person visitor reception and information services
No alternative reception point exists in the same lobby or entrance area
exceptions: The desk operates as a security checkpoint requiring controlled access
Building function demands high security separation (e.g., prison, classified facility)

subject: Access Control Turnstile
rule: Access Control Turnstile must have a physical barrier (e.g., tripod arms, full-height gates, or drop arms) that can be mechanically locked in the closed position to block passage

subject: Access Control Turnstile
rule: Access Control Turnstile must have an integrated or directly interfaced credential reader (card, biometric, token, or mobile) positioned on the entry side before the barrier

subject: Access Control Turnstile
rule: Access Control Turnstile must be installed on a stable, level surface capable of supporting the unit weight plus dynamic loads from persons pushing against the barrier
conditions: permanent installation

subject: Access Control Turnstile
rule: Access Control Turnstile must_not have a passage width (rotor opening) narrower than 500 mm at any point when the barrier is in the open position

subject: Security Vestibule
rule: Security vestibule must have two interlocking doors that cannot both be opened simultaneously
conditions: when configured as a secure entry/exit point
when used for access control and security separation
exceptions: When vestibule is used only for environmental buffering (airlock) without security function

subject: Security Vestibule
rule: Security vestibule must have a clear sight line or monitoring capability (e.g., camera, vision panel) into the vestibule area
conditions: when used for access-controlled entry requiring occupant verification
exceptions: When all entry/exit is managed exclusively by electronic credentialing with no human verification of occupants

subject: Security Vestibule
rule: Security vestibule must not have concealed spaces, false ceilings with accessible cavities, or hiding locations within the enclosed volume
conditions: when rated for security/anti-tailgating function

subject: Security Vestibule
rule: Security vestibule floor must be capable of supporting trapped occupant weight with emergency egress loading
conditions: when the vestibule can be locked with an occupant trapped inside (all security vestibules by design)

subject: Public Corridor
rule: public corridor must have a minimum clear width of 36 inches (914 mm) when serving fewer than 10 occupants and 44 inches (1118 mm) when serving 10 or more occupants or as required by applicable building code
conditions: serves as means of egress
exceptions: existing buildings undergoing limited alteration where code allows reduction

subject: Public Corridor
rule: public corridor must have a clear ceiling height of at least 7 feet 6 inches (2286 mm) except under beams, ducts, or similar obstructions where minimum is 6 feet 8 inches (2032 mm) as allowed by code
conditions: serves as means of egress
exceptions: existing buildings under limited alteration provisions

subject: Public Corridor
rule: public corridor must not have a dead-end exceeding 20 feet (6.1 m) in length unless sprinklered throughout, in which case maximum is 50 feet (15.2 m)
conditions: serves as means of egress
dead-end corridor configuration
exceptions: one- and two-family dwellings
existing non-conforming conditions legally grandfathered

subject: Public Corridor
rule: public corridor serving as a means of egress must maintain a minimum fire-resistance rating of 1 hour when connecting more than two stories or as required by building code based on occupancy and construction type
conditions: serves as means of egress to more than two stories
building of Type II, III, IV, or V construction and occupancy group requiring rated corridors
exceptions: fully sprinklered buildings where code allows reduction to 0.5-hour or non-rated depending on occupancy

subject: Public Corridor
rule: public corridor must have a means of egress door that opens into it or from it swing in the direction of egress travel when serving an occupant load of 50 or more
conditions: occupant load served is 50 or more
exceptions: swinging doors serving individual dwelling units

subject: Restricted Corridor
rule: Restricted corridor must have a minimum clear width of 900 mm (36 in) to accommodate emergency egress and stretcher passage
conditions: Building is classified as healthcare, residential care, or high-occupancy assembly
exceptions: Sprinklered buildings with approved alternative life-safety strategy

subject: Restricted Corridor
rule: Restricted corridor must not dead-end beyond a length of 6 m (20 ft) unless served by two means of egress
conditions: Corridor serves more than one occupancy or exit access
exceptions: Sprinklered buildings with approved alternative life-safety strategy where travel distance is within code exception limits

subject: Restricted Corridor
rule: Restricted corridor must have fire-resistance-rated construction (minimum 1-hour fire barrier) when serving as a means of egress from two or more separate fire compartments
conditions: Corridor serves as exit access from multiple fire compartments or floors
exceptions: Fully sprinklered buildings with corridor not exceeding code-specified occupant load thresholds

subject: Visitor Waiting Area
rule: The Visitor Waiting Area floor must be slip-resistant
conditions: Area is accessible to the public
Floor is expected to be used in wet or damp conditions
exceptions: Area is a designated non-public back-of-house space with restricted access

subject: Visitor Waiting Area
rule: The Visitor Waiting Area must have at least one means of egress that leads directly to a public way or exit discharge
conditions: Area accommodates more than 10 occupants

subject: Visitor Waiting Area
rule: The Visitor Waiting Area must not have floor level changes that exceed 1/2 inch without a ramp or other code-compliant transition
conditions: Area is accessible to the general public
exceptions: Historic buildings where full compliance would destroy historically significant features, subject to alternative means of access

subject: Cluster Access Road
rule: Cluster Access Road must have a minimum width to accommodate emergency vehicles
conditions: When emergency vehicle access is required
exceptions: If the site has alternative emergency access routes that bypass the Cluster Access Road

subject: Cluster Access Road
rule: Cluster Access Road must have a maximum gradient within safe driving limits
conditions: Vehicular access is intended

subject: Cluster Access Road
rule: Cluster Access Road must not have a surface that becomes impassable under expected weather conditions
conditions: The road is the primary or sole vehicular access to the cluster

subject: Individual Dwelling Units
rule: Individual dwelling unit must have at least one means of egress (door or window) that opens directly to the exterior or to a fire-resistance-rated exit passageway
conditions: Building code applies
Unit is occupied or intended for occupancy
exceptions: Loft or mezzanine accessed only by ladder within the same unit if below a certain size threshold per local code

subject: Individual Dwelling Units
rule: Individual dwelling unit must have a minimum ceiling height of at least 2.1 m (approx. 7 ft) over at least 50% of the floor area
conditions: Unit is for permanent habitation
exceptions: Beams, ducts, or sloped ceilings may project below that height if they occupy less than the allowed percentage per code

subject: Individual Dwelling Units
rule: Individual dwelling unit must have at least one natural ventilation opening (operable window or vent) to the exterior
conditions: Mechanical ventilation is not provided as the primary system
exceptions: Units with approved mechanical ventilation systems that meet fresh-air requirements may omit operable windows

subject: Individual Dwelling Units
rule: Individual dwelling unit must have a minimum floor-to-floor height that accommodates the required ceiling height plus structural depth
conditions: Unit is a stacked multi-story dwelling

subject: Individual Dwelling Units
rule: Individual dwelling unit must not have a toilet room with direct opening into a kitchen or food-preparation area without an intervening ventilated space or door
conditions: Local plumbing code enforces separation
exceptions: Some codes allow a direct door if the room has mechanical ventilation and a self-closing door

subject: Cluster Pedestrian Walkway
rule: pedestrian walkway surface must provide slip resistance under expected conditions
conditions: when used as an exterior walkway
when exposed to rain or moisture

subject: Cluster Pedestrian Walkway
rule: pedestrian walkway must have a minimum clear width to allow two pedestrians to pass
conditions: when designated for two-way pedestrian traffic
when serving more than one dwelling unit

subject: Cluster Pedestrian Walkway
rule: walkway surface must not have sudden level changes or trip hazards exceeding threshold
conditions: along primary accessible route

subject: Shared Courtyard / Common Green
rule: Shared courtyard / common green must have a minimum of 6 hours of direct sunlight per day on at least 50% of its area during the growing season
conditions: courtyard contains vegetation or is intended for passive recreation
exceptions: courtyard is designed exclusively as a wind-scoop / light-well with no occupiable ground surface

subject: Shared Courtyard / Common Green
rule: shared courtyard / common green must have a continuous, unobstructed drainage path that directs surface water away from all building entrances and occupied ground-floor thresholds
conditions: courtyard is open to the sky
exceptions: courtyard is entirely roofed

subject: Shared Courtyard / Common Green
rule: shared courtyard / common green must not have any point within its area that is more than 30 m from an accessible building entry or pedestrian passage
conditions: courtyard is designated as a means of egress or emergency access route
exceptions: courtyard is decorative only and not part of the egress path

subject: Shared Courtyard / Common Green
rule: shared courtyard / common green must be entirely free of permanent overhead obstruction (buildings, bridges, large canopies) over more than 20% of its plan area
conditions: courtyard is classified as 'common green' and contains living plant material
exceptions: overhead elements are transparent to >85% of photosynthetically active radiation

subject: Cluster Parking Area
rule: Cluster Parking Area surface must be paved or surfaced with a hard, dust-free material (e.g., asphalt, concrete, permeable pavers)
conditions: Used for any vehicle parking on a regular basis
Occupied by cars, trucks, or other wheeled vehicles
exceptions: Temporary overflow parking areas used fewer than 5 days per year

subject: Cluster Parking Area
rule: Cluster Parking Area must have a minimum slope of 0.5% and a maximum slope of 5% in any parking stall direction
conditions: Outdoor parking area
exceptions: Indoor structured parking where drainage is handled by the structure

subject: Cluster Parking Area
rule: Cluster Parking Area surface drainage must not sheet-flow into adjacent pedestrian walkways, building entrances, or dwelling units
conditions: Parking area is adjacent to buildings or pedestrian paths
exceptions: Site is designed with an engineered drainage swale or curb system that captures all runoff before reaching pedestrian zones

subject: Cluster Parking Area
rule: Cluster Parking Area must have a minimum aisle width of 6.0 m (two-way) or 3.5 m (one-way) for vehicular access
conditions: Parking area serves standard passenger vehicles
exceptions: Parking area is valet-only with attendant operation restricting access to one direction at a time

subject: Cluster Boundary Wall / Fence
rule: boundary wall / fence must be structurally stable under self-weight and expected lateral loads (wind, minor impact)

subject: Cluster Boundary Wall / Fence
rule: boundary wall / fence must not obstruct required sight lines at vehicular or pedestrian egress points
conditions: when located adjacent to road or driveway access points

subject: Cluster Boundary Wall / Fence
rule: boundary wall / fence must have foundations adequate for soil bearing capacity and frost protection where applicable
conditions: when wall height exceeds 1.0 m
or when soil conditions are poor

subject: Common Utility Trench
rule: Common utility trench must have a minimum slope for drainage
conditions: trench conveys liquids
trench is gravity-drained
exceptions: trench is only for dry utilities (e.g., electrical conduits without liquid cooling)

subject: Common Utility Trench
rule: Common utility trench must not be located directly below building structural footings or foundations
conditions: trench runs adjacent to or beneath a building structure
exceptions: trench is designed with a structural slab or load-distribution system rated for the footing loads above

subject: Common Utility Trench
rule: Common utility trench must have removable, rated covers or gratings where accessible to pedestrian or vehicular traffic
conditions: trench is located in a trafficked area (pedestrian or vehicular)
exceptions: trench is entirely within a secure, non-trafficked equipment room with no public access

subject: Cluster Stormwater Drainage Network
rule: Cluster Stormwater Drainage Network must have a defined discharge point (outfall) to a receiving water body, municipal storm sewer, or infiltration system
conditions: system is operational

subject: Cluster Stormwater Drainage Network
rule: Cluster Stormwater Drainage Network must maintain continuous positive gravity slope (or equivalent pumped gradient) from catchment inlets to outfall
conditions: system relies on gravity flow
exceptions: systems that use mechanical pumping for the entire flow path

subject: Cluster Stormwater Drainage Network
rule: Cluster Stormwater Drainage Network must not have pipe diameters that decrease in the downstream direction
conditions: network uses closed pipes rather than open channels

subject: Cluster Stormwater Drainage Network
rule: Cluster Stormwater Drainage Network must have inlet capacities that match or exceed the design storm runoff at each catchment connection point
conditions: system is designed to a specified return-period storm event
exceptions: systems with intentional controlled ponding/attenuation upstream of inlets

subject: Shared Waste / Recycling Enclosure
rule: Shared Waste / Recycling Enclosure must have a fire-rated enclosure with minimum 1-hour fire resistance rating
conditions: building exceeds 3 stories in height
enclosure contains mixed recyclable materials with combustible content
exceptions: single-family detached dwellings
enclosure is located entirely outdoors with no connection to occupied structure

subject: Shared Waste / Recycling Enclosure
rule: Shared Waste / Recycling Enclosure must have a floor drainage system connected to building drainage
conditions: enclosure is indoors
enclosure is used for organic/putrescible waste or recycling with liquid residue potential
exceptions: outdoor enclosures with permeable ground surface and no roof

subject: Shared Waste / Recycling Enclosure
rule: Shared Waste / Recycling Enclosure must have a minimum ceiling height of 2.1 m (7 ft)
conditions: enclosure is accessible to personnel for waste handling

subject: Shared Waste / Recycling Enclosure
rule: Shared Waste / Recycling Enclosure must not have electrical outlets, switches, or fixtures within the enclosure interior
conditions: enclosure stores combustible waste materials
exceptions: electrical equipment rated for hazardous/classified locations
explosion-proof fixtures

subject: Shared Waste / Recycling Enclosure
rule: Shared Waste / Recycling Enclosure must have a ventilation system providing minimum 6 air changes per hour
conditions: enclosure is fully enclosed indoors
exceptions: naturally ventilated enclosure with permanent openings totaling at least 5% of floor area on two opposite walls

subject: Cluster Fire Hydrant Assembly
rule: fire hydrant assembly must have unobstructed access from a minimum of one side for fire department connection

subject: Cluster Fire Hydrant Assembly
rule: fire hydrant assembly must_not have its outlet nozzles oriented directly downward or into the ground

subject: Cluster Fire Hydrant Assembly
rule: fire hydrant assembly must have a shutoff valve that isolates it from the water main without disrupting supply to other hydrants in the cluster
conditions: cluster configuration with multiple hydrants sharing a branch line

subject: Common Mailbox Kiosk
rule: common mailbox kiosk must have a weatherproof enclosure
conditions: outdoor installation
intended for all-weather use

subject: Common Mailbox Kiosk
rule: common mailbox kiosk must have secure locking mechanisms on all access panels
conditions: contains mail or parcels
publicly accessible

subject: Common Mailbox Kiosk
rule: common mailbox kiosk must have a clear identification label or numbering for each mail slot
conditions: serves multiple recipients
exceptions: single-recipient kiosk where recipient identity is obvious

subject: Common Mailbox Kiosk
rule: common mailbox kiosk must not obstruct required clearances for emergency access or pedestrian walkways
conditions: installed on public right-of-way or in a building egress path

subject: Common Mailbox Kiosk
rule: common mailbox kiosk must have mail-retrieval openings sized to accommodate typical parcel dimensions
conditions: designed for parcel delivery as well as letter mail
exceptions: letter-only kiosk with explicit service restriction

subject: Row House Unit
rule: row house unit must have at least one means of egress to a public way or safe area

subject: Row House Unit
rule: row house unit must have a minimum ceiling height of at least 2.1 m (approx. 7 ft) in habitable rooms
conditions: applies to habitable rooms within the unit

subject: Row House Unit
rule: row house unit must be separated from adjacent row house units by a fire-resistance-rated wall (party wall)
conditions: when sharing a common wall with another unit

subject: Front Façade
rule: Front façade must include at least one primary public entrance on the ground floor if the building is occupied and the façade faces a public street or public open space
conditions: building is occupied
façade faces a public street or public open space
exceptions: building is a service/infrastructure structure with no public access
façade is a purely blank stage wall of a theatre

subject: Front Façade
rule: Front façade must be structurally self-supporting or attached to the building's primary structural system such that it can resist wind loads and transfer them to the foundation
exceptions: temporary installations of less than 6 months duration

subject: Front Façade
rule: Front façade must not have openings that allow water ingress at the interface between the façade assembly and adjacent building envelope components
conditions: façade is exposed to exterior weather conditions
exceptions: intentional weeps or drainage openings designed as part of a rainscreen system

subject: Rear Façade
rule: rear façade must have at least one opening to provide means of egress or emergency rescue access
conditions: building has more than one story
façade faces a public right-of-way or open space
exceptions: building is single-story with alternative egress paths
façade is on a property line where code prohibits openings

subject: Rear Façade
rule: rear façade must not have openings within the fire-resistance-rated separation distance from an adjacent building on the same lot
conditions: adjacent building exists on the same lot within fire-separation distance
exceptions: openings are protected by fire-rated glazing or assemblies as permitted by code

subject: Stoep / Front Steps
rule: stoep / front steps must have a minimum tread depth of at least 280 mm (11 inches) to safely accommodate a human foot
conditions: serves as an entry step or stair component

subject: Stoep / Front Steps
rule: stoep / front steps must have a maximum riser height of no more than 200 mm (8 inches)
conditions: serves as an entry step or stair component

subject: Stoep / Front Steps
rule: stoep / front steps must not have a slippery walking surface
conditions: exposed to outdoor weather (rain, frost, dew)

subject: Stoep / Front Steps
rule: stoep / front steps must have a minimum clear width of at least 900 mm (36 inches)
conditions: serves as the primary entrance steps to a building

subject: Stoep / Front Steps
rule: stoep / front steps must not have abrupt changes in level between consecutive treads exceeding 5 mm variation
conditions: constructed as a multi-step stoep

subject: Areaway / Light Well
rule: Areaway / Light Well must provide a minimum clear opening for emergency egress and rescue access
conditions: If the areaway/light well serves a habitable basement or cellar with occupancy
exceptions: When the areaway serves only mechanical or storage spaces with no occupancy

subject: Areaway / Light Well
rule: Areaway / Light Well must be drained to prevent water accumulation at the base

subject: Areaway / Light Well
rule: Areaway / Light Well must not be located where surface or subsurface water can freely flow into it without diversion

subject: Areaway / Light Well
rule: Areaway / Light Well walls must extend above the adjacent finished grade to prevent surface runoff entry
exceptions: Where a continuously drained trench grate at grade intercepts all runoff before it reaches the areaway opening

subject: Party Wall Parapet
rule: party wall parapet must be at least as high as any adjoining roof covering to prevent fire spread between buildings
conditions: where the parapet separates two buildings
where the building is subject to fire safety regulations
exceptions: where a fire-resisting barrier of equal or greater performance is provided at the roof junction

subject: Party Wall Parapet
rule: party wall parapet must have a minimum height of at least 200mm above the roof surface
conditions: where the parapet is on a flat or low-slope roof

subject: Party Wall Parapet
rule: party wall parapet must not have combustible cladding or finishes on its external faces
conditions: where the parapet is within 1m of a relevant boundary
exceptions: where the cladding system has been tested and certified to meet fire resistance standards

subject: Common Roof Assembly
rule: roof must have a drainage path to prevent water accumulation
conditions: roof has any slope or flat surface exposed to precipitation
exceptions: roof is an internal/decorative assembly not exposed to weather

subject: Common Roof Assembly
rule: roof must not have a continuous flat deck without minimum slope or secondary drainage
conditions: roof is exposed to rain or snow
roof is not designed as a green/vegetated roof with engineered drainage layers
exceptions: roof is an indoor roof element in a conditioned space not exposed to precipitation

subject: Common Roof Assembly
rule: roof membrane must be continuous and watertight across all penetrations and transitions
conditions: roof serves as the building envelope weather barrier
exceptions: roof is a non-envelope element such as a shade canopy or open trellis

subject: Row House Cellar / Basement
rule: Row house cellar/basement must have a means of egress (e.g., door, window, or stair) to the exterior
conditions: occupied space
habitable room
exceptions: uninhabitable crawl space with no occupancy

subject: Row House Cellar / Basement
rule: Row house cellar/basement must not have floor level below the groundwater table without a permanent waterproofing and drainage system
conditions: below-grade construction

subject: Row House Cellar / Basement
rule: Row house cellar/basement must have a minimum ceiling height of at least 7 feet (2.13 m) if intended as habitable space
conditions: habitable room
exceptions: unfinished storage or mechanical spaces

subject: Party Wall Firestop
