conditions: when the lift is at a landing

subject: Senior Lift / Platform Lift
rule: platform lift operating in a hoistway must have a locking mechanism on landing doors that prevents opening unless the platform is at that landing
conditions: when a hoistway and landing doors are provided

subject: Senior Lift / Platform Lift
rule: platform lift must not have exposed moving parts (e.g., chains, cables, scissor mechanisms) within reach of users at any point of travel

subject: Senior Lift / Platform Lift
rule: platform lift must have an emergency lowering or backup power system that functions if main power fails
conditions: when the lift is used as an accessible means of egress

subject: Senior Corridor Handrail
rule: Senior corridor handrail must have a continuous gripping surface along the entire length of the corridor
conditions: The corridor is accessible to seniors/elderly occupants
exceptions: Door openings or elevator entrances where the handrail is intentionally terminated

subject: Senior Corridor Handrail
rule: Senior corridor handrail must be mounted at a height between 34 and 38 inches above the walking surface
conditions: The handrail serves senior/elderly users
exceptions: Where code requires a second lower handrail for wheelchair users

subject: Senior Corridor Handrail
rule: Senior corridor handrail must not have sharp edges or protruding elements that could catch clothing or injure hands

subject: Senior Corridor Handrail
rule: Senior corridor handrail must be capable of sustaining a minimum concentrated load of 200 pounds applied in any direction

subject: Senior Corridor Handrail
rule: Senior corridor handrail must return to the wall, floor, or terminate in a rounded end that does not project into the path of travel

subject: Senior Facility Flooring
rule: flooring in senior facility must be slip-resistant under wet conditions
conditions: flooring is located in bathroom, shower, kitchen, or entryway areas
flooring is subject to frequent wetting or spills
exceptions: carpeted areas not subject to wet conditions

subject: Senior Facility Flooring
rule: flooring must not have trip hazards exceeding 1/4 inch at transitions or surface discontinuities
conditions: flooring includes transitions between different flooring materials
flooring has joints, seams, or level changes
exceptions: ramped transitions meeting ADA slope requirements are permitted

subject: Senior Facility Flooring
rule: flooring must have a coefficient of friction (COF) of 0.6 or higher when wet for walking surfaces
conditions: flooring is installed in resident-accessible areas
flooring is a hard surface (not carpet)

subject: Senior Facility Flooring
rule: flooring must not off-gas volatile organic compounds (VOCs) at levels exceeding healthy building standards for continuous occupancy
conditions: flooring is installed in occupied indoor spaces
flooring is not a fully sealed natural material
exceptions: outdoor or unoccupied service areas

subject: Senior Facility Flooring
rule: flooring surface temperature must not create discomfort or burn risk from direct skin contact for barefoot or seated residents
conditions: flooring contains radiant heating elements
flooring is exposed to direct sunlight for extended periods

subject: Non-Slip Bathroom Tiling
rule: Non-slip bathroom tiling must have a coefficient of friction (COF) of at least 0.6 when wet
conditions: tiling is installed in a wet-area bathroom zone (shower floor, shower pan, or area subject to direct water exposure)

subject: Non-Slip Bathroom Tiling
rule: Non-slip bathroom tiling must not have sharp edges, raised burrs, or surface irregularities that could cause barefoot lacerations
conditions: tile is installed in an area accessible to bare feet (any residential bathroom floor or shower floor)

subject: Non-Slip Bathroom Tiling
rule: Non-slip bathroom tiling must be impervious to water absorption (absorption rate ≤ 0.5%)
conditions: tiling is used on shower floors or continuously wet bathroom surfaces

subject: Senior Toilet / Raised Toilet
rule: senior toilet / raised toilet must have a minimum clear floor space of at least 1500 mm x 1500 mm to allow wheelchair turning
conditions: when the toilet is intended for wheelchair users
exceptions: when the toilet is a retrofitted installation in an existing building where structural limitations make this impossible and a minimum 1300 mm diameter turning space is provided instead

subject: Senior Toilet / Raised Toilet
rule: senior toilet / raised toilet must have grab bars installed on at least one side of the toilet

subject: Senior Toilet / Raised Toilet
rule: senior toilet / raised toilet must not have a seat height lower than 450 mm above finished floor level

subject: Senior Toilet / Raised Toilet
rule: senior toilet / raised toilet must have a clear transfer space of at least 900 mm on at least one side of the toilet

subject: Senior Toilet / Raised Toilet
rule: senior toilet / raised toilet must be located within 400 mm of an emergency call button or pull cord

subject: Cafeteria
rule: cafeteria must have at least one means of egress (exit door) that leads directly to a path of discharge to a public way
conditions: occupied by more than 50 people
located above or below grade
exceptions: single-story cafeteria with occupant load under 50 may have a single exit if within travel distance limits

subject: Cafeteria
rule: cafeteria kitchen exhaust hood must be ducted directly to the exterior
conditions: contains commercial cooking equipment with grease-producing appliances
exceptions: non-grease-producing appliances such as microwaves or warming ovens only

subject: Cafeteria
rule: cafeteria floor surface in food preparation and serving areas must be slip-resistant and cleanable
conditions: contains food preparation or serving zones

subject: Quiet Room
rule: Quiet Room must have sound-isolating construction (e.g., high-STC rated walls, doors, and windows) to prevent intrusive noise from adjacent spaces
conditions: Quiet Room is adjacent to or shares boundaries with spaces that generate noise (e.g., mechanical rooms, corridors, public areas)
exceptions: The room is located in a detached structure with no shared walls/ceilings/floors with noise-generating spaces

subject: Quiet Room
rule: Quiet Room must not contain mechanical equipment (HVAC units, fans, pumps) within the occupied space or in direct contact with the structure
conditions: The room is intended for quiet activities such as meditation, prayer, or silent study
exceptions: Mechanical equipment is installed on vibration isolators in a separate mechanical enclosure that does not share structural paths with the Quiet Room

subject: Kitchenette
rule: kitchenette must have a dedicated ventilation system or operable window to remove cooking exhaust and moisture
conditions: kitchenette includes cooking appliances
kitchenette is enclosed or located in an interior space without cross-ventilation
exceptions: kitchenette is in a space already served by a building-wide mechanical exhaust system rated for cooking

subject: Kitchenette
rule: kitchenette must have a floor finish that is impervious to water and grease within a 0.6 m radius around the cooking and sink areas
conditions: kitchenette includes a sink or cooking appliances

subject: Kitchenette
rule: kitchenette must not have an open-flame cooking appliance (e.g., propane burner, alcohol stove) in a space without a fire-rated separation from egress paths
conditions: kitchenette contains open-flame cooking equipment
the kitchenette space also functions as or opens directly onto a means of egress
exceptions: the appliance is permanently installed and the space has an automatic fire suppression system complying with applicable code

subject: Locker Room
rule: locker room floor must be slip-resistant and sloped to a floor drain
conditions: locker room contains shower or wet area

subject: Locker Room
rule: locker room must have a means of mechanical ventilation that provides continuous air changes
conditions: locker room is in a conditioned building with no operable windows to exterior

subject: Locker Room
rule: locker room must have a clearance of at least 36 inches in front of lockers and benches for accessible circulation
conditions: locker room is subject to accessibility code compliance

subject: Locker Room
rule: locker room walls and ceiling in wet zones must be constructed of mould-resistant, non-absorbent materials
conditions: locker room contains shower or steam-generating fixtures

subject: Wellness Room
rule: Wellness Room must have at least one operable window or mechanical ventilation providing minimum outdoor air delivery rate per occupant
conditions: room is fully enclosed
room is intended for occupancy
exceptions: room is never occupied
room is classified as a storage closet with no occupancy

subject: Wellness Room
rule: Wellness Room must have a means of egress (door or exit) that opens directly to a corridor, exit stair, or exterior
conditions: room is designed for occupancy by one or more persons

subject: Wellness Room
rule: Wellness Room floor finish must be cleanable and non-porous at surfaces that come into contact with skin or bodily fluids
conditions: room is used for first aid, medical examination, or therapy involving physical contact
exceptions: room is used only for meditation or talk therapy with no physical contact or fluid exposure

subject: Wellness Room
rule: Wellness Room must not have any sharp or protruding objects below 80 inches (2032 mm) on walls accessible to occupants in a prone or seated position
conditions: room is designated for yoga, massage, floor-based therapy, or medical examination

subject: Library / Resource Room
rule: library / resource room must have at least one means of egress (door or exit) that opens directly to a corridor, exit stair, or exterior
conditions: occupied by more than one person
enclosed space with walls
exceptions: mezzanine with direct access to a primary exit via open stair

subject: Library / Resource Room
rule: library / resource room must have a floor-to-ceiling height of at least 2.4 m (8 ft) in all habitable areas
conditions: room intended for occupancy by standing adults or shelving above eye level
exceptions: limited areas under ducts or beams where soffit height is permitted per local building code

subject: Library / Resource Room
rule: library / resource room must not have a floor load capacity less than the greater of 2.4 kPa (50 psf) for reading areas or 2.9 kPa (60 psf) for stack areas
conditions: room contains book stacks or shelving units

subject: Library / Resource Room
rule: library / resource room must have at least one natural or artificial light source providing minimum maintained illuminance of 200 lux at task height
conditions: space is used for reading, study, or book retrieval
exceptions: storage-only annex not intended for occupant reading

subject: Collaborative Table
rule: Collaborative table must have a flat, stable top surface

subject: Collaborative Table
rule: Collaborative table must have a height suitable for seated or standing use (typically 28-30 inches for seated, 40-42 inches for standing)
exceptions: Adjustable-height tables can vary beyond these ranges

subject: Collaborative Table
rule: Collaborative table must be structurally capable of supporting its intended load without collapse

subject: Collaborative Table
rule: Collaborative table must not have sharp exposed edges or corners that pose laceration risk to users
conditions: when intended for general public or child use
exceptions: Specialized task tables with documented hazard warnings

subject: Communal Seating Bench
rule: communal seating bench must have a minimum seat height of 380 mm to accommodate adult users
conditions: bench is intended for general adult public use
exceptions: benches explicitly designed for children only
custom benches for specific non-seating uses

subject: Communal Seating Bench
rule: communal seating bench must have a maximum seat height of 510 mm
conditions: bench is intended for general adult public use
exceptions: bar-height or counter-height seating where foot support is provided

subject: Communal Seating Bench
rule: communal seating bench must not have sharp corners or edges on user-contact surfaces

subject: Communal Seating Bench
rule: communal seating bench must be structurally stable against overturning when a lateral load of 890 N is applied at seat height
conditions: bench is freestanding (not fixed to ground)
exceptions: benches permanently fixed/anchored to a foundation or structure

subject: Whiteboard Wall
rule: Whiteboard wall must be mounted on a structurally sound base (e.g., stud, masonry, or furring strip rated for the wall load)
exceptions: free-standing portable whiteboard that does not rely on wall attachment

subject: Whiteboard Wall
rule: Whiteboard wall surface material must be compatible with dry-erase markers (non-porous, erasable finish)
conditions: the wall is intended for dry-erase writing
exceptions: wall designated exclusively as a projection surface or tackable board with no writing requirement

subject: Whiteboard Wall
rule: Whiteboard wall must not be installed in a location exposed to continuous direct sunlight or high heat that exceeds the material's rated temperature tolerance
exceptions: material specifically rated for UV/heat exposure and verified by manufacturer

subject: Breakroom Sink & Counter
rule: breakroom sink must be connected to a drain/waste water plumbing line

subject: Breakroom Sink & Counter
rule: breakroom sink must be connected to a potable cold water supply line

subject: Breakroom Sink & Counter
rule: breakroom sink must not be installed where ambient temperature can fall below freezing unless freeze protection is provided
conditions: installation in an unconditioned or exterior space subject to freezing temperatures
exceptions: freeze-protection measures such as heat tracing or insulation are provided

subject: Breakroom Sink & Counter
rule: breakroom sink countertop must be sealed or made of a water-resistant material on its surface
exceptions: countertop made of solid impervious material (e.g., stainless steel, solid surface) that does not require separate sealing

subject: Vending Machine Recess
rule: Vending machine recess must have a minimum interior depth to fully accommodate the vending machine without protruding into the circulation path
conditions: Where vending machine is installed in a wall recess
Adjacent to a pedestrian circulation path
exceptions: Recess is in a non-public area where protrusion is acceptable

subject: Vending Machine Recess
rule: Vending machine recess must not block or reduce required egress width
conditions: Recess is located adjacent to an egress corridor or doorway

subject: Vending Machine Recess
rule: Vending machine recess must be provided with an electrical outlet with appropriate voltage and amperage rating
conditions: Vending machine requires electrical power to operate
exceptions: Machine is non-powered (e.g., gravity-feed no-refrigeration unit)

subject: Vending Machine Recess
rule: Vending machine recess must have a finished floor that supports the loaded weight of the vending machine
exceptions: Floor structure is independently verified to support the point load

subject: AV System for Breakout
rule: AV System for Breakout must receive adequate power supply
conditions: when system includes active electronic components

subject: AV System for Breakout
rule: AV System for Breakout must not exceed electrical load capacity of dedicated circuit
conditions: when system is connected to building electrical infrastructure

subject: Coat Rack / Wardrobe
rule: coat rack / wardrobe must be capable of supporting the weight of coats and hangers without collapsing or detaching from the mounting surface
exceptions: lightweight valet hooks intended only for single garment display

subject: Coat Rack / Wardrobe
rule: coat rack / wardrobe must not have sharp edges or protruding hardware at user reachable height that could cause injury during normal use
exceptions: items explicitly designed as wall-mounted coat hooks with blunt hook ends

subject: Coat Rack / Wardrobe
rule: coat rack / wardrobe must not tip over when loaded asymmetrically with typical hanging garments
conditions: freestanding (not wall-mounted) configuration
exceptions: units permanently bolted to floor or wall

subject: Communal HVAC Zoning
rule: Supply and return air zoning dampers must not isolate any occupied zone from the HVAC system when the main air handler is operating
conditions: System is configured with zone-level dampers
Main air handler is active
exceptions: Fire or smoke control mode actively overriding normal operation

subject: Communal HVAC Zoning
rule: In a communal zoning layout, each zone must have at least one supply path and one return path to the central air handling unit
conditions: System serves multiple thermal zones

subject: Communal HVAC Zoning
rule: Zone walls or boundaries that separate zones with different thermal setpoints must be insulated to prevent excessive inter-zone heat transfer that would make independent zone control ineffective
conditions: Adjacent zones have different temperature setpoints
Boundary is not a building exterior wall

subject: Acoustic Treatment Panels
rule: Acoustic treatment panels must be installed with an air gap between the panel and the backing wall/surface
conditions: When used for sound absorption in reverberant spaces
exceptions: Direct-bonded membrane absorbers specifically designed for surface mounting

subject: Acoustic Treatment Panels
rule: Acoustic treatment panels must be made of or faced with a material that has a Class A (or local equivalent) fire rating when installed in buildings subject to occupancy fire codes
conditions: When installed in enclosed spaces accessible to building occupants
exceptions: Buildings or jurisdictions with no fire-rating requirement for interior finishes

subject: Acoustic Treatment Panels
rule: Acoustic treatment panels must not be installed in direct contact with moisture sources (e.g., condensation-prone ducts, exterior walls without vapor barrier, wet spaces)
conditions: When the panel material is porous or fibrous (e.g., open-cell foam, fiberglass, mineral wool)
exceptions: Panels specifically manufactured for high-humidity environments with closed-cell or hydrophobic facings

subject: Ribbon Canopy
rule: ribbon canopy must have continuous structural connection to primary building structure at each anchor point
conditions: when acting as a permanent weather shelter
when spanning more than 3 meters without ground support
exceptions: free-standing ribbon canopy with independent structural frame

subject: Ribbon Canopy
rule: ribbon canopy must not pond water on its surface
conditions: when membrane or solid roofing is used
exceptions: canopies designed with intentional water-feature containment system

subject: Ribbon Canopy
rule: ribbon canopy must have minimum lateral bracing to resist wind uplift
conditions: when canopy is enclosed or semi-enclosed on underside

subject: Ribbon Walkway
rule: A ribbon walkway must have a minimum clear width of at least 1.2 m (or locally adopted accessible route standard) to allow two persons to pass and for wheelchair passage
conditions: used as an accessible pedestrian route
publicly accessible
exceptions: temporary construction walkways not serving as accessible routes
private residential paths not open to the public

subject: Ribbon Walkway
rule: Ribbon walkway surface must be slip-resistant under foreseeable wet conditions
conditions: exposed to weather
pedestrian access is intended

subject: Ribbon Walkway
rule: Ribbon walkway must not have a change in level exceeding the maximum allowed step height (typically 150-200 mm) without an intermediate landing or ramp
conditions: pedestrian accessible route

subject: Ribbon Structure (Primary Frame)
rule: Ribbon Structure (Primary Frame) must have a continuous load path from the cladding attachment points to the ground via the primary frame members
conditions: When supporting cladding or façade elements

subject: Ribbon Structure (Primary Frame)
rule: Ribbon Structure (Primary Frame) must have a lateral bracing system (e.g., diaphragm, cross-bracing, or moment connections) to resist out-of-plane forces
conditions: When the ribbon frame spans more than one story in height or is exposed to wind/seismic loads

subject: Ribbon Structure (Primary Frame)
rule: Ribbon Structure (Primary Frame) must not have uncontrolled thermal expansion gaps that interrupt structural continuity unless designed as a deliberate expansion joint
conditions: When constructed of materials with significant thermal expansion coefficients (steel, aluminum, or long-span members)
exceptions: Deliberate, engineered expansion joints that maintain load transfer across the gap

subject: Lecture Theater Bowl
rule: seating bowl rake angle must not exceed 1:1.5 (approximately 34 degrees) for sightline safety
conditions: fixed seating is installed
seating rows are stepped
exceptions: handrail or guardrail provided at every row

subject: Lecture Theater Bowl
rule: stage or presentation platform must have an accessible means of egress at floor level
conditions: the space includes a raised stage or platform

subject: Lecture Theater Bowl
rule: floor-to-ceiling height must be at least 4.5 m to accommodate projection beam clearance and sightlines
conditions: the space uses a front-projection system
seating is tiered

subject: Lecture Theater Bowl
rule: seating rows must not block required exit paths or exit door swing arcs
conditions: fixed or loose seating is arranged in rows

subject: Ribbon Balustrade / Guardrail
rule: ribbon balustrade / guardrail must have a minimum height of 1.0 m (or local code minimum) to prevent falls
conditions: when installed at any change in level where the drop exceeds the local threshold (typically 600 mm)

subject: Ribbon Balustrade / Guardrail
rule: ribbon balustrade / guardrail must be capable of resisting the design loads specified by the governing code (e.g., 0.5 kN/m uniformly distributed line load or 1.0 kN concentrated load)

subject: Ribbon Balustrade / Guardrail
rule: ribbon balustrade / guardrail must have infill openings that prevent passage of a sphere of diameter 100 mm (or local code requirement)
conditions: when children are reasonably expected to have access
exceptions: private dwellings with no child access and compliant with alternative local code

subject: Ribbon Balustrade / Guardrail
rule: ribbon balustrade / guardrail must not have horizontal elements that can be climbed by children
conditions: when children are reasonably expected to have access
where the balustrade serves as a fall-protection barrier
exceptions: configurations where horizontal members are spaced such that climbing footholds do not form a ladder-like pattern per local code

subject: Ribbon Balustrade / Guardrail
rule: ribbon balustrade / guardrail must be fixed to the primary structure with connections capable of transferring design loads

subject: Ribbon Balustrade / Guardrail
rule: ribbon balustrade / guardrail must provide a continuous top-rail surface graspable by hand
conditions: when the top rail is intended as a handrail per code
exceptions: when the top rail is not required to function as a handrail (e.g., separate handrail is provided)

subject: Information / Reception Kiosk
rule: must be positioned to allow unobstructed visual and physical access from main circulation paths
conditions: when serving as primary information or reception point for a building or major zone
exceptions: when kiosk is supplementary or secondary to a main information desk

subject: Information / Reception Kiosk
rule: counter/desk surface height must be between 700 mm and 1100 mm from finished floor
conditions: where the kiosk includes a counter for standing users to interact with staff or a screen
exceptions: dedicated accessible-height kiosks for wheelchair users may have a lower surface at 650–850 mm

subject: Information / Reception Kiosk
rule: must have a clear floor space of at least 900 mm × 1200 mm in front of the kiosk for wheelchair approach
conditions: when the kiosk provides direct service to the public (check-in, information, payment)
exceptions: when kiosk is purely decorative or non-interactive and not intended for public access

subject: Pop-up Stall Infrastructure
rule: roof must provide weather protection (rain/sun) over the stall's primary service area
conditions: stall has a roof
exceptions: stall is designed exclusively for covered indoor use where external weather protection is provided by the host structure

subject: Pop-up Stall Infrastructure
rule: structural frame must withstand wind loads calculated for the intended installation location and duration
conditions: stall is used outdoors
stall has any vertical surface area that can catch wind
exceptions: stall is anchored to a permanent building or ground that provides the wind resistance

subject: Pop-up Stall Infrastructure
rule: electrical system must be protected from water ingress
conditions: stall includes electrical equipment or lighting
stall is used outdoors or in damp environments
exceptions: all electrical components are battery-operated low-voltage with no mains connection and are rated for outdoor use

subject: Pop-up Stall Infrastructure
rule: floor surface must not create a tripping hazard at transitions or on the walking surface
conditions: stall has a raised floor or ground-level walking surface accessible to customers

subject: Wayfinding Signage System
rule: wayfinding signage must provide legible information under all intended lighting conditions
conditions: signage is installed in any environment
exceptions: electronic signage that is intentionally designed to be readable only in low-light conditions with backlighting

subject: Wayfinding Signage System
rule: wayfinding signage must not contain text or symbols that are ambiguous to the point of having multiple contradictory interpretations
conditions: signage is used for emergency egress or safety direction

subject: Wayfinding Signage System
rule: wayfinding signage must be mounted at a height and position that allows intended users to physically see it within the intended viewing arc
conditions: signage is fixed in place
exceptions: temporary or floor-mounted signage that is designed to be viewed from above

subject: Wayfinding Signage System
rule: wayfinding signage must not use symbols or color coding that are indistinguishable for the relevant user population given known visual impairments
conditions: signage relies on color alone to convey meaning
or signage uses symbols not accompanied by text
exceptions: signage in areas where all intended users are screened for the relevant impairment

subject: Café / Food Court Servery
rule: café / food court servery must have a floor surface rated for commercial food service (i.e., slip-resistant, non-absorbent, and cleanable by mop/hose-down)
exceptions: if the servery is at an outdoor/seasonal event where temporary matting is used

subject: Café / Food Court Servery
rule: café / food court servery must have a backsplash or wall finish that is smooth, non-porous, and cleanable immediately behind all food-prep sinks and cooking equipment
conditions: where walls are adjacent to sinks, cooktops, or food-prep surfaces
exceptions: freestanding island servery with no adjacent wall

subject: Café / Food Court Servery
rule: café / food court servery must have a direct or mechanical connection to a grease interceptor on the waste plumbing line serving cooking and dishwashing fixtures
conditions: if the servery includes cooking equipment, deep fryers, or three-compartment dishwashing sinks
exceptions: prepackaged / no-cook servery with only cold-hold and warming (no grease-generating fixtures)

subject: Café / Food Court Servery
rule: café / food court servery must have a hand-washing sink within the servery area that is separate from food-prep and dishwashing sinks
conditions: if the servery is a permanent, licensed food-service operation
exceptions: temporary / pop-up servery operating under a temporary food service permit with alternative hand-washing provided

subject: Fixed Banquette / Window Seat
rule: Fixed banquette / window seat must have a minimum seat depth of 450 mm (18 in) to provide adequate seating area
conditions: used for human seating
exceptions: decorative-only non-seating application

subject: Fixed Banquette / Window Seat
rule: Fixed banquette / window seat must have a minimum seat height from finished floor of 400 mm (16 in)
conditions: used for human seating
exceptions: custom accessibility design with documented alternate ergonomic target

subject: Fixed Banquette / Window Seat
rule: Fixed banquette / window seat must_not block egress path when installed in front of a window that is a required emergency escape or rescue opening
conditions: window is designated as an emergency egress or rescue opening per building code
exceptions: seat is hinged, removable, or otherwise designed to allow unobstructed egress through the window

subject: Fixed Banquette / Window Seat
rule: Fixed banquette / window seat must_not reduce window well clearance below code-required minimums for emergency escape
conditions: installed in a below-grade window well that serves as an emergency escape opening

subject: Interactive Touchscreen Display
rule: interactive touchscreen display must have a power supply connection
conditions: when used as a standalone unit
exceptions: battery-powered or self-powered models

subject: Interactive Touchscreen Display
rule: interactive touchscreen display must not have its touch sensor surface fully obstructed by opaque materials in active touch zones
conditions: when touch interaction is a required function
exceptions: purpose-built tactile-only displays where touch is not used

subject: Interactive Touchscreen Display
rule: interactive touchscreen display must have its display surface oriented within the user's line of sight
conditions: when visual output is a required function
exceptions: audio-only or haptic-only feedback variants

subject: Interactive Touchscreen Display
rule: interactive touchscreen display must not operate in ambient temperatures exceeding its specified operating range
conditions: when deployed outdoors or in unconditioned indoor spaces
exceptions: units specifically rated/extended-temperature models

subject: Public Announcement / Digital Display System
rule: Public Announcement / Digital Display System must have a power supply connection (mains or PoE)
conditions: system is not battery-powered only
exceptions: battery-powered portable units

subject: Public Announcement / Digital Display System
rule: Public Announcement / Digital Display System must have an environmental rating (IP rating) appropriate for its installation location
conditions: installed outdoors
installed in wet or dusty indoor environments
exceptions: installed in climate-controlled indoor environment with no exposure to moisture or particulates

subject: Public Announcement / Digital Display System
rule: Public Announcement / Digital Display System must have a structural mounting method rated for the weight of the unit
conditions: unit is wall-mounted
unit is ceiling-mounted
unit is pole-mounted
exceptions: free-standing floor unit

subject: Public Announcement / Digital Display System
rule: Public Announcement / Digital Display System must not have its ventilation openings obstructed
conditions: unit has active or passive cooling requirements
exceptions: units rated for fully enclosed installation with conduction cooling

subject: Bookable Meeting Pod
rule: must have a clear opening width of at least 800 mm per accessibility regulations
conditions: if the pod is intended for wheelchair access
if located in a jurisdiction that enforces accessibility codes
exceptions: private residence pods not open to the public where codes do not apply

subject: Bookable Meeting Pod
rule: must have a self-closing door or latching mechanism to meet fire/smoke compartmentation
conditions: if the pod is installed in a means of egress path
if local fire code requires compartmentation
exceptions: pods located entirely outdoors away from egress routes

subject: Bookable Meeting Pod
rule: must provide a minimum clear floor area of 1.5 m x 1.5 m for a single-occupant wheelchair-accessible pod
conditions: if the pod is designed for wheelchair accessibility
exceptions: pods not required to be accessible under applicable codes

subject: Bookable Meeting Pod
rule: must have a means of emergency release from inside the pod
conditions: if the pod is fully enclosed and can be locked from inside
if occupancy exceeds one person or if the door has a lock
exceptions: pods without any lock or latching mechanism and always openable from inside

subject: Bookable Meeting Pod
rule: must have a ventilation system that provides at least 15 CFM per occupant of outdoor air
conditions: if the pod is an enclosed indoor space without direct natural ventilation to outdoors
exceptions: pods with operable windows that meet natural ventilation requirements per local code

subject: Bookable Meeting Pod
rule: must not have a ceiling height less than 2.1 m (7 ft) in any occupied area
conditions: if the pod is intended for standing occupancy or sitting at a desk
exceptions: pods meant only for prone or seated use where head clearance is not needed (e.g., phone-booth style seated-only pod with lower ceiling)

subject: Council Chamber
rule: Council Chamber must have at least one means of egress (doorway or exit) that opens directly to a corridor, exit stair, or the exterior at grade
exceptions: Spaces with occupant load less than 10 that have an exit access through an adjacent space may use that path

subject: Council Chamber
rule: Council Chamber floor must be structurally capable of supporting the design live load for assembly occupancy
conditions: Room is located above grade or on any elevated level
exceptions: Chamber located on a slab-on-grade where ground supports all loads directly

subject: Council Chamber
rule: Council Chamber must have a minimum ceiling height that complies with occupancy classification requirements
conditions: Room is designed for seated assembly use

subject: Council Chamber
rule: Council Chamber must not have a floor level that is more than one story below the level of exit discharge without appropriate smoke control or pressurization
exceptions: Chambers protected by an engineered smoke control system designed per code

subject: Council Chamber
rule: Council Chamber must have natural or mechanical ventilation providing minimum outdoor air delivery rate for assembly occupancy
conditions: Room is designed for occupancy by people

subject: Public Records Archive
rule: public records archive must have environmental controls (temperature and humidity regulation)
conditions: contains permanent paper records
contains photographic or film media
exceptions: temporary holding facility with no long-term storage

subject: Public Records Archive
rule: public records archive must have fire suppression system appropriate for archival materials
conditions: contains combustible records (paper, film, etc.)

subject: Public Records Archive
rule: public records archive must not have direct roof or wall penetrations that create moisture intrusion pathways
conditions: above-grade envelope
exceptions: properly sealed and flashed penetrations with redundant waterproofing

subject: Municipal Courtroom
rule: courtroom floor-to-ceiling height must be at least 2.4 m (8 ft)
conditions: applicable to all occupied spaces

subject: Municipal Courtroom
rule: courtroom must have at least one exit door leading directly to a means of egress
conditions: occupied courtroom

subject: Municipal Courtroom
rule: courtroom must have a clear sightline from the judge's bench to the entire public seating area

subject: Municipal Courtroom
rule: courtroom must not have any structural column or obstruction within the direct sightline between judge's bench and witness stand

subject: Municipal Courtroom
rule: courtroom floor must have a minimum live load capacity of 4.79 kN/m² (100 psf)

subject: Judge's Bench and Witness Stand
rule: Judge's bench must be elevated above the courtroom floor level
conditions: In a formal courtroom setting

subject: Judge's Bench and Witness Stand
rule: Witness stand must be positioned so the witness faces the judge and is visible to both judge and jury
conditions: In a courtroom with a jury

exceptions: Facilities where all return air is exhausted to the outside (100% exhaust)

subject: Medical Records Storage
rule: medical records storage area must maintain temperature between 60-75°F (15-24°C)
conditions: when active records are stored on paper or film media
exceptions: temporary excursions during HVAC maintenance not exceeding 4 hours

subject: Medical Records Storage
rule: medical records storage area must maintain relative humidity between 30-50%
conditions: when active records are stored on paper or film media
exceptions: temporary excursions during HVAC maintenance not exceeding 4 hours

subject: Medical Records Storage
rule: medical records storage area must not have exposed water or sprinkler piping directly above shelving or record storage locations
conditions: when records are stored in open shelving or containers without waterproof covers
exceptions: pre-action or dry-pipe sprinkler systems designed to prevent accidental discharge

subject: Medical Records Storage
rule: medical records storage area must be separated from other occupancies by fire-resistance-rated construction
conditions: when the storage area exceeds 500 square feet

subject: IT / Server Closet
rule: IT / Server Closet must have its own dedicated cooling system or be served by an HVAC system capable of maintaining temperature between 18°C and 27°C (64°F to 80°F)
conditions: space contains active IT/server equipment generating heat
exceptions: space is unconditioned and contains no active electronic equipment

subject: IT / Server Closet
rule: IT / Server Closet floor must be capable of supporting the static and dynamic load of installed server racks and equipment
conditions: space contains rack-mounted servers or heavy equipment

subject: IT / Server Closet
rule: IT / Server Closet must not share air supply with spaces containing corrosive fumes, excessive dust, or combustible particles unless equipped with appropriate filtration
exceptions: proven isolation and filtration systems are installed and maintained

subject: IT / Server Closet
rule: IT / Server Closet must have a grounded electrical system meeting local code for IT equipment loads
conditions: space contains electrical equipment requiring power

subject: IT / Server Closet
rule: IT / Server Closet must not have water or steam pipes passing directly above or within the space unless protected by a drip pan and leak detection system
conditions: building has plumbing or steam systems on floors above or adjacent
exceptions: pipes are fully enclosed in a secondary containment system with active leak detection and automatic shutoff

subject: Emergency Power / Generator Room
rule: Emergency power / generator room must have adequate ventilation for heat dissipation and exhaust
conditions: Room contains fuel-burning generator
exceptions: Generator is electric only with no combustion engine

subject: Emergency Power / Generator Room
rule: Emergency power / generator room must not have ventilation openings that allow direct water entry
conditions: Room is located in a flood-prone area or at grade level
exceptions: Ventilation openings are equipped with automatic flood dampers rated to the design flood elevation

subject: Emergency Power / Generator Room
rule: Emergency power / generator room must have a fuel supply system that prevents spillage and is contained within a secondary containment or dike
conditions: Generator uses liquid fuel (diesel, gasoline, propane) stored on-site

subject: Emergency Power / Generator Room
rule: Emergency power / generator room must not share a common fresh air intake with other building occupancy spaces
conditions: Generator is combustion-powered
exceptions: The shared intake includes dedicated exhaust purging and backdraft dampers specifically rated to prevent exhaust re-entry

subject: Handicap-Accessible Toilet Room
rule: handicap-accessible toilet room must have a clear floor space of at least 30 inches by 48 inches (760 mm by 1220 mm) clear of obstructions at the accessible fixture
conditions: applies where the room contains a toilet, lavatory, or other accessible fixture

subject: Handicap-Accessible Toilet Room
rule: handicap-accessible toilet room must have a door with minimum 32 inches (815 mm) clear opening width

subject: Handicap-Accessible Toilet Room
rule: handicap-accessible toilet room must provide a wheelchair-accessible water closet with centerline 16-18 inches (405-455 mm) from the side wall
conditions: applies where a water closet is provided

subject: Handicap-Accessible Toilet Room
rule: handicap-accessible toilet room must have grab bars behind and on the side wall adjacent to the water closet
conditions: applies where a water closet is provided

subject: Vaccine Refrigerator
rule: Vaccine refrigerator must maintain internal temperature within 2°C to 8°C range
conditions: when storing vaccines requiring refrigerated storage
exceptions: during defrost cycles consistent with manufacturer specifications
during transient door openings of less than 30 seconds

subject: Vaccine Refrigerator
rule: Vaccine refrigerator must have a temperature monitoring system that is visible without opening the door
conditions: when used for vaccine storage

subject: Vaccine Refrigerator
rule: Vaccine refrigerator must not have a freezer compartment integrated into the same chamber
conditions: when the unit is used exclusively for storing refrigerated vaccines at 2-8°C
exceptions: dual-compartment units with separate insulated freezer and refrigerator sections that maintain independent temperature zones are acceptable

subject: Vaccine Refrigerator
rule: Vaccine refrigerator must have a locking mechanism on the door
conditions: when the refrigerator is in a public or semi-public access area
exceptions: when the refrigerator is located in a locked room with restricted access

subject: Vaccine Refrigerator
rule: Vaccine refrigerator must be powered by a reliable electrical supply with battery backup or capable of maintaining temperature during power outages of at least 4 hours
conditions: when located in areas with intermittent grid power
exceptions: when used in facilities with guaranteed uninterrupted power supply

subject: Medical Ceiling Pendant / Boom
rule: Medical ceiling pendant / boom must be securely anchored to the building structure above the ceiling
conditions: installed in a medical setting
suspended from ceiling
exceptions: free-standing medical equipment columns on the floor

subject: Medical Ceiling Pendant / Boom
rule: Medical ceiling pendant / boom must not obstruct emergency exit pathways or fire suppression system coverage
conditions: positioned in a treatment room with egress paths
located near sprinkler heads or fire alarms

subject: Medical Ceiling Pendant / Boom
rule: Medical ceiling pendant / boom must have a dedicated emergency stop (E-stop) mechanism for equipment movement
conditions: the pendant includes motorized articulating arms or height adjustment
exceptions: manually positioned booms with no powered movement

subject: Medical Ceiling Pendant / Boom
rule: Medical ceiling pendant / boom must have medical gas outlets that comply with color-coding and indexing standards (e.g., CGA, ISO)
conditions: the pendant supplies medical gases (O2, N2O, medical air, vacuum)
exceptions: pendants used exclusively for electrical/data pendants with no gas service

subject: Medical Ceiling Pendant / Boom
rule: Medical ceiling pendant / boom must not exceed the ceiling structural load rating under any combination of static and dynamic loads

subject: Built-in Seating (Waiting Benches)
rule: Built-in seating must be anchored or secured to the floor or wall structure to prevent tipping or movement under normal use
conditions: seating is intended for public or waiting areas
seating is freestanding (not monolithic with structure)

subject: Built-in Seating (Waiting Benches)
rule: Built-in seating must have a minimum clear width per seat of at least 450 mm (18 inches) at seat level to accommodate a seated occupant
conditions: seating is installed in a space accessible to adults
exceptions: seating specifically designed for children under 12 with known smaller ergonomic dimensions

subject: Built-in Seating (Waiting Benches)
rule: Built-in seating must have no sharp edges, corners, or protruding fasteners on surfaces that contact users

subject: Built-in Seating (Waiting Benches)
rule: Built-in seating must be designed so the seat height (top of seat cushion or surface) is between 380 mm and 510 mm (15–20 inches) from the finished floor
conditions: seating is for general adult use
exceptions: seating in spaces exclusively for children or with a stated accessibility exception for a specific design intent

subject: Built-in Seating (Waiting Benches)
rule: Built-in seating must have a minimum clear depth (seat pan depth) of at least 400 mm (16 inches) to support the user's thighs
conditions: seating is intended for sitting with back support or for extended waiting
exceptions: perch-style seating (stool-height, no back) designed for brief standing-rest only

subject: Vaccination / Immunization Station
rule: Vaccination/Immunization Station must have a handwashing sink accessible to staff within the station
conditions: station provides clinical vaccination services

subject: Vaccination / Immunization Station
rule: Vaccination/Immunization Station must have a dedicated biohazard waste container for sharps disposal
conditions: station administers injectable vaccines

subject: Vaccination / Immunization Station
rule: Vaccination/Immunization Station must have an exam/treatment surface (e.g., chair or table) that allows patient access for injection

subject: Vaccination / Immunization Station
rule: Vaccination/Immunization Station must not have an open flame or ignition source within the immediate vaccination area
conditions: alcohol-based antiseptic products are used for skin preparation

subject: Wheelchair Storage Alcove
rule: Wheelchair storage alcove must have a clear floor area of at least 30 inches by 48 inches (760 mm by 1220 mm) to accommodate a wheelchair
conditions: Alcove provides storage for a wheelchair while occupied

subject: Wheelchair Storage Alcove
rule: Wheelchair storage alcove must have a door or opening with a minimum clear width of 32 inches (815 mm) when the door is open at 90 degrees
conditions: Alcove is enclosed by a door or gate

subject: Wheelchair Storage Alcove
rule: Wheelchair storage alcove must not have any protruding objects in the wheelchair maneuvering path within the alcove that reduce the clear width below the required minimum
exceptions: Objects mounted with the leading edge at or below cane-detectable height (not more than 27 inches above floor)

subject: Wheelchair Storage Alcove
rule: Wheelchair storage alcove floor surface must be stable, firm, and slip-resistant

subject: Wheelchair Storage Alcove
rule: Wheelchair storage alcove must not be located where its door swing encroaches into an accessible route or adjacent required clear floor space
conditions: Alcove has a hinged door

subject: Central Courtyard
rule: central courtyard floor surface must have a positive slope (≥1-2%) away from building entrances toward drainage points
conditions: courtyard is paved or hardscaped
courtyard is enclosed by buildings with roof drainage feeding into it
exceptions: courtyard has a completely permeable/absorption-based surface (e.g., rain garden, gravel infiltration bed) designed to pond temporarily

subject: Central Courtyard
rule: central courtyard must not have a continuous impervious surface that blocks all stormwater infiltration
conditions: courtyard area exceeds 50 m²
local regulations require on-site stormwater management
exceptions: courtyard is part of a certified greywater/rainwater harvesting system that captures and reuses all runoff

subject: Lattice Screen Facade
rule: Lattice screen facade must allow wind passage through its openings
conditions: When facade is attached to a building envelope

subject: Lattice Screen Facade
rule: Lattice screen facade must have a structural connection capable of transferring its self-weight and imposed loads to the main building structure

subject: Lattice Screen Facade
rule: Lattice screen facade must not be constructed from materials that are incompatible with the adjacent building materials causing galvanic corrosion
conditions: When metal components are in direct contact with dissimilar metals or reactive building materials
exceptions: When appropriate isolating barriers or coatings separate the dissimilar materials

subject: Load-Bearing Party Walls
rule: Load-bearing party walls must be continuous from foundation through roof to transfer loads vertically
conditions: wall supports structural loads from floors or roof

subject: Load-Bearing Party Walls
rule: Load-bearing party walls must not have lateral displacement exceeding structural stability limits
conditions: wall is subjected to lateral loads such as wind or seismic forces

subject: Load-Bearing Party Walls
rule: Load-bearing party walls must have a minimum thickness adequate for the supported loads and wall height

subject: Load-Bearing Party Walls
rule: Load-bearing party walls must be founded on a footing or foundation capable of distributing the wall load to the soil

subject: Load-Bearing Party Walls
rule: Load-bearing party walls must not have openings that reduce the load-bearing capacity below design requirements unless structurally compensated
conditions: wall contains doors, windows, or other penetrations
exceptions: openings are designed with adequately sized lintels, arches, or reinforcement to redistribute loads

subject: Rainwater Collection System
rule: collection surface must be positioned lower than the catchment area
conditions: when relying on gravity flow

subject: Rainwater Collection System
rule: rainwater collection system must have a first-flush diverter
conditions: when system is used for potable water collection

subject: Rainwater Collection System
rule: collection tank must be sealed against mosquito entry
conditions: in regions where mosquitoes are present

subject: Rainwater Collection System
rule: overflow outlet must be larger than the inlet
conditions: when system has a closed storage tank

subject: Natural Ventilation Shaft
rule: Natural ventilation shaft must have a minimum cross-sectional area to allow adequate airflow by natural buoyancy and wind effects

subject: Natural Ventilation Shaft
rule: Natural ventilation shaft must be vertically continuous (unobstructed) from the intake opening to the exhaust outlet

subject: Natural Ventilation Shaft
rule: Natural ventilation shaft must terminate above the highest occupied floor level or be mechanically assisted if terminated lower
conditions: serving multiple floors

subject: Natural Ventilation Shaft
rule: Natural ventilation shaft must not have its exhaust outlet located in a recirculation zone or at a location where exhaust air can re-enter the building through other intakes

subject: Natural Ventilation Shaft
rule: Natural ventilation shaft must have internal surfaces that are smooth and do not create excessive friction losses for the intended airflow

subject: Natural Ventilation Shaft
rule: Natural ventilation shaft must be sealed against air leakage to adjacent spaces not intended to be part of the ventilation path

subject: Shared Terrace Roof
rule: Shared terrace roof must have a minimum slope to ensure drainage
conditions: roof surface is exposed to precipitation
exceptions: roof is designed as a 'blue roof' with controlled rainwater retention system

subject: Shared Terrace Roof
rule: Shared terrace roof must have a continuous waterproof membrane
conditions: roof is used as an occupiable terrace

subject: Shared Terrace Roof
rule: Shared terrace roof must have a load-bearing capacity that supports anticipated live loads
conditions: roof is accessible to occupants

subject: Shared Terrace Roof
rule: Shared terrace roof must have a means of egress meeting applicable fire code requirements
conditions: roof is occupiable and serves as an occupied roof or podium
exceptions: roof serves only mechanical equipment and is not accessible to the public

subject: Concrete Frame Structure
rule: Concrete frame structure must have a continuous load path from roof to foundation
conditions: any building

subject: Concrete Frame Structure
rule: Concrete frame structure must not have rebar exposed to environmental conditions without adequate cover depth per code
conditions: exterior exposure
reinforced concrete frame
exceptions: stainless steel or epoxy-coated rebar used with reduced cover requirements per ACI 318

subject: Concrete Frame Structure
rule: Concrete frame structure must have beam-column joints detailed to develop the full moment capacity of connected members
conditions: seismic design category D, E, or F
moment-resisting frame

subject: Concrete Frame Structure
rule: Concrete frame structure must not have cold joints between concrete pours without proper roughening and reinforcement continuity
conditions: structural elements (beams, columns, slabs)
exceptions: intentional construction joints designed per ACI 318 with shear keys and tie steel

subject: Concrete Frame Structure
rule: Concrete frame structure must not have a slenderness ratio (effective height / least lateral dimension) exceeding limits specified in structural code
conditions: columns

subject: Integrated Planter Bench
rule: planter must have drainage holes or a drainage layer to prevent waterlogging
conditions: planter contains soil and live plants
exceptions: planter is used only for decorative artificial plants

subject: Integrated Planter Bench
rule: bench seating surface must support a minimum distributed live load of at least 1.9 kN/m² (40 psf)
conditions: bench is intended for public or commercial use
exceptions: bench is purely decorative and not intended for sitting

subject: Integrated Planter Bench
rule: planter must not leak water onto the bench seating area
conditions: planter is positioned above or adjacent to the seating surface
exceptions: a sealed waterproof membrane fully separates planter from bench

subject: In-Slab Hydronic Heating
rule: In-slab hydronic heating pipes must be fully embedded within the concrete slab and not exposed to air or direct contact with vapor-permeable insulation below
conditions: System is installed in a concrete slab on grade
System uses embedded pipe loops

subject: In-Slab Hydronic Heating
rule: The slab must have a continuous vapor barrier (minimum 6-mil polyethylene or equivalent) directly beneath it, with no thermal insulation placed between the vapor barrier and the slab that would allow the slab to stay cold enough to cause condensation
conditions: System is a ground-contact slab on grade
exceptions: Slab is installed over an insulated, conditioned crawlspace where vapor drive conditions do not exist

subject: In-Slab Hydronic Heating
rule: The supply water temperature must not exceed the slab material's long-term thermal tolerance (typically 140°F / 60°C for conventional concrete, lower for gypsum-based toppings)
conditions: System uses standard concrete or gypsum-based slab materials
exceptions: Slab mix is specifically designed with high-temperature-tolerant aggregate and verified by structural engineer

subject: In-Slab Hydronic Heating
rule: A minimum of 2 inches (50 mm) of continuous rigid insulation must be placed beneath and at the perimeter edge of the slab to prevent excessive downward and lateral heat loss
conditions: Slab is on grade or over an unconditioned space
exceptions: Slab is in a continuously conditioned space with verified stable ground temperatures and design energy modeling demonstrates no condensation risk at perimeter

subject: In-Slab Hydronic Heating
rule: The hydronic loop piping must be pressure-tested before the concrete pour to at least 1.5 times the working pressure and must remain pressurized during the pour
conditions: System is installed in a poured-in-place concrete slab

subject: Asphalt Wearing Surface
rule: asphalt wearing surface must have a minimum thickness to avoid raveling and cracking under traffic loads
conditions: when used as a pavement layer for vehicular traffic
exceptions: pedestrian-only or non-traffic applications

subject: Asphalt Wearing Surface
rule: asphalt wearing surface must not be placed directly on a subgrade without a base course
conditions: when used in pavement construction for roads or parking areas

subject: Road Pavement Structure
rule: Road pavement structure must provide adequate load-bearing capacity for design traffic loads
conditions: When designed for vehicular traffic
exceptions: Pedestrian-only pavements

subject: Road Pavement Structure
rule: Road pavement structure must have a properly designed drainage system to prevent water accumulation within or beneath the pavement layers
conditions: In all pavement designs

subject: Road Pavement Structure
rule: Road pavement surface must provide adequate skid resistance for design speed and expected traffic conditions
conditions: When open to vehicular traffic

subject: Road Pavement Structure
rule: Road pavement structure must not have reflective cracking from underlying layers propagate through to the surface in a manner that compromises structural integrity
conditions: For rigid or composite pavements over jointed concrete base
exceptions: Where crack relief layers or interlayers are explicitly designed to mitigate reflective cracking

subject: Road Pavement Structure
rule: Road pavement layers must be compacted to achieve specified density requirements
conditions: During construction of all pavement layers

subject: Concrete Curb
rule: concrete curb must have a minimum height to prevent vehicles from mounting the sidewalk or landscaped area
conditions: when used as a traffic barrier or edge restraint adjacent to a drivable surface
exceptions: when designed as a mountable curb for specific access points such as driveways or crosswalks

subject: Concrete Curb
rule: concrete curb must have a continuous vertical face or sufficient structural anchorage to resist impact loads from vehicles
conditions: when the curb is located adjacent to a vehicular travel lane
exceptions: when the curb is only decorative and physically separated from traffic by other barriers

subject: Concrete Curb
rule: concrete curb must not have a sharp exposed edge that could cause injury to pedestrians or vehicle tires
conditions: when the curb is in a pedestrian-accessible zone

subject: Road Gutter
rule: road gutter must collect and convey surface runoff from the road pavement
conditions: gutter is installed along a road segment

subject: Road Gutter
rule: road gutter must have a continuous slope toward the outlet or catch basin
conditions: gutter is installed on a graded road
exceptions: gutters on crowned roads that drain to both sides via cross slope only

subject: Road Gutter
rule: road gutter must not have openings or gaps larger than the design maximum that allow vehicles to drop into the gutter
conditions: gutter is adjacent to vehicular travel lanes

subject: Road Gutter
rule: road gutter must not be constructed at a level higher than the adjacent road pavement surface
conditions: gutter is a curb-and-gutter type
gutter abuts the paved roadway

subject: Road Shoulder
rule: road shoulder must provide lateral support to the adjacent pavement or roadway edge
conditions: where road shoulder is present adjacent to a paved roadway
exceptions: road sections with integral curb and gutter that provide structural containment

subject: Road Shoulder
rule: road shoulder must be sloped to drain surface water away from the pavement
conditions: unpaved or paved shoulder adjacent to a roadway
exceptions: shoulders in superelevated curves where drainage is directed across the pavement

subject: Road Shoulder
rule: road shoulder must not have a sustained cross-slope steeper than the adjacent travel lane
conditions: paved shoulder on a high-speed roadway
exceptions: shoulders with a break-over design for emergency parking on steep grades

subject: Road Shoulder
rule: road shoulder width must be sufficient to accommodate stopped vehicles without intruding into the travel lane
conditions: roadway with shoulder used for emergency stopping
exceptions: low-volume local roads where stopping is infrequent and sight distance is adequate

subject: Traffic Signage
rule: traffic signage must have adequate structural support to resist wind loads
conditions: signage is installed outdoors

subject: Traffic Signage
rule: traffic signage must not obstruct driver sight lines or visibility of other traffic control devices
conditions: signage is positioned within or adjacent to a roadway corridor

subject: Traffic Signage
rule: traffic signage must have retroreflective or illuminated faces for nighttime visibility where required by code
conditions: signage is intended for use on public roads with nighttime traffic
exceptions: temporary construction signage used only during daylight hours

subject: Road Pavement Marking
rule: Road pavement marking must be retroreflective to be visible at night under vehicle headlights
conditions: marking is used on roads with nighttime traffic
exceptions: roads with permanent ambient lighting that meets minimum visibility standards
temporary markings for construction zones where supplemental lighting is provided

subject: Road Pavement Marking
rule: Road pavement marking must not be applied to wet or frozen pavement surfaces
conditions: during initial application or curing process
exceptions: markings specifically formulated for application on damp surfaces with manufacturer approval

subject: Road Pavement Marking
rule: Road pavement marking must have a minimum coefficient of skid resistance (friction) to prevent vehicles from slipping on the marking
conditions: marking is applied to road surfaces where vehicles travel at speeds above 30 km/h or where braking is expected

subject: Road Pavement Marking
rule: Road pavement marking must be applied at a dry film thickness within the manufacturer's specified range

subject: Road Drainage Inlet
rule: road drainage inlet must have a positive hydraulic connection to a downstream drainage system or approved outfall
conditions: inlet is connected to a pipe network
stormwater management system is present
exceptions: inlet discharges directly to an approved natural watercourse or channel that meets regulatory requirements

subject: Road Drainage Inlet
rule: road drainage inlet must not have its grating or opening fully blocked by debris, sediment, or pavement
conditions: inlet is in service and expected to capture surface runoff

subject: Road Drainage Inlet
rule: road drainage inlet must have a minimum 0.5% longitudinal grade on the connecting pipe from the inlet to the first manhole or junction
conditions: inlet connects to a piped stormwater system
exceptions: system is designed with siphonic or pumped drainage

subject: Road Drainage Inlet
rule: road drainage inlet must have structural load rating adequate for the traffic class of the road it serves
conditions: inlet is located in a vehicular travel lane or wheel-path area
exceptions: inlet is only in a pedestrian or landscaped area with no vehicle loading

subject: Pedestrian Crosswalk
rule: Pedestrian crosswalk surface must be slip-resistant under expected wet conditions
conditions: crosswalk is exposed to rain or moisture
exceptions: temporary crosswalks for special events where dry conditions are guaranteed

subject: Pedestrian Crosswalk
rule: Pedestrian crosswalk must have a minimum width of at least the width of the designated crosswalk zone as marked (typically 2.5-4 m minimum per standards)
conditions: crosswalk is intended for regular public pedestrian use

subject: Pedestrian Crosswalk
rule: Pedestrian crosswalk must be visibly distinguishable from adjacent roadway surface (e.g., via contrasting markings, texture, or color)

subject: Pedestrian Crosswalk
rule: Pedestrian crosswalk must not have vertical obstacles or abrupt level changes exceeding 6 mm within the crossing path
exceptions: temporary maintenance where alternative safe route is provided

subject: Underground Stormwater Drainage Pipe
rule: underground stormwater drainage pipe must maintain continuous downward slope toward discharge point
conditions: pipe is gravity-fed
no pumping system is used
exceptions: pipe is part of a pressurized/siphonic system with designed lift

subject: Underground Stormwater Drainage Pipe
rule: underground stormwater drainage pipe must be watertight at all joints and connections
exceptions: perforated pipes designed for infiltration/drainage where exfiltration is intentional

subject: Underground Stormwater Drainage Pipe
rule: underground stormwater drainage pipe must have invert elevation below the frost line in cold climates
conditions: climate zone experiences ground freezing

subject: Underground Stormwater Drainage Pipe
rule: underground stormwater drainage pipe must not be installed directly beneath building foundations without protective structural measures
conditions: pipe passes under a load-bearing foundation or footing
exceptions: pipe is encased in a concrete structural sleeve designed to transfer foundation loads

subject: Underground Stormwater Drainage Pipe
rule: underground stormwater drainage pipe must be sized to convey the design storm runoff without surcharging
exceptions: system is explicitly designed as an inline detention/storage facility with controlled outlet

subject: T-Junction Wall Intersection
rule: T-Junction Wall Intersection must have a continuous load path transferring forces from the intersecting wall to the main wall's foundation
conditions: The walls are load-bearing
exceptions: Non-structural partition walls that do not carry vertical loads

subject: T-Junction Wall Intersection
rule: T-Junction Wall Intersection must have adequate connection ties (e.g., mechanical anchors, rebar dowels, or masonry bonding) at the interface between the two walls

subject: T-Junction Wall Intersection
rule: T-Junction Wall Intersection must not have misaligned or discontinuous reinforcement across the joint that creates a plane of weakness
conditions: Reinforced concrete or reinforced masonry construction

subject: T-Junction Corridor
rule: A T-Junction Corridor must provide a clear path of egress in at least two directions (the stem and at least one arm of the T) for emergency evacuation
conditions: The corridor serves as a means of egress
exceptions: The building is a single-occupancy structure with direct exterior exit from every space

subject: T-Junction Corridor
rule: The intersecting corridors at a T-Junction must not form a dead-end corridor longer than the allowable dead-end length per code (typically 20 ft or as adopted locally)
conditions: The corridor is part of a building subject to life safety codes
exceptions: The corridor is sprinklered throughout and local code permits longer dead ends
All spaces served by the dead-end have a second means of egress

subject: T-Junction Corridor
rule: The T-Junction Corridor must have minimum clear width (typically 44 inches for egress corridors, or as adopted by local code)
conditions: The corridor serves as a means of egress serving more than 50 occupants

subject: T-Junction Corner Guard
rule: T-Junction Corner Guard must be installed at all T-junctions of guardrail/handrail systems where a continuous run ends at an intersecting run
conditions: The guardrail or handrail system uses a corner configuration at a T-junction intersection

subject: T-Junction Corner Guard
rule: T-Junction Corner Guard must have all exposed edges and corners deburred or radiused to prevent injury
conditions: The corner guard is exposed to user contact in its installed location

subject: T-Junction Corner Guard
rule: T-Junction Corner Guard must be securely fastened to both intersecting rail runs

subject: T-Junction Corner Guard
rule: T-Junction Corner Guard must not reduce the effective handrail gripping clearance below code minimum
conditions: The corner guard is used on a handrail system

subject: T-Junction Fire Compartment Penetration
rule: A fire compartment penetration at a T-junction must maintain the fire resistance rating of the compartment boundary at the junction point
conditions: The penetration occurs at the intersection of three compartment boundaries forming a T-junction

subject: T-Junction Fire Compartment Penetration
rule: The penetration seal or service passing through the T-junction must not create a continuous cavity that bypasses any of the three compartment boundaries
conditions: The penetration accommodates a service (e.g., pipe, cable, duct) that passes through the T-junction

subject: T-Junction Handrail Termination
rule: handrail must terminate into a wall or post at the T-junction
conditions: handrail forms a T-junction intersection
exceptions: continuous handrail that wraps around the corner without a termination point

subject: T-Junction Handrail Termination
rule: T-junction handrail termination must not have a projecting sharp end or exposed cut edge
conditions: handrail termination occurs at a T-junction
exceptions: termination is fully capped with a smooth, rounded cover or return

subject: T-Junction Handrail Termination
rule: termination of a handrail at a T-junction must be rigidly fastened to the supporting structure
conditions: handrail terminates at a T-junction intersection

subject: T-Junction Accessibility Turning Circle
rule: T-Junction Accessibility Turning Circle must have a minimum turning radius that accommodates the design vehicle (e.g., fire truck, wheelchair, or service vehicle) to prevent the vehicle from mounting the curb or encroaching into opposing lanes
conditions: when the turning circle is intended for vehicular access

subject: T-Junction Accessibility Turning Circle
rule: T-Junction Accessibility Turning Circle must have a clear width free of fixed obstructions (e.g., bollards, poles, trees, signs) throughout the swept path of the design vehicle
exceptions: retractable or breakaway bollards that are designed to yield under vehicle impact

subject: T-Junction Accessibility Turning Circle
rule: T-Junction Accessibility Turning Circle must not have a crossfall or grade exceeding the maximum allowable slope for the design vehicle's stability during a turn
conditions: when the turning circle accommodates wheelchair users or mobility scooters
when the turning circle accommodates heavy vehicles on a superelevated curve

subject: T-Junction Accessibility Turning Circle
rule: T-Junction Accessibility Turning Circle must have a paved or hard-surface finish capable of supporting the design vehicle's wheel loads without rutting or deformation
conditions: when the turning circle is designed for motor vehicles
exceptions: when the turning circle is designed exclusively for pedestrians or manual wheelchairs on soft landscape

subject: Green Street Planting Beds
rule: Green Street Planting Beds must have positive drainage to prevent standing water and root rot
conditions: Planted with non-water-tolerant vegetation
exceptions: Beds designed as constructed wetland or rain garden with water-tolerant species

subject: Green Street Planting Beds
rule: Green Street Planting Beds must have a geotextile filter fabric separation layer between planting soil and underlying subgrade or drainage aggregate
conditions: Bed is adjacent to building foundation or structural subgrade
exceptions: Bed is a fully contained modular planter with impervious liner and no subgrade connection

subject: Green Street Planting Beds
rule: Green Street Planting Beds must not be positioned directly over underground utility lines without adequate clearance and access provisions
conditions: Utility lines exist in the proposed bed footprint
exceptions: Lines are decommissioned and abandoned in place
Bed depth is less than 12 inches (surface planting only) and utilities are deeper than 24 inches with protective marking

subject: Tree Trench Systems
rule: Tree trench system must have a continuous overflow outlet at a height that prevents standing water from reaching tree root crown
conditions: System is installed in a paved or impermeable surface area
Trees are planted within the trench
exceptions: System is designed as an injection/aeration system only with no surface grate

subject: Tree Trench Systems
rule: Tree trench system must not have an impermeable liner or barrier that prevents vertical drainage into the subgrade
conditions: System is intended to infiltrate stormwater into surrounding soil
exceptions: System is designed as a fully contained structural soil vault with sealed bottom for groundwater protection

subject: Tree Trench Systems
rule: Trench excavation bottom must be at least 12 inches above the seasonal high groundwater table
conditions: Native soil has low permeability or seasonally high water table is present

subject: Stormwater Bioretention Cells
rule: Stormwater bioretention cells must have an underdrain system when installed in soils with an infiltration rate below 0.5 inches per hour
conditions: installed in soils with infiltration rate below 0.5 inches per hour
exceptions: cell is designed as a lined system with complete stormwater capture and evapotranspiration only

exceptions: foundation is a precast structural slab designed for simply-supported span action

subject: Raised Walk Decking
rule: raised walk decking must have a minimum structural load capacity for live loads (e.g., 1.9 kN/m² or as per local code)
conditions: when used as an accessible walkway
exceptions: if only decorative and not intended for pedestrian use

subject: Raised Walk Decking
rule: raised walk decking must have slip-resistant surface finish
conditions: when located in exterior or wet-area environment
exceptions: interior decorative-only decking not exposed to moisture

subject: Raised Walk Decking
rule: raised walk decking must have guardrails or handrails where drop height exceeds code threshold (typically >600mm)
conditions: when elevated above adjacent grade by more than 600mm

subject: Raised Walk Decking
rule: raised walk decking must not have standing water accumulation on its surface
conditions: when designed for pedestrian use
exceptions: intentionally designed drainage channels or ponding features

subject: Raised Walk Substructure/Support Frame
rule: raised walk substructure/support frame must transfer all vertical loads to the ground or supporting structure without excessive deformation
conditions: when supporting a raised walkway
under any service load condition
exceptions: temporary construction conditions where controlled settlement is acceptable

subject: Raised Walk Substructure/Support Frame
rule: raised walk substructure/support frame must have a factor of safety against buckling of all compression members
conditions: when any member is in compression

subject: Raised Walk Substructure/Support Frame
rule: raised walk substructure/support frame must not have bolted or welded connections that cannot resist the design loads

subject: Raised Walk Substructure/Support Frame
rule: raised walk substructure/support frame must provide lateral stability (horizontal load resistance) in all directions
exceptions: if the frame is only bracing against an adjacent stable structure that provides all lateral resistance

subject: Raised Walk Handrail/Guardrail
rule: Raised walk handrail/guardrail must have a height between 42 inches (1067 mm) and 48 inches (1219 mm) measured from the walking surface
conditions: walkway is elevated more than 30 inches above adjacent ground or floor

subject: Raised Walk Handrail/Guardrail
rule: Raised walk handrail/guardrail must withstand a concentrated load of at least 200 lb (890 N) applied at any point

subject: Raised Walk Handrail/Guardrail
rule: Raised walk handrail/guardrail must have infill openings that do not permit passage of a 4-inch (102 mm) sphere
conditions: guardrail has balusters or other infill elements

subject: Raised Walk Handrail/Guardrail
rule: Raised walk handrail/guardrail must not have a handrail diameter less than 1.25 inches (32 mm) or greater than 2 inches (51 mm) for circular cross-sections
conditions: handrail is provided as part of the guardrail assembly

subject: Raised Walk Handrail/Guardrail
rule: Raised walk handrail/guardrail must provide continuous grasping surface without obstruction on top or side
conditions: handrail is provided as part of the guardrail assembly
exceptions: newel posts and horizontal extensions at turns

subject: Raised Walk Balustrade
rule: raised walk balustrade must have a top rail that can withstand a horizontal load of at least 0.74 kN/m
conditions: raised walk is accessible to the public
raised walk height exceeds 0.5 m

subject: Raised Walk Balustrade
rule: raised walk balustrade infill must not permit passage of a sphere of diameter 100 mm or larger
conditions: raised walk height exceeds 0.5 m

subject: Raised Walk Balustrade
rule: raised walk balustrade must have a minimum height of 1.1 m measured from the walking surface
conditions: raised walk height exceeds 0.5 m
exceptions: private single-family dwellings where local code may permit 0.9 m

subject: Raised Walk Balustrade
rule: raised walk balustrade must be continuous except at permitted gaps such as stair stringers or structural columns
exceptions: interruptions required by the structure itself (e.g., columns, posts)

subject: Raised Walk Stair/Step Access
rule: raised walk stair/step access must have a minimum tread depth adequate for safe foot placement
conditions: when intended for pedestrian use
exceptions: when stairs are part of emergency egress only and are marked as not for general use

subject: Raised Walk Stair/Step Access
rule: raised walk stair/step access must have riser heights that are consistent within a flight
conditions: when the assembly includes two or more consecutive steps

subject: Raised Walk Stair/Step Access
rule: raised walk stair/step access must not have a riser height exceeding 7 inches (178 mm) for standard pedestrian access
conditions: when serving general building occupant egress or日常 access
exceptions: private residences or spaces not open to the public may have local code variations

subject: Raised Walk Stair/Step Access
rule: raised walk stair/step access must have a minimum clear width adequate for occupant egress
conditions: when serving as part of a means of egress

subject: Raised Walk Stair/Step Access
rule: raised walk stair/step access must have slip-resistant tread surfaces
conditions: when exposed to weather or wet conditions
exceptions: when the stair is interior-only and surface material provides adequate friction inherently

subject: Raised Walk Stair/Step Access
rule: raised walk stair/step access must have a handrail when the total rise exceeds 30 inches (762 mm)
conditions: when serving general occupant access

subject: Raised Walk Ramp Access
rule: Raised walk ramp access must have a minimum slope of 1:20 (5%) for drainage
