conditions: Outdoor installation
Exposed to precipitation
exceptions: Ramp is located in a covered/enclosed area with no drainage exposure

subject: Raised Walk Ramp Access
rule: Raised walk ramp access must have a slip-resistant surface

subject: Raised Walk Ramp Access
rule: Raised walk ramp access must have handrails on both sides if the rise exceeds 6 inches (150 mm)
conditions: Rise greater than 6 inches
exceptions: Ramp serves only maintenance/non-public access with administrative controls prohibiting use by persons with mobility impairments

subject: Raised Walk Ramp Access
rule: Raised walk ramp access must not have a running slope steeper than 1:12 (8.33%)
conditions: Ramp is intended for public pedestrian use or ADA compliance
exceptions: Existing site constraints where equivalent facilitation is provided via alternate accessible route

subject: Raised Walk Ramp Access
rule: Raised walk ramp access must have edge protection (curbs, walls, or railings) along open sides to prevent wheel-off
conditions: Drop-off adjacent to ramp edge exceeds 4 inches
Ramp is open-sided
exceptions: Ramp is flush with adjacent surface at same elevation

subject: Raised Walk Ramp Access
rule: Raised walk ramp access must not have cross slope exceeding 1:50 (2%)

subject: Raised Walk Expansion Joint
rule: A raised walk expansion joint must allow for differential thermal movement between connected walk segments
conditions: When connecting two separate walkway segments

subject: Raised Walk Expansion Joint
rule: A raised walk expansion joint must prevent water ingress into the joint cavity
conditions: Exposed to outdoor weather conditions

subject: Raised Walk Expansion Joint
rule: A raised walk expansion joint must not create a tripping hazard exceeding code-allowable height differential
conditions: Installed in pedestrian walkway

subject: Raised Walk Foundation/Footing
rule: Raised walk foundation/footing must bear on undisturbed soil or engineered fill with adequate bearing capacity
conditions: when supporting any raised walk structure
exceptions: when foundation is designed as a pile or pier system extending to competent bearing stratum

subject: Raised Walk Foundation/Footing
rule: Raised walk foundation/footing must be placed below frost depth
conditions: in climates where seasonal ground freezing occurs
when the walk is intended for year-round use without frost heave damage
exceptions: when foundation is designed to accommodate frost heave (e.g., frost-protected shallow foundation with insulation)

subject: Raised Walk Foundation/Footing
rule: Raised walk foundation/footing must not be constructed on organic soils, uncompacted fill, or debris without removal or stabilization
conditions: when the bearing stratum directly under the footing includes such materials
exceptions: when geotechnical analysis confirms that the material can be stabilized or the footing can be deepened or widened to achieve acceptable bearing capacity

subject: Raised Walk Foundation/Footing
rule: Raised walk foundation/footing must be reinforced to resist tensile stresses from bending and temperature changes
conditions: when the footing is constructed of cast-in-place concrete or masonry
and spans between supports or is subject to soil movement
exceptions: when a specifically engineered mass-gravity section is designed without tension reinforcement and has been analyzed for crack control

subject: Raised Walk Anti-Slip Surface Treatment
rule: raised walk anti-slip surface treatment must have a coefficient of friction (COF) ≥ 0.5 under wet conditions
conditions: surface is used as an exterior walking surface
surface is exposed to rain or moisture
exceptions: surface is designated as a temporary construction walkway with restricted access and signage

subject: Raised Walk Anti-Slip Surface Treatment
rule: raised walk anti-slip surface treatment must not have standing water or ponding on the walking surface
conditions: surface is installed outdoors or in a wet-area environment
exceptions: surface is designed as a drainage plank with intentional gaps for water passage

subject: Raised Walk Anti-Slip Surface Treatment
rule: raised walk anti-slip surface treatment must be resistant to UV degradation for the intended service life
conditions: material contains polymer, elastomer, or resin components
surface is exposed to direct sunlight
exceptions: surface is covered by a permanent canopy or roof

subject: Elevated Timber Walkway
rule: walkway surface must have a load-bearing capacity sufficient for intended pedestrian or maintenance loads
conditions: when designed for public access or maintenance vehicle access

subject: Elevated Timber Walkway
rule: walkway must have guardrails or edge barriers on open sides above a threshold height
conditions: when elevated more than 30 inches / 760 mm above adjacent ground or surface
when sides are not bounded by a wall or structure
exceptions: guardrails are not required if the walkway is not intended for public or occupant use and access is restricted

subject: Elevated Timber Walkway
rule: timber components must be preservative-treated or naturally durable to resist decay and insect attack
conditions: when exposed to weather or in contact with ground
exceptions: timber species with natural durability (e.g., black locust, certain tropical hardwoods) may not require chemical treatment

subject: Elevated Timber Walkway
rule: walkway must not have an impermeable continuous surface that traps moisture on the timber
conditions: when the walkway is fully exposed to rain

subject: Elevated Timber Walkway
rule: walkway dead and live loads must be fully transferred to supporting structure or ground without exceeding member capacities

subject: Elevated Steel Grating Walkway
rule: Elevated Steel Grating Walkway must have load-rated structural supports capable of sustaining design live load plus dead load
conditions: when used for personnel access
when used for equipment access

subject: Elevated Steel Grating Walkway
rule: Elevated Steel Grating Walkway must not have open grating openings larger than 1 inch (25 mm) in the direction of pedestrian travel
conditions: when used for pedestrian access
exceptions: when guarded by a secondary mesh or screen beneath the grating that prevents foot penetration

subject: Elevated Steel Grating Walkway
rule: Elevated Steel Grating Walkway must have guardrails on open sides where drop exceeds 30 inches (760 mm)
conditions: when drop height below walkway exceeds 30 inches
exceptions: when the walkway is atop a structure where equivalent fall protection is provided by another means (e.g., parapet wall, safety net system)

subject: Elevated Steel Grating Walkway
rule: Elevated Steel Grating Walkway must have a slip-resistant surface
conditions: when exposed to wet, oily, or icy conditions
exceptions: when walkway is in a climate-controlled interior environment with no foreseeable wet or contaminant exposure

subject: Roof-Level Raised Walk
rule: Roof-level raised walk must have a minimum clear width of at least 3 feet (0.91 m) to allow safe pedestrian passage and emergency egress
conditions: Walk is intended for pedestrian use
Walk is means of egress
exceptions: Walk is restricted to maintenance access only with no general occupancy

subject: Roof-Level Raised Walk
rule: Roof-level raised walk must have continuous handrails where the walking surface is elevated more than 30 inches above the adjacent roof surface
conditions: Walk elevation exceeds 30 inches above adjacent roof surface
exceptions: Walk is less than 30 inches above adjacent surface
Walk serves only maintenance personnel and is not a general-occupancy path

subject: Roof-Level Raised Walk
rule: Roof-level raised walk must not have standing water in any area where walking occurs
exceptions: Temporary pooling during active rainfall that drains within 15 minutes

subject: Roof-Level Raised Walk
rule: Roof-level raised walk must have a slip-resistant walking surface
conditions: Walk is exposed to weather (rain, snow, ice)
exceptions: Walk is fully enclosed and weather-protected

subject: Bicycle Shelter/Canopy
rule: roof must have a drainage path
conditions: shelter has a solid roof panel
exceptions: roof is fully permeable (e.g., open mesh or slatted louvers that do not pond water)

subject: Bicycle Shelter/Canopy
rule: structure must resist overturning from wind loads
conditions: shelter is freestanding and not attached to a larger building

subject: Bicycle Shelter/Canopy
rule: ground-contact post bases must be corrosion-resistant or isolated from moisture
conditions: posts embed in or rest on the ground
exceptions: posts are designed as sacrificial elements intended for periodic replacement

subject: Bicycle Shelter/Canopy
rule: shelter must not block required egress or emergency vehicle access
conditions: shelter is located within a path of travel, near a building exit, or on a fire lane

subject: Bicycle Repair Station
rule: bicycle repair station must have a stable, level base or foundation to prevent tipping during use
conditions: station is freestanding
station is anchored to ground or pavement
exceptions: station is integrated into a wall or other permanent structure that provides stability

subject: Bicycle Repair Station
rule: bicycle repair station must have tools securely attached or tethered to prevent theft
conditions: station is in a public or unstaffed location
exceptions: station is inside a staffed bike shop where tools are checked out by an attendant

subject: Bicycle Repair Station
rule: bicycle repair station must not have sharp edges or protrusions at user contact points

subject: Bike Path Pavement
rule: bike path pavement must have a minimum thickness to support expected bicycle loads
conditions: pavement is subject to bicycle traffic

subject: Bike Path Pavement
rule: bike path pavement must have a cross-slope for water drainage
conditions: pavement is exposed to rainfall
exceptions: pavement is designed with permeable materials that drain vertically

subject: Bike Path Pavement
rule: bike path pavement must not have abrupt vertical discontinuities exceeding a safe threshold

subject: Bike Path Curb/Edge Restraint
rule: bike path curb/edge restraint must have a minimum height differential from the adjacent bike path surface
conditions: when installed adjacent to a bike path
exceptions: flush-mounted curb designs specifically intended for shared-use surfaces

subject: Bike Path Curb/Edge Restraint
rule: bike path curb/edge restraint must not have sharp exposed edges or protrusions facing the bike path
conditions: where cyclist contact is possible

subject: Bike Path Curb/Edge Restraint
rule: bike path curb/edge restraint must be structurally continuous to prevent gaps wider than the design maximum
conditions: when used as a wheel-stop or lateral guide
exceptions: drainage gaps explicitly detailed to be narrow enough to prevent wheel entry

subject: Bike Path Bollard
rule: bollard must be securely anchored to prevent displacement under impact
conditions: installed on bike path

subject: Bike Path Bollard
rule: bollard must not create an entrapment hazard for cyclists
conditions: used as a gate or removable bollard with moving parts

subject: Bike Path Bollard
rule: bollard must have minimum height and visibility to be noticed by approaching cyclists
conditions: installed on active bike path

subject: Bike Path Lighting
rule: Bike path lighting must be weather-sealed to at least IP65 ingress protection rating
conditions: installed outdoors on a bike path
exceptions: lighting installed in fully enclosed tunnels with controlled environment

subject: Bike Path Lighting
rule: Bike path lighting must not emit glare that exceeds recommended threshold for cyclists and pedestrians
conditions: mounted along shared-use bike paths used by cyclists and pedestrians

subject: Bike Path Lighting
rule: Bike path lighting must have a minimum mounting height that prevents collision with cyclists and pedestrians
conditions: mounted on poles or structures adjacent to the bike path
exceptions: bollard-style path lights designed for ground-level installation that are impact-tested and yield on collision

subject: Bike Path Drainage System
rule: bike path drainage system must have an unobstructed outlet path for collected water
conditions: system is installed
system collects water

subject: Bike Path Drainage System
rule: bike path drainage system must not have a continuous slope that directs water toward the bike path surface
conditions: system is adjacent to or integrated with a bike path

subject: Bike Path Drainage System
rule: bike path drainage system must have a minimum longitudinal slope to maintain gravity flow
conditions: system relies on gravity flow
no mechanical pumping is provided
exceptions: system uses a sealed pressurized pipe network with pumping

subject: Bicycle Wash Station
rule: Bicycle Wash Station must have a water supply connection with backflow prevention
conditions: If the wash station is plumbed with a permanent water supply
exceptions: Manual-fill systems using a bucket or non-pressurized container

subject: Bicycle Wash Station
rule: Bicycle Wash Station must have a wash water capture and containment system
conditions: If the wash station is located in an area where wash water cannot drain to a sanitary sewer or approved treatment system
exceptions: Locations where wash water is explicitly permitted to drain to ground by local environmental authority

subject: Bicycle Wash Station
rule: Bicycle Wash Station must have a slip-resistant floor surface
conditions: If the station includes a standing area where users wash bicycles

subject: Bicycle Wash Station
rule: Bicycle Wash Station must not have electrical outlets or switches within reach of the wash area without GFCI protection
conditions: If the wash station has any electrical components within 6 feet of the wash or spray zone
exceptions: Battery-operated, low-voltage systems with sealed enclosures rated for wet locations

subject: Child-Safe Circulation Routes
rule: All circulation routes that are designated as child-safe must be completely separated from vehicle traffic paths, with no at-grade crossings
conditions: The building or site has vehicular traffic routes

subject: Child-Safe Circulation Routes
rule: Handrails and guardrails on child-safe circulation routes must have vertical infill elements spaced no more than 100 mm apart to prevent a child's body or head from passing through
conditions: The route includes stairways, ramps, or elevated walkways with a drop of more than 600 mm

subject: Child-Safe Circulation Routes
rule: Child-safe circulation routes must not include any gaps, openings, or holes in the walking surface larger than 10 mm in the smallest dimension

subject: Child-Safe Circulation Routes
rule: All child-safe circulation routes must have a minimum clear width of 1200 mm

subject: Children's Playroom
rule: Children's playroom floor must be impact-absorbent (e.g., cushioned, rubber, or soft matting) under play equipment
conditions: play equipment (e.g., climbing structures, slides) is installed
exceptions: room is designated only for seated activities (e.g., reading, board games) and contains no climbing or jumping fixtures

subject: Children's Playroom
rule: Children's playroom must have electrical outlets covered with tamper-resistant safety caps or receptacles
conditions: electrical outlets are present within reach of children (typically below 1.5 m)
exceptions: outlets are installed above 1.5 m and inaccessible to children without climbing

subject: Children's Playroom
rule: Children's playroom must not have windows below 0.6 m from the floor without safety glazing or window fall protection
conditions: windows are present in the playroom
exceptions: windows are fixed (non-operable) and fitted with safety glazing and window guards or stops limiting opening to less than 100 mm

subject: Children's Playroom
rule: Children's playroom must have unobstructed egress path to exit without passing through another high-risk area
conditions: the playroom is occupied by children
exceptions: the room has a direct door to exterior at grade level

subject: Children's Playroom
rule: Children's playroom must not have sharp corners or protrusions on built-in fixtures below 1.2 m
conditions: built-in fixtures (e.g., shelves, cabinets, window sills) are present
exceptions: sharp corners are covered with cushioned edge guards

subject: Integrated Child-Scale Seating
rule: Integrated Child-Scale Seating must be structurally capable of supporting a child's weight without collapsing or deforming
conditions: when intended for seating use by a child
exceptions: decorative-only seating intended never to bear weight

subject: Integrated Child-Scale Seating
rule: Integrated Child-Scale Seating must have no sharp edges, pinch points, or protruding fasteners in areas reachable by a child occupant
conditions: when the seating is accessible to children during normal use

subject: Integrated Child-Scale Seating
rule: Integrated Child-Scale Seating must not have openings that could entrap a child's head or limbs
conditions: when the seating is designed for children under typical child-safety age ranges

subject: Integrated Child-Scale Seating
rule: Integrated Child-Scale Seating must be stable against tipping when a child sits, stands, or climbs on it
conditions: when the seating is a standalone or partially supported element (not fully integrated into a larger stable mass)

subject: Child-Helght Counter/Desk
rule: The counter/desk top surface must be at a height accessible to a child (e.g., between approximately 20–30 inches / 508–762 mm from the floor)
conditions: The counter/desk is intended for use by children
exceptions: Adjustable-height designs that can be raised later for adult use

subject: Child-Helght Counter/Desk
rule: The counter/desk must not have sharp corners or edges at the child's height zone that could cause injury upon impact
conditions: The counter/desk is in a location where children can walk or run near it
The child user is within the typical age range of 2–10 years
exceptions: Rounded or radiused edges (≥ 3 mm radius) are acceptable

subject: Built-in Toy/Book Shelving
rule: built-in toy/book shelving must be securely anchored to wall structure
conditions: shelving is freestanding taller than 30 inches
shelving is in a seismic zone or child-occupied space
exceptions: shelving is low-height (≤30 inches) and designed as a floor-mounted base unit without tipping risk

subject: Built-in Toy/Book Shelving
rule: built-in toy/book shelving must not have shelves that exceed the manufacturer-specified or structurally calculated load capacity
conditions: shelving is designed or marketed for toy/book storage

subject: Built-in Toy/Book Shelving
rule: built-in toy/book shelving must have a smooth or rounded edge profile on all exposed corners and edges accessible to children
conditions: shelving is installed in a space accessible to children under 6 years old
exceptions: shelving is installed in a locked or otherwise inaccessible childproof area

subject: Childproof Safety Glazing
rule: Childproof safety glazing must comply with impact safety standards (e.g., ANSI Z97.1, CPSC 16 CFR 1201, or EN 12600) to prevent shattering upon human impact
conditions: Where glazing is installed in locations subject to human impact (e.g., doors, side lights, low windows, bathtub and shower enclosures)
exceptions: Laminated glass or wired glass assemblies that are tested and certified to an equivalent impact safety standard

subject: Childproof Safety Glazing
rule: Childproof safety glazing must_not contain or release lead, cadmium, or other heavy metals in concentrations that exceed regulatory safe limits for children
exceptions: Trace contaminant levels below applicable regulatory thresholds (e.g., CPSIA limits)

subject: Childproof Safety Glazing
rule: Childproof safety glazing must resist breakage under a minimum impact force equivalent to a child running into it, without producing sharp-edged fragments
exceptions: Glazing that is fully protected by a permanent barrier (e.g., guardrail) that prevents human contact with the glass surface

subject: Child-Height Door Hardware
rule: Child-height door hardware must be reachable by children without requiring a step stool or climbing aid
conditions: hardware is intended for child use
hardware is installed in a location accessible to children
exceptions: hardware is in a restricted area where children are never present

subject: Child-Height Door Hardware
rule: Child-height door hardware must not have pinch points or sharp edges within the reach zone of small fingers
conditions: hardware is within 48 inches (122 cm) of the floor

subject: Child-Height Door Hardware
rule: Child-height door hardware must not require fine motor grip strength exceeding a 5-year-old's typical capability
conditions: hardware is intended for independent operation by children
exceptions: hardware is specifically designed as a safety lock that adults must operate

subject: Guardrail/Barrier System for Children
rule: guardrail/barrier system for children must have vertical balusters or mesh infill with no horizontal climbing surfaces
conditions: barrier height exceeds 24 inches (610 mm)
exceptions: barrier uses smooth non-climbable surface such as glass

subject: Guardrail/Barrier System for Children
rule: guardrail/barrier system for children must not allow passage of a 4-inch (100 mm) sphere through any opening
exceptions: barrier serves a secondary decorative function in an area not accessible to children under 6 years old

subject: Guardrail/Barrier System for Children
rule: guardrail/barrier system for children must resist a concentrated static load of at least 200 lbf (890 N) applied horizontally at any point

subject: Guardrail/Barrier System for Children
rule: guardrail/barrier system for children must not have sharp edges, protruding hardware, or pinch points on any accessible surface

subject: Child Activity Room Partition
rule: Child Activity Room Partition must have a minimum fire-resistance rating of 1 hour when serving as an occupancy separation between a child activity room and an adjacent space in a building required to have fire-resistance-rated separations
conditions: When the partition separates a child activity room from an adjacent occupancy
When required by applicable building code (e.g., IBC Section 420, 422) based on building type and occupant load
exceptions: When no fire-resistance rating is required by code because the building is sprinklered throughout and the code allows reduction
When the partition is not acting as an occupancy separation (e.g., interior non-separating wall within the same occupancy)

subject: Child Activity Room Partition
rule: Child Activity Room Partition must not have any operable opening or gap larger than 4 inches within 18 inches of the floor that could allow a child's body or head to become entrapped
conditions: When the partition is located in a space serving children under 5 years of age
When the partition contains panels, doors, or fixed glazing with openings
exceptions: When the partition is entirely above 5 feet in height and children cannot access it
When the partition is not in a child-accessible area

subject: Child Activity Room Partition
rule: Child Activity Room Partition must be constructed of materials that comply with Class A (Class I) interior finish flame spread and smoke development requirements
conditions: When the partition surface is exposed within the child activity room
When required by applicable building and fire codes for child-occupied facilities
exceptions: When the partition is entirely concealed behind another finish that meets the code requirements

subject: Child-Zone Acoustic Treatment
rule: Child-Zone Acoustic Treatment must achieve a minimum Sound Transmission Class (STC) rating consistent with the required acoustic separation between the child zone and adjacent spaces
conditions: When used in interior partitions, floors/ceilings, or any building assembly separating a child-occupied space from other occupancies
exceptions: Spaces where no acoustic privacy or noise control is required by code or program

subject: Child-Zone Acoustic Treatment
rule: Child-Zone Acoustic Treatment must not introduce combustible or toxic materials that violate fire-resistance ratings of the assembly in which it is installed
conditions: When installed within or upon a fire-resistance-rated assembly (wall, floor, ceiling, or enclosure) serving a child-occupancy space
exceptions: Materials specifically approved via fire testing and code-compliant encapsulation or fire-protective covering

subject: Carnival Structure / Enclosure
rule: enclosure must resist wind loads for temporary installation
conditions: structure is exposed to outdoor wind
exceptions: enclosure is fully indoor with no wind exposure

subject: Carnival Structure / Enclosure
rule: enclosure must have a means of egress that remains operable
conditions: structure is occupied by people
exceptions: enclosure is never occupied during operation

subject: Carnival Structure / Enclosure
rule: structural frame must not use materials that degrade rapidly under UV or moisture exposure without protective treatment
conditions: structure is used outdoors for multiple days or seasons
exceptions: single-day indoor use
materials are specifically rated for outdoor temporary use per manufacturer specifications

subject: Carnival Structure / Enclosure
rule: enclosure must be anchored or ballasted to resist uplift and overturning
conditions: enclosure has a roof or top surface exposed to wind
exceptions: enclosure is attached to a permanent structure that provides equivalent restraint

subject: Child-Safe Electrical Outlet System
rule: child-safe electrical outlet system must have shutter mechanisms that close automatically when no plug is inserted
conditions: outlet is not in use

subject: Child-Safe Electrical Outlet System
rule: child-safe electrical outlet system must not allow a single foreign object (e.g., paperclip, key) to access live electrical contacts

subject: Child-Safe Electrical Outlet System
rule: child-safe electrical outlet system must comply with applicable national safety standard (e.g., UL 498, NFPA 70, or equivalent)
exceptions: outlet is not intended for sale or installation in jurisdictions that enforce these standards

subject: Carnival Stage / Performance Platform
rule: stage platform must have a load-bearing capacity sufficient for expected performers and equipment
conditions: when occupied during performances
exceptions: non-occupied decorative platforms

subject: Carnival Stage / Performance Platform
rule: stage must not have unguarded edges above a drop height that could cause fall injury
conditions: when elevated more than 0.5 m above surrounding grade
exceptions: edges used as performer access points with controlled egress

subject: Carnival Stage / Performance Platform
rule: stage platform surface must be slip-resistant under anticipated weather conditions
conditions: outdoor carnival stage exposed to rain or moisture
exceptions: indoor or covered stages not subject to moisture

subject: Carnival Stage / Performance Platform
rule: stage must have a clear egress path for performers in an emergency

subject: Carnival Stage / Performance Platform
rule: overhead structure (roof/canopy/suspension) must withstand wind uplift forces
conditions: when a roof, canopy, or overhead rigging is present
exceptions: fully open stage with no overhead elements

subject: Ticket Booth / Entry Kiosk
rule: must have a ticket transaction opening (window/hatch) for customer-facing operation
conditions: staffed operation
customer service function
exceptions: fully automated/unattended kiosk with no human staff

subject: Ticket Booth / Entry Kiosk
rule: must have a secure lockable door for staff entry/exit separate from the customer window
conditions: staffed booth
exceptions: extremely small temporary kiosks (e.g., festival tent with single flap)

subject: Ticket Booth / Entry Kiosk
rule: must have a weather-resistant enclosure (water can penetrate neither through openings nor through the envelope)
conditions: outdoor installation
exceptions: indoor kiosks under conditioned roof

subject: Ticket Booth / Entry Kiosk
rule: customer-facing counter height must be within 1000–1200 mm from finished floor
conditions: staffed booth where staff are seated
exceptions: standing-only kiosk (e.g., concert gate)
wheelchair-accessible lowered counter variant

subject: Concession Stand / Food Counter
rule: Concession stand / food counter must have a hand-washing sink with potable water supply
conditions: Used for handling unpackaged food
exceptions: Pre-packaged food-only sales where no food handling occurs

subject: Concession Stand / Food Counter
rule: All food-contact surfaces of the concession counter must be made of smooth, non-porous, easily cleanable material
conditions: Surfaces that contact food directly

subject: Concession Stand / Food Counter
rule: Concession stand must not have floor drains that are lower than the sanitary sewer backflow level unless equipped with backflow preventer
conditions: Indoor or covered permanent concession stand with plumbing
exceptions: Temporary / mobile units without permanent plumbing connection

subject: Concession Stand / Food Counter
rule: Hot-holding equipment for food must maintain internal food temperature at or above 57°C (135°F)
conditions: Equipment used to hold hot prepared food
exceptions: Equipment used only for cold-holding or dry storage

subject: Carnival Game Booth Structure
rule: structure must be stable against overturning from lateral wind loads
conditions: outdoor installation
booth has vertical surfaces (walls or backdrops) that catch wind
exceptions: indoor carnival installations with no wind exposure

subject: Carnival Game Booth Structure
rule: ground-contact surfaces must be level and stable to prevent tripping or rocking
conditions: booth is placed on any walking surface

subject: Carnival Game Booth Structure
rule: all structural members (frames, legs, cross-braces) must not have sharp edges or protrusions at heights accessible to users
conditions: booth is accessible to the public
exceptions: fasteners deliberately recessed or covered

subject: Carnival Game Booth Structure
rule: floor surface within the player zone must be slip-resistant
conditions: booth includes an interior standing area for players

subject: Carnival Game Booth Structure
rule: canopy or roof structure must not collapse under its own weight plus expected snow or rain load
conditions: booth has a canopy/roof
outdoor installation
exceptions: indoor installation where no snow/rain load applies

subject: Carnival Game Booth Structure
rule: electrical wiring within the booth structure must be protected from abrasion and pinching
conditions: booth includes electrical components (lighting, game electronics)
exceptions: battery-only booth with no wired power distribution

subject: Ride Foundation / Anchor
rule: Ride foundation / anchor must be embedded in or bear on undisturbed native soil or engineered fill with adequate bearing capacity
conditions: foundation type is shallow (spread footing or mat)
exceptions: deep foundations (piles, caissons) transfer load to deeper strata

subject: Ride Foundation / Anchor
rule: Ride foundation / anchor must not experience net uplift exceeding its weight plus any mechanical anchorage capacity
conditions: ride includes inversion, high-speed turns, or portions where occupants are inverted
exceptions: foundation is designed with tension piles or rock anchors specifically rated for the calculated uplift force

subject: Ride Foundation / Anchor
rule: Ride foundation / anchor must resist overturning moment without exceeding factor of safety
conditions: structure is tall or top-heavy relative to its footprint

subject: Ride Foundation / Anchor
rule: Ride foundation / anchor concrete must achieve minimum specified compressive strength before ride loads are applied
conditions: foundation is cast-in-place reinforced concrete

subject: Ride Foundation / Anchor
rule: Ride foundation / anchor anchor bolts must be installed to manufacturer-specified torque and embedment depth
conditions: ride structure is mechanically bolted to the foundation

subject: Carnival Seating / Spectator Area
rule: seating / spectator area must have a means of egress (exits) that meets minimum width and number requirements based on occupant load
conditions: occupied by more than 50 persons

subject: Carnival Seating / Spectator Area
rule: seating rake or tiered platforms must be structurally stable under live load (occupant weight)
conditions: bleachers or tiered seating are used
exceptions: flat-ground seating without any raised platform

subject: Carnival Seating / Spectator Area
rule: temporary or portable seating units must be secured against overturning or lateral movement
conditions: seating is not fixed to the ground or structure

subject: Carnival Seating / Spectator Area
rule: seating area must not have tripping hazards in egress paths (e.g., unmarked steps, loose cables)
conditions: egress pathways exist through the seating area

subject: Carnival Seating / Spectator Area
rule: fireworks or open flame must not be located within the spectator seating area
conditions: carnival includes pyrotechnics or open-flame attractions
exceptions: professional pyrotechnics with approved safety zone and barriers separating spectators

subject: Carnival Enclosure Curtain / Partition
rule: curtain/partition must be wind-resistant to prevent collapse or dangerous flapping under expected wind loads
conditions: when used outdoors as an enclosure or partition
exceptions: when used only indoors in a fully sheltered environment

subject: Carnival Enclosure Curtain / Partition
rule: curtain/partition must be fire-resistant to not propagate flame
conditions: when used in an assembly/occupancy setting with public access

subject: Carnival Enclosure Curtain / Partition
rule: curtain/partition must not obstruct emergency egress paths
conditions: when installed as a room divider or enclosure near exit routes
exceptions: when the curtain can be instantly opened/removed and is clearly marked

subject: Carnival Barricade / Queue Railing
rule: queue railing must have a minimum clear width for passage to allow pedestrian flow
conditions: when used as a queue railing at entry or service points
exceptions: decorative-only barricades not intended for queuing

subject: Carnival Barricade / Queue Railing
rule: carnival barricade must be stable against overturning under horizontal crowd loads
conditions: when installed in a deployed configuration
exceptions: barricades secured by ground anchors or fixed structures

subject: Carnival Barricade / Queue Railing
rule: queue railing must not have sharp edges or protrusions at hand-contact height
conditions: when within reach of the public, typically below 2.1 m

subject: Sound-Attenuating Partition
rule: Sound-attenuating partition must have a minimum STC (Sound Transmission Class) rating of at least 35 when installed between occupiable rooms
conditions: installed between two occupiable rooms requiring acoustic privacy
exceptions: storage rooms, mechanical rooms, or other non-occupiable spaces

subject: Sound-Attenuating Partition
rule: Sound-attenuating partition must be continuous from finished floor to finished ceiling or structural deck without gaps
exceptions: where a fire-rated smoke seal or acoustic seal is explicitly detailed as an alternative continuity method

subject: Sound-Attenuating Partition
rule: Sound-attenuating partition must not have rigid mechanical connections (e.g., hard conduit, ductwork) bridging both sides
conditions: when electrical or mechanical penetrations are present
exceptions: flexible acoustic-rated boots or vibration isolation connectors are used

subject: Sound-Attenuating Partition
rule: Sound-attenuating partition must have a minimum mass per unit area sufficient to achieve the design STC target
conditions: when relying on mass-law attenuation rather than a tuned resonant or absorptive assembly
exceptions: specially engineered double-stud or staggered-stud assemblies with decoupled layers where mass is reduced through other acoustic design strategies

subject: Acoustic Door Assembly
rule: acoustic door assembly must have acoustic seals (gaskets) on all four edges of the door leaf
conditions: when rated for sound transmission class (STC) performance
exceptions: automatic sliding doors where perimeter seals are replaced by brush or drop seals at jamb and head

subject: Acoustic Door Assembly
rule: acoustic door assembly must not have through-openings (e.g., gaps, unfilled cutouts, or missing seals) that breach the acoustic barrier
conditions: when the assembly is specified for a sound-rated application
exceptions: intentional acoustic louvers or transfer grilles specifically designed and rated for the required STC

subject: Acoustic Door Assembly
rule: acoustic door assembly must have a minimum STC rating that meets or exceeds the specified requirement for the partition it is installed in
conditions: when installed in a rated wall or partition assembly

subject: Acoustic Door Assembly
rule: acoustic door frame must be structurally reinforced to prevent deflection that breaks the acoustic seal under door operation
conditions: for any acoustic door assembly with perimeter gaskets or seals

subject: Integrated Seating Nook
rule: integrated seating nook must have a load-bearing structure that supports the combined weight of occupants and the nook itself

subject: Integrated Seating Nook
rule: integrated seating nook must not block emergency egress paths
conditions: when located in or adjacent to a means of egress
exceptions: if the nook is designed to be removable or collapsible to maintain clear egress width during an emergency

subject: Integrated Seating Nook
rule: integrated seating nook must have a minimum clear floor area that complies with applicable accessibility standards
conditions: when the nook is in a publicly accessible or common area
exceptions: when the nook serves a private dwelling unit only and local code exempts accessible route requirements within dwelling units

subject: Reception/Information Counter
rule: Reception/information counter must have a clear sightline to the main entrance or waiting area
conditions: counter is positioned in a lobby or entrance hall
exceptions: counter is in a ticketing hall where orientation is handled by signage

subject: Reception/Information Counter
rule: Reception/information counter must have a clear approach path free of obstructions
exceptions: temporary event setup where the counter is intentionally placed behind a barrier

subject: Reception/Information Counter
rule: Reception/information counter must_not be positioned where it blocks required egress paths

subject: Reception/Information Counter
rule: Reception/information counter work surface height must be between 700 mm and 1100 mm from finished floor
conditions: counter is intended for standing or seated staff use
exceptions: counter is purely decorative or non-operational

subject: Acoustic Glazing Assembly
rule: acoustic glazing assembly must achieve a minimum weighted sound reduction index (Rw) of 30 dB
conditions: when the assembly is rated for acoustic performance
when the assembly is installed in a noise-sensitive boundary condition
exceptions: when the assembly is used only as a secondary or decorative layer with no acoustic requirement

subject: Acoustic Glazing Assembly
rule: acoustic glazing assembly must have a minimum interpane air gap of 6 mm when configured as double glazing
conditions: when the assembly is a sealed double-glazed unit
exceptions: when the assembly uses laminated glass only without an air gap
when the unit is a triple-glazed assembly with different geometry

subject: Acoustic Glazing Assembly
rule: acoustic glazing assembly must not have panes of identical thickness
conditions: when the assembly consists of multiple glass panes in a sealed unit
exceptions: when a laminated pane is paired with another laminated pane of asymmetrical layer composition achieving equivalent mass mismatch

subject: Accessible Ramp
rule: accessible ramp must have a slope between 1:12 (8.33%) and 1:20 (5%) for the running slope
conditions: ramp is for general pedestrian use
ramp serves a change in elevation
exceptions: ramps serving dwelling units or spaces not required to be accessible may exceed 1:12 slope if permitted by local code

subject: Accessible Ramp
rule: accessible ramp must have landings at top and bottom that are at least as wide as the ramp and a minimum length of 60 inches (1524 mm)
conditions: ramp has a rise greater than zero

subject: Accessible Ramp
rule: accessible ramp must have handrails on both sides if the rise exceeds 6 inches (152 mm) or the horizontal projection exceeds 72 inches (1830 mm)
conditions: ramp is for general pedestrian use
ramp is not located within a dwelling unit
exceptions: ramps at curbs or existing site constraints where handrails would obstruct necessary clearances may be exempt per local authority

subject: Accessible Ramp
rule: accessible ramp must not have a cross slope greater than 1:48 (2%)
conditions: ramp surface is exposed to weather or drainage requirements apply

subject: Accessible Ramp
rule: accessible ramp must have a clear width of at least 36 inches (915 mm) between handrails or curb faces
conditions: ramp serves as an accessible route

subject: Accessible Route
rule: accessible route must have a minimum clear width of 36 inches (915 mm)
exceptions: At doors, clear width may be reduced to 32 inches (815 mm) for a maximum depth of 24 inches

subject: Accessible Route
rule: accessible route must have a maximum running slope of 1:20 (5%)
exceptions: Where the slope exceeds 1:20, the segment must be designed as a ramp with handrails and landings per ramp code

subject: Accessible Route
rule: accessible route must have a maximum cross slope of 1:48 (2.08%)

subject: Accessible Route
rule: accessible route must not have a vertical rise exceeding 1/4 inch (6.4 mm) at any walking surface joint or crack without beveling
exceptions: Vertical rises between 1/4 inch and 1/2 inch (6.4–13 mm) are permitted if beveled at 1:2 maximum slope; rises exceeding 1/2 inch must be treated as a ramp or curb ramp

subject: Accessible Route
rule: accessible route must have a clear width of 32 inches (815 mm) minimum at any door opening measured from the door stop to the opposite stop
conditions: applies to door openings along the accessible route

subject: Accessible Route
rule: accessible route must have a minimum clear turning space of 60 inches (1525 mm) diameter at any dead-end corridor or where the route changes direction
conditions: applies where route includes a dead-end or a turn
exceptions: A T-shaped turning space with minimum dimensions may substitute for a full 60-inch circle

subject: Accessible Parking Space
rule: accessible parking space must have a minimum width of 96 inches (2440 mm) and a minimum length of 180 inches (4572 mm) to accommodate a van lift or ramp

subject: Accessible Parking Space
rule: accessible parking space must be located on a route that is accessible and has a maximum slope of 1:48 (2.08%)

subject: Accessible Parking Space
rule: accessible parking space must be paired with an adjacent access aisle of minimum 60 inches width for car-accessible or 96 inches width for van-accessible

subject: Accessible Parking Space
rule: accessible parking space must not have a slope exceeding 1:48 (2.08%) in any direction on the parking surface itself

subject: Accessible Parking Space
rule: accessible parking space must be clearly marked with the International Symbol of Accessibility signage mounted at least 60 inches above the ground

subject: Accessible Toilet Room
rule: accessible toilet room must have a clear floor space of at least 1500mm diameter (or 1500mm x 1500mm) for wheelchair turning

subject: Accessible Toilet Room
rule: accessible toilet room must have a door that provides a minimum clear opening width of 850mm

subject: Accessible Toilet Room
rule: accessible toilet room must have grab rails beside the toilet pan

subject: Accessible Toilet Room
rule: accessible toilet room must have a toilet pan with a seat height between 460mm and 480mm from finished floor level

subject: Accessible Toilet Room
rule: accessible toilet room must not have a step or change in level at the doorway threshold
exceptions: A maximum 5mm beveled lip is permitted where weatherproofing is required

subject: Accessible Shower Room
rule: shower room floor must have a slip-resistant finish
conditions: when used as an accessible shower room

subject: Accessible Shower Room
rule: shower room floor must be sloped towards a drain
conditions: when used as an accessible shower room

subject: Accessible Shower Room
rule: shower room must have a minimum clear floor area of 900 mm x 1300 mm (or 1500 mm diameter turning circle) for wheelchair access
conditions: when designated as an accessible shower room

subject: Accessible Shower Room
rule: shower room entry threshold must not exceed 13 mm in height
conditions: when the shower room is fully accessible

subject: Accessible Shower Room
rule: shower room must have a waterproof lining on walls and floor
conditions: when the shower room contains a wet-area shower

subject: Accessible Shower Room
rule: shower room floor must be flush with the surrounding floor (zero-threshold entry)
conditions: when designated as a roll-in accessible shower

subject: Accessible Shower Room
rule: shower room must have grab bars installed at designated locations
conditions: when the shower room is for general public or staff accessible use

subject: Accessible Door Assembly
rule: accessible door assembly must have a clear opening width of at least 32 inches (813 mm) in the fully open position
conditions: applies to doors serving accessible routes
applies to new construction per IBC/ADA
exceptions: existing buildings where structural limitations prevent alteration — allow minimum 30 inches clearance

subject: Accessible Door Assembly
rule: accessible door assembly must have clear maneuvering clearance on the pull side of the door
conditions: door is not automatic or power-operated

subject: Accessible Door Assembly
rule: accessible door assembly's operable hardware must be usable with one hand and not require tight grasping, pinching, or twisting of the wrist
exceptions: security doors in high-security areas where special hardware is required for safety

subject: Accessible Door Assembly
rule: accessible door assembly must not have a threshold greater than 1/2 inch (13 mm) in height
exceptions: existing thresholds up to 3/4 inch are permitted if beveled with a slope not steeper than 1:2

subject: Accessible Door Assembly
rule: accessible door assembly must have a door closing speed such that the door takes at least 5 seconds to move from 90 degrees to 12 degrees from the closed position
conditions: door is equipped with a door closer

subject: Accessible Window
rule: accessible window sill height must be between 24-34 inches (610-864 mm) above finished floor
conditions: window is intended for egress
window is intended for occupant use
exceptions: windows serving as fixed architectural glazing not operable by occupants

subject: Accessible Window
rule: accessible window must not require more than 5 lbf (22.2 N) of force to operate
conditions: window is operable by occupant
exceptions: windows in fire-rated assemblies requiring higher force for compliance

subject: Accessible Window
rule: accessible window handle or hardware must be operable with one hand and without tight grasping, pinching, or twisting of the wrist
conditions: window has operable hardware

subject: Accessible Window
rule: accessible window visual sill height must not exceed 44 inches (1118 mm) above finished floor for a view to the exterior
conditions: window is located in an accessible space where a view is required by code
window is not solely for light or ventilation
exceptions: windows in spaces where the exterior grade is above the interior finished floor

subject: Accessible Lift / Platform Lift
rule: accessible lift / platform lift must have a rated load capacity that is never exceeded during operation
conditions: when lift is in service

subject: Accessible Lift / Platform Lift
rule: accessible lift / platform lift must have operational safety edges or sensors that stop or reverse travel when an obstruction is detected
conditions: when lift is equipped with power-operated doors or gates
when lift platform is moving

subject: Accessible Lift / Platform Lift
rule: accessible lift / platform lift must have a functioning manual lowering mechanism (e.g., hand pump or backup release) for emergency descent during power loss
conditions: when lift is hydraulically powered

subject: Accessible Lift / Platform Lift
rule: accessible lift / platform lift must not have a travel distance exceeding applicable accessibility code maximum (typically 12 ft / 3.66 m for unenclosed platform lifts)
conditions: when installed as a platform lift without a full hoistway enclosure
exceptions: where local authority having jurisdiction permits greater travel distance with additional safety features

subject: Accessible Elevator
rule: An accessible elevator must have a rated hoistway door that provides a clear width of at least 36 inches (915 mm) when open.
conditions: Applicable to all passenger accessible elevators

subject: Accessible Elevator
rule: An accessible elevator must have a car interior that is at least 54 inches (1370 mm) deep if the door is located at the narrow end of the cab, or at least 68 inches (1725 mm) deep if the door is centered on the wide end.
conditions: Applicable to all passenger accessible elevators

subject: Accessible Elevator
rule: An accessible elevator must have automatic doors with a re-opening device that prevents the doors from closing on obstructions.
conditions: Applicable to all power-operated accessible elevators

subject: Accessible Elevator
rule: An accessible elevator must have emergency two-way communication systems that are accessible to persons with visual or hearing impairments.
conditions: Applicable to all accessible elevators with emergency communication

subject: Accessible Elevator
rule: An accessible elevator must not have a change in level greater than 1/4 inch (6.4 mm) at the threshold between the hoistway door and the elevator car floor.
conditions: Applicable to all accessible elevators
exceptions: A beveled edge up to 1/2 inch (13 mm) with a slope no steeper than 1:2 is permitted per ADA

subject: Accessible Elevator
rule: An accessible elevator must have elevator car and landing call buttons that are no higher than 42 inches (1067 mm) above the floor and are centered on the control panel.
conditions: Applicable to all accessible elevators with manual call stations
exceptions: In existing buildings, reach ranges may be permitted up to 48 inches (1220 mm) if the elevator is altered under certain ADA safe harbor provisions

subject: Accessible Signage System
rule: Signage characters and symbols must have a minimum stroke width-to-height ratio of 1:6
conditions: signage contains raised characters or symbols
signage is intended for tactile reading

subject: Accessible Signage System
rule: Tactile characters must be a minimum of 1/32 inch (0.8 mm) above the surface
conditions: signage includes tactile (raised) characters

subject: Accessible Signage System
rule: Signage mounting height must allow wheelchair-accessible sight lines
conditions: signage is wall-mounted
signage provides visual information for wayfinding

subject: Accessible Signage System
rule: Braille dots must not be truncated or divided across sign edges
conditions: signage includes braille

subject: Accessible Signage System
rule: Signage must comply with mandated color contrast ratio between text and background
conditions: signage is intended for visual reading

subject: Accessible Counter / Work Surface
rule: accessible counter / work surface must have a clear knee space beneath it
conditions: counter is designed for seated user access
counter is intended for use by persons using wheeled mobility aids
exceptions: counter is a service counter with no seated user requirement
counter is a portable/temporary surface

subject: Accessible Counter / Work Surface
rule: accessible counter / work surface must have a maximum surface height between 28 and 34 inches above finished floor
conditions: counter is intended for use by persons in wheeled mobility aids

subject: Accessible Counter / Work Surface
rule: accessible counter / work surface must not have sharp or abrasive edges on the leading edge of the surface
conditions: counter is located in a path of travel or accessible route
counter is at a height where a person could contact the edge while passing

subject: Accessible Assembly Area
rule: accessible assembly area must have a minimum clear floor area of 30 inches by 48 inches (760 mm by 1220 mm) for a single wheelchair
conditions: serves people with mobility disabilities

subject: Accessible Assembly Area
rule: accessible assembly area must have an accessible route connecting it to the building entrance and to all accessible elements within the space

subject: Accessible Assembly Area
rule: accessible assembly area must have wheelchair seating spaces distributed throughout the seating area
conditions: the assembly area contains fixed seating

subject: Accessible Assembly Area
rule: accessible assembly area must have at least one accessible route that does not require passing through a kitchen or storage room

subject: Accessible Assembly Area
rule: accessible assembly area must not have a step or change in level greater than 1/2 inch (13 mm) without a ramp or lift
exceptions: changes in level between 1/4 inch and 1/2 inch may be beveled with a slope not steeper than 1:2

subject: Grab Bar Assembly
rule: grab bar must be securely anchored to structure capable of supporting minimum 250 lb (113 kg) static load
conditions: grab bar is installed for ADA/building code compliance
grab bar is in a commercial or public accessible bathroom
exceptions: temporary/friction-fit grab bars not intended for weight-bearing

subject: Grab Bar Assembly
rule: grab bar must have a diameter between 1.25 inches and 1.5 inches (32–38 mm)
conditions: grab bar is intended for use by persons with disabilities per ADA or similar accessibility standards
exceptions: grab bars in residential settings not governed by accessibility codes

subject: Grab Bar Assembly
rule: grab bar must maintain a minimum 1.5 inch (38 mm) clearance between bar surface and any adjacent wall or mounting surface
conditions: grab bar is wall-mounted

subject: Grab Bar Assembly
rule: grab bar flange or escutcheon must not have sharp edges or protruding set screws when installed
conditions: grab bar assembly includes any flange or escutcheon component that contacts user's hand or arm
exceptions: set screws that are recessed and covered by trim

subject: Accessible Drinking Fountain
rule: accessible drinking fountain must have an operating mechanism that does not require tight grasping, pinching, or twisting of the wrist
conditions: fountain is intended for use by persons with disabilities
fountain is located in a jurisdiction that adopts ADA or equivalent accessibility standards
exceptions: fountain is not required to be accessible (e.g., secondary non-accessible unit provided elsewhere)

subject: Accessible Drinking Fountain
rule: accessible drinking fountain must have a spout height between 36 inches and 38 inches measured from the finished floor
conditions: fountain is for standing persons
fountain is subject to ADA compliance
exceptions: fountain is for wheelchair-bound persons only and a separate high-unit is provided (height range differs)

subject: Accessible Drinking Fountain
rule: accessible drinking fountain must provide clear floor space of at least 30 inches by 48 inches centered on the fountain
conditions: fountain is wall-mounted or freestanding

subject: Accessible Drinking Fountain
rule: accessible drinking fountain must not have a basin depth less than 5.5 inches
conditions: fountain is designed with a basin-style water receptor
fountain is subject to ADA requirements

subject: Accessible Evacuation Zone
rule: An accessible evacuation zone must be at the same level as the egress path it serves or be connected via a ramped or level landing with no step
conditions: The zone serves as an assembly point for evacuation
exceptions: When the entire evacuation route is served by an elevator that is designated for evacuation and is on an approved emergency power supply

subject: Accessible Evacuation Zone
rule: An accessible evacuation zone must have a minimum clear floor area of sufficient size to accommodate the occupant load it serves
conditions: The zone is used as an area of refuge or an exterior assembly point

subject: Accessible Evacuation Zone
rule: An accessible evacuation zone must be served by an accessible means of egress that is protected from fire and smoke
conditions: The zone is an interior area of refuge
exceptions: When the zone is an exterior open area at grade level

subject: Accessible Evacuation Zone
rule: An accessible evacuation zone must have two-way communication device for emergency contact
conditions: The zone is an interior area of refuge or an exterior evacuation assembly point not within direct sight of emergency personnel
exceptions: When the zone is directly adjacent to an exit stairwell door with constant visual supervision by building staff

subject: Accessible Evacuation Zone
rule: An accessible evacuation zone must not be located in a space that requires travel through a hazardous area (e.g., boiler room, high-hazard storage) to reach it

subject: Tactile Warning Surface
rule: Tactile warning surface must comply with ADA detectable warning dome specifications (truncated domes with specific diameter, height, center-to-center spacing, and contrast requirements)
conditions: installed at pedestrian curb ramps
installed at transit platform edges
exceptions: private residential walkways not open to the public

subject: Tactile Warning Surface
rule: Tactile warning surface must have a color contrast of at least 70% light reflectance value (LRV) difference from the surrounding surface
conditions: installed in jurisdictions adopting current PROWAG or ADA Accessibility Standards
exceptions: some local jurisdictions accept contrast detectable by other means (e.g., high-visibility yellow or red without exact LRV measurement)

subject: Tactile Warning Surface
rule: Tactile warning surface must not present a tripping hazard — it must be flush with or within 1/4 inch of the adjoining surface
conditions: any pedestrian installation

subject: Tactile Warning Surface
rule: Tactile warning surface must be slip-resistant in wet conditions
conditions: exterior installations
interior installations subject to wetting

subject: Accessible Switch / Outlet
rule: accessible switch/outlet must be installed at a height between 15 inches and 48 inches above finished floor
conditions: applies to wall-mounted switches and outlets in accessible spaces per ADA

subject: Accessible Switch / Outlet
rule: accessible switch/outlet must not be obstructed by building elements or furnishings within the clear floor space
conditions: applies to any accessible switch or outlet with a required clear floor space for approach
exceptions: temporary obstructions during maintenance are not considered violations

subject: Accessible Switch / Outlet
rule: accessible switch/outlet must have a minimum of 30 inches by 48 inches of clear floor space centered on the device
conditions: applies to all accessible switches and outlets requiring unobstructed approach

subject: Accessible Intercom / Entry System
rule: accessible intercom / entry system must be mounted at a height reachable from a wheelchair
conditions: when serving an accessible entrance
exceptions: when equivalent functionality is provided through a different accessible means (e.g., automatic door activation without manual intercom operation)

subject: Accessible Intercom / Entry System
rule: accessible intercom / entry system must be located on the accessible route leading to the entrance it serves
conditions: when required as part of an accessible entry system

subject: Accessible Intercom / Entry System
rule: accessible intercom / entry system must_not require tight grasping, pinching, or twisting of the wrist to operate
conditions: when the system includes manual controls such as buttons or keypads

subject: Accessible Intercom / Entry System
rule: accessible intercom / entry system must provide both visual and audible indication of communication status (e.g., ring, door answered, waiting)
conditions: when the system is the primary means of requesting entry

subject: Paved Plaza Surface
rule: paved plaza surface must have a minimum cross-slope of 1% for drainage
conditions: surface is exposed to precipitation
surface is intended for pedestrian use
exceptions: surfaces designed with an alternative engineered drainage system (e.g., permeable pavement with sub-base drainage)

subject: Paved Plaza Surface
rule: paved plaza surface must_not have unpermitted ponding areas exceeding 1/4 inch depth after 24 hours
conditions: surface is exposed to precipitation
exceptions: areas specifically designed as water features or rain gardens

subject: Paved Plaza Surface
rule: paved plaza surface must have a load-bearing capacity sufficient for its intended use
conditions: surface supports vehicular traffic or heavy maintenance equipment
exceptions: pedestrian-only surfaces with clear weight restriction signage

subject: Paved Plaza Surface
rule: paved plaza surface must_not have a coefficient of friction below 0.5 when wet
conditions: surface is accessible to the public
exceptions: slip-resistant surface treatments are applied that achieve equivalent wet friction performance

subject: Public Square Drainage System
rule: drainage system must maintain continuous gravity flow from collection points to outfall
conditions: system relies on gravity drainage
exceptions: site incorporates active pumping as primary drainage mechanism

subject: Public Square Drainage System
rule: drainage system must not discharge onto pedestrian surfaces at velocities or volumes that cause public safety hazard
conditions: system outlets near or onto public square paved areas

subject: Public Square Drainage System
rule: drainage system surface inlets must be positioned at local low points of the square grading
conditions: system collects surface runoff via inlets

subject: Public Square Drainage System
rule: drainage system must be sized to convey the design storm runoff without surcharge or overflow

subject: Integrated Bollard Lighting
rule: Integrated bollard lighting must have an IP rating of at least IP65 for external use
conditions: installed outdoors
exposed to weather
exceptions: installed in sheltered location with overhead protection

subject: Integrated Bollard Lighting
rule: Integrated bollard lighting must not have electrical components below the finished ground level
conditions: installed in landscape or paved areas

subject: Integrated Bollard Lighting
rule: Integrated bollard lighting must be anchored to a structurally sound concrete footing or base plate
conditions: installed in trafficked areas
subject to vehicle impact risk
exceptions: installed in soft landscape with no vehicular access and low pedestrian traffic

subject: Tree Pit with Grating
rule: Tree pit grating must have openings large enough for water and air to reach the tree roots

subject: Tree Pit with Grating
rule: Tree pit grating must not have openings that pose a trip hazard to pedestrians
conditions: grating is installed in a pedestrian walkway or publicly accessible area

subject: Tree Pit with Grating
rule: Tree pit grating must be structurally capable of supporting the design pedestrian load
conditions: grating is installed in a pedestrian-accessible location

subject: Bicycle Rack Anchorage
rule: Bicycle rack anchorage must be capable of resisting design loads (wind, seismic, live loads) specified by applicable building codes
conditions: When installed in a region with adopted building codes
When the bicycle rack is permanently attached to the structure
exceptions: Freestanding portable racks not anchored to any structure

subject: Bicycle Rack Anchorage
rule: Bicycle rack anchorage must be secured against unauthorized removal or theft
conditions: When installed in a publicly accessible location
exceptions: Temporary event racks that are supervised

subject: Bicycle Rack Anchorage
rule: Bicycle rack anchorage must not create a tripping hazard
conditions: When installed in pedestrian walkways, paths, or egress routes

subject: Bicycle Rack Anchorage
rule: Bicycle rack anchorage must be corrosion-resistant for the exposure environment
conditions: When installed outdoors or in a corrosive environment (e.g., near saltwater, de-icing chemicals)
exceptions: Indoor installations in conditioned, non-corrosive spaces

subject: Water Feature Basin
rule: water feature basin must be watertight to retain water
conditions: basin is intended to hold water
exceptions: basin is explicitly designed as a dry feature (e.g., dry creek bed representation)

subject: Water Feature Basin
rule: water feature basin must have a water supply or recirculation system to maintain water level
conditions: basin is intended to operate as a functional water feature with standing or flowing water
exceptions: basin is purely rainwater-collecting without intended aesthetic water display
basin is filled manually on an occasional basis without continuous operation

subject: Water Feature Basin
rule: water feature basin must_not overflow onto adjacent building components or critical site areas without controlled drainage
conditions: basin is located adjacent to building foundations, walls, or pedestrian paths
exceptions: overflow is deliberately directed to a designed drainage system or rain garden

subject: Water Feature Basin
rule: water feature basin must have an overflow outlet or drainage path
conditions: basin receives continuous or pumped water supply
exceptions: basin is small, manually filled, and monitored with no continuous inflow

subject: Water Feature Basin
rule: water feature basin lining or structure must be compatible with continuous water exposure (non-degrading, non-corrosive)
conditions: basin is permanently installed and intended for prolonged water contact

subject: Trash Receptacle Enclosure
rule: trash receptacle enclosure must have a sloped or grated floor to allow liquid drainage and prevent pooling
conditions: enclosure is exposed to weather
enclosure contains wet waste or receives cleaning
exceptions: enclosure is fully sealed and liquid-tight with a drain connection to plumbing system

subject: Trash Receptacle Enclosure
rule: trash receptacle enclosure must have a minimum clearance in front of access doors to allow trash bin removal
conditions: access doors open outward or bins are rolled out through the door opening
exceptions: enclosure is designed with a removable roof or wall panel for bin extraction rather than door swing clearance

subject: Trash Receptacle Enclosure
rule: trash receptacle enclosure must not impede natural ventilation or trap explosive methane gas concentrations
conditions: enclosure is fully enclosed with walls and a roof on all sides
organic waste is stored inside
exceptions: enclosure is mechanically ventilated with explosion-proof rated equipment

subject: Trash Receptacle Enclosure
rule: trash receptacle enclosure must have a floor rated for the point load of a fully loaded waste collection truck wheel if the truck drives over or parks on the slab
conditions: enclosure floor is contiguous with or directly adjacent to the driveway/collection route
collection truck accesses the enclosure area
exceptions: enclosure is positioned such that truck wheels never bear on the enclosure floor slab

subject: Pergola or Trellis Structure
rule: pergola or trellis structure must have vertical load-bearing members (posts/columns) embedded in or anchored to a foundation or structural base
conditions: structure is freestanding and not attached to an existing building
exceptions: structure is a lightweight temporary/seasonal unit placed directly on grade and not intended for wind or snow load resistance

subject: Pergola or Trellis Structure
rule: pergola or trellis structure must not exceed the lateral load capacity of its connections and supports under local wind/snow design loads
conditions: structure is located in a region requiring engineered design per building code
exceptions: structure is a purely decorative, non-loadbearing trellis not intended to carry any vegetation or environmental loads

subject: Pergola or Trellis Structure
rule: pergola or trellis structure must not have closed roofing or solid decking that would create an enclosed habitable space
conditions: structure is classified as an open-air structure under applicable building code

subject: Pergola or Trellis Structure
rule: pergola or trellis structure must have lateral bracing or moment connections to resist racking
conditions: structure height exceeds 8 ft (2.4 m) or span between posts exceeds 12 ft (3.6 m)
exceptions: structure is attached to a rigid existing building wall on at least one side providing lateral stability

subject: Public Art Pedestal
rule: pedestal must have a flat, level top surface for art placement
conditions: art piece requires stable horizontal placement
exceptions: art piece designed with its own integrated base that accounts for non-level surface

subject: Public Art Pedestal
rule: pedestal must support the vertical load of the art piece without excessive deflection or failure
conditions: art piece mass exceeds pedestal's self-weight capacity

subject: Public Art Pedestal
rule: pedestal must not have sharp exposed edges or protrusions at accessible height in public areas
conditions: pedestal is installed in a publicly accessible location without barriers
exceptions: art piece itself intentionally incorporates sharp elements as part of its design, and signage or barriers are provided

subject: Public Art Pedestal
rule: pedestal must be anchored or weighted to prevent overturning under lateral wind load
conditions: pedestal height exceeds twice its base width
art piece has significant wind sail area
exceptions: pedestal and art assembly's combined center of gravity remains within the base's middle third under expected wind loads

subject: Public Art Pedestal
rule: pedestal base must be designed to prevent frost heave damage in freeze-thaw climates
conditions: pedestal is installed in a climate with ground freezing
pedestal bears directly on soil rather than on a frost-protected foundation

subject: Accessible Ramp Integration
rule: accessible ramp must have a slope ratio between 1:12 and 1:20 for wheelchair accessibility
conditions: ramp serves wheelchair users
ramp is part of an accessible route
exceptions: ramp serves only non-ADA-jurisdiction sites (e.g., private residence with no public access)

subject: Accessible Ramp Integration
rule: accessible ramp must have a minimum clear width of 36 inches (914 mm) between handrails
conditions: ramp is along an accessible means of egress or public path of travel

subject: Accessible Ramp Integration
rule: accessible ramp must have handrails on both sides when rise exceeds 6 inches
conditions: ramp rise is greater than 6 inches (152 mm)

subject: Accessible Ramp Integration
rule: accessible ramp must have landings at top and bottom with minimum 60 inch length in direction of travel
conditions: ramp run exceeds 30 feet (9.1 m) horizontal projection or ramp changes direction

subject: Accessible Ramp Integration
rule: accessible ramp must not have a cross slope exceeding 2% (1:48)

subject: Accessible Ramp Integration
rule: accessible ramp must have edge protection (curb, rail, or barrier) on open sides to prevent wheel-off
conditions: ramp is elevated and has open sides with drop-off

subject: Accessible Ramp Integration
rule: accessible ramp surface must be slip-resistant

subject: Stormwater Planter
rule: Stormwater planter must have an overflow outlet or bypass path to safely convey flows exceeding its storage capacity
conditions: Planter receives runoff from any contributing drainage area
exceptions: Planter is designed with sufficient freeboard such that over-topping cannot cause damage or erosion under the design storm

subject: Stormwater Planter
rule: Stormwater planter must have an impermeable liner or barrier if placed directly against a building foundation to prevent water infiltration into the structure
conditions: Planter is located adjacent to or abutting a building foundation or basement wall
exceptions: Local geotechnical investigation confirms that additional moisture from planter will not compromise foundation integrity

subject: Stormwater Planter
rule: Stormwater planter must not be placed over underground utility lines, septic systems, or cisterns without protective measures
conditions: Planter footprint overlaps with buried infrastructure
exceptions: Engineered load-distribution and root-barrier systems are installed to protect the underlying infrastructure

subject: Stormwater Planter
rule: Stormwater planter must have a positive drainage outlet at a lower elevation than the inlet invert to prevent standing water
conditions: Planter has an underdrain system or piped outlet
exceptions: Planter is designed as a fully infiltration-based system with no underdrain, relying solely on exfiltration into surrounding soils

subject: Balcony
rule: balcony must have a minimum depth of slip-resistant walking surface
conditions: balcony is accessible for occupant use
exceptions: decorative balcony that is not meant for occupancy

subject: Balcony
rule: balcony must have a guardrail or parapet at its open edge
conditions: balcony is at a height greater than 600 mm above adjacent grade or floor
exceptions: historically preserved facades where no occupancy is permitted

subject: Balcony
rule: guardrail or parapet must be high enough to prevent a person from falling over it
conditions: balcony is elevated and accessible

subject: Balcony
rule: balcony must not have gaps in the guardrail or floor through which a 100 mm sphere could pass
conditions: balcony is elevated and accessible to children

subject: Balcony
rule: balcony must be capable of supporting its design live load without collapse
conditions: balcony is designed as a load-bearing platform

subject: Balcony
rule: balcony walking surface must drain to prevent ponding water
conditions: balcony is exposed to rain or snow melt
exceptions: fully enclosed climate-controlled balcony

subject: Mezzanine
rule: mezzanine floor live load must not exceed the structural design capacity of the supporting building structure
conditions: mezzanine used for storage
mezzanine used for occupancy
exceptions: mezzanine is independently supported on its own foundation system isolated from the building structure

subject: Mezzanine
rule: mezzanine floor deck must have a fire-resistance rating consistent with the building code occupancy classification
conditions: mezzanine is open to the building interior
mezzanine exceeds the area limit for open mezzanines per applicable building code
exceptions: the entire building is protected by an automatic sprinkler system and code permits reduction or omission

subject: Mezzanine
rule: the clear height below a mezzanine must not be less than the minimum habitable or egress height required by applicable building code
conditions: the space below the mezzanine is occupied or used as a means of egress

subject: Observation Deck
rule: observation deck must have a fall-protection barrier (guardrail, parapet wall, or equivalent) at any open edge where the deck is elevated more than 30 inches above adjacent grade or floor
conditions: deck is elevated more than 30 inches above adjacent grade or floor
deck has open edges without full-height enclosing walls
exceptions: deck is at grade level with no drop-off
deck serves as a stage or performance platform where barriers would conflict with intended use (requires alternative safety measures)

subject: Observation Deck
rule: observation deck floor surface must have a slip-resistant finish or material
conditions: deck is exposed to weather
deck is accessible to the public
exceptions: interior observation decks not subject to moisture or spillage

subject: Observation Deck
rule: observation deck must have a means of egress that meets minimum width and travel distance requirements for the occupant load
conditions: deck is accessible to the public
deck occupant load exceeds the capacity of a single exit

subject: Observation Deck
rule: observation deck must not have unprotected glazing or openings at the base of guardrails where the drop exceeds the code-specified dimension
conditions: deck has guardrails with glass infill or openings
deck is elevated more than 30 inches

subject: Rooftop Terrace
rule: Rooftop terrace must have a minimum parapet or guardrail height of at least 1100 mm (or local code minimum) at all unenclosed edges to prevent falls
conditions: Terrace is elevated above adjacent grade
Edge is not enclosed by a wall
exceptions: Terrace is at grade level with no fall hazard

subject: Rooftop Terrace
rule: Rooftop terrace must have a safe means of egress (at least one exit path that meets building code requirements)
conditions: Terrace is accessible to occupants
Terrace area exceeds local code threshold for occupancy
exceptions: Terrace is for maintenance access only and not occupied

subject: Rooftop Terrace
rule: Rooftop terrace must be designed to sustain its design live load (e.g., minimum 4.8 kPa or as per local code for occupiable roof areas)
conditions: Terrace is intended for occupancy or use by people

subject: Rooftop Terrace
rule: Rooftop terrace must not have drainage that directs water toward building entrances or critical building systems
conditions: Terrace includes any drainage scuppers, downspouts, or overflow drains
exceptions: Drainage is specifically designed into a controlled stormwater management system

subject: Staircase
rule: staircase tread depth and riser height must satisfy the building code's max riser / min tread ratio (typically 7-11 rule or equivalent)
conditions: staircase is intended for occupant egress or regular pedestrian use
exceptions: ship ladders
alternating tread devices
industrial catwalks not for general occupancy

subject: Staircase
rule: staircase must have at least one handrail where the total rise exceeds a code-defined threshold (typically 4 risers or 0.5 m)
conditions: staircase serves as a means of egress or is used by building occupants
exceptions: private residential stairs with fewer than 4 risers in some jurisdictions
service stairs not for general occupant use

subject: Staircase
rule: staircase must not have open risers that allow passage of a 4-inch (100 mm) sphere, unless the staircase is not part of a required egress
conditions: staircase is in a building requiring child safety (e.g. residential, school)
exceptions: industrial catwalks or service ladders where child access is prevented

subject: Staircase
