rule: staircase landing must be at least as wide as the stairway and have a minimum depth equal to the width of the stair (or the code-specified minimum, typically 36-44 inches)
conditions: staircase has a change of direction or a door opening onto the landing
exceptions: straight-run stairs with no intermediate landing required by code (rise below threshold)

subject: Elevator/Lift
rule: Elevator/lift car must have a functioning braking system that engages automatically upon power loss or overspeed
conditions: all elevator/lift types

subject: Elevator/Lift
rule: Elevator/lift hoist cables must have a safety factor of at least 12:1 relative to the maximum rated load
conditions: traction elevators and rope-lifted systems
exceptions: hydraulic elevators that use a piston instead of cables

subject: Elevator/Lift
rule: Elevator/lift must not operate with an open hoistway door or car door at a floor other than the landing floor
conditions: all passenger and freight elevators

subject: Elevator/Lift
rule: Elevator/lift must have a rated load capacity that is never exceeded by the sum of applied loads during operation
conditions: all elevator/lift types

subject: Elevator/Lift
rule: Elevator/lift pit must be dry and free of standing water
conditions: all elevator/lift types with a pit

subject: Catwalk
rule: catwalk must have a load-bearing capacity sufficient for intended use (personnel, equipment, or both)
conditions: when intended for personnel access
when intended for equipment access
exceptions: purely decorative catwalks with no live load requirement

subject: Catwalk
rule: catwalk must have guardrails or fall protection along open sides
conditions: when elevated more than standard fall-protection threshold (typically 30 inches / 0.76 m above adjacent surface)
exceptions: catwalks with no open sides (e.g., fully enclosed tunnel-type)
catwalks in industrial settings where guardrails would interfere with operations and alternative fall protection is in place

subject: Catwalk
rule: catwalk surface must be slip-resistant
conditions: when exposed to moisture, oil, or other slippery substances
when intended for regular personnel access

subject: Catwalk
rule: catwalk must not have a tripping hazard at surface joints or transitions
conditions: when used as a walking surface for personnel

subject: Catwalk
rule: catwalk must be cantilevered or supported such that lateral stability is maintained under design wind load
conditions: when installed outdoors
when installed at significant height above ground

subject: Gallery
rule: Gallery floor live load must be at least 4.8 kN/m² (100 psf) for exhibit spaces
conditions: Space is used for temporary exhibitions or permanent collection display

subject: Gallery
rule: Gallery must have at least two separate means of egress with minimum clear width of 1120 mm (44 in)
conditions: Gallery floor area exceeds 465 m² (5000 ft²)
Occupant load exceeds 49 people
exceptions: Single-exit exception may apply only for very small accessory galleries under specific code allowance

subject: Gallery
rule: Gallery must not have direct sunlight falling on exhibited works without UV-filtering glazing or shading devices
conditions: Gallery contains light-sensitive materials (paintings, textiles, works on paper)
exceptions: Specially designed galleries for works that tolerate or require daylight (e.g., certain sculptures, modern works)

subject: Gallery
rule: Gallery ceiling or wall structure must be capable of supporting point loads of at least 1.5 kN (150 kg) for hanging art
conditions: Gallery uses picture rails, suspension cables, or ceiling-mounted hanging systems

subject: Gallery
rule: Gallery must maintain relative humidity between 40% and 60% with a maximum daily fluctuation of ±5%
conditions: Gallery houses hygroscopic collection materials (paintings on canvas, wooden panels, paper, textiles)

subject: Gallery
rule: Gallery HVAC system must provide positive pressurization relative to adjacent spaces
conditions: Gallery is mechanically conditioned

subject: Guardrail/Parapet
rule: parapet/guardrail must have a minimum height to prevent accidental falls
conditions: when serving as a fall-protection barrier on roofs, balconies, or elevated walkways
exceptions: when the parapet is purely ornamental and a separate fall-protection system is provided

subject: Guardrail/Parapet
rule: parapet/guardrail must resist specified lateral loads (wind, live load at top rail) without collapse
conditions: when designed as a guardrail or barrier
exceptions: when it is a non-structural decorative parapet not serving as a barrier and not exposed to lateral loads

subject: Guardrail/Parapet
rule: parapet/guardrail must be free of openings large enough to pass a 4-inch sphere
conditions: when serving as a fall-protection barrier accessible to children
exceptions: when the parapet is not serving as a child-guard barrier (e.g., height > 24 inches above the walking surface for certain conditions)

subject: Fall Arrest System Anchor
rule: Fall arrest system anchor must be attached to a structurally capable substrate (e.g., concrete, steel beam) that can withstand the required ultimate load (typically 5,000 lbf per ANSI/ASSP Z359) without failure
conditions: When used as a personal fall arrest system anchor point

subject: Fall Arrest System Anchor
rule: Fall arrest system anchor must not be installed on drywall, plaster, lightweight non-structural cladding, or similar materials incapable of sustaining the fall arrest load
conditions: When used as a personal fall arrest system anchor point

subject: Fall Arrest System Anchor
rule: Fall arrest system anchor must be corrosion-resistant or protected from corrosion in the intended service environment
conditions: When exposed to outdoor, marine, or corrosive atmospheres
exceptions: Stainless steel or hot-dipped galvanized anchors in non-corrosive indoor environments may not require additional protection

subject: High-Level Glazing
rule: High-level glazing must be constructed from laminated or tempered safety glass
conditions: glazing is at height where breakage could cause injury to people below
glazing is in an occupancy category requiring safety glazing per building code
exceptions: glazing is fully screened or guarded to prevent human impact
glazing is too small (e.g., less than 0.33 m²) to pose a fall-through risk

subject: High-Level Glazing
rule: High-level glazing must be capable of supporting its own weight and wind loads without excessive deflection or breakage
conditions: glazing is installed in an exterior wall or roof
glazing spans a large area
exceptions: glazing is a small non-structural decorative element fully supported by a load-bearing frame

subject: High-Level Glazing
rule: High-level glazing must not be installed in locations where thermal stress from direct sunlight can cause breakage unless it is heat-treated or designed for such exposure
conditions: glazing is exposed to direct solar radiation without shading
glazing has high solar absorption (e.g., tinted or coated glass)
exceptions: glazing is fully heat-strengthened or tempered to withstand thermal gradient stress
glazing is shaded by an external architectural element

subject: Stage Platform
rule: stage platform must have a structure capable of supporting the intended static and dynamic loads (performers, equipment, audience if applicable)
conditions: platform is elevated above ground level
platform is used for performance or assembly

subject: Stage Platform
rule: stage platform must have a slip-resistant walking surface on all areas accessible to performers or audience
conditions: platform is intended for human occupancy or foot traffic

subject: Stage Platform
rule: stage platform must incorporate fall-protection (guardrails or other restraint) if its unguarded edge height exceeds the applicable safety threshold
conditions: platform edge is elevated more than the local code threshold (typically 30 inches / 76 cm) above the adjacent surface
exceptions: platform is at ground level
platform edge is used as a performance edge with alternative safety measures (e.g., safety lines, crash mats under specific protocols)

subject: Stage Platform
rule: stage platform must not have a gap or opening between deck boards large enough to allow a person's foot or body to pass through unsafely
conditions: platform uses spanning deck boards or modular segments with gaps

subject: Sound-Absorbing Wall Panels
rule: Sound-absorbing wall panels must be installed with the sound-absorbing face oriented toward the sound source / interior of the room
conditions: The panel is designed with a specific absorptive face (not symmetrical/identical on both sides)
exceptions: Panel is designed as a symmetrical absorber with identical acoustic performance on both faces

subject: Sound-Absorbing Wall Panels
rule: Sound-absorbing wall panels must not be fully sealed with a non-porous, airtight coating or paint on the absorptive face
conditions: The panel relies on porous/fibrous material (e.g. fiberglass, mineral wool, acoustic foam, polyester fiber) for sound absorption
exceptions: The panel has a perforated or micro-perforated facing that is specifically designed as part of the absorptive system
The panel is a membrane-type absorber where the facing is the functional element

subject: Dance Studio Flooring (Marley)
rule: Dance studio Marley flooring must be installed over a smooth, clean, and level subfloor surface
conditions: Subfloor is concrete, wood, or existing resilient flooring

subject: Dance Studio Flooring (Marley)
rule: Dance studio Marley flooring must not be installed in areas subject to standing water or continuous moisture
conditions: Flooring is in a permanent or semi-permanent installation
exceptions: Temporary Marley laid over a waterproof barrier for a single event may be acceptable

subject: Dance Studio Flooring (Marley)
rule: Marley flooring seams must be heat-welded or chemically fused for permanent installations
conditions: Installation is permanent (not roll-out/temporary)
Floor area exceeds a single roll width, requiring seams
exceptions: Temporary roll-out Marley without seams is acceptable for portable use

subject: Lighting Grid
rule: A lighting grid's structural supports and mounting hardware must be rated for the static and dynamic loads of all attached luminaires
conditions: grid supports luminaires
exceptions: temporary/suspended lighting without fixed attachment points

subject: Lighting Grid
rule: A lighting grid must not allow exposed live electrical conductors at any point accessible during normal operation or maintenance
conditions: grid carries electrical wiring for luminaires
exceptions: grids that use only low-voltage SELV/PELV systems with certified insulation

subject: Lighting Grid
rule: A lighting grid must maintain minimum clearance from combustible building materials as prescribed by applicable fire code
conditions: grid is installed adjacent to or within combustible construction
exceptions: grid components that are themselves listed fire-rated assemblies

subject: Lighting Grid
rule: A lighting grid must provide a reliable low-impedance path for fault current to the building grounding electrode system
conditions: grid is metallic and part of the electrical distribution system
exceptions: non-metallic grids or grids that do not carry branch-circuit wiring

subject: Lighting Grid
rule: A lighting grid must not shed or drop luminaires or grid components under design wind/seismic loads
conditions: grid is installed in a location subject to seismic or wind loading per applicable building code
exceptions: grids designed as frangible or breakaway elements where dropping is the intended fail-safe behavior

subject: Dance Floor Subfloor Assembly
rule: Dance floor subfloor assembly must be capable of supporting the design live load without excessive deflection
conditions: When used in a public dance floor application

subject: Dance Floor Subfloor Assembly
rule: Dance floor subfloor assembly must provide a level and stable surface within the specified flatness tolerance

subject: Dance Floor Subfloor Assembly
rule: Dance floor subfloor must not create a resonance condition that coincides with typical dance step frequencies
conditions: When designed as a sprung/raised floor system

subject: Dance Floor Subfloor Assembly
rule: Dance floor subfloor assembly must be installed over a properly vapor-retarded substrate when in contact with a concrete slab on grade
conditions: When the subfloor is installed directly over a concrete slab on grade or below-grade area

subject: Dance Floor Subfloor Assembly
rule: Dance floor subfloor assembly must not contain materials that off-gas at levels hazardous to occupants in the occupied space
conditions: When installed in an interior conditioned space

subject: Control Booth
rule: control booth must have a clear sightline to the stage or performance area
conditions: booth is used for live sound, lighting, or video operation
booth is positioned in a venue with a defined stage

subject: Control Booth
rule: control booth must have electrical power supply

subject: Control Booth
rule: control booth must be separated from the auditorium by a fire-rated barrier where required by code
conditions: booth is in a building subject to fire code
booth opens into an occupied assembly space

subject: Floor Receptacle Boxes
rule: Floor receptacle boxes must be securely fastened to the subfloor or framing structure
conditions: When installed in new construction
When located in accessible areas
exceptions: When used as temporary power during construction (if permitted by code)

subject: Floor Receptacle Boxes
rule: Floor receptacle boxes must have a cover plate or floor-plate assembly that is flush with the finished floor surface
conditions: When installed in finished flooring areas
exceptions: When box is located in a concealed/unfinished space not intended for occupancy

subject: Floor Receptacle Boxes
rule: Floor receptacle boxes must not be installed in locations where standing water is expected to accumulate
conditions: In areas subject to regular flooding, washing, or drainage
exceptions: When box is specifically rated for wet locations (e.g., listed as 'floor box' with watertight gasketed cover and drainage)

subject: Swimming Pool
rule: swimming pool water depth must not exceed structural containment limits
conditions: water-retaining structure

subject: Swimming Pool
rule: swimming pool perimeter must have a barrier (fence, wall, or cover) preventing unsupervised access by small children
conditions: outdoor installation
accessible to general public or residential use
exceptions: pools with rigid safety cover rated to safety standards when pool is not in use
pools in secure buildings where building envelope already provides equivalent access control

subject: Swimming Pool
rule: swimming pool circulation/filtration system must be operational during occupied periods
conditions: pool is in use or occupied

subject: Swimming Pool
rule: swimming pool water must not be electrically conductive to ground in an uncontrolled path
conditions: electrical equipment present within 5m of pool water

subject: Pool Water Recirculation System
rule: Pool water recirculation system must have a continuously closed loop from return inlets to suction outlets to maintain hydraulic prime and prevent pump cavitation
conditions: system is operating
exceptions: system is drained for maintenance

subject: Pool Water Recirculation System
rule: Pool water recirculation pump must be located below the water level of the pool (flooded suction) or be equipped with a self-priming mechanism
conditions: pump is at same elevation or above pool water level
exceptions: pump is self-priming and meets manufacturer lift specification

subject: Pool Water Recirculation System
rule: Pool water recirculation piping must not contain air-lock segments where high points lack air release valves
conditions: piping has peaks higher than both adjacent sections
exceptions: system is designed with continuous upward slope to an air release point

subject: Pool Water Recirculation System
rule: Pool water recirculation system must include a means of measuring flow rate (flow meter or equivalent) on the return line
conditions: system is required to meet health code turnover rate
exceptions: system serves a private residential pool with no regulatory turnover requirement

subject: Pool Lighting
rule: Pool lighting must be rated for wet locations
conditions: pool lighting is installed in or directly adjacent to the pool water
exceptions: lighting located more than 5 ft from the pool edge in a fully enclosed dry niche

subject: Pool Lighting
rule: Pool lighting must be supplied by a low-voltage system not exceeding 15 volts
conditions: pool lighting is submerged or in contact with pool water

subject: Pool Lighting
rule: Pool lighting must be bonded to the pool bonding grid
exceptions: lighting that is listed as double-insulated and does not require bonding per manufacturer specification and local code

subject: Pool Lighting
rule: Pool lighting must be protected by a ground-fault circuit interrupter (GFCI)

subject: Pool Heating System
rule: Pool heating system must have adequate freeze protection (e.g., antifreeze, recirculation, or drainage provisions) when installed in climates where freezing temperatures occur
conditions: Located in climate zone with anticipated freezing temperatures
exceptions: System is designed to be fully drained and winterized during freezing periods

subject: Pool Heating System
rule: Pool heating system must have a flow switch or interlock that prevents burner/compressor operation when water flow is insufficient
conditions: System uses a gas burner, heat pump compressor, or electrical resistance heating element

subject: Pool Heating System
rule: Pool heating system must not have gas-fired heater flue terminals located within enclosed pool structures without proper combustion air and venting to outdoors
conditions: Gas-fired pool heater installed indoors or within a enclosed pool building
exceptions: Installation complies with applicable mechanical code for enclosed pool heater venting with dedicated combustion air supply

subject: Pool Heating System
rule: Pool heating system's heat exchanger must have a pressure relief valve on the water side
conditions: System includes a closed-loop heat exchanger (gas, heat pump, or solar)

subject: Pool Heating System
rule: Pool heating system must not operate without a properly sized circulation pump providing minimum design flow rate through the heater
conditions: System is not installed in a gravity-fed or thermosiphon configuration

subject: Pool Cover System
rule: Pool cover system must be capable of supporting the design live load (e.g., snow, maintenance personnel) without collapse or excessive deflection
conditions: When pool cover is installed in a location where snow accumulation is possible
When pool cover is designed to support pedestrian loads
exceptions: Covers designed exclusively as safety barriers with no load-bearing function and clearly marked as such

subject: Pool Cover System
rule: Pool cover system must form a continuous barrier that prevents a child or small adult from falling into the pool when the cover is secured in its closed position
conditions: When the cover is intended for safety/security purposes
exceptions: Decorative or seasonal covers not marketed or intended for safety are excluded

subject: Pool Cover System
rule: Pool cover system must not fully seal the pool surface such that trapped gases (e.g., chlorine fumes) cannot escape without an intentional vent path
conditions: When the cover is a solid, non-breathable membrane that creates an airtight seal over the water surface
exceptions: Covers with integral passive ventilation systems designed to mitigate gas accumulation

subject: Pool Deck
rule: Pool deck surface must have a non-slip finish or texture
conditions: Pool deck is adjacent to a pool of water
Pool deck is accessible to users

subject: Pool Deck
rule: Pool deck must be sloped for drainage away from the pool
conditions: Pool deck is outdoors or exposed to water splash

subject: Pool Deck
rule: Pool deck must not have gaps or openings that could trap fingers, toes, or limbs
conditions: Pool deck has grating, deck boards, or expansion joints
exceptions: Gaps required by code for seismic or expansion purposes where gap width is less than 5 mm or greater than 25 mm to avoid entrapment

subject: Pool Deck
rule: Pool deck surface material must be chemically resistant to chlorine and common pool chemicals
conditions: Pool deck is adjacent to a chemically treated pool

subject: Pool Stairs and Ladders
rule: pool stairs and ladders must be constructed from corrosion-resistant materials (e.g., stainless steel, aluminum, or marine-grade polymer)
conditions: pool stairs and ladders are installed in a water environment
pool water is treated with chemicals such as chlorine or salt

subject: Pool Stairs and Ladders
rule: pool stairs and ladders must have slip-resistant treads or steps
conditions: pool stairs and ladders are used for ingress or egress from the water

subject: Pool Stairs and Ladders
rule: pool stairs and ladders must be securely anchored or fastened to the pool structure or deck
conditions: pool stairs and ladders are installed for use

subject: Pool Stairs and Ladders
rule: pool stairs and ladders must not have sharp edges, protruding hardware, or pinch points
conditions: pool stairs and ladders are accessible to swimmers

subject: Pool Coping
rule: Pool coping must have a continuous, sealed joint between coping and pool shell to prevent water infiltration behind the pool structure
conditions: for in-ground concrete pools with tile or plaster finish

subject: Pool Coping
rule: Pool coping must be non-absorbent or have a sealed surface to prevent water absorption and freeze-thaw damage
conditions: in climates where freezing temperatures occur
exceptions: dry climates with no freeze-thaw cycling

subject: Pool Coping
rule: Pool coping must have a slip-resistant surface finish
exceptions: areas that are never walked on by bare feet (e.g., purely decorative raised bond beam with no access)

subject: Pool Coping
rule: Pool coping must not have sharp edges or corners

subject: Pool Coping
rule: Pool coping must project at least 25-30 mm beyond the pool shell face to create a drip edge that prevents water from running down the pool wall
conditions: for in-ground pools

subject: Pool Chemical Treatment System
rule: pool chemical treatment system must be located in a well-ventilated area or equipped with mechanical ventilation
conditions: indoor installation

subject: Pool Chemical Treatment System
rule: pool chemical treatment system must not be installed where it can spill or leak chemicals into the pool body or circulation piping

subject: Pool Chemical Treatment System
rule: pool chemical treatment system must have secondary containment (dike or bund) for liquid chemical storage vessels
conditions: system includes liquid chemical storage tanks

subject: Pool Chemical Treatment System
rule: pool chemical treatment system must not allow mixing of incompatible chemicals (e.g., acid and chlorine) within the system

subject: Pool Drainage and Overflow System
rule: Pool drainage and overflow system must have a continuous gravity flow path from the pool outlet to the discharge point or collection system
exceptions: When the system uses a fully enclosed pumped overflow recovery system with dedicated pump

subject: Pool Drainage and Overflow System
rule: Pool overflow system must not allow backflow of drainage water into the pool basin
conditions: When the overflow system is connected to a sanitary sewer or combined drainage system

subject: Pool Drainage and Overflow System
rule: Pool drainage and overflow system must have sufficient hydraulic capacity to convey the maximum anticipated overflow rate without surcharging

subject: Pool Drainage and Overflow System
rule: Pool overflow drainage outlets must be equipped with a debris screen or grating with openings small enough to prevent entrapment but large enough to prevent clogging
conditions: When the overflow system includes open channel gutters, deck drains, or scupper outlets
exceptions: Systems using only submerged main-drain piping with no surface openings

subject: Decorative Water Feature
rule: decorative water feature must have a contained water volume that does not exceed the structural load capacity of its supporting surface or structure
conditions: when the water feature is installed on a raised structure, rooftop, or elevated deck
exceptions: free-standing water features installed directly on grade (ground) where structural load is not a concern

subject: Decorative Water Feature
rule: decorative water feature must have a water containment system that is watertight to prevent uncontrolled leakage
conditions: when the water feature includes a basin, pool, or recirculating water system
exceptions: water features designed intentionally to allow water to seep or drain (e.g., rock seep features with planned drainage)

subject: Decorative Water Feature
rule: decorative water feature must not have electrical components exposed to water or positioned where water can enter enclosures in a manner causing short-circuit or electrocution risk
conditions: when the water feature includes pumps, lighting, or any electrical equipment
exceptions: components specifically rated and certified for submerged or wet-location use per applicable electrical codes

subject: Decorative Water Feature
rule: decorative water feature must not be positioned such that wind-driven water spray enters building openings (windows, doors, air intakes) in quantities that cause moisture damage or indoor air quality issues
conditions: when the water feature is located within 3 meters of building openings
exceptions: water features designed with integrated wind barriers or spray patterns that are demonstrated to not reach building openings under all prevailing wind conditions

subject: Artificial Stream / Channel
rule: channel must have a continuous, unobstructed flow path from inlet to outlet
conditions: when functioning as a drainage or water conveyance element

subject: Artificial Stream / Channel
rule: channel cross-section must provide positive gravity-driven slope toward outlet
conditions: when designed for gravity flow (non-pressurized)

subject: Artificial Stream / Channel
rule: channel lining or bed must resist erosion at design flow velocity
conditions: when conveying water at velocity exceeding native soil erosion threshold

subject: Artificial Stream / Channel
rule: channel must not allow water to overflow its banks at design capacity
conditions: when designed for a specific capacity event (e.g., 10-year, 100-year storm)

subject: Artificial Stream / Channel
rule: channel inlet and outlet must be physically connected to the upstream and downstream drainage system respectively
conditions: when part of a continuous drainage network

subject: Stream Pump and Recirculation System
rule: Stream pump and recirculation system must maintain positive suction head at all operating conditions
conditions: system is operational
exceptions: during controlled shutdown sequence

subject: Stream Pump and Recirculation System
rule: Stream pump and recirculation system must not operate with closed suction or discharge valve while pump is running
conditions: pump motor is energized
exceptions: during momentary priming sequence if pump manufacturer explicitly permits it

subject: Stream Pump and Recirculation System
rule: Stream pump and recirculation system piping must be arranged to prevent vapor lock at pump inlet
conditions: pump handles liquid near its vapor pressure
system is in continuous operation

subject: Pool Basin Waterproofing Membrane
rule: Pool basin waterproofing membrane must be continuous across the entire pool basin surface without gaps or breaks
conditions: applies to all pool basin constructions
exceptions: intentional drainage points or penetrations designed with sealed collars

subject: Pool Basin Waterproofing Membrane
rule: Pool basin waterproofing membrane must be compatible with the substrate and any applied adhesives or sealants
conditions: applies to all membrane installations

subject: Pool Basin Waterproofing Membrane
rule: Pool basin waterproofing membrane must not be used at expansion or movement joints without a specifically designed movement-capable joint detail
conditions: where the membrane is applied over building expansion joints or construction joints subject to differential movement
exceptions: specifically engineered movement joint cover systems designed for compatibility with the waterproofing membrane

subject: Pool Equipment Room
rule: pool equipment room must have a drainage path to handle equipment leaks and condensation
conditions: room contains equipment with water connections (filters, pumps, heaters)
room is located below grade or at grade

subject: Pool Equipment Room
rule: pool equipment room must have electrical receptacles protected by ground-fault circuit interrupters (GFCI)
conditions: room contains electrical equipment within 6 feet of water connections or wash-down area

subject: Pool Equipment Room
rule: pool equipment room must have adequate ventilation or mechanical exhaust for combustion equipment and chemical off-gassing
conditions: room contains gas-fired heaters
or room contains chemical feeders or chlorine/pH storage

subject: Pool Equipment Room
rule: pool equipment room must have corrosion-resistant materials on all surfaces subject to chemical exposure
conditions: room stores or handles pool chemicals (chlorine, acid, algaecides)

subject: Pool Tile Finish
rule: Pool tile finish must be non-porous (water absorption rate < 0.5%)
conditions: Tile is installed in contact with pool water

subject: Pool Tile Finish
rule: Pool tile finish must be frost-resistant when installed in freeze-thaw climates
conditions: Pool is located in a region where ambient temperature drops below freezing
exceptions: Indoor pools in climate-controlled environments that never reach freezing temperatures

subject: Pool Tile Finish
rule: Pool tile finish must be chlorine-resistant (no degradation from chlorinated water exposure)
conditions: Pool uses chlorine-based sanitization
exceptions: Pools using only non-chlorine sanitizers such as bromine or saltwater chlorine generators at appropriate levels

subject: Pool Tile Finish
rule: Pool tile finish must have a slip resistance of at least 0.42 COF (wet) on walking surfaces
conditions: Tile is installed on horizontal or sloped surfaces intended for foot traffic (e.g., pool deck, steps, sun shelf)
exceptions: Vertical wall tiles not subject to foot traffic

subject: Pool Tile Finish
rule: Pool tile finish must not contain lead or heavy metals that can leach into pool water
conditions: Tile finish contacts pool water

subject: Delivery Room
rule: Delivery room must have handwashing sink accessible within direct line of sight from the entry or scrub station area
conditions: when used for surgical or sterile procedures
exceptions: when delivery room is designated exclusively for low-risk, non-interventional natural birth without any surgical planned backup

subject: Delivery Room
rule: Delivery room must have medical gas outlets (oxygen, vacuum, and medical air) installed on the headwall
conditions: when the facility provides interventional obstetric care
when room is classified as a cesarean-capable delivery room
exceptions: temporary birthing centers not licensed as healthcare facilities
home-birth environments

subject: Delivery Room
rule: Delivery room floor must be cleanable, seamless, and resistant to staining and fluids

subject: Delivery Room
rule: Delivery room must not have exposed sharp corners or protruding edges on built-in casework, columns, or door hardware below 72 inches

subject: Delivery Room
rule: Delivery room must have emergency electrical power (generator-backed outlets and lighting) for life-safety equipment
exceptions: facilities not licensed or classified as healthcare occupancies under applicable building code

subject: Delivery Room
rule: Delivery room must have a minimum clear floor area of at least 250 sq ft (excluding fixed cabinetry and baby warming station)
conditions: when the room is designed for active labor and delivery with obstetrical team present

subject: Nursery
rule: nursery must have at least one accessible egress path to the exterior that does not require passing through any other dwelling unit or hazardous space
conditions: nursery is a ground-floor or egress-compliant space
nursery is occupied by children
exceptions: if the nursery is part of a single-family dwelling with direct outdoor access at grade

subject: Nursery
rule: nursery windows in occupied rooms must have fall protection if sill height is less than 24 inches above the floor
conditions: nursery is located above the ground floor
window is operable or openable by children
exceptions: if window is fixed (non-operable) and glazing is safety-rated

subject: Nursery
rule: nursery floor finish must be cleanable, non-porous, and slip-resistant
conditions: nursery is used for infant or toddler activities involving food, bodily fluids, or wet play
exceptions: if a separate dedicated diaper-changing and feeding area with impervious flooring is provided

subject: Nursery
rule: nursery must not have freestanding furniture or equipment that could tip over and is not anchored to the structure
conditions: nursery contains shelving units, bookcases, wardrobes, or similar tall furniture
exceptions: if all furniture is less than 30 inches in height or is designed with a base wider than its height

subject: Nursery
rule: nursery must have a hand-washing sink with tempered water within the space or immediately adjacent
conditions: nursery provides diaper-changing services or food preparation
exceptions: if an adjacent janitorial sink with hands-free controls is provided within 10 feet of the nursery entrance

subject: Nursery
rule: nursery must have electrical outlets protected by tamper-resistant receptacles or outlet covers
conditions: electrical outlets are within reach of children (below 48 inches from floor)
exceptions: if the nursery is a temporary or short-term setup that is continuously supervised by an adult-to-child ratio of 1:2 or less

subject: Birthing Pool Area
rule: Birthing Pool Area floor must be slip-resistant to prevent falls when wet
conditions: floor is exposed to water from pool usage

subject: Birthing Pool Area
rule: Birthing Pool Area must have a floor drain or sloped floor to a drain to manage overflow and spillage
conditions: pool is filled with water for use

subject: Birthing Pool Area
rule: Birthing Pool Area must have a dedicated tempered water supply at appropriate flow rate for pool filling
conditions: pool is used for water birth

subject: Recovery Room
rule: Recovery room must have a minimum of two egress paths (doors) located at opposite ends of the space
conditions: Room serves post-anesthesia or post-surgical patients
Room is classified as an outpatient or inpatient recovery area under applicable building code
exceptions: Single-occupancy recovery rooms less than 100 sq ft with direct exit to a corridor that leads to a rated exit

subject: Recovery Room
rule: Recovery room walls and ceiling must have a minimum fire-resistance rating of 1 hour
conditions: Recovery room is part of a hospital, surgical center, or other healthcare occupancy classified as Institutional (I-2)
exceptions: Rooms protected throughout by an approved automatic sprinkler system (may reduce to 30-minute rated construction in some codes)

subject: Recovery Room
rule: Recovery room must have medical gas outlets (oxygen and vacuum) installed on the headwall
conditions: Recovery room is classified as Phase I or Phase II post-anesthesia care unit (PACU)
exceptions: Recovery rooms used exclusively for Phase III (minimal sedation) recovery where patients are fully conscious and mobile

subject: Recovery Room
rule: Recovery room must have a hand-washing sink adjacent to the room or within the patient bay
conditions: Multiple patient beds are present in the same recovery room
exceptions: Single-bed recovery rooms where a hand-washing station is located directly outside the room door within the same circulation path

subject: Newborn Resuscitation Station
rule: newborn resuscitation station must have a direct, unobstructed line-of-sight to the delivery area or be equipped with real-time video monitoring of the delivery bed
conditions: station is located outside the immediate delivery room
exceptions: station is integrated into the delivery bed itself

subject: Newborn Resuscitation Station
rule: newborn resuscitation station must have a radiant warmer with a servo-controlled temperature sensor

subject: Newborn Resuscitation Station
rule: newborn resuscitation station must have a blended oxygen-air source with flowmeter capable of delivering 0–100% FiO2 at 5–10 L/min

subject: Newborn Resuscitation Station
rule: newborn resuscitation station must have a suction source with pressure regulator capable of 80–100 mmHg negative pressure
exceptions: meconium-stained liquor requiring intubation suction

subject: Newborn Resuscitation Station
rule: newborn resuscitation station must not have any exposed sharp edges, corners, or pinch-points within the infant care zone

subject: Newborn Resuscitation Station
rule: newborn resuscitation station must have an integral clock with seconds display visible from the primary caregiver position

subject: Birth Bed / Obstetric Table
rule: birth bed / obstetric table must have a smooth, non-porous, easily cleanable surface
conditions: used in clinical or sterile environment

subject: Birth Bed / Obstetric Table
rule: birth bed / obstetric table must support the full weight of a patient in lithotomy position without structural collapse

subject: Birth Bed / Obstetric Table
rule: birth bed / obstetric table must not have sharp edges or protrusions in the patient contact zone

subject: Birth Bed / Obstetric Table
rule: birth bed / obstetric table leg support stirrups must be securely lockable in position
conditions: includes leg supports or stirrups

subject: Birth Bed / Obstetric Table
rule: birth bed / obstetric table must provide a continuous fluid-impermeable barrier between the patient and internal mechanisms

subject: Overhead Surgical Lighting System
rule: overhead surgical lighting system must be securely mounted to a structurally adequate ceiling or support rail
conditions: fixed installation

subject: Overhead Surgical Lighting System
rule: overhead surgical lighting system must have a backup power source or emergency battery
conditions: used in surgical environments where continuous illumination is critical

subject: Overhead Surgical Lighting System
rule: overhead surgical lighting system must not obstruct sterile airflow or HVAC diffusers above the surgical field
conditions: installed in operating rooms with laminar flow ventilation

subject: Overhead Surgical Lighting System
rule: overhead surgical lighting system must not generate temperatures above safe limits on its accessible surfaces
conditions: continuous operation at typical surgical duration

subject: Baby Warming Radiant Heater
rule: Baby Warming Radiant Heater must not be placed within direct splash or spray zone
conditions: when installed in a nursery or healthcare environment where liquids may be present
exceptions: heater is certified IPX5 or higher water ingress protection

subject: Baby Warming Radiant Heater
rule: Baby Warming Radiant Heater must have automatic over-temperature shutdown mechanism
conditions: when used for direct infant warming

subject: Baby Warming Radiant Heater
rule: Baby Warming Radiant Heater must not have exposed electrical terminals or conductors on surfaces reachable by an operator

subject: Baby Warming Radiant Heater
rule: Baby Warming Radiant Heater must have a stable base that prevents tipping when a lateral force is applied

subject: Medical Gas Wall Headwall System
rule: medical gas wall headwall system must be connected to a dedicated medical gas supply source with appropriate pressure and flow
conditions: when used for active patient care requiring medical gas delivery
exceptions: non-functional display/training units not connected to gas supply

subject: Medical Gas Wall Headwall System
rule: medical gas wall headwall system must not have incompatible gas outlet connections that could allow cross-connection between different gas services
conditions: when equipped with multiple gas outlets (e.g., oxygen, medical air, vacuum)
exceptions: single-gas systems with only one outlet type

subject: Medical Gas Wall Headwall System
rule: medical gas wall headwall system must be secured to the building structure in a manner that prevents dislodgement under normal and emergency use conditions
conditions: when installed in patient care areas

subject: Medical Gas Wall Headwall System
rule: medical gas wall headwall system must have gas outlets that are clearly and permanently labeled with the gas type and service
conditions: when any medical gas outlet is present

subject: Birthing Suite Patient Toilet Room
rule: Birthing Suite Patient Toilet Room must have a toilet fixture

subject: Birthing Suite Patient Toilet Room
rule: Birthing Suite Patient Toilet Room must have a handwashing sink

subject: Birthing Suite Patient Toilet Room
rule: Birthing Suite Patient Toilet Room must have an emergency call/nurse call device accessible from the toilet

subject: Birthing Suite Patient Toilet Room
rule: Birthing Suite Patient Toilet Room floor must be slip-resistant and cleanable

subject: Neonatal Intensive Care Cubicle
rule: Neonatal Intensive Care Cubicle must maintain positive air pressure relative to adjacent spaces
conditions: cubicle is part of a healthcare facility licensed for neonatal intensive care
exceptions: cubicle is used exclusively for patient isolation requiring negative pressure

subject: Neonatal Intensive Care Cubicle
rule: Neonatal Intensive Care Cubicle must have a handwashing sink immediately accessible within the cubicle or at its entry
conditions: cubicle provides patient care space
exceptions: cubicle is a temporary transport holding area not used for ongoing care

subject: Neonatal Intensive Care Cubicle
rule: Neonatal Intensive Care Cubicle must have at least six dedicated electrical receptacles per patient care location, with two on emergency power
conditions: cubicle contains a patient bed space

subject: Neonatal Intensive Care Cubicle
rule: Neonatal Intensive Care Cubicle must_not have ceiling-mounted light fixtures or equipment directly above the infant warming bed without protective shielding
conditions: cubicle contains a radiant warmer or incubator
exceptions: fixtures are recessed with flush lens and no projection risk

subject: C-Section Operating Theater
rule: C-Section Operating Theater must have sealed, smooth, non-porous wall, floor, and ceiling surfaces that can withstand frequent cleaning with disinfectants
conditions: Used for surgical procedures
Classified as sterile environment

subject: C-Section Operating Theater
rule: C-Section Operating Theater must have positive pressure relative to adjacent spaces with a minimum differential of 2.5 Pa
conditions: In use for surgery

subject: C-Section Operating Theater
rule: C-Section Operating Theater must have HEPA-filtered supply air (minimum MERV-16 or equivalent)
conditions: Surgery in progress

subject: C-Section Operating Theater
rule: C-Section Operating Theater must have a minimum of 15 air changes per hour (ACH)
conditions: Surgery in progress

subject: C-Section Operating Theater
rule: C-Section Operating Theater must not have exposed horizontal surfaces (shelves, ledges, pipe runs) that collect dust
conditions: Within sterile zone of the theater
exceptions: Essential surgical equipment mounted per sterile protocols

subject: C-Section Operating Theater
rule: C-Section Operating Theater must have an emergency power supply capable of supporting all life-safety systems (ventilation, surgical lighting, monitoring equipment)
conditions: Facility located in region with unreliable grid power or subject to code requiring backup for surgical suites

subject: Infant Security System Zone
rule: The infant security system zone must have continuous RFID or proximity sensor coverage with no blind spots
conditions: indoor infant security zone
active monitoring system

subject: Infant Security System Zone
rule: All exit points from the infant security zone must be fitted with a fail-secure latching or alarm mechanism
conditions: zone perimeter includes doors or gates
exceptions: emergency egress doors that must remain un-lockable from the inside per life-safety codes

subject: Infant Security System Zone
rule: The infant security system zone must not share air-handling ductwork with non-secured zones in a way that allows physical passage of a person
conditions: duct dimensions exceed 22 cm × 22 cm (i.e., large enough for a small infant to be passed through)
exceptions: ducts fitted with grilles, bars, or sensors that prevent or detect passage

subject: Birthing Suite Nurse Call System
rule: Birthing Suite Nurse Call System must provide a means for a patient in the birthing suite to summon nursing staff assistance
conditions: Patient is in the birthing suite

subject: Birthing Suite Nurse Call System
rule: Birthing Suite Nurse Call System must have audible and visual alert indicators at the nurse station that uniquely identify the calling room
exceptions: Facilities with a centralized digital nurse call display system that provides equivalent room-identification may substitute a single audible tone

subject: Birthing Suite Nurse Call System
rule: Birthing Suite Nurse Call System must not fail silent — loss of primary power must trigger a visible trouble indication or automatic failover

subject: Birthing Suite Nurse Call System
rule: Birthing Suite Nurse Call System must include a code blue (emergency) activation capability in each birthing room

subject: Birthing Suite Nurse Call System
rule: Birthing Suite Nurse Call System must not create a shock or fire hazard — all patient-accessible components must be electrically isolated per IEC 60601 or UL 1069

subject: Sacred Enclosure Wall
rule: wall must be able to resist lateral earth pressure and hydrostatic pressure when serving as a retaining structure
conditions: when the sacred enclosure wall functions as a retaining wall (e.g., built into sloping ground or below grade)
exceptions: wall does not retain any soil or water on either side

subject: Sacred Enclosure Wall
rule: wall must have a foundation that can bear its自重 weight and any imposed lateral loads without excessive settlement or overturning

subject: Sacred Enclosure Wall
rule: wall must not exceed its material's maximum compressive or tensile stress limits under any design load combination

subject: Birthing Suite Ceiling-Mount IV Track System
rule: ceiling-mount IV track system must be structurally anchored to building structure capable of supporting its design load (static plus rated dynamic load)
conditions: installed in birthing suite
ceiling-mounted configuration

subject: Birthing Suite Ceiling-Mount IV Track System
rule: ceiling-mount IV track system must not intrude into clear height/headroom zones required for safe movement of patients, staff, and equipment below
conditions: installed over patient bed area
installed over staff circulation paths

subject: Birthing Suite Ceiling-Mount IV Track System
rule: ceiling-mount IV track system must be installed with continuous load path to structure — no attachment solely to ceiling finish, dropped ceiling grid, or non-structural backing
conditions: any installation location within birthing suite

subject: Birthing Suite Ceiling-Mount IV Track System
rule: IV track rails and trolleys must be compatible in cross-section and engagement geometry — incompatible rail/trolley pairs must not be field-assembled
conditions: when track and trolley are from different manufacturers or different product series

subject: Altar Platform
rule: altar platform must be horizontally level (within structural tolerance)
conditions: when supporting any offering, statue, or ceremonial object
exceptions: intentionally sloped platforms for liquid offerings or drainage

subject: Altar Platform
rule: altar platform must not have any single unsupported span exceeding the structural capacity of its material
conditions: when constructed of stone, masonry, wood, or any solid material

subject: Holy Ground Drainage System
rule: drainage system must have a continuous gravity-driven flow path from inlet to outlet
exceptions: if pumped drainage is used

subject: Holy Ground Drainage System
rule: drainage system must not pass effluent through or beneath consecrated areas
exceptions: if effluent is fully sealed in an approved containment pipe and routed only through non-consecrated service zones

subject: Holy Ground Drainage System
rule: drainage system must have a minimum slope of 1:80 (1.25%) for foul water pipes
conditions: if the system conveys foul sewage
exceptions: if positive-pressure or vacuum sewer technology is employed

subject: Holy Ground Drainage System
rule: drainage system must not allow backflow of sewage into clean water sources

subject: Sacred Boundary Marker
rule: A sacred boundary marker must be physically fixed and stable in its ground position
conditions: Used as a permanent territorial or property demarcation
exceptions: Temporary or ceremonial boundary markers that are intentionally movable

subject: Sacred Boundary Marker
rule: Sacred boundary marker must not be constructed of materials that rapidly decay, rot, or erode within one seasonal cycle
conditions: Installed outdoors and intended as a long-term marker
exceptions: Markers designed as ephemeral ritual objects with known short lifespan

subject: Sacred Boundary Marker
rule: Sacred boundary marker must be legible or interpretable as a boundary indicator at ground level
conditions: Placed to define a spatial limit for human understanding
exceptions: Markers whose location is transmitted only through oral tradition and require no visual indication

subject: Holy Ground Lighting
rule: Holy Ground Lighting must maintain clearance from combustible materials
conditions: when installed in close proximity to flammable building fabric or staging
exceptions: when fully enclosed within a fire-rated housing certified to the relevant standard

subject: Holy Ground Lighting
rule: Holy Ground Lighting must have an IP rating appropriate to its mounting location
conditions: when installed outdoors, in unheated narthex, in crypts, or near baptismal fonts
exceptions: when mounted entirely inside a sealed weatherproof enclosure already rated for the exposure zone

subject: Holy Ground Lighting
rule: Holy Ground Lighting must not exceed the branch-circuit current rating of the supplying circuit

subject: Sacred Garden Bed
rule: Sacred Garden Bed soil must allow water drainage to prevent root rot and standing water
conditions: constructed as a planted garden bed
contains soil substrate
exceptions: designed as a water feature or bog garden where standing water is intentional

subject: Sacred Garden Bed
rule: Sacred Garden Bed must not be positioned where overhead soil or debris can fall onto occupants or ceremonial participants below
conditions: located above occupied space
contains loose soil or granular growing medium
exceptions: fully sealed or contained system with impermeable liner and structural cover prevents any material fall-through

subject: Kneeling Rail
rule: kneeling rail must be located between the buffer beam and the first axle of the vehicle
conditions: vehicle equipped with buffing and draw gear at standard coupling height
exceptions: vehicles with retractable or removable kneeling rails

subject: Kneeling Rail
rule: kneeling rail must have a ground clearance less than or equal to that of the vehicle's lowest fixed structure
conditions: kneeling rail is fitted to a rail vehicle
exceptions: vehicles with variable-height suspension that raises the rail at speed

subject: Kneeling Rail
rule: kneeling rail must be continuous across the full width between the side frames or solebars
conditions: kneeling rail is fitted as a fixed bar across the vehicle width
exceptions: split-rail designs where two independently mounted rails overlap in coverage

subject: Kneeling Rail
rule: kneeling rail must not deflect upward under impact load
conditions: kneeling rail is in service and subjected to end-load or obstacle strike
exceptions: designed energy-absorption deformation that redirects downward only

subject: Sacred Water Feature
rule: water in sacred water feature must be contained by an impermeable lining or basin
conditions: if feature holds standing water
exceptions: natural groundwater-fed features where soil composition provides natural sealing

subject: Sacred Water Feature
rule: recirculation pump intake must be submerged at all times during operation
conditions: if feature uses mechanical recirculation

subject: Sacred Water Feature
rule: overflow drainage must be provided to prevent basin overtopping
conditions: if feature receives water from a supply source or rainfall

subject: Sacred Water Feature
rule: water feature must not be located directly above unconditioned habitable space without a waterproof membrane and secondary drainage
conditions: if feature is interior or located over occupiable space

subject: Holy Ground HVAC Supply
rule: HVAC supply airflow must be sufficient to meet the design heating and cooling load of the supplied zone
conditions: When system is operational

subject: Holy Ground HVAC Supply
rule: Supply air temperature must remain above the dew point of the surrounding air to prevent condensation on duct surfaces
conditions: When ducts pass through unconditioned spaces or spaces with high humidity
exceptions: When ducts are explicitly designed and insulated for condensation handling

subject: Holy Ground HVAC Supply
rule: HVAC supply duct static pressure must not exceed the rated maximum static pressure of the fan or air-handling unit

subject: Fixed Sacred Seating
rule: Fixed sacred seating must have a minimum clear width of at least 0.45 m (18 inches) per seated occupant for egress
conditions: When seating is arranged in rows
When seating is used for assembly occupancy
exceptions: When seating is continuous bench without defined individual positions, aisle-based width calculation applies instead

subject: Fixed Sacred Seating
rule: Fixed sacred seating must be anchored to the floor or structure to resist overturning under lateral loads
conditions: Where seating is not attached to a larger structural assembly (e.g., stepped riser)
In seismic zones or wind-prone regions
exceptions: Seating that is monolithic with the structure (e.g., concrete steps cast in place) does not require separate anchorage

subject: Fixed Sacred Seating
rule: Fixed sacred seating must not have sharp edges or protruding corners within the occupant circulation zone
conditions: At heights between 0.15 m and 2.0 m above finished floor
exceptions: Liturgical or symbolic elements intentionally protruding and protected by railings or guards are exempt from corner-radius rules but must still avoid laceration hazard

subject: Lawn / Turf
rule: Lawn / Turf must have positive drainage away from building structures
conditions: when installed adjacent to building foundations
exceptions: when designed as a rain garden or bioswale with engineered waterproofing between turf and structure

subject: Lawn / Turf
rule: Lawn / Turf must not be installed over utility access points that require periodic maintenance
conditions: where underground utilities (water, gas, electric, telecom) have manholes, valves, or junction boxes within the turf area
exceptions: when access points are fitted with permanent turf-grade access covers marked and detectable

subject: Lawn / Turf
rule: Lawn / Turf must have a stable growing medium depth of at least 150 mm (6 in) for healthy root development
conditions: where the turf is intended to sustain plant health and soil coverage
exceptions: green roof systems with engineered lightweight growing medium where 100 mm is acceptable per manufacturer specification

subject: Tree / Shrub Planting Bed
rule: tree/shrub planting bed must have a minimum soil volume of 15 cubic feet (0.42 m³) per shrub or 75 cubic feet (2.1 m³) per tree to sustain root growth
conditions: planting bed is intended to support long-term plant survival
exceptions: temporary or seasonal decorative planting beds that will be replanted annually

subject: Tree / Shrub Planting Bed
rule: tree/shrub planting bed must have positive drainage (surface or subsurface) to prevent waterlogging
exceptions: bog-garden or rain-garden planting beds specifically designed for saturated conditions

subject: Tree / Shrub Planting Bed
rule: tree/shrub planting bed must have a minimum depth of 18 inches (460 mm) of uncompacted soil
exceptions: beds for shallow-rooted shrub species only, where 12 inches may suffice

subject: Tree / Shrub Planting Bed
rule: tree/shrub planting bed must not be located directly above underground utility lines or septic fields without protective measures
conditions: bed is in-ground (not in a planter above grade)
exceptions: tree/shrub species with non-invasive root systems planted with root barriers approved by the utility authority

subject: Paved Walkway
rule: paved walkway must have a minimum cross-slope of 1% for drainage
conditions: exposed to precipitation
located outdoors
exceptions: walkway is covered by a roof or canopy

subject: Paved Walkway
rule: paved walkway must not have standing water on its surface after precipitation
conditions: exposed to precipitation
exceptions: ephemeral puddles that evaporate within 30 minutes under design conditions

subject: Paved Walkway
rule: paved walkway must have a maximum longitudinal slope of 5% for accessible pedestrian use
conditions: designated as accessible pedestrian route
subject to ADA or equivalent accessibility requirements
exceptions: exception allowed where site conditions prevent compliance and alternative accessible route is provided

subject: Paved Walkway
rule: paved walkway must have a minimum width of 36 inches (0.91 m) for single wheelchair passage
conditions: designated as accessible pedestrian route
exceptions: existing constraints where width cannot be increased and alternative accessible route exists

subject: Plaza / Hardscape
rule: Plaza / hardscape surface must have a minimum cross-slope of 1% (1/8" per foot) for drainage
conditions: Surface is impermeable (concrete, asphalt, unit pavers on full mortar bed)
Surface is exposed to precipitation
exceptions: Surface is designed as a retention/detention area with engineered sub-base drainage
Surface is permeable paving with integrated subsurface drainage system

subject: Plaza / Hardscape
rule: Plaza / hardscape must not have discontinuous trip hazards exceeding 1/4 inch at joints or transitions
conditions: Surface is intended for pedestrian access
exceptions: Historic preservation requirements where full compliance would destroy the character of a listed structure

subject: Plaza / Hardscape
rule: Plaza / hardscape surface materials must have a wet coefficient of friction (COF) of at least 0.5 when tested per ASTM C1028
conditions: Surface is in a climate with average annual rainfall above 20 inches
Surface is sloped more than 2%
exceptions: Surface is covered by a permanent canopy or roof
Surface is a decorative water feature basin not intended for pedestrian traffic

subject: Plaza / Hardscape
rule: Plaza / hardscape must not trap water against adjacent building foundations or basement walls
conditions: Plaza adjoins a building with a below-grade occupied space
exceptions: Plaza is separated from the building foundation by a waterproofed retaining wall and a drainage plane meeting code requirements

subject: Site Drainage System
rule: Site drainage system must have continuous gravity flow path from collection points to discharge point
conditions: Site is not designed for pumped drainage
exceptions: Site uses fully redundant mechanical pumping system with emergency power

subject: Site Drainage System
rule: Site drainage system must not discharge onto adjacent properties without legal easement
exceptions: Adjacent property owner has granted written drainage easement

subject: Site Drainage System
rule: Site drainage system must have positive slope (minimum 0.5%) on all unlined overland flow paths
conditions: Flow path is unpaved swale or overland sheet flow
exceptions: Flow path is fully enclosed pipe system

subject: Site Drainage System
rule: Site drainage system must have outlet at a point where water can leave the site by gravity
conditions: System relies on gravity drainage
exceptions: System uses lift station/pumps as primary means of discharge

subject: Fence / Gate
rule: gates must swing freely through their full intended arc without obstruction
conditions: gate is present
gate is hinged (not sliding or removable)

subject: Fence / Gate
rule: gate latch and locking mechanism must engage correctly when the gate is closed
conditions: gate has a latch or lock

subject: Fence / Gate
rule: fence posts must be embedded, anchored, or ballasted to resist anticipated wind and impact loads without toppling
conditions: fence is freestanding (not supported by a building wall)

subject: Fence / Gate
rule: gate must not sag such that it drags on the ground or fails to operate
conditions: gate is hinged

subject: Signage / Wayfinding
rule: signage must remain legible under all expected lighting conditions
conditions: signage is installed in a publicly accessible location
signage conveys safety or directional information
exceptions: signage is intentionally designed as emergency back-up system activated only in darkness

subject: Signage / Wayfinding
rule: signage must not be positioned where it can be physically obstructed by building elements or movable objects under normal use

subject: Signage / Wayfinding
rule: signage must comply with minimum contrast ratio between text and background
conditions: signage contains text
signage is intended for general public use

subject: Signage / Wayfinding
rule: signage must not contain hazardous materials in locations accessible to the public
conditions: signage is mounted within reach of building occupants

subject: Outdoor Lighting
rule: Outdoor lighting fixtures must be rated for wet or damp locations as appropriate for their exposure to moisture
conditions: Outdoor installation
Fixture is exposed to rain, snow, or condensation

subject: Outdoor Lighting
rule: Outdoor lighting must have a ground-fault circuit interrupter (GFCI) protected supply

exceptions: Fixed lighting fixtures mounted at least 2.4 m above grade and not readily accessible may be exempt per some code versions

subject: Outdoor Lighting
rule: Outdoor lighting must not be installed in direct contact with combustible materials unless the fixture is listed for that purpose

subject: Plaza Fountain / Water Feature
rule: Plaza fountain / water feature must have a contained water circulation system with pump and filtration
conditions: the feature recirculates water
it is connected to building mechanical/plumbing systems
exceptions: fountains that are strictly drain-to-waste with no recirculation
naturalistic water features relying solely on municipal supply and drain

subject: Plaza Fountain / Water Feature
rule: Plaza fountain / water feature basin must be watertight (lined or sealed) and connected to an overflow drain
conditions: the feature holds standing or recirculating water
exceptions: a completely drain-to-waste feature with no water retention

subject: Plaza Fountain / Water Feature
rule: Plaza fountain / water feature must not have electrical components (pumps, lighting, controls) that are exposed to water without proper waterproofing and ground-fault protection
conditions: the fountain includes electrical equipment within or adjacent to water
exceptions: low-voltage landscape lighting fully outside the water contact zone

subject: Plaza Fountain / Water Feature
rule: Plaza fountain / water feature must have a freeze-protection strategy in climates where temperatures drop below freezing
conditions: the fountain is installed in a climate with freezing winter temperatures
the fountain holds water year-round or seasonally
exceptions: fountains fully drained and winterized before each freeze season
indoor or heated-plaza fountains

subject: Landscape Subsoil / Topsoil
rule: Landscape subsoil/topsoil must have a minimum depth of 150 mm for typical planting applications
conditions: when used as growing medium for plants
when used in landscape/garden areas
exceptions: green roof systems with engineered growing media may use shallower depths where specified

subject: Landscape Subsoil / Topsoil
rule: Landscape subsoil/topsoil must not be placed directly against building foundations without a drainage layer or waterproofing barrier
conditions: when adjacent to building structures with below-grade walls or foundations
exceptions: where a专门的 drainage system and waterproofing membrane are designed and installed to manage moisture

subject: Landscape Subsoil / Topsoil
rule: Landscape subsoil/topsoil must not contain debris, contaminants, or oversized material exceeding 75 mm in diameter
conditions: when specified for use as planting soil
exceptions: fill applications where no planting occurs and contamination is within regulatory limits

subject: Exterior Stair / Ramp
rule: Exterior stair/ramp must have a slip-resistant tread surface
conditions: surface exposed to weather

subject: Exterior Stair / Ramp
rule: Exterior stair/ramp must have stair nosings or edge markings that provide visual contrast

subject: Exterior Stair / Ramp
rule: Exterior stair/ramp must have a landing at the top and bottom

subject: Exterior Stair / Ramp
rule: Exterior stair/ramp must have handrails on both sides when the total rise exceeds 30 inches or ramp slope exceeds 1:20

subject: Exterior Stair / Ramp
rule: Exterior stair/ramp must not have standing water on treads or running surfaces after drainage

subject: Exterior Stair / Ramp
rule: Exterior stair/ramp treads must be designed such that open risers (if any) do not allow passage of a 4-inch-diameter sphere
conditions: stair has open risers

subject: Play Structure Climbing Wall
rule: climbing wall handholds and footholds must be securely attached to withstand dynamic loads from children climbing and falling
conditions: when the climbing wall is in use by children

subject: Play Structure Climbing Wall
rule: climbing wall must not have gaps or openings between 3.5 inches and 9 inches that could entrap a child's head
conditions: when the climbing wall is designed for children ages 2-12

subject: Play Structure Climbing Wall
rule: climbing wall must have a maximum fall height that corresponds to an appropriate impact-attenuating surface underneath
conditions: when the climbing wall is installed in a playground setting

subject: Play Structure Climbing Wall
rule: climbing wall must not have protrusions that could impale or lacerate a falling child
conditions: when the climbing wall is accessible to children

subject: Ball Pit Enclosure
rule: enclosure walls must be at least as tall as the deepest point of the ball pit to prevent balls from spilling out
conditions: enclosure contains a ball pit
enclosure uses loose fill balls

subject: Ball Pit Enclosure
rule: enclosure must have a means of egress (opening or gate) that allows a person to enter and exit
conditions: enclosure is designed for human occupancy
exceptions: enclosure is purely decorative and not intended for human entry

subject: Ball Pit Enclosure
rule: enclosure walls must not have sharp edges, exposed fasteners, or pinch points on interior surfaces at contact height
conditions: enclosure is intended for children's play

subject: Ball Pit Enclosure
rule: enclosure must be constructed from materials that can withstand the static load of filled balls pushing against the walls without rupture or excessive deflection
conditions: enclosure walls contain loose fill balls

subject: Indoor Slide / Tube Slide
rule: A tube slide running indoors must have a minimum clearance of 2x the slide diameter (or 1.5 m, whichever is greater) on all sides from walls, columns, and other fixed obstructions to allow emergency rescue access
conditions: slide is enclosed (tube type)

subject: Indoor Slide / Tube Slide
rule: The exit of an indoor slide must discharge into a clear zone free of pedestrian traffic paths, furniture, doors, or other obstacles with a minimum run-out zone of at least 1.8 m beyond the slide exit

subject: Indoor Slide / Tube Slide
rule: The slide tunnel must have a minimum internal diameter of at least 0.6 m (24 in) to prevent entrapment and allow self-rescue
conditions: slide is a tube/enclosed type

subject: Indoor Slide / Tube Slide
rule: Indoor slide angle of inclination must not exceed 34 degrees (measured from horizontal) for a straight slide and 30 degrees for a spiral or curved slide
exceptions: Standalone commercial waterslides or thrill slides with attended operation and height/age restrictions may exceed this angle

subject: Indoor Slide / Tube Slide
rule: Indoor slide must have a landing at the exit no higher than 0.35 m (14 in) above the floor or impact-attenuating surface
conditions: slide is intended for children aged 2–12
exceptions: Slides with a designated attended zone with trained operator supervision and minimum user age of 6+ may have exit height up to 0.5 m

subject: Indoor Slide / Tube Slide
rule: Indoor tube slide must be fitted with ventilation openings along the tube at maximum 2 m intervals if the tube length exceeds 5 m
conditions: slide is enclosed tube type
tube length exceeds 5 m

subject: Foam Block Pit
rule: foam block pit must maintain a minimum freeboard above water level to prevent floating displacement
conditions: when used as a water-holding structure
when located below the water table
exceptions: when mechanically anchored or ballasted to resist buoyancy

subject: Foam Block Pit
rule: foam block pit must not be exposed to solvents or petroleum-based chemicals that dissolve or degrade expanded polystyrene foam
conditions: when made of EPS or XPS foam
exceptions: when protected by an impermeable chemical-resistant coating or liner

subject: Sensory Play Wall Panel
rule: Sensory Play Wall Panel must be mounted to a structurally sound vertical surface (wall or sturdy partition)
conditions: when installed as a fixed panel
exceptions: free-standing or portable sensory play wall panels

subject: Sensory Play Wall Panel
rule: Sensory Play Wall Panel must not have sharp edges, corners, or protrusions on any child-accessible surface

subject: Sensory Play Wall Panel
rule: Sensory Play Wall Panel must not use small detachable parts that could present a choking hazard for children under 3 years
conditions: when the panel is intended for use in areas accessible to children under 3 years old

subject: Sensory Play Wall Panel
rule: Sensory Play Wall Panel's electrical components (if any) must be enclosed and isolated from child contact with IP54 or higher ingress protection
conditions: when the panel includes electrically powered sensory elements (lights, vibration, sound modules)

subject: Indoor Playground Structure
rule: Indoor playground structure must have guardrails or barriers at all elevated platforms, ramps, and walkways above 20 inches (508 mm) of fall height
conditions: Structure includes elevated platforms, ramps, or walkways
Height of fall exceeds 20 inches (508 mm)
exceptions: Areas specifically designed for supervised fall-zone activities with appropriate impact-absorbing surfacing

subject: Indoor Playground Structure
rule: Indoor playground structure must not have entrapment openings that allow passage of a 5-inch (127 mm) sphere
conditions: Structure contains openings, gaps, or holes between structural members

subject: Indoor Playground Structure
rule: Indoor playground structure must have impact-absorbing surfacing beneath and within the fall zone of all climbing, sliding, and elevated play elements
conditions: Structure includes climbing elements, slides, or elevated play components with a fall height exceeding 20 inches (508 mm)

subject: Indoor Playground Structure
rule: Indoor playground structure must have all exposed corners, edges, and protrusions rounded or padded to prevent laceration and impact injury
conditions: Structure has exposed rigid structural members, fasteners, or decorative elements at reachable height

subject: Play Equipment Anchoring System
rule: Play equipment anchoring system must resist applicable overturning, sliding, and uplift forces
conditions: When installed on any surface
Where equipment is subject to wind loads or user-induced forces

subject: Play Equipment Anchoring System
rule: Play equipment anchoring system must not use above-ground concrete footings that create tripping hazards or impact-absorption hazards
conditions: When anchoring is within a play zone or fall-zone area

subject: Play Equipment Anchoring System
rule: Play equipment anchoring system must have all fasteners and connection hardware rated for corrosive exposure if installed outdoors
conditions: When installed outdoors or in an environment with moisture or chemical exposure

subject: Play Equipment Anchoring System
rule: Play equipment anchoring system must be installed such that the finished grade provides positive drainage away from footings
conditions: When footings are installed in soil

subject: Connected Play Area Floor Plan Layout

exceptions: Doors that swing fully out of the circulation path (e.g., into a wall pocket or closet)

subject: Connected Play Area Floor Plan Layout

subject: Connected Play Area Floor Plan Layout

subject: Connected Play Area Floor Plan Layout
rule: Connected play area floor plan layout must provide an unobstructed viewing sightline of at least 75% of the floor area from at least one supervisory vantage point
conditions: When the play area is designed for children under age 6 or for licensed childcare use
exceptions: Play structures with intentional hideaways that are less than 24 inches deep and visible from two sides

subject: Public Outdoor Room Floor/Deck

conditions: floor/deck is exposed to rain or moisture
floor/deck is accessible to the public

subject: Public Outdoor Room Floor/Deck
rule: public outdoor room floor/deck must be designed to prevent ponding water
conditions: floor/deck is horizontal or nearly horizontal
exceptions: surface is specifically designed as a water-feature basin or rain garden that intentionally holds water

subject: Public Outdoor Room Floor/Deck
rule: public outdoor room floor/deck must not have tripping hazards at changes in level
conditions: change in floor level occurs within a pedestrian path of travel

change in level is between 6 mm and 13 mm (1/2 inch) with beveled edge at 1:2 maximum slope

subject: Play Area Acoustic Treatment
rule: Play area acoustic treatment material must have a minimum NRC (Noise Reduction Coefficient) rating of 0.7
conditions: The play area is an indoor space
The space is used for group activities or children's play
exceptions: Outdoor play areas where acoustic treatment is not required

subject: Play Area Acoustic Treatment

conditions: The play area is accessible to children under 12 years old
The acoustic treatment is installed on walls, ceilings, or columns within 2.4 m of the floor

subject: Play Area Acoustic Treatment
rule: Play area acoustic treatment must be impact-resistant to withstand a minimum 50 J impact force without cracking or dislodging
conditions: The treatment is installed below 2.1 m from the finished floor
The play area is used by children aged 2–12

subject: Play Area Acoustic Treatment
rule: Play area acoustic treatment must not reduce room visibility such that it creates blind spots that compromise adult supervision sight lines
conditions: The play area is designed for supervised children's activities

subject: Public Outdoor Room Roof/Canopy

exceptions: canopy is designed as a fully permeable surface that allows water to pass through

subject: Public Outdoor Room Roof/Canopy
rule: roof/canopy must withstand expected wind uplift loads

subject: Public Outdoor Room Roof/Canopy
rule: roof/canopy must not trap snow or debris in a manner that causes progressive collapse

subject: Public Outdoor Room Roof/Canopy
rule: roof/canopy must not have unsecured loose elements that could fall onto occupants
conditions: canopy is located above occupied areas

subject: Public Outdoor Room Enclosure Walls

conditions: walls are load-bearing
walls support roof structure
exceptions: walls are non-load-bearing infill only

subject: Public Outdoor Room Enclosure Walls

walls create a fully enclosed perimeter

subject: Public Outdoor Room Enclosure Walls
rule: Enclosure walls must resist design wind loads as required by local building code

subject: Public Outdoor Room Enclosure Walls

conditions: room is enclosed by walls on more than three sides
space is intended for occupancy

subject: Public Outdoor Room Structural Frame
rule: structural frame must resist all applicable design loads (dead, live, wind, seismic, snow)

subject: Public Outdoor Room Structural Frame
rule: structural frame must transfer loads continuously to the foundation

subject: Public Outdoor Room Structural Frame
rule: structural frame must not have unstable buckling-prone compression members without adequate bracing
conditions: member is in compression

subject: Public Outdoor Room Structural Frame
rule: structural connections between frame members must be capable of transferring the design forces

subject: Public Outdoor Room Structural Frame
rule: roof or overhead horizontal member of the frame must provide a drainage path for rainwater
conditions: frame includes a roof or overhead covering

subject: Public Outdoor Room Lighting
rule: public outdoor room lighting fixtures must be weather-rated (minimum IP65) for outdoor exposure
conditions: fixture is installed in an unconditioned outdoor environment

subject: Public Outdoor Room Lighting

Surface is impervious or semi-pervious

Space is fully enclosed and climate-controlled (indoor atrium) with no precipitation exposure

subject: Public Outdoor Room Drainage System

Water is directed into a designated rain garden or bio-swale designed to accept surface flow

subject: Public Outdoor Room Shading Devices

Devices with solid surface area greater than 1 m²
Outdoor installation exposed to wind

subject: Public Outdoor Room Shading Devices

Device designed with sufficiently steep pitch to shed snow before hazardous accumulation

subject: Public Outdoor Room Shading Devices

planter is a sealed water-feature basin not supporting plant life

subject: Public Outdoor Room Planting and Planters

subject: Public Outdoor Room Planting and Planters

subject: Public Outdoor Room Planting and Planters

subject: Public Outdoor Room Wind Screens

subject: Public Outdoor Room Wind Screens

subject: Public Outdoor Room Wind Screens

subject: Public Outdoor Room Wind Screens

subject: Public Outdoor Room Sound System

system includes active electronic components requiring mains or low-voltage power

subject: Public Outdoor Room Sound System
