subject: Public Outdoor Room Sound System

subject: Public Outdoor Room Furniture (Fixed)

adjacent to pedestrian pathways

subject: Public Outdoor Room Furniture (Fixed)

subject: Public Outdoor Room Furniture (Fixed)

subject: Public Outdoor Room Furniture (Fixed)

subject: Public Outdoor Room Furniture (Fixed)

subject: Public Outdoor Room Fire Protection

When the outdoor room exceeds 200 m² in area
exceptions: When the outdoor room is open on all sides with no obstructions

subject: Public Outdoor Room Fire Protection

subject: Public Outdoor Room Fire Protection

subject: Grave Liner/Vault

subject: Grave Liner/Vault

subject: Grave Liner/Vault

subject: Headstone/Stele

subject: Headstone/Stele
rule: headstone/stele must be made of durable, weather-resistant material

subject: Headstone/Stele
rule: headstone/stele must have a stable foundation or base to prevent toppling

subject: Headstone/Stele
rule: headstone/stele must_not have sharp or protruding edges at accessible human height

exceptions: Edges that are part of intentional sculptural design above 2m height

subject: Grave Base/Foundation
rule: grave base/foundation must be stable on the substrate

subject: Grave Base/Foundation
rule: grave base/foundation must not have voids or cavities that permit subsidence

supporting a masonry or stone monument

subject: Grave Base/Foundation
rule: grave base/foundation must be below the frost line

subject: Grave Cover/Lawn Slab
rule: grave cover/lawn slab must be planar or slightly crowned to shed water

subject: Grave Cover/Lawn Slab
rule: grave cover/lawn slab must have a minimum thickness to resist soil heave and foot traffic without fracture

subject: Grave Curb/Edging
rule: grave curb/edging must sit on stable, level ground
conditions: permanent installation
ground-mounted
exceptions: temporary installation on prepared subgrade

subject: Grave Curb/Edging
rule: grave curb/edging must not shift or displace laterally under soil pressure
conditions: below-grade portion present

conditions: system serves active play zones with impact-absorbing surfacing

subject: Playground Drainage System
rule: playground drainage system must be designed to handle a 10-year, 24-hour storm event without surface flooding
conditions: system is the primary stormwater management for the playground area
exceptions: local code explicitly requires a different return-period standard

subject: Animal Enclosure
rule: Animal enclosure must provide at least one means of egress (exit) for animals
conditions: enclosure houses animals that cannot exit through the same opening used for entry in an emergency
exceptions: enclosure is a temporary transport container continuously attended by a handler

subject: Animal Enclosure
rule: Enclosure floor must be sloped to drain liquids to a collection or disposal point
conditions: enclosure houses animals that produce urine or liquid waste
enclosure is cleaned with water or liquid sanitizers
exceptions: enclosure uses fully absorbent bedding replaced between each occupant
enclosure is a dry-only enclosure with no liquid introduction

subject: Animal Enclosure
rule: Enclosure must not have sharp protrusions, edges, or pinch points accessible to animals
conditions: animals are housed inside the enclosure

subject: Animal Containment System
rule: animal containment system must have a means of preventing escape of contained animals
conditions: system is used to house animals that can climb, jump, dig, or fly
exceptions: system contains only animals incapable of escaping under any conditions

subject: Animal Containment System
rule: animal containment system must have a means of providing fresh air or ventilation
conditions: system houses living animals that respire
exceptions: system is used only for temporary transport under continuous human supervision with active life support

subject: Animal Containment System
rule: animal containment system must not have internal surfaces or features that can trap or entangle animals
conditions: system is designed for housing animals capable of movement
exceptions: system is designed specifically for short-term medical or handling procedures where continuous human observation is present

subject: Animal Containment System
rule: animal containment system must have a barrier that contains liquid waste
conditions: system houses animals that produce liquid waste
system is not a fully permeable enclosure such as an open-range fence
exceptions: system is designed with a permeable floor over a drainage field specifically engineered for waste management

subject: Animal Habitat Fixtures
rule: Animal habitat fixtures must be non-toxic to the species housed
conditions: fixture comes into contact with animals
fixture is within the occupied enclosure
exceptions: fixture is separated by a fully impermeable barrier that prevents any contact or leaching

subject: Animal Habitat Fixtures
rule: Animal habitat fixtures must not have sharp edges, protrusions, or pinch points accessible to animals
conditions: fixture is within reach of any housed animal
exceptions: the sharp/protruding feature is a controlled veterinary or feeding tool used only during direct human supervision and removed immediately afterward

subject: Animal Habitat Fixtures
rule: Animal habitat fixtures must be structurally stable against loads imposed by the animal species
conditions: fixture supports animal weight or climbing forces
exceptions: fixture is a temporary enrichment item that is removed when not actively supervised

subject: Animal Habitat Fixtures
rule: Animal habitat fixtures must not contain gaps or openings that can trap animal body parts
conditions: fixture has any space between elements
fixture is sized for use by the housed species
exceptions: gaps are intentionally designed as part of a species-specific enrichment puzzle and are monitored/managed to prevent injury

subject: Animal Flooring
rule: Animal flooring must be non-slip to prevent animal injury
conditions: used in wet environments
housed animals have hooves or paws

subject: Animal Flooring
rule: Animal flooring must be cleanable and not absorb moisture or waste
conditions: used for housing or confining animals
exceptions: temporary flooring for show rings where animals are present only hours and waste is managed externally

subject: Animal Flooring
rule: Animal flooring must not contain materials toxic to the housed species if ingested or contacted
conditions: animals have access to gnaw or lick the flooring surface

subject: Animal Flooring
rule: Animal flooring must have adequate drainage to prevent standing liquid
conditions: flooring is in a wet or wash-down area

subject: Animal Space Ventilation
rule: Animal space ventilation must provide continuous airflow to prevent CO₂ and ammonia accumulation to hazardous levels
conditions: enclosed animal housing
occupancy by live animals

subject: Animal Space Ventilation
rule: Animal space ventilation must not recirculate air that has passed through one animal enclosure into another animal enclosure without treatment
conditions: multi-compartment animal facility
airborne disease transmission risk is present
exceptions: air is passed through HEPA filtration and UV-C treatment before re-entry

subject: Animal Space Ventilation
rule: Animal space ventilation intake must be located away from sources of toxic exhaust, manure gas, or combustion products
conditions: mechanical ventilation system with outdoor air intake

subject: Animal Waste Management System
rule: containment structure must be watertight and impermeable
conditions: used for liquid or slurry waste storage
exceptions: composting systems handling only dry, solid waste

subject: Animal Waste Management System
rule: must not allow untreated waste to discharge directly into natural water bodies
conditions: system is located outdoors or adjacent to waterways, drainage ditches, or stormwater infrastructure
exceptions: system includes engineered treatment to regulatory standards before discharge

subject: Animal Waste Management System
rule: storage structure must have sufficient structural capacity to withstand the full hydrostatic pressure of contained waste
conditions: system includes a contained liquid or semi-liquid waste storage component

subject: Animal Waste Management System
rule: ventilation system must be provided for enclosed waste storage or treatment areas
conditions: waste is stored or processed inside an enclosed structure
system handles anaerobic decomposition or generates biogas
exceptions: entirely open-air or fully outdoor systems with no enclosure

subject: Animal Door
rule: animal door must be large enough for the target animal species to pass through

subject: Animal Door
rule: animal door must have a closing mechanism that returns to a closed position after the animal passes through

subject: Animal Door
rule: animal door must not have sharp edges or pinch points at the opening that could injure the animal

subject: Veterinary Treatment Area
rule: Veterinary treatment area must have impermeable, non-porous flooring (e.g., sealed concrete, epoxy) to prevent absorption of biological fluids and enable cleaning and disinfection

subject: Veterinary Treatment Area
rule: Veterinary treatment area must have a floor drain with proper trap and connection to sanitary sewer system

subject: Veterinary Treatment Area
rule: Veterinary treatment area must not have ceiling-mounted fixtures or equipment directly above patient examination/treatment tables without drip-proof shielding

subject: Veterinary Treatment Area
rule: Veterinary treatment area must have handwashing sink with hands-free (elbow, foot, or sensor) operation

subject: Animal-Accessible Circulation
rule: animal-accessible circulation pathways must be free of sharp edges, protrusions, or gaps that could trap or injure an animal's limb, head, or body
conditions: circulation route is used by animals
route includes doors, gates, railings, or wall openings
exceptions: temporary construction or maintenance zones that are actively supervised and physically barricaded to prevent animal access

subject: Animal-Accessible Circulation
rule: animal-accessible circulation pathways must have a slip-resistant walking surface
conditions: surface is sloped steeper than 1:20
surface is exposed to moisture, urine, or cleaning washdown

subject: Animal-Accessible Circulation
rule: animal-accessible circulation pathways must not include stairs as the sole means of vertical circulation
conditions: pathway is the primary access route between two occupied levels
species using the route includes non-climbing animals (ungulates, cattle, horses, swine, sheep, goats)
exceptions: supplementary stairs may exist alongside a ramp or sloped walkway

subject: Animal-Accessible Circulation
rule: animal-accessible circulation pathways must have a minimum clear width that accommodates the largest animal species using the route
exceptions: chutes or single-file raceways designed specifically for veterinary inspection, where the narrower width is intentional for restraint and is supervised

subject: Family Kitchen
rule: Family kitchen must have a dedicated ventilation system (range hood or downdraft) exhausting directly to the outdoors
conditions: kitchen contains a cooking range or cooktop

subject: Family Kitchen
rule: Family kitchen must have at least one means of egress (exit path) that does not pass through the kitchen cooking area
conditions: kitchen serves as a habitable space with occupancy
exceptions: if the kitchen is open-plan and the entire floor area has an alternative direct exit within allowable travel distance

subject: Family Kitchen
rule: Family kitchen must not have a gas range located directly beneath an openable window that would cause flame flutter or wind disturbance
conditions: gas cooking range is present
window above is operable
exceptions: if window is fixed (non-operable) or if range is placed such that the window sill height and range depth prevent flame disturbance

subject: Family Kitchen
rule: Family kitchen must have a floor finish that is non-absorbent and cleanable near the cooking and sink areas

subject: Family Kitchen
rule: Family kitchen must have at least one grounded electrical receptacle (outlet) within 600 mm of the intended sink location, on a GFCI-protected circuit
conditions: sink is present in the kitchen

subject: Family Bedroom
rule: Family Bedroom must have at least one egress window or door compliant with local building code for emergency escape and rescue
conditions: Bedroom is located in a habitable basement or on any floor above grade
exceptions: Bedroom is a sprinklered space per NFPA 13 in jurisdictions that permit sprinkler alternative

subject: Family Bedroom
rule: Family Bedroom must have a minimum net floor area of at least 70 square feet and a minimum horizontal dimension of 7 feet in at least one direction

subject: Family Bedroom
rule: Family Bedroom must have a ceiling height of at least 7 feet 6 inches over at least 50% of the required floor area
exceptions: Beams, girders, ducts, or other obstructions may project to 6 feet 8 inches minimum below the ceiling

subject: Family Bedroom
rule: Family Bedroom must not be located directly above a garage unless the floor-ceiling assembly has a minimum 5/8-inch Type X gypsum board fire-resistance rating on the garage side
conditions: Garage is directly below the bedroom

subject: Family Bedroom
rule: Family Bedroom must have a smoke alarm installed inside the room and one within 15 feet of the bedroom door in the hallway

subject: Family Hallway/Corridor
rule: Family hallway/corridor must have a minimum clear width of 1200 mm (47 inches) to allow for two people passing or family members moving in opposite directions
conditions: The corridor serves a residential unit with multiple bedrooms
The corridor is a primary circulation route within the dwelling unit
exceptions: When the corridor is less than 2 m long and serves only one room

subject: Family Hallway/Corridor
rule: Family hallway/corridor must have a clear height of at least 2100 mm (2.1 m)
conditions: The corridor is enclosed with a ceiling

subject: Family Hallway/Corridor
rule: Family hallway/corridor must not have steps or level changes that create a tripping hazard in the primary travel path
conditions: The corridor is less than 1200 mm wide
The corridor is the only egress path from bedrooms
exceptions: When the level change is served by a ramp with slope ≤ 1:12
When the level change is served by at least two steps with contrasting nosing strips and handrails on both sides

subject: Family Hallway/Corridor
rule: Family hallway/corridor must provide a turning space (1500 mm diameter or T-shaped) if it is a dead-end corridor longer than 6 m serving habitable rooms
conditions: The corridor is a dead-end (single point of entry/exit)
The corridor length exceeds 6 m
The corridor serves one or more habitable rooms
exceptions: If the corridor serves only storage or utility rooms and no habitable rooms

subject: Family Laundry Room
rule: must have a floor drain or dedicated drain connection for washing machine wastewater

subject: Family Laundry Room
rule: must have supply connections for hot and cold water

subject: Family Laundry Room
rule: must have GFCI-protected electrical outlet within 1.8 m (6 ft) of intended washing machine location

subject: Family Laundry Room
rule: must have a minimum ceiling height of at least 2.1 m (7 ft) to accommodate standing occupants and top-loading machines

subject: Family Laundry Room
rule: must not locate the washing machine over a finished ceiling below without a water-tight pan and drain
conditions: when the laundry room is not on a slab/grade floor

subject: Family Toilet
rule: Family Toilet must have a dedicated vent pipe or mechanical ventilation system connected to the exterior
conditions: when located in a conditioned space
when lacking an exterior wall with operable window area ≥ 0.5 m²
exceptions: if the toilet is a composting/incinerating type with sealed airtight system and no sewer connection

subject: Family Toilet
rule: Family Toilet must have a floor drain with trap seal connected to the building drainage system
exceptions: temporary portable toilet units not connected to plumbing

subject: Family Toilet
rule: Family Toilet must have a water supply for handwashing within the same room or directly adjacent
conditions: when the building has a piped water supply

subject: Family Toilet
rule: Family Toilet must have a door that provides privacy and can be locked from inside

subject: Interior Partition Walls (Family Zone)
rule: interior partition walls must have continuous fire-rated construction from floor to floor or floor to roof deck above
conditions: when required by building code for occupancy type or building height
when the wall serves as a fire barrier or fire partition
exceptions: walls that are not fire-rated (e.g., non-rated simple dividing walls in single-family zones)

subject: Interior Partition Walls (Family Zone)
rule: interior partition walls must be laterally braced to resist out-of-plane forces
conditions: when wall height exceeds code-prescribed unbraced length limits for the given material and thickness

subject: Interior Partition Walls (Family Zone)
rule: interior partition walls must be supported by structure capable of carrying the wall's self-weight and any superimposed loads
conditions: when the wall is a bearing partition or supports heavy finishes/equipment
exceptions: non-load-bearing partitions that bear only on a slab-on-grade or adequately rated floor structure

subject: Interior Partition Walls (Family Zone)
rule: interior partition walls must not block required means of egress width
conditions: when located along or adjacent to a designated exit corridor or egress path

subject: Family Room Windows
rule: family room windows must be glazed with safety glass if the window is within 18 inches of the floor and the pane is larger than 9 square feet
conditions: window within 18 inches of finished floor
pane larger than 9 square feet
exceptions: window is a grade-level egress opening that meets alternative safety requirements

subject: Family Room Windows
rule: family room windows must not have a sill height lower than 24 inches above the finished floor unless the window is protected by a guard or fixed glazing meets safety impact standards
conditions: window is operable
no guard or barrier in place
exceptions: window serves as an emergency egress opening compliant with required opening dimensions

subject: Family Room Wall Finishes
rule: wall finish must be non-combustible or have a fire-resistant rating appropriate for family room occupancy
conditions: family room is an occupied interior space
building code requires fire safety in habitable rooms
exceptions: when sprinkler system provides equivalent protection per code

subject: Family Room Wall Finishes
rule: wall finish must not off-gas toxic volatile organic compounds (VOCs) at levels exceeding indoor air quality thresholds
conditions: family room is an enclosed interior space without dedicated continuous mechanical ventilation

subject: Family Room Wall Finishes
rule: wall finish must be cleanable and non-absorbent to prevent mold growth in areas subject to moisture exposure
conditions: wall finish is installed in a below-grade family room
or the family room has direct access to exterior with frequent door opening
exceptions: when a dedicated vapor barrier and mechanical dehumidification system is provided

subject: Family Plumbing System
rule: family plumbing system must have adequate slope (minimum 1/4 inch per foot) for drainage piping to ensure gravity flow
conditions: system includes horizontal drainage piping
exceptions: system uses pressure-based drainage (pumped system)

subject: Family Plumbing System
rule: family plumbing system must have vent piping connected to drainage system to prevent siphonage and allow sewer gas escape
conditions: system includes gravity drainage fixtures

subject: Family Plumbing System
rule: family plumbing system must have a backflow prevention device at potable water supply connections
conditions: system connects to public water supply or well

subject: Family Plumbing System
rule: family plumbing system hot water supply must not exceed 120°F at fixtures accessible to occupants
conditions: fixtures are intended for handwashing, bathing, or showering
exceptions: commercial dishwashing fixtures with separate temperature controls

subject: Family HVAC System
rule: refrigerant circuit must be sealed and leak-free
conditions: system uses vapor-compression refrigeration cycle

subject: Family HVAC System
rule: condensate drainage must be continuously sloped downward or actively pumped
conditions: system produces condensate during cooling operation

subject: Family HVAC System
rule: airflow path must not be blocked by closed dampers or obstructed filters when system is operating
conditions: system is in operation with forced air circulation

subject: Family HVAC System
rule: indoor coil surface temperature must not drop below freezing under normal operation
conditions: system operates in cooling mode
exceptions: unit is specifically designed with freeze-protection controls that cycle compressor

subject: Family Bathroom Vanity (Fixed)
rule: Family Bathroom Vanity (Fixed) must be mounted to wall studs or a properly anchored backing structure
conditions: vanity is wall-mounted
vanity supports a countertop and sink
exceptions: vanity is a freestanding/floor-supported unit

subject: Family Bathroom Vanity (Fixed)
rule: Family Bathroom Vanity (Fixed) must have a waterproof finish or impervious surface on all horizontal and splash-prone vertical surfaces
conditions: vanity is located within a bathroom wet zone

subject: Family Bathroom Vanity (Fixed)
rule: Family Bathroom Vanity (Fixed) must not obstruct required clear floor space in front of fixtures
conditions: vanity is adjacent to a toilet, bidet, or shower entry

subject: Family Kitchen Cabinetry (Fixed)
rule: Family kitchen cabinetry (fixed) must have a minimum clearance of at least 18 inches between the top of the cooking surface and the bottom of any unprotected combustible cabinet above
conditions: when installed above a cooktop or rangetop
exceptions: if a listed range hood or microwave hood combination provides adequate clearance per manufacturer specifications

subject: Family Kitchen Cabinetry (Fixed)
rule: Family kitchen cabinetry (fixed) must not block or obstruct designated egress paths or required clear floor space at appliance fronts
conditions: when cabinets are installed in a kitchen that is part of a dwelling unit
exceptions: if the cabinet layout has been explicitly designed and approved to maintain the required egress width per local code

subject: Family Kitchen Cabinetry (Fixed)
rule: Family kitchen cabinetry (fixed) must be securely anchored to wall framing or structure to prevent overturning or detachment
conditions: for wall-mounted upper cabinets and tall cabinets

subject: Family Kitchen Cabinetry (Fixed)
rule: Family kitchen cabinetry (fixed) must not be installed directly above or adjacent to a gas cooking appliance without a backguard, range hood, or clearance that meets code
conditions: when gas cooktop or gas range is present directly below or beside the cabinet
exceptions: if the cabinet is non-combustible or protected by a code-compliant backguard/hood

subject: Load-Bearing Walls
rule: Load-bearing walls must be vertically continuous from foundation to the roof or to the floor/roof they support, with load path unbroken
conditions: The wall carries gravity loads from above
exceptions: Structures with load redistribution via deep transfer beams or trusses that redirect loads laterally

subject: Load-Bearing Walls
rule: Load-bearing walls must be laterally braced against out-of-plane buckling
conditions: The wall is slender (height-to-thickness ratio exceeds code limits)
exceptions: Massive walls (e.g., thick stone or heavily reinforced concrete) where slenderness ratio is low enough that buckling is not the governing failure mode

subject: Load-Bearing Walls
rule: Load-bearing walls must not have large openings removed without structural compensation such as lintels, arches, or surrounding frame
conditions: The wall supports significant gravity load above the opening location
exceptions: Openings located entirely in non-load-bearing infill panels where the wall's structural role is already satisfied by a separate frame

subject: Load-Bearing Walls
rule: Load-bearing walls must be founded on soil or rock with adequate bearing capacity or on a foundation system that distributes loads to competent strata

subject: Damp-Proof Membrane
rule: Damp-proof membrane must be continuous across the entire floor or wall area to prevent moisture penetration
conditions: when used in below-ground construction
when used in ground-floor slabs
exceptions: where designed with a specific discontinuation for structural movement joints if detailed with a sealed overlap or compression seal

subject: Damp-Proof Membrane
rule: Damp-proof membrane must be lapped and sealed at all joints by a minimum of 100 mm
conditions: when installing sheet DPM
when joining separate membrane sheets

subject: Damp-Proof Membrane
rule: Damp-proof membrane must be protected from puncture during and after installation
conditions: when installed below ground
when installed under concrete slabs
when backfilling against the membrane

subject: Damp-Proof Membrane
rule: Damp-proof membrane must not be bridged by materials that can transmit moisture from the ground to the superstructure
conditions: when installed in wall construction
where cavity walls are used
where the DPM is in contact with above-ground masonry
exceptions: where a specifically designed moisture break or cavity tray is provided at the bridging point

subject: Floor Structure
rule: Floor structure must be designed to support its design live load plus dead load without exceeding allowable deflection limits
conditions: All habitable or occupiable floor areas
exceptions: Non-occupiable catwalks or service platforms with restricted access

subject: Floor Structure
rule: Floor structure must have a minimum fire-resistance rating as required by building code for its occupancy and building type
conditions: Floors separating dwelling units
Floors in buildings above a minimum height threshold per code
exceptions: Single-family dwellings of limited size where code permits reduced rating

subject: Floor Structure
rule: Floor structure must not exceed the maximum allowable span for its construction type and loading without additional engineering justification
conditions: All floor framing members (joists, beams, slabs)

subject: Floor Structure
rule: Floor structure in wet areas must be防水 (waterproofed) or sloped to drain to prevent water accumulation and damage
conditions: Floor structures in bathrooms, kitchens, laundry rooms, balconies, or any area with plumbing fixtures or regular wetting

subject: Floor Structure
rule: Floor structure must provide a continuous load path to transfer all vertical and lateral loads to the foundation or supporting structure
conditions: All floors that are part of the primary lateral-force-resisting system

subject: Internal Partition Walls
rule: Internal partition walls must transfer their own weight and imposed vertical loads to the floor structure beneath
exceptions: Walls that are structurally independent and supported directly by the building frame at multiple levels

subject: Internal Partition Walls
rule: Internal partition walls must not be constructed without provision for lateral stability against out-of-plane forces
conditions: Wall height exceeds 3 m
Wall is not braced by return walls or ceiling diaphragms
exceptions: Walls that are designed as freestanding elements with verified moment capacity

subject: Internal Partition Walls
rule: Internal partition walls must not block required means of egress paths
conditions: The space is classified as occupied (any occupancy group)
exceptions: Walls that are fully relocatable and marked as temporary with fire-engineering approval

subject: Internal Partition Walls
rule: Internal partition walls must have a fire-resistance rating not less than that required by the adjacent occupancy separation
conditions: Wall separates different fire compartments or occupancy groups
exceptions: Walls within the same dwelling unit where no fire separation is mandated by code

subject: Plasterboard Lining
rule: plasterboard lining must be protected from sustained moisture exposure
conditions: installed in wet areas such as bathrooms, kitchens, or laundries
or in any location subject to potential water leakage or high humidity
exceptions: when specifically manufactured as moisture-resistant plasterboard (e.g., green board or blue board) and installed in accordance with manufacturer's specifications for wet-area use

subject: Plasterboard Lining
rule: plasterboard lining must have joints properly taped and finished before decoration
conditions: when used as a finished interior wall or ceiling surface

subject: Plasterboard Lining
rule: plasterboard lining must not be installed directly onto masonry without appropriate furring or isolation
conditions: when the masonry substrate is external or below grade
exceptions: when the masonry is internal, dry, and a full vapour-permeable membrane system is used as per manufacturer specification

subject: Plasterboard Lining
rule: plasterboard lining must not be fixed with nails alone when used on ceilings
conditions: when installed on ceilings

subject: Window Assemblies
rule: window assemblies must be weather-sealed against air and water infiltration at all perimeter joints
conditions: assembly is installed in an exterior wall
assembly separates conditioned from unconditioned space
exceptions: temporary mock-ups or test specimens not intended for occupancy

subject: Window Assemblies
rule: window assemblies must structurally anchor to the rough opening with sufficient fasteners to resist design wind loads and prevent dislodgement
conditions: assembly is installed in a vertical wall opening
exceptions: non-structural decorative window dummies not exposed to wind loading

subject: Window Assemblies
rule: window assemblies must not have glazing that prohibits required emergency egress and rescue opening dimensions
conditions: assembly is in a room designated as a sleeping room or habitable basement
applicable building code requires egress opening
exceptions: windows not required to be operable (e.g., fixed windows in non-egress areas)
building is sprinklered and code allows reduced egress requirements where permitted

subject: Window Assemblies
rule: window assemblies must have operable sash that can be opened and closed without racking or binding
conditions: assembly includes operable (non-fixed) sash
exceptions: fixed window assemblies with no operable components

subject: External Door
rule: External door must have a positive latching mechanism
conditions: door is of swinging type
door is an exit door for occupied spaces
exceptions: sliding doors where latch is not applicable but lock replaces it

subject: External Door
rule: External door must swing in the direction of egress travel
conditions: door serves an assembly, educational, or high-occupancy space
door is on a means of egress path
exceptions: residential single-family dwelling exterior doors
doors serving spaces with occupant load less than 50 where local code permits

subject: External Door
rule: External door assembly must not have a threshold height exceeding the maximum allowed by accessibility code
conditions: door serves a building entrance required to be accessible
exceptions: existing buildings under alteration where full compliance is technically infeasible and an alternative barrier is provided

subject: External Door
rule: External door must have weatherstripping or gasketing at all perimeter gaps
conditions: door separates conditioned interior space from exterior environment
exceptions: doors in unconditioned buildings such as unheated sheds

subject: External Door
rule: External door leaf must not be installed with hinge-side clearance less than required for a 90-degree swing
conditions: door is a side-hinged swinging door
exceptions: doors designed to be fixed in open position

subject: Internal Doors
rule: internal doors must not obstruct egress paths when opened
conditions: door swings into an egress corridor or means of egress
exceptions: doors serving occupancies with a total occupant load of 10 or fewer that are side-hinged and open into a corridor are permitted if they do not reduce the corridor width to less than required

subject: Internal Doors
rule: internal doors must have a minimum clear opening width of at least 32 inches (813 mm)
conditions: door serves an accessible route or an occupiable space
exceptions: doorways in existing buildings where compliance is technically infeasible
doorways serving individual dwelling unit bathrooms

subject: Internal Doors
rule: fire-rated internal doors must be self-closing or automatic-closing
conditions: door is located in a fire-resistance-rated wall or partition (e.g., corridor, stair enclosure, shaft)
exceptions: doors in existing buildings where alternative closing devices are approved by the authority having jurisdiction

subject: Internal Doors
rule: internal doors must not block required clearances at electrical panels or mechanical equipment
conditions: door swing overlaps the required working clearance in front of an electrical panelboard or HVAC equipment access

subject: Internal Doors
rule: internal doors must have hardware that operates with one simple motion and does not require tight grasping, pinching, or twisting of the wrist
conditions: door is on an accessible route

subject: Sanitary Fixtures
rule: Sanitary fixture waste outlet must connect to a drainage system that is vented to prevent siphonage and trap seal loss
conditions: fixture has a trap
fixture discharges to a shared drain
exceptions: fixtures with integral vacuum-breaker or air-admittance valve certified to applicable standard

subject: Sanitary Fixtures
rule: Sanitary fixture waste pipe diameter must not be smaller than the fixture trap outlet diameter
conditions: pipe is downstream of the fixture trap

subject: Sanitary Fixtures
rule: Sanitary fixture with a water supply must have a backflow prevention device or air gap at the supply connection
conditions: fixture has a direct water supply connection
fixture waste outlet is below flood-level rim of another fixture or submerged
exceptions: fixtures supplied only via an integral fill valve that meets backflow standards (e.g., toilet fill valve with approved anti-siphon port)

subject: Sanitary Fixtures
rule: Sanitary fixture trap must maintain a minimum water seal depth (typically 50-75 mm depending on jurisdiction)

subject: Built-In Wardrobes
rule: built-in wardrobe must have a minimum internal depth of at least 500mm (clear of doors/hardware) to accommodate standard hanging rods and clothing
conditions: designed for hanging garments on a rod
exceptions: wardrobe designed exclusively for shelved or folded storage only, with no hanging provision

subject: Built-In Wardrobes
rule: built-in wardrobe must have a structural fixing to the building fabric (wall, floor, or ceiling) capable of resisting overturning and service loads
conditions: wardrobe height exceeds 1200mm

subject: Built-In Wardrobes
rule: built-in wardrobe doors must not obstruct adjacent door swings, corridor egress paths, or building egress routes when opened
conditions: wardrobe is located adjacent to a doorway, in a corridor, or within the swing zone of another door
exceptions: doors are sliding, pocket, or bifold types that do not project into the path of travel when opened

subject: Paint and Decorative Coatings
rule: paint and decorative coatings must be compatible with the substrate material to which they are applied
conditions: paint is applied to any substrate
exceptions: paints designed as universal primers that chemically bond irrespective of substrate composition

subject: Paint and Decorative Coatings
rule: paint and decorative coatings must not be applied over surfaces contaminated with grease, oil, loose debris, moisture, or other substances that prevent adhesion
conditions: paint is applied in normal environmental conditions
exceptions: specialized coatings formulated for application over lightly contaminated surfaces (e.g., certain masonry sealers)

subject: Paint and Decorative Coatings
rule: paint and decorative coatings must be applied within the manufacturer-specified temperature and humidity range
conditions: coating is applied on-site in ambient conditions
exceptions: coatings specifically formulated for low-temperature or high-humidity application

subject: Rainwater Drainage
rule: Rainwater drainage system must have a continuous gravity flow path from collection point to outlet or disposal point
conditions: Applicable to all building rainwater drainage systems
exceptions: Systems using active pumping as primary conveyance may interrupt gravity flow
Siphonic drainage systems operate under full-bore negative pressure, not open-channel gravity

subject: Rainwater Drainage
rule: Drainage pipes must have a minimum slope (gradient) to maintain self-cleansing flow velocity
conditions: Gravity drainage system
Not a siphonic or pressurized drainage system
exceptions: Siphonic drainage systems use full-bore flow with no slope requirement
Pressurized drainage systems use pump energy to maintain flow

subject: Rainwater Drainage
rule: Rainwater downpipes must not discharge directly onto a public footpath or highway
conditions: Building is connected to a public drainage system or has a dedicated disposal point
exceptions: Where local authority permits controlled discharge to a designated soakaway or drainage channel at the edge of the path

subject: Rainwater Drainage
rule: The rainwater drainage system must not allow cross-connection with potable water supply
conditions: Building has a potable water supply system
exceptions: No genuine exceptions — any cross-connection is a public health violation

subject: Rainwater Drainage
rule: Rainwater drainage pipe materials must be durable against rainwater chemistry and UV exposure where exposed
conditions: Pipes exposed to sunlight or in corrosive environments
exceptions: Pipes fully enclosed within building structure (not UV-exposed) may use less UV-resistant materials

subject: Septic Tank or Sewer Connection
rule: septic tank or sewer connection must have a downstream outlet or disposal path
conditions: entity is a septic tank or sewer connection

subject: Septic Tank or Sewer Connection
rule: septic tank or sewer connection must be watertight and prevent untreated leakage into surrounding ground
conditions: entity is a septic tank or sewer connection

subject: Septic Tank or Sewer Connection
rule: septic tank or sewer connection must not be located uphill from or too close to a water well or surface water body without adequate separation
conditions: entity is a septic tank or sewer connection
a water well or surface water body is present on or adjacent to the site
exceptions: engineered treatment system achieves equivalent pathogen reduction and is approved by the relevant authority

subject: Structural Frame
rule: structural frame must provide continuous load path to foundation
conditions: for any building with a structural frame

subject: Structural Frame
rule: structural frame must not have a missing or incomplete lateral load-resisting system
conditions: in regions with wind or seismic loads
exceptions: structures designed for low-risk regions with no lateral loading requirement

subject: Structural Frame
rule: structural frame must not have structural members that exceed their load-bearing capacity under design loads

subject: Structural Frame
rule: connections in the structural frame must be capable of transferring design forces between connected members

subject: Structural Frame
rule: structural frame must be supported on a foundation system capable of bearing the imposed loads without excessive settlement or bearing failure

subject: Exterior Walls
rule: exterior walls must resist lateral wind loads
conditions: building is in a wind-prone region
building height exceeds 10 meters

subject: Exterior Walls
rule: exterior walls must be continuous from foundation to roof diaphragm
conditions: building has a roof diaphragm
building is in a seismic zone

subject: Exterior Walls
rule: exterior walls must not have openings that exceed the maximum permitted percentage of wall area
conditions: wall is load-bearing
wall is part of the lateral force-resisting system
exceptions: engineered structural frame provides alternative load path

subject: Exterior Walls
rule: exterior walls must have a fire-resistance rating meeting the building code minimum for the occupancy type
conditions: building is of combustible construction
building has more than one story
adjacent building is within fire separation distance
exceptions: building is fully sprinklered per NFPA 13 and local code allows reduction

subject: Exterior Walls
rule: exterior walls must have a continuous air barrier system
conditions: building is conditioned
building is located in a climate zone with heating or cooling degree days
exceptions: building is an unconditioned structure such as an open parking garage

subject: Roof Assembly
rule: roof assembly must provide a continuous water-shedding surface
conditions: applies to all building roof assemblies
exceptions: green/vegetated roofs designed for retention are exempt from water-shedding in the immediate runoff sense, though still require waterproofing

subject: Roof Assembly
rule: roof assembly must have a minimum slope for drainage of standing water
conditions: applies to all roof assemblies except those explicitly designed as 'dead-level' with dedicated positive drainage systems
exceptions: vegetated roofs with engineered drainage layers and membrane waterproofing may function at nominally zero slope
some modified-bitumen or single-ply low-slope roofs with tapered insulation systems can achieve drainage at slopes as low as 1/8 inch per foot

subject: Roof Assembly
rule: roof assembly must not have openings or penetrations that are unsealed against water intrusion
conditions: applies to any roof assembly that includes penetrations (vent pipes, flues, skylights, mechanical curbs)

subject: Interior Partition Walls
rule: Interior partition walls must be laterally braced to prevent out-of-plane buckling
conditions: wall height exceeds 10 times its thickness
wall is not a shear wall or part of a lateral force resisting system
exceptions: walls that are self-bracing (e.g., curved-shell or rigid-frame partitions designed to resist lateral loads)

subject: Interior Partition Walls
rule: Interior partition walls must not impose vertical load on structural elements beyond their design capacity
conditions: partition walls are non-loadbearing (typical)
exceptions: intentionally loadbearing partition walls designed as structural elements

subject: Interior Partition Walls
rule: Interior partition walls must have a fire-resistance rating not less than that required by applicable building code for the occupancy and location
conditions: wall separates dwelling units
wall separates exit corridors from adjacent spaces
wall encloses a shaft or stairwell
wall is required to have a fire-resistance rating by local code
exceptions: walls in single-family dwellings where code does not mandate a rating
walls entirely within a single dwelling unit where no rating is required

subject: Interior Partition Walls
rule: Interior partition walls must not be constructed of materials that emit toxic fumes at the expected temperature range of a fire in the building
conditions: wall is part of a means of egress or required fire-resistance-rated assembly
building code restricts combustible or toxic materials in such locations
exceptions: materials that are code-compliant and tested for limited flame spread and smoke development

subject: Interior Partition Walls
rule: Interior partition walls must not be installed in a way that blocks required means of egress width
conditions: wall encroaches into a corridor, hallway, or doorway required for egress
exceptions: walls that are recessed or located such that they do not reduce the required clear egress width

subject: Doors
rule: a door must have a clear opening width of at least 32 inches (813 mm) when the door is open to 90 degrees
conditions: door is part of a means of egress
occupancy is other than one- and two-family dwellings
exceptions: existing doors in alterations where factors beyond the door prevent compliance

subject: Doors
rule: a door must not obstruct the required width of an accessible route when in any position
conditions: door serves an accessible space
door swings into the accessible route
exceptions: door is automatic or power-operated

subject: Doors
rule: a door must have a clear opening height of at least 80 inches (2032 mm)
exceptions: door openings in residential dwelling units serving a closet that does not exceed 24 inches in depth

subject: Doors
rule: a door must be operable with a single effort requiring no more than 5 lbf (22.2 N) for interior hinged doors and 8.5 lbf (37.8 N) for other doors
conditions: door is required to be accessible
exceptions: fire doors where fire rating requires greater latching force
doors in certain security applications

subject: Kitchen Cabinetry
rule: kitchen cabinetry must be constructed from materials that can withstand the moisture levels and temperature ranges typical in a kitchen environment
conditions: cabinetry is installed in a functional kitchen
exceptions: cabinetry is purely decorative and not intended for any food preparation or storage use

subject: Kitchen Cabinetry
rule: kitchen cabinetry must not block or obstruct required ventilation paths for cooking appliances or building mechanical systems
conditions: cabinetry is installed near a cooktop, range, oven, or any HVAC vent/return
exceptions: a dedicated engineered duct or ventilation path has been provided that routes around or through the cabinetry and meets code requirements

subject: Kitchen Cabinetry
rule: kitchen cabinetry must have all exposed edges and surfaces sealed or finished to prevent moisture ingress
conditions: cabinetry is constructed from engineered wood products (MDF, particleboard, plywood)
exceptions: cabinetry is made entirely of solid wood or materials that are inherently moisture-resistant (e.g., stainless steel) requiring no edge sealing

subject: Bathroom Fixtures
rule: bathroom fixture waste outlet must connect to a sanitary drainage system that is separate from stormwater drainage
conditions: fixture produces liquid waste (e.g., toilet, sink, shower, bidet)

subject: Bathroom Fixtures
rule: bathroom fixture water supply must be protected against backflow to the potable water system
conditions: fixture is connected to a potable water supply line

subject: Bathroom Fixtures
rule: bathroom fixture with an electrical component must be grounded and GFCI-protected
conditions: fixture incorporates electrical components (e.g., electric towel warmer, bidet seat with heater, washlet, electric shower pump)

subject: Bathroom Fixtures
rule: toilet waste outlet must connect to a drainage pipe of at least 3-inch (76 mm) nominal diameter
conditions: fixture is a water closet (toilet)

subject: Fireplace
rule: fireplace flue must extend above the roof surface
conditions: fireplace is vented to the exterior
fireplace burns solid fuel (wood, pellets, coal) or gas
exceptions: electric fireplace with no combustion and no flue

subject: Fireplace
rule: combustible materials must not be placed within the required clearance zone around the fireplace
conditions: fireplace burns solid fuel or gas
exceptions: fireplace is listed and installed with an approved zero-clearance system following manufacturer specifications

subject: Fireplace
rule: fireplace must have a non-combustible hearth extending in front and to the sides
conditions: fireplace burns solid fuel
exceptions: gas fireplace with sealed glass front and listed for installation without a hearth

subject: Fireplace
rule: chimney must be lined with a code-compliant flue liner
conditions: fireplace has a masonry chimney

subject: Garage
rule: garage floor must slope toward the door for drainage
exceptions: garages that are not enclosed or do not have a floor slab

subject: Garage
rule: garage must have a minimum ceiling height that accommodates the largest intended vehicle
conditions: garage is designed for vehicle storage
exceptions: garage used exclusively for non-vehicle storage or as a workshop with no vehicle entry

subject: Garage
rule: garage floor must be capable of supporting the live load of parked vehicles
conditions: garage is designed for vehicle storage

subject: Built-In Seating
rule: built-in seating must have adequate structural support to carry expected live loads (e.g., occupants plus normal use)
conditions: seating is intended for occupancy
exceptions: purely decorative seating not designed to support weight

subject: Built-In Seating
rule: built-in seating must have a finished surface or edge treatment that prevents injury from splinters, sharp edges, or rough materials
conditions: seating is in an occupied space accessible to users

subject: Built-In Seating
rule: built-in seating must not block required means of egress or reduce corridor clearance below minimum code width
conditions: seating is located adjacent to or within circulation paths or egress routes
exceptions: where seating is set back such that clear egress width is maintained per applicable code

subject: Front Porch
rule: A front porch must have a minimum clear walking width of at least 36 inches (914 mm) for egress and accessible passage
conditions: porch serves as primary or secondary egress path
porch is intended for occupant use
exceptions: porch serves exclusively as decorative feature with no floor area intended for occupancy

subject: Front Porch
rule: A front porch floor surface must be sloped away from the building (minimum 1/4 inch per foot) to prevent water accumulation against the structure
conditions: porch is covered and exposed to precipitation
exceptions: porch is fully enclosed and waterproofed by an integrated drainage system

subject: Front Porch
rule: A front porch with steps must have a handrail on at least one side if the stair rise exceeds 30 inches
conditions: porch has stairs
total stair rise exceeds 30 inches

subject: Front Porch
rule: A front porch guardrail (if elevated more than 30 inches above grade) must have balusters spaced no more than 4 inches apart
conditions: porch floor is more than 30 inches above adjacent grade
porch has a guardrail

subject: Front Porch
rule: A front porch must not trap standing water on its walking surface
conditions: porch has a floor/deck surface
exceptions: porch surface is designed as a shallow water feature (e.g., splash pond) as a deliberate design intent

subject: Rainwater Gutter System
rule: gutter must have continuous slope toward downspout outlet
conditions: gravity-fed system
no siphonic/equalizer system
exceptions: siphonic roof drainage systems that operate under negative pressure

subject: Rainwater Gutter System
rule: gutter cross-section must be free of internal obstructions that block water flow
exceptions: purpose-built internal baffles or flow directors that are designed to guide water without blocking flow

subject: Rainwater Gutter System
rule: downspout outlet must discharge to an approved location (e.g., storm drainage system, splash block, rain garden) and not directly onto a walkway or foundation

subject: Rainwater Gutter System
rule: gutter material must be compatible with the roof runoff chemistry and local climate to prevent corrosion or degradation within design life

subject: Rainwater Gutter System
rule: seams and joints in the gutter system must be watertight

subject: Micro-Foundation & Floor Slab
rule: micro-foundation must bear on undisturbed soil or engineered fill with adequate bearing capacity
conditions: micro-foundation is present
floor slab is present
exceptions: deep foundation system transfers load to deeper strata

subject: Micro-Foundation & Floor Slab
rule: micro-foundation and floor slab must not be placed on frozen ground
conditions: construction occurs in cold climate
ground is subject to freezing

subject: Micro-Foundation & Floor Slab
rule: floor slab must be provided with a vapor retarder beneath it when in contact with soil or aggregate base
conditions: floor slab is on-grade or below-grade
slab is interior conditioned space
exceptions: unconditioned or ventilated crawl space where moisture migration is not detrimental

subject: Micro-Foundation & Floor Slab
rule: micro-foundation must be protected from frost heave
conditions: frost-susceptible soil is present
foundation is in a frost-prone climate
exceptions: foundation depth extends below frost line
frost-protected shallow foundation design with insulation is used

subject: Compact Roof Assembly
rule: compact roof assembly must provide a continuous drainage path to shed water
conditions: when used in an external building envelope application

subject: Compact Roof Assembly
rule: compact roof assembly must have a vapor retarder or venting strategy to prevent moisture accumulation within the assembly
conditions: when the assembly is installed over a conditioned interior space
exceptions: assemblies designed with fully vented drainage cavities that equalize vapor pressure may omit a dedicated vapor retarder if climate and local code permit

subject: Compact Roof Assembly
rule: compact roof assembly must be securely fastened or ballasted to resist wind uplift forces
conditions: when installed in a region with design wind speeds exceeding 100 mph (basic wind speed) or on a building above 30 ft in height

subject: Single-Layer Exterior Wall System
rule: Single-layer exterior wall system must be structurally anchored to the building frame
conditions: wall is load-bearing or subjected to wind/seismic loads
exceptions: free-standing non-structural walls not attached to a building

subject: Single-Layer Exterior Wall System
rule: Single-layer exterior wall system must incorporate a continuous water-resistive barrier (WRB) or equivalent behind the cladding
conditions: wall separates conditioned interior space from exterior environment
assembly is not designed as a drained/ventilated rainscreen with intentional drainage cavity
exceptions: wall systems that are inherently waterproof (e.g., monolithic cast-in-place concrete walls where concrete itself serves as both structure and WRB)
temporary structures not intended to be weathertight

subject: Single-Layer Exterior Wall System
rule: Single-layer exterior wall system must not have thermal bridges exceeding 5% of the opaque wall area unless compensated by interior continuous insulation
conditions: wall is part of a conditioned building in a climate zone with heating degree days > 2000 or cooling degree days > 1500
exceptions: unconditioned buildings such as unheated storage or parking structures

subject: Single-Layer Exterior Wall System
rule: Single-layer exterior wall system must have all joints and penetrations sealed against air and water intrusion
conditions: wall assembly is intended to be air-barrier and water-barrier continuous
exceptions: walls designed as intentionally ventilated assemblies (e.g., some agricultural or industrial buildings) where ventilation is a design requirement

subject: Entry Door & Locking System
rule: entry door must have a lock that engages with the door frame or strike plate
conditions: door is part of an exterior wall
door provides access to an occupiable space
exceptions: doors that are purely decorative and not intended for security or privacy

subject: Entry Door & Locking System
rule: entry door must not have a locking mechanism that can be engaged while the door is open if the design intends to prevent occupant entrapment
conditions: door swings inward
door is for a room with no other means of egress
exceptions: doors equipped with tool-free emergency release hardware (e.g., push-to-exit, panic bar)

subject: Entry Door & Locking System
rule: entry door strike plate must be securely fastened to the door frame and not rely solely on the door stop or casing
conditions: door is a primary exterior entry door

subject: Entry Door & Locking System
rule: entry door locking system must not prevent the door from being opened from the inside without a key or special knowledge
conditions: door is a means of egress from an occupiable space
exceptions: where local code permits egress-controlled locks (e.g., certain high-security exits with approved release mechanisms)

subject: Entry Door & Locking System
rule: entry door hinges must support the door weight such that the door does not sag and misalign the locking mechanism
conditions: door weight exceeds hinge capacity rating

subject: Single-Pane or Double-Glazed Window Unit
rule: Single-pane or double-glazed window unit must be structurally framed to prevent glass from falling out

subject: Single-Pane or Double-Glazed Window Unit
rule: Single-pane or double-glazed window unit must have an air-tight perimeter seal to prevent uncontrolled air leakage
conditions: when installed in a conditioned building envelope

subject: Single-Pane or Double-Glazed Window Unit
rule: Single-pane or double-glazed window unit must be glazed with a material that is transparent or translucent to visible light
exceptions: decorative or opaque spandrel glass panels used as visual infill rather than vision glazing

subject: Single-Pane or Double-Glazed Window Unit
rule: Single-pane or double-glazed window unit must not have a single glass layer thinner than the minimum safe thickness for its area and wind load
conditions: when subject to design wind pressures as per applicable building code

subject: Single-Pane or Double-Glazed Window Unit
rule: Double-glazed window unit must have a sealed insulating glass (IG) cavity that is hermetically sealed
conditions: if the unit is double-glazed

subject: Micro-Kitchen Block
rule: Micro-Kitchen Block must have a dedicated electrical circuit with GFCI protection
conditions: when installed in a commercial or multi-unit residential building

subject: Micro-Kitchen Block
rule: Micro-Kitchen Block must have a water supply shut-off valve within accessible reach
conditions: when connected to building plumbing

subject: Micro-Kitchen Block
rule: Micro-Kitchen Block must not have exposed electrical outlets within 600 mm horizontal reach of a sink basin
conditions: when sink and outlets are part of the same unit

subject: Micro-Kitchen Block
rule: Micro-Kitchen Block must have a ventilation path to outdoors or to a mechanically exhausted system
conditions: when unit includes a cooktop or range

subject: Compact Bathroom Pod
rule: bathroom pod must have a waterproof floor pan or continuous waterproof membrane covering the entire wet area floor

subject: Compact Bathroom Pod
rule: bathroom pod must not have electrical outlets or switches located within the defined splash zone (typically within 600 mm horizontally of a water outlet or shower head)
conditions: where electrical fixtures are present within the pod
exceptions: outlets specifically rated for wet locations (IPX5 or higher) and protected by a residual-current device

subject: Compact Bathroom Pod
rule: bathroom pod must have a mechanical ventilation path (either passive vent to outside or active exhaust fan ducted to exterior) to remove moisture-laden air
conditions: pod is fully enclosed and used for bathing/showering

subject: Compact Bathroom Pod
rule: bathroom pod drainage system must have a minimum slope (typically 1:50 to 1:100) toward the drain outlet to prevent standing water
conditions: pod includes a shower or floor drain

subject: Compact Bathroom Pod
rule: bathroom pod toilet waste connection must have a trap seal of at least 50 mm to prevent sewer gas ingress
conditions: pod includes a toilet

subject: Multi-Functional Sleeping / Living Platform
rule: sleeping/living platform must have a minimum load capacity sufficient to support static and dynamic human occupancy
conditions: platform intended for human occupation

subject: Multi-Functional Sleeping / Living Platform
rule: sleeping/living platform must have a slip-resistant walking surface
conditions: platform surface used for barefoot or stocking-foot walking/standing

subject: Multi-Functional Sleeping / Living Platform
rule: sleeping/living platform must not have unguarded edges exceeding a drop height where fall risk is unacceptable
conditions: platform elevated above floor/ground by more than typical bed height (e.g. >30 cm)
exceptions: platform designed as floor-level (mat on ground) with no fall hazard

subject: Multi-Functional Sleeping / Living Platform
rule: sleeping/living platform must be made of materials that do not off-gas hazardous volatile organic compounds at levels exceeding indoor air quality limits
conditions: enclosed indoor use
platform includes manufactured wood products, adhesives, or synthetic materials
exceptions: platform used only outdoors or in continuously ventilated non-residential space

subject: Integrated Storage System
rule: Integrated Storage System must maintain structural enclosure integrity to prevent environmental ingress
conditions: when installed outdoors or in unconditioned spaces
exceptions: systems designed for indoor conditioned environments with no weather exposure

subject: Integrated Storage System
rule: Integrated Storage System must have a thermal management path that prevents internal temperature exceeding component rated limits
conditions: under any expected ambient temperature range and maximum sustained charge/discharge rate
exceptions: systems rated for passive thermal operation where self-heating never exceeds limits under worst-case conditions

subject: Integrated Storage System
rule: Integrated Storage System must not allow intermixing of incompatible chemistries or voltage classes within the same enclosure without physical isolation barriers
conditions: when multiple battery modules or cell types are colocated
exceptions: modules explicitly designed and certified for direct electrical paralleling with interoperable battery management systems

subject: Point-of-Use Water Heater
rule: point-of-use water heater must be installed with a pressure and temperature (P&T) relief valve
conditions: when connected to a pressurized water supply
exceptions: factory-sealed systems that include an approved combination P&T relief valve

subject: Point-of-Use Water Heater
rule: point-of-use water heater must have an electrical supply that matches its rated voltage and amperage
conditions: when electrically powered

subject: Point-of-Use Water Heater
rule: point-of-use water heater must not be installed in a location subject to freezing temperatures
conditions: when water-filled and not designed for freeze protection
exceptions: units specifically rated and equipped with freeze-protection features

subject: Point-of-Use Water Heater
rule: point-of-use water heater must have a cold water supply line connected to its inlet

subject: Point-of-Use Water Heater
rule: point-of-use water heater must be oriented vertically within manufacturer-specified tilt tolerance
conditions: when unit is a tank-type water heater
exceptions: units explicitly designed for horizontal or multi-orientation mounting

subject: Mechanical Ventilation with Heat Recovery (MVHR) Unit
rule: MVHR unit must have a condensate drain line to a suitable drainage point
conditions: unit includes a heat recovery core that produces condensate
unit operates in climates or conditions where intake air temperature can drop below the dew point of exhaust air
exceptions: unit is installed in a fully conditioned space where condensate is negligible and manufacturer explicitly waives drain requirement

subject: Mechanical Ventilation with Heat Recovery (MVHR) Unit
rule: MVHR unit must not be installed with shared ductwork connecting to a combustion appliance flue or exhaust system
conditions: building contains any combustion appliance (gas boiler, gas fireplace, wood stove, oil furnace) that vents combustion products
exceptions: combustion appliance is fully sealed/condensing with its own dedicated outdoor air supply and the MVHR ductwork is independently verified to have no cross-connection

subject: Mechanical Ventilation with Heat Recovery (MVHR) Unit
rule: MVHR unit must have accessible filters upstream of the heat exchanger on both intake and exhaust sides
conditions: unit is in continuous operation for occupied spaces
exceptions: manufacturer-specified filterless unit designed specifically for cleanroom environments with HEPA bypass filtering elsewhere in the system

subject: Mechanical Ventilation with Heat Recovery (MVHR) Unit
rule: MVHR unit must not be operated without frost protection strategy in sub-zero intake air conditions
conditions: outdoor intake air temperature regularly falls below -5°C
unit has a non-hygroscopic enthalpy or aluminum heat exchanger core
exceptions: unit has a ground-coupled intake preheater (buried pipe) that raises intake temperature above freezing
unit is equipped with an electric preheater or recirculation defrost cycle that activates automatically

subject: Single-Zone Heating / Cooling Split System
rule: refrigerant lines between indoor and outdoor units must be properly insulated
conditions: system uses vapor-compression refrigeration cycle
lines carry refrigerant between indoor evaporator and outdoor condenser/compressor
exceptions: lines are never exposed to ambient temperature differences
line set is factory pre-insulated as a single assembly

subject: Single-Zone Heating / Cooling Split System
rule: condensate drain pan and drain line must be sloped to allow gravity drainage of condensate water
conditions: system includes an indoor evaporator coil that produces condensate during cooling operation
exceptions: unit uses a condensate pump that actively lifts water

subject: Single-Zone Heating / Cooling Split System
rule: outdoor unit must not be installed in a fully enclosed space without adequate ventilation for heat rejection
conditions: outdoor unit rejects heat via condenser coil and fan
exceptions: space is mechanically ventilated with sufficient air changes to reject condenser heat load

subject: Single-Zone Heating / Cooling Split System
rule: supply and return air plenums must be sealed and continuous to prevent air leakage
conditions: system includes ducted air distribution
exceptions: unit is ductless mini-split with no ductwork

subject: Single-Zone Heating / Cooling Split System
rule: refrigerant charge must be within manufacturer-specified range for the installed line set length
conditions: system is charged with refrigerant on-site or has field-adjustable charge
exceptions: factory-sealed pre-charged system with line set length exactly matching factory charge conditions

subject: Lighting Fixture Set
rule: lighting fixture set must be rated for the environmental conditions of its installation location (e.g., IP rating for moisture/dust, temperature rating)

subject: Lighting Fixture Set
rule: lighting fixture set must not exceed the maximum load rating of its mounting surface or support structure

subject: Lighting Fixture Set
rule: lighting fixture set must have electrical connections that comply with applicable wiring and grounding codes (e.g., NEC)

subject: Electrical Distribution Board & Meter
rule: Electrical Distribution Board & Meter must be installed with IP (Ingress Protection) rating suitable for its location (indoor/outdoor/wet/dry)
exceptions: Temporary installations during construction

subject: Electrical Distribution Board & Meter
rule: Electrical Distribution Board & Meter must have a locked or sealed enclosure to prevent unauthorized access
conditions: Board is accessible to the public or shared premises
exceptions: Boards located within a locked utility room that itself is secured

subject: Electrical Distribution Board & Meter
rule: Electrical Distribution Board & Meter must not be installed in a location subject to flooding or where standing water can accumulate
exceptions: Boards rated for submersion (e.g., IP68) and approved for such use by authority having jurisdiction

subject: Electrical Distribution Board & Meter
rule: Electrical Distribution Board & Meter must be mounted on a non-combustible surface or with a fire-rated backing board
conditions: Board contains overcurrent protection devices (circuit breakers/fuses)
exceptions: Boards mounted on fire-rated enclosures that provide equivalent thermal protection

subject: Electrical Distribution Board & Meter
rule: Electrical Distribution Board & Meter must have a minimum working clearance in front of the board as prescribed by local electrical code (typically 900–1100 mm)
conditions: Board is permanently installed and requires operator access

subject: Electrical Distribution Board & Meter
rule: Electrical Distribution Board & Meter must not be located directly above or below a water pipe, sink, or sanitary fixture
exceptions: Board and all its components are rated for wet locations and installed with drip-proof shielding

subject: Electrical Distribution Board & Meter
rule: Electrical Distribution Board & Meter must be installed with the main switch or isolating device that disconnects all live supply conductors
conditions: Board is the main point of supply entry to a premises

subject: Rainwater Downpipe & Greywater Diversion
rule: rainwater downpipe must be connected to a gutter system or roof drainage outlet
conditions: when collecting rainwater from roof surfaces

subject: Rainwater Downpipe & Greywater Diversion
rule: greywater diversion system must not connect to potable water supply lines

subject: Rainwater Downpipe & Greywater Diversion
rule: rainwater downpipe must have a minimum diameter sufficient to convey peak roof runoff without overflowing

subject: Rainwater Downpipe & Greywater Diversion
rule: greywater diversion must include a backflow prevention device or air gap
conditions: when greywater system is connected to any plumbing system that also serves fixtures using potable water

subject: Plumbing Rough-In Network
rule: Plumbing rough-in network must maintain minimum slope for drainage (e.g., 1/4 inch per foot for waste pipes)
conditions: Applies to gravity-drained waste and vent piping within the rough-in network
exceptions: Where waste is mechanically assisted (e.g., grinder pump or vacuum system)

subject: Plumbing Rough-In Network
rule: Plumbing rough-in network must have adequate venting to prevent siphoning of trap seals
conditions: Applies to all drainage fixture connections within the rough-in network
exceptions: Fixtures with integral venting devices approved by applicable plumbing code

subject: Plumbing Rough-In Network
rule: Plumbing rough-in network must not have waste piping smaller than the minimum diameter required for each fixture or appliance served
conditions: Applies to all sanitary drainage branches within the rough-in network

subject: Exterior Cladding or Finish Layer
rule: exterior cladding or finish layer must be weather-resistant to prevent moisture ingress into the building envelope
conditions: the cladding is exposed to exterior weather conditions

subject: Exterior Cladding or Finish Layer
rule: exterior cladding or finish layer must be securely attached to the structural backing or substructure

subject: Exterior Cladding or Finish Layer
rule: exterior cladding or finish layer must not create a combustible fire path that can spread flame vertically across the building face
conditions: the building is higher than 2 storeys or subject to fire code
exceptions: tested and approved fire-resistive assembly with non-combustible core or fire-stops at every floor level

subject: Exterior Cladding or Finish Layer
rule: exterior cladding or finish layer must have drainage or weep provisions to prevent water accumulation behind the cladding
conditions: the cladding system is not a fully-adhered membrane directly on substrate (i.e., is a drained or rainscreen assembly)

subject: Fire Detection & Alarm Device
rule: A fire detection and alarm device must be connected to a reliable primary power source (e.g., building mains with backup) to remain operational at all times
conditions: The device is not a purely mechanical (non-electric) alarm
exceptions: Battery-powered single-station smoke alarms that comply with local codes and are tested periodically may be considered compliant if battery backup is treated as the primary source in the specific application

subject: Fire Detection & Alarm Device
rule: A fire detection and alarm device must not be installed in a location where ambient conditions (temperature, humidity, dust, steam, or airflow) would prevent it from sensing fire or initiating an alarm
conditions: The device relies on heat, smoke, or gas sensing to operate
exceptions: Devices specifically rated and listed for the given environment (e.g., explosion-proof detectors in hazardous locations)

subject: Fire Detection & Alarm Device
rule: A fire detection and alarm device must be positioned so that its notification signal (audible or visible) is perceivable by intended occupants throughout the protected space
conditions: The device serves as a notification appliance (e.g., horn, strobe, speaker)
exceptions: Systems that rely solely on remote monitoring/central station signaling with no occupant notification requirement

subject: Fire Detection & Alarm Device
rule: A fire detection and alarm device must not have its detection or notification function blocked by building finishes, furniture, or structural elements
conditions: The device is installed in an occupied space
exceptions: Devices placed in designated service/utility spaces where blockage is accounted for by design and code

subject: Floor Finish Material
rule: Floor finish material must have a hardness (e.g., determined by scratch resistance or indentation tests) sufficient to resist permanent indentation or abrasion under the expected foot and furniture traffic loads for its occupancy type
conditions: applies to all floor finish materials installed in occupied spaces
exceptions: temporary protective coverings not considered permanent finish

subject: Floor Finish Material
rule: Floor finish material must not have a coefficient of friction (slip resistance) below the minimum safe value required by applicable building code for the occupancy and whether the surface is expected to be wet or dry
conditions: applies to all walking surfaces
exceptions: areas not intended for occupancy or pedestrian traffic (e.g., inside a sealed equipment plenum)

subject: Floor Finish Material
rule: Floor finish material must not emit volatile organic compounds (VOCs) above the maximum allowable emission rate specified by relevant indoor air quality regulations or green building standards for the enclosed occupancy type
conditions: applies to interior floor finish materials installed within conditioned occupied spaces
exceptions: exterior or unconditioned spaces not classified as occupied

subject: Floor Finish Material
rule: Floor finish material must be dimensionally stable under the anticipated range of temperature and humidity conditions of its installed environment such that it does not buckle, curl, gap, or delaminate
conditions: applies to all permanent floor finish materials
exceptions: sacrificial or temporary finishes intended for short-term use where dimensional movement is acceptable

subject: Interior Wall & Ceiling Lining
rule: Interior wall and ceiling lining must provide a fire-resistance rating compliant with building code for the specific occupancy and fire zone
conditions: building is of a type requiring fire-resistance-rated separation
lining is used in a fire-rated assembly
applicable building code requires fire rating for occupancy type
exceptions: lining is used in a non-combustible or sprinklered building where code exempts the specific lining material
lining is behind a fire-rated covering or assembly that independently meets the rating

subject: Interior Wall & Ceiling Lining
rule: Interior wall and ceiling lining must not promote rapid flame spread (must meet flame spread index limits per building code)
conditions: lining is installed in a means of egress corridor
lining is installed in a room exceeding code-defined area limits
lining material classification is regulated by local building code
exceptions: lining is specifically tested and listed as acceptable for unclassified use
entire building is protected throughout by an approved automatic sprinkler system and code allows reduced classification

subject: Interior Wall & Ceiling Lining
rule: Interior ceiling lining must have a means of access for inspection and maintenance of concealed spaces above (where such spaces contain building services)
conditions: ceiling lining encloses a plenum or concealed space containing mechanical, electrical, or plumbing systems
access is not otherwise provided from the floor above
exceptions: concealed space is unconditionally inaccessible and contains no serviceable equipment
all services in the concealed space are designed for zero-maintenance and are sealed for the life of the building

subject: Interior Wall & Ceiling Lining
rule: Interior wall and ceiling lining must be structurally fixed to supporting framing such that it will not detach under its own weight or under normal service loads
conditions: lining is installed in any occupied space

subject: Thermal Insulation Layer
rule: Thermal insulation layer must remain dry to maintain its thermal performance
conditions: Insulation is of a type whose R-value degrades with moisture content
exceptions: Insulation specifically designed for wet service conditions (e.g., closed-cell spray foam, extruded polystyrene below grade)

subject: Thermal Insulation Layer
rule: Thermal insulation layer must not be compressed beyond its design thickness
conditions: Insulation is of a compressible type (e.g., fiberglass batts, mineral wool)
exceptions: Rigid insulation boards or spray foams that are not compressible in service

subject: Thermal Insulation Layer
rule: Thermal insulation layer must be continuous across the building envelope with no uninsulated gaps
exceptions: Intentional thermal breaks for structural elements (e.g., slab edges, balcony connections) where structural continuity is required

subject: Thermal Insulation Layer
rule: Thermal insulation layer must be installed on the correct side of the vapor retarder where required by climate and assembly type
conditions: A vapor retarder or vapor barrier is present in the assembly
Climate zone requires vapor control
exceptions: Insulation types that are themselves vapor-permeable and part of a designed drying assembly

subject: Waterproofing & Vapor Control Membranes
rule: Waterproofing membrane must be continuous across the entire building envelope surface it is intended to protect
conditions: when serving as primary water barrier
exceptions: intentional drainage openings or weeps

subject: Waterproofing & Vapor Control Membranes
rule: Vapor retarder/barrier must be installed on the warm side of the insulation assembly in the relevant climate
conditions: in heating-dominated climates
when the membrane functions as a vapor control layer
