subject: Waterproofing & Vapor Control Membranes
rule: Waterproofing membrane must not be directly exposed to sustained UV radiation without UV-resistant rating or protective covering
conditions: when installed above grade or on roofs
exceptions: membranes specifically rated for UV exposure per manufacturer

subject: Waterproofing & Vapor Control Membranes
rule: Vapor-impermeable membrane must not be installed in a location that traps moisture between two vapor-impermeable layers
conditions: when both the interior and exterior layers of the assembly are vapor-impermeable

subject: Structural Framing
rule: Structural framing members must be capable of supporting all applied dead, live, wind, seismic, and other environmental loads without exceeding allowable stress or deflection limits
conditions: Load-bearing structural framing

subject: Structural Framing
rule: Structural framing connections (welds, bolts, rivets, or welds) must develop the required strength and stiffness of the connected members
conditions: Any structural frame connection

subject: Structural Framing
rule: Structural framing must not have a load path discontinuity that prevents gravity or lateral loads from reaching the foundation
conditions: Gravity or lateral load-resisting system

subject: Structural Framing
rule: Structural framing must maintain stability against overturning, sliding, and uplift under design load combinations

subject: Structural Framing
rule: Steel structural framing must be protected against corrosion where exposed to moisture or corrosive environments
conditions: Steel framing in exterior or wet environments
exceptions: Stainless steel or inherently corrosion-resistant alloys used in lieu of coating

subject: Interior Walls
rule: Interior walls must be vertically plumb (true vertical) within allowable tolerances
conditions: walls are load-bearing
walls are partition walls
exceptions: temporary shoring or bracing during construction

subject: Interior Walls
rule: Interior walls must not compromise the structural load path by being installed without proper bearing or transfer connections
conditions: wall is load-bearing
wall is shear wall

subject: Interior Walls
rule: Interior walls must provide fire-resistance rating as required by building code for their location and occupancy
conditions: wall separates dwelling units
wall separates different occupancy classifications
wall encloses exit stairs or corridors
wall is a fire barrier per code

subject: Interior Walls
rule: Interior walls must not have electrical wiring or plumbing embedded in a manner that violates minimum cover, derating, or penetrations that exceed fire-rated assembly listing
conditions: wall contains embedded MEP services
exceptions: when specially listed assemblies or approved alternate methods explicitly permit the arrangement

subject: Fireplace / Chimney
rule: A chimney must extend at least 2 feet (610 mm) above any part of the roof within 10 feet (3 m), and at least 3 feet (915 mm) above the roof penetration point if there is no adjacent higher structure within 10 feet
conditions: The chimney is attached to a building with a roof
exceptions: Factory-built chimneys listed and installed per manufacturer instructions may have different clearance requirements

subject: Fireplace / Chimney
rule: A fireplace flue must be lined with a material rated for continuous exposure to combustion gases at the temperatures produced by the appliance
conditions: The fireplace burns solid fuel (wood, coal, pellets)

subject: Fireplace / Chimney
rule: Combustible materials must not be placed within the required clearance distance from the outer surface of a chimney or fireplace
exceptions: Materials specifically tested and listed for zero-clearance installation per manufacturer and code

subject: Fireplace / Chimney
rule: A chimney must have a properly functioning damper that seals when closed
conditions: The fireplace is designed for intermittent use rather than continuous operation
exceptions: Chimneys serving only gas appliances with standing pilot lights may have different damper requirements per code

subject: Built-in Kitchen Cabinetry
rule: built-in kitchen cabinetry must have a minimum clearance of 18 inches between the top of the cooking surface and the bottom of any unprotected combustible cabinet above
conditions: cabinetry is installed above a cooking surface
exceptions: cabinetry has a listed range hood or exhaust fan installed that meets code-required clearance reduction

subject: Built-in Kitchen Cabinetry
rule: built-in kitchen cabinetry must not block or obstruct required electrical receptacle access panels or junction boxes
conditions: cabinetry is installed adjacent to or in front of electrical outlets or junction boxes

subject: Built-in Kitchen Cabinetry
rule: built-in kitchen cabinetry must have a minimum clearance of at least 15/16 inch from the edge of the sink cutout to the nearest cabinet side or partition when a top-mount sink is installed
conditions: cabinetry is configured for a top-mount sink installation

subject: Built-in Kitchen Cabinetry
rule: built-in kitchen cabinetry must be securely fastened to wall studs or a structurally adequate backing at intervals not exceeding 24 inches on center
conditions: cabinetry is wall-mounted

subject: Built-in Kitchen Cabinetry
rule: built-in kitchen cabinetry must not be installed such that the finished floor material is trapped between the cabinet base and the subfloor with no way to install floor covering underneath
conditions: cabinetry is installed before finished flooring
flooring is a floating or dimensionally unstable material that requires underlayment clearance
exceptions: floor covering is designed to be installed before cabinetry with scribe or toe-kick finishing

subject: Porch / Veranda
rule: A porch or veranda must have a minimum clear depth of at least 4 feet (1.2 m) to be usable as an occupiable exterior space

subject: Porch / Veranda
rule: Porch or veranda floor must have a slope of at least 1/4 inch per foot (1:48) away from the adjacent building

subject: Porch / Veranda
rule: Porch or veranda floor surface must not be finished with materials that become dangerously slippery when wet (e.g., polished stone or glazed tile) unless a slip-resistant treatment is applied

subject: Porch / Veranda
rule: A porch or veranda roof (if covered) must have a positive drainage path that does not discharge directly onto building entry paths or the adjacent foundation
conditions: porch or veranda has a roof

subject: Basement / Crawlspace
rule: Basement or crawlspace must be ventilated to prevent moisture buildup and mold
conditions: enclosed space
conditioned or unconditioned below-grade space
exceptions: sealed conditioned crawlspace with vapor barrier and dehumidification system

subject: Basement / Crawlspace
rule: Basement or crawlspace must have a moisture barrier on exposed earth floors
conditions: crawlspace with dirt or gravel floor
exceptions: space with sealed concrete slab as finished floor

subject: Basement / Crawlspace
rule: Basement must have at least one means of egress (door or operable window) meeting minimum clear opening dimensions
conditions: basement used as habitable space or bedroom
exceptions: basement used only for mechanical/utility/storage with no occupancy (check local code)

subject: Basement / Crawlspace
rule: Crawlspace must not allow standing water accumulation
conditions: any crawlspace
exceptions: intentionally designed sump pit with active pumping system

subject: Basement / Crawlspace
rule: Basement or crawlspace must have positive drainage (grading or drainage system) directing surface water away from foundation
conditions: any basement or crawlspace
exceptions: building on raised pier foundation with free air movement underneath

subject: Guttering & Downpipes
rule: Guttering and downpipes must have a continuous, unobstructed fall (slope) toward the outlet/downpipe entry
conditions: When installed on a roofed building with rainfall exposure
exceptions: Internal gutters with positive drainage system pressure

subject: Guttering & Downpipes
rule: Downpipes must discharge to an approved drainage system or legal point of disposal (not directly onto a path or neighbouring property)
conditions: In any habitable building installation
exceptions: Temporary rainwater harvesting collection where overflow is directed to legal discharge

subject: Guttering & Downpipes
rule: Gutter joints and connections must be watertight
conditions: For all sections where gutters and downpipes are joined

subject: Guttering & Downpipes
rule: Gutter capacity must be sufficient to convey the design rainfall event without overflowing
conditions: Under any roof catchment area served by the gutter
exceptions: Where overflow devices are intentionally designed to handle exceedance flows and direct them safely away from the building

subject: Guttering & Downpipes
rule: Downpipes must not be blocked or reduced in cross-sectional area below their design minimum
conditions: At any point along the downpipe run
exceptions: Temporary blockage during maintenance with an operable cleanout provided

subject: Attic
rule: attic must be ventilated to prevent moisture accumulation and heat buildup
conditions: attic is enclosed
attic is habitable or contains mechanical equipment
exceptions: unvented attic assemblies designed with insulated roof decks and air-impermeable insulation per building code

subject: Attic
rule: attic floor (ceiling below) must have sufficient insulation to meet thermal performance requirements
conditions: attic separates conditioned space below from unconditioned attic space above
exceptions: buildings in climate zones with no heating or cooling requirements
attic designed as a conditioned space with insulation at roof plane

subject: Attic
rule: attic must have an access opening of sufficient size for inspection and maintenance
conditions: attic space has a clear height of 30 inches or more over an area of at least 30 square feet
exceptions: scuttle holes smaller than required in existing buildings where structural constraints prevent enlargement

subject: Attic
rule: attic must not have unprotected openings that allow pest entry
conditions: attic is enclosed and connected to the building envelope

subject: Attic
rule: attic must not have plumbing waste pipes that could freeze
conditions: attic is unconditioned
plumbing vent pipes or waste lines pass through the attic
exceptions: pipes are adequately insulated and heat-traced in cold climates
attic is located in a climate zone with no freezing risk

subject: Driveway / Walkway
rule: driveway / walkway must have a minimum cross-slope of 1% for drainage
conditions: applies to exterior paved surfaces exposed to precipitation
exceptions: surfaces designed with permeable paving that allows water infiltration

subject: Driveway / Walkway
rule: driveway / walkway must have a maximum cross-slope of 5% (for pedestrian paths) or 12% (for driveways)
conditions: applies to surfaces intended for pedestrian or vehicle use
exceptions: ramps designed for accessibility may have up to 8.33% slope when following ADA requirements

subject: Driveway / Walkway
rule: driveway / walkway must not have abrupt vertical changes exceeding 0.5 inches (13 mm) without beveling
conditions: applies to joints, settlement offsets, or transitions between materials

subject: Cladding / Siding
rule: Cladding/siding must be weather-resistant to prevent moisture ingress into the building envelope
conditions: when used as the primary exterior weather barrier
exceptions: when used strictly as a decorative rain-screen over a separate fully weatherproofed wall assembly

subject: Cladding / Siding
rule: Cladding/siding must not be attached directly to a combustible exterior insulation layer without a fire-resistant barrier when used on a building taller than two storeys
conditions: when installed over combustible insulation
on buildings exceeding two storeys in height
exceptions: when local building code deems the specific assembly acceptable via full-scale fire testing

subject: Cladding / Siding
rule: Cladding/siding must allow for differential thermal expansion and contraction relative to the structure
conditions: when installed over a structural frame with a different coefficient of thermal expansion
in climates with an annual temperature range exceeding 30°C

subject: Deck / Patio
rule: deck or patio guardrails must have balusters/spindles spaced no more than 4 inches (100 mm) apart
conditions: deck or patio is elevated more than 30 inches (760 mm) above grade
guardrails are installed
exceptions: glass guardrail panels or other infill systems certified to prevent passage of a 4-inch sphere

subject: Deck / Patio
rule: deck or patio guardrails must resist a minimum uniformly distributed live load of 50 lb/ft (0.73 kN/m) applied at the top rail
conditions: deck or patio is elevated more than 30 inches (760 mm) above grade

subject: Deck / Patio
rule: deck ledger connection to the building must not rely solely on nails into the existing rim joist
conditions: deck is attached to the building structure via a ledger board
exceptions: deck is free-standing with no ledger attachment to the building

subject: Deck / Patio
rule: deck or patio surface must slope away from the building at a minimum of 1/4 inch per foot (2% slope)
conditions: deck or patio is adjacent to a building structure
exceptions: surface is designed as a fully drained permeable system with a proven drainage path away from the foundation

subject: Office Modular Desk System
rule: desktop surface must be horizontal and flat within tolerances to support writing, computer use, and other office tasks
conditions: when configured as a primary work surface
exceptions: angled drawing boards or specialty drafting surfaces explicitly designed for sloped use

subject: Office Modular Desk System
rule: modular desk components must be mechanically interlockable or fastenable so the assembled structure is rigid and will not collapse under normal use loads
conditions: when multiple modules are joined side-by-side or in an L/T/U configuration
exceptions: freestanding single-module unit not intended to be joined to others

subject: Office Modular Desk System
rule: desk structure must not tip forward when vertical downward load is applied to the front edge within the normal user reach zone
conditions: in any assembled configuration with a seated user position
exceptions: fixed-to-floor or wall-mounted units with dedicated anchoring hardware

subject: Self-governing Meeting Pod
rule: floor surface must be level within the pod's footprint to prevent tipping of furniture and occupants
conditions: pod is stationary during use
occupants may move within the pod

subject: Self-governing Meeting Pod
rule: enclosure must provide at least one operable means of emergency egress
conditions: pod is enclosed on all sides
pod is intended for occupancy

subject: Self-governing Meeting Pod
rule: interior volume must maintain CO2 concentration below 1000 ppm above ambient under occupied conditions
conditions: pod is enclosed with a door or opening that can be closed during use
pod is occupied by one or more persons
exceptions: pod has a dedicated mechanical ventilation system

subject: Self-governing Meeting Pod
rule: pod structure must not rely on occupants to resist lateral loads
conditions: pod is freestanding (not attached to a building structure)

subject: Workshop Dust Extraction System
rule: ductwork must have a minimum air velocity to prevent dust settling
conditions: system is handling combustible dust
horizontal duct runs exist
exceptions: system is designed for wet collection only

subject: Workshop Dust Extraction System
rule: dust collection system must be electrically bonded and grounded
conditions: ductwork is constructed of conductive material
system handles combustible dust
exceptions: fully non-conductive ductwork with no risk of static accumulation is used (rare in practice)

subject: Workshop Dust Extraction System
rule: filter housing must be located outside the workshop or in a dedicated fire-rated enclosure
conditions: system handles combustible dust

subject: Workshop Dust Extraction System
rule: ductwork must not have unsealed openings or leaks
exceptions: intentional access doors designed for maintenance with proper gasketing

subject: Workshop Dust Extraction System
rule: exhaust air must be filtered to meet applicable emission standards before discharge
conditions: air is discharged to the outdoors
exceptions: system recirculates air back into the workshop after filtration (no outdoor discharge)

subject: Low-Compliance Fire Suppression Rack
rule: fire suppression rack must have a clearly identifiable and unobstructed connection to a water supply or suppression agent source
conditions: the rack is intended to be active/operational
exceptions: the rack is purely a display/dummy unit and explicitly tagged as non-operational

subject: Low-Compliance Fire Suppression Rack
rule: fire suppression rack must not have its discharge nozzles or distribution piping blocked by foreign objects or structural elements
conditions: the rack is installed in its intended operating location

subject: Low-Compliance Fire Suppression Rack
rule: fire suppression rack must be mounted or anchored to prevent tip-over or displacement under its own weight and operational discharge forces
conditions: the rack is intended for stationary use (not handheld/portable)

subject: Workshop Heavy-Duty Floor Finish
rule: heavy-duty floor finish must withstand concentrated point loads from heavy machinery feet, jack stands, and steel wheeled carts without cracking or permanent deformation
conditions: workshop houses machinery weighing over 1000 kg per footprint
workshop uses steel-wheeled or hard rubber wheeled material handling equipment
exceptions: area is only used for light assembly with no heavy point loads

subject: Workshop Heavy-Duty Floor Finish
rule: floor finish must be non-slip when exposed to common workshop fluids (oil, grease, coolant, water)
conditions: workshop involves machining, vehicle repair, or fluid handling operations
exceptions: workshop is dry-process only with no fluids used

subject: Workshop Heavy-Duty Floor Finish
rule: floor finish must be chemically resistant to common workshop chemicals including motor oil, hydraulic fluid, cutting fluids, solvents, and battery acid
conditions: workshop performs vehicle maintenance, machining, or chemical handling
exceptions: workshop is limited to woodworking or dry operations with no chemical exposure

subject: Workshop Heavy-Duty Floor Finish
rule: floor finish must not produce ignitable dust or sparks under heavy abrasion from steel tools, dropped metal objects, or grinding operations
conditions: workshop involves grinding, welding, or metalworking operations that generate sparks or hot debris
floor finish is a combustible material such as certain epoxy or urethane coatings
exceptions: workshop has no ignition sources and is classified non-combustible per fire code

subject: Workshop Heavy-Duty Floor Finish
rule: floor finish must be continuous and seamless in areas subject to fluid immersion
conditions: workshop floor is subjected to standing liquids, washdowns, or fluid immersion during operations
exceptions: workshop is dry and no fluid containment is required

subject: Compact Ventilation Shaft
rule: Compact Ventilation Shaft must maintain a continuous, unobstructed air path from the served space to the exterior
conditions: when shaft serves an occupied interior space
exceptions: shaft is a future stub-out only, not yet active

subject: Compact Ventilation Shaft
rule: Compact Ventilation Shaft must not have its interior cross-section reduced below the minimum free area required by ventilation code for the served occupancy
conditions: shaft is designed to meet minimum ventilation air-flow rates

subject: Compact Ventilation Shaft
rule: Compact Ventilation Shaft must not terminate inside a building cavity or interstitial space
conditions: shaft is part of an active exhaust or supply ventilation system
exceptions: shaft terminates into a dedicated mechanical room designed to handle shaft discharge

subject: Combined Utility Chassis
rule: Combined Utility Chassis must be structurally capable of supporting all mounted equipment under static and dynamic loads
conditions: When equipment is mounted on the chassis

subject: Combined Utility Chassis
rule: Combined Utility Chassis must have attachment points compatible with the mating interfaces of all specified utility modules
conditions: When utility modules are to be attached

subject: Combined Utility Chassis
rule: Combined Utility Chassis must not exceed maximum allowable weight or dimensional limits for its intended deployment context
conditions: When the chassis is intended for transport or deployment within a specified vehicle or facility

subject: Direct-Drain Floor Gully
rule: Direct-drain floor gully must have a continuous unobstructed drainage path from its inlet to the outlet pipe
conditions: when installed as part of a floor drainage system

subject: Direct-Drain Floor Gully
rule: Direct-drain floor gully must have its outlet connected to a drain pipe of equal or larger nominal diameter
exceptions: temporary construction-stage installation where outlet discharges freely to a lower level

subject: Direct-Drain Floor Gully
rule: Direct-drain floor gully must not have its outlet elevation higher than its inlet (weir) elevation
exceptions: pressurized/flooded-floor gully systems specifically designed for trapped positive head

subject: Direct-Drain Floor Gully
rule: Direct-drain floor gully must incorporate a water seal (trap) of minimum depth specified by applicable plumbing code
conditions: when connected to a sanitary drainage system
exceptions: gully discharging directly to a dedicated stormwater system where local code permits an un-trapped connection

subject: Direct-Drain Floor Gully
rule: Direct-drain floor gully must not have its grating/cover installed upside down or missing
exceptions: during maintenance/cleaning only, with temporary barriers in place

subject: Elevator Lobby
rule: elevator lobby must have a fire-rated enclosure (lobby door and walls) separating it from other building spaces on each floor
conditions: building is equipped with an elevator
applicable building code requires fire-rated elevator lobbies (e.g., IBC for buildings over 75 ft in height, or as required by local code)
exceptions: buildings with an automatic sprinkler system throughout where the code permits omission of the lobby
existing buildings not required by code to retrofit

subject: Elevator Lobby
rule: elevator lobby doors must open into the lobby and not directly into the elevator shaft or machine room

subject: Elevator Lobby
rule: elevator lobby floor must be level and free of trip hazards at the elevator entrance threshold

subject: Elevator Lobby
rule: elevator lobby must not have any obstructions (columns, walls, doors) that reduce the required clear width in front of the elevator doors to less than the code minimum landing depth

subject: Bridge / Skywalk
rule: bridge/skywalk load-bearing structure must support its own dead load plus specified live loads without collapse
conditions: structural design

subject: Bridge / Skywalk
rule: bridge/skywalk must not have a net uplift or overturning failure under design wind loads
conditions: wind exposure
lightweight or long-span design

subject: Bridge / Skywalk
rule: bridge/skywalk walking surface must have a slip-resistant finish
conditions: pedestrian accessible areas

subject: Bridge / Skywalk
rule: bridge/skywalk handrails or guardrails must be present on all open sides where the drop exceeds 30 inches
conditions: elevated above grade by more than 30 inches (76 cm)

subject: Bridge / Skywalk
rule: bridge/skywalk must have adequate drainage to prevent standing water on the walking surface
conditions: exposed to precipitation
exceptions: fully enclosed climate-controlled skywalk with sealed roof system

subject: Automatic Sliding Door
rule: Automatic sliding door must have a functioning safety sensor system (e.g., presence/obstruction detection) that stops or reverses door motion when an obstacle is detected in the door path
conditions: Door is power-operated
Door is installed in a public or commercial building accessible to pedestrians
exceptions: Door is purely manual (not power-operated)

subject: Automatic Sliding Door
rule: Automatic sliding door must have a manual break-out or emergency egress capability (panels must swing or break away in the direction of egress when pushed under manual force)
conditions: Door serves as a means of egress from an occupied space
Door is power-operated
exceptions: Door is not on an egress path (e.g., interior room divider not serving as a required exit)

subject: Automatic Sliding Door
rule: Automatic sliding door drive mechanism must be positively disengaged (or door must be manually operable) when power is lost, preventing the door from remaining locked or immovable
conditions: Door is power-operated
exceptions: Door is a security door in a controlled-access environment where fail-secure is specifically permitted by local code

subject: Automatic Sliding Door
rule: Automatic sliding door must not have pinch or shear gaps exceeding code-permitted limits (generally ≤ 4 mm or as specified by standard) between the sliding panel and fixed frame or adjacent stationary panel
conditions: Door is power-operated

subject: Wayfinding Signage
rule: Wayfinding signage must be legible under expected lighting conditions
conditions: signage is installed indoors or outdoors where ambient lighting varies
exceptions: signage is only for temporary use in controlled environments with dedicated task lighting

subject: Wayfinding Signage
rule: Wayfinding signage must have text and symbols that are large enough to be read from the intended viewing distance
conditions: signage is intended for use by pedestrians or vehicle occupants approaching at typical speeds

subject: Wayfinding Signage
rule: Wayfinding signage must not have text or symbols that are illegible due to excessive glare or reflection
conditions: signage uses glossy materials or is placed facing light sources
exceptions: signage is installed in a location where light sources are always behind the viewer

subject: Interior Glazing / Partition
rule: Interior glazing/partition must be fully supported by a structural frame or ceiling track at its top and bottom
conditions: when partition is full-height and non-load-bearing
exceptions: free-standing glass screens anchored directly to floor only
demountable partition systems with proprietary support brackets

subject: Interior Glazing / Partition
rule: Interior glazing/partition must be constructed of safety glass (laminated or tempered) when located in a hazardous location
conditions: when within 600 mm of a doorway
when within 900 mm of floor level on the walking surface
when the glazing is within 300 mm of a door handle
when the partition is in a circulation path accessible to the public
exceptions: glass panels over 1500 mm above the finished floor that are not part of a guard or balustrade

subject: Interior Glazing / Partition
rule: Interior glazing/partition must not have exposed sharp edges or corners on glass panels accessible to occupants
conditions: where the partition is at occupant reach height (0–2000 mm above finished floor)
exceptions: protective edge trim or beveled/polished edges are provided in lieu of removal

subject: Interior Glazing / Partition
rule: Interior glazing/partition must not exceed the maximum unsupported span limits of the specified glass type and thickness
conditions: for any glass panel under in-plane lateral loads (wind, occupant push, door operation)
exceptions: when intermediate stiffeners, mullions, or bracing are provided to reduce effective span

subject: Handrail / Guardrail
rule: Handrail/guardrail must have a top rail capable of withstanding a concentrated load of 200 lbf (0.89 kN) applied in any downward or horizontal direction
conditions: When installed as a stair railing or platform guard
In jurisdictions adopting IBC or similar building codes
exceptions: Handrails in one- and two-family dwellings may have different load requirements under IRC

subject: Handrail / Guardrail
rule: Handrail/guardrail must have a height between 42 inches (1067 mm) and 48 inches (1219 mm) above the walking surface for guards serving multi-family, commercial, or industrial occupancies
conditions: When functioning as a guard (protective barrier at open sides)
On walking surfaces more than 30 inches above the adjacent floor/grade
exceptions: Residential one- and two-family dwellings: minimum 36 inches applies under IRC

subject: Handrail / Guardrail
rule: Handrail/guardrail must have baluster or infill spacing that does not allow passage of a 4-inch (102 mm) sphere
conditions: When the guard has open infill or balusters

subject: Handrail / Guardrail
rule: Handrail/guardrail must not detach from its supporting structure under design loads
conditions: All installations

subject: Handrail / Guardrail
rule: Handrail gripping surface must have a cross-section dimension between 1.25 inches (32 mm) and 2 inches (51 mm) for circular profiles, or a perimeter between 4 inches (102 mm) and 6.25 inches (159 mm) for non-circular profiles
conditions: When the handrail is intended to be grasped by hand for support

subject: Fire Door
rule: Fire door must be self-closing and positive-latching
conditions: used in fire-resistance-rated assembly
exceptions: doors in smoke barriers where automatic release devices are used

subject: Fire Door
rule: Fire door must have a fire-resistance rating equal to or greater than the wall assembly in which it is installed

subject: Fire Door
rule: Fire door must not have unprotected glass panels exceeding the allowed area for the door's fire rating
conditions: door contains vision panels or glazing
exceptions: glazed assemblies tested and rated as part of the complete door assembly

subject: Fire Door
rule: Fire door must not have gaps exceeding the maximum allowable clearance between the door edge and frame

subject: Fire Door
rule: Fire door must be installed with listed fire-rated hardware (hinges, locks, closers) as per the door assembly listing

subject: Raised Floor System
rule: raised floor system must support the design live load without excessive deflection
conditions: when the raised floor is designed to carry pedestrian traffic or equipment loads
exceptions: non-load-bearing raised floor systems used only for cable management with no walking or equipment loading

subject: Raised Floor System
rule: raised floor system must provide adequate fire resistance rating for the occupancy type
conditions: when the raised floor encloses plenum spaces used for air circulation
exceptions: raised floors in spaces not subject to fire codes or where the plenum is not used for air handling

subject: Raised Floor System
rule: raised floor system must not have gaps or openings that allow accumulation of debris or vermin entry
conditions: when the raised floor is in a food preparation, healthcare, or cleanroom environment
exceptions: raised floors in non-sensitive environments such as general office data centers without hygiene requirements

subject: Raised Floor System
rule: raised floor pedestals must be secured to the structural slab to prevent overturning under lateral loads
conditions: when the raised floor is in a seismically active region or where lateral forces are expected
exceptions: raised floors less than 300 mm in height in low-seismic zones where overturning moment is negligible

subject: Visitor Seating (Built-in)
rule: Visitor seating (built-in) must have a load-bearing structure capable of supporting intended occupant loads without collapse
exceptions: Decorative-only seating not intended for occupancy

subject: Visitor Seating (Built-in)
rule: Built-in visitor seating must not block required egress paths or exit access
conditions: When located in means of egress zones

subject: Visitor Seating (Built-in)
rule: Built-in seating must have all exposed edges and corners radiused or chamfered to prevent laceration
conditions: When located in publicly accessible areas

subject: Master Demonstration Bench
rule: bench must have a level working surface

subject: Master Demonstration Bench
rule: bench must support its specified maximum load without structural failure or excessive deflection

subject: Master Demonstration Bench
rule: bench must not have sharp edges or protrusions at user-accessible locations
conditions: when intended for manual interaction by operators

subject: Apprentice Workshop Area
rule: Apprentice Workshop Area must have adequate ventilation to prevent accumulation of fumes, dust, and airborne particulates from workshop activities
conditions: Space is used for activities involving materials that produce fumes, dust, or particulates (e.g., woodworking, metalworking, painting, chemical mixing)
exceptions: Space is used exclusively for non-emitting activities such as computer-based design work with no material processing

subject: Apprentice Workshop Area
rule: Apprentice Workshop Area must have a fire-rated separation from adjacent spaces when housing combustible materials or heat-producing equipment
conditions: Workshop stores combustible materials (wood, paints, solvents, fabrics) or contains heat-producing equipment (welding stations, kilns, forges)
exceptions: Workshop contains no combustible materials and no heat-producing equipment (e.g., purely digital/assembly workspace)

subject: Apprentice Workshop Area
rule: Apprentice Workshop Area floor must be slip-resistant and capable of withstanding spillage of workshop fluids without degradation
conditions: Activities involve liquids (oils, coolants, paints, solvents, water)
exceptions: Workshop is used exclusively for dry activities (e.g., assembly of pre-fabricated components, electronics workbench with no fluids)

subject: Apprentice Workshop Area
rule: Apprentice Workshop Area must not have floor drains in locations where spilled flammable or hazardous liquids could drain into the building's general wastewater system
conditions: Workshop handles flammable liquids, solvents, or hazardous chemicals
exceptions: Floor drains are connected to approved hazardous-waste collection or treatment systems

subject: Waste & Scrap Collection Station
rule: waste and scrap collection station floor must be constructed of non-combustible, chemical-resistant, and impermeable material
conditions: station handles combustible waste or scrap
station handles liquid waste or chemicals

subject: Waste & Scrap Collection Station
rule: waste and scrap collection station must have a dedicated ventilation system that prevents accumulation of flammable or toxic gases
conditions: station collects organic waste, chemical waste, or any materials that can off-gas
exceptions: station collects only fully inert non-organic dry scrap (e.g., clean metal offcuts) with no gas emission potential

subject: Waste & Scrap Collection Station
rule: waste and scrap collection station must not have floor drains that connect to the sanitary sewer system
conditions: station handles hazardous, oily, or chemical waste/scrap
exceptions: floor drains connect to a dedicated containment tank or treatment system

subject: Safety Equipment Locker
rule: Safety equipment locker must be located in a readily accessible location without requiring special tools or keys to open
conditions: when serving emergency safety equipment
exceptions: lockers secured with break-glass or emergency-only access mechanisms are permitted

subject: Safety Equipment Locker
rule: Safety equipment locker must not be obstructed by stored materials, equipment, or furnishings
exceptions: temporary obstruction during active maintenance with warning signage in place

subject: Safety Equipment Locker
rule: Safety equipment locker must have clearly visible identification and signage indicating its contents

subject: Study Zone
rule: Study Zone must have at least one means of egress (exit path) to a circulation space or exterior
conditions: occupied by more than one person
enclosed on all sides

subject: Study Zone
rule: Study Zone must have a minimum floor-to-ceiling height of at least 2.4 m (or locally adopted building code minimum)
conditions: occupied as a habitable study space

subject: Study Zone
rule: Study Zone must not have a floor slope exceeding the maximum allowed for the occupancy type (typically 1:20 for accessible occupied spaces)
conditions: designated for stationary study activities at desks or tables

subject: Study Zone
rule: Study Zone must have adequate artificial or natural lighting to meet minimum illuminance levels for reading and study tasks (e.g., ≥ 300 lux at task plane)
conditions: available for use during hours without sufficient daylight

subject: Study Zone
rule: Study Zone must not contain unguarded openings or unprotected glazing at floor level that could cause a fall hazard
conditions: located above ground floor level
has windows or openings with sill height below 900 mm

subject: Display & Presentation Wall
rule: Display & Presentation Wall must be structurally stable and capable of supporting its own weight and any attached display loads
conditions: when used as a freestanding element
when bearing display materials or equipment
exceptions: temporary lightweight displays with independent support structure

subject: Display & Presentation Wall
rule: Display & Presentation Wall must not obstruct required egress paths or emergency access
conditions: when installed in a circulation space
when located near exits, corridors, or emergency equipment
exceptions: when designed as a movable/temporary wall that can be quickly relocated or removed

subject: Display & Presentation Wall
rule: Display & Presentation Wall surface must be stable and not present sharp edges, protrusions, or tipping hazards at accessible heights
conditions: when located in areas accessible to the public or building occupants
exceptions: when the wall is explicitly designed as an art installation in a controlled-access area with appropriate warning signage

subject: Snack Bar / Kitchenette
rule: snack bar / kitchenette must have a dedicated floor sink or grease trap if it includes a sink for food preparation
conditions: includes a sink used for food preparation
located in a jurisdiction requiring grease traps
exceptions: pre-packaged foods only with no washing required
snack bar is temporary (< 30 days)

subject: Snack Bar / Kitchenette
rule: snack bar / kitchenette must have a dedicated 20-amp small-appliance circuit if it contains any countertop receptacles
conditions: contains countertop receptacles

subject: Snack Bar / Kitchenette
rule: snack bar / kitchenette countertop must not be located less than 24 inches from a cooking surface if both are combustible
conditions: countertop material is combustible
adjacent cooking surface is present
exceptions: non-combustible countertop material (e.g., stainless steel, tile)

subject: Impact-Resistant Flooring
rule: impact-resistant flooring must have a minimum thickness adequate to absorb impact loads without cracking or excessive deflection
conditions: when installed in areas subject to falling objects or heavy foot traffic

subject: Impact-Resistant Flooring
rule: impact-resistant flooring must be bonded to a substrate with sufficient compressive strength to prevent punching failure under impact
conditions: when flooring is installed over a structural slab or subfloor

subject: Impact-Resistant Flooring
rule: impact-resistant flooring must not have gaps, unbonded edges, or loose tiles that can become trip hazards or propagate cracking under impact
exceptions: intentional control joints designed to accommodate thermal movement

subject: Impact-Resistant Flooring
rule: impact-resistant flooring must have a slip-resistant surface texture when wet if installed in wet-area environments
conditions: when installed in bathrooms, kitchens, pool surrounds, or other regularly wet areas

subject: Display Window Sill
rule: display window sill must provide a minimum 5° outward slope for water runoff
conditions: sill is exposed to exterior weather conditions
sill is constructed from impermeable material
exceptions: sill is part of a curtain wall system with internal drainage channels

subject: Display Window Sill
rule: display window sill must have a projecting drip edge or groove (drip notch) at the underside
conditions: sill projects beyond the wall face below
exceptions: sill terminates flush with wall surface and is protected by a flashing system

subject: Display Window Sill
rule: display window sill must not be lower than the finished floor level of the interior space behind it
conditions: the window sill serves a display window intended to be viewed from the interior

subject: Signage Mounting Frame
rule: Signage mounting frame must be securely attached to its supporting structure (e.g., wall, roof, pole) with engineered fasteners capable of withstanding dead load, wind load, and seismic loads per applicable building code
conditions: Frame supports a sign that is permanently installed

subject: Signage Mounting Frame
rule: Signage mounting frame must not be fabricated from materials that are incompatible with the base sign material such that galvanic corrosion or chemical degradation compromises structural integrity within the design service life
conditions: Frame is exposed to outdoor or corrosive environment
Frame is in direct contact with a dissimilar-metal sign panel
exceptions: Dissimilar materials are separated by a non-conductive isolation barrier (e.g., neoprene gasket, dielectric coating) that is rated for the environmental exposure

subject: Canopy / Awning
rule: canopy/awning must have a minimum slope for rainwater runoff
conditions: outdoor installation
exposed to precipitation
exceptions: fully enclosed canopy with sealed roof membrane and dedicated drainage system

subject: Canopy / Awning
rule: canopy/awning must be structurally anchored to resist wind uplift forces
conditions: any external installation

subject: Canopy / Awning
rule: canopy/awning must not trap water between the fabric/panel and the supporting structure
conditions: fabric or membrane material
horizontal or near-horizontal orientation
exceptions: integrated gutter system continuously drains any trapped water

subject: Canopy / Awning
rule: canopy/awning must not create a tripping hazard from perimeter footing/support encroachment
conditions: ground-supported
pedestrian-accessible area
exceptions: support posts are clearly demarcated with visual contrast or bollards

subject: Storefront Bulkhead
rule: storefront bulkhead must be structurally supported by the building frame or foundation
conditions: installed as a non-structural infill component
supports storefront glazing above

subject: Storefront Bulkhead
rule: storefront bulkhead must provide a continuous thermal and weather barrier at the base of the storefront assembly
conditions: located at the exterior wall plane
adjacent to conditioned interior space
exceptions: unconditioned interior vestibule where thermal break is provided elsewhere

subject: Storefront Bulkhead
rule: storefront bulkhead must not be constructed of materials that are incompatible with adjacent storefront framing in terms of galvanic corrosion potential
conditions: materials are dissimilar metals (e.g., aluminum frame with steel bulkhead)
direct contact without isolation
exceptions: galvanic isolation (e.g., neoprene gaskets, tape, or coatings) is provided between dissimilar metals

subject: Interior Display Plinth
rule: Interior Display Plinth must have a level and stable top surface for display
conditions: when used as a display surface

subject: Interior Display Plinth
rule: Interior Display Plinth must be constructed from non-combustible or fire-retardant materials
conditions: when located in a publicly accessible interior space

subject: Interior Display Plinth
rule: Interior Display Plinth must not have sharp edges or protruding elements at accessible heights
conditions: when located in areas accessible to visitors

subject: Interior Display Plinth
rule: Interior Display Plinth must be capable of bearing the weight of the displayed object without structural failure
conditions: when supporting any object

subject: Roller Shutter / Security Grille
rule: roller shutter / security grille must be operable (open and close) under normal operating conditions
conditions: when used as a door or window closure
exceptions: when permanently fixed for historical or security reasons and labeled as non-operable

subject: Roller Shutter / Security Grille
rule: roller shutter / security grille must have a manual override mechanism for operation during power failure
conditions: when motorized or electrically operated
exceptions: when manually operated only (no motor)

subject: Recessed Entry Vestibule
rule: Recessed entry vestibule must have a covered overhead structure (roof, canopy, or building overhang) providing weather protection
conditions: Located at building entrance exposed to exterior weather
exceptions: Building is in a climate-controlled enclosed arcade or galleria where entire entry path is interior

subject: Recessed Entry Vestibule
rule: Recessed entry vestibule floor must drain away from the building entrance door
conditions: Vestibule is open to exterior elements on at least one side
Located in a climate with measurable precipitation
exceptions: Vestibule is fully enclosed by doors on both sides (weather-sealed at both interior and exterior faces)

subject: Recessed Entry Vestibule
rule: Recessed entry vestibule must not trap exhaust or vehicle fumes at the entrance
conditions: Vestibule is at grade level adjacent to a vehicle loading zone, driveway, or street
Vestibule depth exceeds 4 feet (creating a pocket that inhibits natural ventilation)
exceptions: Vestibule is equipped with mechanical exhaust ventilation meeting code intake-air requirements

subject: Recessed Entry Vestibule
rule: Recessed entry vestibule floor surface must be slip-resistant when wet
conditions: Vestibule is not fully enclosed (exposed to rain/snow entry)
Vestibule floor is within the building's means of egress path
exceptions: Vestibule has a dedicated drainage grate and heated floor system that prevents any standing water or ice

subject: Child Bedroom / Dormitory
rule: child bedroom / dormitory must have at least one operable window for emergency egress
conditions: space is intended for sleeping occupancy
space is located above ground floor
exceptions: space has direct door access to exterior at grade

subject: Child Bedroom / Dormitory
rule: child bedroom / dormitory must have a minimum ceiling height of at least 2.1 m over at least 50% of the room area
conditions: space is a habitable room
exceptions: ceiling under beams or ducts may be lower but not below 1.5 m, and limited to narrow areas

subject: Child Bedroom / Dormitory
rule: child bedroom / dormitory that provides an egress window must not have a window sill height more than 1100 mm above the floor
conditions: egress window is the primary means of emergency escape
room is above grade
exceptions: window is not used as an egress opening and a door to exterior is provided instead

subject: Child Bedroom / Dormitory
rule: child bedroom / dormitory must have a floor area of at least 7.4 m² for single occupancy
conditions: space is a single-occupancy bedroom
exceptions: space is a dormitory with multiple occupants, in which case 6.5 m² per occupant applies

subject: Playroom / Activity Room
rule: floor surface must be cleanable and non-absorbent
conditions: space is used by children under 6 years old

subject: Playroom / Activity Room
rule: playroom must have at least two means of egress
conditions: room is classified as an assembly or daycare occupancy with occupant load exceeding 49

subject: Dining Hall
rule: dining hall must have a dedicated means of egress (exit) that meets egress capacity requirements
conditions: dining hall occupancy exceeds 50 persons

subject: Dining Hall
rule: dining hall must not have cooking equipment without a Type I or Type II commercial kitchen exhaust hood
conditions: dining hall contains cooking appliances that produce grease-laden vapors or significant heat/steam
exceptions: equipment is electric and produces no grease-laden vapors (e.g., warming only, no frying/grilling)

subject: Dining Hall
rule: dining hall floor finish must be slip-resistant and cleanable
conditions: floor is in food-serving or food-preparation area
exceptions: carpeted dining-only area with no food/drink spill exposure

subject: Baby Nursery
rule: baby nursery floor surface must be slip-resistant
conditions: when floor is wet

subject: Baby Nursery
rule: baby nursery must not have any sharp edges or protrusions below 4 feet (1.2 m) on walls, furniture, or fixtures
conditions: within reach zone of children

subject: Baby Nursery
rule: baby nursery crib spacing must not allow passage of a 3.5-inch (89 mm) sphere between crib bars
conditions: when crib is present in the nursery

subject: Baby Nursery
rule: baby nursery electrical outlets must be tamper-resistant or fitted with safety covers
conditions: outlets are within 4 feet of floor

subject: Baby Nursery
rule: baby nursery must have a functioning smoke detector within the room or directly adjacent

subject: Baby Nursery
rule: baby nursery window coverings must not have accessible pull cords or looped cords
conditions: windows have coverings

subject: Sick Bay / Isolation Room
rule: Sick bay / isolation room must have a ventilation system that maintains negative air pressure relative to adjacent spaces
conditions: room is used for airborne infectious disease isolation
exceptions: room is not used for airborne infection isolation (e.g., only for non-infectious patient observation)

subject: Sick Bay / Isolation Room
rule: Sick bay / isolation room must have a dedicated exhaust system that discharges air directly to the outside, away from air intakes and occupied areas
conditions: room is used for airborne infectious disease isolation

subject: Sick Bay / Isolation Room
rule: Sick bay / isolation room must have an anteroom or airlock with two self-closing doors that interlock
conditions: room is designated for high-risk airborne infection isolation (e.g., TB, measles)
exceptions: facility uses equivalent pressure differential and buffer zone approach approved by authority having jurisdiction

subject: Sick Bay / Isolation Room
rule: Sick bay / isolation room must have handwashing sink located at the room entrance or within the anteroom
exceptions: portable hand sanitizer dispenser is permitted in temporary or field medical settings where plumbing is unavailable

subject: Sick Bay / Isolation Room
rule: Sick bay / isolation room walls, floors, and ceiling surfaces must be non-porous and cleanable (impervious to fluids and able to withstand disinfection chemicals)

subject: Sick Bay / Isolation Room
rule: Sick bay / isolation room must not have recirculating HVAC airflow (HEPA-filtered recirculation within room is permitted but return air must not mix with general building supply)
conditions: room is used for airborne infectious disease isolation
exceptions: HEPA-filtered recirculation within the room itself is permitted

subject: Laundry Room
rule: laundry room must have a floor drain or secondary containment to prevent water damage in case of appliance leak or overflow
conditions: room contains washing machine
exceptions: room is a closet-type laundry with no floor drain and is located on a ground-level slab with waterproof membrane

subject: Laundry Room
rule: laundry room must have a vented exhaust system or ventless dryer with condensate drain if gas dryer is installed
conditions: room contains a gas dryer
exceptions: dryer is electric and ventless (condenser or heat-pump type)

subject: Laundry Room
rule: laundry room must have a GFCI-protected electrical receptacle within 6 feet of any water source
conditions: room contains a washing machine or laundry sink

subject: Laundry Room
rule: laundry room floor must be waterproof or water-resistant and sloped toward drain if drain is present
exceptions: room is on an upper floor with no floor drain and has a leak-proof pan under each appliance

subject: Laundry Room
rule: laundry room must not share a return air plenum with living spaces if combustion appliances are present
conditions: room contains a gas dryer or gas water heater
exceptions: room is directly ventilated to the outdoors and sealed from return air pathways

subject: Kitchen / Pantry
rule: Kitchen/pantry must have a ventilation path (e.g., range hood exhaust, window, or mechanical ventilation) to remove heat, steam, smoke, and cooking odors
conditions: space contains cooking appliances
exceptions: pantry-only spaces with no cooking equipment

subject: Kitchen / Pantry
rule: Kitchen must have a sink and associated drain connection for food preparation and cleaning
conditions: space is a full kitchen (not a dry pantry only)
exceptions: pantry-only storage spaces with no food preparation function

subject: Kitchen / Pantry
rule: Kitchen must not have open-flame cooking appliances in direct proximity to combustible materials without appropriate clearance distances
conditions: space contains gas cooktops, ovens, or other open-flame equipment
exceptions: if all adjacent materials are rated non-combustible per applicable fire code

subject: Storage Room
rule: storage room must have a door with a clear opening width of at least 32 inches (813 mm)
conditions: served by a corridor or means of egress
exceptions: existing non-conforming buildings where alteration is infeasible

subject: Storage Room
rule: storage room must not have a floor load rating lower than the weight of stored materials plus a safety factor
conditions: room is designed for storage of heavy items such as shelving, pallets, or equipment

subject: Storage Room
rule: storage room containing fuel-burning equipment (e.g., furnace, water heater) must have combustion air openings or mechanical ventilation to the outdoors
conditions: contains fuel-burning appliance
exceptions: direct-vent or sealed-combustion appliances

subject: Bathroom / Shower Block
rule: Bathroom / Shower Block floor must be waterproof and sloped to a drain
conditions: the space contains shower fixtures
the space contains plumbing fixtures that discharge water

subject: Bathroom / Shower Block
rule: Bathroom / Shower Block must have a ventilation path to remove moisture-laden air to the exterior
conditions: the space is enclosed on all sides
the space contains hot-water fixtures that generate steam

subject: Bathroom / Shower Block
rule: Bathroom / Shower Block must not have non-waterproof electrical fixtures within direct spray zone of shower heads or taps
conditions: the space contains both electrical fixtures and water fixtures

subject: Bathroom / Shower Block
rule: Bathroom / Shower Block floor and wall surfaces must be cleanable and non-porous in wet areas
conditions: the surfaces are within 2 metres of shower heads or water outlets

subject: Bathroom / Shower Block
rule: Bathroom / Shower Block must have a trap/seal on every drain connection to the sewer system
conditions: the space is connected to a sanitary drainage system

subject: Outdoor Play Area
rule: Outdoor play area must have a fall-attenuating surface (e.g., rubber, engineered wood fiber, sand) under and around play equipment within the fall zone
conditions: Play equipment with a fall height exceeding 600 mm is installed
exceptions: No play equipment with fall height risk is present (e.g., sandbox, playhouse on ground level)

subject: Outdoor Play Area
rule: Outdoor play area must not have protruding hardware, sharp edges, or exposed bolt ends on play equipment at accessible heights
conditions: Play equipment is present for children's use
exceptions: None — this applies universally to any equipment accessible to children

subject: Outdoor Play Area
rule: Outdoor play area must have drainage that prevents standing water within the use zone 24 hours after a rain event
conditions: Play area is at grade or in a region with measurable precipitation
exceptions: Area is located within an arid climate zone where standing water is not a realistic risk

subject: Outdoor Play Area
rule: Outdoor play area must have clear sight lines from supervising adult vantage points to all play equipment zones
conditions: Play area serves children aged 0–12
exceptions: None — supervision sight lines are a universal safety requirement for any supervised children's play space

subject: Reception / Entry Lobby
rule: reception/entry lobby must have a clear accessible path from the main building entrance to the reception desk
conditions: building has a public entrance
reception desk is staffed or intended for visitor check-in
exceptions: building is a private residence without public reception function

subject: Reception / Entry Lobby
rule: reception/entry lobby must have means of egress (exit path) meeting local fire code occupant load requirements
conditions: lobby serves as primary entrance/exit for the building
occupant load exceeds threshold requiring rated egress
exceptions: very small buildings where the lobby is also the single exit door and meets minimum code requirements

subject: Reception / Entry Lobby
rule: reception/entry lobby must not have a floor level change (step/ramp) at the main entrance threshold that exceeds local accessibility code maximum
conditions: building is required to comply with accessibility codes (e.g., ADA, local equivalent)
exceptions: historic buildings with granted waiver
residential single-family dwellings exempt from public accommodation codes

subject: Reception / Entry Lobby
rule: reception/entry lobby must provide a means of shelter/weather protection (canopy, recess, or enclosed vestibule) at the main public entrance
conditions: building is in a climate with significant precipitation
building is commercial/institutional with public access
exceptions: buildings in arid climates where weather protection is not required by code
very small buildings where a canopy is structurally infeasible

subject: Reception / Entry Lobby
rule: reception/entry lobby floor finish must be slip-resistant when wet
conditions: lobby is a public or common area
floor is near the exterior entrance where water/mud is tracked in
exceptions: lobby has no exterior entrance (internal-only lobby)

subject: Secure Perimeter Fencing
rule: secure perimeter fencing must extend at least 2.4 meters above grade
conditions: anti-climb security requirement applies
facility is not in a blast-overpressure zone where lower height is mandated
exceptions: site-specific threat assessment justifies a different height

subject: Secure Perimeter Fencing
rule: secure perimeter fencing must have a buried or anti-dig extension at least 300 mm below grade
conditions: the fence is in a location where digging under is physically possible
soil type is not solid rock requiring blasting
exceptions: site rests on continuous bedrock that prevents digging

subject: Secure Perimeter Fencing
rule: secure perimeter fencing must not have handholds or footholds on the outward-facing side below 2.4 m
conditions: the fence is designed as an anti-climb barrier
exceptions: none — any such feature defeats the anti-climb purpose

subject: Secure Perimeter Fencing
rule: secure perimeter fencing must not have gaps larger than 100 mm between any structural elements
conditions: the fence is intended to prevent human passage
exceptions: none

subject: Child-Safe Window Guards
rule: Window guard bars must have spacing no greater than 100 mm (4 inches) to prevent child passage or head entrapment
conditions: guard is installed on any window accessible to children under 6 years old
exceptions: guards designed with mesh or infill panels that prevent passage through any opening larger than 100 mm in any dimension

subject: Child-Safe Window Guards
rule: Window guard must not have sharp edges, protruding bolts, or snag points on the interior face accessible to children
conditions: guard is within reach of children under 6 years old

subject: Child-Safe Window Guards
rule: Window guard must be capable of withstanding a horizontal outward load of at least 330 N (75 lbf) without permanent deformation or detachment
conditions: guard is intended as a fall-prevention device for windows above ground floor
exceptions: guards on ground-floor windows that do not pose a fall hazard from height

subject: Child-Safe Window Guards
rule: Any release mechanism for emergency egress must be operable by a child under 6 years old with no tool and no more than two simultaneous actions
conditions: guard is installed on a window designated as an emergency escape or rescue opening
exceptions: guard that is permanently fixed (non-releasable) and where alternative egress is provided elsewhere in the room

subject: Emergency Call / Nurse Call System
rule: emergency call / nurse call system must have a redundant power supply (battery backup or generator)
conditions: system is required to function during a general power failure
exceptions: facility has a facility-wide uninterruptible power supply that covers all nurse call devices

subject: Emergency Call / Nurse Call System
rule: emergency call / nurse call system must be electrically supervised for open circuits and ground faults
conditions: system includes wiring between call stations and nurse control units
exceptions: wireless (battery-powered RF) systems that use self-diagnostic polling instead of line supervision

subject: Emergency Call / Nurse Call System
rule: emergency call / nurse call system must not share conduit or raceway with power-lighting circuits above 30 volts
conditions: system uses low-voltage signaling (typically 24 V or less)
exceptions: separate compartments within same enclosure listed for mixed-voltage use
system rated for Class 1 wiring and installed per its listing

subject: Emergency Call / Nurse Call System
rule: emergency call / nurse call system must annunciate calls at a location staffed 24/7
conditions: system is installed in a healthcare occupancy
exceptions: system uses wireless mobile devices (nurse phones/tablets) that are carried by on-duty staff at all times

subject: Child-Height Fixtures & Fittings
rule: Child-height fixtures and fittings must be installed at a height reachable by children (typically within 600–1100 mm from finished floor level)
conditions: The building or space is intended for use by children (e.g., kindergarten, nursery, paediatric ward, children's museum)
exceptions: Spaces exclusively for adults that incidentally contain child-height fixtures as part of adjustable furniture systems

subject: Child-Height Fixtures & Fittings
rule: Child-height fixtures and fittings must not pose a finger-entrapment or pinch hazard at accessible edges, gaps, or moving parts
conditions: The fixture has moving parts, hinged elements, or gaps between 5 mm and 12 mm accessible to a child hand
exceptions: Fixtures with approved safety guards or shrouds that prevent finger access to the pinch zone

subject: Child-Height Fixtures & Fittings
rule: Child-height fixtures and fittings must have rounded or radiused corners on all exposed edges and protrusions within the child reach zone
conditions: The fixture has exposed corners, edges, or protrusions within the reach zone of children (typically below 1200 mm)
exceptions: Soft furnishings or padded elements where the material itself prevents impact injury

subject: Built-in Crib / Cot Anchoring
rule: Built-in crib/cot anchoring must withstand forces from an active child without releasing
conditions: When anchoring a built-in crib or cot to a structure (wall, floor, or frame)
exceptions: Cribs/cots designed as freestanding, non-anchored units

subject: Built-in Crib / Cot Anchoring
rule: Built-in crib/cot anchoring must have no exposed sharp edges, protrusions, or pinch points
conditions: At any accessible surface or edge of the anchoring hardware after installation

subject: Built-in Crib / Cot Anchoring
rule: Built-in crib/cot anchoring must not allow the crib/cot to detach from the anchorage under any single-plane loading direction
conditions: When the crib/cot is anchored to a building structure
exceptions: Quick-release mechanisms explicitly designed for emergency evacuation with documented release force exceeding child-applied forces

subject: Shop Frontage System
rule: shop frontage must provide a clear, unobstructed public entrance
conditions: where retail occupancy is active
where the frontage faces a public street or pedestrian way
exceptions: temporary construction or maintenance periods with posted alternative entry

subject: Shop Frontage System
rule: shop frontage must not have trapping hazards where glazed panels or doors can close on occupants without fail-safe detection
conditions: where automatic or power-operated doors or windows are installed in the frontage system
exceptions: manually operated glazing that requires deliberate human force to close

subject: Shop Frontage System
rule: shop frontage structural frame must support its own self-weight and imposed wind loads without collapse
conditions: in all installed configurations

subject: Fire Evacuation Alarm System
rule: Fire Evacuation Alarm System must be powered by an emergency backup power source (e.g., battery or generator) that activates automatically upon loss of primary power

subject: Fire Evacuation Alarm System
rule: Fire Evacuation Alarm System must produce an audible and/or visible notification signal that is distinct from all other building signals and clearly recognizable as an emergency alarm

subject: Fire Evacuation Alarm System
rule: Fire Evacuation Alarm System must not be located in areas where ambient noise or vibration could prevent its proper operation or detection of initiating signals

subject: Fire Evacuation Alarm System
rule: Fire Evacuation Alarm System must have manual pull stations located within 60 inches (1.5 m) of each exit on every floor and at each floor egress path
conditions: The building is equipped with manual fire alarm boxes (not solely automatic detection)
exceptions: Buildings where the alarm system is fully automatic with no manual initiation requirement per approved fire code variance

subject: Checkout Counter
rule: checkout counter must have a clear opening width of at least 36 inches (914 mm) for accessible passage
conditions: counter is located in a customer-accessible area
counter serves as an accessible checkout station
exceptions: counter is not intended for customer use (e.g., back-of-house only)

subject: Checkout Counter
rule: checkout counter must not have sharp edges or corners at customer-contact surfaces
conditions: counter is located in a customer-service area

subject: Checkout Counter
rule: checkout counter work surface height must be between 28 inches and 34 inches above finished floor for accessible use
conditions: counter is intended for customer transactions
counter serves the general public
exceptions: counter is a designated standing-height express lane with alternative accessible accommodation nearby

subject: Checkout Counter
rule: checkout counter must have a minimum 30-inch-wide accessible portion at the transaction surface
conditions: counter is a service counter for the public

subject: Retail Display Fixtures
rule: Retail display fixtures must have a stable base or mounting that prevents tipping under expected product loads and customer interaction
conditions: When the fixture is freestanding (not wall-mounted or secured to structure)
exceptions: Fixtures that are permanently anchored to the floor or wall structure

subject: Retail Display Fixtures
rule: Retail display fixtures must not have sharp edges or protrusions at typical customer reach and sight heights
conditions: In areas accessible to customers (non-staff-only zones)
exceptions: Edge protectors or safety caps are installed rendering the edge non-hazardous

subject: Retail Display Fixtures
rule: Retail display fixtures must not exceed the rated floor load capacity of the retail space
conditions: When the fixture is placed on a suspended or structurally limited floor

subject: Retail Display Fixtures
rule: Retail display fixture shelves must have a load limit equal to or greater than the maximum intended product weight per shelf
conditions: When the fixture includes horizontal shelf surfaces for product display

subject: Shop Floor Finish
rule: shop floor finish must be compatible with the substrate material to which it is applied
conditions: when applied over an existing substrate

subject: Shop Floor Finish
rule: shop floor finish must withstand the expected mechanical loads (traffic, equipment, impact)
conditions: when floor is subject to operational use

subject: Shop Floor Finish
rule: shop floor finish must not create a slipping hazard under expected conditions
conditions: when finish is wet or contaminated with oils/grease typical of shop environment
exceptions: areas designated as wet-process zones where anti-slip texture is explicitly part of the finish specification

subject: Shop Floor Finish
rule: shop floor finish must be applied at conditions within its specified curing temperature and humidity range
conditions: during installation/curing phase

subject: Stockroom or Back-of-House Space
rule: Back-of-house spaces must have a floor drainage system for cleaning and spill management
conditions: space is used for food storage or preparation
space contains plumbing fixtures or equipment that may leak
exceptions: space is used exclusively for dry goods storage with no plumbing present

subject: Stockroom or Back-of-House Space
rule: Back-of-house spaces must not have direct exterior glazing that compromises security or thermal envelope
conditions: space is at grade level
space is designated for storage of high-value inventory
exceptions: space has a secured loading dock or controlled access zone with appropriate glazing treatment

subject: Stockroom or Back-of-House Space
rule: Stockroom floor must be capable of supporting the design live load for storage use
conditions: space is designated for storage of materials or equipment
exceptions: space is used exclusively for office or personnel support functions

subject: Stockroom or Back-of-House Space
rule: Stockroom must have a means of egress that meets code-required travel distance from any point within the space
conditions: space is occupied by personnel
space contains combustible materials

subject: Shop Signage Mounting System
rule: mounting system must be securely attached to the building structure (not only to cladding or finishes)
conditions: signage is surface-mounted
signage weight exceeds 5 kg
signage is located above pedestrian areas
exceptions: building has no structural substrate available and signage is freestanding

subject: Shop Signage Mounting System
rule: mounting system must not penetrate roofing or cladding membranes without proper waterproof flashing or seal
conditions: roof or wall membrane is present at the mounting point
signage is wall- or roof-mounted
exceptions: mounting is entirely on a non-enclosed frame separate from the building envelope

subject: Shop Signage Mounting System
rule: mounting system must be rated for the lateral wind load at the specific mounting height and local wind zone
conditions: signage face area exceeds 1 m²
signage is located above ground floor level
exceptions: signage is fully enclosed within a protected alcove

subject: Shop Signage Mounting System
rule: mounting system must not block or obstruct required means of egress, fire escape routes, or emergency access
conditions: signage is mounted on a wall containing an exit door
signage is mounted near a fire escape
signage projects into a pathway

subject: Fitting Room Enclosure
rule: Fitting room enclosure must have a door or curtain that provides visual privacy from the exterior
conditions: The enclosure is not an open-plan fitting room layout

subject: Fitting Room Enclosure
rule: Fitting room enclosure must have a minimum internal clear floor area sufficient for a person to change clothes (typically at least 0.9 m x 0.9 m)
conditions: The enclosure is intended for single-person use

subject: Fitting Room Enclosure
rule: Fitting room enclosure must_not have a fully transparent wall or door that exposes the interior to public view
exceptions: Electrically switchable glass that becomes opaque when the room is occupied
Louvered or angled-slat screens that block direct sight lines while allowing light

subject: Fitting Room Enclosure
rule: Fitting room enclosure internal height must be at least 2.0 m (or local building code minimum)
exceptions: Spaces with sloped ceilings where the minimum height is maintained over the required floor area

subject: Ceiling Grid and Tiles
rule: ceiling grid must be designed to support the full dead load of ceiling tiles plus any attached equipment (lights, diffusers, speakers, etc.) without sagging or failure
conditions: suspended ceiling system
any tiles or fixtures attached to grid

subject: Ceiling Grid and Tiles
rule: ceiling tiles must fit within the grid openings with sufficient edge bearing surface to prevent fall-through
conditions: lay-in ceiling tile system

subject: Ceiling Grid and Tiles
rule: ceiling grid must not be used as the primary lateral bracing system for walls or partitions

subject: Ceiling Grid and Tiles
rule: ceiling tiles must not be made of materials that contribute fuel load beyond code-allowed flame spread and smoke development indices
conditions: building subject to fire code regulation

subject: Ceiling Grid and Tiles
rule: ceiling grid must maintain minimum vertical clearance above any sprinkler heads to ensure unobstructed sprinkler spray pattern
conditions: building with fire sprinkler system
suspended ceiling below sprinklers

subject: Electrical Subpanel for Shop
rule: Electrical subpanel must have a dedicated ground bus bar bonded to the main panel's grounding system
conditions: When used as a subpanel (not as a main service panel)
When fed from a main service panel in a separate structure or building
exceptions: If the subpanel is in the same building and no separate grounding electrode is required by code

subject: Electrical Subpanel for Shop
rule: Electrical subpanel must not have neutral bonded to ground
conditions: When the subpanel is fed from a main service panel
exceptions: When the panel is the first service disconnecting means (i.e., it is a main panel, not a subpanel)

subject: Electrical Subpanel for Shop
rule: Electrical subpanel must have a main breaker or main lug rating that matches or exceeds the calculated load
conditions: When the subpanel serves a shop with workshop machinery and equipment

subject: Cafe Service Counter
rule: Cafe Service Counter must have a continuous, seamless solid-surface top (e.g., stainless steel or solid-surface composite) that is non-absorbent, non-porous, and resistant to food acids and cleaning chemicals at the customer-facing work zone
conditions: when used for food and beverage service to customers
exceptions: temporary pop-up counters not intended for repeated use

subject: Cafe Service Counter
rule: Cafe Service Counter must provide a minimum clear work-surface depth of 600 mm (24 inches) measured from the front edge to any back barrier or equipment
conditions: where the counter is used for order assembly or food/drink placement by staff
exceptions: counters used solely as pass-through / pick-up only with no staff-side work activity

subject: Cafe Service Counter
rule: Cafe Service Counter must not have sharp exposed edges or corners at customer-accessible height (between 600 mm and 1200 mm above finished floor)
conditions: when the counter is located in a customer circulation zone with pedestrian traffic on the customer side
exceptions: counters separated from customer path by a full-height barrier or railing

subject: Cafe Kitchen/Prep Area
rule: cafe kitchen/prep area must have a grease trap or interceptor if it has a commercial-grade cooking appliance that produces grease-laden exhaust
conditions: contains commercial-grade cooking appliance that produces grease-laden exhaust
exceptions: appliance is electric and produces no grease-laden vapors
facility has an approved in-line grease removal system that meets local code

subject: Cafe Kitchen/Prep Area
rule: cafe kitchen/prep area must have a fire-suppression system over any cooking equipment that generates grease-laden vapors
conditions: contains cooking equipment that generates grease-laden vapors (e.g., griddle, deep fryer, range top)
exceptions: only equipment is microwave oven, toaster, or coffee brewer with no grease output

subject: Cafe Kitchen/Prep Area
rule: cafe kitchen/prep area must not have unrated ceiling tiles or combustible finishes within 24 inches of a cooking surface
conditions: has cooking surface that produces grease-laden vapors
exceptions: non-combustible or Class A rated finishes used

subject: Cafe Kitchen/Prep Area
rule: cafe kitchen/prep area floor must be slip-resistant and constructed of non-absorbent material with coved bases at walls
conditions: space is used for wet food preparation or dishwashing
exceptions: prep area handles only dry goods and has no water source

subject: Cafe Kitchen/Prep Area
rule: cafe kitchen/prep area must have a handwashing sink separate from food-prep sinks
conditions: space is used for food preparation that will be served to the public
exceptions: temporary food service event exempted by local health authority

subject: Outdoor Terrace Flooring
rule: Outdoor terrace flooring must have a minimum slope of 1-2% away from the building for drainage
conditions: Outdoor terrace is exposed to rain or precipitation
exceptions: Terrace is fully enclosed and weatherproofed
Terrace uses a proprietary level-access drainage system specifically designed for zero-slope applications

subject: Outdoor Terrace Flooring
rule: Outdoor terrace flooring materials must be freeze-thaw resistant in climates where freezing occurs
conditions: Terrace is located in a climate where ambient temperature drops below freezing

subject: Outdoor Terrace Flooring
rule: Outdoor terrace flooring must not create a trip hazard at transitions (height change at threshold must not exceed typically 1/2 inch unless beveled)
conditions: Terrace is adjacent to an interior floor or egress door
exceptions: Steps or ramps are intentionally designed at the transition

subject: Awning / Canopy Structure
rule: awning / canopy structure must be designed to withstand wind uplift forces
conditions: when the structure is attached to a building
when located in a region subject to wind loads
exceptions: temporary or retractable awnings that are designed to be stowed during high-wind events

subject: Awning / Canopy Structure
rule: awning / canopy structure must have a minimum slope or camber for positive drainage
conditions: when the fabric or panel surface is continuous and non-porous
exceptions: fully permeable mesh or open-lath canopies that allow water to pass through freely

subject: Awning / Canopy Structure
rule: awning / canopy structure must not shed water or snow onto building egress paths or public walkways without mitigation
conditions: when positioned above a door, stair, or public sidewalk
