exceptions: when a gutter, downspout, or drip edge directs water away from the path

subject: Awning / Canopy Structure
rule: awning / canopy structure must have structural attachment capable of supporting dead load plus live load (snow/rain)
conditions: when installed as a permanent fixture
exceptions: lightweight retractable awnings that are rated only for sun-shade and retract under load

subject: Cafe Ventilation Hood
rule: ventilation hood must be connected to an exhaust duct that terminates outside the building envelope
conditions: hood is installed and operational
exceptions: hood serves a recirculating system with appropriate filtration and no external venting required by code

subject: Cafe Ventilation Hood
rule: ventilation hood ductwork must be constructed of non-combustible materials (e.g., steel) with a minimum thickness per fire code
conditions: hood is a Type I (grease) hood used for cooking above grills, fryers, or similar
exceptions: Type II hoods for dishwashers or ovens may have less restrictive material requirements where local code permits

subject: Cafe Ventilation Hood
rule: ventilation hood must be provided with an automatic fire-extinguishing system that activates upon detection of fire or excessive heat
conditions: hood is a Type I hood serving grease-producing cooking equipment

subject: Cafe Ventilation Hood
rule: exhaust duct from the ventilation hood must not pass through fire-rated walls or floors unless protected by a fire-rated enclosure or fire dampers as required
conditions: duct penetrates a fire-resistance-rated assembly
exceptions: duct is enclosed in a fire-resistive shaft or uses approved fire dampers rated for the assembly

subject: Cafe Ventilation Hood
rule: ventilation hood must maintain a minimum clearance to combustible materials unless the hood and duct are enclosed in a fire-rated assembly
conditions: hood and duct are not enclosed in a fire-rated chase

subject: Cafe Plumbing System
rule: hot water supply piping must be thermally insulated to prevent heat loss and protect against contact burns
conditions: where hot water is supplied to fixtures
exceptions: momentary exposure systems (point-of-use instant heaters with no distribution piping)

subject: Cafe Plumbing System
rule: waste and vent piping must be sloped to maintain adequate drainage velocity (minimum 1/4 inch per foot for pipes 3 inches or less in diameter)
conditions: for gravity drainage sections of the plumbing system
exceptions: pumps or ejector systems where positive pressure drives flow

subject: Cafe Plumbing System
rule: potable water supply piping must be protected from backflow contamination at all cross-connections
conditions: where potable water piping connects to any non-potable source, equipment, or fixture
exceptions: fixtures with integral air gaps meeting code-required separation distances

subject: Cafe Plumbing System
rule: piping material must be rated for the maximum operating temperature and pressure of the system
conditions: for all piping within the café plumbing system

subject: Cafe Plumbing System
rule: sanitary drainage system must not be directly connected to a storm drainage system
conditions: for any waste or sewer connection within the café
exceptions: combined sewer systems where local municipality explicitly permits combined connections (rare in modern code)

subject: Menu Board / Digital Display
rule: Menu board / digital display must have a weatherproof enclosure when installed outdoors
conditions: installed outdoors
exceptions: installed in a fully sheltered/indoor location

subject: Menu Board / Digital Display
rule: Menu board / digital display must have a dedicated electrical power supply within manufacturer voltage tolerance
exceptions: battery-powered or solar-powered portable display units that have integrated power

subject: Menu Board / Digital Display
rule: Menu board / digital display must not be installed where it blocks required egress or fire-exit paths
conditions: mounted on wall or freestanding in a pathway

subject: Cafe Walk-in Cooler
rule: walk-in cooler enclosure must be thermally insulated to maintain interior temperature below 40°F
conditions: cooler is used for perishable food storage
exceptions: cooler is used only for dry storage or non-perishable items

subject: Cafe Walk-in Cooler
rule: walk-in cooler door must close and seal automatically or be self-closing
conditions: cooler is accessible to staff during operation
exceptions: cooler has a solid door with a latch that is always manually closed when not in use

subject: Cafe Walk-in Cooler
rule: walk-in cooler floor must be sloped toward a floor drain
conditions: cooler floor is subject to washing or condensate drainage
exceptions: cooler is a dry-goods-only unit with no washdown and no condensate drip source

subject: Cafe Walk-in Cooler
rule: walk-in cooler must not be located directly adjacent to heat-producing equipment exceeding 120°F surface temperature
conditions: cooler shares a wall or is within 12 inches of ovens, fryers, or other high-heat equipment
exceptions: a properly insulated thermal barrier is installed between the heat source and the cooler

subject: Retail Floor Area
rule: retail floor area must have a minimum clear floor area to allow customer circulation and occupancy
conditions: when classified as occupied space

subject: Retail Floor Area
rule: retail floor area must have a ceiling height that permits standing human occupancy
conditions: when classified as occupied space

subject: Retail Floor Area
rule: retail floor area must have at least one means of egress to a public way or exit
conditions: when the area is enclosed or bounded by walls/barriers
exceptions: when the area is completely open-sided and at grade with direct unobstructed access to the exterior

subject: Retail Floor Area
rule: retail floor area must not have a floor slope exceeding the maximum accessible slope for occupied retail use
conditions: when the area is intended for customer sales or display

subject: Walk-in Cooler
rule: walk-in cooler must have a vapor barrier on the warm side of the insulation
conditions: cooler separates conditioned space from unconditioned space
cooler uses insulated panels or built-up insulation
exceptions: cooler is located entirely within a conditioned space with controlled humidity

subject: Walk-in Cooler
rule: walk-in cooler must have a door that seals airtight when closed
conditions: cooler is accessed by personnel or for product loading/unloading

subject: Walk-in Cooler
rule: walk-in cooler must not have an interior floor drain located inside the cold space
conditions: cooler floor is at or below grade
cooler is used for food storage
exceptions: drain is specifically designed with trap heating and insulation to prevent freezing

subject: Walk-in Cooler
rule: walk-in cooler must have a door that opens from the inside (panic/safety release)
conditions: cooler is large enough for a person to enter
cooler is mechanically refrigerated
exceptions: cooler has a non-latching door that cannot trap a person
cooler is an extremely small reach-in style with no interior occupancy possible

subject: Checkout Counter Assembly
rule: checkout counter assembly must provide a clear, unobstructed horizontal work surface for placing and processing merchandise
conditions: when configured as a staffed checkout station
exceptions: self-checkout kiosk configurations where the customer-facing surface is sloped or minimized

subject: Checkout Counter Assembly
rule: checkout counter assembly must not have sharp corners or edges on surfaces that contact customers or operators
conditions: at customer-facing and operator-facing zones within typical reach range

subject: Checkout Counter Assembly
rule: checkout counter assembly must have a minimum clear height beneath the counter top to accommodate standard wheelchair knee clearance
conditions: when the counter is intended as an accessible checkout station under ADA or equivalent codes
exceptions: dedicated express lanes not required to be accessible

subject: Walk-in Freezer
rule: walk-in freezer must have continuous vapor barrier on the warm side of all insulated panels to prevent moisture migration and ice buildup
conditions: freezer is located in a climate with ambient humidity
freezer operates below freezing point (typically 0°F to -10°F)
exceptions: freezer is a factory-sealed one-piece unit where the manufacturer has integrated the vapor barrier into the panel construction

subject: Walk-in Freezer
rule: walk-in freezer floor must be insulated and equipped with a heated or glycol-warmed floor system beneath the slab to prevent frost heave
conditions: freezer floor rests on soil or ground that can contain moisture
freezer operates below 32°F
exceptions: freezer is installed on an existing heated space (e.g., above a conditioned room) where no ground moisture can freeze under the floor

subject: Walk-in Freezer
rule: walk-in freezer door must be self-closing and have a magnetic or cam-lift gasket seal that is continuous and undamaged
conditions: freezer has a hinged access door for human entry
exceptions: roll-up or sliding doors may use different sealing mechanisms but must still achieve an equivalent airtight seal

subject: Walk-in Freezer
rule: all refrigerant piping entering or leaving the walk-in freezer must be fully insulated with closed-cell insulation (minimum 3/4-inch thickness for suction lines) and have a vapor-sealed outer jacket
conditions: freezer uses remote refrigeration system with piping runs
exceptions: self-contained refrigeration units with no external piping runs

subject: Cooler Display Cases
rule: Cooler display case must maintain a sealed refrigeration loop
conditions: If the case uses vapor-compression refrigeration
exceptions: Cases using solid-state thermoelectric cooling may not require a sealed loop, though this is rare in commercial display cases

subject: Cooler Display Cases
rule: Cooler display case must not have internal air temperatures that allow foodborne pathogen growth
conditions: When used for perishable food storage and display
exceptions: Cases used solely for non-perishable or decorative display items

subject: Cooler Display Cases
rule: Cooler display case must allow access for cleaning of interior surfaces
conditions: If the case stores food or beverages directly
exceptions: Disposable one-time-use display units that are never restocked

subject: Shelving Racking System
rule: Shelving racking system must be laterally braced against overturning and buckling
conditions: Free-standing shelving unit
Height-to-depth ratio exceeds 5:1
Located in seismic zone or wind-exposed area
exceptions: System is built into and laterally supported by building structure at multiple points

subject: Shelving Racking System
rule: Shelving racking system must have a load capacity rating that equals or exceeds the maximum intended storage load
conditions: System is used for storage of any material
exceptions: System is purely decorative and not designed for load-bearing

subject: Shelving Racking System
rule: Shelving racking system must not have sharp edges or protruding hardware at reachable heights
conditions: System is accessible by personnel (not in locked/restricted area)

subject: Shelving Racking System
rule: Shelving racking system must have a level base bearing fully on the supporting floor
conditions: System is floor-supported
exceptions: System is wall-mounted or ceiling-suspended with dedicated engineered supports

subject: Produce Display Shelving
rule: Produce display shelving must have adequate drainage to allow water from misting/spraying systems to flow away and not pool on shelves
conditions: shelving is used for fresh produce that requires misting or spraying
shelving is located indoors where water drainage must be managed
exceptions: shelving is used for dry produce (e.g., potatoes, onions, gourds) where no water is applied

subject: Produce Display Shelving
rule: Produce display shelving must not have sharp edges or protrusions that can damage fresh produce
conditions: shelving is used to display any type of fresh produce

subject: Produce Display Shelving
rule: Produce display shelving must be constructed of food-safe materials that will not leach harmful substances into produce
conditions: shelving is used for any produce intended for human consumption

subject: Freezer Display Cases
rule: Freezer display cases must have a defrost system (electric, off-cycle, or gas-based) to prevent ice buildup on evaporator coils
conditions: Used in environments where ambient humidity can lead to frost accumulation
exceptions: None — all commercial freezer display cases require defrosting

subject: Freezer Display Cases
rule: Freezer display cases must have insulated glass or doors to maintain internal temperature and prevent excessive condensation
conditions: Open-front or reach-in freezer display case configurations
exceptions: Walk-in freezer display cases with solid doors may use different glazing

subject: Freezer Display Cases
rule: Freezer display cases must not have unsealed gaps or breaches in the vapor barrier surrounding the insulated envelope
conditions: Any freezer display case with a closed refrigeration circuit
exceptions: Service ports specifically designed for maintenance and sealed afterward

subject: Receiving and Loading Area
rule: receiving and loading area must have a minimum clearance height for truck access
conditions: designed for truck/semi-trailer loading

subject: Receiving and Loading Area
rule: receiving and loading area must have a load-bearing floor surface rated for heavy vehicle loads
conditions: designed for vehicle loading operations

subject: Receiving and Loading Area
rule: receiving and loading area must not have steps or level changes at the loading dock edge
conditions: dock is configured for direct truck backing
exceptions: dock leveler or bridge plate is provided to bridge the gap

subject: Receiving and Loading Area
rule: receiving and loading area must have a weather-protected threshold between exterior and interior
conditions: located in climate with precipitation or extreme temperatures
exceptions: facility is entirely enclosed and conditioned as single zone

subject: Trash and Recycling Enclosure
rule: trash and recycling enclosure must have a minimum clear floor area of 4 ft by 4 ft
conditions: enclosure serves a dwelling unit

subject: Trash and Recycling Enclosure
rule: trash and recycling enclosure must have a washdown-capable floor drain or sloped floor to drain
conditions: enclosure is used for food waste or organic waste storage

subject: Trash and Recycling Enclosure
rule: enclosure must not have floor drains that connect directly to the public sanitary sewer without an approved grease interceptor
conditions: enclosure is used for food waste or grease-laden waste

subject: Trash and Recycling Enclosure
rule: trash and recycling enclosure must have ventilation to the outdoors or mechanical exhaust
exceptions: enclosures that are fully open on at least one side to outdoor air

subject: Trash and Recycling Enclosure
rule: trash and recycling enclosure must have a minimum ceiling height of 7 ft

subject: Trash and Recycling Enclosure
rule: trash and recycling enclosure must not have its only access door swing inward into the enclosure
conditions: enclosure is less than 6 ft deep from door opening

subject: Trash and Recycling Enclosure
rule: trash and recycling enclosure must not be located directly adjacent to fresh air intakes
exceptions: enclosure is sealed and mechanically ventilated separately from building air intake system

subject: Trash and Recycling Enclosure
rule: trash and recycling enclosure must have a fire-rated enclosure separation from the rest of the building if it exceeds 50 sq ft
conditions: enclosure is interior to a building

subject: Shopping Cart Corral
rule: shopping cart corral must be placed on a level, paved surface
conditions: installed as a standalone unit
permanent installation

subject: Shopping Cart Corral
rule: shopping cart corral must have a retaining barrier on at least three sides
conditions: designed to hold more than two carts
exceptions: corrals designed as single-bay wall-mounted units may rely on an adjacent building wall as one side

subject: Shopping Cart Corral
rule: shopping cart corral must not have sharp edges or protruding fasteners at pedestrian contact height
conditions: installation is accessible to the public

subject: Public Restroom
rule: public restroom must have at least one toilet fixture that serves each legally required gender designation (e.g., male, female, or all-gender) per applicable plumbing code
conditions: jurisdiction has adopted a plumbing code that specifies minimum fixture counts per gender
building occupancy is covered by that code
exceptions: single-occupancy/unisex restrooms may satisfy all-gender fixture requirement without separate gendered banks

subject: Public Restroom
rule: public restroom must have a minimum of one lavatory (hand-washing sink) per code-specified number of fixtures
conditions: building is classified as a public occupancy under applicable code
exceptions: none — hand-washing facilities are universally required adjacent to toilet fixtures in public restrooms

subject: Public Restroom
rule: public restroom must have plumbing fixtures that discharge to an approved sanitary sewer or septic system via properly vented DWV piping
conditions: building is connected to utility infrastructure
fixtures are water-supplied
exceptions: temporary portable restrooms with holding tanks that are regularly pumped out

subject: Public Restroom
rule: public restroom must provide a minimum clear floor space of 30 inches by 48 inches at each accessible fixture per ADA standards
conditions: restroom is required to be accessible under applicable accessibility code
exceptions: none — public restrooms in buildings subject to ADA or equivalent state codes must provide accessible clearances

subject: Public Restroom
rule: public restroom must have a floor finish that is non-absorbent, smooth, and easily cleanable (e.g., ceramic tile, sheet vinyl, terrazzo) with a floor drain in gang-restroom configurations
conditions: restroom has more than one toilet fixture (gang/multi-stall configuration)
exceptions: single-occupancy public restrooms may omit floor drain if not required by local plumbing code

subject: Public Restroom
rule: public restroom must not have interior swing of the entry door directly obstruct the required clear floor space at any fixture
conditions: door swings into the restroom (not outward)
exceptions: none — ADA clearance requirements cannot be reduced by door swing interference

subject: Bakery Preparation Area
rule: Bakery preparation area must have a grease-intercepting floor drain connected to the waste plumbing system
conditions: area is used for dough mixing or batter preparation
area is used for washing baking equipment
exceptions: area uses only pre-packaged ingredients with no liquid waste

subject: Bakery Preparation Area
rule: Bakery preparation area must have floor and wall surfaces that are smooth, non-absorbent, and cleanable to food-grade standards

subject: Bakery Preparation Area
rule: Bakery preparation area must not have unprotected floor drains that lack a grease interceptor
conditions: area is used for dough mixing, batter preparation, or washing baking equipment

subject: Bakery Preparation Area
rule: Bakery preparation area must have a ventilation hood or exhaust system capable of capturing flour dust and heat from ovens/proofers
conditions: area contains ovens, proofers, or fryers
area has high-volume dry ingredient mixing

subject: Meat and Seafood Preparation Room
rule: All surfaces in a Meat and Seafood Preparation Room must be constructed of smooth, non-absorbent, corrosion-resistant materials (e.g., stainless steel, approved food-grade plastic, or sealed tile)
conditions: space is classified as a food preparation area
space handles raw meat or seafood
exceptions: Ceilings in dry storage areas within the same space may use moisture-resistant gypsum board if separated by a vapour barrier

subject: Meat and Seafood Preparation Room
rule: Meat and Seafood Preparation Room must be physically separated from ready-to-eat food preparation areas by a full-height wall or impervious barrier
conditions: the facility also contains ready-to-eat food preparation spaces

subject: Meat and Seafood Preparation Room
rule: Floor surfaces in a Meat and Seafood Preparation Room must have a non-slip finish and be coved at the wall-to-floor junction

subject: Meat and Seafood Preparation Room
rule: The Meat and Seafood Preparation Room must maintain a temperature not exceeding 10°C (50°F) during active food handling
conditions: space is used for processing of fresh meat or seafood
exceptions: Spaces used exclusively for frozen product tempering may operate at higher temperatures for limited durations

subject: Meat and Seafood Preparation Room
rule: Meat and Seafood Preparation Room must not contain exposed horizontal ledges, open shelving above food contact surfaces, or recessed fixtures that cannot be cleaned

subject: Signage Band and Canopy
rule: signage band must be securely attached to the building facade or supporting structure
conditions: signage band is present on the facade

subject: Signage Band and Canopy
rule: canopy must be designed to support its self-weight plus expected live loads (e.g., snow, rain, wind)
conditions: canopy is present

subject: Signage Band and Canopy
rule: canopy must have a minimum slope or drainage provision to prevent water ponding
conditions: canopy has a horizontal or near-horizontal surface

subject: Signage Band and Canopy
rule: signage band must not obstruct required egress paths or emergency exits
conditions: signage band is located near doors or egress routes

subject: Grocery Delivery Vestibule
rule: grocery delivery vestibule must have a clear floor area of at least 5 ft deep (measured from the outer face of the inner door) to allow a person to stand clear of the swinging delivery door while a delivery is placed inside
conditions: vestibule is between two doors (outer public access door and inner retail door)
delivery mode uses a pass-through or drop-off arrangement
exceptions: vestibule is used only for queuing and not for door-swing clearance separation

subject: Grocery Delivery Vestibule
rule: grocery delivery vestibule must not have door swings that conflict with each other when both doors are opened simultaneously
conditions: two doors are arranged in series along a single path of travel
exceptions: doors are sliding or revolving
doors are offset so swing arcs do not overlap

subject: Grocery Delivery Vestibule
rule: grocery delivery vestibule must have a floor-to-ceiling height of at least 7 ft 0 in
conditions: vestibule is intended for occupancy (not a cabinet or pass-through hatch)
exceptions: local code permits less for incidental spaces

subject: Beer Dispensing System
rule: beer dispensing system must maintain closed pressure path from gas source to keg to dispensing faucet
conditions: system uses pressurized gas (CO₂ or mixed gas) to dispense beer
exceptions: gravity-fed dispensing systems that do not use gas pressure

subject: Beer Dispensing System
rule: beer dispensing system must not have any continuous flow path between keg contents and ambient air

subject: Beer Dispensing System
rule: beer dispensing system must have cooling path from coolant source to all beer-holding and beer-transporting components
conditions: beer is served at standard cold-draft serving temperatures (below 40°F / 4°C)
exceptions: systems designed for ambient-temperature cask ale serving

subject: Keg Cellar / Cold Room
rule: keg cellar / cold room must have a floor drain or sloped floor to a drain
conditions: space contains keg storage
space requires floor washing
exceptions: space uses portable drainage pumps for periodic cleaning only

subject: Keg Cellar / Cold Room
rule: keg cellar / cold room must not have exposed electrical fixtures or outlets below 1.2 m above finished floor
conditions: space is classified as a wet or damp environment
space contains pressurised beer lines or keg washing equipment
exceptions: fixtures are NEMA 4X or IP66 rated and on a GFCI-protected circuit

subject: Keg Cellar / Cold Room
rule: keg cellar / cold room must maintain an ambient temperature between 2°C and 10°C
conditions: space stores kegs of lager or ale
space is designated as a cold room
exceptions: cask-conditioned ale cellar designed for 11–13°C storage

subject: Beer Hall Stage / Band Platform
rule: stage/band platform must support the anticipated live load of performers and equipment
conditions: when used for performances

subject: Beer Hall Stage / Band Platform
rule: stage/band platform surface must be slip-resistant under expected use conditions
conditions: when performers or staff will stand or move on the surface

subject: Beer Hall Stage / Band Platform
rule: electrical supply to stage/band platform must be protected from moisture
conditions: when located outdoors or in a beer hall environment with beverages

subject: Beer Hall Stage / Band Platform
rule: stage/band platform must not block required egress paths from the hall
conditions: when located in a room with occupants other than performers on stage

subject: Steel Framed Glazed Frontage
rule: steel frame must be structurally self-supporting independent of the glazed panel infill
conditions: when used as a non-loadbearing curtain wall or facade system

subject: Steel Framed Glazed Frontage
rule: glazed panels must be mechanically restrained within the steel frame to prevent out-of-plane displacement
conditions: in all configurations

subject: Steel Framed Glazed Frontage
rule: interior face of the frontage must not be in direct contact with non-compatible metals without isolation
conditions: where steel frame and aluminum/glass components meet
exceptions: where a certified isolation break or compatible coating is interposed

subject: Steel Framed Glazed Frontage
rule: glazing must be laminated or tempered safety glass
conditions: when located within 1m of pedestrian areas or building entrances

subject: Bar Counter Drainage Trench
rule: Bar counter drainage trench must have a continuous downward slope toward the designated drainage outlet
conditions: trench is installed
trench is intended to drain liquid
exceptions: trench is purely decorative and not intended to handle liquids

subject: Bar Counter Drainage Trench
rule: Bar counter drainage trench must not have any section that is lower than the outlet connection point
conditions: trench is connected to a drainage outlet
exceptions: trench system includes a sump pump or active lifting mechanism

subject: Bar Counter Drainage Trench
rule: Bar counter drainage trench must be watertight along all joints and seams within the trench body
conditions: trench is installed below or adjacent to wet bar areas
trench conveys liquid waste
exceptions: trench is designed as a drip tray with intentional drainage holes to an underlying catch basin

subject: Bar Counter Drainage Trench
rule: Bar counter drainage trench must be fabricated from corrosion-resistant material
conditions: trench is used in a bar serving acidic beverages or food
trench is subject to repeated cleaning with chemical sanitizers
exceptions: trench is a disposable/one-time-use temporary installation

subject: Industrial Ceiling Mounted Extract Hood
rule: industrial ceiling mounted extract hood must be ducted to the exterior of the building
exceptions: recirculating hoods that filter and return air to the space are not extract hoods and fall outside this entity definition

subject: Industrial Ceiling Mounted Extract Hood
rule: industrial ceiling mounted extract hood must have a fire-rated duct and automatic fire suppression system
conditions: hood is installed over cooking equipment that produces grease-laden vapors
exceptions: hoods serving only steam-producing equipment (no grease) may not require fire suppression but still require fire-rated duct

subject: Industrial Ceiling Mounted Extract Hood
rule: industrial ceiling mounted extract hood must have a condensate/grease collection and drainage system

subject: Industrial Ceiling Mounted Extract Hood
rule: industrial ceiling mounted extract hood must not be shared with non-grease exhaust systems

subject: Beer Hall Floor Finish
rule: beer hall floor finish must be slip-resistant in wet conditions
conditions: floor is in an area where beer or other beverages may be spilled
floor is accessible to patrons or staff
exceptions: temporary protective covering is installed over the floor finish

subject: Beer Hall Floor Finish
rule: beer hall floor finish must be impermeable to water and beer
conditions: floor is in an area where beer or beverages are served or consumed

subject: Beer Hall Floor Finish
rule: beer hall floor finish must not be chemically reactive with acidic or alkaline cleaning agents
conditions: floor finish will be cleaned with industrial cleaning agents

subject: Reinforced Concrete Floor Slab
rule: reinforced concrete floor slab must have adequate thickness to resist expected bending moments and shear forces
conditions: when used as a structural floor element
exceptions: none — minimum thickness requirements are fundamental to structural safety

subject: Reinforced Concrete Floor Slab
rule: reinforced concrete floor slab must not have reinforcement less than the minimum ratio specified by the governing design code
conditions: when the slab is designed as a reinforced concrete element
exceptions: none — minimum reinforcement is required to control cracking and prevent brittle failure

subject: Reinforced Concrete Floor Slab
rule: reinforced concrete floor slab must have adequate concrete cover over reinforcement to prevent corrosion and ensure fire resistance
conditions: when exposed to environmental moisture or fire risk conditions
exceptions: none — cover is a code-mandated safety requirement for durability and fire protection

subject: Reinforced Concrete Floor Slab
rule: reinforced concrete floor slab must not have unsupported spans that exceed the slab's structural capacity under design loads
conditions: when the slab is simply supported or continuous without intermediate beams or columns
exceptions: none — exceeding span capacity causes excessive deflection or collapse

subject: Acoustically Absorbent Wall Lining
rule: acoustically absorbent wall lining must not be the sole structural or load-bearing element of a wall assembly
conditions: when used in any wall assembly

subject: Acoustically Absorbent Wall Lining
rule: acoustically absorbent wall lining must have a continuous air gap or decoupling layer behind it when installed on a rigid backing to function as a sound absorber
conditions: when the lining is intended to absorb sound via a Helmholtz or porous absorber mechanism
when mounted directly on a rigid substrate (e.g., concrete, masonry)
exceptions: when the lining material itself provides sufficient internal porosity and thickness (>100 mm) such that particle velocity is nonzero at the boundary without an air gap

subject: Acoustically Absorbent Wall Lining
rule: acoustically absorbent wall lining must have a minimum thickness of at least 25 mm to provide meaningful sound absorption below 1000 Hz
conditions: when specified for broadband sound absorption including low-to-mid frequencies
exceptions: when the lining is used only for high-frequency flutter echo control (>2000 Hz) where thinner membranes may suffice

subject: Brewpub (variant)
rule: brewpub variant must have a floor drainage system in kitchen and brewing areas
conditions: if the brewpub variant includes a kitchen
if the brewpub variant includes a brewing area

subject: Brewpub (variant)
rule: brewpub variant must have a ventilation hood above the brewing kettle
conditions: if the brewpub variant includes a brewing kettle

subject: Brewpub (variant)
rule: brewpub variant must have a grease trap in the wastewater line from kitchen sinks
conditions: if the brewpub variant includes a kitchen

subject: Brewpub (variant)
rule: brewpub variant must have fire-rated separation between brewing area and public seating
conditions: if the brewpub variant has a brewing area adjacent to a public seating area

subject: Brewpub (variant)
rule: brewpub variant must not have fermented beer stored in direct sunlight
conditions: if the brewpub variant includes beer storage or serving areas
exceptions: if UV-blocking glass or opaque enclosures are used

subject: Festhalle (variant)
rule: building envelope must be weathertight (roof, walls, and glazing system must prevent water ingress)
conditions: building is enclosed
building is occupied
exceptions: structures explicitly designed as open-air or semi-covered

subject: Festhalle (variant)
rule: roof must have a positive drainage path to shed rainwater
conditions: roof is not designed as a cistern/water-feature surface
roof slope is less than 1%
exceptions: roofs explicitly designed as green roofs with engineered drainage layers that meet local code

subject: Festhalle (variant)
rule: means of egress must comply with minimum width and travel-distance requirements for the calculated occupant load
conditions: building is occupied by more than 49 persons

subject: Festhalle (variant)
rule: structure must resist gravity loads (dead + live loads) without collapse

subject: Common Lounge
rule: Common Lounge must have a minimum floor-to-ceiling height of 2.4 m (8 ft) to meet occupancy egress requirements
conditions: when classified as an occupied space

subject: Common Lounge
rule: Common Lounge must have at least one means of egress (door or exit) that opens directly to a corridor or exterior
conditions: when floor area exceeds 50 m² or occupancy load exceeds 49 persons

subject: Common Lounge
rule: Common Lounge must not have a floor finish that produces hazardous slip conditions when wet
conditions: where food or drink is permitted

subject: Common Lounge
rule: Common Lounge must be provided with artificial lighting that achieves a minimum of 100 lux at floor level
conditions: when no significant daylight is available

subject: Guestroom Wing
rule: guestroom wing must have a minimum ceiling height of 2.4 m for habitable spaces
conditions: occupied rooms (bedrooms, bathrooms, corridors)
exceptions: mechanical or service voids

subject: Guestroom Wing
rule: guestroom wing must have at least one means of egress from each guestroom directly to a corridor or exterior
conditions: each guestroom

subject: Guestroom Wing
rule: guestroom wing corridor width must be at least 1.1 m clear for accessible egress
conditions: corridor serving guestrooms

subject: Guestroom Wing
rule: guestroom wing must not have a guestroom floor level that is more than 1.5 m below the adjacent ground level without a second means of egress
conditions: below-grade guestrooms
exceptions: if automatic sprinkler system is provided throughout the wing

subject: Breakfast Room / Dining Hall
rule: Breakfast Room / Dining Hall must have at least one means of egress (door or exit) to the exterior or a fire-rated corridor
conditions: When the room is designed for occupancy
exceptions: When the room is directly adjacent to and open to a larger egress-served space with no intervening door

subject: Breakfast Room / Dining Hall
rule: Breakfast Room / Dining Hall must not have floor drains that connect directly to the sanitary sewer system without an air gap or trap
conditions: When food or beverage is served or consumed in the space

subject: Commercial Kitchen
rule: commercial kitchen must have a fire suppression system (e.g., Ansul system) over cooking equipment
conditions: kitchen contains grease-producing cooking appliances (e.g., fryers, grills, ranges)
exceptions: kitchen has no cooking equipment (e.g., prep-only or warming-only kitchen)

subject: Commercial Kitchen
rule: commercial kitchen must have a Type I or Type II hood system over cooking equipment that exhausts to the outside
conditions: kitchen contains grease-producing cooking appliances (e.g., fryers, grills, ranges)
exceptions: kitchen has only electric ovens or steam equipment with no grease production and local code permits recirculating hood

subject: Commercial Kitchen
rule: commercial kitchen must have a grease-trap or interceptor on the wastewater drain line from scullery/ dishwashing area
conditions: kitchen has a three-compartment sink or dishwasher that discharges greasy wastewater
exceptions: facility connected to a municipal sewer system with an agreement allowing discharge without pretreatment (rare)

subject: Commercial Kitchen
rule: commercial kitchen floor must be constructed of non-absorbent, slip-resistant material and sloped to floor drains

subject: Commercial Kitchen
rule: commercial kitchen must have handwashing sinks that are separate from food-prep and dishwashing sinks

subject: Commercial Kitchen
rule: commercial kitchen must not have exposed wooden beams or other porous, cleanable surfaces within the food-prep zone
conditions: surfaces are exposed within 4 ft of food-contact surfaces or above open food areas
exceptions: decorative wood elements fully sealed, non-absorbent, and approved by health authority

subject: Guest Bathroom
rule: guest bathroom must have a ventilation path to the exterior (either window or mechanical exhaust)

subject: Guest Bathroom
rule: guest bathroom must have a water-resistant floor and wall finish in the wet zone (shower/bath area)
conditions: bathroom contains a shower or bathtub

subject: Guest Bathroom
rule: guest bathroom must not have electrical switches or outlets within the defined wet zone reach (typically within 1 meter of a water source)
conditions: bathroom contains a shower, bathtub, or sink
exceptions: GFCI-protected outlets installed per code may be placed at permitted distances

subject: Guest Bathroom
rule: guest bathroom must have a toilet connected to a sanitary drainage system
conditions: bathroom contains a toilet

subject: Guestroom Door & Lock System
rule: guestroom door must allow emergency egress from inside without requiring a key or special knowledge
conditions: occupiable guestroom
building code jurisdiction applies
exceptions: facilities with secure treatment or detention functions where alternate life-safety plans are approved

subject: Guestroom Door & Lock System
rule: guestroom door must not lock in a manner that prevents re-entry from the corridor side when the room is unoccupied and the door is closed
conditions: hotel or multi-unit residential building
corridor serves as the means of egress

subject: Guestroom Door & Lock System
rule: guestroom door lock must not disengage automatically upon power loss if the lock is electronically operated
conditions: electronically operated lock is the primary locking mechanism
exceptions: fail-secure configuration approved by fire marshal and building code official

subject: Guestroom Door & Lock System
rule: guestroom door must not obstruct the required egress width of the corridor when fully open
conditions: door swings into the corridor
exceptions: door opens into an alcove or recess that keeps the door clear of the required egress path

subject: Guestroom Door & Lock System
rule: latch or deadbolt must not require more than one releasing operation to open the door from the egress side
conditions: door is on a means of egress

subject: Built-in Wardrobe
rule: wardrobe depth must allow clearance for hanging clothes (typically minimum 600mm from back wall to front face)
conditions: built-in wardrobe is designed for hanging clothes storage
wardrobe includes a hanging rod
exceptions: wardrobe is designed exclusively for folded/shelf storage with no hanging rod

subject: Built-in Wardrobe
rule: wardrobe must have a minimum interior clear height for hanging long garments if a long-hanging section is included
conditions: wardrobe includes a dedicated long-hanging section (e.g., for coats, dresses)
exceptions: wardrobe has no long-hanging section — only short hanging (double rods) or shelving

subject: Built-in Wardrobe
rule: wardrobe must not have doors that are obstructed by adjacent building elements (e.g., walls, other cabinetry, bed placement)
conditions: wardrobe has hinged or sliding doors
exceptions: wardrobe has no doors (open shelving concept)
wardrobe uses roller shutters or curtains that do not require clearance swing

subject: Built-in Wardrobe
rule: built-in wardrobe must be structurally anchored to the wall or floor to prevent tipping
conditions: wardrobe is a freestanding tall unit exceeding 800mm in height

subject: Guestroom Window Assembly
rule: guestroom window assembly must have a weathertight seal between the window frame and the wall opening
conditions: where window assembly is installed in an exterior wall

subject: Guestroom Window Assembly
rule: guestroom window assembly must be rated for the local wind load pressure at the building elevation where installed
conditions: for guestrooms above ground level or in wind-exposed zones

subject: Guestroom Window Assembly
rule: guestroom window assembly must not obstruct the required emergency egress opening size
conditions: where the window serves as a required means of egress per local building code

subject: Guestroom Window Assembly
rule: guestroom window assembly must allow operation (open/close) without binding under design temperature ranges
conditions: for operable window types
exceptions: fixed (non-operable) window assemblies

subject: Electrical Room
rule: An electrical room must have a minimum ceiling height of at least 2.4 m (8 ft) to accommodate electrical equipment, panelboards, and safe personnel access
exceptions: Facilities specifically designed as walk-in crawl spaces with external disconnects

subject: Electrical Room
rule: An electrical room must have a dedicated means of ventilation or air conditioning to prevent heat buildup from electrical equipment
exceptions: Rooms containing only low-voltage or passive equipment with negligible heat output

subject: Electrical Room
rule: An electrical room must not contain plumbing pipes, water lines, or drainage pipes passing through the space
exceptions: Fire sprinkler piping required for the room itself

subject: Electrical Room
rule: An electrical room must have a door that swings outward (away from the room)
exceptions: Doors in rooms under 3 m² where outward swing would obstruct a required egress path, provided the door opens inward with panic hardware

subject: Electrical Room
rule: An electrical room must have the floor rated for the point-load weight of the heaviest piece of electrical equipment to be installed

subject: Electrical Room
rule: An electrical room floor must be level and free of floor drains
conditions: The room contains electrical equipment at floor level
exceptions: Flood-prone zones where sealed floor drains with gas-tight covers are required by plumbing code

subject: Mechanical Room
rule: mechanical room must have a dedicated ventilation path to outside air
conditions: room contains combustion equipment (e.g., gas-fired boilers, water heaters)
room contains refrigerating machinery with air-cooled condensers
exceptions: all equipment in the room is fully electric and produces no combustion byproducts and rejection heat is captured by a water-cooled system piped to remote dry coolers or cooling towers

subject: Mechanical Room
rule: mechanical room must have a floor drain or a sealed secondary containment system capable of holding the full volume of the largest vessel
conditions: room contains water-heating or steam equipment
room contains fuel-oil or chemical storage tanks
exceptions: room contains only dry-type transformers and solid-state electrical equipment with no liquid contents

subject: Mechanical Room
rule: mechanical room floor must be rated for the point-load of the heaviest piece of equipment plus a safety factor of at least 1.5
exceptions: equipment is mounted on a structural curb that distributes load to main building columns and the intervening floor slab is not required to carry any equipment load

subject: Mechanical Room
rule: mechanical room must not have any floor drains that connect to the sanitary sewer system without an air gap or trap
conditions: drain is present
exceptions: drain is used exclusively for condensate from air-conditioning equipment where local code permits direct connection

subject: Mechanical Room
rule: mechanical room must have a fire-resistance rating of at least 1 hour when separating it from occupied spaces
conditions: building is of combustible construction (Type III, IV, or V)
building height exceeds three stories
exceptions: all equipment is electric with no combustible fuel source and room contains no oil-filled transformers or other combustible liquids

subject: Elevator Machine Room
rule: Elevator machine room must have adequate ventilation to dissipate heat from elevator machinery and controls
conditions: Room contains elevator hoist machinery
Room contains motor-generator sets or drive controllers
exceptions: Room equipped with active cooling system (e.g., HVAC) that maintains operating temperature without requiring ventilation openings

subject: Elevator Machine Room
rule: Elevator machine room floor must be level and capable of supporting concentrated live loads from elevator equipment
conditions: Room houses traction elevator machinery

subject: Elevator Machine Room
rule: Elevator machine room must not be used for storage of any materials not related to elevator operation

subject: Elevator Machine Room
rule: Elevator machine room must have a minimum ceiling height as specified by applicable elevator code

subject: Sprinkler Riser Room
rule: Sprinkler riser room must have a dedicated floor drain or trench drain connected to the building drainage system
conditions: The room contains a fire sprinkler riser assembly
exceptions: The riser room is a dry-pipe or pre-action system with no main drain or test/drain valve requiring water discharge

subject: Sprinkler Riser Room
rule: Sprinkler riser room must have a minimum clearance of at least 36 inches (914 mm) in front of all control valves and equipment requiring maintenance access
conditions: The riser room contains valves, gauges, or flow switches that require periodic inspection or operation

subject: Sprinkler Riser Room
rule: Sprinkler riser room must be separated from other building spaces by fire-resistance-rated construction
conditions: The building is classified as requiring fire-resistive construction per applicable code
exceptions: The riser room serves a building or portion of a building not required to have fire-resistive separations (e.g., small buildings with exceptions in the adopted code)

subject: Sprinkler Riser Room
rule: Sprinkler riser room must not contain non-fire-protection equipment or storage
exceptions: Equipment and piping serving the fire protection system itself (e.g., fire pump controllers, backflow preventers)

subject: Passenger Elevator
rule: passenger elevator car must have a functioning braking system that can engage upon cable failure or overspeed
conditions: elevator is operational
elevator serves passenger loads

subject: Passenger Elevator
rule: passenger elevator must not have an unguarded opening between the hoistway and the car at any landing
conditions: elevator serves any floor

subject: Passenger Elevator
rule: passenger elevator car must have a rated load capacity that is never exceeded during operation
conditions: elevator is carrying passengers or cargo

subject: Fire Alarm System
rule: a fire alarm system must be connected to an uninterruptible power supply or backup battery source
conditions: where the system is the primary fire detection and alarm system for the building
exceptions: systems that are purely manual call-point only with no electronic detection or notification appliances

subject: Fire Alarm System
rule: a fire alarm system must not have its notification appliances (horns, strobes, speakers) obstructed by building finishes, furnishings, or architectural features
conditions: where notification appliances are installed for occupant warning

subject: Fire Alarm System
rule: a fire alarm system's initiating devices (smoke detectors, heat detectors) must be installed at the correct spacing and location per code, not placed where airflow, geometry, or obstructions prevent smoke or heat from reaching them
conditions: where automatic detection is required by code or design

subject: Sprinkler System
rule: Sprinkler system must have a reliable water supply
conditions: For automatic fire sprinkler systems

subject: Sprinkler System
rule: Sprinkler system must be designed to prevent freezing in locations subject to freezing temperatures
conditions: When installed in unheated areas or climates with freezing temperatures
exceptions: Dry-pipe or pre-action systems that drain after operation

subject: Sprinkler System
rule: Sprinkler heads must not be obstructed by building elements or stored materials
exceptions: Where designed with sidewall sprinklers or in-rack sprinklers that account for specific obstructions

subject: Sprinkler System
rule: Sprinkler system piping must be seismically braced in earthquake-prone regions
conditions: In seismic design categories where building codes require seismic bracing

subject: Plumbing Distribution System
rule: plumbing distribution system must maintain adequate pressure at all fixtures under simultaneous design demand
conditions: when system is operational
during peak demand periods
exceptions: during planned maintenance shutdowns with advance notice

subject: Plumbing Distribution System
rule: plumbing distribution system must not allow backflow of contaminated water into potable supply
conditions: when connected to potable water supply
exceptions: if system is entirely non-potable (e.g., reclaimed water system isolated by air gap)

subject: Plumbing Distribution System
rule: plumbing distribution system must have positive drainage slope on waste and vent piping
conditions: for gravity drainage portions of the system
exceptions: where pumped drainage is explicitly designed and approved

subject: Plumbing Distribution System
rule: plumbing distribution system must not exceed maximum rated pressure of any component in the system
conditions: under any operating condition including water hammer surge

subject: Electrical Distribution System
rule: electrical distribution system must have proper overcurrent protection (fuses, circuit breakers, or equivalent) at every point where conductor ampacity changes
conditions: system includes conductors rated below the available fault current
exceptions: systems designed with current-limiting transformers or fault-current-limiting devices that ensure downstream equipment can withstand available fault current

subject: Electrical Distribution System
rule: electrical distribution system must maintain adequate working clearance around all energized equipment per applicable electrical code
conditions: equipment requires routine inspection, maintenance, or operation

subject: Electrical Distribution System
rule: electrical distribution system must not have ungrounded metallic enclosures or exposed live parts
conditions: system operates at voltages above 50V to ground
exceptions: equipment listed and approved for double-insulated or equivalent construction where grounding is not required

subject: Electrical Distribution System
rule: electrical distribution system must have selective coordination of overcurrent protective devices where required by code for life safety and essential systems
conditions: system serves emergency, legally required standby, or critical operations power loads

subject: Electrical Distribution System
rule: electrical distribution system must not exceed rated voltage, current, and interrupting capacity of any component

subject: Guestroom Bed Base & Headboard
rule: bed base must not exceed the guestroom floor load rating
conditions: when loaded with a typical mattress and occupants

subject: Guestroom Bed Base & Headboard
rule: headboard must not obstruct required fire egress path from the bed area
conditions: when headboard is attached to wall adjacent to an egress route

subject: Guestroom Bed Base & Headboard
rule: bed frame must not have sharp edges or protrusions at occupant head height
conditions: when headboard and bed base are assembled

subject: Guestroom Bed Base & Headboard
rule: bed base must provide adequate support for the mattress without sagging beyond allowable deflection
conditions: when supporting a standard guestroom mattress

subject: Parking Lot Pavement System
rule: Parking lot pavement system must have a minimum cross-slope of 1% (1/8 inch per foot) to ensure positive surface drainage
conditions: pavement is exposed to precipitation
exceptions: indoor parking structures not exposed to weather

subject: Parking Lot Pavement System
rule: Parking lot pavement system must have a minimum structural thickness (combined base and surface) adequate for the design vehicle load
conditions: pavement is designed for vehicular traffic

subject: Parking Lot Pavement System
rule: Parking lot pavement surface must not have standing water exceeding 24 hours after precipitation ceases
conditions: pavement is exposed to precipitation
drainage system is properly installed
exceptions: extreme storm events exceeding the 10-year design storm

subject: Parking Lot Pavement System
rule: Parking lot pavement subgrade must be compacted to at least 95% of maximum dry density (Standard Proctor) before base placement
conditions: pavement is constructed on native soil subgrade
exceptions: subgrade is rock or existing competent base meeting bearing capacity requirements

subject: Canopy / Porte-Cochère
rule: canopy/porte-cochère roof must have a continuous fall (minimum slope) toward a defined drainage path or outlet
conditions: canopy/porte-cochère is exposed to precipitation
canopy/porte-cochère has a solid (non-permeable) roof covering
exceptions: canopy/porte-cochère roof is designed as a green/vegetated roof with integrated drainage layer
canopy/porte-cochère roof uses a scupper/overflow system that allows ponding up to a designed depth

subject: Canopy / Porte-Cochère
rule: canopy/porte-cochère must have adequate vertical clearance for the intended vehicle types (typically minimum 3.5–4.5 m / 12–14 ft)
conditions: canopy/porte-cochère is designed for vehicular access or drop-off
exceptions: canopy/porte-cochère is explicitly for pedestrian-only use with signage and physical barriers preventing vehicle entry

subject: Canopy / Porte-Cochère
rule: canopy/porte-cochère structure must withstand its own dead load plus live loads (snow, rain, maintenance) without collapse
conditions: canopy/porte-cochère is a permanent structure

subject: Canopy / Porte-Cochère
rule: canopy/porte-cochère must not have unsecured overhead elements that could fall onto vehicles or people below
conditions: canopy/porte-cochère is located above an area of vehicular or pedestrian traffic

subject: Outdoor Patio / Terrace
rule: outdoor patio/terrace surface must have a minimum slope for water drainage
conditions: surface is exposed to precipitation
exceptions: surface is covered by a waterproof roof

subject: Outdoor Patio / Terrace
rule: outdoor patio/terrace must not have standing water accumulations
conditions: surface is exposed to precipitation
exceptions: surface is specifically designed as a water feature or reflecting pool

subject: Outdoor Patio / Terrace
rule: outdoor patio/terrace guardrail or edge protection must be provided where drop exceeds hazard threshold
conditions: terrace is elevated more than 30 inches (approx. 762 mm) above adjacent grade or finish surface
exceptions: terrace is at grade level with no drop
terrace is bounded by a parapet wall meeting guardrail height

subject: Outdoor Patio / Terrace
rule: outdoor patio/terrace surface material must be slip-resistant when wet
conditions: surface is expected to get wet from rain, snow, or splash
surface is intended for pedestrian use
exceptions: surface has controlled access and warning signage (e.g., maintenance-only area)

subject: Exterior Wall Cladding
rule: Exterior wall cladding must provide a continuous water-resistive barrier or be installed over one, to prevent moisture ingress into the building envelope
conditions: Located in a climate zone with precipitation
Applied to exterior face of building
exceptions: Building is a temporary structure with no weather exposure requirement

subject: Exterior Wall Cladding
rule: Exterior wall cladding must not trap moisture between itself and the structural wall or sheathing
conditions: Cladding type is impermeable or semi-permeable (e.g., metal panel, vinyl, stucco)
Building has a backing wall that can absorb or retain moisture
exceptions: Assembly includes a properly designed drained and vented cavity that allows drying

subject: Exterior Wall Cladding
rule: Exterior wall cladding must be attached with sufficient mechanical connection to resist design wind loads
conditions: Building is in a wind zone requiring engineered design

subject: Exterior Wall Cladding
rule: Exterior wall cladding must not be combustible on buildings above a height threshold where fire spread via the exterior wall is a life-safety risk
conditions: Building exceeds local code height limit for combustible cladding (typically 12-18 m)
Cladding material does not pass a relevant fire-resistance or flame-spread test
exceptions: Cladding is part of an assembly that passes a full-scale fire test (e.g., NFPA 285) for the specific building height and occupancy

subject: Bus Shelter
rule: bus shelter roof must provide a clear drainage path (sloped or scuppered) such that standing water cannot pond
conditions: shelter has a solid roof panel
exceptions: roof is entirely permeable grating

subject: Bus Shelter
rule: bus shelter must not have structural elements that protrude into the minimum passenger waiting area or the adjacent roadway clearance envelope
conditions: shelter is installed at a curb/stop with pedestrian access

subject: Bus Shelter
rule: bus shelter glazing must be of safety-glazed or impact-resistant material where located in a vulnerable roadside zone
conditions: shelter has glass or transparent panels
shelter is within 3 m of a travel lane with posted speed > 40 km/h
exceptions: mesh or solid panel is used in lieu of glazing

subject: Foundation System
rule: Foundation system must transfer building loads to soil or rock with adequate bearing capacity
conditions: All buildings
All structural loads

subject: Foundation System
rule: Foundation system must bear on soil or rock below the zone of frost heave
conditions: Buildings in frost-susceptible soils
Climates where freezing temperatures penetrate the ground
exceptions: Foundations designed as frost-protected shallow foundations with perimeter insulation per ASCE 32

subject: Foundation System
rule: Foundation system must not be undermined by erosion or scour
conditions: Foundations adjacent to water bodies
Foundations in erodible soils

subject: Foundation System
rule: Foundation system must have minimum embedment depth to prevent lateral sliding or overturning under design loads
conditions: All buildings subjected to lateral loads (wind, seismic, earth pressure)
exceptions: Massive mat foundations or rock-anchored systems where sliding resistance is verified by friction/adhesion alone

subject: Foundation System
rule: Foundation system must be constructed of materials durable against the specific site's soil chemistry and groundwater
conditions: Sites with aggressive soil chemistry (e.g., sulfates, chlorides)
Sites with corrosive groundwater
exceptions: When sacrificial corrosion allowance and monitoring are included in design life calculations

subject: Bus Stop Signage
rule: Bus stop signage must have its message/face oriented toward approaching traffic or waiting passengers
conditions: signage is installed at a bus stop

subject: Bus Stop Signage
rule: Bus stop signage must be legible from the intended viewing distance under normal daylight conditions
conditions: signage is installed at a bus stop

subject: Bus Stop Signage
rule: Bus stop signage must not be positioned where it is fully obstructed by permanent infrastructure (e.g., poles, trees, walls) from the primary approach direction
conditions: signage is installed at a bus stop

subject: Real-Time Passenger Information Display
rule: display must be legible under direct sunlight
conditions: display is installed outdoors or in areas with direct sunlight exposure
exceptions: display is installed in fully enclosed, windowless indoor space with controlled lighting

subject: Real-Time Passenger Information Display
rule: display must have a minimum contrast ratio for readability

subject: Real-Time Passenger Information Display
rule: display must not be placed where it creates a physical obstruction in emergency egress paths
conditions: display is wall-mounted or pole-mounted in a public transit area
exceptions: display is recessed into wall such that its profile does not protrude into the path

subject: Real-Time Passenger Information Display
rule: display must be protected from direct water ingress
conditions: display is installed outdoors or in semi-outdoor areas
exceptions: display is installed in a fully indoor climate-controlled environment

subject: Bus Stop Bench
rule: bus stop bench must have a stable base that prevents tipping under expected wind loads and incidental human contact
conditions: installed outdoors
freestanding design
exceptions: bench is integral to a larger anchored structure

subject: Bus Stop Bench
rule: bus stop bench seating surface must not have sharp edges or protrusions at contact points
conditions: publicly accessible

subject: Bus Stop Bench
rule: bus stop bench must support a minimum static vertical load of at least 250 kg distributed across the seating area without collapse
conditions: designed for multiple simultaneous occupants
exceptions: single-occupant bench with explicit signage limiting capacity

subject: Ticket Vending Machine
rule: Ticket vending machine must be positioned such that its display and interactive elements are within accessible reach range (typically 400–1200 mm from ground) for standing and wheelchair users

subject: Ticket Vending Machine
rule: Ticket vending machine must not have any sharp external edges or protruding corners that could cause injury to users

subject: Ticket Vending Machine
rule: Ticket vending machine must be anchored or stabilized to prevent tipping when a user applies force to interactive elements (e.g., pushing buttons or touching the screen)

subject: Ticket Vending Machine
rule: Ticket vending machine's payment slot and ticket output mechanism must be designed to prevent foreign object insertion and jamming

subject: Bus Stop Foundation
rule: bus stop foundation must be placed on stable, load-bearing soil or engineered fill
conditions: foundation supports shelter or structure above

subject: Bus Stop Foundation
rule: bus stop foundation must have a minimum compressive strength adequate for the design load
conditions: foundation is cast-in-place concrete or concrete masonry

subject: Bus Stop Foundation
rule: bus stop foundation must not be located directly over active utility lines without protective measures
conditions: excavation depth exceeds cover over utilities
exceptions: utility company provides engineered encasement or relocation

subject: Passenger Waiting Pad
rule: passenger waiting pad must have a slip-resistant surface finish
conditions: pad is uncovered/exposed to weather
exceptions: pad is fully enclosed and climate-controlled

subject: Passenger Waiting Pad
rule: passenger waiting pad surface must have a minimum cross-slope of 1% for drainage
conditions: pad is uncovered
exceptions: pad is covered by roof with redirected drainage

subject: Passenger Waiting Pad
rule: passenger waiting pad must not have steps or curbs that create a tripping hazard at the boarding edge
conditions: pad abuts a vehicle boarding lane or curb
exceptions: a flush transition or ADA-compliant ramp is provided

subject: Bus Stop Pole
rule: bus stop pole must be vertically oriented within 5 degrees of plumb
conditions: when installed in its permanent position
exceptions: temporary wind deflection during extreme weather

subject: Bus Stop Pole
rule: bus stop pole must have a minimum embedment depth or foundation to resist overturning
conditions: when installed in soil or ground
exceptions: pole mounted on a pre-existing concrete base or structure designed for its loading

subject: Bus Stop Pole
rule: bus stop pole must not have sharp burrs or protruding edges at typical hand-contact height
conditions: where public may grasp or lean against the pole

subject: Bus Stop Pole
rule: bus stop pole must be made of weather-resistant material or have protective coating
conditions: when exposed to outdoor weather conditions

subject: Bus Stop Trash Receptacle
rule: receptacle must be secured against tipping or displacement by wind or incidental contact
conditions: unit is freestanding and not bolted to ground or bus stop structure

subject: Bus Stop Trash Receptacle
rule: receptacle must not have sharp edges or protrusions at handle/opening height that could injure users

subject: Bus Stop Trash Receptacle
rule: receptacle must be drainable or water-shedding to prevent liquid accumulation inside
conditions: unit has a solid bottom or enclosed body
exceptions: units with fully perforated/mesh construction that naturally drains

subject: Food stand counter
rule: Food stand counter must have a horizontal work surface that is continuous and impervious to moisture
conditions: intended for food preparation
serving food directly to customers

subject: Food stand counter
rule: Food stand counter must have a minimum clear height underneath for standing operator access
conditions: operator works from behind the counter
exceptions: counter is designed exclusively as a display-only shelf with no operator behind it

subject: Food stand counter
rule: Food stand counter must not have exposed sharp edges or corners at customer reach height
conditions: counter is accessible to the public

subject: Food stand counter
rule: Food stand counter must shed liquid away from customer and operator zones
conditions: counter is exposed to rain or condensation
exceptions: counter is fully indoors with no moisture source above

subject: Kerb and Channel
rule: kerb and channel must have a continuous fall (gradient) along its length to direct water to the downstream drainage point
conditions: used in road or pavement drainage system

subject: Kerb and Channel
rule: kerb and channel must not have a cross-sectional profile that allows water to flow away from the channel (i.e., the channel lip must be higher than the pavement surface on the channel side)
conditions: adjacent to a paved surface that requires drainage

subject: Kerb and Channel
rule: kerb and channel must have a minimum height above the pavement surface to prevent vehicles from mounting the kerb at low speeds
conditions: used in a trafficked area where vehicle containment is required
exceptions: low-profile kerbs used in shared zones or car parks where vehicle over-run is permitted

subject: Kerb and Channel
rule: kerb and channel joint between adjacent sections must be watertight

subject: Kerb and Channel
rule: kerb and channel invert (lowest point of the channel) must be positioned at or below the level of the adjacent pavement surface to capture sheet flow

subject: Display shelving
rule: Display shelving must be capable of supporting its intended display load without collapsing or permanently deforming
conditions: when loaded with displayed items up to the rated capacity

subject: Display shelving
rule: Display shelving must not tip over under expected eccentric or frontal loads
conditions: when configured as a freestanding unit subject to browsing/pulling forces
exceptions: when the shelving is permanently anchored to a structural wall or floor such that tipping is mechanically prevented regardless of geometry

subject: Display shelving
rule: Display shelving must have a minimum clearance between shelves that accommodates the tallest intended displayed item
conditions: when shelving is intended for items of known maximum height

subject: Built-in refrigeration unit
rule: Built-in refrigeration unit must have proper ventilation clearance around condenser coils
conditions: unit uses air-cooled condenser
exceptions: unit uses water-cooled or remote condenser system

subject: Built-in refrigeration unit
rule: Built-in refrigeration unit must not be installed in a location where the ambient temperature exceeds the design rating of the system
conditions: unit is installed indoors or in an enclosed space
exceptions: unit is specifically rated and designed for high-ambient conditions

subject: Built-in refrigeration unit
rule: Built-in refrigeration unit must have a sealed, insulated refrigerant circuit with no leaks

subject: Built-in refrigeration unit
rule: Built-in refrigeration unit must be connected to a dedicated electrical circuit with proper overcurrent protection sized to the unit's locked rotor amps and full load amps

subject: Built-in refrigeration unit
rule: Built-in refrigeration unit must not be installed with condensate drainage that allows water to pool, freeze, or back up into the unit
conditions: unit produces condensate during normal defrost or cooling operation
exceptions: unit is designed as a self-contained system with integrated condensate evaporation handling

subject: Hood and exhaust system
rule: Hood exhaust system must terminate outdoors at least 3 feet from any building opening
conditions: System is a Type I or Type II hood
exceptions: Systems serving recirculating hoods that filter and return air to space

subject: Hood and exhaust system
rule: Ductwork for hood exhaust system must be constructed of steel of minimum thickness as required by code
conditions: Duct serves a commercial kitchen hood exhaust system

subject: Hood and exhaust system
rule: Hood exhaust duct must not pass through fire-rated assemblies unless enclosed in a 2-hour rated shaft or otherwise protected per code
conditions: Duct penetrates a fire-rated floor or wall assembly

subject: Hood and exhaust system
rule: Hood exhaust system must have automatic fire suppression system (wet chemical or equivalent) covering all cooking appliances under the hood
conditions: Hood is installed over commercial cooking equipment producing grease-laden vapors

subject: Hood and exhaust system
rule: Hood exhaust system ductwork must be leak-tight and cleanable along the full length
conditions: Duct is a grease duct serving commercial cooking equipment

subject: Grease interceptor
rule: Grease interceptor must be installed outdoors or in a well-ventilated area to prevent accumulation of explosive methane gas
conditions: interceptor receives kitchen wastewater containing fats, oils, and grease
exceptions: installation includes continuous mechanical ventilation and methane detection system with alarm

subject: Grease interceptor
rule: Grease interceptor must have a gas-tight and water-tight lid or cover when installed indoors
conditions: interceptor is located inside a building

subject: Grease interceptor
rule: Grease interceptor inlet and outlet invert elevations must have a minimum vertical separation to prevent short-circuiting of flow
conditions: interceptor is a gravity-flow passive type
exceptions: interceptor is equipped with an internal baffle system specifically designed for same-elevation ports

subject: Food preparation sink
rule: food preparation sink must be connected to a potable water supply
conditions: sink is intended for food preparation

subject: Food preparation sink
rule: food preparation sink must have a drain connection to an approved sanitary sewer or greywater system
conditions: sink is installed and operational

subject: Food preparation sink
rule: food preparation sink must not be made of porous unsealed material on food-contact surfaces
conditions: sink is used for washing food or utensils

subject: Food preparation sink
rule: food preparation sink must have a backsplash or be sealed against the wall
conditions: sink is mounted against a wall

subject: Service counter top
rule: service counter top must be fabricated from a material that can be cleaned and sanitized to code-required hygiene levels
conditions: used in food-service or healthcare settings

subject: Service counter top
rule: service counter top must have a minimum horizontal bearing area sufficient to prevent tipping under expected service loads
conditions: cantilevered or freestanding configuration
exceptions: counter built integrally into a wall or supported on all sides

subject: Food stand cabinetry
rule: food stand cabinetry must have at least one continuous, impermeable work surface for food preparation
conditions: used for food preparation
exceptions: pre-packaged food sales only with no on-site preparation

subject: Food stand cabinetry
rule: food stand cabinetry used for dry storage only must not be constructed of unsealed or absorbent wood directly contacting food
conditions: cabinetry interior surfaces contact food items during storage
exceptions: food is in sealed factory packaging that prevents any surface contact

subject: Food stand cabinetry
rule: food stand cabinetry must have enclosed base (toe-kick or solid bottom) that prevents pest entry from below
conditions: cabinetry sits on ground or floor in outdoor or semi-outdoor food stand
exceptions: cabinetry is wall-mounted with minimum 300mm clearance below and no ground contact

subject: Backsplash panel
rule: backsplash panel must be made of non-porous or sealed material in wet locations
conditions: installed behind a sink
installed behind a cooktop or range
installed in a commercial kitchen
exceptions: backsplash in a dry location with no moisture exposure
backsplash purely decorative and not in a food-prep or wet area

subject: Backsplash panel
rule: backsplash panel must not block or interfere with electrical outlet boxes or receptacle cutouts
conditions: backsplash covers a wall that contains electrical receptacles or switches
exceptions: outlets are relocated or extended to clear the panel face

subject: Backsplash panel
rule: backsplash panel must have a fire-resistant or non-combustible surface when installed behind a cooking appliance
conditions: installed directly behind a gas or electric range/cooktop
exceptions: there is a code-compliant clearance or a metal heat shield between the appliance and the panel

subject: Sleeping Platform
rule: sleeping platform must have a minimum horizontal area sufficient to accommodate a sleeping human body
conditions: platform is intended for human occupancy
exceptions: platform is purely decorative or representational

subject: Sleeping Platform
rule: sleeping platform must not have sharp edges or protruding hazards on its upper surface where a person lies
conditions: platform is intended for direct sleeping use without a thick mattress
exceptions: platform is always used with a mattress or padding that fully covers the surface

subject: Sleeping Platform
rule: sleeping platform must be capable of supporting the static weight of at least one adult human without collapse
conditions: platform is designed for human occupancy

subject: Public Dormitory
rule: at least one means of egress (exit) must be provided from each sleeping room and common area to a public way or safe area
conditions: building is occupied
designed for residential occupancy
exceptions: historic buildings with existing non-conforming layouts where equivalent safety is demonstrated

subject: Public Dormitory
rule: corridor travel distance to at least two exits from any point must not exceed the code-prescribed maximum for the occupancy type
conditions: floor has more than one exit required
exceptions: dead-end corridors may be limited in length rather than eliminated entirely per code

subject: Public Dormitory
rule: fire-resistance-rated barriers (walls and floor/ceiling assemblies) must separate each sleeping unit from adjacent units and corridors per the required fire-resistance rating for the occupancy
conditions: building has more than one sleeping unit
building is classified as Group R-2
exceptions: sprinklered buildings may permit reduced ratings per code

subject: Public Dormitory
rule: the roof must have a drainage path (slope, scuppers, internal drains, or gutters) to prevent ponding water
conditions: roof is flat or low-slope (slope < 1/4 inch per foot)

subject: Public Dormitory
rule: sleeping rooms must have a minimum window area for emergency escape and rescue (egress window) when located in a story at or below the level of exit discharge
conditions: room is a sleeping room
room is in a basement or on a story with a floor level at or below grade
exceptions: rooms with direct access to an exit door at grade may be exempt

subject: Privacy Partition
rule: a privacy partition must have a minimum thickness to resist lateral loads and provide stability
conditions: when used as a freestanding element

subject: Privacy Partition
rule: a privacy partition must not exceed a maximum unsupported height without structural bracing or stiffening
conditions: when constructed as a vertical freestanding panel
exceptions: unless the partition is reinforced or structurally framed to resist overturning

subject: Privacy Partition
rule: a privacy partition must be made of a material that is sufficiently opaque to provide visual privacy
conditions: when the intended function is visual screening
exceptions: unless the design intentionally uses translucent or perforated material for partial privacy

subject: Integrated Sleep Pod
rule: enclosed volume must maintain adequate ventilation to prevent CO2 buildup
conditions: occupant present
pod is sealed/closed
exceptions: short-duration occupancy under 5 minutes with pod door open

subject: Integrated Sleep Pod
rule: interior surfaces must be cleanable and non-porous
conditions: intended for multi-user or public use

subject: Integrated Sleep Pod
rule: pod must not have sharp internal edges or protrusions within occupant reach envelope

subject: Integrated Sleep Pod
rule: fire-resistant materials must be used for all interior linings and structural components

subject: Ventilation Grille for Sleep Cubicles
rule: ventilation grille must have a minimum free airflow area per cubicle to ensure adequate fresh air supply for sleeping occupants
conditions: installed in sleep cubicle enclosure

subject: Ventilation Grille for Sleep Cubicles
rule: ventilation grille must not be positioned where it can be blocked by bedding, pillows, or occupant movement
conditions: installed in a sleep cubicle
exceptions: grille is fitted with a rigid protective shroud or recessed behind a fixed baffle that prevents obstruction

subject: Ventilation Grille for Sleep Cubicles
rule: ventilation grille must be positioned to create cross-ventilation through the cubicle
conditions: cubicle has both an inlet and an outlet grille
exceptions: mechanical ventilation system actively forces airflow through a single grille opening

subject: Ventilation Grille for Sleep Cubicles
rule: ventilation grille must be fire-rated to prevent flame spread between adjacent cubicles
conditions: grille connects two separate cubicles or connects a cubicle to a common plenum
