rule: Thermally massive slab-on-grade must have its mass (thickness and material) sized to the diurnal thermal load and solar aperture of the space it serves
conditions: slab is designed as active thermal storage for a passive solar or radiant system

subject: Rain Screen Cladding System
rule: rain screen cladding system must have an open drainage cavity behind the cladding panels to allow moisture evacuation
conditions: when used on exterior walls

subject: Rain Screen Cladding System
rule: rain screen cladding system must have a continuous air barrier on the interior (warm) side of the insulation layer
conditions: when used in climates with significant indoor-outdoor temperature differentials

subject: Rain Screen Cladding System
rule: rain screen cladding system must not have airtight cladding joints that block the drainage cavity

subject: Rain Screen Cladding System
rule: rain screen cladding system must have a capillary break between the cladding and the drainage cavity

subject: Sliding Partition Wall
rule: Sliding partition wall must be installed on a level, structurally supported overhead track or floor guide system
conditions: When installed as a non-loadbearing interior divider

subject: Sliding Partition Wall
rule: Sliding partition wall must not have its track or rollers obstructed by adjacent finishes, trim, or floor-mounted fixtures
conditions: When sliding motion is required for operation

subject: Sliding Partition Wall
rule: Sliding partition wall must have a clearance path free of structural columns, ducts, or permanent partitions along its full travel distance
conditions: When designed to slide open/closed along a horizontal path

subject: Sliding Partition Wall
rule: Sliding partition wall's top track must be secured to structure capable of supporting the wall's dead load plus dynamic forces from sliding operation
conditions: When overhead-hung (top-hung) configuration is used

subject: Entrance Frame
rule: entrance frame must provide a clear opening width of at least the minimum required for egress (typically 32 inches clear between the frame and the open door)
conditions: the entrance serves as an occupied-space egress door
exceptions: frameless glass door assemblies where the frame does not project into the opening

subject: Entrance Frame
rule: entrance frame must not rack or twist under its own weight before permanent bracing is installed
conditions: the entrance frame is pre-hung or assembled prior to rough-in

subject: Entrance Frame
rule: entrance frame must be anchored to structural supports at intervals sufficient to resist design wind loads without separation
conditions: the entrance is in an exterior wall subject to wind pressure

subject: Entrance Frame
rule: entrance frame must not have a lintel or header that is undersized for the tributary load above the opening
conditions: the frame includes a load-bearing header or lintel

subject: Linear Foundation Trench
rule: Linear foundation trench must be excavated to a depth that reaches adequate load-bearing soil or below the frost line
conditions: Site soil conditions require frost protection
Structural loads require bearing on competent soil
exceptions: Engineered soil replacement or deep foundation systems are used instead of shallow trench

subject: Linear Foundation Trench
rule: Trench bottom must be level and uniform to within acceptable construction tolerances before placing foundation material
conditions: Continuous footing or strip footing is placed directly in the trench
exceptions: Stepped foundations designed for sloped sites compensate by design

subject: Linear Foundation Trench
rule: Trench sidewalls must not collapse or slough during the period between excavation and placement of foundation or backfill
conditions: Trench exceeds 1.2 m (4 ft) depth
Trench walls are unsupported
exceptions: Trench is in stable rock that does not require shoring

subject: Linear Foundation Trench
rule: Trench must not be excavated within a horizontal distance less than the angle-of-repose distance from existing foundations or structures
conditions: Adjacent to existing load-bearing walls or footings
exceptions: Temporary shoring or underpinning is engineered and installed prior to excavation

subject: Linear Foundation Trench
rule: Trench must be free of standing water and soft material (silt, mud, snow, ice) at the time of concrete placement or footing installation
conditions: Concrete or masonry is cast directly in the trench
exceptions: Tremie concrete placement or dewatering system is designed for underwater conditions

subject: Entrance Glazing
rule: Entrance glazing must be made of safety glass (tempered or laminated) if within 900 mm of a door or within 1500 mm of the floor
conditions: glazing is within 900 mm of a door opening
glazing is within 1500 mm of finished floor level
exceptions: glazing is fully tempered and meets break-safe standards

subject: Entrance Glazing
rule: Entrance glazing must not create an obstruction that reduces the minimum clear opening width of the entrance door
conditions: glazing is mounted on or immediately adjacent to a swinging door leaf

subject: Entrance Glazing
rule: Entrance glazing must be rated for wind load at the building's specific location
conditions: glazing is installed in an exterior entrance wall assembly
exceptions: fully protected by an overhang or screen that prevents direct wind pressure

subject: Entrance Glazing
rule: Entrance glazing must not create a thermal bridge that causes continuous condensation
conditions: glazing is in a conditioned building in a climate where exterior temperatures regularly fall below 4°C
exceptions: entrance is unconditioned or exterior-only (e.g., unheated vestibule)

subject: Entrance Matting System
rule: Entrance matting system must be recessed into the floor so that its top surface is flush with the finished floor level on all sides
conditions: Installed in a pedestrian entrance pathway
exceptions: Temporary matting used for construction-phase protection where trip hazard is managed by other means

subject: Entrance Matting System
rule: Entrance matting system must have sufficient depth (minimum ~10–15 mm typical) to allow dirt and moisture to fall below foot traffic and not be tracked beyond the mat
conditions: Used as a scrape-and-wipe entry mat for soil/moisture removal
exceptions: Matting whose sole function is anti-fatigue (no dirt/moisture removal requirement)

subject: Entrance Matting System
rule: Entrance matting system must not create a water-collecting basin or ponding surface at the door threshold
conditions: Installed at an exterior door entrance directly exposed to rain or snowmelt

subject: Entrance Matting System
rule: Entrance matting system must be removable or have a removable/cleanable surface layer for maintenance
conditions: Installed in a location where accumulation of dirt, debris, or moisture is expected
exceptions: Disposable/one-use matting systems intended for single-event temporary use only

subject: Entrance Locking Hardware
rule: entrance locking hardware must engage fully with the strike plate or jamb when in the locked position
conditions: hardware is installed on a swinging door

subject: Entrance Locking Hardware
rule: entrance locking hardware must not allow the latch or deadbolt to retract when the door is closed and locked without intentional actuation of the handle, key, or thumb-turn
conditions: hardware is in the locked state
exceptions: panic hardware or fire exit devices where single-action egress is required by code

subject: Entrance Locking Hardware
rule: entrance locking hardware must withstand cyclic operation without mechanical failure or significant degradation of locking function

subject: Entrance Weatherstripping
rule: Entrance weatherstripping must create a continuous seal around the entire perimeter of the door when closed
conditions: The door is an exterior entrance
Weatherstripping is installed on a swinging or sliding door
exceptions: Doors with intentionally designed gaps for ventilation or drainage (e.g., barn doors, louvered doors)

subject: Entrance Weatherstripping
rule: Entrance weatherstripping must be compressible enough to accommodate door closure without preventing latching
conditions: Weatherstripping is installed on a hinged door
exceptions: Sliding or overhead doors where compression is not the engagement mechanism

subject: Entrance Weatherstripping
rule: Entrance weatherstripping must not obstruct the door's operation mechanism (hinges, latch, lock)
conditions: Weatherstripping is applied to any operable entrance door

subject: Entrance Ramp
rule: Entrance ramp slope must not exceed 1:12 (8.33%)
conditions: Applies to pedestrian entrance ramps
exceptions: When ramp serves only freight/service access and is not intended for public or wheelchair use

subject: Entrance Ramp
rule: Entrance ramp must have a clear width of at least 36 inches (915 mm) between handrails
conditions: Applies to pedestrian entrance ramps required to be accessible

subject: Entrance Ramp
rule: Entrance ramp must have handrails on both sides if rise exceeds 6 inches (150 mm)
conditions: Applies when ramp rise is greater than 6 inches

subject: Entrance Ramp
rule: Entrance ramp landing must be at least as wide as the ramp and minimum 60 inches (1525 mm) long
conditions: Applies at top and bottom of every entrance ramp run

subject: Entrance Steps
rule: entrance steps must have a minimum tread depth that accommodates a secure foothold
conditions: steps are intended for pedestrian use

subject: Entrance Steps
rule: entrance steps must have a maximum riser height that allows safe ascent and descent
conditions: steps are intended for pedestrian use

subject: Entrance Steps
rule: entrance steps must_not have a sudden change in height between consecutive treads exceeding a small tolerance
conditions: steps are intended for pedestrian use

subject: Entrance Steps
rule: entrance steps must_not have a slippery upper surface under foreseeable wet conditions
conditions: steps are exposed to weather or cleaning moisture

subject: Entrance Steps
rule: entrance steps must have a landing at the top and bottom that provides a stable platform
conditions: steps serve as a primary building entrance

subject: Entrance Steps
rule: entrance steps must have a handrail if the total rise exceeds a threshold (typically 30 inches / 4 risers)
conditions: steps serve as a primary building entrance
total rise exceeds typical code threshold
exceptions: a single step or very low rise where fall distance is negligible

subject: Entrance Landing
rule: Entrance landing must have a clear width of at least 36 inches (914 mm) to meet minimum accessible egress path requirements
conditions: Where the landing serves as part of an accessible means of egress
exceptions: One-story buildings or facilities with no accessible path of travel required

subject: Entrance Landing
rule: Entrance landing must have a slope no greater than 1:48 (2%) in any direction
conditions: The landing is at an exterior or interior entrance door

subject: Entrance Landing
rule: Entrance landing must be at least 5 feet 0 inches (1524 mm) long in the direction of door swing when the door opens toward the landing
conditions: Door swings toward the landing
exceptions: Residential one- and two-family dwellings (some codes exempt)

subject: Entrance Landing
rule: Entrance landing must not have surface water ponding of any depth that remains more than 1 hour after rainfall
conditions: Landing is exterior and exposed to precipitation

subject: Vestibule
rule: a vestibule must have two doors (an outer door and an inner door) separating indoor and outdoor environments
conditions: the vestibule serves as an entrance between conditioned interior space and outdoor environment

subject: Vestibule
rule: vestibule floor must be waterproof and sloped to drain
conditions: vestibule is directly accessible from exterior
vestibule is at grade level

subject: Vestibule
rule: vestibule must not have a floor drain directly connected to building sewer without a trap seal
conditions: vestibule has floor drain

subject: Garden Enclosure Wall
rule: Garden enclosure wall must have a continuous load path to transfer lateral wind loads to the ground or main structure
conditions: wall is freestanding
wall height exceeds 1.0 m

subject: Garden Enclosure Wall
rule: Garden enclosure wall must not have a foundation that bears on topsoil or uncompacted fill without engineered ground improvement
conditions: wall weight exceeds lightweight decorative screen
exceptions: wall is a temporary installation less than 1.0 m in height and weighs less than 200 kg/m

subject: Entrance Handrail
rule: Entrance handrail must be continuous for the full length of the stair or ramp run
exceptions: Where a handrail is interrupted by a newel post at a landing, the handrail may be discontinuous at that point if grip continuity is provided

subject: Entrance Handrail
rule: Entrance handrail must have a cross-section diameter between 1.25 inches (32 mm) and 2 inches (51 mm)

subject: Entrance Handrail
rule: Entrance handrail must have a minimum clearance of 1.5 inches (38 mm) between the handrail and any adjacent wall or surface

subject: Entrance Handrail
rule: Entrance handrail must return smoothly to wall, floor, or terminate in a newel post (no abrupt projecting ends)

subject: Entrance Handrail
rule: Entrance handrail must not rotate or deflect more than 0.25 inches when a 200 lb (890 N) concentrated load is applied

subject: Entrance Handrail
rule: Entrance handrail must be slip-resistant

subject: Garden Canopy
rule: canopy must have a minimum roof pitch to shed rainwater
conditions: canopy has a solid roof surface
exceptions: canopy roof is made of permeable material (e.g., open lattice or slats with gaps)

subject: Garden Canopy
rule: canopy must have structural connections capable of resisting wind uplift forces
conditions: canopy is attached to a building or freestanding in an exposed location

subject: Garden Canopy
rule: canopy must not have unvented enclosed spaces that can trap moisture
conditions: canopy includes any enclosed or semi-enclosed volume (e.g., storage box, solid fascia)
exceptions: space is designed with proper ventilation openings or is in an arid climate zone where moisture trapping is not a concern

subject: Garden Canopy
rule: canopy must have a drainage path for any collected rainwater
conditions: canopy collects or channels rainwater (e.g., via gutters, downspouts, or roof surface)

subject: Planting Bed
rule: planting bed must have drainage openings or a permeable base layer to prevent waterlogging
conditions: planter is enclosed on bottom and sides
exceptions: hydroponic or bog-adapted planting systems where saturated conditions are intentional

subject: Planting Bed
rule: planting bed must not exceed structural load capacity of its supporting surface
conditions: planting bed is elevated on a roof, balcony, or other structure not designed for soil loads

subject: Planting Bed
rule: planting bed must have a physical barrier separating it from building foundation or waterproofing membrane
conditions: planting bed is adjacent to a building wall or above a roof membrane
exceptions: where planter is fully independent and separated by a minimum air gap with drainage provision

subject: Garden Drainage System
rule: garden drainage system must have a minimum slope of at least 1% toward the outlet or collection point
conditions: system is gravity-fed
exceptions: system uses active pumping and has no gravity-flow segment

subject: Garden Drainage System
rule: drainage outlet must not discharge onto adjacent property or public right-of-way without approved easement or stormwater connection

subject: Garden Drainage System
rule: garden drainage system must not allow surface water to pond within 10 feet of building foundation
exceptions: site has a fully engineered waterproofing and drainage board system rated for hydrostatic pressure at the foundation wall

subject: Garden Irrigation Supply
rule: water supply to irrigation system must be physically disconnected from potable water supply or protected by an approved backflow prevention device
conditions: system is connected to a municipal or potable water source
exceptions: system uses only harvested rainwater with no cross-connection to potable water

subject: Garden Irrigation Supply
rule: irrigation supply piping must not exceed the rated pressure of its lowest-rated component under normal operating conditions
conditions: system includes pressurized distribution piping

subject: Garden Irrigation Supply
rule: irrigation supply system must include a means of manual shutoff that is accessible and operable
exceptions: temporary or portable supply using a garden hose with an accessible spigot serves as the shutoff

subject: Garden Entry Door Assembly
rule: door leaf must fit within the door frame opening
conditions: door assembly includes a swinging or sliding leaf

subject: Garden Entry Door Assembly
rule: door weatherstripping or gasket must form a continuous seal around the perimeter when closed
conditions: assembly is intended to be weather-rated or exterior-grade

subject: Garden Entry Door Assembly
rule: hinge or pivot hardware must be capable of supporting the door leaf weight at full opening
conditions: assembly includes a pivoting or hinged door leaf

subject: Garden Entry Door Assembly
rule: lockset strike plate must align with the latch bolt when the door is closed
conditions: assembly includes a lockset or latch

subject: Interior Garden Window Wall
rule: Interior Garden Window Wall must be structurally self-supporting or supported by adjacent structure to prevent collapse into the garden area
conditions: When used as a freestanding wall element
When separating interior space from an interior garden/atrium

subject: Interior Garden Window Wall
rule: Interior Garden Window Wall must not obstruct required egress pathways from the interior space
conditions: When located along a path required for means of egress
exceptions: When alternative compliant egress path is provided

subject: Interior Garden Window Wall
rule: Interior Garden Window Wall must incorporate safety glazing or equivalent barrier to prevent accidental fall-through into the garden area
conditions: When the wall contains glazed panels
When the garden side has a drop greater than 600 mm
exceptions: When a guardrail or barrier meeting code requirements is provided independently of the glazing

subject: Garden Soils and Growing Medium
rule: garden soils and growing medium must have adequate drainage to prevent waterlogging and root asphyxiation
conditions: when used as a growing substrate in a contained planter or raised bed
when used in a roof garden or green roof assembly
exceptions: when the medium is designed specifically for aquatic or bog plant species

subject: Garden Soils and Growing Medium
rule: garden soils and growing medium must not contain hard, sharp, or toxic debris that could physically injure root systems or contaminate water flow
conditions: when the medium is intended for edible crop production or sensitive ornamental plantings

subject: Garden Soils and Growing Medium
rule: garden soils and growing medium must support the structural loads imposed by the saturated medium plus any plants and surface loads without excessive settlement or lateral displacement
conditions: when used on a rooftop, balcony, or elevated structure where load capacity is limited

subject: Entry Canopy / Porte-Cochère
rule: a canopy/porte-cochère roof must have a minimum slope to prevent ponding and ensure drainage
conditions: roof is flat or low-slope
roof is opaque and exposed to precipitation
exceptions: roof is designed as a green/vegetated roof with engineered drainage layers

subject: Entry Canopy / Porte-Cochère
rule: canopy/porte-cochère structure must resist calculated wind uplift forces
conditions: canopy is cantilevered or freestanding
canopy is located in a wind zone or region subject to high winds

subject: Entry Canopy / Porte-Cochère
rule: canopy/porte-cochère must not block required emergency vehicle access or fire apparatus clearance envelope
conditions: canopy projects over a driveway or vehicular route serving a building
exceptions: local fire code explicitly provides a reduced height or alternative compliance path

subject: Entry Canopy / Porte-Cochère
rule: canopy/porte-cochère must provide minimum vertical clearance for the intended vehicle types
conditions: canopy is designed to allow vehicular passage beneath it
exceptions: canopy is purely pedestrian-scale with no vehicular traffic intended

subject: Entry Floor Grille / Mat
rule: Entry floor grille/mat must be flush with or slightly recessed below the finished floor surface to prevent trip hazards
conditions: installed in pedestrian walkway
at building entrance
exceptions: temporary construction matting

subject: Entry Floor Grille / Mat
rule: Entry floor grille/mat must have openings (or drainage paths) that allow water and debris to fall through to the recess below rather than ponding on the surface
conditions: exposed to exterior weather
located at exterior entrance
exceptions: interior-only mat not exposed to moisture

subject: Entry Floor Grille / Mat
rule: Entry floor grille/mat must be removable or hinged to allow access to the recess/pit below for cleaning and drainage maintenance
conditions: installed over a recessed pit
exceptions: surface-mounted mats with no underlying pit

subject: Entry Stoop / Landing
rule: Entry stoop / landing must have a minimum depth of 3 feet (0.91 m) to allow a person to stand safely and clear of the door swing
conditions: When adjacent to a door that swings outward
exceptions: When door swings inward and landing is not required by code

subject: Entry Stoop / Landing
rule: Entry stoop / landing must have a slip-resistant walking surface

subject: Entry Stoop / Landing
rule: Entry stoop / landing surface must slope away from the building (minimum 1/4 in per ft, 2% slope)
conditions: When the stoop is exterior and exposed to precipitation

subject: Entry Stoop / Landing
rule: Entry stoop / landing must have a minimum clear width of 36 inches (0.91 m)
conditions: When serving as an accessible egress path

subject: Entry Stoop / Landing
rule: Entry stoop / landing must not have a change in elevation (step) at the door threshold exceeding 7-3/4 inches (196 mm) without an intermediate landing
conditions: When serving as the only means of egress
exceptions: Existing construction under certain historic building codes

subject: Ramp at Entry
rule: ramp at entry must have a maximum slope ratio of 1:12 (8.33%)
conditions: for wheelchair accessibility
for any sloped pedestrian entry ramp
exceptions: existing buildings where compliance is technically infeasible and allowable per local code variance

subject: Ramp at Entry
rule: ramp at entry must have a minimum clear width of 36 inches (915 mm)
conditions: for wheelchair accessible path of travel

subject: Ramp at Entry
rule: ramp at entry must have handrails on both sides when rise exceeds 6 inches
conditions: when total vertical rise is greater than 6 inches (150 mm)
exceptions: curb ramps
existing conditions where grandfathering applies per local code

subject: Ramp at Entry
rule: ramp at entry must_not have a change in level or threshold exceeding 1/2 inch (13 mm)
conditions: at the transition between ramp and landing or doorway
exceptions: when beveled with a slope no steeper than 1:2

subject: Ramp at Entry
rule: ramp at entry must have landings at top and bottom that are at least as wide as the ramp and minimum 60 inches long
conditions: for any ramp with a rise greater than 6 inches

subject: Accessible Door Operator
rule: accessible door operator must have manual override mechanism for use during power failure
conditions: operator is electrically powered
door serves an accessible means of egress
exceptions: manually operated doors that do not rely on power

subject: Accessible Door Operator
rule: accessible door operator activation force must not exceed 5 lbf (22.2 N) to open
conditions: operator is used on a door serving an accessible route
exceptions: fire-rated doors where applicable code permits higher force for latching

subject: Accessible Door Operator
rule: accessible door operator closing speed must not exceed 7 seconds from 90 degrees to 12 degrees from the latch
conditions: operator is automatic-closing type

subject: Accessible Door Operator
rule: accessible door operator must be mounted at a height that does not obstruct clear wheelchair maneuvering space
conditions: operator includes wall-mounted controls or push plates

subject: Entry Stairs
rule: Entry stairs must have a minimum tread depth of at least 11 inches (280 mm) for means of egress
conditions: stairs serve as required means of egress
stairs are in a building subject to building code
exceptions: stairs within a single dwelling unit serving only that unit (some codes allow 10 inch treads)

subject: Entry Stairs
rule: Entry stairs must have a maximum riser height of no more than 7 inches (178 mm) for means of egress
conditions: stairs serve as required means of egress
stairs are in a building subject to building code
exceptions: stairs within a single dwelling unit serving only that unit (some codes allow 7.75 inch risers)

subject: Entry Stairs
rule: Entry stairs must have a minimum width of at least 36 inches (914 mm) clear for means of egress
conditions: stairs serve as required means of egress
occupant load served by stairs is within typical code thresholds
exceptions: stairs serving fewer than 10 occupants may have reduced width in some codes

subject: Entry Stairs
rule: Entry stairs must have handrails on at least one side if the total vertical rise exceeds 30 inches (762 mm)
conditions: total vertical rise of stair flight exceeds 30 inches
exceptions: stairs within a single dwelling unit serving only that unit may have different criteria

subject: Entry Stairs
rule: Entry stairs must have a coefficient of friction (slip resistance) adequate for wet or icy conditions
conditions: stairs are exterior entry stairs exposed to weather
exceptions: interior entry stairs not exposed to moisture

subject: Entry Stairs
rule: Entry stairs must not have open risers if the stair is required to serve children or if code prohibits them
conditions: stairs are in a building subject to modern building code
stairs serve more than a single dwelling unit
exceptions: stairs within a single dwelling unit are often permitted to have open risers if openings are sized to prevent passage of a 4-inch sphere

subject: Door Bell / Intercom / Keypad
rule: door bell / intercom / keypad must be electrically powered within its rated voltage range
conditions: device is wired (not purely mechanical or inductive)
exceptions: battery-powered wireless units are exempt from hardwired power requirement but still require battery power within specified voltage

subject: Door Bell / Intercom / Keypad
rule: door bell / intercom / keypad must be installed in a location protected from direct water ingress
conditions: device is rated for indoor use only (not IP-rated for exterior)
exceptions: weatherproof/weather-resistant units (e.g., IP54 or higher) rated for outdoor installation are exempt

subject: Door Bell / Intercom / Keypad
rule: door bell / intercom / keypad must not have its button/switch or touch surface obstructed by permanent building elements

subject: Entry Lighting
rule: entry lighting must be rated for wet or damp locations when installed in an exterior or semi-exposed entry condition
conditions: entry is exterior or semi-exposed to weather
exceptions: entry is fully enclosed conditioned interior space with no weather exposure

subject: Entry Lighting
rule: entry lighting must have a minimum clearance from combustible materials if it generates heat (e.g., incandescent or halogen sources)
conditions: luminaire uses incandescent, halogen, or other high-heat source
exceptions: LED luminaire with negligible surface temperature

subject: Entry Lighting
rule: entry lighting must not be installed in a location where its normal operation would be blocked by the swing of the entry door
conditions: entry has a swinging door

subject: Threshold Plate
rule: threshold plate must be located at the base of a door opening, at the transition between flooring surfaces
conditions: the building has a door opening

subject: Threshold Plate
rule: threshold plate must be installed level and flush with the adjacent finished floor surface on each side
exceptions: steps or ramps immediately adjacent where a sloped transition is intentional

subject: Threshold Plate
rule: threshold plate must not create a vertical step greater than 1/2 inch (13 mm) at an accessible doorway
conditions: the doorway is required to be accessible per building code
exceptions: existing construction where full compliance is technically infeasible and a variance is granted

subject: Handrail / Guardrail at Entry
rule: handrail/guardrail at entry must have a height between 34 and 38 inches (864–965 mm) measured vertically from the stair nosing or walking surface
conditions: serves a stairway
serves a ramp
serves a walking surface with drop-off
exceptions: when the handrail is on the stair side of a guardrail at the open side of a stair, the handrail height measured from the stair nosing may be between 34 and 38 inches and the guardrail height must be at least 36 inches

subject: Handrail / Guardrail at Entry
rule: handrail/guardrail at entry must have a cross-sectional diameter or width between 1.25 and 2 inches (32–51 mm) for circular profiles, or equivalent perimeter for non-circular profiles
conditions: designed as a graspable handrail
exceptions: handrails at stairs within dwelling units may have a minimum of 1 inch (25 mm) if Type I handrail is used per some code editions

subject: Handrail / Guardrail at Entry
rule: handrail/guardrail at entry must have a clearance of at least 1.5 inches (38 mm) between the handrail gripping surface and any adjacent wall or surface
conditions: installed along a wall

subject: Handrail / Guardrail at Entry
rule: handrail/guardrail at entry must resist a concentrated load of at least 200 pounds applied in any direction at any point

subject: Handrail / Guardrail at Entry
rule: handrail/guardrail at entry must have a guardrail height of at least 36 inches (42 inches in some jurisdictions) measured from the walking surface when the drop-off exceeds 30 inches
conditions: located at a drop-off greater than 30 inches
exceptions: IBC permits 36 inches for occupancies with less than 10 dwelling units; some residential codes permit 36 inches universally

subject: Handrail / Guardrail at Entry
rule: handrail/guardrail at entry must not have intermediate baluster or guard openings that permit passage of a 4-inch (100 mm) sphere
conditions: used as a guardrail (fall-protection barrier)
exceptions: openings at stair risers are measured from the tread nosing; triangular openings at the open side of stairs may use 4-inch sphere rule but some codes allow up to 6 inches for certain configurations

subject: Car Parking Space
rule: a car parking space must have a horizontal or gently sloped (≤5%) surface

subject: Car Parking Space
rule: a car parking space must have a minimum width of 2.4 m for standard parking (2.2 m in some compact jurisdictions)
exceptions: Compact-car-only spaces may reduce to 2.2 m where legally permitted

subject: Car Parking Space
rule: a car parking space must have a minimum length of 4.8 m

subject: Car Parking Space
rule: a car parking space must have a vertical clearance of at least 2.1 m (or local code minimum)
conditions: space is located within a structure (garage, parking deck, or under a building)

subject: Car Parking Space
rule: a car parking space must not have its access blocked by a fixed obstruction (wall, column, permanent equipment)

subject: Vehicle Restraint System
rule: Vehicle Restraint System must be capable of arresting a moving vehicle within the design stopping distance without exceeding allowable deceleration limits
conditions: When installed as a safety barrier
When subjected to an errant vehicle impact within its design speed and angle range

subject: Vehicle Restraint System
rule: Vehicle Restraint System must transfer impact loads to the ground or supporting structure without catastrophic failure of its own structural elements
conditions: During vehicle impact event

subject: Vehicle Restraint System
rule: Vehicle Restraint System must not contain rigid elements that could penetrate a vehicle passenger compartment under impact
conditions: When used in roadside or vehicle-intercept applications where occupant safety is required

subject: Vehicle Restraint System
rule: Vehicle Restraint System must maintain continuity — there must be no gaps in the restraint line exceeding the designed maximum spacing
conditions: When installed as a continuous barrier system along a roadway or hazard perimeter

subject: Parking Ventilation System
rule: Parking ventilation system must provide a minimum of 6 air changes per hour for enclosed parking garages
conditions: enclosed parking garage
occupied by vehicles
exceptions: naturally ventilated parking garages meeting opening area requirements

subject: Parking Ventilation System
rule: Parking ventilation system must maintain carbon monoxide concentration below 50 ppm averaged over 8 hours in occupied areas
conditions: enclosed parking garage

subject: Parking Ventilation System
rule: Parking ventilation exhaust must discharge at least 10 feet above grade and away from building air intakes
conditions: mechanical ventilation system
exceptions: exhaust discharged through a stack extending 3 feet above the roof

subject: Parking Ventilation System
rule: Parking ventilation system must not recirculate exhaust air back into the parking area or occupied spaces

subject: Parking Ventilation System
rule: Parking ventilation fan motors serving enclosed parking must be rated for the operating environment
conditions: enclosed parking garage

subject: Roller Door / Overhead Door
rule: roller door / overhead door must have a clear operational zone free of obstructions on both sides
conditions: door is manually operated
door is power-operated

subject: Roller Door / Overhead Door
rule: roller door / overhead door must not have its guide tracks or roll-up mechanism blocked by structural elements, piping, or ductwork

subject: Roller Door / Overhead Door
rule: roller door / overhead door must have a maximum width-to-height ratio that does not exceed the manufacturer's specified limit for the chosen door type
conditions: door width exceeds 6 meters

subject: Roller Door / Overhead Door
rule: roller door / overhead door must have headroom clearance above the opening equal to or greater than the manufacturer's specified minimum for the door type and size

subject: Pedestrian Walkway in Parking
rule: pedestrian walkway surface must be slip-resistant
conditions: walkway is exposed to weather
walkway is in a parking area where water/oil may accumulate

subject: Pedestrian Walkway in Parking
rule: pedestrian walkway must have a minimum clear width of 36 inches (914 mm)
conditions: walkway serves pedestrian access

subject: Pedestrian Walkway in Parking
rule: pedestrian walkway must have a maximum cross slope of 1:48 (2%)
conditions: walkway is part of an accessible route

subject: Pedestrian Walkway in Parking
rule: pedestrian walkway must not have a running slope exceeding 1:20 (5%) without a level landing
conditions: walkway is part of an accessible route
exceptions: walkway is designed as a ramp with handrails and meets ramp slope requirements up to 1:12

subject: Pedestrian Walkway in Parking
rule: pedestrian walkway must be protected from vehicular encroachment where adjacent to moving traffic
conditions: walkway is adjacent to vehicle travel lanes in the parking area
exceptions: vehicular separation is provided by curbs, bollards, barriers, or a minimum 2-foot buffer zone

subject: Parking Space Marking
rule: Parking space marking must have minimum width of 2.4 meters (standard parking space) to allow vehicle entry and exit
conditions: applies to standard angled or perpendicular parking spaces
exceptions: compact car spaces may be narrower if explicitly designated

subject: Parking Space Marking
rule: Parking space marking must be visible and have sufficient color contrast against the pavement surface
conditions: applies to all parking space markings in active use
exceptions: temporary closed/blocked spaces where markings are intentionally obscured

subject: Parking Space Marking
rule: Parking space marking must not be located within a minimum clearance zone required for fire truck access lanes
conditions: when fire lanes are defined per local fire code

subject: Car Park Drainage System
rule: car park drainage system must have a continuous gravity-driven outlet path to a lawful point of discharge

subject: Car Park Drainage System
rule: car park drainage system must not discharge directly into a combined sewer without prior written approval from the sewerage undertaker

subject: Car Park Drainage System
rule: car park drainage system must have a minimum fall of 1:80 on collection pipework serving gullies

subject: Car Park Drainage System
rule: car park drainage system must not have gullies located in vehicle running lanes where wheel loading would cause structural failure of the gully grating or frame

subject: Car Park Drainage System
rule: car park drainage system must include trapped gullies with a minimum seal depth of 50 mm when drainage connects to a foul or combined sewer
exceptions: where the car park is drained entirely to a separate surface water sewer and no cross-connection with foul drainage exists

subject: Plaza
rule: plaza ground surface must be structurally capable of supporting design live loads for pedestrian occupation and occasional vehicular access
conditions: plaza is accessible to pedestrians
plaza is designed for public use
exceptions: plaza is a green/landscaped roof with restricted access

subject: Plaza
rule: plaza ground surface must have positive drainage to prevent ponding water
conditions: plaza is exposed to precipitation
exceptions: plaza is an interior/atrium space with controlled environment

subject: Plaza
rule: plaza must not have tripping hazards at surface transitions exceeding allowable threshold
conditions: plaza is accessible to pedestrians

subject: Covered Walkway
rule: covered walkway roof must have a minimum slope to shed rainwater
conditions: located in region with measurable precipitation
exceptions: roof is designed as a green roof with controlled drainage
roof is a flat roof with internal drainage system

subject: Covered Walkway
rule: covered walkway must have a minimum overhead clearance of at least 2.1 m (7 ft)
conditions: intended for pedestrian use

subject: Covered Walkway
rule: covered walkway must not have unguarded edges where the walking surface is elevated more than 600 mm above adjacent ground
conditions: walking surface is elevated above grade
exceptions: edge is against an opaque wall that prevents passage

subject: Sky Garden
rule: sky garden must have a minimum floor-to-floor height to allow adequate vertical air circulation for plant respiration
conditions: enclosed space
contains living plant material

subject: Sky Garden
rule: sky garden must not block emergency egress paths with planting beds or tree canopies
conditions: located adjacent to or within means of egress
exceptions: if planting is entirely above head height (≥ 2.0 m clear) and does not reduce egress width

subject: Sky Garden
rule: sky garden must have a waterproof membrane below all soil and planting medium
conditions: located above habitable or occupiable space

subject: Sky Garden
rule: sky garden must have an overflow drainage system sized for the projected rainfall intensity
conditions: contains soil/planting medium deeper than 150 mm

subject: Sky Garden
rule: sky garden structural slab must be designed for saturated soil weight plus live load

subject: Arcade
rule: An arcade must have a continuous, unobstructed pedestrian path at ground level
conditions: arcade is part of a building fronting a public street
exceptions: arcade is entirely within a private interior mall

subject: Arcade
rule: The arcade must provide overhead weather protection (roof or upper-story projection) along its entire length

subject: Arcade
rule: The arcade's ceiling or roof must be at a height that allows safe pedestrian passage (minimum 2.4 m / 8 ft clear headroom)

subject: Arcade
rule: An arcade must not have blind-end dead ends longer than its width (must be through-passage or terminate in another public space)

subject: Lightwell
rule: lightwell must have bottom drainage or sump pump connection to remove accumulated water
conditions: lightwell is below grade
lightwell is exposed to precipitation
exceptions: lightwell is covered with a waterproof canopy
lightwell is designed as a planter with sealed waterproof membrane

subject: Lightwell
rule: lightwell must provide minimum clear opening dimensions for emergency egress from habitable basement rooms
conditions: lightwell serves a habitable basement room
building code applies
exceptions: the basement room has a separate direct exit to the exterior
the space is not classified as habitable under applicable code

subject: Lightwell
rule: lightwell must not allow falling hazard from adjacent grade if opening is at floor level
conditions: lightwell is open at grade level
lightwell is adjacent to a pedestrian area or door
exceptions: a guardrail, balustrade or fence at least 1070 mm high is provided
the drop is less than 600 mm

subject: Lightwell
rule: lightwell must not collect flammable vapours or allow pooling of combustible liquids
conditions: lightwell is located adjacent to a fuel storage area
lightwell is located adjacent to a mechanical area with oil/gas equipment
lightwell is below grade and connected to a garage or loading bay via a door or vent
exceptions: lightwell is sealed from the adjacent hazardous area by a fire-rated assembly with no openings
the lightwell has active vapour detection with automatic shutdown

subject: Courtyard Enclosure Walls
rule: courtyard enclosure walls must be vertical to enclose space
conditions: wall is intended to define courtyard boundary
exceptions: retaining walls or terraced conditions where engineered slope is intentional

subject: Courtyard Enclosure Walls
rule: courtyard enclosure walls must have a continuous load path to foundation
conditions: wall is load-bearing
exceptions: non-load-bearing infill walls framed between columns

subject: Courtyard Enclosure Walls
rule: courtyard enclosure walls must not exceed their unbraced height limit without lateral bracing
conditions: wall is masonry or concrete
wall height exceeds material-specific slenderness ratio
exceptions: walls designed with reinforced cores or pilasters that provide inherent lateral stability

subject: Courtyard Enclosure Walls
rule: courtyard enclosure walls must provide a means of drainage at base where wall meets grade
conditions: wall base is in contact with soil or planted area
wall is solid (not open screen)
exceptions: walls founded on waterproofed retaining wall systems with subsurface drainage designed into the foundation

subject: Courtyard Floor/Paving
rule: Courtyard floor/paving must be sloped to drain surface water away from building structures
conditions: Courtyard is open to rain
Courtyard is adjacent to occupied building walls
exceptions: Courtyard is entirely covered by a roof or canopy

subject: Courtyard Floor/Paving
rule: Courtyard floor/paving must have adequate structural sub-base to prevent differential settlement under expected loads
conditions: Courtyard is accessible to pedestrian or vehicular traffic
Soil conditions are expansive, compressible, or otherwise unstable
exceptions: Courtyard is a decorative planter bed with no traffic loading

subject: Courtyard Floor/Paving
rule: Courtyard floor/paving must not create a trip hazard at transitions
conditions: Paving abuts door thresholds, steps, or different paving materials
exceptions: Change in level is clearly marked by a ramp, contrasting color, or handrail per accessibility codes

subject: Courtyard Drainage System
rule: courtyard drainage system must have a positive outflow path (gradient or pumped) to an approved point of discharge
exceptions: closed-loop water features that recirculate and have overflow protection

subject: Courtyard Drainage System
rule: courtyard drainage system must not allow surface water to pond deeper than the specified maximum allowable depth for the occupancy zone
conditions: courtyard is accessible to people or vehicles
exceptions: deliberate stormwater detention features designed with safety measures and overflow routes

subject: Courtyard Drainage System
rule: courtyard drainage system must have inlets (e.g., drains, grates) at all local low points to prevent uncontrolled overflow into adjacent occupied spaces
conditions: courtyard is enclosed or bounded by walls/buildings with openings to habitable spaces

subject: Courtyard Drainage System
rule: courtyard drainage system must not have collection points lower than the downstream public stormwater connection invert without a pumping mechanism
conditions: system connects to a gravity-based municipal stormwater network
exceptions: systems with approved sump pumps and backup power

subject: Courtyard Planting Beds
rule: Courtyard planting beds must have drainage to prevent waterlogging and root rot
conditions: When used for soil-based planting
exceptions: Hydroponic or aquaponic systems that recirculate water and do not rely on soil drainage

subject: Courtyard Planting Beds
rule: Courtyard planting beds must not exceed the structural load capacity of the underlying slab or structure
conditions: When located above grade (e.g., on a podium, roof deck, or elevated courtyard)
exceptions: Planting beds placed directly on native soil at grade

subject: Courtyard Planting Beds
rule: Courtyard planting beds must have a waterproofing membrane beneath them when located above occupied spaces
conditions: When located above habitable or occupiable interior spaces
exceptions: Planting beds at grade on native soil with no space below

subject: Courtyard Irrigation System
rule: irrigation water must not come into direct contact with building foundation walls
conditions: courtyard is immediately adjacent to building
irrigation system uses spray or drip emitters near building perimeter

subject: Courtyard Irrigation System
rule: irrigation system must include a backflow prevention device on the supply line
conditions: system is connected to potable water supply
exceptions: system is supplied solely by harvested rainwater or greywater with no connection to potable mains

subject: Courtyard Irrigation System
rule: courtyard surface drainage must not be obstructed by irrigation components
conditions: courtyard has a designed surface drainage pattern (e.g., slopes, inlets, channels)
exceptions: irrigation components are fully recessed below finished grade and do not alter surface flow paths

subject: Courtyard Water Feature
rule: Courtyard water feature must have a contained waterproof basin or liner to prevent uncontrolled water leakage into the ground or building structure
conditions: If water is recirculated or retained within the feature
exceptions: Temporary or seasonal features that are drained when not in use

subject: Courtyard Water Feature
rule: Courtyard water feature must not be located directly above occupied interior spaces without a redundant waterproof membrane and leak detection system
conditions: When the courtyard is above grade (e.g., podium deck, rooftop plaza)

subject: Courtyard Water Feature
rule: Courtyard water feature must have an overflow drainage path that discharges to a rated drainage system, not to the courtyard surface or building envelope
conditions: If the feature includes a pump or recirculation system
If the feature can receive rainwater or splash water in excess of its designed volume
exceptions: Fully self-contained temporary features that are manually emptied before rain events

subject: Courtyard Canopy/Shade Structure
rule: shade structure must have structural connection to ground or adjacent building walls
conditions: when designed as a permanent installation
when not a freestanding portable canopy
exceptions: temporary or event-based canopies that are weighted rather than fixed

subject: Courtyard Canopy/Shade Structure
rule: shade structure must not pond water on canopy surface
conditions: when canopy/surface is solid or impermeable
exceptions: permeable mesh or fabric canopies designed to allow water passage

subject: Courtyard Canopy/Shade Structure
rule: shade structure must have minimum slope for drainage
conditions: when canopy surface is solid and impermeable
exceptions: canopies made entirely of permeable mesh or fabric

subject: Courtyard Canopy/Shade Structure
rule: shade structure materials must be rated for exterior/UV exposure
exceptions: structures used exclusively for temporary shade where duration does not exceed material weathering limits

subject: Courtyard Seating Elements
rule: Courtyard seating elements must be structurally stable under expected live loads (including occupants and normal environmental loads such as wind)
conditions: when installed in a publicly accessible courtyard
exceptions: temporary or decorative elements not intended for occupancy, where instability poses no safety risk

subject: Courtyard Seating Elements
rule: Courtyard seating elements must not have sharp edges, protruding fasteners, or pointed corners at contact surfaces that could cause injury to users
conditions: when located within user reach zones (typically within 1.2 m of seated or standing positions)
exceptions: elements intentionally designed with controlled sharp features for a specific function where equivalent safety is provided by alternative guarding measures

subject: Courtyard Seating Elements
rule: Courtyard seating elements must provide a stable, level seating surface that does not tip or rock when occupied under normal use
conditions: for any seating element designed for occupancy
exceptions: non-seating elements such as planters or sculptural forms that are not intended to be sat upon

subject: Courtyard Power and Data Outlets
rule: Courtyard power and data outlets must be weatherproof (minimum IP54 rated) when located outdoors in an uncovered courtyard area
conditions: Outlet is located in an uncovered outdoor courtyard area exposed to rain
Outlet is located in a semi-covered courtyard area subject to water splash or ingress
exceptions: Outlet is located in a fully enclosed, conditioned interior courtyard space classified as indoor

subject: Courtyard Power and Data Outlets
rule: Courtyard power and data outlets must be installed on a grounded electrical circuit with GFCI (Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter) protection
conditions: Outlet is within 6 feet of a water source
Outlet is in a wet or damp location
Outlet serves outdoor courtyard use
exceptions: Outlet is in a dry interior courtyard zone with no water sources within 6 feet and no moisture exposure — though almost all courtyard locations are subject to at least occasional moisture

subject: Courtyard Power and Data Outlets
rule: Courtyard power outlet voltage rating must match the supply voltage of the building's electrical system (e.g., 120V in North America, 230V in Europe)
conditions: Outlet is a standard power receptacle for general use
exceptions: Outlet is a specialized low-voltage or data-only outlet (e.g., USB charging, telecom) with its own transformer/power supply

subject: Courtyard Power and Data Outlets
rule: Courtyard data outlets must not be installed where standing water or flooding can occur at the outlet height level
conditions: Courtyard area is known to have poor drainage or flood risk
Outlet is at or near ground level in a landscape depression
exceptions: Outlet is elevated minimum 12 inches above the finished floor/grade per code and drainage is proven adequate

subject: Courtyard Access Doors/Gates
rule: courtyard access doors/gates must swing outward (away from the courtyard) or be sliding gates
conditions: door/gate serves as an egress path from the courtyard
courtyard is enclosed on all sides
exceptions: when inward swing is specifically approved by fire code authority with proven clear path and occupant load below threshold

subject: Courtyard Access Doors/Gates
rule: courtyard access doors/gates must not reduce the required egress width of the path of travel
conditions: door/gate is part of a means of egress from the courtyard

subject: Courtyard Access Doors/Gates
rule: courtyard access gates that are locked must be readily openable from the egress side without keys, tools, or special knowledge
conditions: gate is lockable
gate is on a means of egress path
exceptions: gates serving secured areas where delayed egress locks are permitted by code

subject: Courtyard Access Doors/Gates
rule: courtyard access doors/gates must have a minimum clear opening width of 32 inches (813 mm) when serving an accessible route
conditions: door/gate is on an accessible route into or out of the courtyard
exceptions: existing buildings where alterations are limited by structural constraints, to the maximum feasible extent

subject: Stepped Roof Plane
rule: Each stepped roof plane must have a continuous drainage path that directs water to a gutter, downspout, or drainage layer without ponding.
conditions: Roof plane is exposed to precipitation
exceptions: Roof plane serves as a green/vegetated roof with engineered drainage and waterproofing membrane designed for controlled water retention

subject: Stepped Roof Plane
rule: Stepped roof planes must not create an inverted step geometry where a lower plane sheds water onto a higher plane's wall or roof surface.
conditions: Multiple stepped roof planes exist at different elevations
exceptions: A designed waterproof counter-flashing or kick-out flashing system is installed at the intersection to redirect water away from the higher plane

subject: Courtyard Interior Partition Walls (if enclosed)
rule: Interior partition walls enclosing a courtyard must provide a structural connection from the courtyard floor to the roof or upper structure to resist lateral wind loads on the wall panel
conditions: Courtyard is enclosed on at least three sides by building mass
Partition walls are full-height from ground to roof
exceptions: Walls are designed as non-structural infill within a structural frame that independently resists lateral loads

subject: Courtyard Interior Partition Walls (if enclosed)
rule: Interior partition walls enclosing a courtyard must not be constructed of a single material that has no fire-resistance rating when they serve as a fire barrier between the courtyard and occupied spaces
conditions: Building code requires fire separation between the courtyard and adjacent habitable rooms
Courtyard is a lightwell or atrium that connects multiple floors
exceptions: A fire suppression system (e.g., sprinklers) is provided throughout the connected spaces and code allows trade-off

subject: Courtyard Interior Partition Walls (if enclosed)
rule: Interior partition walls enclosing a courtyard must have a continuous vapor barrier on the warm side of the wall assembly to prevent interstitial condensation
conditions: Courtyard is unconditioned or semi-conditioned (e.g., open to the sky or ventilated)
Adjacent interior spaces are conditioned (heated/cooled)
exceptions: The entire courtyard is fully conditioned to the same temperature and humidity as the adjacent spaces
A hygrothermal analysis demonstrates that no condensation risk exists without a vapor barrier

subject: Step Vertical Risers
rule: step vertical risers must have consistent individual riser heights within a flight (within 3/16 inch / 4.8 mm tolerance between the tallest and shortest riser)
conditions: step vertical risers are part of the same stair flight

subject: Step Vertical Risers
rule: step vertical risers must have riser height between 4 inches (100 mm) and 7 inches (180 mm) for occupiable building stairs
conditions: stair is in an occupiable building
stair is not a service or utility ladder
exceptions: monumental or grand stairs in assembly occupancies may have reduced constraints under alternative code compliance

subject: Step Vertical Risers
rule: step vertical risers must not be open (without a solid vertical face) unless the stair is designed for specific non-standard applications
conditions: stair is used for general egress or primary circulation
exceptions: exterior deck stairs in some residential contexts
fire-escape stairs where code explicitly allows open risers

subject: Step Vertical Risers
rule: step vertical risers on the same flight must not vary in slope from the nosing line angle
conditions: risers are part of the same straight-run flight

subject: Roof Step Structure
rule: Each step in a roof step structure must have a minimum slope of 1:12 (approx. 4.8 degrees) to ensure positive drainage
conditions: Roof step structure is exposed to rain or moisture
Roof step structure is not designed as a water-retaining feature
exceptions: Roof step structure is located in an interior/conditioned space with no moisture exposure
Roof step structure is explicitly designed as a green roof with engineered drainage layers

subject: Roof Step Structure
rule: Waterproof membrane continuity must be maintained across all step transitions and vertical risers
conditions: Roof step structure separates interior space from exterior environment

subject: Roof Step Structure
rule: Roof step structure must not have horizontal flat surfaces (zero slope) on any step tread that is exposed to precipitation
conditions: Roof step structure is exposed to outdoor weather conditions
Roof step structure is not a designated terrace or occupied deck with secondary drainage
exceptions: Step tread is designed as a green roof with engineered drainage, filter, and water retention layers

subject: Roof Step Structure
rule: Each step level must have an overflow/scupper path sized for the tributary drainage area of that step
conditions: Roof step structure has more than one step level
Step is bounded by parapets or curbs that could trap water

subject: Cascade Water Diversion System
rule: Cascade Water Diversion System must maintain a continuous positive slope in the direction of flow
conditions: system is installed
system is conveying water under gravity flow
exceptions: system uses pumped or pressurized flow

subject: Cascade Water Diversion System
rule: Cascade Water Diversion System must not have any flow-path cross-section reduced below the minimum design capacity at any point
conditions: system is in operation

subject: Cascade Water Diversion System
rule: Cascade Water Diversion System must have all conveyance elements hydraulically sealed against leakage at joints and connections
conditions: system is designed to convey water without loss to surrounding environment
exceptions: system is designed for intentional infiltration or exfiltration (e.g., leaky weir or spreader system)

subject: Stepped Roof Decking
rule: stepped roof decking must maintain minimum step overlap for water shedding
conditions: when used as primary roof covering
exceptions: when designed with complete sealed membrane system

subject: Stepped Roof Decking
rule: stepped roof decking must have continuous drainage slope on each step surface
conditions: when exposed to precipitation
exceptions: when installed under a continuous weatherproof membrane

subject: Stepped Roof Decking
rule: stepped roof decking must not have concealed cavities that trap moisture without ventilation
conditions: when constructed with closed-step geometry

subject: Roof Step Flashing
rule: Roof step flashing must be installed so that each piece overlaps the piece below it (shingle-lap orientation)
conditions: When installed on a sloped roof where flashing steps up along the roof slope
exceptions: On roofs with no slope or drainage direction where step flashing is not used

subject: Roof Step Flashing
rule: Roof step flashing must extend up the sidewall a minimum of 4 inches (100 mm) above the roof surface
conditions: When roof step flashing is used at a sidewall-to-roof intersection
exceptions: When a manufacturer's specification explicitly allows a different dimension that still prevents water ingress

subject: Roof Step Flashing
rule: Roof step flashing must not be installed without being interleaved with the adjacent roofing material (e.g., shingles or tiles)
conditions: When step flashing is used in a roof assembly with discrete roofing units such as asphalt shingles, wood shakes, or tiles
exceptions: On continuous roofing systems (e.g., metal standing seam) where a different flashing type is used instead of step flashing

subject: Roof Step Flashing
rule: Roof step flashing must be corrosion-resistant (e.g., galvanized steel, copper, or aluminum) and compatible with adjacent materials to prevent galvanic corrosion
conditions: When installed in an exterior (weather-exposed) environment
exceptions: In temporary/construction-phase applications where the flashing will be replaced before exposure to moisture

subject: Cascade Roof Drainage Scupper
rule: Cascade roof drainage scupper must have its inlet opening at or below the lowest point of the roof catchment area's overflow weir elevation
conditions: The scupper is installed as a primary drainage device
The catchment area has a defined overflow weir
exceptions: When the scupper serves only as a secondary/emergency overflow and another primary drain handles the low-point flow

subject: Cascade Roof Drainage Scupper
rule: Cascade roof drainage scupper must not have its outlet discharge directed against an exterior wall, window, or occupied area without a splash block or diverter
conditions: The scupper discharges directly above a façade, pedestrian walkway, or building entrance
exceptions: When the discharge point is over a non-accessible green roof or a designated drainage channel that contains the flow

subject: Cascade Roof Drainage Scupper
rule: Cascade roof drainage scupper must maintain a minimum cross-sectional area (width × height) that matches or exceeds the computed design flow rate divided by the maximum allowable head
conditions: The scupper is sized using the rational method or equivalent hydraulic calculation

subject: Cascade Roof Drainage Scupper
rule: Cascade roof drainage scupper must have a continuous, unobstructed flow path from inlet to outlet (no intermediate traps, reverse slopes, or horizontal dead legs longer than the scupper's own depth)
conditions: The scupper penetrates a parapet wall or curb
exceptions: When a dedicated leader/pipe with cleanout is installed immediately downstream of the scupper outlet

subject: Cascading Roof Overhang
rule: cascading roof overhang must maintain a continuous downward drainage path from each successive roof level to prevent ponding and water ingress
conditions: when assembled as part of a weather-enclosing building envelope
exceptions: when designed as a purely sculptural or non-weatherproof element with a separate drainage system behind it

subject: Tiered Roof Insulation Layer
rule: tiered roof insulation layer must maintain a minimum thickness to prevent thermal bridging at step transitions
conditions: when insulation is applied in stepped or tiered layers
when insulation spans structural transitions
exceptions: when a continuous thermal break material is used at all tier transitions

subject: Tiered Roof Insulation Layer
rule: tiered roof insulation layer must not create an unvented air gap that traps moisture between tiers
conditions: when the tiers create enclosed cavities or horizontal ledges
when a vapor-permeable membrane is not used between tiers
exceptions: when each tier cavity is actively ventilated to the exterior
when the entire assembly is designed as a sealed warm roof with no vapor drive into the cavity

subject: Tiered Roof Insulation Layer
rule: tiered roof insulation layer must have a continuous drainage path across all tier transitions
conditions: when the roof is not designed as a zero-slope (dead-level) assembly
exceptions: when each tier is independently drained to a separate outlet
when the insulation is fully encapsulated in a waterproof membrane that directs water to a single plane drain

subject: Roof Deck / Substrate
rule: roof deck/substrate must support the design live load and dead load without structural failure
conditions: when occupied or used as accessible space
when supporting roof-top equipment or landscaping

subject: Roof Deck / Substrate
rule: roof deck/substrate must provide a positive slope (minimum 1/4 inch per foot for membrane roofs, 1/8 inch per foot for metal panel roofs) to ensure water drainage
conditions: for low-slope roof assemblies with weatherproof membrane
exceptions: roofs designed as 'dead-flat' with internal drainage and secondary overflow systems specially engineered

subject: Roof Deck / Substrate
rule: roof deck/substrate must be continuous and have sufficient rigidity to prevent excessive deflection under load
conditions: when supporting a brittle or adhered roof covering (e.g., tile, built-up roofing, single-ply membrane)

subject: Roof Deck / Substrate
rule: roof deck/substrate must be made of a material that is compatible with the roof covering system to prevent chemical or galvanic reactions
conditions: when using metal roof decks with dissimilar metal roof coverings or when using certain insulation adhesives directly on the deck
exceptions: when a suitable separation layer or barrier is installed

subject: Roof Deck / Substrate
rule: roof deck/substrate must not contain or emit substances that degrade the roof covering material (e.g., outgassing from certain insulations applied directly to the underside)
conditions: when closed-cell polyurethane foam or similar materials are applied to the underside of the deck
exceptions: when a vapor retarder or barrier coating is applied to isolate the deck from the covering

subject: Roof Covering / Finish
rule: roof covering/finish must be waterproof to prevent water ingress into the building
conditions: building is enclosed
roof is exposed to precipitation
exceptions: fully interior roof coverings not exposed to weather

subject: Roof Covering / Finish
rule: roof covering/finish must be secured against wind uplift forces
conditions: roof is located in a region subject to wind loads
roof slope is less than or equal to the critical angle for aerodynamic uplift
exceptions: roof covering that is only ballasted and not mechanically fastened may be acceptable if ballast weight exceeds uplift forces per code

subject: Roof Covering / Finish
rule: roof covering/finish must be compatible with the roof substrate and not cause chemical or galvanic degradation
conditions: roof covering is metal or contains metal components
substrate is a dissimilar metal or reactive material
exceptions: a separation layer or barrier is provided between incompatible materials

subject: Roof Covering / Finish
rule: roof covering/finish must not trap moisture against the roof deck
conditions: roof deck is made of moisture-sensitive material (e.g., wood, steel)
roof assembly is not designed as a vented or drainage system
exceptions: a vapor-permeable underlayment or drainage mat is provided

subject: Roof Edge / Fascia
rule: roof edge / fascia must be watertight to prevent moisture ingress into roof assembly
conditions: when used as part of the building envelope
exceptions: decorative fascia not part of the weatherproofing system

subject: Roof Edge / Fascia
rule: roof edge / fascia must be securely fastened to withstand design wind uplift loads
conditions: for all roof edge / fascia installations

subject: Roof Edge / Fascia
rule: fascia must not create a dam that blocks water flow from roof to gutter
conditions: when fascia is installed above a gutter system
exceptions: fascia designs with integrated drainage gaps or weep slots

subject: Roof Penetration Flashing
rule: roof penetration flashing must create a watertight seal around the penetrating element
conditions: the roof penetration passes through the roof membrane

subject: Roof Penetration Flashing
rule: roof penetration flashing must be lapped shingle-fashion (overlapped) to shed water downward
conditions: flashing consists of multiple pieces or layers
exceptions: factory-fabricated single-piece flashing boots that are seamless and monolithic

subject: Roof Penetration Flashing
rule: roof penetration flashing must not be installed under tension or stress that would prevent thermal movement
conditions: the roof is exposed to diurnal or seasonal temperature cycles

subject: Roof Overhang / Eaves
rule: roof overhang / eaves must provide a minimum clearance to allow for safe pedestrian passage and prevent debris accumulation
conditions: when eave height is less than 2.4 m above grade
when the overhang is located over a walkway or occupied exterior area
exceptions: if the area below is intentionally inaccessible (e.g., fenced off or designed as a planter bed)

subject: Roof Overhang / Eaves
rule: roof overhang / eaves must not have a flat top surface that allows standing water
conditions: when the eave or overhang is exposed to precipitation

subject: Roof Overhang / Eaves
rule: roof overhang / eaves must be designed with a continuous drainage path that prevents water from penetrating the wall-roof junction
conditions: when the roof is sloped and has an eave overhang

subject: Roof Overhang / Eaves
rule: roof overhang / eaves must not extend beyond the property boundary or into an adjacent airspace with no legal easement
conditions: when the building is on a site with defined property lines
exceptions: if a valid easement or setback variance has been granted

subject: Roof Truss / Rafter System
rule: roof truss/rafter system must have a minimum pitch to enable drainage
conditions: system is exposed to precipitation
exceptions: system is covered by a separate weatherproof membrane that provides drainage independently

subject: Roof Truss / Rafter System
rule: roof truss/rafter system must not have unbraced compression members exceeding slenderness limits
conditions: members are designed as load-bearing compression elements

subject: Roof Truss / Rafter System
rule: roof truss/rafter system must have connections capable of transferring all design forces between members

subject: Roof Truss / Rafter System
rule: roof truss/rafter system must not be installed with wood moisture content exceeding threshold for the intended service environment
conditions: system uses timber as primary material

subject: Snow Guard / Snow Rail
rule: Snow guard / snow rail must be installed above all roof penetrations, chimneys, and skylights on the same roof slope
conditions: The roof has penetrations, chimneys, or skylights below the installation zone
exceptions: Roof has no penetrations, chimneys, or skylights on that slope

subject: Snow Guard / Snow Rail
rule: Snow guard / snow rail must be anchored to structural roof framing, not only to roof sheathing or finish layer
conditions: Snow guard is intended to retain a design snow load that exceeds the pull-through capacity of the sheathing
exceptions: Installation on a structural metal roof panel where the panel itself is designed to transfer concentrated loads to the structure

subject: Snow Guard / Snow Rail
rule: Snow guard / snow rail must not be installed such that it dams water or traps debris against the roof covering
exceptions: System is specifically designed as a drainage-compatible snow retention system with built-in weep paths

subject: Roof Access / Hatch
rule: roof access hatch must have a means of being secured against unauthorized entry
conditions: when hatch provides access from exterior or public area to occupied building interior
exceptions: buildings where security is not required (e.g., uninhabited storage structures)

subject: Roof Access / Hatch
rule: roof access hatch must not open onto a drop-off without a guard or landing
conditions: when hatch opens outward or upward and the area directly below the opening is occupied space or a circulation path
exceptions: hatches serving exclusively as emergency escape openings with compliant fall protection systems

subject: Roof Access / Hatch
rule: roof access hatch must be operable from both sides
conditions: when hatch is used as an emergency egress point
exceptions: hatches that serve only as maintenance access and are not part of the means of egress

subject: Roof Access / Hatch
rule: roof access hatch must have weatherstripping or gasketing to prevent water infiltration
conditions: when hatch is installed in a roof assembly exposed to precipitation
exceptions: hatches in covered or unconditioned structures where water ingress does not damage interior

subject: Roof Access / Hatch
rule: roof access hatch curb must be elevated above the roof surface
conditions: when hatch is installed on a low-slope or flat roof
exceptions: hatches integrated into parapet wall assemblies where drainage is routed differently

subject: Roof-mounted Equipment Support
rule: Roof-mounted equipment support must be anchored to a structural element capable of bearing the equipment's dead load, live load, and wind uplift forces
conditions: equipment is attached to roof
exceptions: equipment is freestanding on grade, not roof-mounted

subject: Roof-mounted Equipment Support
rule: Roof-mounted equipment support must not penetrate the roof membrane unless penetrations are sealed with an approved waterproof flashing system
conditions: equipment requires through-roof attachment or conduit/pipe penetration
exceptions: equipment is entirely ballasted with no roof penetrations

subject: Roof-mounted Equipment Support
rule: Roof-mounted equipment support structure must not obstruct required roof drainage paths or create ponding zones
conditions: equipment is placed on a flat or low-slope roof

subject: Roof-mounted Equipment Support
rule: Roof-mounted equipment support must maintain minimum clearances from roof edges and parapets as specified by applicable building code for wind resistance and fall protection

subject: Green / Vegetated Roof Assembly
rule: Green/vegetated roof assembly must have a waterproof membrane layer separating the growing medium from the roof structure
conditions: All green roof types (extensive, intensive, semi-intensive)
exceptions: Prefabricated modular tray systems that include integral waterproofing certified to meet local code

subject: Green / Vegetated Roof Assembly
rule: Green/vegetated roof assembly must have a root barrier layer to protect the waterproof membrane and roof structure from root penetration
conditions: Systems where vegetation includes woody plants, aggressive root species, or is designed for long-term (>5 year) installation
exceptions: Extensive green roofs with only shallow-rooted sedum/moss species where the waterproof membrane is root-resistant by specification

subject: Green / Vegetated Roof Assembly
rule: Green/vegetated roof assembly must have a drainage layer (or equivalent system) capable of removing excess water from the growing medium
conditions: All green roof assemblies
exceptions: Green roof systems designed as water-retention/temporary storage systems where controlled saturation is intentional and structural design accounts for full saturated load

subject: Green / Vegetated Roof Assembly
rule: Green/vegetated roof assembly must not have the growing medium depth exceed the structural load capacity of the supporting roof deck and building structure
conditions: All green roof installations on existing or new structures

subject: Green / Vegetated Roof Assembly
rule: Green/vegetated roof assembly must be installed on a roof slope that does not exceed the slip/crosion stability angle of the growing medium system
conditions: Roof slopes greater than 2:12 (approx. 9.5 degrees)
exceptions: Systems specifically engineered with soil stabilization grids, erosion mats, or mechanical retention devices verified by a structural engineer for the specific slope

subject: Roof Flashing / Counter-flashing
rule: Roof flashing/counter-flashing must be installed with a minimum overlap of 100 mm (4 inches) between flashing sections and at all lap joints
conditions: Where flashing sections join to form a continuous waterproof barrier
exceptions: Factory-fabricated continuously welded/sealed pan or single-piece flashings

subject: Roof Flashing / Counter-flashing
rule: Roof flashing/counter-flashing must not be installed with upward-facing horizontal ledges or flat surfaces that can retain standing water
conditions: At any exposed horizontal or near-horizontal surface of the flashing assembly
exceptions: Surfaces designed with integral positive slope (minimum 1:6) that shed water

subject: Roof Flashing / Counter-flashing
rule: Counter-flashing must be reglet (recessed) or surface-mounted with the top edge sealed and the bottom edge extending minimum 100 mm (4 inches) down over the base flashing
conditions: Where counter-flashing terminates against a vertical wall or parapet
exceptions: Through-wall flashing systems where the counter-flashing is integral to the masonry course

subject: Roof Flashing / Counter-flashing
rule: Roof flashing must be made of material compatible with all adjacent roofing, wall, and sealant materials to prevent galvanic corrosion or chemical degradation
conditions: Where dissimilar metals contact each other or where flashing contacts chemically active roofing materials or sealants
exceptions: Materials separated by an approved dielectric barrier or inert isolation layer

subject: Roof Garden Drainage Layer
rule: Roof garden drainage layer must have a minimum slope of at least 1-2% towards outlet points
conditions: flat roof construction
gravity drainage system
exceptions: tapered insulation or drainage boards that achieve equivalent drainage performance
active pumping/siphonic drainage system

subject: Roof Garden Drainage Layer
rule: Drainage layer must maintain continuous flow path free from blockage by root penetration, soil migration, or debris

subject: Roof Garden Drainage Layer
rule: Drainage layer material must not decompose, dissolve, or compact to less than 50% of design thickness under loaded conditions

subject: Roof Garden Drainage Layer
rule: Drainage layer must not create a capillary break that prevents water from reaching the outlet
conditions: system relies on gravity drainage through coarse aggregate or geocomposite drain
exceptions: capillary drainage systems specifically designed to wick water laterally

subject: Roof Garden Waterproof Membrane
rule: Roof garden waterproof membrane must be continuous and fully sealed at all joints and penetrations
conditions: membrane is used as primary waterproofing layer

subject: Roof Garden Waterproof Membrane
rule: Roof garden waterproof membrane must be root-penetration resistant
conditions: membrane is installed beneath planted soil/growing medium
exceptions: membrane is only beneath hardscape/paver areas with no root contact

subject: Roof Garden Waterproof Membrane
rule: Roof garden waterproof membrane must not be directly exposed to ultraviolet radiation for extended periods
conditions: membrane is not rated UV-stable for prolonged exposure
