exceptions: membrane material is specifically formulated for continuous UV exposure

subject: Roof Garden Waterproof Membrane
rule: Roof garden waterproof membrane must be installed over a stable, smooth, and debris-free substrate

subject: Roof Garden Waterproof Membrane
rule: Roof garden waterproof membrane must be protected from mechanical damage during subsequent construction layers
conditions: membrane is covered by subsequent drainage/filter/soil layers

subject: Roof Garden Growing Medium
rule: Roof garden growing medium must have a maximum dry density not exceeding the structural load capacity of the roof
conditions: Roof has structural load limits specified
exceptions: Roof structure is specifically designed for the growing medium density

subject: Roof Garden Growing Medium
rule: Roof garden growing medium must not contain particles small enough to wash into and clog the roof drainage system
conditions: Roof has a drainage system with filter fabric or drainage layer
exceptions: Drainage system includes an adequately designed filtration barrier that prevents clogging

subject: Roof Garden Growing Medium
rule: Roof garden growing medium must have a saturated hydraulic conductivity sufficient to prevent prolonged ponding on the roof membrane
conditions: Roof membrane is not designed for prolonged water contact
exceptions: Roof membrane is specifically designed and rated for permanent ponding conditions

subject: Roof Garden Growing Medium
rule: Roof garden growing medium must not contain organic matter that will decompose to less than 20% of its original volume
conditions: Growing medium is used in an extensive green roof system with shallow depth
exceptions: Intensive green roof with sufficient depth to accommodate volume loss without compromising drainage or plant anchorage

subject: Roof Garden Planting
rule: Roof garden planting must have a drainage layer (e.g., drainage board, gravel, or drainage mat) to prevent waterlogging and structural overloading
conditions: Any roof garden with planted vegetation above a waterproofed roof deck
exceptions: Roof gardens where the entire planting is in freestanding containers with drip trays that drain to an approved collection system separate from the roof structure

subject: Roof Garden Planting
rule: Roof garden planting must_not block or obstruct existing roof drainage outlets (scuppers, roof drains, gutters, or overflow drains)
conditions: Any roof garden installed on a roof that has pre-existing drainage infrastructure
exceptions: When drainage outlets are intentionally relocated or extended as part of the roof garden design and approved by a structural engineer

subject: Roof Garden Planting
rule: Roof garden planting must use a root-resistant waterproofing membrane or root barrier system to protect the roof structure
conditions: Any roof garden where plant roots can contact the roof waterproofing layer
exceptions: Roof garden areas where plants are fully contained in raised planters with an impermeable base separated from the roof membrane by a continuous air gap

subject: Roof Garden Insulation Layer
rule: Roof garden insulation layer must have a sufficient compressive strength to support the overlying green roof system loads (soil, plants, water, live loads) without excessive deformation
conditions: Green roof with accessible vegetation
Load-bearing roof garden assembly

subject: Roof Garden Insulation Layer
rule: Roof garden insulation layer must not degrade when in contact with moisture, soil chemicals, or plant roots
conditions: In direct contact with growing medium or drainage layer

subject: Roof Garden Insulation Layer
rule: Roof garden insulation layer must be placed above the waterproofing membrane
conditions: Inverted (protected membrane) roof assembly
exceptions: In conventional (warm roof) assembly where insulation is below waterproofing

subject: Roof Garden Insulation Layer
rule: Roof garden insulation layer must have a continuous, unbroken surface to prevent thermal bridging
exceptions: Joints sealed with compatible tape or sealant are acceptable

subject: Roof Garden Insulation Layer
rule: Roof garden insulation layer must be non-combustible or have an approved fire rating for roof garden applications
conditions: Building with fire-resistance-rated construction
Multi-story building
exceptions: Where local code explicitly allows combustible insulation with thermal barrier protection

subject: Roof Garden Root Barrier
rule: Roof garden root barrier must be continuous across the entire roof surface to prevent root penetration into the waterproofing membrane
conditions: when installed as part of a green roof assembly
when waterproofing membrane is present beneath

subject: Roof Garden Root Barrier
rule: Roof garden root barrier must be resistant to biological degradation by plant roots and soil microorganisms
conditions: when buried in growing medium

subject: Roof Garden Root Barrier
rule: Roof garden root barrier must not be installed upside down or with the wrong face oriented toward the waterproofing membrane
conditions: when the barrier has a directional/ asymmetric construction (e.g., bonded sheets with different top and bottom layers)

subject: Intensive Roof Garden
rule: roof must have a drainage path
conditions: intensive roof garden with soil depth sufficient to retain water
roof is horizontal or pitched
exceptions: roof is designed as a contained wetland/bioretention system with controlled outflow

subject: Intensive Roof Garden
rule: waterproof membrane must be installed beneath the growing medium
conditions: intensive roof garden on any building roof deck

subject: Intensive Roof Garden
rule: root barrier must be present above the waterproofing layer
conditions: intensive roof garden with woody plants, trees, or deep-rooted vegetation
exceptions: only sedum/moss ground cover with fibrous shallow roots is used

subject: Intensive Roof Garden
rule: the structural roof deck must have a load capacity equal to or greater than the saturated weight of the intensive roof garden assembly
conditions: intensive roof garden

subject: Intensive Roof Garden
rule: irrigation system must not leak below the waterproofing layer
conditions: intensive roof garden with any installed irrigation

subject: Extensive Roof Garden
rule: Extensive roof garden must have a waterproof membrane system underneath the growing medium

subject: Extensive Roof Garden
rule: Extensive roof garden growing medium depth must not exceed the structural load capacity of the underlying roof deck

subject: Extensive Roof Garden
rule: Extensive roof garden must have a drainage layer beneath the growing medium

subject: Extensive Roof Garden
rule: Extensive roof garden must have an appropriate roof slope or positive drainage system to prevent standing water

subject: Extensive Roof Garden
rule: Extensive roof garden must be accessible for periodic maintenance

subject: Roof Garden Edge Restraint / Curb
rule: Roof garden edge restraint/curb must have a minimum height sufficient to prevent soil and drainage media from washing or blowing over the edge
conditions: when the roof garden is designed with growing medium loose above the finished roof surface

subject: Roof Garden Edge Restraint / Curb
rule: Roof garden edge restraint/curb must not create a dam that prevents water from draining off the roof
conditions: when the roof garden has any roof drainage system
exceptions: when the curb incorporates integrated drainage weeps, scuppers, or drains that are designed to pass water through the curb

subject: Roof Garden Edge Restraint / Curb
rule: Roof garden edge restraint/curb must be physically continuous around the perimeter of the garden area with no gaps large enough for soil or water to bypass
conditions: when the edge curb defines the boundary of the planted roof area

subject: Roof Garden Edge Restraint / Curb
rule: Roof garden edge restraint/curb must be anchored or ballasted to resist horizontal displacement from saturated soil pressure
conditions: when the curb is not part of a monolithic parapet structure and is a separate installed element

subject: Roof Garden Irrigation System
rule: irrigation piping must not penetrate the roof waterproofing membrane
conditions: roof garden has a waterproofing membrane
exceptions: penetrations are sealed with approved waterproof boot or flange

subject: Roof Garden Irrigation System
rule: irrigation system must have an automatic backflow prevention device
conditions: system is connected to the potable water supply
exceptions: system is supplied by a dedicated non-potable rainwater harvesting tank with no cross-connection

subject: Roof Garden Irrigation System
rule: irrigation system must be designed to withstand the design wind speed for the roof elevation
conditions: system includes above-ground components such as sprinkler heads, drip lines, or exposed piping
exceptions: all irrigation components are recessed or subsurface and fully protected from wind exposure

subject: Roof Garden Irrigation System
rule: irrigation system must not impose live load exceeding the roof's structural load capacity
conditions: system includes water-filled piping, storage tanks, or heavy components on the roof
exceptions: structural engineer has verified and approved that the roof can support the additional load

subject: Roof Garden Pedestal System
rule: the pedestal system must transfer imposed loads (dead, live, wind, snow, thermal) directly to the structural roof deck without overstressing the roof membrane or insulation
conditions: any roof garden pedestal system supporting paving, planters, or occupiable surfaces
exceptions: loads that are carried by a separate structural frame independent of the pedestal system

subject: Roof Garden Pedestal System
rule: the pedestal system base must create an air gap of at least 25 mm between the roof membrane and the underside of any pedestal-supported surface to allow drainage and ventilation
conditions: when installed over a conventional roof membrane
exceptions: systems specifically designed for zero-clearance (e.g., green-roof-inverted assemblies where drainage is handled by a separate layer)

subject: Roof Garden Pedestal System
rule: the pedestal system must not impede water flow to roof drains or scuppers
conditions: when roof drains are present within or adjacent to the pedestal field
exceptions: where pedestals are arranged around a dedicated drainage mat or channel that routes water directly to drains

subject: Roof Garden Pedestal System
rule: each pedestal must be positively fixed or weighted to resist lateral sliding under wind uplift or seismic loads
conditions: in locations where design wind speed exceeds 130 km/h or in seismic design categories D, E, or F
exceptions: systems where the paving units are mechanically clamped together into a monolithic surface that resists sliding as an assembly, and the pedestals are only gravity-bearing

subject: Roof Garden Paver / Deck Surface
rule: Paver/deck surface on a roof must have a minimum slope (e.g., ≥ 1/4 inch per foot or as per applicable code) to ensure positive drainage away from the building structure
conditions: Surface is installed over a habitable or occupiable roof space
Surface is not designed as a 'green roof' detention system
exceptions: Roof is designed as a fully detained, engineered water-retention system (e.g., blue roof) with structural over-flow paths

subject: Roof Garden Paver / Deck Surface
rule: Paver/deck surface must be fire-rated or non-combustible (Class A or equivalent) when installed on a roof of a building with a required fire-resistance rating
conditions: Building is of Type I, II, III, or IV construction (or as required by local code)
Roof is within the fire-resistance-rated envelope
exceptions: Building is unreinforced and has no fire-resistance-rating requirement for the roof covering (e.g., certain detached single-family dwellings under specific codes)

subject: Roof Garden Paver / Deck Surface
rule: Paver/deck surface must not trap moisture between the paver and the roof membrane
conditions: Surface is installed directly over a waterproofing membrane
Surface is not a fully bonded adhered system
exceptions: System is specifically designed as a protected-membrane roof (inverted roof) with drainage-compatible insulation and where moisture is intentionally above the membrane

subject: Roof Garden Paver / Deck Surface
rule: Paver/deck surface must be installed over a slip-sheet or separation layer when placed directly over a waterproof membrane to prevent membrane puncture
conditions: Pavers are loose-laid or pedestal-mounted on a flexible single-ply membrane (e.g., TPO, PVC, EPDM)
exceptions: Paver system uses a factory-bonded protective base that provides equivalent puncture resistance and is approved by the membrane manufacturer

subject: Roof Garden Access / Maintenance Hatch
rule: A roof garden access or maintenance hatch must be weathertight when closed
conditions: when installed in a roof assembly that separates interior from exterior
exceptions: hatches in conditioned interior spaces that are not exposed to weather

subject: Roof Garden Access / Maintenance Hatch
rule: A roof garden access or maintenance hatch must be able to support the minimum design live load for the accessible roof area
conditions: when the hatch is part of a roof surface intended for pedestrian access or maintenance traffic
exceptions: hatches serving non-trafficable roofs where no load-bearing capacity beyond self-weight is required

subject: Roof Garden Access / Maintenance Hatch
rule: A roof garden access hatch must have a positive latching or locking mechanism that prevents unintended opening
conditions: when the hatch provides access from occupied interior space to the roof
exceptions: hatches secured by building security systems that otherwise meet fall protection requirements

subject: Roof Garden Fall Protection System
rule: Roof garden fall protection system must have a minimum height of 42 inches (1067 mm) above the adjacent walking surface
conditions: applies to roof gardens accessible to building occupants

subject: Roof Garden Fall Protection System
rule: Roof garden fall protection system must have balusters or infill spaced such that a 4-inch (102 mm) sphere cannot pass through
conditions: applies when guardrail system includes balusters or open infill

subject: Roof Garden Fall Protection System
rule: Roof garden fall protection system must be designed to resist a concentrated load of 200 pounds (0.89 kN) applied at any point
conditions: applies to guardrail top rail or handrail serving as fall protection

subject: Roof Garden Fall Protection System
rule: Roof garden fall protection system must not have horizontal elements or ledges that could be used as a ladder or climbing aid
conditions: applies where fall protection system is required to be non-climbable

subject: Roof Garden Fall Protection System
rule: Roof garden fall protection system must not create a tripping hazard at its base or transition to the walking surface

subject: Roof Garden Fall Protection System
rule: Roof garden fall protection system must be constructed of materials rated for exterior/weather-exposed use
conditions: applies to roof gardens not enclosed in a conditioned space

subject: Roof Garden Substrate Retention Grid
rule: substrate retention grid must be placed over a waterproof membrane
conditions: when installed on a roof deck

subject: Roof Garden Substrate Retention Grid
rule: substrate retention grid must have open area or drainage openings to allow water to pass through
conditions: when used above a drainage layer

subject: Roof Garden Substrate Retention Grid
rule: substrate retention grid must not be made of materials that degrade when in continuous contact with moist soil and water

subject: Arcade colonnade
rule: An arcade colonnade must have sufficient structural support to carry its roof and any superimposed loads
conditions: when the colonnade includes a roof or covering
exceptions: freestanding arcade elements without a roof load

subject: Arcade colonnade
rule: Columns in an arcade colonnade must be spaced to allow free pedestrian passage through the arcade
conditions: when the arcade is intended for pedestrian use
exceptions: decorative arcades not intended for circulation

subject: Arcade colonnade
rule: An arcade colonnade must not have columns that obstruct the required clear width for emergency egress
conditions: when the arcade serves as a means of egress path

subject: Arcade vaulted ceiling
rule: Arcade vaulted ceiling must have a lateral thrust resistance system (e.g., buttresses, tie rods, or reinforced abutments) at each springing point
conditions: The vaulted ceiling is masonry or stone construction
The ceiling is a true structural arch/vault rather than a decorative profile
exceptions: The vault is a modern thin-shell concrete or steel construction that can resist horizontal thrust through material continuity

subject: Arcade vaulted ceiling
rule: Arcade vaulted ceiling must have self-weight and live load capacity verified through structural analysis for the span and rise geometry
conditions: The vault spans more than 3 meters between arcade supports
exceptions: The vault is purely decorative (non-structural) cladding applied to a flat ceiling

subject: Arcade spandrel panel
rule: Arcade spandrel panel must be installed between two adjacent arcade columns
conditions: When part of an arcade structure

subject: Arcade spandrel panel
rule: Arcade spandrel panel must be rigidly connected at both ends to supporting columns or structure

subject: Arcade spandrel panel
rule: Arcade spandrel panel must not exceed its material's allowable bending stress under design loads

subject: Arcade keystone
rule: Arcade keystone must have its wedge-shaped sides cut to precisely match the radial angle of the arch it locks
conditions: Used as the final/fixing stone at the crown of an arch

subject: Arcade keystone
rule: Arcade keystone must be in full contact with adjacent voussoirs on both radial faces
conditions: Installed in a load-bearing masonry arch

subject: Arcade keystone
rule: Arcade keystone must not be removed once the arch centering/falsework has been struck
conditions: Arch is complete and centering has been removed
exceptions: Temporary removal during controlled structural demolition with supplemental shoring in place

subject: Arcade entablature
rule: Arcade entablature must be supported by columns or piers at regular intervals
conditions: When part of a classical or neoclassical arcade

subject: Arcade entablature
rule: Arcade entablature must have a continuous horizontal bearing surface on its supporting columns

subject: Arcade entablature
rule: Arcade entablature must not be constructed of materials with insufficient compressive strength for the span
conditions: When spanning more than one intercolumniation
exceptions: If a relieving arch or lintel system is incorporated within the entablature depth

subject: Arcade entablature
rule: Arcade entablature must not exceed a slenderness ratio that would cause buckling under its own weight
conditions: When the entablature depth is less than 1/10 of the clear span between supports

subject: Arcade drainage channel
rule: arcade drainage channel must have a continuous minimum slope (typically 0.5–1%) along its entire length
conditions: the arcade is served by a surface drainage channel
exceptions: the channel is replaced by a positive-pressured piped system with integral flushing capability

subject: Arcade drainage channel
rule: arcade drainage channel must not discharge onto pedestrian walking surfaces at outlet
conditions: the channel outlets at grade within the arcade or adjacent footpath
exceptions: the outlet is designed as a discrete grated sump with full pedestrian coverage and connection to an underground drain

subject: Arcade drainage channel
rule: arcade drainage channel must have a debris-trapping device or removable grate at every inlet point
conditions: the channel is open-top or grate-covered and receives runoff from the arcade floor
exceptions: the system is a fully enclosed pressurised drainage line with no surface inlets within the arcade

subject: Arcade column base
rule: Arcade column base must provide a level bearing surface for the column above
conditions: where column is load-bearing
where base supports a vertical structural column
exceptions: base designed as a decorative non-structural element with documented alternative support system

subject: Arcade column base
rule: Arcade column base must not be undersized relative to the column diameter such that the column overhangs the base edge
conditions: base is supporting a load-bearing column
exceptions: intentional architectural detail where structural capacity is verified through alternative load path

subject: Arcade column base
rule: Arcade column base must be durable against ground moisture and splash-back
conditions: base is at grade level or within 300 mm of exterior ground
base is in an exterior location
exceptions: base is protected by an impermeable plinth or moisture barrier

subject: Arcade impost block
rule: arcade impost block must transfer vertical load from the arch above directly into the column or pier below
conditions: when used in a load-bearing arcade structure

subject: Arcade impost block
rule: arcade impost block must have a horizontal bearing surface on its underside that matches the top surface of the supporting column or pier
conditions: when used in a load-bearing arcade structure

subject: Arcade impost block
rule: arcade impost block must not project so far laterally that its cantilevered portion exceeds the material's tensile capacity
conditions: when the impost block is monolithic stone or masonry and extends beyond the column face

subject: Blind arcade
rule: A blind arcade must have a solid backing wall or structural support behind each arch
conditions: blind arcade is load-bearing
blind arcade is part of a masonry wall
exceptions: arcade is purely decorative and non-structural, attached to an already stable wall

subject: Blind arcade
rule: A blind arcade must not have through-openings that penetrate the wall behind it
conditions: the element is classified as a blind arcade (not an open arcade)

subject: Arcade arch voussoirs
rule: Arcade arch voussoirs must be wedge-shaped (tapered) to maintain compression in the arch
conditions: Used in a masonry arch arcade
exceptions: Structural reinforcement (e.g., steel frame) carries all loads independently of voussoir geometry

subject: Arcade arch voussoirs
rule: Arcade arch voussoirs must be arranged in a curved or arched configuration with a keystone at the crown
conditions: Part of a self-supporting masonry arch arcade
exceptions: The arch is a flat or jack arch where the top is horizontal but the voussoirs still radiate from a center

subject: Arcade arch voussoirs
rule: Adjacent voussoir faces in an arcade arch must be cut to match exactly (radial joints perpendicular to the arch curve)
conditions: Unreinforced masonry arch arcade
exceptions: The arch is a dry-stack rubble arch where irregular stones are tightly packed with no precision cutting

subject: Arcade arch voussoirs
rule: Arcade arch voussoirs must not have tensile weakness across the bed joint (e.g., unbonded stacked voussoirs without lateral restraint in a wide arcade)
conditions: Arcade span is wide (e.g., >3 m) and voussoirs are unreinforced masonry
exceptions: The voussoirs are part of a reinforced concrete or steel-framed arch where the material handles tension

subject: Pier arcade
rule: Pier arcade roof or overhead covering must provide a continuous drainage path to shed water away from the structure and users
conditions: if the arcade has a solid roof/covering
if the arcade is exposed to precipitation
exceptions: when the arcade covering is intentionally permeable or open (e.g., louvers, trellis) and no water accumulation occurs

subject: Pier arcade
rule: Pier arcade must not have unbraced or laterally unstable columns or supports
conditions: if the arcade is load-bearing
if the arcade is located in a wind-prone or seismic zone

subject: Pier arcade
rule: Pier arcade must maintain minimum clear headroom of at least 2.1 m (7 ft) above the walking surface
conditions: if the arcade is intended for pedestrian passage

subject: Arcade cornice
rule: Arcade cornice must project beyond the wall face below it
conditions: when installed as part of a load-bearing masonry or precast concrete system
exceptions: when the cornice is purely decorative and non-structural with a separate water management system

subject: Arcade cornice
rule: Arcade cornice must have a continuous drip groove or projecting drip kerf on its underside
conditions: when the cornice is exposed to rainfall

subject: Arcade cornice
rule: Arcade cornice must not be constructed with materials having a coefficient of thermal expansion mismatched with the supporting structure by more than a factor of two
conditions: when the cornice is rigidly fixed to the structure over spans greater than 3 m
exceptions: when movement joints are provided at intervals not exceeding 3 m

subject: Stairway
rule: stairway must have a minimum clear width for occupant egress
conditions: serves as means of egress
occupant load exceeds threshold

subject: Stairway
rule: stairway must have riser height and tread depth within allowable range

subject: Stairway
rule: stairway must not have a missing handrail on at least one side
conditions: stairway has four or more risers

subject: Stairway
rule: stairway must have consistent riser heights throughout a flight

subject: Exit Passageway
rule: exit passageway must have a minimum clear width of 44 inches (1118 mm)
conditions: serving an occupant load of 50 or more

subject: Exit Passageway
rule: exit passageway must have a fire-resistance rating of at least 1 hour
conditions: connecting two or more exits
or part of a required means of egress
exceptions: when the exit passageway is within a fully sprinklered building and the building code allows reduction

subject: Exit Passageway
rule: exit passageway must not have any openings other than required exit doors
conditions: within the fire-resistance-rated enclosure
exceptions: openings to exit enclosures from interstitial spaces that are protected by fire dampers in accordance with code

subject: Exit Passageway
rule: exit passageway doors must swing in the direction of egress travel
conditions: serving an occupant load of 50 or more

subject: Escalator Well
rule: escalator well must have a floor drain or sump pump at the lowest point
conditions: escalator well is enclosed
escalator well extends below the surrounding floor level
exceptions: escalator well is fully open to exterior grade with positive drainage

subject: Escalator Well
rule: escalator well must not have any water, gas, or steam pipes passing through its floor or walls unless they are fully encased in a secondary containment and sealed
conditions: escalator well is an interior space below grade or at grade
exceptions: pipes that serve the escalator equipment itself (e.g., fire suppression sprinklers) are permitted

subject: Escalator Well
rule: escalator well must have a minimum clear pit depth as specified by the escalator manufacturer at the lowest point
conditions: escalator well is designed to house the escalator machinery and truss

subject: Emergency Egress Stair
rule: Emergency egress stair must have a minimum clear width of 1.12 m (44 in) where serving an occupant load of 50 or more
conditions: stair serves an occupant load of 50 or more persons

subject: Emergency Egress Stair
rule: Emergency egress stair must have a minimum clear width of 0.91 m (36 in) where serving an occupant load of fewer than 50
conditions: stair serves an occupant load of fewer than 50 persons

subject: Emergency Egress Stair
rule: Emergency egress stair must have a maximum riser height of 178 mm (7 in)

subject: Emergency Egress Stair
rule: Emergency egress stair must have a minimum tread depth of 279 mm (11 in)

subject: Emergency Egress Stair
rule: Emergency egress stair must have handrails on both sides
conditions: stairwidth exceeds 1.12 m (44 in)

subject: Emergency Egress Stair
rule: Emergency egress stair must be enclosed with fire-resistance-rated construction
conditions: building is of a type requiring a protected means of egress

subject: Emergency Egress Stair
rule: Emergency egress stair must not have projecting objects that reduce the required clear width at or below handrail height
exceptions: handrails themselves may project up to 114 mm (4.5 in) into the required width

subject: Emergency Egress Stair
rule: Emergency egress stair must have illumination of at least 10.8 lux (1 foot-candle) at all times

subject: Emergency Egress Stair
rule: Emergency egress stair must have a maximum flight height of 3.66 m (12 ft) between landings

subject: Egress Path Marking System
rule: egress path marking system must be visible in low-light and smoke conditions (e.g., photoluminescent or emergency-powered)
conditions: building is used for occupancy
egress path is not directly illuminated to at least 1 fc by emergency lighting at all points
exceptions: building has no occupied floors below the level of exit discharge

subject: Egress Path Marking System
rule: egress path marking system must be continuously installed along the entire egress path from the most remote point to the public way
conditions: building requires more than one exit
occupant load exceeds thresholds in code
exceptions: single-exit buildings with very short travel distance where exit is visible from any occupied point

subject: Egress Path Marking System
rule: egress path marking system must not rely solely on building normal power (must have backup from battery, generator, or photoluminescence)
conditions: system uses electrically powered components
exceptions: system is entirely photoluminescent and does not require any electrical power

subject: Guardrail
rule: guardrail must have continuous load path to primary structure
conditions: guardrail is load-bearing
exceptions: decorative/non-structural guardrails

subject: Guardrail
rule: guardrail infill openings must not exceed maximum allowable dimension
conditions: guardrail is used where fall hazard exists (height difference > 30 inches)
exceptions: guards with solid panels or where code specifically permits larger openings for unique occupancies

subject: Guardrail
rule: guardrail top rail must resist specified concentrated load
conditions: guardrail serves as a handrail or top rail assembly
exceptions: guards not required to resist point loads per specific jurisdiction exemption

subject: Step Nosing
rule: step nosing must project at least 1/2 inch (12.7mm) beyond the face of the riser
conditions: when installed on stairs with a vertical riser

subject: Step Nosing
rule: step nosing must have a slip-resistant surface finish
conditions: when installed in any public or commercial building
when installed in any wet-area location (exterior stairs, pool decks, entryways)

subject: Step Nosing
rule: step nosing profile radius must not exceed 0.5 inches (13mm)
conditions: when installed on stairs serving accessible means of egress

subject: Step Nosing
rule: step nosing must contrast visually with the adjacent tread
conditions: when installed in any building subject to accessibility regulations

subject: Egress Door
rule: egress door must swing in the direction of egress travel
conditions: serves an occupant load of 50 or more
serves a high-hazard occupancy
exceptions: door serving a residential occupancy
door serving a private garage

subject: Egress Door
rule: egress door must be operable without the use of a key, tool, or special knowledge
conditions: door is part of a means of egress
exceptions: doors in secured psychiatric facilities
doors in detention occupancies where egress is supervised

subject: Egress Door
rule: egress door must have a clear opening width of at least 32 inches
conditions: door is required for means of egress
exceptions: existing buildings with smaller doors where approved by the authority having jurisdiction

subject: Egress Door
rule: egress door must not reduce the required egress width of the exit passageway when fully open
conditions: door projects into an exit stairway or passageway
exceptions: door located in a corridor where the door swing does not reduce the required corridor width below the minimum

subject: Egress Door
rule: egress door must be self-closing and positive-latching
conditions: door is a fire door
door separates a corridor from an exit enclosure
exceptions: doors in dwelling units

subject: Linear Path Shape
rule: linear path shape must have a minimum width that allows safe occupant egress
conditions: used as an egress route
occupied spaces served
exceptions: not required when path is purely mechanical/service access and not an egress route

subject: Linear Path Shape
rule: linear path shape must not have any segment shorter than the path width
conditions: path serves as a corridor or circulation route

subject: Linear Path Shape
rule: linear path shape must maintain a clear headroom of at least 2.1 m (7 ft)
conditions: path is accessible to occupants
exceptions: mechanical/utility tunnels where restricted access is permitted

subject: L-Shaped Path
rule: path must have a clear, unobstructed width of at least 900 mm (36 in) at every point along its length
conditions: path is intended for pedestrian access
path is part of an accessible route
exceptions: path serves only maintenance/utility access and is not on an accessible route

subject: L-Shaped Path
rule: path must have a turning radius at the interior corner that accommodates wheelchair turning (minimum 1500 mm × 1500 mm clear space or equivalent radius)
conditions: path is intended for pedestrian access
path is part of an accessible route
path includes a 90-degree (or sharper) turn

subject: L-Shaped Path
rule: path must not have a slope steeper than 1:20 (5%) along any segment designated as a walking surface
conditions: path is designated as a pedestrian walkway
path is not a ramp
exceptions: segments designed as compliant ramps with handrails and landings

subject: Cross/Intersection Path Shape
rule: cross/intersection path shape must maintain a minimum of 1 continuous walkable surface from one entry point to another
conditions: used as a pedestrian walkway

subject: Cross/Intersection Path Shape
rule: cross/intersection path shape must not have vertical drops or steps exceeding 200mm within the pedestrian travel path
conditions: accessible pedestrian route
exceptions: where ramp or lift is provided as alternative accessible route

subject: Switchback Path Shape
rule: switchback path must maintain a minimum turning radius adequate for the intended user (e.g., wheelchair, pedestrian, or bicycle)
conditions: path is designed for wheeled use (wheelchair, bicycle, stroller, or mobility device)

subject: Switchback Path Shape
rule: switchback path must not exceed maximum slope/gradient limits for the intended user type

subject: Switchback Path Shape
rule: switchback path segments must be long enough between turns to allow the user to fully clear the previous switchback before the next change of direction

subject: Path Width Transition
rule: path width transition must maintain a minimum width of 36 inches (914 mm) for accessible egress paths
conditions: path is part of an accessible means of egress
path serves an occupiable space
exceptions: existing buildings undergoing minor alteration where structural conditions prevent compliance and equivalent facilitation is provided

subject: Path Width Transition
rule: path width transition must not reduce the clear width below the required width of the narrower adjoining path segment
conditions: path transition connects two segments of different widths
exceptions: when a smoke-proof enclosure or exit stair landing requires a different minimum per code

subject: Path Width Transition
rule: path width transition must have a clear opening width of at least 32 inches (813 mm) where a door is located at the transition
conditions: transition includes a door opening

subject: Main Entrance Front
rule: Main Entrance Front must provide a clear and unobstructed path of travel from the exterior to the interior building entry
conditions: when the entrance is intended for public access or egress
exceptions: service or emergency-only entrances that are not general public access points

subject: Main Entrance Front
rule: Main Entrance Front must not have a step or change in level at the threshold unless a ramp or lift is provided
conditions: when the entrance serves as the primary accessible entrance
exceptions: historic buildings where full accessibility compliance is legally exempted

subject: Main Entrance Front
rule: Main Entrance Front must have a minimum clear opening width of at least 32 inches (813 mm) in the open position
conditions: when the entrance is required to be accessible
exceptions: existing buildings undergoing alteration where technical infeasibility is demonstrated and documented

subject: Main Entrance Front
rule: Main Entrance Front door swing must not encroach into the required means of egress path by more than 7 inches (178 mm) when fully open
conditions: when the door opens into the egress path or corridor
exceptions: doors in private offices or dwelling units not on an exit access corridor

subject: Front Structural Frame
rule: front structural frame must transfer all gravity loads (dead, live, snow) to the foundation or supporting structural elements without exceeding material stress limits
conditions: when the building is in service under design loads
exceptions: temporary construction/erection phases where partial load paths are acceptable

subject: Front Structural Frame
rule: front structural frame must not undergo lateral deflection that compromises stability or causes progressive collapse under design wind and seismic loads
conditions: under design wind and seismic events as defined by applicable building code

subject: Front Structural Frame
rule: front structural frame must maintain continuous load path connections between all frame members (beams, columns, bracing)

subject: Facade Cladding System
rule: facade cladding system must have a structurally adequate attachment to the building substrate capable of resisting wind loads, self-weight, and thermal movements
conditions: applies to all facade cladding systems regardless of material

subject: Facade Cladding System
rule: facade cladding system must provide a continuous weather barrier that prevents bulk water penetration through the cladding plane
conditions: applies to all exterior facade cladding systems
exceptions: intentionally ventilated or drained cavity systems where water is managed via drainage and ventilation behind the cladding face

subject: Facade Cladding System
rule: facade cladding system must not trap moisture against the building substrate in a manner that prevents drying
conditions: applies when cladding is installed over moisture-sensitive substrates such as wood, gypsum, or insulation
exceptions: systems specifically designed as a fully adhered water-control membrane with documented compatibility

subject: Facade Cladding System
rule: facade cladding system must accommodate differential thermal movement between cladding material and building structure without causing distress or failure
conditions: applies where the coefficient of thermal expansion of cladding differs significantly from that of the substrate or supporting structure

subject: Facade Cladding System
rule: facade cladding system must not create a fire propagation pathway between floors or into the building interior
conditions: applies to all facade cladding systems on buildings above 18 meters in height or where local building codes mandate fire-resistant construction

subject: Front Glazing and Windows
rule: Front glazing and windows must be sloped or positioned to shed water away from the building envelope
conditions: Building is exposed to exterior weather conditions
Glazing is in exterior wall assembly
exceptions: Glazing is entirely interior (e.g., internal curtain wall)

subject: Front Glazing and Windows
rule: Front glazing and windows must be structurally supported by a surrounding frame or anchorage system capable of transferring wind and gravity loads
conditions: Glazing is installed in a vertical or near-vertical orientation
Building is subject to wind loads

subject: Front Glazing and Windows
rule: Front glazing and windows must not create a thermal bridge that causes continuous condensation on interior surfaces under design conditions
conditions: Building is mechanically heated or cooled
Climate has periods where exterior temperature falls below interior dew point
exceptions: Building is unconditioned (no HVAC)

subject: Front Canopy / Marquee
rule: front canopy / marquee must resist wind uplift loads
conditions: canopy is attached to building facade
canopy projects over exterior space

subject: Front Canopy / Marquee
rule: front canopy / marquee must have a minimum structural load capacity for snow and live loads
conditions: canopy has a solid roof surface
canopy is located in a climate with snow loads
exceptions: canopy is constructed entirely of fabric or tensile membrane with no load-bearing requirement beyond self-weight

subject: Front Canopy / Marquee
rule: front canopy / marquee must be attached to a structurally adequate supporting wall or frame
conditions: canopy is mounted on a building facade
exceptions: canopy is freestanding with its own foundation system

subject: Front Canopy / Marquee
rule: front canopy / marquee must not obstruct emergency egress or fire escape routes
conditions: canopy is installed at ground-floor level or above an exit path

subject: Front Canopy / Marquee
rule: front canopy / marquee must not accumulate standing water on its surface
conditions: canopy has a solid roof surface
canopy is not intentionally designed as a water feature
exceptions: canopy is designed with a green roof or intentional ponding system with waterproofing and controlled drainage

subject: Building Signage and Lettering
rule: Building signage and lettering must comply with local building codes and accessibility standards (e.g., ADA requirements for tactile signage at egress locations)
conditions: Signage is required by code for means of egress
Signage serves a life-safety or wayfinding function
exceptions: Decorative signage with no regulatory or wayfinding function

subject: Building Signage and Lettering
rule: Externally illuminated signage must not have electrical connections or wiring exposed to weather without proper weatherproofing and conduit
conditions: Signage uses external electrical illumination
exceptions: Battery-powered signage with no permanent wiring
Signage located in fully interior conditioned space with no weather exposure

subject: Front Landscape Buffer
rule: Front Landscape Buffer must remain free of structures that block required sight lines at vehicular entrances
conditions: buffer is adjacent to a vehicular entrance or driveway
exceptions: when sight lines are provided through transparent elements (e.g., low canopy trees with clear trunk) that meet local zoning sight-triangle requirements

subject: Front Landscape Buffer
rule: Front Landscape Buffer must not contain impervious coverage exceeding local stormwater ordinance maximum
conditions: local code defines a maximum impervious percentage for front setback/landscape strips
exceptions: when an approved stormwater management system (e.g., underground detention) is provided to match pre-development runoff

subject: Forecourt / Plaza
rule: forecourt/plaza ground surface must have a minimum slope of 1% for drainage
conditions: outdoor forecourt/plaza
exceptions: fully enclosed indoor plaza with mechanical drainage

subject: Forecourt / Plaza
rule: forecourt/plaza must not have a continuous slope exceeding 5% that would classify it as a ramp
conditions: pedestrian forecourt/plaza
exceptions: terrace/amphitheater seating designed as stepped landscape

subject: Forecourt / Plaza
rule: forecourt/plaza surface materials must be slip-resistant when wet
conditions: outdoor forecourt/plaza exposed to rain or snow

subject: Ground Floor Frontage
rule: ground floor frontage must provide a continuous, unobstructed pedestrian access path from the public right-of-way to the main entrance
conditions: building has a public-facing entrance at ground level
building is located in a jurisdiction with accessibility codes
exceptions: site topography makes a level path physically impossible and alternative accessible routes are provided

subject: Ground Floor Frontage
rule: ground floor frontage must not have any fully enclosed, non-egress spaces that block vision or egress from the interior to the exterior at sidewalk level
conditions: space is required to be occupiable
exceptions: security-required enclosed guard booths where sight lines are provided via glazing

subject: Ground Floor Frontage
rule: ground floor frontage must maintain a minimum structural clear height of 2.4 m (8 ft) above the finished floor
conditions: frontage is designed as an occupiable space or circulation zone

subject: Cornice and Parapet
rule: Parapet must be at least as high as the minimum code-required height above the roof surface for fire separation and fall protection
conditions: when parapet serves as fire barrier between adjacent buildings
when roof is accessible or occupiable
exceptions: when building code explicitly permits reduced height based on occupancy or alternative protection systems

subject: Cornice and Parapet
rule: Cornice must not project beyond the property line
conditions: when cornice projects over public right-of-way or adjacent property
exceptions: where local zoning or easements explicitly permit encroachment

subject: Cornice and Parapet
rule: Parapet must be designed to resist wind uplift forces at its connection to the roof structure
conditions: when parapet is loadbearing masonry or attached to a flexible roof diaphragm

subject: Cornice and Parapet
rule: Cornice must not trap water against the wall or roof deck
conditions: when cornice has a horizontal top surface or returns
exceptions: when equipped with continuous drainage weeps and drip edges

subject: Cornice and Parapet
rule: Parapet must be provided with through-wall flashing or a cap to shed water away from the wall below
conditions: when parapet is exposed to rainfall
exceptions: when parapet is entirely interior or protected by an overhanging roof

subject: Awning / Sunshade Device
rule: awning/sunshade device must be sloped or angled to shed water and prevent ponding
conditions: installed in exterior/outdoor environment
subject to precipitation
exceptions: device is designed with integrated drainage channels or gutters

subject: Awning / Sunshade Device
rule: awning/sunshade device must be securely anchored to resist wind uplift forces
conditions: installed in exterior/outdoor environment

subject: Awning / Sunshade Device
rule: awning/sunshade device must not block required egress paths or emergency exits when deployed
conditions: mounted near doors, windows, or designated egress routes
exceptions: device is designed to automatically retract, break away, or release upon emergency activation or obstruction force

subject: Awning / Sunshade Device
rule: awning/sunshade device must not exceed the structural load capacity of its mounting surface or support structure

subject: Front Stoop / Steps
rule: Front stoop/steps must have a minimum tread depth of at least 11 inches (280 mm) for each step
conditions: Steps are intended for pedestrian use
exceptions: Private residential stoops where local building code explicitly permits shallower treads (e.g., 10 inches)

subject: Front Stoop / Steps
rule: Front stoop/steps must have a maximum riser height of no more than 7.75 inches (196 mm) for each step
conditions: Steps are intended for pedestrian use
exceptions: Private residential stoops where local code permits up to 8.25 inches in limited circumstances

subject: Front Stoop / Steps
rule: All risers within a flight of front stoop steps must have uniform height, with a maximum variation of 3/8 inch (9.5 mm) between the tallest and shortest riser
conditions: Flight contains two or more risers

subject: Front Stoop / Steps
rule: Front stoop/steps must not have a nosing projection that exceeds 1.25 inches (32 mm) beyond the riser below
conditions: Steps have a nosing projection

subject: Front Stoop / Steps
rule: Front stoop/steps must have a slip-resistant finish or texture on the tread surface
conditions: Stoop/steps are exposed to rain, snow, or ice

subject: Front Stoop / Steps
rule: Front stoop landing at the top of the steps must have a minimum depth of at least 36 inches (914 mm) measured in the direction of travel
conditions: There is a door or entryway at the top of the stoop

subject: Front Column / Pilaster
rule: Front column / pilaster must transfer vertical gravity load from supported structure down to foundation to prevent collapse
conditions: column/pilaster is load-bearing
exceptions: decorative/purely ornamental non-structural pilaster

subject: Front Column / Pilaster
rule: Front column / pilaster must resist lateral (wind/seismic) loads at its connection points to prevent instability
conditions: column/pilaster is load-bearing and laterally braced by structure
exceptions: free-standing decorative column not integrated into lateral force-resisting system

subject: Front Column / Pilaster
rule: Front column / pilaster must not be constructed of materials with compressive strength lower than required by the applied gravity load
conditions: column/pilaster is load-bearing

subject: Front Security Grilles / Shutters
rule: Front security grilles/shutters must be openable from inside without tools during egress
conditions: when installed on a required egress opening
when serving an occupiable space
exceptions: when the opening is not required for egress
when the grille/shutter is motorized with battery-backed release and manual override

subject: Front Security Grilles / Shutters
rule: Front security grilles/shutters must not obstruct fire department access or external rescue operations
conditions: when installed at grade or accessible level on a public frontage
exceptions: when the grille/shutter design includes a readily identifiable, rapid-release mechanism from the exterior

subject: Front Security Grilles / Shutters
rule: Front security grilles/shutters must not block required natural light or ventilation openings when in the closed position
conditions: when the opening is relied upon for required natural light or ventilation under code
exceptions: when the grille or shutter is of open-mesh or louvered design that permits airflow and light transmission above minimum thresholds

subject: Egress Capacity
rule: egress capacity must accommodate the total occupant load of the served area within the required egress time
conditions: building is occupied
occupant load is known

subject: Egress Capacity
rule: egress capacity must not be reduced below the minimum required width at any point along the egress path

subject: Egress Capacity
rule: egress capacity must be continuous from any occupied point to the public way without interruption

subject: Activity Pocket Partition/Enclosure
rule: Activity Pocket Partition/Enclosure must be fire-rated when serving as a fire separation between different fire compartments or exit enclosures
conditions: when the partition/enclosure acts as a fire separation between different fire compartments or between a fire compartment and an exit enclosure

subject: Activity Pocket Partition/Enclosure
rule: Activity Pocket Partition/Enclosure must have a minimum clear opening width for accessible egress when it contains a door
conditions: when the partition contains an operable door that is part of an accessible means of egress

subject: Activity Pocket Partition/Enclosure
rule: Activity Pocket Partition/Enclosure must not obstruct required means of egress width when in any stored or deployed position
conditions: when the partition is located in or adjacent to a required means of egress path

subject: Pedestrian Flow Zone
rule: pedestrian flow zone must maintain a minimum clear width of 1.2 m (≥ 1.8 m in accessible/institutional contexts)
conditions: any corridor, pathway, or circulation route designated as a Pedestrian Flow Zone
exceptions: temporary bottleneck zones during scheduled events when crowd management plan is in effect
areas serving fewer than 10 occupants where local code permits 0.9 m

subject: Pedestrian Flow Zone
rule: pedestrian flow zone must be free of fixed obstructions that reduce clear width below the required minimum
conditions: any Pedestrian Flow Zone
exceptions: columns where minimum clear width is maintained on both sides

subject: Pedestrian Flow Zone
rule: pedestrian flow zone must have a slip-resistant walking surface with a coefficient of friction ≥ 0.5 when wet
conditions: any interior or exterior Pedestrian Flow Zone
exceptions: none — slip resistance is a non-negotiable safety requirement for walking surfaces in circulation zones

subject: Pedestrian Flow Zone
rule: pedestrian flow zone must have a maximum running slope of 1:20 (5 %) where designed as a walkway (no steps)
conditions: where the Pedestrian Flow Zone is designed as a sloped walkway rather than stairs
exceptions: ramps are designed as accessible routes per code (max 1:12) and are a separate entity type, not generic Pedestrian Flow Zone

subject: Pedestrian Flow Zone
rule: pedestrian flow zone must provide a clear headroom of minimum 2.1 m (7'-0") throughout
conditions: any Pedestrian Flow Zone
exceptions: doorway openings (minimum 2.03 m per code)
areas under ducts, beams, or soffits where alternative clearance is provided per local code

subject: Activity Pocket Storage Unit
rule: must have a drainage path to prevent water accumulation
conditions: if exposed to outdoor weather
exceptions: entirely enclosed within conditioned indoor space with no roof penetration or exposure

subject: Activity Pocket Storage Unit
rule: must have structural capacity to support its stored contents without collapse
exceptions: unit is a non-structural enclosure within an already-capable host structure

subject: Activity Pocket Work Surface
rule: work surface must be horizontal (within tolerance) to allow stable placement of tools and materials
conditions: when used as a work surface for assembly, repair, or material handling
exceptions: designs with built-in tilt for specific draining or ergonomic purposes

subject: Activity Pocket Work Surface
rule: work surface must not have sharp edges or protrusions within the primary working area that could snag or injure the user
conditions: when the surface is intended for manual work by personnel
exceptions: edges that are explicitly functional tools (e.g., integrated cutting edges) that are guarded or marked

subject: Activity Pocket Work Surface
rule: work surface must be capable of supporting the intended static load without collapse or excessive deflection
conditions: under all intended loading conditions as specified in the design requirements

subject: Activity Pocket Work Surface
rule: work surface material must be compatible with the chemicals, solvents, or fluids expected in the activity pocket environment
conditions: when the activity pocket involves use of oils, fuels, solvents, cleaning agents, or other reactive substances
exceptions: surfaces with sacrificial or replaceable coverings

subject: Activity Pocket Lighting System
rule: lighting system must be electrically grounded
conditions: system uses mains voltage electricity
exceptions: battery-powered low-voltage systems

subject: Activity Pocket Lighting System
rule: lighting system must not exceed the electrical circuit's rated ampacity
conditions: system is hardwired into building electrical circuits

subject: Activity Pocket Lighting System
rule: lighting system must have a minimum clearance from combustible materials
conditions: system uses incandescent or high-heat lamps
exceptions: LED or cold-light sources with surface temperature below ignition point

subject: Activity Pocket Lighting System
rule: lighting system must not produce light flicker below the safe threshold for photosensitive individuals
conditions: system is installed in publicly accessible spaces
exceptions: emergency strobe systems explicitly designed for alerting

subject: Activity Pocket Door or Gateway
rule: activity pocket door or gateway must provide a clear opening width that accommodates the intended circulation or activity flow
conditions: when used as an accessible route
when used for equipment or material passage

subject: Activity Pocket Door or Gateway
rule: activity pocket door or gateway must have a latching or securing mechanism to prevent unintended movement
conditions: when installed in a vertical (door) orientation
exceptions: if the design intention is a free-swinging or unsecured gateway in a controlled-access-only setting

subject: Activity Pocket Door or Gateway
rule: activity pocket door or gateway must not obstruct the adjacent wall cavity or pocket when fully open

subject: Stair Seat Tread
rule: Stair seat tread must have a minimum depth of 280 mm (11 inches) for residential occupancies
conditions: applicable to any stair with seat treads

subject: Stair Seat Tread
rule: Stair seat tread must have a maximum riser height of 200 mm (7.75 inches) for residential occupancies
conditions: applicable to any stair with seat treads

subject: Stair Seat Tread
rule: Stair seat tread must not have a projecting nosing that reduces the effective tread depth below the minimum required
conditions: applicable to any stair with seat treads having nosing projections

subject: Stair Seat Tread
rule: Stair seat tread must be slip-resistant

subject: Stair Seat Stringer
rule: stair seat stringer must be capable of supporting the dead load of the stair treads and live loads from occupants
conditions: when used as a structural component in stair construction
exceptions: when stair seat stringer is not load-bearing (e.g., decorative only)

subject: Stair Seat Stringer
rule: stair seat stringer must have minimum bearing support at each end
conditions: when the stringer spans between landings or supports
exceptions: when the stringer is cantilevered and designed with sufficient moment connection

subject: Stair Seat Stringer
rule: stair seat stringer must not be notched beyond maximum allowable depth ratio
conditions: when notches are cut into the stringer to receive treads and risers

subject: Stair Seat Handrail
rule: Stair seat handrail must have a minimum height of 900mm measured vertically from the pitch line of the stairs to the top of the handrail
conditions: stairs serving a change in level
stairs in buildings other than dwellings
exceptions: stairs within a dwelling where the minimum is 840mm

subject: Stair Seat Handrail
rule: Stair seat handrail must have a maximum gap of 100mm between balusters or infill elements
conditions: handrail assembly includes balusters or vertical infill

subject: Stair Seat Handrail
rule: Stair seat handrail must be continuous throughout the full length of the stair flight
exceptions: where a newel post or landing interrupts the run

subject: Stair Seat Handrail
rule: Stair seat handrail must not have any sharp edges or protruding elements that could cause injury

subject: Stair Seat Handrail
rule: Stair seat handrail must have a cross-sectional diameter between 40mm and 50mm (or equivalent perimeter shape providing equivalent graspability)

subject: Stair Seat Guardrail/Balustrade
rule: stair seat guardrail/balustrade must have a height of at least 900mm (or local code minimum) measured from the pitch line of the stair
conditions: installed on stairs with a drop of more than 600mm on either side

subject: Stair Seat Guardrail/Balustrade
rule: stair seat guardrail/balustrade must have no opening that permits passage of a 100mm diameter sphere
conditions: the guardrail is intended to serve as a fall-protection barrier for children

subject: Stair Seat Guardrail/Balustrade
rule: stair seat guardrail/balustrade must withstand a uniformly distributed horizontal load of at least 0.5 kN/m applied at the top rail or handrail height
conditions: the guardrail functions as a structural barrier against people pushing or leaning

subject: Stair Seat Under-stair Storage
rule: Under-stair storage space must maintain a minimum clear head height of 1800mm at the access point
conditions: storage is intended for human access
storage area requires entry for use

subject: Stair Seat Under-stair Storage
rule: Under-stair storage floor must be structurally adequate to support the intended storage load
conditions: storage will hold items of significant weight
exceptions: storage is designated for lightweight items only with signage

subject: Stair Seat Under-stair Storage
rule: Under-stair storage must not obstruct the structural integrity or fire-rating of the stair assembly
conditions: the stair is part of a required egress path

subject: Stair Seat Under-stair Storage
rule: Under-stair storage must have ventilation to prevent moisture accumulation and mold growth
conditions: storage is enclosed (has doors or panels)
space is not climate-controlled as part of the main dwelling

subject: Stair Seat Concrete Structure
rule: A stair seat concrete structure must be adequately anchored or tied into the primary building structure (e.g., concrete beam or wall) to prevent overturning or displacement under live load
conditions: When supporting stair flights or landings
When designed as a cantilever or bracket projection

subject: Stair Seat Concrete Structure
rule: A stair seat concrete structure must have minimum bearing length (e.g., not less than 90 mm on masonry or 75 mm on concrete) to avoid edge failure or crushing
conditions: When the stair seat supports precast stair elements

subject: Stair Seat Concrete Structure
rule: Stair seat concrete structure must not have a downward slope or negative drainage away from the supporting wall/beam that could trap water
conditions: When the stair seat is exposed to weather (e.g., external concrete stair seat)
exceptions: If the seat is deliberately designed as a water-collection detail for controlled drainage (very rare in stair seats)

subject: Stair Seat Concrete Structure
rule: The concrete in a stair seat structure must have adequate cover to reinforcement as required by the exposure class (e.g., minimum 25 mm for interior, 40 mm for exterior exposed)
conditions: When the stair seat contains steel reinforcement
exceptions: When stainless steel or epoxy-coated reinforcement is used and applicable code permits reduced cover

subject: Stair Seat Concrete Structure
rule: Stair seat concrete structure must not be unreinforced when spanning across a void or supporting more than nominal loads
conditions: When the seat span (horizontal distance between supports) exceeds 300 mm
When the seat supports stair flights with a rise > 1.5 m
exceptions: Short nibs (≤150 mm projection) designed as plain concrete per code for low-load conditions

subject: Stair Seat Power/Data Outlet
rule: Stair seat power/data outlets must be UL-listed or equivalent certified for the intended installation jurisdiction
conditions: when installed in a public or commercial building
when installed in a stair seating area accessible to occupants

subject: Stair Seat Power/Data Outlet
rule: Stair seat power/data outlets must be installed at a minimum height above the stair tread or floor to avoid water ingress during cleaning or spill events
conditions: when located in an indoor stairwell or seating area where wet cleaning or liquid spills are possible
exceptions: outlets rated with an appropriate ingress protection (IP) rating for wet exposure

subject: Stair Seat Power/Data Outlet
rule: Stair seat power/data outlets must not be placed where they protrude into the required egress path or stairway clear width
conditions: when installed adjacent to a stairway or aisle that serves as a means of egress
exceptions: if the outlet is recessed flush with the finished surface such that it does not reduce clear width

subject: Bleacher Seating
rule: Bleacher seating must be anchored or ballasted to resist overturning under wind loads
conditions: Bleacher seating is installed outdoors
Bleacher seating is not permanently attached to a primary building structure
exceptions: Bleacher seating that is fully enclosed within a structure that independently resists wind loads

subject: Bleacher Seating
rule: Bleacher seating must have slip-resistant walking surfaces on aisles, steps, and platforms
conditions: Bleacher seating provides egress paths for occupants

subject: Bleacher Seating
rule: Bleacher seating must not have openings between seat boards or footboards that permit passage of a 4-inch sphere
conditions: Bleacher seating has multiple rows or tiers

subject: Bleacher Seating
rule: Bleacher seating must have guards at any open side where the adjacent surface is more than 30 inches below
conditions: Bleacher seating is elevated more than 30 inches above adjacent surface
exceptions: At the front row where seating faces the field/floor level

subject: Amphitheater Seating
rule: Amphitheater seating rows must have a minimum tread depth (row-to-row spacing) sufficient for safe passage and egress
conditions: seating is arranged in stepped rows
occupant load exceeds 50 persons
exceptions: seating is not accessible to the public

subject: Amphitheater Seating
rule: Amphitheater seating aisles must not have a slope that exceeds the maximum allowable gradient for safe occupant evacuation
conditions: seating area has designated aisles
occupant load exceeds 50 persons

subject: Amphitheater Seating
rule: Amphitheater seating must provide handrails along stepped aisles where the rise exceeds a threshold that would pose a fall hazard without support
conditions: aisle stairs have a rise greater than 6 inches total or where required by local building code
exceptions: aisles with fewer than 2 risers total

subject: Amphitheater Seating
rule: Amphitheater seating must have a clear sightline from every seat to the performance area without obstruction by the row immediately in front
conditions: seating is arranged in tiers/rows
seats are fixed in place

subject: Amphitheater Seating
rule: Amphitheater seating rows must have riser heights that do not exceed a maximum safe step height for occupants to ascend/descend
conditions: seating is arranged in stepped rows
rows are accessed by stepping from one row to another

subject: Monolithic Stair Bench
rule: The stair bench tread must be at least 280 mm deep
conditions: If the bench is intended for seated use
exceptions: Decorative-only benches not meant for sitting

subject: Monolithic Stair Bench
rule: The stair bench must not have a vertical riser height exceeding 200 mm
conditions: If the bench is used as a stepped seating element

subject: Monolithic Stair Bench
rule: The bench must have a slip-resistant surface on the tread
conditions: If the bench is located in an area exposed to water or weather
exceptions: Interior benches in dry, controlled environments

subject: Core
rule: A building core must have a continuous load path to transfer vertical and lateral loads directly to the foundation
conditions: for any structural core that carries building gravity or lateral loads
exceptions: non-structural architectural cores that serve only as circulation or service shafts and are independently supported

subject: Core
rule: Core enclosure walls providing fire separation must achieve the required fire-resistance rating with no unprotected openings that violate the rating
conditions: when the core contains fire-rated egress stairs, elevator shafts, or mechanical shafts required by building code to be enclosed
exceptions: fire-rated assemblies that incorporate approved fire dampers, fire doors, or firestop systems as permitted by code

subject: Core
rule: Core must not have structural elements that block required means of egress path width
conditions: where the core contains egress stairs or corridors that must maintain minimum clear width per building code
exceptions: columns or walls that are fully enclosed within rated construction and do not encroach on required egress clear width

subject: Central Light Well
rule: Central Light Well must have a continuous vertical shaft from top to bottom of building with no obstructions that would block light transmission
conditions: if designed to admit daylight to lower floors
exceptions: if the light well is purely for ventilation rather than light

subject: Central Light Well
rule: Central Light Well must have fire-rated walls separating it from adjacent occupied spaces
conditions: when the light well passes through multiple floors

subject: Central Light Well
rule: Central Light Well must not have a roof that is fully enclosed without ventilation or drainage
conditions: when the light well is open to the sky at top
exceptions: if the light well is an internal atrium with a fully glazed roof that is properly drained

subject: Central Light Well
rule: Central Light Well's floor at base must have drainage to handle accumulated rainwater and cleaning runoff
conditions: when the light well is open to the sky at top
exceptions: if the base is designed as a planted bioswale that absorbs all water
if the light well has a fully sealed roof

subject: Central Mechanical Room
rule: Central Mechanical Room must have adequate ventilation for heat rejection from mechanical equipment
conditions: room contains combustion equipment (boilers, generators)
room contains refrigerant-based cooling equipment
exceptions: all equipment is electric and air-cooled via direct outdoor intake/exhaust with no indoor heat dissipation

subject: Central Mechanical Room
rule: Central Mechanical Room must have a floor drain connected to building drainage system
conditions: room contains water-cooled equipment (chillers, cooling towers)
room contains boilers with blowdown or relief valves

subject: Central Mechanical Room
rule: Central Mechanical Room must not have combustible storage
exceptions: fuel stored in approved containers for boiler/generator operation

subject: Central Mechanical Room
rule: Central Mechanical Room must have minimum ceiling height of 7 feet (2.13 m) clear
exceptions: existing buildings with documented structural constraints where equipment fits within available space without requiring personnel to work in cramped conditions

subject: Central Mechanical Room
rule: Central Mechanical Room must have a door wide enough to allow equipment removal
exceptions: room has a removable exterior wall panel or equivalent large opening for equipment replacement

subject: Central Staircase
rule: central staircase must have handrails on at least one side
conditions: stairs have more than 3 risers

subject: Central Staircase
rule: central staircase must have minimum tread depth of at least 254 mm (10 inches) for occupiable use
conditions: staircase is used for egress or regular occupancy

subject: Central Staircase
rule: central staircase must have maximum riser height no greater than 190 mm (7.5 inches)
conditions: staircase is used for egress or regular occupancy

subject: Central Staircase
rule: central staircase must not have a change in riser height between consecutive steps exceeding 4.8 mm (3/16 inch)

subject: Central Staircase
rule: central staircase must have a minimum clear width of at least 900 mm (36 inches) if serving as a required egress stair
conditions: staircase is part of the means of egress

subject: Central Staircase
rule: central staircase must have landing at top and bottom with dimensions at least as wide as the stair width and minimum depth of 900 mm
conditions: staircase exceeds 3.66 m (12 ft) in vertical rise
exceptions: private stairs in single dwelling units may have exceptions

subject: Central Atrium Floor Slab Opening
rule: Central Atrium Floor Slab Opening must have a structural edge support or edge reinforcement at all sides
conditions: The opening is intended for pedestrian traffic below
The slab is structural concrete
exceptions: Opening is less than 300 mm in any dimension

subject: Central Atrium Floor Slab Opening
rule: Central Atrium Floor Slab Opening must not exceed the maximum allowable span-to-depth ratio without additional support
conditions: The opening is formed within a reinforced concrete slab
The slab thickness is less than 150 mm
exceptions: A structural engineer has designed supplemental beams or a thickened slab edge

subject: Central Lobby
rule: Central Lobby must have at least one means of egress providing direct exit to a corridor or exterior
conditions: Central Lobby is a circulation or assembly space
space is occupied by the public or staff
exceptions: Lobby is less than 50 sq ft and opens directly to exterior

subject: Central Lobby
rule: Central Lobby must have a floor that is structurally capable of supporting the anticipated live load
conditions: Central Lobby is located on any floor above grade

subject: Central Lobby
rule: Central Lobby must_not have any single point of entry/exit narrower than 32 inches clear width
conditions: Central Lobby serves as a required egress path
exceptions: Door is not part of the means of egress

subject: Entry Transition Zone
rule: An entry transition zone must provide a weather-protected path between the exterior and the interior primary entrance
conditions: building is located in a climate with precipitation
exceptions: building is fully interior with no exterior exposure

subject: Entry Transition Zone
rule: Entry transition zone floor surface must not create a tripping hazard at the threshold transition between exterior and interior finishes
exceptions: step-free access is intentionally designed with a sloped transition

subject: Entry Transition Zone
rule: Entry transition zone must have a minimum clear width that matches the required egress width of the door it serves
conditions: zone is part of a means of egress path

subject: Public Gathering Hall
rule: floor assembly must have a fire-resistance rating of at least 1 hour
conditions: occupant load exceeds 100 persons
exceptions: building is sprinklered throughout and floor is at grade level

subject: Public Gathering Hall
rule: doors serving the hall must swing in the direction of egress travel
conditions: hall has an occupant load of 50 or more persons

subject: Public Gathering Hall
rule: must have at least two separate exits
conditions: occupant load exceeds 49 persons

subject: Public Gathering Hall
rule: ceilings must have a minimum clear height of 7 feet 6 inches in the occupied area
exceptions: beams, ducts, or lights projecting below that height are permitted if spaced more than 4 feet apart

subject: Public Gathering Hall
rule: must not have any interior finish with a flame-spread index exceeding Class B (26-75)
conditions: hall does not have an automatic sprinkler system throughout
exceptions: if sprinklered throughout, Class C (76-200) finishes are permitted

subject: Semi-Private Corridor
rule: semi-private corridor must have a minimum clear width of at least 900 mm (36 in) for accessibility and egress
conditions: building is occupied by persons with mobility impairments
corridor serves more than one occupancy
exceptions: existing buildings where structural infeasibility prevents widening and alternative accessible path is provided

subject: Semi-Private Corridor
rule: semi-private corridor must have a minimum clear height of at least 2100 mm (7 ft)
conditions: corridor is part of a habitable building

subject: Semi-Private Corridor
rule: semi-private corridor must be free of obstructions that reduce clear width below minimum required egress width
conditions: corridor serves as a means of egress
exceptions: fire-rated doors in frames that project no more than 150 mm into the corridor

subject: Semi-Private Corridor
rule: semi-private corridor must not be served by a dead-end path exceeding 6 m (20 ft) without an alternative means of egress
conditions: corridor is the only exit access route for the spaces it serves
exceptions: sprinklered buildings where codes permit longer dead-end corridors

subject: Personal Retreat Room
rule: personal retreat room must have at least one means of egress (door or window) that opens directly to a corridor or exterior
conditions: room is enclosed by walls
room is intended for occupancy
exceptions: room classification as a crawlspace or uninhabitable attic

subject: Personal Retreat Room
rule: personal retreat room must not have a floor-to-ceiling height less than 7 feet (2.13 m)
conditions: room is designated as habitable space
exceptions: loft spaces under sloped roofs where reduced height is permitted by code for a portion of the floor area

subject: Personal Retreat Room
rule: personal retreat room must have a minimum net floor area of at least 70 square feet (6.5 m²)
conditions: room is designated as a habitable room
room contains a bed or sleeping accommodation
exceptions: room is a den, study, or meditation space without sleeping function

subject: Sightline-Blocking Louver
rule: sightline-blocking louver must have solid slats or opaque infill to physically block sightlines
conditions: used for privacy or visual screening
exceptions: louver is purely for light/ventilation and sightline blocking is not a required function

subject: Sightline-Blocking Louver
rule: sightline-blocking louver must not have open gaps larger than the minimum distinguishable visual aperture in the viewing direction
conditions: used to block sightlines from a known viewing distance and angle
exceptions: louver is designed only for light/air control and any sightline blocking is incidental

subject: Sightline-Blocking Louver
rule: sightline-blocking louver must be structurally secured against removal or deflection under design wind load
conditions: installed in an exterior facade or building envelope location
exceptions: louver is interior-only with no wind exposure

subject: Graduated Ceiling Height
rule: graduated ceiling height must maintain a minimum clearance of 2.4 m (8 ft) above finished floor throughout the occupied area
conditions: occupied spaces
new construction
exceptions: mechanical rooms
storage areas not intended for occupancy
areas under beams or ducts where local code allows reduced height

subject: Graduated Ceiling Height
rule: graduated ceiling height transitions must not create an abrupt change exceeding 300 mm (12 inches) without a guardrail or barrier
conditions: changes in ceiling height within the same occupied floor plate
public or circulation areas
exceptions: stairwells
designed seating steps in auditoriums where fall protection is provided by other means

subject: Graduated Ceiling Height
rule: graduated ceiling height must not reduce the clear height below the minimum required for fire sprinkler coverage as specified by the applicable standard
conditions: buildings equipped with automatic fire sprinkler systems
exceptions: areas protected by alternate approved suppression systems (e.g., gaseous or foam)

subject: Layered Door Assembly
rule: Layered door assembly must maintain continuous compression on all gaskets/seals when in closed position
conditions: Door assembly includes weatherstripping or acoustic seals
exceptions: Doors not intended to seal (e.g., purely decorative layered doors)

subject: Layered Door Assembly
