conditions: When the worktop is specifically designated as 'child-height'
exceptions: Adjustable-height worktops that can be lowered to child-appropriate heights

subject: Indoor Climbing Structure
rule: Climbing walls must be anchored to the building's primary structure (floor slab, structural wall, or roof truss), not solely to non-structural finishes
conditions: Wall height exceeds 1.5m
exceptions: Freestanding boulder structures designed with self-weight stability

subject: Indoor Climbing Structure
rule: Climbing wall surfaces must not exceed the manufacturer's specified load rating for the hold pattern and intended user weight
conditions: Wall is used for top-rope or lead climbing with fall potential

subject: Indoor Climbing Structure
rule: Floor impact zones at the base of climbing walls must have a shock-absorbing surface (e.g., crash pad, spring-floor, or deep foam matting) of sufficient thickness for the maximum fall height
conditions: Maximum climbing height above floor is greater than 0.5m
exceptions: Walls used exclusively for bouldering with pre-installed auto-belay systems that arrest falls above the floor

subject: Indoor Climbing Structure
rule: Climbing holds and volume shapes must be free of sharp edges, burrs, or pinch hazards

subject: Indoor Climbing Structure
rule: The route-setting plan must allow at least one clear emergency descent route (e.g., via ladder, stairway, or auto-belay) for every climber on the structure
conditions: Structure has more than one climbing station and no single means of egress from each
Structure is used by unaccompanied general public
exceptions: Single-user home wall where the user can self-rescue

subject: Child-Safe Window Guard
rule: guard bars must have spacing no greater than 100 mm (4 inches)
conditions: when used as a fall prevention device
for windows accessible to children under 6 years old

subject: Child-Safe Window Guard
rule: guard must resist a concentrated horizontal load of at least 130 lb (590 N) applied outward
conditions: when permanently installed as a fall protection device

subject: Child-Safe Window Guard
rule: guard must not create a climbable horizontal surface or foothold
conditions: for windows where the guard is the only fall prevention measure

subject: Child-Safe Window Guard
rule: guard must be installed so that the window can be opened for emergency egress without removing the guard
conditions: when the window serves as an emergency escape or rescue opening
exceptions: dedicated fire escape route provided elsewhere in the room

subject: Children's Washroom
rule: Floor finish must be slip-resistant with a coefficient of friction ≥ 0.6 when wet
conditions: Space is a children's washroom
Floor is subject to wet conditions
exceptions: Temporary non-slip mats are in place at all times of use

subject: Children's Washroom
rule: All hot water outlets must be fitted with thermostatic mixing valves limiting outlet temperature to a maximum of 43°C
conditions: Space is a children's washroom
Hot water is supplied to handwashing or bathing fixtures

subject: Children's Washroom
rule: Floor drainage must be provided at a slope of at least 1:100 toward floor drains
conditions: Space is a children's washroom
Floor is subject to wet mopping or overspray
exceptions: The washroom is used exclusively by staff and no wet cleaning occurs

subject: Children's Washroom
rule: Washroom must not contain sharp interior corners or protrusions at child reach height (below 1200 mm)
conditions: Space is a children's washroom

subject: Children's Washroom
rule: All electrical outlets and switches must have ground-fault circuit interrupter (GFCI) protection
conditions: Space is a children's washroom
Electrical outlets or switches are present within 3 m of wash fixtures

subject: Child-Sized Door Hardware
rule: Child-sized door hardware must be operable by a child's hand size and strength
conditions: When hardware is installed in an area intended for children's use
When hardware requires manual grasping, turning, or pulling
exceptions: Hardware on emergency-only doors or egress doors that must comply with adult accessibility codes

subject: Child-Sized Door Hardware
rule: Child-sized door hardware must not have pinch, shear, or entrapment points accessible to small fingers
conditions: When hardware has moving parts, gaps, or closures

subject: Child-Sized Door Hardware
rule: Child-sized door hardware must not require fine motor coordination beyond typical child development
conditions: When hardware operation requires simultaneous multiple actions (e.g., push-and-turn, lift-and-slide)

subject: Nappy Changing Station
rule: nappy changing station must have a waterproof, non-porous surface that can be easily cleaned and disinfected
conditions: used for infant diaper changing

subject: Nappy Changing Station
rule: nappy changing station must have raised edges or sides (typically 50-100mm) to prevent infant from rolling off

subject: Nappy Changing Station
rule: nappy changing station must_not exceed maximum weight capacity specified for its mounting hardware and structural supports
conditions: wall-mounted or freestanding

subject: Nappy Changing Station
rule: nappy changing station must have a safety strap or restraint to secure the infant during changing

subject: Daycare Kitchenette
rule: Daycare kitchenette must have a dedicated handwashing sink separate from food preparation and dishwashing sinks
conditions: When the space is used for food preparation or bottle warming
exceptions: If the kitchenette is used only for staff beverage service and no food handling occurs

subject: Daycare Kitchenette
rule: Daycare kitchenette electrical outlets within 6 feet of a sink must be GFCI-protected
conditions: When any electrical outlet is located within 6 feet of a sink basin

subject: Daycare Kitchenette
rule: Daycare kitchenette countertop and backsplash surfaces must be non-porous and cleanable
conditions: When food contact surfaces are present

subject: Daycare Kitchenette
rule: Daycare kitchenette must not have sharp corners or protrusions at child height accessible to children
conditions: When children under the age of 6 have access to the space or any portion of the countertop edge is below 36 inches

subject: Daycare Kitchenette
rule: Daycare kitchenette sink hot water supply must be limited to a maximum temperature of 120°F at the tap
conditions: When the kitchenette is accessible to children or used for food preparation
exceptions: If a commercial dishwashing sanitizing step requires higher temperature, that fixture must be child-proofed or behind a barrier

subject: Childproof Electrical Covers
rule: Childproof electrical covers must be tamper-resistant to prevent insertion of foreign objects
conditions: when used in residential or public access areas

subject: Childproof Electrical Covers
rule: Childproof electrical covers must not obstruct access to the electrical receptacle when an adult intentionally inserts a plug
conditions: when installed over a standard electrical outlet

subject: Childproof Electrical Covers
rule: Childproof electrical covers must be made of non-conductive material

subject: Childproof Electrical Covers
rule: Childproof electrical covers must not permanently deform or crack under expected insertion force

subject: Art and Craft Activity Wall
rule: Art and Craft Activity Wall must be rigidly attached to a supporting structure (floor, wall, or ceiling) to prevent tipping or collapse under lateral loads
conditions: when installed as a freestanding component
when intended for use by children

subject: Art and Craft Activity Wall
rule: Art and Craft Activity Wall must not have sharp corners, edges, or protruding fasteners at accessible heights
conditions: when installed within reach of users (typically below 2.0 m)
exceptions: intentionally blunt design elements that mimic a feature (e.g., a decorative faux-bolt with rounded head)

subject: Art and Craft Activity Wall
rule: Art and Craft Activity Wall surfaces and coatings must be non-toxic and free of hazardous substances (e.g., lead, phthalates)
conditions: when used in a children's activity setting

subject: Art and Craft Activity Wall
rule: Art and Craft Activity Wall must be fire-retardant or made of materials with a Class A / Class 1 flame-spread rating
conditions: when installed in an indoor occupied space
where building code requires fire-rated interior finishes

subject: Child-Safe Radiator Cover
rule: radiator cover must have ventilation openings that prevent child finger insertion (max 6 mm gap)
conditions: cover is intended for use in households with children under 5 years old
exceptions: cover is purely decorative and never installed near children

subject: Child-Safe Radiator Cover
rule: radiator cover must not have sharp edges or corners accessible to children
conditions: cover is within reach zone of children (typically floor to 1.2 m height)

subject: Child-Safe Radiator Cover
rule: radiator cover material must not exceed safe touch temperature when radiator is at maximum operating temperature
conditions: cover encloses an active hot-water or steam radiator
exceptions: cover is designed for electric radiators that do not exceed 43 °C surface temperature

subject: Child-Safe Radiator Cover
rule: radiator cover must be securely fixed or have a tip-over restraint to prevent it from falling onto a child
conditions: cover is freestanding or not permanently attached to the wall or radiator
exceptions: cover is permanently bolted to the wall structure

subject: Morning Light Shelf
rule: Morning Light Shelf must be dimensioned to fit the designated window or wall opening it is mounted on
conditions: if installed on a window or wall opening
exceptions: custom-fit units that are site-measured and built to non-standard dimensions

subject: Morning Light Shelf
rule: Morning Light Shelf must not obstruct the operation of the window it is associated with
conditions: if the shelf is mounted above or near an operable window

subject: Morning Light Shelf
rule: Morning Light Shelf must be mounted securely to support its own weight plus any design load

subject: East-Side Sleep Pod
rule: sleep pod must be enclosed on all sides (except entry) to provide acoustic and visual privacy for sleeping
conditions: function is sleeping/resting

subject: East-Side Sleep Pod
rule: pod interior must have a minimum clear floor area for a single occupant to lie down (at least 2000mm x 900mm)
conditions: designed for horizontal sleeping position

subject: East-Side Sleep Pod
rule: entry opening must be dimensioned to allow occupant egress without assistance (min 600mm clear width)

subject: East-Side Sleep Pod
rule: pod must have a means of fresh air supply to maintain safe CO2 levels
conditions: pod is fully enclosed and occupied for sleep duration

subject: East-Side Sleep Pod
rule: interior surfaces must not have sharp edges or protrusions within occupant reach zone

subject: East-Orientation Window Sash
rule: East-orientation window sash must be rated for direct solar radiation exposure
conditions: window is on east facade
sash is exposed to exterior
exceptions: sash is protected by permanent exterior shading device

subject: East-Orientation Window Sash
rule: East-orientation window sash must have operable weatherstripping on all perimeter joints
conditions: sash is operable (awning, casement, sliding, etc.)
exceptions: sash is fixed/non-operable

subject: East-Orientation Window Sash
rule: East-orientation window sash must not allow water penetration under standard ASTM E1105 test pressure
conditions: sash is part of building envelope

subject: Phase-Change Material East Wall Lining
rule: Phase-Change Material East Wall Lining must be in direct thermal contact with the interior space or a thermally conductive substrate to enable latent heat exchange
conditions: When used for passive thermal regulation
exceptions: When encapsulated within a ventilated cavity system with forced air circulation

subject: Phase-Change Material East Wall Lining
rule: Phase-Change Material East Wall Lining must not exceed its rated temperature range during installation or service
exceptions: If the material is specifically designed for abuse-tolerant or fire-resistive applications with a broader range

subject: Phase-Change Material East Wall Lining
rule: Phase-Change Material East Wall Lining must be contained within a leak-proof encapsulation or container system
conditions: If the PCM is in liquid or solid-liquid phase
exceptions: When using a form-stable or micro-encapsulated PCM where the phase-change material is already bound within a polymer matrix

subject: Night-Cooling East Window Trickle Vent
rule: Night-Cooling East Window Trickle Vent must have a clear, unobstructed airflow path from the exterior to the interior space it serves
conditions: when installed in operable configuration

subject: Night-Cooling East Window Trickle Vent
rule: Night-Cooling East Window Trickle Vent must not be installed on façades that are not east-oriented
conditions: if the component is labeled and designed specifically for east-facing night cooling

subject: Night-Cooling East Window Trickle Vent
rule: Night-Cooling East Window Trickle Vent must be integrated with an operable window assembly that can be opened for night flushing
conditions: where the vent relies on stack effect or cross-ventilation with the window

subject: Farmhouse Kitchen Plumbing Rough-In
rule: farmhouse kitchen plumbing rough-in must maintain minimum 1/4 inch per foot slope on horizontal drain pipes toward the main stack or sewer connection
conditions: applies to all horizontal drainage piping in the rough-in
exceptions: horizontal sections shorter than 4 feet may use minimum 1/8 inch per foot if shown on approved engineered design

subject: Farmhouse Kitchen Plumbing Rough-In
rule: farmhouse kitchen plumbing rough-in must have a vent connection within the maximum trap-arm distance from the kitchen sink trap outlet
conditions: applies to any fixture trap served by the rough-in
exceptions: studor vents (air-admittance valves) are permitted under applicable plumbing codes as an alternative to a conventional pipe vent

subject: Farmhouse Kitchen Plumbing Rough-In
rule: farmhouse kitchen plumbing rough-in must not share its drainage connection with a sanitary sewer line without an approved backwater valve or elevated fixture protection
conditions: when the rough-in serves fixtures below the flood level rim of the nearest upstream manhole or sewer main
exceptions: none — backflow prevention is mandatory by code in such configurations

subject: Farmhouse Kitchen Electrical Rough-In
rule: Kitchen electrical rough-in must comply with National Electrical Code (NEC) requirements for receptacle spacing along countertops
conditions: Farmhouse kitchen includes countertop workspace areas
exceptions: Island countertops less than 12 inches wide

subject: Farmhouse Kitchen Electrical Rough-In
rule: Kitchen electrical rough-in must have dedicated 20-amp small-appliance branch circuits for countertop receptacles
conditions: Kitchen has countertop receptacles serving food preparation areas

subject: Farmhouse Kitchen Electrical Rough-In
rule: Kitchen electrical rough-in must not have receptacle outlets installed face-up on countertop surfaces where spillage could occur
conditions: Receptacles are located on countertop surfaces subject to liquid spills
exceptions: Receptacles listed as 'listed for use in countertop' and GFCI-protected may be permitted for specific island installations under NEC 2023 updates

subject: Farmhouse Kitchen Electrical Rough-In
rule: Kitchen electrical rough-in must have all countertop receptacles protected by GFCI
conditions: Receptacles serve countertop areas within 6 feet of sinks or general kitchen wet locations
exceptions: Receptacles not readily accessible or those serving dedicated appliances like refrigerators if located behind them

subject: Farmhouse Kitchen Electrical Rough-In
rule: Kitchen electrical rough-in must have properly sized and rated wiring for anticipated load
conditions: Any electrical circuit is installed

subject: Terrace Slab/Deck
rule: Terrace slab/deck must have a minimum slope for drainage
conditions: exposed to precipitation
located outdoors
exceptions: internal terrace/deck that is fully roofed above and drained via a separate system

subject: Terrace Slab/Deck
rule: Terrace slab/deck must have a continuous waterproof membrane beneath the wearing surface
conditions: located above habitable or occupiable interior space
exceptions: terrace slab over non-occupiable space (e.g., unoccupied garage) where water leakage causes no damage or safety issue

subject: Terrace Slab/Deck
rule: Terrace slab/deck must not have ponding water exceeding structural design depth
conditions: any terrace slab/deck
exceptions: slab specifically designed for ponding (e.g., green roof with controlled detention)

subject: Terrace Slab/Deck
rule: Terrace slab/deck must have a minimum load capacity per applicable building code
conditions: accessible to occupants
exceptions: non-accessible terrace used only for maintenance access

subject: Parapet Wall
rule: parapet wall must have a minimum height above the roof surface to serve as a fall protection barrier
conditions: when the parapet wall is used as a guardrail/fall protection system
building has occupiable roof or accessible roof area
exceptions: when the roof is not occupiable and fall protection is provided by other means

subject: Parapet Wall
rule: parapet wall must be flashed and waterproofed at the junction with the roof membrane
conditions: when the parapet wall is constructed as a perimeter roof element

subject: Parapet Wall
rule: parapet wall must not terminate below the roof surface or allow water to pond against its base without a drainage path

subject: Parapet Wall
rule: parapet wall must have positive attachment to the structural roof deck or building structure

subject: Terrace Paving/Decking Finish
rule: Terrace paving/decking finish must have positive drainage slope away from building structure
conditions: Installed on exterior horizontal or near-horizontal surface
Adjoins building wall or structure
exceptions: Integrated drainage channel system designed to remove water mechanically

subject: Terrace Paving/Decking Finish
rule: Terrace paving/decking finish must have a slip-resistant surface texture
conditions: Located in outdoor or wet-area exposure
exceptions: Area designated as permanently inaccessible or decorative-only with no foot traffic

subject: Terrace Paving/Decking Finish
rule: Terrace paving/decking finish must not impede thermal movement of adjacent building elements
conditions: Continuous paving area exceeds manufacturer-recommended spacing limits
Directly abuts building wall, column, or fixed structure
exceptions: System designed with expansion joints and slip-sheet layer that accommodate movement

subject: Terrace Balustrade/Railing
rule: terrace balustrade/railing must have a minimum height of 1.0 m (or locally mandated height) to prevent falls
conditions: when adjacent to a change in level greater than 0.5 m
exceptions: where a seated-height barrier is specifically designed for accessible seating areas with controlled access

subject: Terrace Balustrade/Railing
rule: terrace balustrade/railing must not have horizontal rails or climbable openings that allow a 150 mm (or locally mandated) sphere to pass through
conditions: when the balustrade serves as fall protection for children or the general public
exceptions: where the balustrade is solely decorative and an independent fall-protection system exists

subject: Terrace Balustrade/Railing
rule: terrace balustrade/railing must resist the design handrail load (typically 0.74 kN/m or locally mandated) without failure
conditions: when required by structural loading code

subject: Terrace Balustrade/Railing
rule: terrace balustrade/railing must be continuous (no gaps larger than code-specified) along any unprotected edge
conditions: when located at a roof terrace with an open edge
exceptions: where a gate or removable section is provided and is designed to latch/self-close to maintain fall protection

subject: Terrace Drainage System
rule: terrace surface must have a minimum slope of 1% toward drainage outlets
conditions: terrace is horizontal or nominally flat
exceptions: terrace uses a fully engineered structural fall system with integrated drainage channels

subject: Terrace Drainage System
rule: terrace drainage outlets must be sized to handle local rainfall intensity for the catchment area
conditions: terrace is exposed to precipitation

subject: Terrace Drainage System
rule: terrace drainage system must not discharge onto adjacent properties or public rights-of-way without approved conveyance
exceptions: where explicitly permitted by local stormwater ordinance

subject: Terrace Drainage System
rule: terrace drainage system must be separated from sanitary sewer system
conditions: jurisdiction requires separate storm and sanitary systems
exceptions: combined sewer systems where permitted by local authority

subject: Terrace Door/Access Door
rule: terrace door/access door must be weather-sealed to prevent water ingress
conditions: door is exposed to exterior environment
exceptions: door is located in fully enclosed interior space with no exterior exposure

subject: Terrace Door/Access Door
rule: terrace door/access door must not be obstructed in its swing or sliding path
conditions: door is operable (not fixed/sealed)
exceptions: door is designed as a fixed non-operable glazed panel

subject: Terrace Door/Access Door
rule: terrace door/access door must have a sill or threshold that prevents water entry at the bottom
conditions: door is at grade or exposed to rain/runoff
exceptions: interior door with no exterior water exposure

subject: Fixed Planter/Built-In Planter
rule: Fixed planter / built-in planter must have drainage to prevent waterlogging and root rot
conditions: used for planting with soil
exposed to irrigation or rainwater
exceptions: planter is purely decorative and contains no plants or drainage-dependent substrate
planter is designed as a watertight indoor vessel with a separate inner liner

subject: Fixed Planter/Built-In Planter
rule: Fixed planter / built-in planter must be structurally capable of supporting the saturated weight of soil plus water
conditions: planter is cantilevered or projecting from a wall
planter is mounted above grade
exceptions: planter is supported continuously by the ground or a slab rated for the load

subject: Fixed Planter/Built-In Planter
rule: Fixed planter / built-in planter must not trap water against the adjacent building structure
conditions: planter is installed directly against a wall, foundation, or waterproofing membrane
exceptions: a fully sealed and properly sloped flashing or waterproof separation is provided between planter and structure

subject: Glass Terrace Balustrade
rule: Glass terrace balustrade must resist horizontal live loads (e.g., people leaning, leaning on, or pushing against it) as specified by applicable building code.
conditions: Balustrade is at a location accessible to occupants
Balustrade height is 1.0 m or more above finished floor level
exceptions: Balustrade is only decorative and not required to serve as a guard (e.g., behind a separate code-compliant guard)

subject: Glass Terrace Balustrade
rule: Glass terrace balustrade must be fabricated from tempered (fully toughened) or laminated glass, or a combination, so that if broken it does not create large, sharp falling shards that could cause severe injury.
conditions: Balustrade is located where people can fall against or through it
Glass is the primary infill or structural element
exceptions: Glass is entirely behind a separate, code-compliant guard that prevents any human contact with the glass

subject: Glass Terrace Balustrade
rule: Glass terrace balustrade must not be the only horizontal attachment point for a handrail that is required to support the full body weight of a person falling.
conditions: Handrail is present and is required by code to serve as a grab for lateral support
exceptions: Glass balustrade system has been specifically tested and certified to withstand the full handrail load without failure in a brittle manner

subject: Private Terrace Space
rule: Private terrace space must have a continuous waterproof membrane separating it from the interior space below
conditions: terrace is located above interior habitable space
exceptions: terrace is at grade level with no interior space beneath

subject: Private Terrace Space
rule: Private terrace space must have a minimum slope of 1% (1:100) toward a drainage outlet
conditions: terrace is exposed to rainfall
exceptions: terrace is fully covered by a solid roof or canopy that sheds water away from the terrace surface

subject: Private Terrace Space
rule: Private terrace space must not have any floor drain or plumbing vent that allows sewer gases to enter the occupied outdoor space
conditions: terrace contains floor drains or plumbing vents
exceptions: drains are equipped with code-compliant trap primers and airtight covers that prevent gas escape

subject: Built-In Terrace Bench/Seating
rule: Built-in terrace bench/seat must have a minimum seat depth between 400mm and 500mm
conditions: Bench is intended for comfortable human seating
exceptions: Decorative-only benches not intended for sitting
Sleeping platforms that have different ergonomic requirements

subject: Built-In Terrace Bench/Seating
rule: Built-in terrace bench/seat must have a seat height between 380mm and 480mm from finished floor
conditions: Bench is intended for standard adult seating
exceptions: Children's seating areas where lower heights are intentional
Bar-height or counter-height seating with footrails provided

subject: Built-In Terrace Bench/Seating
rule: Built-in terrace bench/seat must not have sharp corners or edges on the seating surface or within the knee-swing zone
conditions: Bench is in a publicly accessible area
exceptions: None — this is a safety requirement without exception for occupied spaces

subject: Built-In Terrace Bench/Seating
rule: Built-in terrace bench/seat must have a backrest if seat height exceeds 480mm
conditions: Bench is intended for seating
Bench is accessible to general users
exceptions: Bar/counter seating where perched posture is intentional and foot support is provided

subject: Built-In Terrace Bench/Seating
rule: Built-in terrace bench/seat must have a clear knee space of at least 300mm in front of the seat if enclosed on the front face
conditions: Bench has a solid front panel or enclosed front face
exceptions: Benches with open space below the seat (no front obstruction)

subject: Canopy/Awning Over Terrace
rule: canopy/awning over terrace must resist wind uplift forces
conditions: located in wind zone
exposed to prevailing winds
exceptions: temporary or seasonal awnings that are retracted during high wind events

subject: Canopy/Awning Over Terrace
rule: canopy/awning over terrace must have a minimum slope for water runoff
conditions: fabric or solid roofing material
not designed as a permanently retractable louver system that drains through gaps

subject: Canopy/Awning Over Terrace
rule: canopy/awning over terrace must not obstruct egress paths or required fire-exit routes
conditions: located over or adjacent to a door, stair, or path serving as an exit
exceptions: if the canopy is fully retractable and stows clear of the egress zone when not deployed

subject: Canopy/Awning Over Terrace
rule: canopy/awning over terrace must be attached to a structurally adequate support (wall, beam, or column)
conditions: supporting structure exists

subject: Privacy Screen/Louver
rule: privacy screen/louver must have openings that allow adequate air passage when used for ventilation
conditions: when integrated with building ventilation system
exceptions: when purely decorative with no ventilation function

subject: Privacy Screen/Louver
rule: privacy screen/louver must be structurally secured against wind loads
conditions: when installed externally on building facade

subject: Privacy Screen/Louver
rule: privacy screen/louver must not fully obstruct required emergency egress or fire escape routes
conditions: when installed in front of windows or doors serving as means of egress
exceptions: if operable/latching mechanism allows emergency opening from inside without tools

subject: Privacy Screen/Louver
rule: privacy screen/louver must not trap moisture against the building envelope leading to condensation or decay
conditions: when installed directly against exterior wall cladding without drainage gap
exceptions: if back-ventilated assembly with weep provisions is designed

subject: Privacy Screen/Louver
rule: privacy screen/louver must have fire-resistance rating compatible with adjacent building elements when required by code
conditions: when installed on fire-rated exterior wall assemblies or within required fire separation distances
exceptions: where code allows unprotected openings based on distance or sprinkler protection

subject: Room Enclosure System
rule: room enclosure system must provide a continuous air barrier to prevent uncontrolled air leakage
conditions: conditioning system present
occupancy requires thermal comfort control
exceptions: unconditioned spaces such as storage or parking garages

subject: Room Enclosure System
rule: room enclosure system must separate interior from exterior with a water-resistant barrier to prevent bulk water intrusion
conditions: exposed to exterior environment
exceptions: fully interior rooms with no exterior walls or roof exposure

subject: Room Enclosure System
rule: room enclosure system must not have a thermal bridge that bypasses the primary insulation layer by more than the code-allowed percentage
conditions: heated or cooled space
climate zone requires insulation
exceptions: unconditioned structures with no insulation requirement

subject: Room Enclosure System
rule: room enclosure system must control vapor diffusion to prevent condensation within the assembly
conditions: enclosure separates conditioned interior from exterior in a climate with significant heating or cooling seasons
exceptions: buildings in very dry climates where vapor drive is negligible

subject: Interior Wall Finishes
rule: Interior wall finishes must be non-combustible or fire-rated in means of egress and exit enclosures
conditions: Wall is part of a means of egress
Wall is in an exit enclosure (e.g., stairwell)
Building is subject to IBC or equivalent code
exceptions: One- and two-family dwellings
Buildings with sprinkler systems where code allows reduced ratings

subject: Interior Wall Finishes
rule: Interior wall finishes must not exceed the flame spread index and smoke-developed index limits set by code for the occupancy and location
conditions: Wall is in a commercial, institutional, or multi-family residential building
exceptions: Single-family residential where codes may be less restrictive

subject: Interior Wall Finishes
rule: Interior wall finishes must not harbor or promote mold growth in moisture-prone areas
conditions: Wall is in a wet or damp location (e.g., bathroom, shower, laundry, basement)
Wall is in a climate with high humidity

subject: Interior Wall Finishes
rule: Interior wall finishes must be cleanable and non-absorbent in hygiene-critical occupancies
conditions: Occupancy is healthcare (hospital, clinic)
Occupancy is food preparation or food service
Occupancy is laboratory
exceptions: Spaces not subject to direct contamination (e.g., administrative offices in a hospital)

subject: Electrical Power Outlets
rule: electrical power outlet must have proper grounding connection
conditions: outlet is of a type that requires grounding (e.g., 3-prong NEMA 5-15R)
exceptions: double-insulated Class II devices on circuits where local code permits ungrounded outlets in existing buildings

subject: Electrical Power Outlets
rule: electrical power outlet must not have reversed polarity (hot and neutral swapped)
conditions: outlet is a standard AC power receptacle with polarized configuration

subject: Electrical Power Outlets
rule: electrical power outlet must be rated for the voltage and current of the circuit it serves

subject: Electrical Power Outlets
rule: electrical power outlet must be mounted in a listed electrical box that is securely fastened

subject: Built-in Storage
rule: built-in storage must be ventilated to prevent moisture accumulation when enclosing a habitable or unconditioned space
conditions: when storage is enclosed on all sides
when storage is located in a climate zone with seasonal humidity
exceptions: when storage is conditioned and part of the HVAC pressure boundary
when storage is designed as a sealed dry-goods pantry with vapor-proof construction

subject: Built-in Storage
rule: built-in storage must not block egress pathways or emergency escape routes
conditions: when located in a corridor, stairwell, or designated egress path
when projecting more than the code-allowed encroachment into a means of egress
exceptions: when the storage is recessed or fully within the wall plane and does not reduce the clear egress width below code minimum

subject: Built-in Storage
rule: built-in storage must have a fire-rated enclosure when sharing a wall with an attached garage
conditions: when the storage is built into a wall that is common with an attached garage
exceptions: when the storage is not within the required fire-separation assembly (e.g., garage-side only shelving not penetrating the rated membrane)

subject: Built-in Storage
rule: built-in storage must be structurally supported by the building frame and not rely on finishes alone for load transfer
conditions: when the storage is designed to carry a live load (e.g., shelving with stored items)
exceptions: when the storage is a lightweight decorative unit with a total design load under 5 psf (e.g., a shallow shelf)

subject: Room Security System Components
rule: Room security system components must be physically secured against tampering and unauthorized removal
conditions: component is installed in a publicly accessible or uncontrolled area
exceptions: components located within continuously monitored secure zones with 24/7 guard surveillance

subject: Room Security System Components
rule: Room security system components must not be installed in locations exposed to water ingress or condensation without appropriate environmental protection
conditions: component is an electronic device (reader, controller, sensor, panel)
exceptions: components explicitly rated and certified for wet/damp locations (e.g., IP65+ rated outdoor readers)

subject: Fixed Auditorium Seating
rule: Fixed auditorium seating must be securely anchored to the floor/structure
conditions: seating is installed as fixed/permanent

subject: Fixed Auditorium Seating
rule: The row-to-row spacing (row depth) of fixed auditorium seating must provide a minimum clear aisle width compliant with applicable building code for means of egress
conditions: seating configuration includes multiple rows

subject: Fixed Auditorium Seating
rule: The seat width must not be less than the applicable code minimum for assembly seating

subject: Fixed Auditorium Seating
rule: Fixed auditorium seating must not obstruct any required means of egress door or exit pathway

subject: Bleacher/Retractable Seating
rule: Retractable/bleacher seating must have a positive locking mechanism to prevent unintended movement during use
conditions: seating is retractable or movable
exceptions: fixed bleacher seating without moving parts

subject: Bleacher/Retractable Seating
rule: Retractable/bleacher seating must have a guardrail or barrier at any open side where the floor elevation change exceeds 30 inches (762 mm)
conditions: seating platform is elevated more than 30 inches above adjacent floor or grade
exceptions: seating with a solid wall or enclosure at the open side
seating at aisle access points where a gap is necessary for egress

subject: Bleacher/Retractable Seating
rule: Retractable/bleacher seating must not be loaded beyond its design live load capacity
conditions: seating is in use by spectators

subject: Bleacher/Retractable Seating
rule: The gap between adjacent retractable bleacher platforms must not exceed 1 inch (25 mm) when the units are fully deployed and interlocked
conditions: seating is fully deployed for use

subject: Bleacher/Retractable Seating
rule: Retractable seating units must have a secondary (redundant) braking or backstop system independent of the primary drive mechanism
conditions: seating is mechanically powered (motorized retraction/extension)
seating units are on an inclined floor or slope
exceptions: manually operated units where stored energy is not present in the deployed configuration

subject: Built-In Bench Seating
rule: Built-in bench seating must be structurally anchored to the floor, wall, or supporting structure
conditions: when the bench is fixed/immovable
when the bench supports human occupancy load

subject: Built-In Bench Seating
rule: Built-in bench seating must have a horizontal seat surface that supports intended occupancy loads without failure

subject: Built-In Bench Seating
rule: Built-in bench seating must not have sharp edges, corners, or protrusions at occupant contact points
conditions: when the bench is in a publicly accessible area or egress path

subject: Lecture Hall Tiered Floor
rule: Tiered floor must have a minimum step height of at least 100 mm (4 inches) between successive tiers to ensure each row is visible from the row behind
conditions: The lecture hall uses fixed seating arranged in tiers
Seating rows are oriented toward a central focal point (stage/podium)
exceptions: Lecture halls designed exclusively for flat-floor use with no tiered seating

subject: Lecture Hall Tiered Floor
rule: Tiered floor must have a maximum step height of no more than 210 mm (8.25 inches) between successive tiers
conditions: The lecture hall uses fixed seating arranged in tiers
exceptions: Spaces not intended for public assembly or not requiring egress compliance

subject: Lecture Hall Tiered Floor
rule: Tiered floor must have a continuous stepped structural support system capable of transferring vertical loads from each tier level to the building foundation
conditions: The floor is constructed as a permanent, built-in tiered system
exceptions: Demountable or portable seating platforms that are not structurally integrated with the building

subject: Lecture Hall Tiered Floor
rule: Tiered floor must not have a tread depth (horizontal distance from riser to riser) that is less than the depth required for the installed seating row plus minimum egress aisle width
conditions: Fixed seating is installed on the tiered floor
exceptions: Floor designed without fixed seating (e.g., standing-only lecture tiers)

subject: Seating Row Walkway/Step Lighting
rule: Seating row walkway/step lighting must produce no glare that impairs the vision of performers or audience members
conditions: when lighting is operational during performance
exceptions: lighting designed with louvers or baffles that control emission angle

subject: Seating Row Walkway/Step Lighting
rule: Seating row walkway/step lighting must be positioned and shielded so that it does not create a tripping hazard or obstacle in the egress path

subject: Seating Row Walkway/Step Lighting
rule: Seating row walkway/step lighting must provide minimum illuminance of at least 1 foot-candle (approximately 10 lux) on walking surfaces during egress conditions
conditions: when used as means of egress lighting
exceptions: when separate emergency/egress lighting system is provided

subject: Seating Row Walkway/Step Lighting
rule: Seating row walkway/step lighting must be rated for wet or damp location if installed outdoors or in unenclosed conditions
conditions: where fixture is exposed to rain, condensation, or moisture

subject: Bed Platform
rule: bed platform must support the weight of the mattress and occupants without collapse or excessive deflection

subject: Bed Platform
rule: bed platform slats or deck must not have gaps exceeding the mattress manufacturer's specified maximum
conditions: when supporting a mattress that requires continuous or closely-spaced support (e.g., foam or pocket-spring mattress)

subject: Bed Platform
rule: bed platform must be made from materials that do not pose a fire hazard under normal use conditions

subject: Built-in Headboard
rule: Built-in headboard must be securely anchored to the bed frame or wall structure
conditions: when the headboard is designed to bear the weight of a person leaning or sitting against it
in any permanent installation
exceptions: free-standing headboard units that are not built-in

subject: Built-in Headboard
rule: Built-in headboard must not obstruct access to electrical outlets, light switches, or bedside controls that are intended to remain usable
conditions: when the headboard is positioned against a wall that contains electrical fixtures
when the room design requires those fixtures to remain accessible
exceptions: when outlets and switches are purposefully relocated or covered as part of the design

subject: Built-in Headboard
rule: Built-in headboard must have a minimum clearance from the mattress surface to prevent entrapment
conditions: when the headboard extends below the top surface of the mattress
exceptions: headboards designed with intentional mattress-recess detailing that eliminates the gap

subject: Personal Storage Unit
rule: personal storage unit must have a weatherproof enclosure (walls, roof, and door) that prevents water ingress
conditions: unit is located outdoors
unit is used for storing items that must remain dry
exceptions: unit is an indoor-only shelving system with no external exposure

subject: Personal Storage Unit
rule: personal storage unit door must be openable from the inside without special tools or keys
conditions: unit is large enough for a person to enter (typically > 2m tall interior)
unit has a door that latches or locks closed
exceptions: unit is a small locker not intended for human entry

subject: Personal Storage Unit
rule: personal storage unit must not have unvented gas or fuel-burning appliances inside the enclosed volume
conditions: unit is fully enclosed and not continuously ventilated to the outdoors
exceptions: unit has forced mechanical ventilation interlocked with appliance operation
unit is not intended for human occupancy and has no combustion source

subject: Mattress and Bedding Base
rule: mattress and bedding base must provide a flat, level sleeping surface that distributes occupant weight evenly
conditions: when used as a sleeping surface for humans

subject: Mattress and Bedding Base
rule: mattress and bedding base must not contain protruding rigid elements on the sleeping surface that could cause injury to an occupant
conditions: when used as a sleeping surface

subject: Mattress and Bedding Base
rule: mattress and bedding base must be composed of materials that do not off-gas toxic volatiles at levels harmful to human health under normal use conditions
conditions: when intended for indoor residential use

subject: Mattress and Bedding Base
rule: mattress and bedding base must be able to support the maximum expected static load without permanent deformation that compromises its shape or function

subject: Bathtub
rule: bathtub must have a water-resistant interior surface and sealed joints
conditions: when used as a water-holding vessel
exceptions: decorative bathtubs not intended for use with water

subject: Bathtub
rule: bathtub must have a drain opening at or near the lowest point of the basin
conditions: when plumbed for use
exceptions: freestanding soaking tubs used without permanent plumbing where water is bailed out manually

subject: Bathtub
rule: bathtub must not have an overflow opening positioned below the designed water-fill level
conditions: when equipped with an overflow drain

subject: Shower Tray
rule: Shower tray must have a continuous slope (fall) toward the drain outlet
conditions: tray is of the wet-floor type (no separate raised shower base)
exceptions: tray is designed as a level-access ('walk-on') tray with a linear trench drain integrated along one edge such that the entire floor is level and drainage is via the trench system

subject: Shower Tray
rule: Shower tray must not have any upturned edge or lip lower than the finished floor level on the access side
conditions: tray is used in a level-access (barrier-free) shower installation
exceptions: tray is installed with a recessed channel at the threshold that provides drainage while maintaining a level transition

subject: Shower Tray
rule: Shower tray must have a waterproof (impermeable) substrate throughout its entire surface area

subject: Shower Enclosure
rule: Shower enclosure must have a waterproof lining or membrane on all wet surfaces
conditions: enclosure is used as a wet-area shower

subject: Shower Enclosure
rule: Shower enclosure must have a sloped floor or base directing water to a drain
exceptions: walk-in steam showers with no integral floor drain where water is manually removed

subject: Shower Enclosure
rule: Shower enclosure must not have electrical fixtures or outlets within the direct spray zone unless rated for wet locations
conditions: enclosure contains electrical components such as lights, fans, or outlets
exceptions: fixtures listed and labeled for wet-location use per applicable electrical code

subject: Shower Enclosure
rule: Shower enclosure must have a door or curtain that prevents water from escaping onto surrounding floor area
conditions: enclosure is not a walk-in open wet room with floor drain sloping to a central point

subject: Shower Enclosure
rule: Shower enclosure floor or threshold must be watertight at all joints and penetrations

subject: Washbasin
rule: Washbasin must have a waste outlet connected to a drainage system
conditions: when used in a building with plumbing
exceptions: decorative washbasins not intended for water use

subject: Washbasin
rule: Washbasin must be watertight
conditions: when used for handwashing or other water-based activities

subject: Washbasin
rule: Washbasin must_not have its water supply inlet positioned below the overflow level
conditions: when equipped with an overflow drain

subject: Washbasin
rule: Washbasin mounting must support the weight of the basin when filled with water plus typical applied loads
conditions: when wall-mounted or pedestal-mounted

subject: Toilet
rule: toilet must have a vent pipe connected to a sanitary drainage or sewer system
conditions: toilet is water-flush type
exceptions: dry compost toilet
chemical toilet
incinerating toilet

subject: Toilet
rule: toilet must have a water supply connection of adequate pressure when designed as a flush toilet
conditions: toilet is water-flush type
exceptions: manual bucket-flush toilet
gravity-flush cistern with pressurised mains not required

subject: Toilet
rule: toilet waste outlet must be connected to a sewer or septic system
conditions: toilet is water-flush type
exceptions: composting toilet where solids are contained on-site
incinerating toilet

subject: Toilet
rule: toilet pan with integrated siphon trap must not be installed without a trap seal
conditions: toilet has an integral siphon trap design

subject: Towel Rail / Radiator
rule: towel rail / radiator must be securely fixed to a load-bearing wall or mounting surface capable of supporting its weight when loaded with wet towels
conditions: when installed as a wall-mounted unit
exceptions: freestanding towel rails not attached to walls

subject: Towel Rail / Radiator
rule: towel rail / radiator must not block access to electrical outlets, switches, or valves that require regular operation or maintenance
conditions: when positioned near existing building services
exceptions: if the outlet/switch/valve is relocated or made inaccessible by design as a deliberate choice

subject: Towel Rail / Radiator
rule: towel rail / radiator must maintain minimum clearance from combustible materials (e.g., towels, curtains) as specified by manufacturer and local building code for heat-emitting devices
conditions: when the towel rail functions as a heated radiator emitting surface temperatures above ambient

subject: Towel Rail / Radiator
rule: towel rail / radiator must be connected to the building's plumbing or heating system in a manner that prevents leaks at all joints and connections
conditions: when plumbed into a hot water or central heating system
exceptions: electrically heated towel rails with no water connections

subject: Bathroom Vanity / Cabinet
rule: Bathroom vanity / cabinet countertop must be a minimum of 25mm (1 inch) thick when made of natural stone to prevent cracking under typical loads
conditions: countertop material is natural stone (granite, marble, quartzite)
exceptions: engineered quartz or solid-surface countertops with reinforced backing

subject: Bathroom Vanity / Cabinet
rule: Bathroom vanity / cabinet must have a backsplash that extends at least 50mm (2 inches) up the wall from the countertop surface
conditions: vanity is installed against a wall
exceptions: freestanding vanities not placed against a wall

subject: Bathroom Vanity / Cabinet
rule: Bathroom vanity / cabinet must not have electrical outlets installed inside the cabinet interior without a GFCI-protected and enclosed junction box
conditions: cabinet contains an electrical outlet

subject: Bathroom Vanity / Cabinet
rule: Bathroom vanity / cabinet sink basin must be sealed at all joints between basin and countertop
conditions: vanity includes an installed sink

subject: Bathroom Vanity / Cabinet
rule: Bathroom vanity / cabinet plumbing access panel or removable drawer front must be provided at the sink trap area
conditions: vanity has an enclosed base (doors or drawers below sink)
exceptions: open-shelf vanities with no enclosure below the sink

subject: Bathroom Lighting
rule: bathroom lighting fixtures must be UL-listed for damp locations
conditions: fixture is located in a shower or bath area within zone 1 or 2
installation in residential or commercial bathroom
exceptions: fixture is a low-voltage (< 15V) LED strip sealed to IP65 or higher and installed outside direct spray zones

subject: Bathroom Lighting
rule: bathroom lighting must not be installed within the prohibited zone above a bathtub or shower
conditions: ceiling-mounted fixture above bathtub or shower
exceptions: fixture is listed for wet locations and installed according to manufacturer's clearance instructions

subject: Bathroom Lighting
rule: recessed bathroom luminaires must be IC-rated when in contact with insulation
conditions: recessed fixture installed in insulated ceiling
fixture will be covered by or adjacent to thermal insulation
exceptions: fixture housing is marked 'non-IC' and a minimum 3-inch clearance is maintained from all insulation

subject: Bathroom Lighting
rule: bathroom lighting must be protected by a Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter (GFCI)
conditions: lighting circuit serves receptacles in the bathroom
lighting circuit is rated 120V, 15 or 20 amperes
exceptions: lighting is on a dedicated branch circuit with no receptacles and is not within 1.5 m of a water source

subject: Bathroom Lighting
rule: bathroom light fixtures must have a minimum clearance from combustibles
conditions: fixture uses incandescent, halogen, or HID lamp
fixture surface temperature exceeds 90 °C
exceptions: fixture is listed as 'suitable for installation in direct contact with combustible material' (e.g., IC-rated recessed)

subject: Exhaust Fan / Ventilation
rule: Exhaust fan/ventilation ducted to the exterior must terminate at an exterior location that does not recirculate exhaust back into building air intakes
conditions: ducted exhaust system
exterior termination
exceptions: recirculating range hoods designed to filter and return air to the space

subject: Exhaust Fan / Ventilation
rule: Exhaust fan discharge must not terminate in an attic, ceiling plenum, or interstitial space that is not designed as an exhaust path
conditions: any exhaust fan system
exceptions: systems specifically designed and rated for attic ventilation (e.g., powered attic ventilators)

subject: Exhaust Fan / Ventilation
rule: Exhaust fan serving a bathroom, toilet room, or kitchen must be ducted to the building exterior
conditions: fan serves bathroom, toilet room, or kitchen
exceptions: recirculating range hoods in kitchens that comply with applicable codes and only remove grease/odors without moisture

subject: Exhaust Fan / Ventilation
rule: Exhaust fan must not terminate within 3 feet of an operable window, door, or building air intake unless local codes permit a lesser distance
conditions: exhaust termination near openings or intakes
exceptions: jurisdictions with adopted codes that specify different setbacks

subject: Exhaust Fan / Ventilation
rule: Exhaust fan installed in a fire-rated assembly must include a fire damper rated to the same fire-resistance rating as the assembly
conditions: fan penetrates a fire-rated wall, floor, or ceiling assembly
exceptions: duct systems entirely within the same fire compartment that do not penetrate a rated separation

subject: Hot Water Supply Piping
rule: Hot water supply piping must be insulated to prevent heat loss and protect against thermal burns
conditions: piping carries water heated above 60°C (140°F)
piping is located in accessible or occupied spaces
exceptions: piping that is intentionally uninsulated for heat dissipation (e.g., within a mechanical room where waste heat is acceptable)

subject: Hot Water Supply Piping
rule: Hot water supply piping must be rated for the maximum operating temperature and pressure of the system

subject: Hot Water Supply Piping
rule: Hot water supply piping must not be installed in direct contact with incompatible metals (dissimilar metal corrosion)
conditions: dissimilar metals are in contact in the presence of water
exceptions: dielectric unions, bushings, or insulating couplings are used to separate dissimilar metals

subject: Hot Water Supply Piping
rule: Hot water supply piping must be provided with means for thermal expansion control
conditions: system includes a closed-loop or check-valve configuration
exceptions: open systems where expanded water can backflow into the cold water supply without restriction

subject: Cold Water Supply Piping
rule: Cold water supply piping must be protected from freezing
conditions: piping is located in areas subject to freezing temperatures
piping is installed in unconditioned spaces
piping is installed in exterior walls
exceptions: piping is designed as a freeze-tolerant system (e.g., recirculation loop maintains flow)
piping is installed with approved heat tracing and insulation system rated for the climate

subject: Cold Water Supply Piping
rule: Cold water supply piping must be installed with adequate pressure rating to withstand maximum expected static and operating pressure
conditions: system is connected to a pressurized water main or booster pump system

subject: Cold Water Supply Piping
rule: Cold water supply piping must not be directly connected to a sewer, drainage system, or non-potable source without an approved backflow prevention device
conditions: piping is part of a potable water system
exceptions: system is a dedicated non-potable cold water system clearly labeled and separated

subject: Cold Water Supply Piping
rule: Cold water supply piping must be supported at intervals specified by the pipe material and applicable code
conditions: piping is installed in a horizontal or vertical run exceeding standard support spacing

subject: Cold Water Supply Piping
rule: Cold water supply piping must not be installed in direct contact with corrosive materials or dissimilar metals without dielectric insulation
conditions: piping material is copper, steel, or other metal
piping contacts a dissimilar metal or corrosive substance
exceptions: manufacturer-rated transition fittings with built-in dielectric properties are used

subject: Waste & Drainage Piping
rule: waste and drainage piping must maintain minimum slope for gravity drainage
conditions: piping is configured for gravity flow (non-pressurized)
exceptions: pressurized drainage systems (e.g., sewage ejector systems) where positive pressure drives flow

subject: Waste & Drainage Piping
rule: waste and drainage piping must not have trapped air pockets or reverse gradients that prevent flow

subject: Waste & Drainage Piping
rule: waste and drainage piping must be vented to prevent siphonage and trap seal loss
conditions: piping is part of a sanitary drainage system with trap fixtures

subject: Waste & Drainage Piping
rule: waste and drainage piping must be sized to handle peak flow without surcharging
conditions: system receives intermittent high-volume discharge (e.g., multiple fixtures, rainfall on roof drains)

subject: Waste & Drainage Piping
rule: waste and drainage piping must not connect to potable water supply piping
exceptions: approved backflow prevention devices that provide an air gap or reduced-pressure zone assembly

subject: Sanitary Pipe Vent
rule: Sanitary pipe vent must terminate above the roof surface
conditions: Vent pipe penetrates roof assembly
System is gravity-drained
exceptions: Vent terminates in a mechanical penthouse or interior stack if combined with air admittance valve (AAV) and local code permits

subject: Sanitary Pipe Vent
rule: Sanitary pipe vent must maintain minimum separation from roof obstructions, openings, and building air intakes
conditions: Vent terminal is located on roof
exceptions: Separation distances may be reduced if local code provides specific alternative clearance values

subject: Sanitary Pipe Vent
rule: Sanitary pipe vent must not be trapped or obstructed by debris, bird screens, or undersized caps
exceptions: Approved vent caps designed with open area equal to or greater than pipe cross-sectional area are not considered obstructions

subject: Floor Waterproofing Membrane
rule: Floor waterproofing membrane must form a continuous, unbroken barrier across the entire floor area it is intended to protect
conditions: When installed as part of a wet-area or below-grade floor assembly
exceptions: Joints and penetrations may be present if they are detailed with purpose-made sealed connections that preserve barrier continuity

subject: Floor Waterproofing Membrane
rule: Floor waterproofing membrane must not be installed directly over a structural expansion joint without a purpose-designed accommodating detail
conditions: When the underlying structural slab includes an expansion joint
exceptions: Proprietary expansion-joint waterproofing systems designed to accommodate movement while maintaining watertightness are acceptable

subject: Floor Waterproofing Membrane
rule: Floor waterproofing membrane must be applied to a substrate that is sufficiently cured, clean, and free of laitance, dust, oil, or loose particles
conditions: During installation onto concrete or cementitious substrate

subject: Bathroom Tiles (Wall & Floor)
rule: Bathroom wall and floor tiles must be water-resistant (non-absorbent, impervious to moisture)
conditions: Tile is installed in a wet or damp area (shower, bath surround, bathroom floor)

subject: Bathroom Tiles (Wall & Floor)
rule: Bathroom floor tiles must have a slip-resistant surface (adequate coefficient of friction when wet)
conditions: Tile is used on a bathroom floor surface

subject: Bathroom Tiles (Wall & Floor)
rule: Bathroom floor tiles must not be installed on a surface not designed to support the tile load (excessive weight relative to substrate capacity)
conditions: Tile material has high density (e.g., natural stone, thick porcelain)
Substrate or floor structure has limited load-bearing capacity

subject: Wall Waterproofing / Tanking
rule: Wall waterproofing/tanking must form a continuous barrier without gaps or voids
conditions: applied to below-grade walls
applied to wet-room walls
applied to retaining walls
exceptions: where waterproofing is achieved by integral water-resistant concrete mix and no membrane is used

subject: Wall Waterproofing / Tanking
rule: Wall waterproofing/tanking must not be applied to a damp or frozen substrate
conditions: any application of cementitious or sheet membrane tanking
exceptions: fully bonded liquid-applied membranes specifically formulated for damp substrates per manufacturer's data

subject: Wall Waterproofing / Tanking
rule: Wall waterproofing/tanking must lap with floor waterproofing to form a continuous tray
conditions: wall and floor both receive tanking in the same basement or wet-room enclosure

subject: Grab Bar / Handrail
rule: grab bar / handrail must be securely anchored to structure capable of supporting minimum 250 lb (1.1 kN) load applied in any direction
conditions: installed for fall prevention or ADA compliance
exceptions: temporary or decorative grab bars not intended for weight bearing

subject: Grab Bar / Handrail
rule: grab bar / handrail must have a slip-resistant gripping surface
conditions: installed in wet or potentially wet locations such as bathrooms, showers, or pool areas
exceptions: handrails installed exclusively in dry indoor areas where slip resistance is not required by code

subject: Grab Bar / Handrail
rule: grab bar / handrail must not have a diameter less than 1.25 inches (32 mm) nor greater than 2 inches (51 mm)
conditions: installed for ADA-compliant or public accessibility purposes
exceptions: non-ADA residential installations where local code permits other sizes

subject: Grab Bar / Handrail
rule: grab bar / handrail must have a minimum 1.5 inch (38 mm) clearance from the wall surface
conditions: installed as a wall-mounted grab bar or handrail
exceptions: recessed grab bars specifically designed to be flush-mounted

subject: Grab Bar / Handrail
rule: grab bar / handrail must not rotate or detach from its mounting brackets under designed load
conditions: any permanent installation
exceptions: handrails designed with intentional rotational elements for specific functional purposes, if rated for load in all positions

subject: Bathroom Door
rule: a bathroom door must have a privacy lock or latch mechanism
conditions: door is used as a primary access point to a bathroom
exceptions: door is to a fully public/communal toilet with no expectation of privacy

subject: Bathroom Door
rule: a bathroom door must open outward or be sized to allow emergency access if a person collapses inside
conditions: the bathroom is smaller than 2.5 m² in floor area
exceptions: door is a sliding/pocket door that does not swing into the room

subject: Bathroom Door
rule: a bathroom door must not have a threshold higher than 13 mm (1/2 inch)
conditions: the bathroom is required to be accessible per applicable building code
exceptions: threshold beveled to allow wheelchair passage

subject: Bathroom Door
rule: a bathroom door must resist moisture and not warp when exposed to high humidity
conditions: bathroom has a shower or bath creating steam

subject: Wet Room System
rule: Wet room floor must be sloped toward a drain
conditions: floor is part of the wet room system
drain is present
exceptions: floor is a prefabricated single-slope pan with integral drainage

subject: Wet Room System
rule: Wet room floor substrate must be completely waterproofed before tile or finish is applied
conditions: substrate is cement board, plywood, or poured mortar bed
exceptions: system uses a one-piece waterproof receptor pan listed as the finished surface

subject: Wet Room System
rule: Wet room wall-to-floor joint must be waterproofed with a flexible membrane or sealant
conditions: wall and floor meet at a change-of-plane corner within the wet area
exceptions: wall and floor are a single monolithic waterproof casting with no joint

subject: Wet Room System
rule: Wet room must not contain any electrical fixtures not rated for wet-location use
conditions: electrical fixtures are present within the wet-room zone

subject: Sauna / Steam Room Inserts
rule: Sauna / steam room inserts must be vapor-sealed on all sides facing the building structure
conditions: insert is installed within a wall, ceiling, or floor assembly
exceptions: insert is a free-standing prefabricated unit with its own factory-integrated vapor barrier

subject: Sauna / Steam Room Inserts
rule: Sauna / steam room inserts must not have untreated wood in direct contact with steam room interior surfaces
conditions: insert forms the interior lining of a steam room (as opposed to a dry sauna)
exceptions: wood is a species rated for wet environments (e.g., cedar, thermory ash) and is sealed with appropriate high-temperature moisture-resistant finish

subject: Sauna / Steam Room Inserts
rule: Sauna / steam room inserts must maintain a minimum slope on any overhead surface to prevent condensate dripping
conditions: insert includes a ceiling panel or overhead surface within the steam room or sauna
exceptions: ceiling is designed with a condensate gutter system or drip channel

subject: Dry Bulk Storage
rule: enclosed dry bulk storage must have ventilation to prevent dust accumulation and combustible gas buildup
conditions: storage space is enclosed
material stored is combustible or generates dust
exceptions: space is only used for non-combustible, non-dusty bulk materials such as clean gravel or washed sand and is unoccupied

subject: Dry Bulk Storage
rule: dry bulk storage must not have floor drains that discharge directly to sanitary sewer without sediment interceptor
conditions: floor drains are present
exceptions: only clean water runoff is collected and no bulk material can enter the drain

subject: Dry Bulk Storage
rule: dry bulk storage roof must have a drainage path with slope sufficient to prevent ponding

subject: Liquid Bulk Storage
rule: Liquid bulk storage containment dike or berm must have a minimum volumetric capacity of 110% of the largest tank's volume within the diked area
conditions: Outdoor storage of liquids
Multiple tanks in same diked area
exceptions: Single tank with secondary containment demonstrated equivalent via engineering analysis

subject: Liquid Bulk Storage
rule: Liquid bulk storage tank vent must remain unobstructed and functional at all times
conditions: Fixed-roof or floating-roof atmospheric storage tank

subject: Liquid Bulk Storage
rule: Liquid bulk storage tank foundations must not be subject to differential settlement exceeding tank manufacturer's tolerance
conditions: Large-diameter vertical storage tanks on soil foundations

subject: Liquid Bulk Storage
rule: Liquid bulk storage must not allow incompatible reactive liquids to mix via shared piping, diking, or drainage
conditions: Multiple liquid products stored in same facility
exceptions: Separation by blind flange, spool piece removal, or dedicated dedicated systems with verifiable isolation

subject: Cold Bulk Storage
rule: Cold Bulk Storage must have a vapor barrier on the warm side of the insulation envelope
conditions: designed for refrigerated or frozen product storage
operating below ambient dew point temperature
exceptions: uninsulated structure not intended for temperature-controlled storage

subject: Cold Bulk Storage
rule: Cold Bulk Storage floor must withstand the full imposed load of stacked product plus forklift traffic without excessive deflection
conditions: designed for bulk solid or palletized product storage
exceptions: space used exclusively for light or non-stacked goods

subject: Cold Bulk Storage
rule: Cold Bulk Storage must not have uninsulated thermal bridges penetrating the envelope
conditions: operating in a temperature-controlled mode below or above ambient
exceptions: structures where thermal bridging is intentionally designed as part of a controlled freeze-thaw operation

subject: Bulk Storage Bin or Silo
rule: bulk storage bin or silo must have a pressure relief or venting system
conditions: enclosed
stores granular solids or powders
exceptions: open-top bins

subject: Bulk Storage Bin or Silo
rule: bulk storage bin or silo must have a discharge/outlet that allows complete emptying or cleanout
conditions: bottom is not designed to be removable
exceptions: bins designed for single-use disposal
bins with removable liners that are discarded with contents

subject: Bulk Storage Bin or Silo
rule: bulk storage bin or silo must not have sharp internal corners or crevices in contact with stored material
conditions: stores food, pharmaceutical, or hygroscopic materials
exceptions: non-food industrial aggregates where bridging/arching is not a concern

subject: Bulk Storage Racking System
rule: bulk storage racking system must be structurally stable under its maximum design load
conditions: when fully loaded to rated capacity

subject: Bulk Storage Racking System
rule: racking system must not exceed its rated load capacity per bay or shelf level
conditions: during normal storage operation

subject: Bulk Storage Racking System
rule: racking system must have vertical load paths from each storage level to the floor

subject: Bulk Storage Racking System
rule: racking system must be anchored or braced to resist overturning from horizontal forces
conditions: when rack height exceeds three times its base width
or when located in a seismic zone
exceptions: low-height racking with width-to-height ratio greater than 3:1 that is inherently stable without anchorage

subject: Bulk Storage Racking System
rule: racking system must be free from corrosion or damage that reduces load-bearing capacity of primary structural members
conditions: during service life

subject: Bulk Storage Racking System
rule: racking system must not have missing or damaged beam locks or safety clips at beam-to-upright connections
conditions: when beams are installed

subject: Bulk Storage Racking System
rule: racking system must not be used on a floor slab that cannot support the imposed load from rack footplates and pallet loads

subject: Bulk Storage Tank
rule: bulk storage tank must have a secondary containment system (e.g., dike, berm, or double-wall) for any single-walled tank containing liquid
conditions: tank contains liquid
tank is single-walled
exceptions: tank is double-walled and equipped with interstitial leak monitoring
tank is located within a vault or lined concrete pit that meets containment volume requirements

subject: Bulk Storage Tank
rule: bulk storage tank must be equipped with a venting device sized for the maximum fill and withdrawal rate
conditions: tank stores a liquid or gas at atmospheric or low-pressure conditions
tank is not a fully refrigerated closed system
exceptions: tank is designed as a fully pressurized vessel that does not rely on venting for overpressure protection

subject: Bulk Storage Tank
rule: bulk storage tank foundation must be designed to prevent differential settlement that exceeds the tank's structural tolerance
conditions: tank is supported on a foundation (not ground-supported directly)
tank diameter exceeds 10 m

subject: Bulk Storage Tank
rule: bulk storage tank must not have bottom welds or seams in contact with the ground or supporting surface unless protected against corrosion
conditions: tank bottom is made of carbon steel
tank is in contact with soil or a concrete pad
exceptions: tank bottom is cathodically protected
tank bottom has a corrosion-resistant lining or coating rated for the service environment

subject: Bulk Storage Hopper
rule: bulk storage hopper must have a minimum wall slope equal to or steeper than the angle of repose of the stored material to ensure complete emptying by gravity
conditions: hopper is designed for gravity discharge
no mechanical flow aid is provided
exceptions: hopper includes mechanical discharge aids such as vibrators, air cannons, or screw feeders that actively move material regardless of slope

subject: Bulk Storage Hopper
rule: bulk storage hopper must not have a discharge opening smaller than the maximum lump size of the bulk material
conditions: stored material contains lumps or agglomerates

subject: Bulk Storage Hopper
rule: bulk storage hopper must not have an unsupported cantilevered section that exceeds the buckling capacity of the wall material under the full bulk load

subject: Bulk Storage Conveyor System
rule: belt must be tensioned to prevent slip under full load
conditions: belt-driven conveyor

subject: Bulk Storage Conveyor System
rule: idler rollers must be spaced to prevent excessive belt sag between supports
conditions: belt conveyor

subject: Bulk Storage Conveyor System
rule: discharge chute must have a cross-section large enough to prevent clogging at peak flow rate
conditions: any bulk conveyor with a discharge chute

subject: Bulk Storage Conveyor System
rule: conveyor belt must not operate at a speed exceeding the manufacturer-rated maximum for the belt and material combination
conditions: belt conveyor

subject: Bulk Storage Conveyor System
rule: walkways and access platforms adjacent to the conveyor must have a minimum clear width of 600 mm for safe passage and emergency egress
conditions: conveyor with personnel access requirements

subject: Bulk Storage Floor Slab / Pad
rule: Bulk Storage Floor Slab / Pad must be designed for the maximum expected storage load (including live load from stored materials and dead load from the slab itself)
conditions: when used for bulk storage of materials
exceptions: If the slab/pad is only used for light storage or pedestrian access

subject: Bulk Storage Floor Slab / Pad
rule: Bulk Storage Floor Slab / Pad must have a minimum thickness adequate for the design loads and subgrade conditions
conditions: when cast-in-place concrete slab is used for bulk storage
exceptions: If a different structural system (e.g., precast or steel-framed floor) is used instead

subject: Bulk Storage Floor Slab / Pad
rule: Bulk Storage Floor Slab / Pad must be placed on properly compacted and prepared subgrade to prevent differential settlement
conditions: when slab-on-grade construction is used for bulk storage
exceptions: If the slab is structurally suspended/piled and not bearing on the subgrade

subject: Bulk Storage Floor Slab / Pad
rule: Bulk Storage Floor Slab / Pad must not have uncontrolled cracks or joints that compromise load transfer between slab sections
conditions: when the slab supports heavy bulk storage loads with forklift or heavy equipment traffic
exceptions: If joints are designed with proper load-transfer devices (e.g., dowels, keyed joints)

subject: Bulk Storage Wall / Bunker Wall
rule: Bulk Storage Wall / Bunker Wall must be designed to resist lateral earth pressure from stored bulk materials and/or soil when used as a retaining structure
conditions: Wall is retaining bulk materials (e.g., grain, coal, aggregate) or earth on one side
exceptions: Wall is not retaining any material (freestanding decorative wall)

subject: Bulk Storage Wall / Bunker Wall
rule: Bulk Storage Wall / Bunker Wall must include provisions for drainage or hydrostatic pressure relief
conditions: Wall retains earth or moisture-prone bulk material, or is located below grade
exceptions: Wall retains only dry, free-draining granular material with no water source present

subject: Bulk Storage Wall / Bunker Wall
rule: Bulk Storage Wall / Bunker Wall must not have uncontrolled openings at the base that permit bulk material flow leakage
conditions: Wall encloses granular bulk material (e.g., grains, sand, gravel)
exceptions: Openings are fitted with operable gates/valves designed for controlled material discharge

subject: Bulk Storage Ventilation System
rule: Bulk storage ventilation systems must maintain a minimum air velocity through stored bulk material to prevent spontaneous combustion or anaerobic decomposition
conditions: system stores organic bulk materials (e.g., grain, wood chips, coal)
system is in operation
exceptions: inert gas blanketing systems designed to suppress oxygen

subject: Bulk Storage Ventilation System
rule: Bulk storage ventilation systems must not allow moisture ingress into the stored bulk material through the ventilation openings
conditions: system is exposed to exterior weather conditions
stored material is hygroscopic or degradable by moisture
exceptions: system is designed specifically for wet storage or material washing

subject: Bulk Storage Ventilation System
rule: Bulk storage ventilation system ducts and plenums must be constructed of materials rated for the maximum potential temperature and dust explosion pressure of the stored material
conditions: system handles combustible dusts (e.g., grain, wood, coal, chemical powders)
exceptions: system handles only non-combustible liquids or inert solids

subject: Bulk Storage Ventilation System
rule: Bulk storage ventilation systems must provide a means of manual or automatic isolation from fire-rated building compartments
conditions: system penetrates fire-rated walls or floors
building is required to have fire compartmentation
exceptions: system is entirely external to the building envelope

subject: Bulk Storage Fire Protection System
rule: Bulk storage fire protection system must have an adequate and reliable water supply
conditions: system is water-based (e.g., sprinkler, deluge, foam-water)
exceptions: system uses only clean agent, dry chemical, or inert gas suppression that does not require water

subject: Bulk Storage Fire Protection System
rule: Bulk storage fire protection system must not have nozzles or discharge ports blocked by stored materials or storage racking
conditions: system includes fixed sprinklers or spray nozzles within or above storage arrays

subject: Bulk Storage Fire Protection System
rule: Bulk storage fire protection system must be designed for the specific commodity classification and storage arrangement (height, configuration, aisle width) being protected

subject: Bulk Storage Fire Protection System
rule: Bulk storage fire protection system must maintain required clearance between stored commodities and sprinkler deflectors
conditions: system is ceiling-mounted sprinkler system
exceptions: in-rack sprinklers designed specifically for those clearance constraints

subject: Bulk Storage Fire Protection System
rule: Bulk storage fire protection system must have fire protection piping sized to deliver required flow and pressure at the hydraulically most demanding point
conditions: system uses piping network for agent delivery

subject: Bulk Storage Access Door / Hatch
rule: Bulk storage access door/hatch must open outward or slide to allow egress without interference from stored materials
conditions: when intended for egress or personnel access
when located in a storage area where bulk materials may shift against the door
exceptions: when the hatch is a roof access hatch not used for egress and is secured from the inside

subject: Bulk Storage Access Door / Hatch
rule: Bulk storage access door/hatch must have a minimum clear opening width of at least 0.8 m (30 in) for personnel access
conditions: when the hatch is intended for personnel entry/exit
exceptions: when the hatch is strictly for material transfer and personnel entry is prohibited by design and signage

subject: Bulk Storage Access Door / Hatch
rule: Bulk storage access door/hatch must not be installed in a location where it is the sole roof access point if it opens inward
conditions: when located at roof level
when inward-opening
exceptions: when a secondary means of egress exists from the same roof area
