subject: Bulk Storage Loading / Unloading Area
rule: loading / unloading area must have a structurally adequate, load-bearing surface capable of supporting heavy vehicle loads (e.g., trucks, forklifts) without failure
conditions: area is used by motorized vehicles or heavy equipment

subject: Bulk Storage Loading / Unloading Area
rule: loading / unloading area must have a minimum clearance height that accommodates the tallest vehicle or equipment expected to use the space
conditions: area is covered or enclosed by a structure above
exceptions: uncovered open-air area with no overhead obstruction

subject: Bulk Storage Loading / Unloading Area
rule: loading dock or edge of the loading / unloading area must not be obstructed by fixed structures or walls that prevent vehicle backing or side access
conditions: area includes a loading dock or defined vehicle-access edge
exceptions: area is designed for top-loading only (e.g., overhead crane)

subject: Modular Floor Grid
rule: modular floor grid must be supported by a level structural substrate or frame capable of bearing its design load without excessive deflection
conditions: when installed in any load-bearing application
exceptions: temporary floor grids designed only for surface-level marking or layout reference

subject: Modular Floor Grid
rule: modular floor grid must not have gaps or misalignments between adjacent modules that exceed the system's specified tolerance
conditions: when the grid is walked on or supports equipment
exceptions: decorative/display grids not subject to foot or equipment traffic

subject: Modular Floor Grid
rule: modular floor grid must maintain electrical continuity across its grounding path if it contains conductive panels or structural elements
conditions: when the grid is used in an environment requiring electrical safety grounding (e.g., data centers, labs, industrial floors)
exceptions: fully non-conductive/polymeric grids with no metallic components

subject: Zone HVAC Diffuser / VAV Box
rule: A zone HVAC diffuser / VAV box must have a functional connection to a primary air source (HVAC air handler or central duct)
conditions: when the system is intended to deliver conditioned air to an occupied zone
exceptions: when the VAV box is installed as a non-operational placeholder or for future use

subject: Zone HVAC Diffuser / VAV Box
rule: The VAV box damper must not be physically blocked from opening or closing through its full range of motion
conditions: when the VAV box is installed and operational

subject: Zone HVAC Diffuser / VAV Box
rule: The diffuser must be physically connected to the VAV box outlet or ductwork such that air can pass without leakage that exceeds code-allowable limits
conditions: when the system is operational and delivering air to the zone

subject: Sliding / Folding Partition Door
rule: sliding / folding partition door must have a clear horizontal sliding or folding path free of obstructions
conditions: door is installed in an opening
door is operable (not fixed)
exceptions: door is permanently fixed/sealed closed

subject: Sliding / Folding Partition Door
rule: sliding / folding partition door must have an overhead track or floor guide system that is structurally supported at both ends
conditions: door is top-hung or overhead-track operated

subject: Sliding / Folding Partition Door
rule: sliding / folding partition door must not have its stacking/pocket space occupied by services (ducts, pipes, conduits)
conditions: door is a stacking or pocket type where leaves gather when open

subject: Sliding / Folding Partition Door
rule: sliding / folding partition door panel height must not exceed the clear head-room when fully opened
conditions: door folds or tilts upward during opening sequence

subject: Cafeteria Servery Line
rule: Cafeteria servery line must have a continuous, unobstructed path for tray slide or customer flow from start to end of the line
conditions: servery line is in active use for customer self-service
exceptions: lines designed as full-service (staff-served) where trays are handed directly

subject: Cafeteria Servery Line
rule: Cafeteria servery line must maintain minimum clear width of 0.9 m (36 in) at all points for wheelchair accessibility along the customer side
conditions: servery line serves the general public or is subject to accessibility regulations

subject: Cafeteria Servery Line
rule: Cafeteria servery line must not have any step or change in floor level along the customer pathway that exceeds 13 mm (0.5 in) without a ramp
conditions: servery line is in a facility open to the public

subject: Cafeteria Servery Line
rule: Hot food pans in a cafeteria servery line must be supported by a structure capable of withstanding their filled weight and thermal load without collapse
conditions: servery includes hot food stations with drop-in pans

subject: Dining Table (Fixed)
rule: Dining table must have a level (horizontal) top surface to prevent items from sliding off
conditions: When intended for serving food or holding objects
exceptions: Tables specifically designed with tilted or sloped surfaces for artistic/decorative purposes

subject: Dining Table (Fixed)
rule: Dining table must have a minimum top surface height sufficient to accommodate seated users' leg clearance
conditions: When designed for standard seated dining use
exceptions: Fixed-height bar tables or counter-height tables designed for standing or bar-stool seating where different leg-clearance standards apply

subject: Dining Table (Fixed)
rule: Dining table must not have sharp protruding edges or corners at seated-user head/eye height
conditions: When table is intended for use in occupied spaces where people walk near or sit at it
exceptions: Tables with explicit protective edge treatments or in contexts where sharp edges are part of the design brief

subject: Kitchen Exhaust Hood & Ductwork
rule: kitchen exhaust hood ductwork must terminate above the roof line with no low point where grease or condensate can accumulate
conditions: exhaust duct penetrates roof

subject: Kitchen Exhaust Hood & Ductwork
rule: kitchen exhaust ductwork must be constructed of steel of minimum thickness as specified by code with tight welded or bolted joints

subject: Kitchen Exhaust Hood & Ductwork
rule: kitchen exhaust hood ductwork must have no grease-laden vapor duct penetrating a fire-resistance-rated wall assembly unless enclosed in a shaft
conditions: duct passes through a fire-rated wall
duct carries grease-laden vapors

subject: Kitchen Exhaust Hood & Ductwork
rule: kitchen exhaust hood ductwork must not share a common exhaust system with any non-grease-producing appliance

subject: Kitchen Exhaust Hood & Ductwork
rule: kitchen exhaust hood ductwork must be accessible for cleaning along the entire duct run

subject: Fire Suppression System (Kitchen)
rule: kitchen fire suppression system must have a dedicated connection to an approved extinguishing agent supply
conditions: installed in commercial kitchen
fixed suppression system

subject: Fire Suppression System (Kitchen)
rule: kitchen fire suppression system must have fusible links or automatic heat detectors positioned over all cooking appliances
conditions: hood-based suppression system

subject: Fire Suppression System (Kitchen)
rule: kitchen fire suppression system must not be installed such that its nozzles are obstructed by cooking equipment or ductwork

subject: Fire Suppression System (Kitchen)
rule: kitchen fire suppression system must have a mechanical or electrical manual release pull station within the path of egress from the kitchen

subject: Fire Suppression System (Kitchen)
rule: kitchen fire suppression system must automatically shut off fuel and/or electrical power to cooking appliances upon detection
conditions: commercial kitchen hood suppression system

subject: Walk-in Cooler/Freezer
rule: walk-in cooler/freezer enclosure must be constructed with closed-cell insulation (e.g., polyurethane or polystyrene) to prevent moisture infiltration and maintain thermal performance
conditions: unit is used for refrigerated or frozen storage

subject: Walk-in Cooler/Freezer
rule: walk-in cooler/freezer must have a vapor barrier installed on the warm side of the insulation
conditions: unit separates conditioned interior from unconditioned or warmer exterior

subject: Walk-in Cooler/Freezer
rule: walk-in cooler/freezer door must close and latch automatically (or be self-closing) to prevent continuous cold air loss
conditions: door provides access to the refrigerated space

subject: Walk-in Cooler/Freezer
rule: walk-in cooler/freezer evaporator coil must not be blocked by stored product within the minimum clearance distance specified by manufacturer
conditions: interior is used for product storage

subject: Walk-in Cooler/Freezer
rule: walk-in freezer (not cooler) must have a heated door frame or anti-sweat heater to prevent the door from freezing shut
conditions: unit is a freezer operating below 32°F / 0°C
door is used for entry

subject: Walk-in Cooler/Freezer
rule: walk-in cooler/freezer floor must be insulated and capable of preventing ground freezing beneath it when installed on a slab
conditions: unit is installed on a concrete slab or ground floor
interior temperature is below 32°F / 0°C

subject: Dishwashing Station
rule: Dishwashing station must have a hot water supply connection
conditions: Commercial or permanent installation
exceptions: Mobile/temporary dishwashing units with self-contained heating

subject: Dishwashing Station
rule: Dishwashing station must have a dedicated drain connection to a sanitary sewer or approved greywater system

subject: Dishwashing Station
rule: Dishwashing station must not have electrical outlets or switches located directly above or within the splash zone of the sink basin
conditions: Station includes electrically powered components nearby
exceptions: GFCI-protected and weatherproof-rated enclosures specifically rated for wet locations

subject: Dishwashing Station
rule: Dishwashing station must be positioned such that the work surface is accessible from at least one side for loading and unloading dishes
conditions: Fixed/installed station (not a portable unit)

subject: Tray Return Conveyor
rule: Tray return conveyor must have continuous travel path free of physical obstructions that would block tray movement
conditions: when conveyor is installed and operational
exceptions: during maintenance or repair when conveyor is intentionally halted

subject: Tray Return Conveyor
rule: Tray return conveyor belt or chain must maintain adequate tension to prevent slippage or derailment
conditions: when conveyor is under load

subject: Tray Return Conveyor
rule: Tray return conveyor must not exceed its designed load capacity

subject: Tray Return Conveyor
rule: Tray return conveyor must have guards or barriers at all pinch points and nip points accessible to personnel
conditions: where conveyor is located in areas accessible to operators or maintenance staff

subject: Serving Counter (Heated/Chilled)
rule: A serving counter with heating elements must have a grounded electrical connection
conditions: The serving counter includes heating elements

subject: Serving Counter (Heated/Chilled)
rule: A serving counter with chilling/refrigeration must have adequate ventilation around condenser coils
conditions: The serving counter includes chilling/refrigeration components

subject: Serving Counter (Heated/Chilled)
rule: The food-contact surfaces of a heated/chilled serving counter must be made of materials that are rated for the operating temperature range

subject: Serving Counter (Heated/Chilled)
rule: A serving counter with heating elements must maintain minimum clearance from combustible materials as specified by fire code
conditions: Heating elements are present

subject: Waste Compactor (Building-integrated)
rule: A building-integrated waste compactor must have an accessible collection or removal point on the same floor or via a dedicated service path
conditions: when installed in a multi-story building
when the compactor serves more than one floor
exceptions: facilities served exclusively by a pneumatic waste conveyor system

subject: Waste Compactor (Building-integrated)
rule: A building-integrated waste compactor must be vented to the outdoors or to a mechanical exhaust system
conditions: when the compactor is enclosed in a room or alcove
exceptions: rooms that are directly open to the outdoors on at least one full wall

subject: Waste Compactor (Building-integrated)
rule: A building-integrated waste compactor must not be installed directly adjacent to a fresh-air intake
conditions: any installation
exceptions: when a physical barrier or zoning airlock separates the compactor room from the intake by at least 3 m of sealed ductwork

subject: Waste Compactor (Building-integrated)
rule: The floor under a building-integrated waste compactor must be rated for the fully loaded static and dynamic load of the unit
conditions: any installation
exceptions: units supported directly on a structural slab-on-grade

subject: Drink Dispensing Station
rule: the drink dispensing station must have a dedicated water supply connection
conditions: if the station dispenses potable water-based beverages
exceptions: beverage dispensing stations that use pre-packaged containers with no direct water line connection

subject: Drink Dispensing Station
rule: the drink dispensing station must include a drainage system for waste liquids
exceptions: single-use stations dispensing only sealed, pre-packaged beverages that produce no wastewater

subject: Drink Dispensing Station
rule: the drink dispensing station must not have exposed electrical components within the splash zone
conditions: if the station uses electrical power for refrigeration, pumping, or dispensing
exceptions: components rated with ingress protection (IP) suitable for wet locations

subject: Tackable Wall Surface
rule: tackable wall surface must be capable of supporting specified point loads without permanent deformation or failure
conditions: when used for mounting objects such as shelves, monitors, or artwork
exceptions: decorative surfaces explicitly labeled as non-load-bearing

subject: Tackable Wall Surface
rule: tackable wall surface must not delaminate or separate from substrate under normal tacking and removal cycles
conditions: when subjected to repeated insertion and removal of tacks, pins, or hooks

subject: Mobile Whiteboard
rule: Mobile whiteboard must have a writing surface that is compatible with dry-erase markers
conditions: when intended for use with dry-erase markers
exceptions: board is designed as a chalkboard or corkboard instead

subject: Mobile Whiteboard
rule: Mobile whiteboard must have casters (wheels) that allow rolling on standard indoor flooring
conditions: when the unit is intended to be mobile
exceptions: board is a wall-mounted or fixed unit, not mobile

subject: Mobile Whiteboard
rule: Mobile whiteboard must_not have a surface that is permanently damaged by repeated marker erasure

subject: Mobile Whiteboard
rule: Mobile whiteboard must have a height and weight distribution that prevents tip-over under normal leaning or writing pressure
conditions: when in use in an upright writing position

subject: Reception Desk Lighting
rule: Reception desk lighting must be positioned to avoid direct glare into the eyes of seated reception staff and approaching visitors
conditions: desk is staffed by a person
desk faces an entry or waiting area
exceptions: task lighting with adjustable louvers or diffusers that can be redirected

subject: Reception Desk Lighting
rule: Reception desk lighting must not create veiling reflections on computer monitors used at the desk
conditions: monitors are present at the reception desk
light source is overhead or behind the user's seated position
exceptions: monitors are anti-glare rated and lighting position is verified at install

subject: Backdrop Wall / Feature Wall
rule: a backdrop wall / feature wall must be structurally stable and capable of supporting its own weight plus any imposed loads (e.g., attached decorations, signage, lighting fixtures)
exceptions: free-standing walls that are designed to be temporary and braced externally

subject: Backdrop Wall / Feature Wall
rule: a backdrop wall / feature wall must not obstruct required egress paths, fire exits, or emergency access routes
conditions: when located in a building or occupied space
exceptions: when the wall is intentionally designed as part of a fire-rated separation and additional egress is provided

subject: Backdrop Wall / Feature Wall
rule: a backdrop wall / feature wall must be laterally braced or designed to resist overturning forces (self-weight, wind, seismic, or accidental impact)
exceptions: walls that are free-standing and have a width-to-height ratio less than 1:3 and are located in interior protected areas with negligible lateral forces

subject: Backdrop Wall / Feature Wall
rule: a backdrop wall / feature wall must not be constructed from materials that, when ignited, produce rapid flame spread or toxic smoke in quantities hazardous to occupants
exceptions: when the wall is located in an area not required to comply with interior finish fire ratings (e.g., outdoor temporary stage sets)

subject: Visitor Management System Kiosk
rule: Visitor Management System Kiosk must have a stable, level base or footing to prevent tipping under expected wind loads and incidental contact
conditions: free-standing installation
exceptions: kiosk bolted directly to a structural wall or embedded in a building structure

subject: Visitor Management System Kiosk
rule: Visitor Management System Kiosk must have an electrical supply that meets its rated power requirements
conditions: includes electronic components such as touchscreen, computer, scanner, or printer
exceptions: manually operated kiosk with no powered components

subject: Visitor Management System Kiosk
rule: Visitor Management System Kiosk must not be placed where it blocks required egress paths or emergency exits
conditions: installed in a public or occupied building space

subject: Visitor Management System Kiosk
rule: Visitor Management System Kiosk must have an enclosure rated for the environmental conditions of its intended location (e.g., weatherproof if outdoors)
conditions: installed in an outdoor or semi-outdoor environment
exceptions: installed in a fully climate-controlled indoor environment

subject: Reception Floor Finish
rule: The reception floor finish must be slip-resistant when wet
conditions: Reception area is an entrance or high-traffic zone where wet conditions may occur from foot traffic, rain, or cleaning
exceptions: Area is permanently covered by removable walk-off mats that are slip-resistant and maintained

subject: Reception Floor Finish
rule: The reception floor finish must not present a trip hazard at transitions
conditions: The floor finish abuts another flooring material or a door threshold
exceptions: The vertical height change is ramped or bevelled at a slope of 1:2 or less per accessibility codes

subject: Reception Ceiling Treatment
rule: a ceiling treatment must be securely fixed to the structural ceiling or supporting framework above
conditions: When a suspended or applied ceiling treatment is installed in a reception area

subject: Reception Ceiling Treatment
rule: ceiling treatment materials must not shed debris or fragments under normal conditions
conditions: When the ceiling treatment is located above a reception or waiting area occupied by the public or staff
exceptions: Temporary installations during construction or refurbishment where area is closed to occupancy

subject: Reception Ceiling Treatment
rule: a ceiling treatment must not reduce the minimum clear headroom required for the space below
conditions: When the ceiling treatment projects below the structural slab or roof
exceptions: Areas not intended for occupant circulation that are marked and barriered accordingly

subject: Lobby Partition / Privacy Screen
rule: lobby partition / privacy screen must be self-supporting or securely anchored to building structure
conditions: when used as a freestanding element
exceptions: when the partition is purely decorative and bears no load, and is not a safety hazard

subject: Lobby Partition / Privacy Screen
rule: lobby partition / privacy screen must not obstruct required egress paths
conditions: when located in or near circulation paths
when in a lobby that serves as an exit access

subject: Lobby Partition / Privacy Screen
rule: lobby partition / privacy screen must not reduce corridor or doorway clear width below applicable building code minimum
conditions: when placed adjacent to a required means of egress corridor or doorway

subject: Waiting Seating
rule: waiting seat must be structurally stable under expected live loads
conditions: when used indoors or outdoors
for public or private use
exceptions: decorative seating not intended for occupancy

subject: Waiting Seating
rule: waiting seat must not have sharp edges or corners at occupant contact points
conditions: when seating is at accessible height for sitting

subject: Waiting Seating
rule: waiting seat must not tip over under expected lateral loads
conditions: when unsecured and freestanding
exceptions: seats permanently bolted to floor or structure

subject: Waiting Seating
rule: seat surface must have a minimum width adequate for an average adult occupant
conditions: when intended for standard adult use
exceptions: seats designed exclusively for children or specific anthropometric groups

subject: Reception Counter
rule: The reception counter must have a clear top surface that is horizontal and stable
conditions: When used as a writing/transaction surface
exceptions: Counters with integrated anti-fatigue standing mats or non-horizontal decorative tops with separate functional surfaces

subject: Reception Counter
rule: The reception counter must not have sharp edges or corners at accessible user heights
conditions: At heights between 600 mm and 1200 mm above floor where users approach

subject: Reception Counter
rule: The reception counter must allow direct visual line of sight between a seated receptionist and a standing visitor
conditions: When the counter separates a receptionist workstation from a public waiting area
exceptions: Counters with integrated privacy glass that can be switched to transparent mode

subject: Waiting Area Lighting
rule: waiting area lighting must not be positioned where it causes glare to waiting passengers or drivers
conditions: lighting is installed in a passenger waiting area
lighting may be seen by approaching drivers or waiting passengers
exceptions: lighting is designed with glare-shielding optics that cut off above 90 degrees

subject: Waiting Area Lighting
rule: waiting area lighting must maintain minimum illuminance level on the waiting surface
conditions: the waiting area is intended for use during hours of darkness or low ambient light
exceptions: the facility explicitly disclaims nighttime operation

subject: Waiting Area Lighting
rule: waiting area lighting must be protected from direct water ingress
conditions: the waiting area is outdoor or semi-enclosed
exceptions: the waiting area is fully interior with no weather exposure

subject: Drinking Fountain
rule: drinking fountain must be connected to a potable water supply
conditions: if the fountain is supplied with water from a municipal or well source
exceptions: fountains intended for decorative purposes only, not for drinking

subject: Drinking Fountain
rule: drinking fountain must have a drainage path for wastewater
conditions: if the fountain dispenses water for drinking

subject: Drinking Fountain
rule: drinking fountain must not have an electrical outlet or power source exposed to standing water
conditions: if the fountain includes a refrigeration/chilling unit or any electrical component

subject: Drinking Fountain
rule: drinking fountain spout must be positioned above the basin such that water stream falls into the basin and not outside

subject: Floor Finish - Waiting Area
rule: floor finish in a waiting area must be slip-resistant
conditions: when the finish is installed in a publicly accessible waiting area
exceptions: areas not intended for standing or walking

subject: Floor Finish - Waiting Area
rule: floor finish in a waiting area must be cleanable and resistant to staining

subject: Floor Finish - Waiting Area
rule: floor finish in a waiting area must not present a trip hazard at transitions
conditions: at junctions with adjacent flooring or door thresholds
exceptions: where a sloped transition strip is used

subject: Acoustic Wall Panel
rule: Acoustic wall panel must have a minimum NRC (Noise Reduction Coefficient) rating of 0.50 when installed in an enclosed occupied space to provide meaningful acoustic absorption
conditions: panel is installed in an enclosed occupied space
panel is used for acoustic treatment purposes
exceptions: panel is used exclusively as a decorative surface where acoustic performance is not specified

subject: Acoustic Wall Panel
rule: Acoustic wall panel must have a Class A fire rating (flame spread index ≤ 25 per ASTM E84) when installed in a commercial building
conditions: panel is installed in a commercial or institutional building
building is subject to IBC or equivalent code
exceptions: building is a single-family residence not subject to commercial fire codes
panel is installed in a jurisdiction with explicitly different fire rating requirements

subject: Acoustic Wall Panel
rule: Acoustic wall panel must not be installed in direct contact with a continuous moisture source
conditions: panel contains porous organic fibers (e.g., fiberglass, polyester, or mineral wool)
exceptions: panel is specifically manufactured with a sealed impermeable facing and moisture-resistant core rated for wet environments

subject: Waiting Area HVAC Diffuser
rule: HVAC supply diffusers must not be positioned directly above fixed seating in waiting areas
conditions: waiting area has fixed seating below
exceptions: diffuser includes an integrated downward-facing deflector or baffle that prevents downdraft on occupants

subject: Waiting Area HVAC Diffuser
rule: Waiting area HVAC diffuser must be located at least 150 mm from any ceiling-mounted fire sprinkler head
conditions: ceiling has fire sprinkler heads within the same bay

subject: Waiting Area HVAC Diffuser
rule: HVAC diffusers in waiting areas must not direct airflow toward building entrance doors
conditions: waiting area has an exterior entrance door within 3 m of the diffuser location

subject: Recessed Ceiling Lights
rule: Recessed ceiling lights must have clearance above the ceiling plane for heat dissipation and fixture housing
conditions: The light is recessed into a finished ceiling
exceptions: Fixtures specifically rated for zero-clearance/insulation-contact (IC-rated) with airtight construction

subject: Recessed Ceiling Lights
rule: Recessed ceiling lights must not be installed in direct contact with thermal insulation unless IC-rated
conditions: The recessed fixture is non-IC-rated
The ceiling cavity contains thermal insulation

subject: Recessed Ceiling Lights
rule: Recessed ceiling lights must maintain minimum separation from combustible materials (e.g., wood joists, framing)
conditions: The fixture is not IC-rated or not marked for zero-clearance
exceptions: Fixtures with UL listing for direct contact with combustibles

subject: Recessed Ceiling Lights
rule: Recessed ceiling lights must be installed in a ceiling cavity with sufficient depth to accommodate the fixture housing without compression or deformation

subject: Acoustic Ceiling Tiles
rule: Acoustic ceiling tiles must be installed with a minimum 1/2-inch (12.7 mm) gap between the tile and any adjacent wall or partition to allow for thermal expansion, moisture-related movement, and installation tolerance without causing buckling or binding
conditions: suspended ceiling grid system
standard mineral-fiber or fiberglass acoustic tiles
exceptions: tiles specifically designed and manufactured for compression-fit or edge-clip installation with manufacturer-approved zero-clearance detailing

subject: Acoustic Ceiling Tiles
rule: Acoustic ceiling tiles must be made of a material with a Class A (Class I) flame-spread rating (per ASTM E84) when installed in any building with a fire-resistance-rated ceiling assembly or in any space required by building code to have a fire-resistive ceiling
conditions: installation in a building subject to IBC, NFPA 101, or equivalent model building code
ceiling serves as part of a fire-resistance-rated floor/ceiling or roof/ceiling assembly
occupancy type that requires fire-resistive construction
exceptions: tiles installed in buildings with an automatic fire sprinkler system fully compliant with NFPA 13, where the local code allows reduction or omission of Class A interior finish requirements for ceiling surfaces

subject: Acoustic Ceiling Tiles
rule: Acoustic ceiling tiles must not be installed in locations subject to direct water spray, continuous high humidity (above the tile manufacturer's rated humidity limit, typically 90-95% RH non-condensing), or condensation-prone surfaces unless the tiles are specifically rated for such conditions
conditions: standard (non-water-resistant) acoustic ceiling tiles
exceptions: tiles certified by the manufacturer as water-resistant or suitable for high-humidity environments such as certain PVC-faced, fiberglass-faced, or closed-cell foam acoustic panels

subject: Motorized Window Blinds
rule: Motorized window blinds must have an accessible power supply connection within reach of the blind's motor cable
conditions: Blind is electrically powered and not a manual or spring-assisted model
exceptions: Blind is battery-powered with integrated battery compartment not requiring external wiring

subject: Motorized Window Blinds
rule: Motorized window blinds must not have the motor or electrical components exposed to direct water spray or immersion
conditions: Blind is installed indoors
exceptions: Blind is specified as IP-rated (e.g., IP65) for outdoor/wet-location use

subject: Motorized Window Blinds
rule: Motorized window blinds must have a mechanical or electronic limit-stop mechanism that prevents the blind from over-traveling beyond its fully open or fully closed position

subject: Power and Data Floor Box
rule: power and data floor box must be UL or equivalent certified for its intended application (e.g., floor box rating, fire rating)
conditions: installed in floor assembly requiring fire resistance rating

subject: Power and Data Floor Box
rule: power and data floor box must not be installed in a location where it will be submerged in standing water or subject to regular flooding
conditions: installed in floor area that may accumulate water (e.g., floor drains, exterior entries, wet areas)
exceptions: box is specifically listed and rated for wet or flood exposure (e.g., NEMA 4X or equivalent)

subject: Power and Data Floor Box
rule: power and data floor box must have a cover that is rated for the anticipated pedestrian or wheeled traffic load
conditions: installed in a floor area subject to foot traffic or wheeled loads (carts, chairs)

subject: Cable Management Tray
rule: cable management tray must be installed with a continuous support structure (e.g., trapeze hangers, wall brackets, or strut channels) at intervals not exceeding the manufacturer's specified span rating
conditions: tray is carrying bundled power or data cables
tray is suspended overhead
exceptions: tray is directly floor-mounted on continuous sleepers or pedestals

subject: Cable Management Tray
rule: cable management tray must be electrically bonded to the building grounding system
conditions: tray is metallic (steel or aluminum)
exceptions: tray is non-metallic (e.g., fiberglass, PVC) and contains only non-conductive cables

subject: Cable Management Tray
rule: cable management tray must not have cable fill that exceeds the manufacturer's rated cable-fill capacity or the allowable fill ratio per applicable code

subject: Cable Management Tray
rule: cable management tray must not be used as a walkway, ladder, or work platform
exceptions: tray is specifically designed and rated for walkway duty (e.g., Catwalk tray)

subject: HVAC Diffuser and Return Grille
rule: HVAC diffuser and return grille must be located such that there is no direct short-circuit path between supply air and return air
conditions: when both supply diffuser and return grille are in the same conditioned space
exceptions: dedicated return ducting physically separated from supply diffuser by a barrier or distance that prevents short-circuiting

subject: HVAC Diffuser and Return Grille
rule: HVAC diffuser and return grille must not be obstructed by building components, furniture, or finishes
conditions: when installed and in operation
exceptions: temporary obstruction during maintenance or construction

subject: Solid Interior Wall Partition
rule: Solid interior wall partition must have structural connection to floor and ceiling/deck above
conditions: Load-bearing wall partition
Non-load-bearing wall partition
exceptions: Freestanding partition not connected to ceiling
Temporary/relocatable partition systems with base-only support

subject: Solid Interior Wall Partition
rule: Solid interior wall partition must not obstruct required means of egress paths
conditions: When located within or adjacent to an egress corridor, exit access, or exit enclosure
exceptions: When wall is constructed with fire-rated doors or openings providing equivalent egress width

subject: Solid Interior Wall Partition
rule: Solid interior wall partition must have fire-resistance rating consistent with its location per building code
conditions: When serving as a fire barrier between dwelling units
When serving as a fire barrier between occupancy groups
When serving as a corridor wall
When serving as a shaft enclosure
exceptions: Partitions in same-occupancy, same-unit interior spaces with no fire separation requirement

subject: Solid Interior Wall Partition
rule: Solid interior wall partition must have limited height-to-thickness ratio to prevent buckling
conditions: Load-bearing solid wall partition
exceptions: Non-load-bearing partitions
Partitions with intermediate lateral bracing

subject: Meeting Room Door with Glass Lite
rule: a meeting room door with glass lite must have safety-rated glazing (tempered or laminated) if the glass lite area exceeds 0.5 m² or is located within 600 mm of the floor
conditions: glass lite area > 0.5 m²
glass lite bottom edge is within 600 mm of finished floor level
exceptions: glass lite is fully covered by a permanent protective grille or guard that meets impact resistance requirements

subject: Meeting Room Door with Glass Lite
rule: a meeting room door with glass lite must have a door frame and hinges rated to support the full weight of the door including the glass lite

subject: Meeting Room Door with Glass Lite
rule: a meeting room door with glass lite must not have exposed glass edges that are sharp or unfinished where the edge is reachable from the occupiable side
conditions: glass edge is exposed (not fully encapsulated in frame or glazing bead)

subject: Meeting Room Door with Glass Lite
rule: a meeting room door with glass lite must not have glass that obstructs required fire-resistance rating of the door assembly
conditions: the door is in a fire-rated wall or opening
exceptions: the glass lite assembly carries a fire-rating equal to or greater than the door rating (e.g., wired glass, ceramic glazing)

subject: Built-in Desk with Cable Management
rule: Cable management channels or raceways must maintain bend radius sufficient for cable type
conditions: Cable management system includes internal routing channels
Cables are intended to remain in place permanently
exceptions: Cables are all wireless or no data/power cables present
Cable management consists only of external adhesive clips with no enclosed path

subject: Built-in Desk with Cable Management
rule: Built-in desk must provide a minimum of two separate grounded electrical receptacles within the desk footprint or module
conditions: The desk is intended to support electronic devices (computers, monitors, peripherals)
exceptions: The desk is specified as a non-electrified furniture unit with no power provisions
Local code exempts built-in furniture from receptacle requirements

subject: Office Partition System
rule: office partition system must be laterally braced or connected to the building structure to resist overturning under design lateral loads
conditions: when partition height exceeds 2.4 m (8 ft)
exceptions: free-standing partitions designed as cantilever elements with verified structural adequacy

subject: Office Partition System
rule: office partition system must not obstruct required means of egress path width or door swing clearance
conditions: when located in or adjacent to an egress corridor or exit doorway

subject: Office Partition System
rule: office partition system must have a fire-resistance rating meeting or exceeding the hourly rating required by the building code for the occupancy and location
conditions: when the partition forms part of a fire-rated enclosure (shaft, corridor, occupancy separation, or exit enclosure)
exceptions: full-height glazed assemblies tested and rated per ASTM E119 or equivalent

subject: Office Partition System
rule: office partition system must not exceed the floor loading capacity of the supporting structure
conditions: when the partition is constructed of heavy materials such as full-height masonry, concrete, or solid metal panels

subject: Glass Storefront Wall
rule: Glass storefront wall must be supported by a structural frame capable of resisting wind and lateral loads
conditions: when used as a non-loadbearing exterior wall

subject: Glass Storefront Wall
rule: Glass in storefront wall must be tempered or laminated safety glass
conditions: when located within 18 inches of the floor
when in doors or side lites
where human impact is possible
exceptions: if glass is fully protected by a permanent railing or barrier

subject: Glass Storefront Wall
rule: Glass storefront wall must not have glass-to-frame contact without setting blocks and gaskets

subject: Glass Storefront Wall
rule: Glass storefront wall must have a continuous weather seal at all perimeter joints
conditions: when exposed to exterior weather conditions

subject: Privacy Blinds or Shades
rule: Privacy blinds or shades must completely cover the vision panel area they are intended to screen
conditions: when used for visual privacy
exceptions: decorative blinds not intended for privacy

subject: Privacy Blinds or Shades
rule: Privacy blinds or shades must not obstruct required egress openings or emergency escape paths
conditions: when installed over or adjacent to an operable window or door designated as an emergency egress
exceptions: blinds that automatically retract upon fire alarm or manual release

subject: Privacy Blinds or Shades
rule: Privacy blinds or shades must not create a strangulation hazard from exposed looped cords in locations accessible to children
conditions: when installed in a residential occupancy or childcare facility
when operated by continuous-loop cord or bead chain
exceptions: cordless or motorized blinds
blinds with breakaway cord connectors compliant with ASTM F4008

subject: Task Lighting System
rule: task lighting system must be connected to a suitable electrical power source

subject: Task Lighting System
rule: task lighting system must not exceed the rated electrical load of the branch circuit it is connected to
conditions: when connected to a building electrical system

subject: Task Lighting System
rule: task lighting luminaires must be rated for their intended installation environment (e.g., damp-rated for bathrooms, wet-rated for exterior)
conditions: when installed in locations with moisture exposure

subject: Task Lighting System
rule: task lighting fixtures must be securely attached to a structural support element

subject: Integrated Power and Data Floor Box
rule: Integrated Power and Data Floor Box must be installed in a floor location that accommodates its required cutout or recess depth without penetrating structural slabs, fire-rated assemblies, or below-floor utilities
conditions: floor-mounted installation
exceptions: purpose-designed raised access floor systems where the box is rated and listed for that specific floor type

subject: Integrated Power and Data Floor Box
rule: Integrated Power and Data Floor Box must not allow liquids to ingress into power or data connectors when the box cover is closed and latched
conditions: floor box located in areas subject to wet mopping, spill risk, or incidental liquid exposure
exceptions: box is specifically rated and listed for wet locations (e.g., UL 514A or equivalent) with appropriate gaskets and drains

subject: Integrated Power and Data Floor Box
rule: Integrated Power and Data Floor Box must have all metallic parts bonded to the equipment grounding conductor in accordance with the applicable electrical code
conditions: box contains metallic enclosures or metal faceplates accessible to users
exceptions: double-insulated or all-nonmetallic construction with no exposed conductive parts

subject: Half-private Office Signage
rule: Half-private office signage must be fixed securely to wall, door, or mounting bracket
conditions: signage is installed on-site
exceptions: signage is digital and freestanding

subject: Half-private Office Signage
rule: Half-private office signage must not obstruct door swing, egress path, or fire-safety equipment
conditions: signage is wall- or door-mounted within circulation zones

subject: Half-private Office Signage
rule: Half-private office signage must have legible text at the intended viewing distance under expected lighting conditions
conditions: signage includes text and is intended to communicate room/occupant information

subject: Privacy Phone Booth
rule: phone booth must provide at least 180° visual privacy for a standing occupant
conditions: occupant is standing
booth is in use

subject: Privacy Phone Booth
rule: phone booth must have a floor area of at least 0.5 m² (clear interior)

subject: Privacy Phone Booth
rule: phone booth must have an interior clear height of at least 2.0 m

subject: Privacy Phone Booth
rule: phone booth must have an operable door or doorway for egress

subject: Privacy Phone Booth
rule: phone booth must not have a fully sealed interior without ventilation
conditions: booth is enclosed on all sides

subject: Rentable Room Entry Doors
rule: rentable room entry doors must swing in the direction of egress travel
conditions: door serves a room with an occupant load of 50 or more
exceptions: where door is not required to be side-hinged (e.g. sliding door)

subject: Rentable Room Entry Doors
rule: rentable room entry doors must have a clear opening width of at least 32 inches
conditions: door is part of a means of egress
door serves a habitable room
exceptions: existing buildings under certain limited alteration scopes

subject: Rentable Room Entry Doors
rule: rentable room entry doors must not have a door closer that results in more than 5 lbf to open
conditions: door is equipped with a self-closing device
door is on an accessible route

subject: Rentable Room Entry Doors
rule: rentable room entry doors must not reduce the required exit width of the corridor they open into
conditions: door opens into a corridor that is part of a means of egress
exceptions: if door is recessed such that swing does not project into corridor clear width

subject: Tenant Utility Sub-Metering System
rule: sub-metering system must be installed downstream of the utility provider's main service meter
conditions: system is connected to electrical, water, or gas utility supply

subject: Tenant Utility Sub-Metering System
rule: sub-metering system must not be installed in a location that bypasses the utility provider's main service meter
conditions: system is connected to electrical, water, or gas utility supply

subject: Tenant Utility Sub-Metering System
rule: metering sensors (current transformers or flow meters) must be matched to the rated capacity of the branch circuit or pipe they monitor
conditions: sensors are installed on live electrical conductors or pressurized piping

subject: Room Numbering & Signage System
rule: Room numbering system must be sequential and follow a logical, consistent pattern throughout the building
exceptions: Renumbering existing occupied buildings where full renumbering would cause operational disruption — in such cases a documented mapping table is acceptable

subject: Room Numbering & Signage System
rule: Room numbers must be unique within the building

subject: Room Numbering & Signage System
rule: Signage for room numbers must be visually legible under all expected lighting conditions within the building

subject: Room Numbering & Signage System
rule: Room number signs must not be placed in locations that are physically obstructed by building elements (doors, columns, furniture) in normal use

subject: Room Numbering & Signage System
rule: Room numbering must map directly to floor number as the first digit(s) of the room number
conditions: Building has more than one story
exceptions: Buildings where floor identification is achieved through other unambiguous means such as color-coded zones with a legend at every entry point

subject: Room Numbering & Signage System
rule: Signage must not use room numbers that are easily confused with other room numbers (e.g., 101 vs. 101A where both exist as separate rooms)

subject: Rentable Room Window Glazing
rule: window glazing in a rentable room must be operable (openable) by occupants for natural ventilation
conditions: room is mechanically ventilated or has no dedicated HVAC system
exceptions: building code explicitly prohibits opening windows above certain heights
room requires strictly controlled environmental conditions (e.g., cleanroom, server room)

subject: Rentable Room Window Glazing
rule: window glazing in a rentable room must_not create a hazardous obstruction or projection into required egress path
conditions: window is located near exitways, corridors, or fire-escape routes
exceptions: glazing is recessed or protected such that it does not encroach on minimum egress clearances

subject: Rentable Room Window Glazing
rule: window glazing in a rentable room must_not have a visible light transmittance below 0.50 for rooms intended for human occupancy
conditions: room is intended for regular occupancy (office, meeting, residential)
exceptions: glazing is part of a specialty application (museum display, darkroom) where light exclusion is deliberate

subject: Rentable Room Window Glazing
rule: window glazing in a rentable room must_not allow water infiltration at the glazing-to-frame interface
conditions: window is exposed to exterior weather conditions

subject: Rentable Room Window Glazing
rule: window glazing in a rentable room must resist wind loads per applicable building code without breakage
conditions: window is part of the building envelope

subject: Teenager's Cottage Exterior Walls
rule: exterior walls must be weathertight to prevent moisture ingress
conditions: walls are exposed to exterior environment

subject: Teenager's Cottage Exterior Walls
rule: exterior walls must resist lateral wind loads
conditions: structure is located in any region subject to wind

subject: Teenager's Cottage Exterior Walls
rule: exterior walls must not contain continuous concealed combustible cavities that bypass fire-resistance-rated assemblies
conditions: walls are part of a building intended for human occupancy
exceptions: cavities are properly fireblocked per code

subject: Teenager's Cottage Roof Assembly
rule: roof assembly must provide a continuous water-shedding surface
conditions: roof is exposed to precipitation

subject: Teenager's Cottage Roof Assembly
rule: roof assembly must have a minimum slope for drainage when using non-membrane roofing
conditions: roof is covered with shingles, tiles, or similar discontinuous materials
exceptions: if roof is designed as a flat roof with a continuous waterproof membrane system

subject: Teenager's Cottage Roof Assembly
rule: roof assembly must not allow condensation to accumulate within the insulated cavity
conditions: roof includes thermal insulation and is located in a climate with interior-exterior temperature differential

subject: Teenager's Cottage HVAC System
rule: HVAC system must maintain at least minimal air circulation to prevent stagnation and mold growth in the conditioned space
conditions: system is operational
exceptions: system is shut down for seasonal non-use with building properly winterized

subject: Teenager's Cottage HVAC System
rule: HVAC system must not allow refrigerant lines to run through unconditioned spaces without proper insulation to prevent condensation damage
conditions: refrigerant lines pass through unconditioned attics, crawlspaces, or exterior walls
exceptions: lines are contained within a sealed, drained chase system

subject: Teenager's Cottage HVAC System
rule: HVAC condensate drain must have a downward slope and clear path to disposal to prevent water backup
conditions: system produces condensate during cooling operation
exceptions: system uses a condensate pump with proper safety float switch

subject: Teenager's Cottage HVAC System
rule: HVAC system must not be installed without a properly sized electrical disconnect within sight of the outdoor unit
conditions: outdoor compressor/condenser unit is installed

subject: Teenager's Cottage Built-In Bed/Loft
rule: built-in bed/loft must have a maximum weight rating specified for the sleeping platform
conditions: used as a sleeping area

subject: Teenager's Cottage Built-In Bed/Loft
rule: built-in bed/loft must have guardrails on any open side where the sleeping surface is more than 30 inches above the floor below
conditions: loft height exceeds 30 inches above ground/floor
exceptions: side adjacent to a wall within 4 inches of the mattress edge

subject: Teenager's Cottage Built-In Bed/Loft
rule: built-in bed/loft must not block the only egress path from the room
conditions: the cottage has only one doorway/exit from the room containing the loft

subject: Teenager's Cottage Built-In Bed/Loft
rule: built-in loft must have at least 36 inches of clearance between the loft floor and the ceiling overhead
conditions: loft is intended for sleeping occupancy

subject: Teenager's Cottage Built-In Bed/Loft
rule: built-in bed structure must not cantilever more than 12 inches beyond its support without engineered fastening to the cottage wall framing
conditions: bed platform is supported at one end only by the cottage wall

subject: Teenager's Cottage Interior Stairs
rule: interior stairs must have a minimum headroom clearance of at least 2.0 m (6 ft 8 in) measured vertically from the nosing line of the treads
conditions: stairs provide access to an upper floor or loft within the cottage

subject: Teenager's Cottage Interior Stairs
rule: interior stairs must have tread depth and riser height combinations that satisfy the building code formula 2R + T ≥ 550 mm and ≤ 700 mm (where R = riser height, T = tread depth)
conditions: stairs are the primary or secondary means of vertical circulation within the cottage

subject: Teenager's Cottage Interior Stairs
rule: interior stairs must have a minimum clear width of at least 860 mm (approximately 34 in) between handrails or between wall and handrail
conditions: stairs serve as an egress path from the upper floor

subject: Teenager's Cottage Interior Stairs
rule: interior stairs must be equipped with a handrail on at least one side
conditions: there are four or more risers in the stair flight

subject: Teenager's Cottage Interior Stairs
rule: interior stairs must not have open risers with a gap that permits passage of a 100 mm (4 in) sphere
conditions: the stairs serve a teenager's cottage where child safety is relevant

subject: Teenager's Cottage Rainwater/Gutter System
rule: gutter system must have a positive slope toward downspouts
conditions: gutter is installed
exceptions: internal gutter system with built-in drainage slope

subject: Teenager's Cottage Rainwater/Gutter System
rule: downspouts must discharge water away from the building foundation
conditions: downspout is present
exceptions: downspout connects directly to an approved stormwater drainage system

subject: Teenager's Cottage Rainwater/Gutter System
rule: gutter cross-section must not be blocked by debris to the point of overflow
conditions: gutter system is in service

subject: Teenager's Cottage Rainwater/Gutter System
rule: gutter system must be sized to handle the contributing roof area's rainfall volume at the local design storm intensity
conditions: gutter system is designed for a specific roof catchment area

subject: Teenager's Cottage Rainwater/Gutter System
rule: downspouts must be securely fastened to prevent detachment under load
conditions: downspout is installed externally

subject: Cottage Foundation
rule: foundation must be placed on stable, load-bearing soil or engineered fill
conditions: applicable to all permanent structures

subject: Cottage Foundation
rule: foundation depth must extend below the local frost line
conditions: in climates where seasonal ground freezing occurs
exceptions: foundation is designed as a frost-protected shallow foundation with perimeter insulation per IRC guidelines

subject: Cottage Foundation
rule: foundation must not be constructed on uncompacted organic topsoil or debris
conditions: always applicable

subject: Cottage Foundation
rule: foundation concrete must achieve a minimum compressive strength of 2500 psi at 28 days
conditions: when using plain concrete in a residential cottage foundation
exceptions: engineered mix design specifies a lower strength with supporting documentation

subject: Cottage Foundation
rule: foundation must provide a continuous load path to transfer all gravity and lateral loads to the ground
conditions: always applicable

subject: Timber Frame Structure
rule: Timber frame must have proper connections between beams, columns, and joints capable of transferring all structural loads
conditions: all timber frame structures
exceptions: non-structural decorative timber frames

subject: Timber Frame Structure
rule: Timber frame must not have untreated wood in direct contact with concrete or masonry below grade
conditions: timber frame with foundation or basement walls
exceptions: timber treated for ground contact per building code
timber separated by a capillary break or waterproof membrane

subject: Timber Frame Structure
rule: Timber frame members must have a minimum cross-section dimension sufficient to resist design loads without exceeding allowable stress limits
conditions: all load-bearing timber frame members
exceptions: non-structural timber elements

subject: Timber Frame Structure
rule: Timber frame must have a continuously load path from roof to foundation
conditions: all timber frame structures carrying gravity or lateral loads
exceptions: free-standing non-structural frames not connected to any foundation

subject: Insulation System
rule: insulation system must be continuous across the building envelope without gaps or compression
conditions: when installed in wall, roof, or floor assemblies
exceptions: intentional breaks for structural elements or service penetrations that are sealed and insulated around

subject: Insulation System
rule: insulation system must not be exposed to moisture levels exceeding its material-specific tolerance
conditions: when used as part of building envelope
exceptions: insulation materials specifically rated for wet service conditions such as closed-cell spray foam or extruded polystyrene

subject: Insulation System
rule: insulation system must be installed with a vapor retarder on the warm side of the assembly in cold climates
conditions: in climate zones with significant heating degree days (Zone 5 and colder)
exceptions: when using vapor-permeable insulation systems such as exterior rigid foam with interior smart vapor retarders, or when hygrothermal modeling demonstrates no condensation risk

subject: Internal Wall Lining
rule: Internal wall lining must be fire-rated in accordance with building code requirements for fire-resisting construction
conditions: building is of Type A or Type B construction
wall is required to have fire-resistance level (FRL)
exceptions: building is of Class 1 or 10 (non-fire-resisting) and not part of a fire wall

subject: Internal Wall Lining
rule: Internal wall lining must provide adequate bracing capacity where designated as a bracing element
conditions: wall lining is part of a designated lateral bracing system
exceptions: lining is non-structural and not assigned bracing function in the structural design

subject: Internal Wall Lining
rule: Internal wall lining must not contain asbestos or other prohibited hazardous materials

subject: Internal Wall Lining
rule: Internal wall lining must be installed in compliance with the manufacturer's maximum unsupported span limitations
conditions: lining is a sheet-based product (e.g. plasterboard, fibre cement)
exceptions: manufacturer has certified an alternative fixing/spacing arrangement

subject: Window System
rule: window system must be structurally supported by the surrounding wall or frame
conditions: when installed in a building envelope

subject: Window System
rule: window system must maintain a continuous air and water barrier seal at its perimeter
conditions: when installed as part of the building envelope

subject: Window System
rule: window system must not obstruct required egress path when in the open position
conditions: when the window serves as an operable egress window per building code

subject: Window System
rule: glazing must not be placed where it creates a hazardous impact risk without safety treatment
conditions: in hazardous locations per building code (doors, near floor, showers, etc.)
exceptions: if laminated or tempered safety glazing is used

subject: Internal Door
rule: internal door must have a clear opening width of at least 750 mm (or as required by applicable building code) to allow passage and egress
conditions: door serves as an egress path
door is in a habitable room
exceptions: doors in non-habitable spaces such as small storage rooms or plant rooms where occupancy is incidental

subject: Internal Door
rule: internal door must not swing into a required clear landing area at the top or bottom of a stairway
conditions: door is located at the top or bottom of a stairway
exceptions: door swings away from the stair
door serves a closet or storage space of very limited size where code explicitly permits

subject: Internal Door
rule: internal door must have a latching mechanism that holds the door in the closed position
conditions: door separates a conditioned space from an unconditioned space
door is in an egress path where self-closing is required
exceptions: decorative or non-functional doors
pocket doors where the latching mechanism is integrated into the frame differently

subject: Bathroom Sanitary Ware
rule: Bathroom sanitary ware (toilet, bidet, urinal) must have a trap/water seal to prevent sewer gas ingress
conditions: Fixture is a toilet
Fixture is a bidet
Fixture is a urinal

subject: Bathroom Sanitary Ware
rule: Bathroom sanitary ware connected to a drainage system must have a vent (or be within swept-distance of one) to prevent trap siphonage
conditions: Fixture drains into a shared soil/waste pipe

subject: Bathroom Sanitary Ware
rule: Toilet bowl water level must not be below the trap weir at rest
conditions: Fixture is a toilet

subject: Rainwater System
rule: rainwater system must have an overflow path to handle extreme rainfall events
conditions: system collects rainwater from roof surfaces
exceptions: system is designed with sufficient storage to contain the 100-year storm event

subject: Rainwater System
rule: rainwater system must have all collection surfaces and conveyance components sloped to prevent stagnation
conditions: system includes gutters, downpipes, or collection surfaces

subject: Rainwater System
rule: rainwater system must not allow cross-connection between rainwater and potable water supply
conditions: building also has a potable water supply system
exceptions: cross-connection is protected by an approved backflow prevention device complying with local code

subject: Verandah/Deck
rule: deck/verandah surface must be sloped for drainage (minimum 1-2% away from building)
conditions: verandah/deck is exposed to rain
verandah/deck is horizontal or near-horizontal
exceptions: fully enclosed/roofed verandah where water does not reach the deck surface
deck with open decking joints where drainage occurs through gaps between boards (e.g., timber deck with gaps)

subject: Verandah/Deck
rule: verandah/deck must have a fall-arrest system (guardrail/balustrade) if elevated more than 600 mm above adjacent ground
conditions: verandah/deck is accessible for occupancy
elevation above adjacent ground exceeds 600 mm (typical building code threshold)
exceptions: verandah/deck is completely enclosed by walls to a height that prevents falls
verandah/deck is at ground level and the adjacent ground does not create a drop hazard

subject: Verandah/Deck
rule: verandah/deck structural framing must be connected to the primary building structure or adequate footings capable of supporting live and dead loads
conditions: verandah/deck is attached to a building
verandah/deck is intended for occupancy
exceptions: free-standing deck on its own independent foundation system not relying on building attachment

subject: Verandah/Deck
rule: verandah/deck must not obstruct required means of egress from the building
conditions: verandah/deck is located over or adjacent to an exit doorway
verandah/deck is enclosed or has barriers that could trap occupants
exceptions: verandah/deck is designed as an open egress balcony meeting code requirements for path of travel

subject: Gable Roof
rule: A gable roof must have a drainage path (e.g., slope/gutter system) to shed rainwater and prevent ponding
conditions: roof is exposed to precipitation
exceptions: roof is an interior architectural feature not exposed to weather

subject: Gable Roof
rule: A gable roof must not have a flat or negative slope that would allow water to flow toward the ridge or accumulate on the roof deck

subject: Skillion Roof
rule: Skillion roof must have a minimum slope to provide drainage
conditions: roof is covered with non-membrane material (e.g., metal sheeting, shingles)
exceptions: roof is designed as 'green roof' with engineered drainage layer
roof uses standing-seam metal with low-friction water shedding

subject: Skillion Roof
rule: Skillion roof must not have a slope less than 1:40 (approx. 1.4°) for membrane roofing
conditions: roof covering is a continuous membrane (EPDM, TPO, PVC, built-up roofing)
exceptions: roof is designed with a structural fall and tapered insulation achieving equivalent drainage

subject: Skillion Roof
rule: Skillion roof must be connected to a rainwater gutter or drainage system at the lower edge
conditions: building is located in a region with measurable rainfall
roof eaves do not discharge onto a pervious surface with adequate splash protection
exceptions: roof is designed with a drip edge and gravel splash strip that meets code for site drainage

subject: Split-Level Cottage Layout
rule: Split-level layout must have a continuous structural load path connecting all floor levels to the foundation
conditions: Split-level cottage with two or more floor levels offset by partial stories
exceptions: Structures built on monolithic slab foundations where all levels are independently supported

subject: Split-Level Cottage Layout
rule: Vertical offset between split levels must not exceed the height of one full story without an intermediate structural landing or shear wall
conditions: Split-level layout where adjacent floor plates are offset vertically
exceptions: Designs where offset levels are independently founded on separate footings without transfer diaphragm requirements

subject: Split-Level Cottage Layout
rule: Stairway connecting split levels must have a minimum clear width of 36 inches (915 mm) and comply with local building code riser/tread ratios
conditions: Split-level cottage includes an interior stair connecting the split floor levels
exceptions: Stairs serving only storage lofts below 50 sq ft (4.6 m²) in jurisdictions allowing narrower egress

subject: Split-Level Cottage Layout
rule: Split-level floor plates must be separated by fire-resistance-rated construction where the vertical offset exceeds 4 feet (1.2 m) in a single dwelling
conditions: Split-level cottage with floor-to-floor vertical offset greater than 4 feet and the upper level contains habitable rooms
exceptions: Single-family dwellings in jurisdictions that exempt one- and two-family homes from interior fire separation requirements between split levels

subject: Split-Level Cottage Layout
rule: Exterior wall at the split-level transition must be braced to resist lateral loads at the plane of offset
conditions: Split-level cottage where the exterior wall plane is interrupted by the floor offset (i.e., a 'knee wall' condition)
exceptions: Designs where lateral loads are fully resisted by interior shear walls or moment frames independent of the exterior wall at the offset plane

subject: Granny Flat (Auxiliary Dwelling)
rule: roof must have a drainage path (e.g., gutter, downpipe, or overflow provision) to divert rainwater away from the structure
conditions: Granny Flat has a roof

subject: Granny Flat (Auxiliary Dwelling)
rule: floor level must be at least 150 mm above the adjacent ground level or finished grade
conditions: Granny Flat is on a site subject to surface water flow or located in a rainfall region
exceptions: Site-specific engineered drainage system certified by a civil engineer that actively manages surface water

subject: Granny Flat (Auxiliary Dwelling)
rule: must have at least one means of egress (door or window of minimum clear opening dimensions 450 mm wide x 500 mm high) that opens directly to the exterior or to a fire-escape path
conditions: Granny Flat is a habitable room or contains a sleeping area
exceptions: Unit is part of a multi-dwelling building with a shared egress path that meets code equivalency

subject: Granny Flat (Auxiliary Dwelling)
rule: ceiling height must be at least 2.4 m in habitable rooms
conditions: Granny Flat contains habitable rooms (living, bedroom, kitchen, study)
exceptions: Existing building conversion where local variation permits 2.1 m in a bathroom or hallway only

subject: Granny Flat (Auxiliary Dwelling)
rule: must not have a bedroom or living room that relies solely on a corridor or internal hallway for natural light and ventilation
conditions: Granny Flat has habitable rooms (bedroom or living room)
exceptions: Mechanical ventilation and artificial lighting system that meets the relevant building code performance standard

subject: Accessible Bathroom Layout
rule: An accessible bathroom must have a clear floor space of at least 30 inches by 48 inches (760 mm by 1220 mm) centered on the toilet to allow a forward or parallel approach by a person using a wheelchair
conditions: Bathroom is designated as accessible
Toilet is present in the bathroom
exceptions: Exception for toilet rooms less than 60 inches (1525 mm) wide where the clear space may extend up to 6 inches (150 mm) under the washbowl if knee clearance is provided

subject: Accessible Bathroom Layout
rule: An accessible bathroom must have a door with a minimum clear opening width of 32 inches (815 mm) when the door is open 90 degrees
conditions: Bathroom is designated as accessible
exceptions: None

subject: Accessible Bathroom Layout
rule: An accessible bathroom must not have a step or threshold higher than 1/2 inch (13 mm) at the entrance
conditions: Bathroom is designated as accessible
exceptions: A threshold up to 3/4 inch (19 mm) is permitted if it is beveled with a slope no steeper than 1:2

subject: Accessible Bathroom Layout
rule: An accessible bathroom must have grab bars installed on the side wall closest to the toilet and behind the toilet
conditions: Bathroom is designated as accessible
Toilet is present in the bathroom
exceptions: None

subject: Accessible Bathroom Layout
rule: An accessible bathroom must provide a turning space of at least 60 inches (1525 mm) in diameter, or a T-shaped turning space complying with ADA requirements
conditions: Bathroom is designated as accessible
exceptions: Turning space may overlap the clear floor space at fixtures by up to 12 inches (305 mm) for a forward approach and up to 6 inches (150 mm) for a parallel approach

subject: Settlement Joint/Accommodation Strip
rule: settlement joint / accommodation strip must allow free horizontal and vertical movement between adjacent building sections
conditions: when used to separate structurally independent building segments
installed at locations of anticipated differential movement

subject: Settlement Joint/Accommodation Strip
rule: settlement joint / accommodation strip must not be bridged by rigid structural elements that would transfer load across the joint
conditions: when intended to remain as a working movement joint
exceptions: temporary bridging during construction that is removed prior to completion

subject: Settlement Joint/Accommodation Strip
rule: settlement joint / accommodation strip must maintain a clear gap through the full building section (structure, finishes, cladding)
exceptions: where fire-rated detailing intentionally seals the joint with a flexible firestop that still permits movement

subject: Compensated Foundation Slab
rule: Compensated foundation slab must be designed to maintain net zero increase in bearing pressure on the underlying soil
conditions: When used to reduce total foundation settlement
When soil bearing capacity is a limiting factor
exceptions: When slab is founded on bedrock or engineered fill with negligible compressibility

subject: Compensated Foundation Slab
rule: Compensated foundation slab must have its base at a depth where the weight of removed soil equals the total building load
conditions: For full compensation design
exceptions: When partial compensation is intentionally designed with a controlled net bearing pressure within allowable limits

subject: Compensated Foundation Slab
rule: Compensated foundation slab must not be subjected to uplift due to groundwater buoyancy exceeding the building's dead load
conditions: In areas with high groundwater table
When the compensated depth extends below the water table
exceptions: When permanent dewatering systems or tension piles are installed to resist uplift

subject: Underpinning Element
rule: Underpinning element must transfer load directly to competent bearing strata
conditions: when used to support a foundation or structure
exceptions: when designed as a friction pile that transfers load through skin friction rather than end bearing

subject: Underpinning Element
rule: Underpinning element must not be subjected to tensile stress that exceeds its tensile capacity
conditions: when constructed of unreinforced concrete or masonry

subject: Underpinning Element
rule: Underpinning element must be installed in a sequence that maintains temporary stability of the existing structure above
conditions: when underpinning an existing building or structure

subject: Jacking Pocket
rule: jacking pocket must have a minimum clearance from the parent pipe wall to allow soil to enter the pocket during jacking
conditions: when used in microtunneling or pipe jacking operations

subject: Jacking Pocket
rule: jacking pocket must not puncture or reduce the structural wall thickness of the parent pipe below the design minimum
conditions: when formed in a precast concrete pipe segment

subject: Jacking Pocket
rule: jacking pocket must be positioned within the designated steering articulation zone of the pipe segment
conditions: when the pocket is used for steering control in pipe jacking

subject: Workbench
rule: workbench work surface must be flat and level
conditions: when used for assembly, writing, or measurement tasks
exceptions: specialized workbenches with angled surfaces for specific trades (e.g., drafting tables, jeweler's bench)

subject: Workbench
rule: workbench must support its rated load without collapse or excessive deflection
conditions: when loaded to its design capacity

subject: Workbench
rule: workbench must not tip over under normal use or rated lateral loads

subject: Workbench
rule: workbench must have a stable base with no rocking
conditions: when placed on a nominally flat floor

subject: Heavy-Duty Flooring
rule: heavy-duty flooring must have a minimum load-bearing capacity specified for the intended use case
conditions: flooring is installed in areas with known load requirements

subject: Heavy-Duty Flooring
rule: heavy-duty flooring must be slip-resistant under expected wet or contaminant conditions
conditions: flooring is in an environment where wetting or contaminant exposure is possible

subject: Heavy-Duty Flooring
rule: heavy-duty flooring must not have untreated joints or gaps that collect hazardous debris or fluids
conditions: flooring is in a hygienic or food-processing environment

subject: Dust Collection System
rule: dust collection system ductwork must be airtight
conditions: system is ducted
system handles combustible dust
exceptions: intentional relief panels or dampers that are designed to open under specific conditions

subject: Dust Collection System
rule: dust collection system must not be located inside the building being served
conditions: system handles combustible dust
exceptions: when installed per NFPA 654 in a properly rated enclosure with explosion protection

subject: Dust Collection System
rule: dust collection system filter media must be grounded and bonded
conditions: system handles combustible dust
exceptions: non-conductive filter media that is certified as static-dissipative and tested per applicable standards

subject: Dust Collection System
rule: dust collection system must have an explosion relief or suppression system
conditions: system handles combustible dust
dust hazard class is St-1 or higher
exceptions: systems handling only non-combustible dusts
systems handling combustible dust at concentrations always below MEC

subject: Workshop Exhaust Ventilation
rule: exhaust ventilation must discharge to the outdoors at a safe location
conditions: workshop contains processes that generate airborne contaminants
system is a mechanical exhaust ventilation system
exceptions: recirculating filtration systems with HEPA and carbon filtration that return air to the space

subject: Workshop Exhaust Ventilation
rule: exhaust ductwork serving workshop ventilation must not be interconnected with other building ventilation systems
conditions: the workshop generates hazardous fumes, flammable vapors, or combustible dust

subject: Workshop Exhaust Ventilation
rule: exhaust fan motor serving workshop ventilation must be located outside the airstream for hazardous exhaust
conditions: exhaust airstream contains flammable vapors, corrosive gases, or combustible dust
exceptions: specially rated spark-proof motors and fans listed for the specific hazardous classification

subject: Workshop Door
rule: workshop door must provide a clear opening width of at least the minimum required for equipment access
conditions: workshop is used for equipment or machinery storage/access
exceptions: door is strictly for personnel-only access with no equipment passage

subject: Workshop Door
rule: workshop door must open outward or be a sliding/overhead type where inward swing would block interior workspace
conditions: interior space behind the door is usable workshop floor area
exceptions: inward-swinging door where clear floor area behind the door is kept permanently unobstructed

subject: Workshop Door
rule: workshop door must_not have a threshold that creates a tripping hazard or prevents wheeled equipment access
conditions: door is at a vehicle or equipment access point
workshop floor is at grade or ramp-accessible
exceptions: threshold height complies with accessibility codes and is bevelled/ramped for wheeled loads

subject: Machine Anchoring & Vibration Isolation
rule: machine anchoring must transfer all dynamic loads to the supporting structure without exceeding the structural capacity of the foundation or anchor points
conditions: machine generates dynamic/cyclic loads during operation
exceptions: machine is mounted on a seismic/isolation base that fully decouples it from the structure

subject: Machine Anchoring & Vibration Isolation
rule: vibration isolators must not permit relative displacement between the machine and its anchorage beyond the design clearance under all rated operating conditions
conditions: vibration isolators are used between machine and foundation

subject: Machine Anchoring & Vibration Isolation
rule: anchoring system must resist overturning moment due to machine operation without relying on gravity alone when the machine produces net lateral or eccentric forces
conditions: machine produces lateral forces or has an eccentric center of mass relative to anchor pattern
exceptions: machine is positively located by mechanical interlock or keyed connection that resists overturning

subject: Machine Anchoring & Vibration Isolation
rule: vibration isolators must be prevented from buckling or bottoming out under maximum static and dynamic load combination
conditions: elastomeric or spring-type vibration isolators are used

subject: Material Storage Racking
rule: Material storage racking must have a maximum load rating that is never exceeded
conditions: racking is in use

subject: Material Storage Racking
rule: Material storage racking must be anchored to the floor or structure to prevent overturning
conditions: racking height exceeds 4x its base width
or seismic/wind loads are anticipated

subject: Material Storage Racking
rule: Material storage racking must not have missing or damaged beam locking clips
conditions: beam-to-upright connections exist

subject: Electrical Outlet Strips (Workstation Power)
rule: Electrical outlet strips must be plugged into a properly rated branch circuit receptacle
conditions: when installed for workstation power distribution

subject: Electrical Outlet Strips (Workstation Power)
rule: Electrical outlet strips must not be daisy-chained (series-connected) via the integral receptacle on the strip
conditions: when used as a workstation power distribution device

subject: Electrical Outlet Strips (Workstation Power)
rule: Electrical outlet strips must not be used with an extension cord as a permanent power source
conditions: when serving as permanent workstation power

subject: Workshop Insulation and Vapor Barrier
rule: insulation must be installed on the warm side of the vapor barrier in conditioned workshop spaces
conditions: workshop is heated or cooled (conditioned space)
exceptions: unconditioned workshop spaces where no temperature differential exists

subject: Workshop Insulation and Vapor Barrier
rule: vapor barrier must have continuous seal at all seams, edges, and penetrations
conditions: vapor barrier is installed

subject: Workshop Insulation and Vapor Barrier
