exceptions: when the seat is purely decorative and explicitly marked not for occupancy

subject: Trellis Support Posts
rule: trellis support posts must be vertically aligned to bear compressive load without buckling
conditions: when supporting overhead trellis structure

subject: Trellis Support Posts
rule: trellis support posts must be embedded or anchored to a depth that provides lateral stability against overturning
conditions: free-standing trellis not attached to a building wall

subject: Trellis Support Posts
rule: trellis support posts must not have rot or decay in the load-bearing cross-section
conditions: when made of wood or other biodegradable material

subject: Trellis Framework
rule: The trellis framework must have a minimum structural load capacity to support the anticipated weight of climbing plants plus environmental loads (e.g., wind, snow, rain)
conditions: When the trellis is installed in an outdoor location
When the trellis is intended to support climbing plants
exceptions: Decorative trellises not intended to support any significant plant weight

subject: Trellis Framework
rule: The trellis framework must be anchored or stabilized to prevent overturning or displacement under expected wind and plant loads
conditions: When the trellis is freestanding (not attached to a permanent structure)
exceptions: Trellises fully integrated into or supported by an existing wall or building structure

subject: Trellis Framework
rule: The trellis framework must not have gaps or openings smaller than the minimum required for plant growth or maintenance access
conditions: When the trellis is designed for plants that require weaving or threading through the framework
exceptions: Trellises designed purely for surface-clinging plants that do not pass through openings

subject: Trellis Roof/Canopy
rule: trellis roof/canopy must have a minimum slope or drainage provision to prevent ponding water
conditions: when designed as a horizontal or near-horizontal surface
exceptions: when the trellis is open-grid with gaps that allow water to pass through freely

subject: Trellis Roof/Canopy
rule: trellis roof/canopy must be designed to resist design wind loads (uplift and lateral)

subject: Trellis Roof/Canopy
rule: trellis roof/canopy must not use materials that cannot support their own self-weight across the intended span

subject: Trellis Walk Floor Surface
rule: Trellis Walk Floor Surface must have a minimum slip resistance classification (e.g., R10 or equivalent) to prevent pedestrian slipping under wet conditions
conditions: surface is exposed to weather or foot traffic while wet
exceptions: surface is permanently covered and never walked on

subject: Trellis Walk Floor Surface
rule: Trellis Walk Floor Surface must have a maximum allowable deflection under design live load to prevent structural failure or unsafe walking deformation
conditions: surface supports pedestrian loads

subject: Trellis Walk Floor Surface
rule: Trellis Walk Floor Surface must not have gaps or openings that exceed a specified maximum size (e.g., 100 mm sphere passage limit)
conditions: surface is elevated above ground level and accessible to pedestrians
exceptions: surface is at grade with no fall risk beneath

subject: Trellis Walk Base/Substrate
rule: Trellis Walk Base/Substrate must be capable of supporting the dead load of the trellis structure plus live loads (e.g., pedestrian traffic, snow, or maintenance loads) without excessive deflection or structural failure
conditions: when used as a walking surface or load-bearing foundation
exceptions: when the substrate serves purely as a non-load-bearing growing medium containment layer with dedicated structural support provided separately

subject: Trellis Walk Base/Substrate
rule: Trellis Walk Base/Substrate must be dimensionally stable under environmental exposure (i.e., must not significantly swell, shrink, warp, or rot when exposed to moisture, temperature cycling, or biological agents)
conditions: when installed outdoors or in unconditioned spaces

subject: Trellis Walk Base/Substrate
rule: Trellis Walk Base/Substrate must not be composed of materials that release toxic leachate or harmful chemicals into the ground or adjacent planting areas
conditions: when in contact with soil, planting medium, or where runoff water may reach surrounding vegetation

subject: Climbing Plant Support System
rule: Climbing plant support system must be securely anchored to a stable structure or the ground

subject: Climbing Plant Support System
rule: Climbing plant support system must not have sharp edges or protrusions at user-accessible heights
conditions: system is intended for use in areas accessible to people or pets
exceptions: sharp edges are part of an intentional anti-climb security feature and clearly marked

subject: Climbing Plant Support System
rule: Climbing plant support system must be made of materials resistant to corrosion or rot in the intended exposure environment
conditions: system is installed outdoors

subject: Trellis Walk Drainage System
rule: Trellis walk drainage system must maintain a continuous slope of at least 1% (1:100) towards outlet points
conditions: surface drainage is used
exceptions: when the system uses a pressurized or pumped drainage mechanism that does not rely on gravity flow

subject: Trellis Walk Drainage System
rule: Drainage system must not allow water to discharge onto pedestrian walkway surfaces in a manner that causes sheet flow across the walking path
conditions: the trellis walk is located above or adjacent to occupied pedestrian zones
exceptions: when the walkway surface itself is explicitly designed as a drainage plane with slip-resistant texture and integrated drainage channels

subject: Trellis Walk Drainage System
rule: Drainage system must have sufficient capacity to handle a 10-year, 1-hour rainfall event without overflow onto the walk surface
conditions: the trellis walk is in a region subject to building code rainfall intensity requirements

subject: Arbored Walkway
rule: Arbored walkway load-bearing structure must be designed for combined dead, live, and wind loads per applicable building code
conditions: Arbored walkway supports a roof or overhead structure
Arbored walkway is accessible to the public

subject: Arbored Walkway
rule: Arbored walkway roof or overhead covering must provide a continuous path for rainwater to drain (e.g., slope, gutters, scuppers)
conditions: Arbored walkway has a solid or impervious roof/covering
exceptions: Open-trellis or slatted arbors where wide gaps allow free water fall-through and no ponding occurs on structural members

subject: Arbored Walkway
rule: Arbored walkway must have minimum headroom clearance of 2.1 m (7 ft) above the walking surface
conditions: Arbored walkway is open to the public

subject: Arbored Walkway
rule: Arbored walkway must not have unguarded drops of 600 mm or more at its edges when the walkway is elevated
conditions: Arbored walkway is elevated more than 600 mm above adjacent grade or floor
exceptions: Areas where guard is not required by code (e.g., loading docks, stages with designated uses)

subject: Pergola Walk
rule: Pergola walk structure must have a minimum clear width of 900 mm (3 ft) for pedestrian passage
conditions: when used as a primary pedestrian route
when required for egress or accessibility
exceptions: where local building codes permit narrower widths for auxiliary or decorative walkways

subject: Pergola Walk
rule: Pergola walk must have a minimum headroom clearance of 2100 mm (7 ft) above finished floor
conditions: where the pergola walk is covered or has overhead beams/lattice
exceptions: none — safety clearance is fundamental for all covered walkways

subject: Pergola Walk
rule: Pergola walk must not have standing water on the walking surface
conditions: when the walkway is exposed to rain or irrigation
exceptions: none — ponding creates slip hazard, mosquito breeding, and material degradation

subject: Greenhouse Glazing System
rule: glazing panes must be tempered or laminated glass (or approved polycarbonate equivalent)
conditions: when glazing material is glass
exceptions: locations where impact resistance is not required and small pane sizes are used

subject: Greenhouse Glazing System
rule: glazing system must allow for differential thermal expansion between frame and glazing material

subject: Greenhouse Glazing System
rule: glazing panels must be positively retained against wind uplift

subject: Greenhouse Glazing System
rule: glazing must not create continuous unvented air spaces that trap condensation against structural members
conditions: when glazing is multi-wall polycarbonate or double-glazed sealed units
exceptions: systems with dedicated weep or condensation drainage paths

subject: Greenhouse Glazing System
rule: glass-to-metal contact must be isolated with gaskets or setting blocks to prevent stress concentration
conditions: when glazing material is glass

subject: Greenhouse Frame Structure
rule: frame must support the full dead load of glazing and live loads from snow, wind, and equipment
conditions: permanent greenhouse structure
exceptions: temporary hoop houses with fabric cover

subject: Greenhouse Frame Structure
rule: frame must not have gaps between structural members that compromise weather sealing
conditions: glazed greenhouse
exceptions: intentional ventilation openings with controlled dampers

subject: Greenhouse Frame Structure
rule: frame material in contact with soil or moisture must be corrosion-resistant or protected
conditions: frame embedded in foundation or ground-contact
exceptions: temporary structures with planned seasonal disassembly

subject: Greenhouse Frame Structure
rule: roof frame slope must provide a drainage path to prevent ponding
conditions: glass or rigid-panel roof
exceptions: flat-roof greenhouse with engineered internal drainage system

subject: Greenhouse Foundation
rule: Greenhouse foundation must provide a continuous load-bearing perimeter to support the superstructure and resist vertical dead and live loads
conditions: The foundation is a perimeter type (e.g., concrete footing, stem wall)
exceptions: Point-foundation or pier systems used in very lightweight or small greenhouses

subject: Greenhouse Foundation
rule: Foundation must extend below the local frost line
conditions: Site experiences freezing temperatures
Foundation is a shallow type (slab-on-grade, footing, or stem wall)
exceptions: Greenhouse is designed as an unheated seasonal structure that is intentionally allowed to heave and releveled each season

subject: Greenhouse Foundation
rule: Foundation must be anchored to resist uplift from wind loads
conditions: Greenhouse is located in a region with design wind speeds above 100 mph (per local code)
Structure is a gutter-connected or large-span greenhouse with high roof area

subject: Greenhouse Environmental Control System
rule: greenhouse ventilation system must provide minimum air exchange rate to prevent lethal heat buildup
conditions: closed greenhouse configuration
solar exposure present
exceptions: active cooling system with adequate capacity is installed and operational

subject: Greenhouse Environmental Control System
rule: shading or glazing system must not transmit more than 80% of incident solar radiation during peak summer conditions
conditions: greenhouse located in climate zone with summer peak irradiance above 800 W/m²
crops are C3 or shade-sensitive plants
exceptions: crops specifically requiring full direct sun (e.g., some succulents, high-light orchids)
supplemental active cooling can maintain internal temperature below 35°C

subject: Greenhouse Environmental Control System
rule: irrigation system must not allow standing water to persist for more than 24 hours in root zone
conditions: soil-based or inert media growing system
crops are not aquatic or semi-aquatic
exceptions: flood-and-drain (ebb-and-flow) systems where drainage is forced
rice or aquatic crop production

subject: Greenhouse Environmental Control System
rule: heating system must maintain internal temperature above crop-specific minimum threshold under worst-case outdoor conditions
conditions: greenhouse used for year-round or cold-season production
minimum outdoor temperature can drop below crop tolerance
exceptions: seasonal greenhouse used only during frost-free period

subject: Greenhouse Irrigation & Drainage System
rule: irrigation supply pipework must be isolated from the domestic water supply by an air gap or approved backflow prevention device
conditions: system is connected to a potable water source

subject: Greenhouse Irrigation & Drainage System
rule: drainage collection pipework must be sloped to maintain gravity flow towards the collection or disposal point
conditions: system relies on gravity drainage
exceptions: where pumped drainage is designed and installed

subject: Greenhouse Irrigation & Drainage System
rule: irrigation emitters must not be positioned such that water is applied directly onto electrical conduits, junction boxes, or controllers
conditions: system includes overhead or pressurised irrigation emitters
exceptions: where all electrical components are rated for wet locations and IP68 enclosures are verified

subject: Greenhouse Irrigation & Drainage System
rule: drainage outlet invert must be lower than the lowest greenhouse floor elevation served
exceptions: where sump pumping with float-activated pump is provided

subject: Greenhouse Shading & Light Control System
rule: shading devices must not block more than 80% of photosynthetically active radiation (PAR) during peak growing hours
conditions: system is used for crop production
system operates during daylight hours
exceptions: specialized photoperiod experiments requiring complete darkness

subject: Greenhouse Shading & Light Control System
rule: shading actuation mechanisms must be operable in the full range of ambient greenhouse humidity conditions (0–100% RH)
conditions: system includes motorized or mechanical actuation

subject: Greenhouse Shading & Light Control System
rule: light control system must not introduce more than 5°C localized temperature increase under any shade sail or screen
conditions: system uses solid or fabric shading materials that restrict airflow

subject: Greenhouse Shading & Light Control System
rule: supplemental lighting fixtures must be rated for the greenhouse wet environment (minimum IP65 or equivalent ingress protection)
conditions: system includes grow lights or supplemental LEDs installed within the greenhouse envelope
exceptions: lights are installed in a separate dry-room isolated from the growing environment

subject: Greenhouse Ventilation System
rule: ventilation openings must be covered with insect screening
conditions: greenhouse is used for crop production
openings are greater than 1 mm in any dimension
exceptions: high-tech greenhouses with positive pressure and filtered intake

subject: Greenhouse Ventilation System
rule: ridge vent or exhaust fan must be located at or near the highest point of the greenhouse roof
conditions: system relies on natural convection for ventilation
exceptions: mechanical ventilation system with sidewall fans only

subject: Greenhouse Ventilation System
rule: ventilation system must not create negative static pressure exceeding structural design limits of greenhouse framing
conditions: system uses exhaust fans

subject: Greenhouse Ventilation System
rule: motorized vent actuators must have a manual override or fail-open mechanism
conditions: system includes motorized opening/closing devices
exceptions: greenhouse with backup generator that automatically powers vent controls on mains failure

subject: Greenhouse Benching & Shelving System
rule: benching and shelving system must be constructed from materials resistant to corrosion, rot, and moisture degradation
conditions: installed in a greenhouse environment with high humidity and potential water exposure

subject: Greenhouse Benching & Shelving System
rule: shelving surfaces must allow drainage of excess water
conditions: shelves are used for potted plants or trays with irrigation
exceptions: shelving used exclusively for dry storage of tools or non-plant supplies

subject: Greenhouse Benching & Shelving System
rule: benching system must not collapse under expected static load of saturated growing media and plants

subject: Greenhouse Growing Medium & Containment
rule: growing medium must be contained within a physical barrier (e.g., pots, benches, ground liner) to prevent direct contact with native soil or subsurface drainage
conditions: greenhouse is floor-based or ground-contact growing system
exceptions: hydroponic systems where growing medium is replaced by nutrient solution and containment is the channel or pipe

subject: Greenhouse Growing Medium & Containment
rule: growing medium depth must not exceed the physical retention capacity of its container or bench without adequate lateral support
conditions: medium is placed on elevated benches or in free-standing containers
exceptions: deep raised beds with reinforced sides designed for full soil depth

subject: Greenhouse Growing Medium & Containment
rule: growing medium must not obstruct greenhouse drainage paths (floor gutters, under-bench channels, or French drains)
conditions: greenhouse has floor-level drainage infrastructure
exceptions: greenhouses with fully sealed floors and recirculating drainage systems where all runoff is captured in pipes

subject: Greenhouse Lighting System
rule: lighting system electrical components must be protected from moisture and condensation
conditions: system is installed in a greenhouse environment with high humidity
exceptions: components are specifically rated and certified for wet/outdoor locations per IP/NEMA standards

subject: Greenhouse Lighting System
rule: lighting fixtures must not obstruct irrigation or ventilation pathways
conditions: system is suspended above or among plant growing areas

subject: Greenhouse Lighting System
rule: lighting system must not generate heat that exceeds the greenhouse's ventilation capacity at design ambient conditions
conditions: system uses non-LED sources (HPS, metal halide, etc.) or high-density LED arrays
exceptions: system includes dedicated supplemental cooling that maintains safe internal temperatures

subject: Greenhouse Access & Circulation Space
rule: Circulation paths within greenhouse access spaces must have a minimum clear width of 0.9 m (3 ft) to accommodate personnel movement and equipment passage
conditions: Space is occupied or used for moving materials
exceptions: Single-person inspection-only access routes in non-operational greenhouses

subject: Greenhouse Access & Circulation Space
rule: Circulation paths must be free of obstructions that block egress in an emergency
conditions: Space serves as a means of egress from greenhouse zones
exceptions: Temporary staging of plants during repotting operations if an unobstructed alternate path remains available

subject: Greenhouse Access & Circulation Space
rule: Floor surface in circulation paths must not create a slip hazard under wet conditions
conditions: Path is exposed to irrigation overspray, condensation, or hose drainage
exceptions: Areas explicitly designated as wet-mopping stations where slip-resistant footwear is mandatory

subject: Greenhouse Access & Circulation Space
rule: Doorways serving greenhouse access and circulation spaces must have a minimum clear opening width of 0.81 m (32 in) for wheelchair and equipment access
conditions: Doorway provides primary access to/from the greenhouse work area
exceptions: Historical greenhouse structures where structural alteration is physically impossible and an alternative accessible entrance exists within 30 m

subject: Greenhouse Emergency Egress & Safety Systems
rule: emergency egress doors must open outward from the greenhouse interior
conditions: Greenhouse has emergency egress doors
exceptions: Doors subject to snow drift or ice buildup that could block outward swing

subject: Greenhouse Emergency Egress & Safety Systems
rule: emergency exit paths must not be obstructed by plants, equipment, or growing media
conditions: Greenhouse has designated egress paths

subject: Greenhouse Emergency Egress & Safety Systems
rule: emergency egress system must provide at least two independent means of escape from any occupied greenhouse zone
conditions: Greenhouse is occupied by personnel
Greenhouse floor area exceeds code-defined threshold (typically 500-1000 sq ft depending on jurisdiction)
exceptions: Greenhouses with a single exit that leads directly to grade and travel distance is below code minimum

subject: Greenhouse Emergency Egress & Safety Systems
rule: emergency safety systems (fire alarms, emergency lighting, panic hardware) must remain functional during a primary power failure
conditions: Greenhouse is occupied by personnel
Greenhouse is mechanically ventilated or heated
exceptions: Unoccupied greenhouses with no overnight occupancy and no combustion equipment

subject: Greenhouse Emergency Egress & Safety Systems
rule: emergency egress doors must not be locked from the inside during occupied hours
conditions: Greenhouse is occupied by personnel
exceptions: Doors equipped with panic hardware or delayed-egress locking systems approved by fire code

subject: Garden Seat Retaining Wall
rule: Garden seat retaining wall must have adequate drainage (weep holes or gravel backfill) to prevent hydrostatic pressure buildup
conditions: wall retains soil
wall is solid/masonry construction
exceptions: wall is purely decorative with no retained soil behind it

subject: Garden Seat Retaining Wall
rule: Garden seat retaining wall must have a foundation/footing that extends below the frost line or be frost-protected
conditions: wall is located in a climate with seasonal ground freezing
exceptions: wall is placed on a free-draining granular base in a non-freeze-thaw environment
wall is a dry-stack gravity wall on a compacted gravel base in a mild climate

subject: Garden Seat Retaining Wall
rule: Garden seat retaining wall must not exceed its overturning or sliding stability limits under retained soil pressure
conditions: wall height exceeds 2 feet
wall retains significant soil depth
exceptions: wall is mechanically anchored or tied back
wall is designed as a reinforced cantilever with verified geotechnical analysis

subject: Pergola-Seat Combination
rule: Pergola-Seat Combination must have a structural connection between the pergola frame and the seat element
conditions: The seat is attached to or integrated with the pergola structure
exceptions: The seat is a separate, freestanding piece placed independently under the pergola

subject: Pergola-Seat Combination
rule: Pergola-Seat Combination must not have cantilevered seat spans that exceed the structural capacity of the supporting pergola members
conditions: The seat cantilevers from the pergola frame without intermediate ground supports

subject: Pergola-Seat Combination
rule: Pergola-Seat Combination must have a minimum clear headroom of 2000 mm between the seat surface and any overhead pergola beam or roof element
conditions: The pergola has overhead beams, rafters, or a roof above the seated area

subject: Pergola-Seat Combination
rule: Pergola-Seat Combination must not have exposed fasteners or sharp edges on the seat surface or armrest area
conditions: The seat is intended for human occupation

subject: Weatherproof Seat Cushion Storage
rule: storage enclosure must be fully sealed against water ingress to prevent cushion degradation
conditions: cushions are present
unit is deployed outdoors
exceptions: cushions are removed during wet conditions

subject: Weatherproof Seat Cushion Storage
rule: storage must not accumulate standing water inside the enclosure
conditions: unit is exposed to rain or splash

subject: Weatherproof Seat Cushion Storage
rule: drainage path must exist at the lowest point of the enclosure if water ingress cannot be absolutely prevented
conditions: enclosure has any openings or breathable membranes
unit is deployed outdoors
exceptions: enclosure is hermetically sealed with no openings whatsoever

subject: Garden Seat Foundation
rule: Garden seat foundation must bear on undisturbed soil or compacted engineered fill
conditions: foundation supports a garden seat
soil-bearing design
exceptions: deep pile foundation designed by a structural engineer

subject: Garden Seat Foundation
rule: Garden seat foundation must be placed below frost depth in frost-prone climates
conditions: located in region where freezing ground temperatures occur
exceptions: foundation designed as a frost-protected shallow foundation per applicable building code

subject: Garden Seat Foundation
rule: Garden seat foundation must not be constructed on organic topsoil or uncompacted fill
conditions: foundation supports a rigid seat structure
exceptions: topsoil and fill are removed and replaced with engineered compacted material below footing depth

subject: Garden Seat Backrest
rule: Garden seat backrest must withstand a horizontal load of at least 0.75 kN applied at any point on the top edge
conditions: backrest is intended for seated adults

subject: Garden Seat Backrest
rule: Garden seat backrest must not have sharp edges or protruding elements that could cause injury

subject: Garden Seat Backrest
rule: Garden seat backrest must have a minimum height of 400 mm above the seat surface
conditions: backrest is intended for typical adult seating

subject: Garden Seat Backrest
rule: Garden seat backrest must not have gaps between 100 mm and 230 mm (or equivalent entrapment zone) in the vertical plane
conditions: backrest includes vertical bars, slats, or any openings

subject: Stepped Garden Seating
rule: Stepped garden seating must have a minimum tread depth of 300mm (12") for safe pedestrian use
conditions: seating is designed for pedestrian access or egress
treads are used as walking surfaces
exceptions: seating is purely decorative with no pedestrian access

subject: Stepped Garden Seating
rule: Stepped garden seating riser height must not exceed 190mm (7.5")
conditions: steps are used for pedestrian circulation
exceptions: seating area is not used for circulation and riser serves only as seat back or planter face

subject: Stepped Garden Seating
rule: Each stepped seating level must have a maximum cross-slope of 2% (1:50) when used as accessible seating
conditions: area is intended as an accessible seating area
wheelchair users are anticipated occupants
exceptions: stepped surface is designated as inaccessible viewing only (e.g., no accessible route required)

subject: Stepped Garden Seating
rule: Stepped garden seating surface materials must be slip-resistant when wet
conditions: seating is exposed to weather
exceptions: seating is under permanent roof cover

subject: Fire Pit Seat Ring
rule: seat ring must be made of non-combustible material
conditions: seat ring is within 3m of fire pit
seat ring serves as seating around a fire feature
exceptions: seat ring is separated by a non-combustible barrier

subject: Fire Pit Seat Ring
rule: seat ring must not block airflow to the fire pit combustion zone
conditions: seat ring fully encloses or partially surrounds the fire pit
exceptions: seat ring has engineered ventilation gaps or is raised clear of the combustion air intake zone

subject: Fire Pit Seat Ring
rule: seat ring must have a minimum clearance gap from the fire pit wall
conditions: seat ring is a separate component installed around an existing fire pit unit
seat ring is not integral/cast as one piece with the fire pit body

subject: Garden Seat Drainage Layer
rule: Garden seat drainage layer must have a continuous slope of at least 1-2% toward an outlet or drainage path
conditions: when installed on a horizontal or near-horizontal surface such as a roof or terrace
exceptions: when the drainage layer is part of a fully contained planter box with internal water storage and no discharge

subject: Garden Seat Drainage Layer
rule: Garden seat drainage layer must not allow fines (soil particles smaller than 0.075 mm) from the growing medium above to migrate into and clog the drainage medium
conditions: when a filter fabric or separator layer is absent between growing medium and drainage layer
exceptions: when the drainage layer material itself has pore sizes small enough to block fines migration (e.g., certain graded sand filters)

subject: Garden Seat Drainage Layer
rule: Garden seat drainage layer must have a flow capacity sufficient to handle the design storm's peak rainfall intensity on the contributing catchment area
conditions: when the drainage layer serves as the primary path for stormwater removal from the garden seat area
exceptions: when an separate overflow drainage system is provided that can handle peak flows independently

subject: Timber Seat Decking
rule: Timber seat decking must have a minimum slope of 1:80 (12.5 mm/m) for drainage to prevent water pooling and decay
conditions: decking is exposed to rain
decking is installed outdoors
exceptions: decking is installed under a fully waterproof roof or canopy that prevents all rainwater from reaching it

subject: Timber Seat Decking
rule: Timber seat decking must not have sharp edges, splinters, or protruding fasteners on any surface that users contact
conditions: decking is in a publicly accessible area or any area where people sit or walk barefoot

subject: Timber Seat Decking
rule: Timber seat decking must be fixed to the substructure with corrosion-resistant fasteners appropriate for the exposure condition
conditions: decking is installed outdoors
decking is installed in a damp or corrosive environment (coastal, poolside, etc.)

subject: Raised Planting Bed
rule: Raised planting bed must have adequate drainage holes or a drainage layer to prevent waterlogging of plant roots
conditions: Used for growing plants directly in the bed
exceptions: Hydroponic or aquatic plant applications where water retention is intentional

subject: Raised Planting Bed
rule: Raised planting bed must not be constructed with untreated wood that contacts soil in ground-contact conditions
conditions: Bed is located outdoors or in a damp environment
Bed uses wood as the primary structural material
exceptions: Treated wood rated for ground contact is acceptable
Non-wood materials (metal, concrete, stone, recycled plastic) are used

subject: Raised Planting Bed
rule: Raised planting bed must support the total weight of saturated soil without structural failure
conditions: Bed has solid sides that retain soil
exceptions: Very shallow beds (under 150 mm depth) have negligible lateral soil pressure

subject: Raised Planting Bed
rule: Raised planting bed must have a minimum depth sufficient for the root systems of intended plants
conditions: Bed is intended for growing specific plants with known root depths
exceptions: Shallow-rooted plants only (e.g., lettuce, herbs in a 150-200 mm deep bed)

subject: In-Ground Planting Bed
rule: In-ground planting bed must have a minimum soil depth of at least 12 inches (300 mm) for root development
conditions: For general planting (turf, groundcovers, small perennials)
Interior or exterior application
exceptions: Specialized shallow-rooted planting schemes (e.g., sedum carpet) may use reduced depth with engineered growing media

subject: In-Ground Planting Bed
rule: In-ground planting bed must have a positive drainage path to prevent standing water
conditions: Any in-ground planting bed with soil and plants
exceptions: Bog gardens or constructed wetlands designed for saturation

subject: In-Ground Planting Bed
rule: In-ground planting bed must not be located directly above underground utility lines without protective measures
conditions: When utilities (gas, electric, water, telecom) exist in the footprint
exceptions: When utilities are decommissioned, relocated, or sleeved with structural protection rated for root penetration and excavation loads

subject: In-Ground Planting Bed
rule: In-ground planting bed must have a clear separation from building foundations (minimum distance or waterproof barrier)
conditions: When adjacent to a building with a conventional foundation
exceptions: When building design specifically accommodates planting against foundation with root barriers and waterproofing details

subject: Garden Pathway
rule: garden pathway must have a stable, load-bearing base material (e.g., compacted gravel, concrete slab, or paving stones) directly underfoot
conditions: pathway is intended for pedestrian use

subject: Garden Pathway
rule: garden pathway must not create a tripping hazard where adjacent paver/slab edges differ in height by more than 6 mm (1/4 inch)
conditions: pathway surface is formed by discrete units such as pavers, tiles, or flagstones

subject: Garden Pathway
rule: garden pathway must have a cross-slope or crown of at least 1% (1 cm per meter) to shed water
conditions: pathway is exposed to rainwater

subject: Garden Irrigation System
rule: garden irrigation system must have a functional backflow prevention device when connected to a potable water supply
conditions: system is connected to a potable (drinking) water supply

subject: Garden Irrigation System
rule: garden irrigation system must not have sprinkler heads that spray directly onto building walls, windows, or electrical components
conditions: system uses overhead sprinklers
building exterior is within spray range
exceptions: drip irrigation or soaker hose systems that do not produce airborne spray

subject: Garden Irrigation System
rule: garden irrigation system must have an automatic shutoff or rain sensor when connected to an automated controller
conditions: system uses an automated timer/controller
exceptions: manually operated systems with no automation

subject: Garden Edging
rule: Garden edging must be made from weather-resistant or treated material to prevent rot and degradation in outdoor conditions
conditions: installed outdoors
exposed to soil moisture and rainfall
exceptions: seasonal/temporary edging not expected to last beyond one season

subject: Garden Edging
rule: Garden edging bottom edge must be at or below grade level to provide effective soil containment
conditions: edging is used for soil retention or border definition
exceptions: purely decorative edging resting on surface with no containment function

subject: Garden Edging
rule: Garden edging must not create a tripping hazard where pedestrian traffic is expected
conditions: edging is adjacent to walkways, lawns, or other pedestrian-accessible areas
exceptions: edging designed and explicitly marked as a deliberate raised barrier in non-traffic areas

subject: Compost Bin Enclosure
rule: enclosure walls must be permeable to allow airflow for aerobic decomposition
conditions: enclosed design
exceptions: anaerobic composting systems

subject: Compost Bin Enclosure
rule: enclosure must have direct ground contact (no impermeable floor)
conditions: ground-level installation
exceptions: tumbler-style composters on stands

subject: Compost Bin Enclosure
rule: enclosure must not have a solid roof that prevents moisture entry
conditions: open-top or partially covered designs
exceptions: fully enclosed bin in arid climate where supplemental watering is provided

subject: Compost Bin Enclosure
rule: access side or door must be removable or hinged for pile turning and removal
conditions: fixed-position enclosure
exceptions: modular stacking bins where sections lift off individually

subject: Garden Trellis
rule: garden trellis must be structurally stable against expected lateral loads (e.g., wind, climbing plants)
conditions: free-standing or attached to a wall

subject: Garden Trellis
rule: garden trellis must not have sharp protruding elements at accessible heights
conditions: installed where people or pets may brush against it

subject: Garden Trellis
rule: garden trellis material must be weather-resistant for outdoor exposure
conditions: installed outdoors

subject: Garden Trellis
rule: garden trellis must not trap water against an adjacent building wall
conditions: attached directly to a building wall

subject: Garden Cold Frame
rule: glazing or cover material must be sloped or curved to shed rain and snow
conditions: used outdoors
exposed to precipitation
exceptions: located in climate with zero precipitation

subject: Garden Cold Frame
rule: lid or cover must be openable or removable to provide ventilation and access
conditions: used for plant cultivation

subject: Garden Cold Frame
rule: glazing material must be transparent or translucent to visible light
conditions: used for plant growth
exceptions: used exclusively as a storage box, not for plants

subject: Garden Hose Bib / Water Spigot
rule: water spigot must be installed on a pressurized water supply line

subject: Garden Hose Bib / Water Spigot
rule: spigot must be protected from freezing temperatures when installed in climates subject to frost
conditions: climate where ambient temperature drops below 0°C (32°F)
exceptions: interior-installed spigot in conditioned space where pipe never freezes

subject: Garden Hose Bib / Water Spigot
rule: spigot must have a backflow prevention device when connected to a potable water supply
conditions: connection to potable/drinking water supply
exceptions: separate non-potable supply line with no cross-connection risk

subject: Garden Hose Bib / Water Spigot
rule: spigot must not be installed in a location inaccessible for manual operation
exceptions: automated/remotely actuated spigot with no manual handle required

subject: Garden Lighting
rule: Garden lighting luminaires must be rated for outdoor/wet-location use (minimum IP65 or equivalent)
conditions: Fixture is installed in an exposed outdoor garden area
exceptions: Fully sheltered locations under a covered verandah or deep eave may use IP44 minimum

subject: Garden Lighting
rule: All garden lighting low-voltage cables must be buried at a minimum depth of 600 mm or protected by mechanical conduit
conditions: Cable run crosses a garden bed, lawn, or pathway
exceptions: Cables routed in rigid metal conduit may be installed at reduced depth of 450 mm per AS/NZS 3000

subject: Garden Lighting
rule: Garden lighting transformer/driver must not be installed inside a sealed underground junction box without ventilation and flood protection
conditions: Transformer is located in a below-grade pit or buried enclosure
exceptions: Transformers rated IP68 and designed for continuous submersion may be used in flood-prone areas

subject: Fence / Garden Boundary
rule: Fence / garden boundary must be structurally stable under its own weight and expected wind loads
conditions: fence is freestanding

subject: Fence / Garden Boundary
rule: Fence / garden boundary must not exceed maximum unsupported span between posts
conditions: fence has rail-and-post or panel construction
exceptions: fence is tensioned wire or chain-link with structural corner posts

subject: Fence / Garden Boundary
rule: Fence / garden boundary posts must be embedded or founded to resist overturning moment
conditions: fence is freestanding with posts

subject: Fence / Garden Boundary
rule: Fence / garden boundary gate must swing freely without binding against adjacent structure or ground
conditions: fence includes a gate

subject: Garden Gate
rule: garden gate must allow passage of persons and equipment through its opening

subject: Garden Gate
rule: garden gate must withstand wind loads without detaching from its hinges or posts

subject: Garden Gate
rule: garden gate must not swing into an obstruction that prevents full opening
conditions: when gate is hinged to swing in a particular direction
exceptions: if the gate is a sliding (bypass) gate that does not swing

subject: Garden Gate
rule: garden gate must have a latch or closing mechanism that secures the gate in the closed position
conditions: when the gate is intended to be closed and secured
exceptions: if the gate is purely decorative and never intended to be latched

subject: Soil / Growing Medium
rule: Soil / Growing Medium in a planter or on a roof must be physically contained by a structure (e.g., planter wall, edge restraint) to prevent lateral displacement or erosion under gravity and wind
conditions: Soil / Growing Medium is used in an elevated planter
Soil / Growing Medium is used on a rooftop growing bed
exceptions: Soil is part of a ground-level, horizontally unbounded landscape where lateral movement is acceptable or naturally arrested by adjacent ground

subject: Soil / Growing Medium
rule: Soil / Growing Medium must be a depth sufficient to support the root system and structural loading of the intended plants, otherwise the growing medium will not hold the plants
conditions: Soil / Growing Medium supports woody plants, trees, or deep-rooted vegetation
exceptions: Growing medium is only for shallow-rooted ground covers or sedum mats where minimum depth is already defined by the plant type

subject: Soil / Growing Medium
rule: Soil / Growing Medium must not contain materials (e.g., large debris, sharp objects, toxic contaminants) that prevent root penetration or harm plant health
conditions: Soil / Growing Medium is used for plant growth

subject: Greenhouse / Polytunnel Structure
rule: glazing/cladding material must be light-transmitting
conditions: used for plant growth lighting
exceptions: tunnel used exclusively for non-photosynthetic purposes such as storage or dry curing

subject: Greenhouse / Polytunnel Structure
rule: structure must be ventilated
conditions: contains living plants
exceptions: temporarily sealed for thermal fumigation or CO₂ enrichment cycles

subject: Greenhouse / Polytunnel Structure
rule: cladding must not be so heavy that it collapses the frame
exceptions: frame is specifically engineered for the imposed dead load

subject: Greenhouse / Polytunnel Structure
rule: foundation or ground-anchoring system must resist wind uplift
exceptions: structure is temporary and intentionally unanchored for relocation

subject: Soil Berm / Mound
rule: soil berm / mound must have a stable angle of repose not exceeding the soil's natural angle of repose
conditions: berm constructed from granular/cohesive soil
exceptions: berm is mechanically stabilized (e.g., geogrid, retaining wall system)

subject: Soil Berm / Mound
rule: soil berm / mound must be compacted to a density sufficient to prevent differential settlement
conditions: berm supports any structural load or is located adjacent to building foundations

subject: Soil Berm / Mound
rule: soil berm / mound must not obstruct required drainage paths or create ponding against building walls
conditions: berm is placed adjacent to building perimeter
exceptions: a dedicated waterproofing and drainage system (e.g., drainage board, gravel trench) is installed to manage water

subject: Rainwater Harvesting System (Garden)
rule: rainwater harvesting system must have a collection surface (e.g., roof, catchment area) that drains into it
conditions: when designed to collect precipitation
when installed in a garden setting
exceptions: system is designed only for manually-supplied water (e.g., hose fill)

subject: Rainwater Harvesting System (Garden)
rule: downspout or inlet pipe must direct water into storage tank or cistern at a lower elevation than the collection surface
conditions: when system relies on gravity flow
when connected to roof or elevated catchment
exceptions: system uses active pumping directly from surface runoff without storage

subject: Rainwater Harvesting System (Garden)
rule: storage tank must have an overflow outlet
conditions: when system includes a closed tank or cistern
exceptions: open pond or basin design where overflow is not confined

subject: Rainwater Harvesting System (Garden)
rule: first-flush diverter or debris screen must be present between catchment surface and storage
conditions: when collection surface is exposed to dirt, leaves, bird droppings, or other debris
exceptions: water is used only for non-potable non-contact irrigation and owner accepts sediment buildup

subject: Rainwater Harvesting System (Garden)
rule: storage tank must be sealed against mosquitoes and light ingress
conditions: when tank is opaque or closed
when system is used for irrigation
exceptions: open pond design intended as wildlife habitat

subject: Garden Tool Storage Shed
rule: roof must have a drainage path
conditions: shed has a roof

subject: Garden Tool Storage Shed
rule: floor must be elevated above grade
conditions: shed is placed on ground with soil or moisture exposure
exceptions: shed is designed as a floating/pontoon structure over water

subject: Garden Tool Storage Shed
rule: all openings must be closable and lockable
conditions: shed contains valuable or moisture-sensitive garden tools

subject: Garden Tool Storage Shed
rule: wall materials must not be combustible near stored fuel or chemicals
conditions: shed stores gasoline, propane, fertilizer, or pesticides
exceptions: shed is separated by an approved fire-rated barrier

subject: Compost Storage Bin
rule: compost storage bin must have adequate ventilation openings or gaps to allow aerobic decomposition and prevent anaerobic conditions
conditions: bin is used for aerobic composting
bin is enclosed on all sides
exceptions: bin is designed specifically for anaerobic composting (e.g., sealed Bokashi system)

subject: Compost Storage Bin
rule: compost storage bin must have a lid or cover to control moisture and deter pests
conditions: bin is located outdoors
exceptions: bin is a fully enclosed tumbler design with integrated cover
bin is an indoor worm-composting system where pests are not a concern

subject: Compost Storage Bin
rule: compost storage bin must not have a solid, sealed base that prevents drainage of excess liquid
conditions: bin is a static (non-tumbler) ground-contact design
exceptions: bin has a spigot or drainage port to actively remove leachate

subject: Compost Storage Bin
rule: compost storage bin's walls must not be made of materials that chemically leach into compost at harmful concentrations
conditions: bin is used for edible food-waste composting
exceptions: material is proven safe by relevant food-contact standards

subject: Compost Chute
rule: compost chute must have a downward slope of at least 45 degrees from inlet to outlet to ensure gravity-driven material flow
conditions: gravity-fed compost chute
exceptions: chute with mechanical conveyance system (e.g., auger or conveyor belt)

subject: Compost Chute
rule: compost chute must be sealed against moisture ingress at all joints and access doors
conditions: chute penetrates building envelope or is exposed to exterior conditions
exceptions: fully interior chute within a conditioned space with no exposure to rain or groundwater

subject: Compost Chute
rule: compost chute access door must not open into a habitable space without a self-closing, gasket-sealed mechanism
conditions: chute has an access door or inlet opening to occupied interior spaces

subject: Compost Collection Room
rule: Compost collection room must have a sealed, non-absorbent floor surface (e.g., concrete with sealer or epoxy coating)
conditions: Room is used for active composting or storage of compost materials

subject: Compost Collection Room
rule: Compost collection room must have a floor drain connected to a proper waste conveyance system
conditions: Room is used for active composting or handling of wet organic waste
exceptions: Room serves only as dry storage for bagged finished compost

subject: Compost Collection Room
rule: Compost collection room must not share a return air plenum or HVAC supply with occupied habitable spaces
conditions: Room contains actively composting material
exceptions: Room has independent dedicated exhaust directly to outdoors with no recirculation

subject: Compost Access Door
rule: compost access door must be lockable or securable while not in active use
conditions: door is externally accessible
compost area is accessible to general public or animals

subject: Compost Access Door
rule: compost access door must not allow leakage of compost liquids or odors into adjacent spaces when closed
conditions: door is located in an enclosed or conditioned space
door separates compost area from occupied or finished spaces

subject: Compost Ventilation System
rule: compost ventilation system must maintain a continuous air path from inlet to outlet
conditions: when designed as passive system

subject: Compost Ventilation System
rule: compost ventilation system must not have air intake located within a known source of toxic or odorous contamination
conditions: when system draws from ambient air

subject: Compost Ventilation System
rule: compost ventilation system must have all ductwork and plenums accessible for cleaning
conditions: when system includes enclosed ducts or plenums

subject: Compost Ventilation System
rule: compost ventilation system must not allow positive pressurization of the compost pile beyond the structural capacity of the confining walls
conditions: when system uses forced (mechanical) aeration

subject: Compost Ventilation System
rule: compost ventilation system's exhaust outlet must be located away from building fresh air intakes and occupied openings
conditions: when system exhausts to outdoors

subject: Compost Area Wall Finish
rule: Compost area wall finish must be impermeable and non-absorbent to prevent moisture ingress from compost liquids and cleaning water
conditions: compost area is a wet environment
wall finish is in direct contact with compost or wash-down areas

subject: Compost Area Wall Finish
rule: Compost area wall finish must be resistant to chemical attack from organic acids and cleaning agents
conditions: compost area is active
cleaning chemicals are used

subject: Compost Area Wall Finish
rule: Compost area wall finish must not be organic or biodegradable material

subject: Compost Area Floor Drain
rule: compost area floor drain must be connected to a drainage or sewer system
exceptions: if the compost area is designed for passive leachate management with no liquid discharge

subject: Compost Area Floor Drain
rule: compost area floor drain must have a trap or odor seal
conditions: when connected to an enclosed sewer or drainage line
exceptions: if the drain discharges directly to an open treatment system where sewer gas backflow is impossible

subject: Compost Area Floor Drain
rule: compost area floor drain must be sized to handle peak liquid flow from the compost area

subject: Compost Area Floor Drain
rule: compost area floor drain must not be placed where it will be crushed or blocked by heavy equipment loads
conditions: when the compost area is accessed by front-end loaders, trucks, or other heavy machinery
exceptions: if the drain and surrounding structure are designed to withstand the full imposed wheel loads

subject: Compost Area Floor Finish
rule: Compost area floor finish must be impervious (non-absorbent) to prevent liquid seepage into the substrate
conditions: floor is in an active composting area where liquids are present

subject: Compost Area Floor Finish
rule: Compost area floor finish must be slip-resistant when wet
conditions: floor is used by personnel for operations, maintenance, or monitoring

subject: Compost Area Floor Finish
rule: Compost area floor finish must be resistant to chemical attack from acidic leachate and organic acids
conditions: floor is exposed to composting materials and leachate

subject: Compost Area Floor Finish
rule: Compost area floor finish must not have open joints or gaps that allow liquid or pest infiltration
conditions: floor is installed with multiple tiles, pavers, or jointed sections

subject: Seating alcove
rule: Seating alcove must have a minimum clear floor area of at least 900 mm × 900 mm (or equivalent area) to accommodate a seated person and allow minimal egress
conditions: seating alcove is intended for occupancy by a person
seating alcove is enclosed on at least two sides
exceptions: alcove is exclusively decorative and not intended for human occupation

subject: Seating alcove
rule: Seating alcove must not have a floor-to-ceiling height less than 1.5 m in any part of the occupiable area
conditions: seating alcove has a roof or overhead enclosure within the space
exceptions: alcove is open to the sky with no overhead covering

subject: Seating alcove
rule: Seating alcove that is enclosed on three or more sides must have a minimum clear opening of at least 600 mm width for egress
conditions: alcove is enclosed on three or more sides
alcove depth exceeds 600 mm
exceptions: alcove is not intended for human occupancy
one full side is completely open (less than three sides enclosed)

subject: Prayer alcove (mihrab)
rule: Must be oriented toward the Qibla (direction of Mecca)
conditions: used for Islamic prayer

subject: Prayer alcove (mihrab)
rule: Must be free of structural columns or obstructions within the alcove space

subject: Prayer alcove (mihrab)
rule: Must not contain any seated or standing plumbing fixtures (toilet, bidet, sink)

subject: Prayer alcove (mihrab)
rule: Floor must be level (no step or slope within the alcove)
conditions: used for standing prayer

subject: Fireplace alcove
rule: fireplace alcove floor must be non-combustible
conditions: alcove contains a solid-fuel or gas fireplace

subject: Fireplace alcove
rule: fireplace alcove must not have combustible materials within the specified clearance zone from the fireplace opening
conditions: alcove contains any type of fireplace
exceptions: manufacturer specifications explicitly allow a reduced clearance with an approved heat shield or insulated system

subject: Fireplace alcove
rule: fireplace alcove must have a solid hearth extension projecting in front of the fireplace opening
conditions: alcove contains a solid-fuel or gas fireplace with a glass-front or open design
exceptions: zero-clearance prefabricated fireplace units with a listed integrated hearth

subject: Kitchen alcove
rule: kitchen alcove must have a dedicated ventilation or exhaust path to the outside
conditions: alcove is enclosed or partially enclosed
cooking or heat-producing appliances are present
exceptions: alcove is used only for dry/cold storage with no cooking or heat-producing equipment

subject: Kitchen alcove
rule: kitchen alcove must not have an open flame or combustible cooking source within a minimum clearance distance of combustible materials
conditions: alcove is used for cooking
exceptions: clearances are designed per applicable fire code (e.g., IRC/IFC) and non-combustible surfaces protect adjacent materials

subject: Alcove lighting
rule: alcove lighting luminaires must be rated for damp locations
conditions: alcove is in a bathroom
alcove is in an exterior wall
alcove is in a location subject to condensation or moisture ingress
exceptions: alcove is fully sealed and climate-controlled with verified dew-point control

subject: Alcove lighting
rule: alcove lighting must not generate surface temperatures exceeding the ignition point of adjacent combustible materials
conditions: alcove walls or ceiling are lined with wood, fabric, or other combustible finishes
exceptions: luminaire is a listed Type IC (insulation-contact) or inherently limited-temperature design per UL 1598

subject: Alcove lighting
rule: alcove lighting must provide minimum maintained illuminance of 50 lux on the alcove task surface during egress conditions when connected to emergency power
conditions: alcove is in an egress path or exit access corridor
building code requires emergency illumination
exceptions: alcove is not on any egress route and local code does not require emergency lighting in that area

subject: Alcove shelving
rule: Alcove shelving must be supported by a horizontal surface or structural brackets fastened to adjacent walls
conditions: shelving is installed in an alcove recess

subject: Alcove shelving
rule: Alcove shelving must have a minimum depth clearance from the back wall to prevent overloading cantilevered spans
conditions: shelving is cantilevered without a front support leg

subject: Alcove shelving
rule: Alcove shelving must not block adjacent door or window openings
conditions: alcove contains a door or window

subject: Alcove architrave/frame
rule: The alcove architrave/frame must maintain a minimum clearance (typically 10-15 mm) from the surrounding wall or backing surface to allow for thermal expansion and moisture movement without causing buckling or stress fractures
conditions: when installed in interior conditioned space
when the architrave is made of timber or timber-based composite
exceptions: when architrave is installed with controlled expansion joints that absorb the movement

subject: Alcove architrave/frame
rule: The alcove architrave/frame must be positively secured to the structural wall or substrate using mechanical fasteners or approved adhesive rated for the full dead load of the assembly
conditions: when the architrave supports any self-weight load

subject: Alcove architrave/frame
rule: The architrave/frame must not obstruct or reduce the clear opening width of the alcove below the minimum required functional dimension
conditions: when the alcove serves as a passage, doorway, or access point

subject: Window Reveal
rule: window reveal must have a minimum depth to allow window installation and operation
conditions: window reveal is recessed into wall

subject: Window Reveal
rule: window reveal must be weather-sealed around its perimeter
conditions: window reveal is exposed to exterior environment
exceptions: internal partition window reveal not exposed to exterior

subject: Window Reveal
rule: window reveal must not be obstructed by structural elements that prevent window insertion

subject: Window Reveal
rule: window reveal must provide a continuous load path for the window to transfer its weight to the wall structure
conditions: window is load-bearing or self-supporting within the reveal

subject: Window Seat
rule: window seat must have a minimum seat depth of at least 300 mm
conditions: when intended for sitting
exceptions: purely decorative window seat not intended for occupancy

subject: Window Seat
rule: window seat must be structurally capable of supporting a live load of at least 1.5 kN
conditions: when intended for sitting or standing on
exceptions: decorative-only seat with no occupancy loading

subject: Window Seat
rule: window seat must not block egress path of the window it adjoins
conditions: when the window is designated as an emergency egress or rescue opening
exceptions: window is not an egress opening (e.g., fixed clerestory)

subject: Window Seat
rule: window seat must be laterally stable against overturning when loaded
conditions: when the seat is a freestanding or cantilevered unit not fixed to floor and wall on all sides
exceptions: seat is fully anchored to building structure

subject: Window Seat
rule: window seat finish materials must not emit hazardous volatile organic compounds at rates exceeding regulatory limits
conditions: when the seat is located inside a conditioned habitable space

subject: Window Lintel
rule: window lintel must transfer vertical load from the wall above the opening to the adjacent masonry or structure on both sides
conditions: lintel is load-bearing
wall above opening is masonry, concrete, or other self-supporting material
exceptions: opening is in a non-load-bearing partition wall
opening is fully within a structural frame that carries all loads above

subject: Window Lintel
rule: window lintel must have sufficient end bearing (minimum support length) on each side of the opening
conditions: lintel is load-bearing
lintel material is not a continuous structural frame element
exceptions: lintel is a reinforced concrete bond beam that is continuous across multiple openings
lintel is part of a steel frame where bearing is provided by the frame connection

subject: Window Lintel
rule: window lintel must not have tensile cracks exceeding allowable limits for its material
conditions: lintel is unreinforced masonry, stone, or plain concrete
exceptions: lintel is reinforced and cracks are within design crack-width limits
lintel is steel or timber where tensile stress is accommodated by material strength

subject: Window Arch
rule: window arch must be centered over the window opening
conditions: load-bearing masonry construction

subject: Window Arch
rule: window arch must have a keystone at the crown
conditions: true arch (voussoir construction)
in a load-bearing wall
exceptions: flat arches (jack arches) with parallel voussoirs may omit a distinct keystone

subject: Window Arch
rule: window arch must not have tensile stresses exceeding material capacity at the intrados or extrados
conditions: any masonry arch

subject: Window Arch
rule: window arch must be supported on both sides by adequate abutments or jambs
conditions: any window arch

subject: Window Backing / Blocking
rule: window backing/blocking must be installed with the correct thickness to match the window jamb depth
conditions: when window rough opening is framed
when window backing/blocking is used for window installation

subject: Window Backing / Blocking
rule: window backing/blocking must be made of material with sufficient structural capacity to support the window and transfer wind loads
conditions: when window backing serves as a structural shim or attachment point

subject: Window Backing / Blocking
rule: window backing/blocking must be treated or rated for moisture exposure when installed in exterior walls
conditions: when installed in exterior wall assemblies
when exposed to potential moisture intrusion

subject: Window Backing / Blocking
rule: window backing/blocking must not create a thermal bridge that causes interior surface condensation
conditions: when installed in exterior wall assemblies in cold climates
exceptions: when a continuous air barrier and vapor control layer is provided on the warm side that prevents moisture-laden air from reaching the cold blocking surface

subject: Window Drip Edge / Weathering
rule: drip edge must project outward from the window head beyond the plane of the wall below
conditions: window has a drip edge/weathering component installed

subject: Window Drip Edge / Weathering
rule: drip edge must incorporate a downward-turned lip or groove at its outer edge
conditions: drip edge is made of sheet metal or rigid material
exceptions: integral formed sill or pre-cast stone sill with an undercut drip notch performs the same function

subject: Window Drip Edge / Weathering
rule: drip edge must not be installed with upward-facing seams or joints
conditions: drip edge is fabricated from sheet metal, membrane, or other jointed material
exceptions: seams are fully soldered/sealed watertight and sloped to drain

subject: Window Drip Edge / Weathering
rule: drip edge weeps or notches must be unobstructed
conditions: drip edge assembly includes weep holes or notches to drain the window frame or sill

subject: Window Security Bar / Grille
rule: window security bar/grille must be securely anchored to the building structure (window frame, wall, or masonry) at all mounting points
exceptions: temporary/removable grilles that rely on friction-fit or locking pins may allow non-permanent anchorage as long as they resist expected forced-entry loads

subject: Window Security Bar / Grille
rule: window security bar/grille must not obstruct emergency egress (escape) from the window unless a compliant release mechanism is provided
conditions: window is designated as an emergency escape or rescue opening per applicable building code
exceptions: bars/grilles equipped with a code-compliant quick-release device (e.g., interior release catch, pressure-release mechanism) are acceptable

subject: Window Security Bar / Grille
rule: window security bar/grille must not reduce the window's operable area below the minimum required for natural ventilation or egress where required
conditions: window is required by code to provide natural ventilation or is an egress window

subject: Window Security Bar / Grille
rule: window security bar/grille must not introduce sharp edges, protrusions, or snag hazards in locations accessible to occupants
conditions: bar/grille is installed at a height reachable by building occupants

subject: Window Opening Control Device
rule: Window opening control device must be capable of withstanding the opening force exerted by the window sash or panel it controls without permanent deformation or failure
conditions: device is installed to control window opening
exceptions: device is purely a limit stop not bearing operational load

subject: Window Opening Control Device
rule: Window opening control device must not obstruct the required egress opening dimensions when the window is in the fully open position
conditions: window serves as an emergency egress or rescue opening per building code

subject: Window Opening Control Device
rule: Window opening control device must maintain its locking or securing function under its rated load without unintended release
conditions: device includes a locking or latching mechanism to secure the window position

subject: Window Blind / Shutter Housing
rule: Window blind / shutter housing must provide an unobstructed path for the blind or shutter to move fully between open and closed positions
conditions: housings for operable blinds or shutters
exceptions: fixed/non-operable decorative shutters

subject: Window Blind / Shutter Housing
rule: Window blind / shutter housing must be securely attached to the building structure or window frame to prevent detachment under expected wind loads
conditions: exterior-mounted shutter housings
exceptions: interior blind housings not exposed to wind

subject: Window Boxing / Pelmet
rule: pelmet must be securely fixed to the wall or window reveal
conditions: pelmet is installed
exceptions: temporary display installations where pelmet is free-standing and not subject to impact

subject: Window Boxing / Pelmet
rule: pelmet must not obstruct the operation of window hinges, handles, or locks
conditions: pelmet is installed over an operable window
exceptions: window is permanently sealed or inoperable

subject: Window Boxing / Pelmet
rule: pelmet must not block the travel path of curtains or blinds when they are drawn
conditions: curtains or blinds are installed behind or within the pelmet
exceptions: no curtains or blinds are used, or curtains/blinds are mounted entirely forward of the pelmet

subject: Window Opening Fanlight
rule: Window opening fanlight must be hinged at top or bottom (not side-hinged) to allow controlled ventilation while shedding rainwater
conditions: fanlight is operable
fanlight is installed on an exterior wall
exceptions: fanlight is sheltered by an overhang or canopy that prevents direct rain exposure

subject: Window Opening Fanlight
rule: Window opening fanlight must not have its hinge axis positioned such that the opening leaf obstructs required egress or fire escape path
conditions: fanlight serves or is adjacent to a room requiring egress
fanlight swings into a means of egress path

subject: Window Opening Fanlight
rule: Window opening fanlight must have a positive locking mechanism to hold it in the closed position against wind loads
conditions: fanlight is operable (not fixed)
fanlight is installed at height where wind exposure is significant

subject: Dormer Window
rule: A dormer window must have a properly flashed and weatherproofed intersection where it meets the main roof surface

subject: Dormer Window
rule: A dormer window must not be positioned such that its roof slope drains water back onto the main roof in a way that creates ponding or背water flow against the roof slope
conditions: The dormer has a shed or gable roof that intersects the main roof

subject: Dormer Window
rule: A dormer window must have adequate structural support to carry its own dead load plus live loads (snow, wind, maintenance access)

subject: Dormer Window
rule: A dormer window must be installed with proper防水 membrane and ice-and-water shield at the base and sidewalls per applicable building code requirements

subject: Dormer Window
rule: A dormer window must not create a roof valley that is too narrow or steep to be properly flashed and maintained
conditions: The dormer roof configuration creates a valley where it meets the main roof

subject: Dormer Window
rule: A dormer window must have a window or opening that is properly flashed and weather-sealed at its perimeter

subject: Window Operator / Actuator
rule: window operator/actuator must be compatible with the window type it operates

subject: Window Operator / Actuator
rule: window operator/actuator must be capable of providing the required opening force for the window sash weight and dimensions
conditions: when the window sash exceeds a manually operable weight or reach threshold

subject: Window Operator / Actuator
rule: window operator/actuator must maintain secure engagement when the window is in the closed position

subject: Window Operator / Actuator
rule: window operator/actuator must not obstruct the designated egress opening dimensions when installed
conditions: when the window serves as an emergency egress opening

subject: Window Sunshade / Brise-soleil
rule: window sunshade / brise-soleil must be securely anchored to the building structure to resist wind uplift and self-weight
conditions: applicable to all permanent sunshade/brise-soleil installations
exceptions: temporary or seasonal removable shades not intended to resist design wind loads

subject: Window Sunshade / Brise-soleil
rule: window sunshade / brise-soleil must not impede required emergency egress or rescue access from windows
conditions: when installed over or adjacent to operable windows that serve as egress openings under building code
exceptions: buildings where those windows are not rated as required emergency egress openings

subject: Window Sunshade / Brise-soleil
rule: window sunshade / brise-soleil must allow for thermal expansion and contraction without structural failure or jamming
conditions: when fabricated from materials with a coefficient of thermal expansion greater than 1e-5 /°C (e.g., aluminum, steel, glass)
exceptions: very short spans (under 600 mm) where thermal movement is negligible and accommodated by fastener clearance

subject: Fire barrier
rule: Fire barrier must have a fire-resistance rating consistent with its required design classification (e.g., 1-hour, 2-hour, 3-hour) per applicable building code
conditions: The barrier is required by code to be a rated fire barrier
The building is subject to a model building code (IBC, NFPA 5000, etc.)

subject: Fire barrier
rule: Fire barrier must be constructed of materials that are approved for fire-resistance-rated assemblies

subject: Fire barrier
rule: Fire barrier must not contain unprotected openings, penetrations, or joints that exceed code-allowed size limits
exceptions: Openings protected by approved fire-rated doors, windows, dampers, or firestop systems that match the required fire-resistance rating

subject: Fire barrier
rule: Fire barrier must extend from the top of the floor or roof deck below to the bottom of the floor or roof deck above, or through the roof or floor as required, to form a continuous separation
conditions: The barrier is a vertical fire barrier (wall)

subject: Fire damper
rule: Fire damper must close automatically upon detection of heat or smoke
conditions: installed in ductwork penetrating fire-rated assemblies
part of an HVAC system
exceptions: dampers in systems that remain operational during fire events (e.g., smoke control systems designed to stay open)

subject: Fire damper
rule: Fire damper must be listed and labeled in accordance with applicable fire-resistance standards
conditions: required by building code or fire-protection engineering specification

subject: Fire damper
rule: Fire damper must not be installed in a position that obstructs its fusible link or actuator from sensing heat
conditions: damper relies on a thermal release mechanism
exceptions: dampers with remote or electronic heat detection that does not require line-of-sight thermal exposure

subject: Fire hydrant / standpipe system
rule: fire hydrant / standpipe system must have an approved water supply capable of delivering required flow and pressure
conditions: fire hydrant or standpipe is part of a building's fire protection system

subject: Fire hydrant / standpipe system
rule: standpipe system must maintain a minimum residual pressure at the most hydraulically remote outlet during flow
conditions: standpipe system is installed in a building

subject: Fire hydrant / standpipe system
rule: fire hydrant must not have obstructions that prevent hose connection or valve operation within its clearance zone
conditions: fire hydrant is installed on a building site or adjacent to a building

subject: Fire hydrant / standpipe system
rule: standpipe system piping must be leak-tight under hydrostatic test pressure
conditions: standpipe system is installed

subject: Smoke control system
rule: smoke control system must maintain operational integrity during a fire event
conditions: when the building is occupied
during active fire conditions
exceptions: system is in maintenance mode with fire watch in place

subject: Smoke control system
rule: smoke control system must not have air leakage paths that bypass intended smoke zone boundaries
conditions: system includes zone pressurization or smoke containment function
exceptions: intentional relief openings designed to activate under specific fire scenarios

subject: Smoke control system
rule: smoke control system must have a dedicated standby power source capable of operating all required functions
conditions: system serves a building required by code to have emergency power

subject: Smoke control system
rule: smoke control system fans and dampers must not be obstructed by building elements, finishes, or stored materials

subject: Firestop sealant system
rule: Firestop sealant system must be tested and rated for the specific fire-resistance rating of the penetrating assembly (wall/floor)
conditions: When used as a through-penetration firestop

subject: Firestop sealant system
rule: Firestop sealant system must be compatible with the substrate materials it contacts (e.g., concrete, steel, gypsum)
conditions: When sealant contacts a substrate surface

subject: Firestop sealant system
rule: Firestop sealant must not be applied over gaps exceeding the manufacturer's maximum rated gap width
conditions: During installation

subject: Firestop sealant system
rule: Firestop sealant system must not be painted over unless the paint is specifically tested and listed as part of the firestop system
conditions: When paint or coating is applied post-installation
exceptions: Factory-applied intumescent coatings that are part of the tested assembly

subject: Restaurant Dining Area
rule: Restaurant dining area floor surface must be slip-resistant and cleanable to allow safe server traffic and food service
conditions: space is used for general dining
space has server circulation
exceptions: private dining rooms with carpeted floors and no food service

subject: Restaurant Dining Area
rule: Restaurant dining area must have at least one direct accessible route to an exit
conditions: occupant load exceeds 50 persons

subject: Restaurant Dining Area
rule: Restaurant dining area must not have exposed grease-producing cooking equipment open to the dining space without a ventilation hood
conditions: cooking equipment is present within the dining area
exceptions: equipment used only for finishing or reheating with no grease production (e.g., microwave, toaster)

subject: Restaurant Dining Area
rule: Restaurant dining area floor must withstand frequent wet mopping and chemical cleaning without degradation
conditions: floor is in a full-service restaurant with sit-down dining
exceptions: floor covering is disposable/removable (e.g., event tents)

subject: Cafeteria Serving Line
rule: Cafeteria serving line must have a clear, unobstructed path of at least 36 inches (914 mm) width for service access and egress
conditions: Serving line is accessible to staff

subject: Cafeteria Serving Line
rule: Cafeteria serving line counter surface must be non-absorbent, smooth, and easily cleanable (typically stainless steel or equivalent food-grade material)
conditions: Serving line is used for direct food contact or plating

subject: Cafeteria Serving Line
rule: Cafeteria serving line must have a handwashing sink located within 25 feet of the serving area
conditions: Serving line dispenses unpackaged food

subject: Cafeteria Serving Line
rule: Cafeteria serving line must not have exposed floor drains or plumbing trenches crossing the customer queuing path

subject: Food Court Seating Area
rule: seating area must provide a minimum of 300 mm clear legroom depth from seat front edge to any fixed obstruction ahead
conditions: fixed seating is installed
seats are arranged in rows facing a common direction
exceptions: standing-only areas with no seating provided
areas using movable chairs that can be repositioned by occupants

subject: Food Court Seating Area
rule: floor surface in the seating and circulation zone must have a slip-resistant finish with a minimum dynamic coefficient of friction of 0.5 when wet
conditions: area is accessible to the public
food or beverages are served or consumed in the area

subject: Food Court Seating Area
rule: seating area must not have any path of egress travel where the clear width is less than 915 mm between seat backs or fixed elements
conditions: seating capacity exceeds 49 persons

subject: Food Court Seating Area
rule: all electrical outlets within 1.5 m of any sink or food preparation surface must be ground-fault circuit-interrupter protected
conditions: electrical outlets are present
food preparation or beverage dispensing occurs within the seating area

subject: Break Room / Lunchroom
rule: break room / lunchroom must have at least one sink with potable water supply for hand washing and beverage preparation
conditions: space is designated as a break room or lunchroom
space is intended for food consumption or beverage preparation
exceptions: space is a break room in a industrial/warehouse setting where only packaged food is consumed and no food preparation occurs

subject: Break Room / Lunchroom
rule: break room / lunchroom must have natural or mechanical ventilation capable of removing cooking odors, moisture, and airborne contaminants
conditions: space contains or is adjacent to a kitchenette or cooking appliances
exceptions: space has no cooking appliances and only vending machines or microwave

subject: Break Room / Lunchroom
rule: break room / lunchroom must have a floor surface that is non-absorbent and cleanable in areas subject to spills
conditions: floor is within 6 feet of sink, refrigerator, or beverage dispensing area
space includes food or beverage preparation surfaces
exceptions: carpet is permitted if no liquid food or beverages are permitted in the space per facility policy

subject: Break Room / Lunchroom
rule: break room / lunchroom must not have floor drains that could emit sewer gases unless equipped with traps and vents
conditions: floor drain is present in the break room
exceptions: floor drain is a trapped and vented sanitary drain approved by local code

subject: Break Room / Lunchroom
rule: electrical outlets within 6 feet of a break room sink must be GFCI-protected
conditions: sink is present in the break room

subject: Banquet Hall
