rule: the mounting system must provide corrosion resistance (or corrosion protection) for all metallic components exposed to outdoor conditions and irrigation water
conditions: metallic components are used in the system
exceptions: systems that use only non-metallic materials (e.g., fully polymeric or composite)

subject: Green Facade Mounting System
rule: the mounting system must not create a fire propagation path between facade zones or between floors
conditions: system is installed on multi-story buildings or where fire compartmentation is required

subject: Irrigation System for Green Wall
rule: irrigation system must deliver water evenly across the entire green wall surface
conditions: green wall is vertical or inclined

subject: Irrigation System for Green Wall
rule: irrigation system must not leak water into the building envelope or interior spaces behind the green wall
exceptions: integrated waterproofing membrane specifically designed for green walls is present and verified intact

subject: Irrigation System for Green Wall
rule: irrigation water must be conveyed to and distributed from the top of the green wall system
conditions: gravity-fed drip or trickle irrigation is used
exceptions: recirculating pump system supplies water at multiple elevations

subject: Irrigation System for Green Wall
rule: irrigation system must have a backflow prevention device on the potable water supply connection
conditions: system is connected to a potable water supply

subject: Irrigation System for Green Wall
rule: irrigation system must not operate when ambient temperatures are below freezing unless the system is freeze-protected
exceptions: system includes heat tracing, insulated pipes, and automatic drain-down provisions

subject: Planting Container/Planter
rule: A planting container/planter must have drainage holes or a drainage layer to prevent waterlogging of soil
conditions: when used for live plant cultivation
when exposed to rainfall or irrigation
exceptions: containers used exclusively for artificial plants or decorative arrangements not requiring soil moisture management

subject: Planting Container/Planter
rule: A planting container/planter must be made of or lined with materials that are waterproof or water-resistant to contain soil moisture without degrading or leaking
conditions: when intended to hold soil and water for live plants
exceptions: decorative planters that contain an inner waterproof liner or separate pot (cachepot arrangement)

subject: Planting Container/Planter
rule: A planting container/planter must not have a solid, non-perforated bottom that fully seals if it is exposed to outdoor rain or automatic irrigation
conditions: when used outdoors
when subject to precipitation or scheduled irrigation
exceptions: containers designed as fully sealed water features or self-watering planters with an integrated internal reservoir and overflow mechanism

subject: Planting Container/Planter
rule: A planting container/planter must be dimensionally stable enough to retain soil mass under its own weight and the weight of saturated soil without rupture or collapse
conditions: when fabricated from non-structural materials such as thin plastic, fiberglass, or ceramic
exceptions: planters structurally integrated into building fabric (e.g., cast-in-place concrete planters)

subject: Drainage and Waterproofing Layer
rule: Drainage and waterproofing layer must have a continuous waterproof membrane to prevent water ingress into the building structure
conditions: applies to all building envelope assemblies

subject: Drainage and Waterproofing Layer
rule: Drainage and waterproofing layer must be sloped to direct water toward designated drainage outlets
conditions: applies to horizontal or near-horizontal surfaces such as roofs, terraces, and plaza decks
exceptions: vertical applications (below-grade walls, retaining walls) where hydrostatic pressure management replaces gravity drainage

subject: Drainage and Waterproofing Layer
rule: Drainage and waterproofing layer must not be penetrated by fasteners or elements that breach the waterproof membrane
conditions: applies within the waterproofed area
exceptions: penetrations that are properly detailed with purpose-made flashings, boots, and sealants at curbs or collars

subject: Drainage and Waterproofing Layer
rule: Drainage and waterproofing layer must be separated from incompatible materials (e.g., certain bituminous membranes with extruded polystyrene) by a suitable geotextile or slip sheet
conditions: when direct contact between chemically incompatible materials would cause degradation of the waterproofing membrane

subject: Root Barrier
rule: root barrier must prevent roots from penetrating the building's waterproofing or structural layers
conditions: when used as part of a foundation, basement wall, or below-grade structure
when installed adjacent to waterproofing membranes
exceptions: when the root barrier is intentionally omitted in favor of a sacrificial layer designed for root penetration

subject: Root Barrier
rule: root barrier must be continuous with sealed seams and joints
conditions: when installed as a sheet or panel system
exceptions: when the barrier is a fluid-applied coating that cures into a seamless membrane, eliminating seam requirements

subject: Root Barrier
rule: root barrier must be chemically resistant to root exudates and soil-borne chemicals
conditions: when used in planted areas or green roof assemblies
when in contact with soil containing active root systems

subject: Growing Medium / Substrate
rule: growing medium must be retained on the roof by physical edging or containment system
conditions: when installed on a sloped roof
when used in an extensive or intensive green roof assembly
exceptions: when growing medium is part of a loose-laid temporary test bed with no occupancy below

subject: Growing Medium / Substrate
rule: growing medium depth must not exceed the structural load capacity of the supporting roof deck
conditions: when installed on any building structure

subject: Growing Medium / Substrate
rule: growing medium must have a saturated hydraulic conductivity sufficient to prevent prolonged ponding on the roof surface
conditions: when used as part of a green roof assembly with a waterproof membrane below

subject: Growing Medium / Substrate
rule: growing medium must not contain constituents that chemically degrade the roofing waterproofing membrane
conditions: when in direct or filtered contact with the waterproofing layer
exceptions: when a separate root/chemical barrier is installed between the medium and the membrane

subject: Stone/Paver Units
rule: Stone/paver units must have a minimum thickness to resist cracking under expected point loads and foot traffic
conditions: When used as finished walking surface
When subject to point loads from furniture or concentrated weights

subject: Stone/Paver Units
rule: Stone/paver units must be laid on a stable, compacted base or substrate to prevent differential settlement and cracking
conditions: When installed as exterior paving or flooring

subject: Stone/Paver Units
rule: Stone/paver units must not be installed in freeze-thaw cycles without being frost-resistant or having appropriate drainage
conditions: When installed in exterior applications in climates that experience freezing temperatures
exceptions: Units rated as frost-resistant per ASTM C902 or equivalent

subject: Joint/Gap Filler Material
rule: Joint/gap filler material must be compatible with the substrates it contacts (chemically and in terms of thermal expansion)
conditions: Material is used to seal or fill a joint or gap between two building components
exceptions: Temporary filler materials used only during construction and removed before final assembly

subject: Joint/Gap Filler Material
rule: Joint/gap filler material must allow for the expected movement range of the joint (expansion, contraction, deflection)
conditions: Applied in joints subject to thermal, moisture, or structural movement
exceptions: Joints that are designed as rigid, non-moving connections (e.g., fully grouted assemblies with no expected movement)

subject: Joint/Gap Filler Material
rule: Joint/gap filler material must not contain or release substances that corrode or stain adjacent building materials
conditions: Filler is in direct contact with metal, stone, masonry, or other stain/corrosion-sensitive substrates
exceptions: When substrates are explicitly designed to be sacrificial or are protected by an inert barrier layer

subject: Base/Subbase Layer
rule: Base/Subbase Layer must be placed on a properly prepared and compacted subgrade
conditions: Applies to all pavement and foundation systems

subject: Base/Subbase Layer
rule: Base/Subbase Layer material must be free of organic matter and deleterious materials
conditions: Applies to all base/subbase construction

subject: Base/Subbase Layer
rule: Base/Subbase Layer must be compacted to the specified density
conditions: Applies to all base/subbase construction

subject: Base/Subbase Layer
rule: Base/Subbase Layer must not be placed on frozen subgrade
conditions: Applies to cold-weather construction

subject: Base/Subbase Layer
rule: Base/Subbase Layer must have adequate drainage to prevent water accumulation
conditions: Applies where groundwater or surface water is present

subject: Edge Restraint
rule: edge restraint must be continuous along the entire perimeter of the concrete pavement or slab it serves
conditions: when used in concrete pavement or slab construction
when functioning as a edge form or support
exceptions: when construction joints or isolation joints interrupt the perimeter intentionally

subject: Edge Restraint
rule: edge restraint must have a minimum of 150 mm (6 inches) of vertical embedment or depth below finished grade
conditions: when used as a vehicular curb or edge barrier adjacent to pavements
exceptions: when designed with an engineered soil-reinforcement or tied system that provides equivalent lateral restraint

subject: Edge Restraint
rule: edge restraint must not have openings or gaps larger than 5 mm that allow uncompacted backfill or subgrade soil to escape
conditions: when edge restraint separates pavement from adjacent soil or granular backfill
exceptions: weep holes or drainage slots designed and filtered to retain soil while allowing water passage

subject: Stormwater Drainage Inlet
rule: stormwater drainage inlet must be connected to a drainage pipe or outlet system
conditions: design intends to capture and convey stormwater away from the source area
exceptions: inlet serves only as a passive overflow spillway with no downstream conveyance required

subject: Stormwater Drainage Inlet
rule: stormwater drainage inlet must have a physical opening or grate that allows water entry
conditions: inlet is intended to collect surface runoff

subject: Stormwater Drainage Inlet
rule: stormwater drainage inlet must be positioned at a low point relative to the contributing drainage area
conditions: inlet is designed to collect runoff by gravity flow
exceptions: inlet is a pressurized or pumped system inlet

subject: Stormwater Drainage Inlet
rule: stormwater drainage inlet must not be fully sealed or capped in a manner that prevents drainage
conditions: inlet is in active service
exceptions: inlet is temporarily sealed for construction, maintenance, or winterization and will be unsealed before service

subject: Permeable Interlocking Concrete Pavement System
rule: The subbase reservoir must have sufficient storage volume to contain the design storm runoff volume without surface ponding exceeding the allowable limits
conditions: Permeable pavement is designed to manage stormwater runoff
exceptions: System is designed only for pedestrian access without stormwater management function

subject: Permeable Interlocking Concrete Pavement System
rule: The pavement surface infiltration rate must not become less than the design rainfall intensity over the service life
conditions: System is used to receive direct rainfall and runoff
exceptions: System is strictly decorative with no hydraulic function and is drained by underlying conveyance pipes

subject: Permeable Interlocking Concrete Pavement System
rule: The bedding and joint aggregate must be angular, open-graded, and free of fines
conditions: Joints and bedding layer are part of the system design

subject: Permeable Interlocking Concrete Pavement System
rule: The subgrade soil must have a measured infiltration rate adequate to pass the design flow, or an underdrain system must be installed
conditions: System relies on in-situ infiltration for drainage
exceptions: Entire system is lined with an impermeable geomembrane and drained by underdrains only

subject: Permeable Interlocking Concrete Pavement System
rule: The concrete pavers must have a minimum thickness and compressive strength to withstand the design traffic load without cracking
conditions: System is subject to vehicular traffic loads
exceptions: System is used exclusively for pedestrian or light-use applications where structural load is negligible

subject: Tile Backer Board
rule: Tile backer board must have a cementitious or gypsum-based composition that is resistant to moisture degradation
conditions: when used as substrate for tile in wet or damp areas (e.g., showers, bathrooms, kitchens)
exceptions: When used exclusively in dry areas and local building code permits standard drywall

subject: Tile Backer Board
rule: Tile backer board must be installed with joints offset from tile joints by at least one-quarter of the tile length
conditions: when installing tile over backer board in floor or wall assemblies subject to structural movement or thermal cycling
exceptions: When a crack-isolation membrane is installed over the backer board

subject: Tile Backer Board
rule: Tile backer board must not be used as a primary structural sheathing element (e.g., diaphragm, shear wall)
conditions: in any structural load-bearing application

subject: Tile Underlayment Membrane
rule: tile underlayment membrane must be installed on a solid, continuous deck surface
conditions: when used as roof underlayment
exceptions: specific manufacturer-approved engineered systems that design for open framing

subject: Tile Underlayment Membrane
rule: tile underlayment membrane must be lapped in a shingle-fashion (weather-lapped) such that upper courses overlap lower courses toward the eave
conditions: when installed on a sloped roof

subject: Tile Underlayment Membrane
rule: tile underlayment membrane must not be left exposed to direct sunlight and weather beyond the manufacturer's specified exposure period
conditions: during construction sequence
for polymer-based or bituminous underlayments
exceptions: products specifically rated for extended UV exposure per manufacturer data

subject: Tile Underlayment Membrane
rule: tile underlayment membrane must be installed with side and end laps meeting minimum overlap dimensions specified by manufacturer and code
conditions: on any roof installation

subject: Brick Mortar Joint
rule: Brick mortar joint must have a minimum thickness to accommodate brick size tolerances and prevent mortar starvation
conditions: load-bearing brick wall
exterior wall

subject: Brick Mortar Joint
rule: Brick mortar joint must not have excessive thickness that causes reduction in compressive strength of the masonry assembly

subject: Brick Mortar Joint
rule: Brick mortar joint must be continuous and fully filled without voids or gaps
conditions: load-bearing wall

subject: Brick Pavers
rule: Brick pavers must be laid on a stable, compacted base or substrate to prevent differential settlement and surface failure
conditions: when used as a ground or surface paving material
when installed in pedestrian or vehicular traffic areas
exceptions: when used as a decorative veneer on a wall (not load-bearing)

subject: Brick Pavers
rule: Brick pavers must have open joints filled with sand or fine aggregate to interlock units and prevent shifting
conditions: when installed as a paver surface for pedestrian or vehicular use
exceptions: when pavers are mortared in place (becomes a brick mortar assembly rather than dry-laid pavers)

subject: Brick Pavers
rule: Brick pavers must not be used in areas with sustained freeze-thaw exposure without being rated as SX (severe weathering) grade
conditions: when installed in exterior locations in climates where temperatures cycle below freezing
exceptions: interior applications
climates without freeze-thaw cycles

subject: Applied Ornament
rule: applied ornament must be securely attached to the substrate

subject: Applied Ornament

conditions: ornament projects beyond the building face into a public right-of-way or egress path
exceptions: local code explicitly permits ornamental projections within specified limits

subject: Ornamental Cladding
rule: ornamental cladding must be securely anchored to the structural backing or substrate

subject: Ornamental Cladding
rule: ornamental cladding must not exceed the load-bearing capacity of its supporting structure

subject: Ornamental Cladding
rule: ornamental cladding must accommodate thermal expansion and contraction

subject: Ornamental Metalwork
rule: ornamental metalwork must be securely fastened to the building structure
conditions: used as an exterior architectural element

subject: Ornamental Metalwork
rule: ornamental metalwork must not create water intrusion paths at attachment points
conditions: installed on an exterior building envelope

subject: Ornamental Metalwork
rule: ornamental metalwork must be made of a material with adequate corrosion resistance for its exposure environment
conditions: exposed to exterior weather conditions

subject: Ornamental Frieze & Entablature
rule: ornamental frieze and entablature must be structurally supported by the columns or wall below
conditions: when used as a load-bearing element
in classical or neoclassical architecture
exceptions: purely decorative non-structural appliqués or adhesive-mounted reproductions

subject: Ornamental Frieze & Entablature
rule: ornamental frieze and entablature must not exceed the spanning capacity of the material and connection system
conditions: when spanning between supports
exceptions: segmented construction with intermediate support at each joint

subject: Ornamental Column & Pilaster

when specified as non-load-bearing in design documentation

subject: Ornamental Column & Pilaster

subject: Ornamental Column & Pilaster

subject: Ornamental Column & Pilaster
rule: ornamental column or pilaster must have positive anchorage resisting withdrawal forces

residential application

subject: Ornamental Balustrade & Handrail

conditions: installed as a handrail intended for continuous hand support

subject: Ornamental Balustrade & Handrail

circular or shape requiring full finger clearance

subject: Ornamental Gutter & Downspout

subject: Ornamental Gutter & Downspout
rule: downspout must be free of obstructions to allow unimpeded water flow
conditions: when installed as part of the drainage system

subject: Ornamental Cornice

conditions: attached to exterior wall
located at roof-wall junction

subject: Ornamental Cornice
rule: ornamental cornice must be securely anchored to the structural backing

subject: Ornamental Cornice
rule: ornamental cornice must have positive slope or drip edge to shed water away from the wall face

exceptions: cornice protected by a substantial roof overhang that fully shields it

subject: Ornamental Window Surround & Hood

exceptions: When the surround and hood are purely interior decorative elements

subject: Ornamental Window Surround & Hood

subject: Ornamental Window Surround & Hood
rule: The hood must not obstruct the operation of the window (e.g., opening, closing, or egress)
conditions: When the window is operable

subject: Ornamental Parapet & Balustrade

subject: Ornamental Parapet & Balustrade

subject: Ornamental Parapet & Balustrade

subject: Ornamental Medallion & Cartouche

subject: Ornamental Medallion & Cartouche

subject: Ornamental Medallion & Cartouche
rule: ornamental medallion or cartouche must not obstruct required ventilation openings or air intake/exhaust grilles

subject: Ornamental Spire & Finial

when it is a roof accessory rather than a structural component

subject: Ornamental Spire & Finial

when the local wind zone is non-sheltered
exceptions: temporary or display-only installations not subject to building code requirements

subject: Ornamental Spire & Finial

subject: Ornamental Grille & Register

subject: Ornamental Grille & Register

subject: Ornamental Grille & Register
rule: ornamental grille and register must be securely fastened to its supporting structure
conditions: when installed in any location
exceptions: temporary placement during construction or maintenance

subject: Warm Color Glazing/Tinted Glass

when used in rooms requiring natural light per building code

where tint is within allowable visible light transmittance (VLT) minimum per applicable code

subject: Warm Color Glazing/Tinted Glass

when the glass is heat-strengthened or tempered
exceptions: when laminated glass with appropriate interlayer is used to absorb stresses
when installed in a fully shaded orientation with no direct solar gain

exceptions: Temporary installations that will be removed before exposure to weather

subject: Warm Color Architectural Millwork

conditions: When installed in means of egress
When adjacent to fire-rated walls or doors
When covering HVAC or electrical access panels
exceptions: When the millwork is designed with approved access doors or removable sections that maintain required ratings and clearances

subject: Warm Color Architectural Millwork

Applicable building/fire code jurisdiction

exceptions: Temporary or retractable seating that is engineered to remain stable without permanent anchorage

subject: Courtroom & Lecture Hall Desking

occupied seating position
exceptions: adjustable-height or tilting surfaces designed for specialized use

fixed seating layout in lecture hall

subject: Courtroom & Lecture Hall Desking

subject: Courtroom & Lecture Hall Desking
rule: desking must not have sharp edges or corners at occupant contact zones
conditions: within reach of seated occupants
egress paths adjacent to desking

conditions: When designed for occupant use
exceptions: Storage-only telescopic seating not intended for occupancy

exceptions: Fixed (non-movable) bleacher seating

subject: Bleacher/Telescopic Seating
rule: Bleacher/Telescopic Seating must not have pinch points or shear hazards in the retraction mechanism that are accessible to users during normal operation
conditions: When seating is movable/retractable
exceptions: Areas guarded by locked enclosures or safety barriers not accessible during normal use

subject: Dental/Medical Procedure Stool Mounts

subject: Dental/Medical Procedure Stool Mounts

conditions: when installed over fire-rated wall assemblies
exceptions: when the strips are specifically tested and rated for use over fire-rated joints

exceptions: Downlight is listed and labeled for wet locations

subject: Recessed Downlights
rule: Recessed downlight must be securely fastened to the ceiling structure to prevent falling

subject: Wall Wash Luminaires

exceptions: custom optical designs that produce wash effect at any distance

luminaires with adequate glare shielding or louvers certified for glare control

subject: Light Pool Trim Rings & Baffles

surface-mounted application

subject: Light Pool Trim Rings & Baffles
rule: baffle must not contact the light source or lamp

light source is present

subject: Light Pool Trim Rings & Baffles
rule: trim ring must be mechanically retained (e.g., springs, clips, or screws) such that gravity alone does not hold it in place
conditions: installed in ceiling
downward-facing orientation

unit is not climate-controlled
exceptions: units located entirely within a conditioned interior space

subject: Personal Storage Units

conditions: unit is accessible to multiple tenants or the public
exceptions: private units in a single-owner facility with no shared access

subject: Personal Storage Units

exceptions: standalone single unit with sufficient separation from other structures

subject: Reception & Entry Desks

desk is located in a public entry zone
exceptions: unstaffed after-hours reception kiosks
desks where the building code allows alternative accessible routes via signage

subject: Reception & Entry Desks

exceptions: desks that are fully retractable or removable during emergency conditions

subject: Reception & Entry Desks

desk is a transaction counter where persons approach and stand
exceptions: separate auxiliary low-height counter provided immediately adjacent

subject: Residential Kitchen Cabinetry

subject: Residential Kitchen Cabinetry

subject: Residential Kitchen Cabinetry

subject: Bathroom Vanities

conditions: vanity is installed against a wall

subject: Bathroom Vanities
rule: Bathroom vanity must not have electrical outlets or switches located inside the sink basin or within the wet zone where direct water spray from the faucet can reach them

subject: Bathroom Vanities
rule: Bathroom vanity plumbing rough-in (supply lines and drain) must align with the vanity cabinet cutouts and not be blocked by structural components of the vanity frame

subject: Bathroom Vanities

subject: Library & Bookcase Systems

conditions: When installed as freestanding units
When floor-mounted with height exceeding 4 times the base depth
exceptions: When permanently anchored to supporting wall structure

subject: Library & Bookcase Systems
rule: Library and bookcase systems must not have shelves that deflect or break under the rated load capacity
conditions: When shelves are made of material other than structural-grade material

subject: Library & Bookcase Systems

When product height exceeds 30 inches (762 mm)
exceptions: When the unit is designed for built-in installation and explicitly labelled not for standalone use

subject: Display Cases & Vitrines
rule: display case or vitrine must have a structurally stable base or support system to prevent toppling
conditions: freestanding unit
taller than 1.5m
not permanently fixed to floor or wall
exceptions: cases designed to be suspended from ceiling structure
cases recessed into floor or wall construction

subject: Display Cases & Vitrines

heritage or sensitive objects displayed inside

subject: Display Cases & Vitrines

case located within visitor reach zone (<2m height)
exceptions: cases behind secondary barrier or rope-off

subject: Personal Study & Hobby Rooms

subject: Personal Study & Hobby Rooms

subject: Personal Study & Hobby Rooms

exceptions: rooms used exclusively for quiet study with no contaminant-generating activities

subject: Personal Study & Hobby Rooms

subject: Museum & Gallery Spaces

public occupancy exceeds 50 persons
exceptions: historic buildings where installation would cause irreversible damage to significant fabric, provided alternative life-safety measures are approved

subject: Museum & Gallery Spaces

subject: Museum & Gallery Spaces

subject: Museum & Gallery Spaces
rule: public circulation paths in museum and gallery spaces must not have level changes (steps) without an adjacent accessible ramp or lift

subject: Museum & Gallery Spaces
rule: museum and gallery spaces must have means of egress sized and arranged for the maximum anticipated occupant load during public events

subject: Dressing Rooms & Walk-in Closets
rule: Dressing rooms and walk-in closets must have adequate ventilation to prevent moisture buildup and mold
conditions: enclosed space with no direct outdoor access
space is used for storing clothing or fabrics

subject: Dressing Rooms & Walk-in Closets
rule: Walk-in closets must have a minimum clear floor area to allow a person to stand and turn around
conditions: designated as 'walk-in' closet
intended for occupant access

subject: Dressing Rooms & Walk-in Closets
rule: Dressing rooms must not have exposed electrical fixtures within reach of a person standing on the floor

subject: Dressing Rooms & Walk-in Closets
rule: Dressing rooms and walk-in closets must have a door or privacy screen that can be fully closed from the inside

subject: IfcWall
rule: Standard walls must have material layer set usage assignment

subject: IfcOpeningElement
rule: Openings must be placed in walls or slabs

subject: IfcProject
rule: IfcProject must be the root container element

subject: IfcDoor
rule: Doors require an IfcOpeningElement to be placed in

subject: IfcWindow
rule: Windows require an IfcOpeningElement to be placed in

subject: IfcWindow
rule: Style information must always be given to windows

subject: IfcWall
rule: Must enforce a single body for shape representation

subject: IfcProject
rule: There can only be a single instance of IfcProject within an IFC file or an IFC database model.

subject: IfcProject
rule: The IfcProject instance must hold the global definitions for the presentation context and the units within the global context.

subject: IfcProject
rule: An IFC project file always has units defined for its shape representations.

subject: IfcRepresentation
rule: IfcRepresentation has to be founded within a representation context, established by the IfcProject

subject: IfcProject
rule: An IFC project has to have at least one representation context

rule: All instances of IfcGeometricRepresentationContext have to define the same world coordinate system

subject: IfcGeometricRepresentationSubContext

subject: IfcGeometricRepresentationContext

subject: IfcUnitAssignment

subject: IfcProject
rule: All spatial structure elements inherit concepts from IfcProduct

subject: IfcProject

subject: IfcProject
rule: IfcProject must have at least one RepresentationContext being an IfcRepresentationContext (or subtype).

subject: IfcProject
rule: IfcProject must have UnitsInContext to define global units.

subject: IfcProject
rule: IfcProject must have a Name (enforced by where rule: WR1).

subject: IfcProject
rule: IfcProject is a mandatory level for the exchange of complex project data.

subject: IfcBuilding
rule: IfcBuilding is a mandatory level for the exchange of complex project data.

subject: IfcBuildingStorey
rule: IfcBuildingStorey is a mandatory level for the exchange of complex project data.

subject: IfcSite
rule: IfcSite is optional (may be provided if it contains necessary data, but doesn't need to be provided).

subject: IfcSpace
rule: IfcSpace is optional (may be provided if it contains necessary data, but doesn't need to be provided).

subject: IfcBuilding
rule: IfcBuilding must be associated to an IfcSite if given, if not then directly to the IfcProject.

subject: IfcSite
rule: If the RepresentationIdentifier is 'SurveyPoints', the RepresentationType must be 'GeometricSet' and Items must include an IfcGeometricSet containing IfcCartesianPoint and IfcPolyline.

subject: IfcBuildingStorey
rule: IfcBuildingStorey must be associated to an IfcBuilding

subject: IfcBuildingStorey
rule: IfcBuildingStorey should declare its own object coordinate system, positioned relative to the next higher level spatial structure

subject: IfcBuilding
rule: IfcBuilding must declare its own object coordinate system, positioned relative to the next higher level spatial structure

subject: IfcSite
rule: IfcSite must declare its own object coordinate system, positioned relative to the next higher level spatial structure

subject: IfcBuilding
rule: IfcBuilding should not contain its own shape representations, as it is provided by its constituting elements

subject: IfcBuildingStorey
rule: IfcBuildingStorey should not contain its own shape representations, as it is provided by its constituting elements

subject: IfcBuildingStorey
rule: IfcRelContainsInSpatialStructure should be used to exchange the containment relationship of elements in a building story

subject: IfcSpace
rule: IfcRelContainsInSpatialStructure should be used to exchange the containment relationship of elements in a space

subject: IfcShapeRepresentation
rule: When RepresentationIdentifier is 'FootPrint', the RepresentationType should be 'Curve2D' or 'GeometricCurveSet'

subject: IfcShapeRepresentation
rule: When RepresentationIdentifier is 'FootPrint' and space has inner boundaries, the RepresentationType should be 'GeometricCurveSet'

subject: IfcShapeRepresentation
rule: When RepresentationIdentifier is 'Body' and RepresentationType is 'SweptSolid', the Items should include an IfcExtrudedAreaSolid

subject: IfcShapeRepresentation
rule: When RepresentationIdentifier is 'Body' and RepresentationType is 'Brep', the Items should include an IfcFacetedBrep

subject: IfcZone
rule: IfcZone can only aggregate spaces or other zones, not other types of objects

subject: IfcZone
rule: Each zone should be named using the inherited Name attribute from IfcRoot

subject: IfcBuildingElement
rule: If the appropriate semantic classification exists in the IFC2x specification, the building element should be exported by the appropriate subtype entity

subject: IfcBuildingElement
rule: If the appropriate semantic classification does not exist, the building element should be exported by IfcBuildingElementProxy

subject: IfcRelSpaceBoundary
rule: Each space boundary defines a 1:1 relationship between a space and a single bounding building element (if given)

subject: IfcWall
rule: IfcWall must use IfcObjectPlacement for placement; in IFC2x views where grid is not supported, must use IfcLocalPlacement

subject: IfcWall
rule: If UoF 'element in space containment' is provided, IfcLocalPlacement.PlacementRelTo shall point to the same spatial structure element

subject: IfcWallStandardCase
rule: IfcWallStandardCase must have at least two shape representations (axis and body)

subject: IfcWallStandardCase
rule: IfcWallStandardCase must have material layer set definitions assigned

subject: IfcWallStandardCase
rule: IfcShapeRepresentation with RepresentationIdentifier='Axis' for wall axis must have only a single Item in Items SET

subject: IfcShapeRepresentation
rule: IfcShapeRepresentation for wall axis must have Items[1] datatype of IfcTrimmedCurve or IfcPolyline

subject: IfcShapeRepresentation
rule: IfcShapeRepresentation with RepresentationType='SweptSolid' for wall body must have only a single Item in Items SET

subject: IfcShapeRepresentation
rule: IfcShapeRepresentation for non-clipped wall body must have RepresentationType='SweptSolid' and Items[1] datatype IfcExtrudedAreaSolid

subject: IfcShapeRepresentation
rule: IfcShapeRepresentation for clipped wall body must have RepresentationType='Clipping' and Items[1] datatype IfcBooleanClippingResult

subject: IfcBooleanClippingResult
rule: For clipped standard wall bodies, only the upper and lower part of the wall shall be clipped

subject: IfcBooleanClippingResult
rule: The start and end part shall not be clipped

subject: IfcBooleanClippingResult
rule: The clipping shall not be used to clip parallel or tangential to the wall path

subject: IfcBooleanClippingResult
rule: The clipping shall not be used to create a hole into the wall body

subject: IfcMaterialLayerSet
rule: The consistency between IfcMaterialLayerSet.TotalThickness and the offset between the two edges of IfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef.OuterCurve must be guaranteed by the sending application

subject: IfcWall
rule: Shape representation shall only contain a single body

subject: IfcWall
rule: If wall consists of two geometrically apart bodies, it must be split into two instances of IfcWall for IFC2x export

subject: IfcWall
rule: A wall must have a single body, not allowed to export a wall having two totally separated wall bodies

subject: IfcWall
rule: If with 'SweptSolid' shape representation, provision of a wall axis is mandatory

subject: IfcWall
rule: For 'SweptSolid' with polygonal footprint, only a single Item shall exist within the SET of IfcShapeRepresentation.Items

subject: IfcWall
rule: For 'SweptSolid' with polygonal footprint, IfcShapeRepresentation.RepresentationType must be 'SweptSolid'

subject: IfcWall
rule: For 'SweptSolid' with polygonal footprint, Item[1] shall be IfcExtrudedAreaSolid

subject: IfcWall
rule: For 'SweptSolid' with polygonal footprint, IfcExtrudedAreaSolid.SweptArea shall be IfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef

subject: IfcWall
rule: For 'Brep' shape representation, only a single Item shall exist within the SET of IfcShapeRepresentation.Items

subject: IfcWall
rule: For 'Brep' shape representation, IfcShapeRepresentation.RepresentationType must be 'Brep'

subject: IfcWall
rule: For 'Brep' shape representation, Item[1] shall be IfcFacetedBrep

subject: IfcWall
rule: No further Boolean operations (beside for the opening) shall be applied to the Brep wall body

subject: IfcWall
rule: For fallback 'SweptSolid' (horizontal extrusion), only a single Item shall exist within IfcShapeRepresentation.Items

subject: IfcWall
rule: For fallback 'SweptSolid', IfcShapeRepresentation.RepresentationType must be 'SweptSolid'

subject: IfcWall
rule: For fallback 'SweptSolid', Item[1] shall be IfcExtrudedAreaSolid

subject: IfcWall
rule: For fallback 'SweptSolid', IfcExtrudedAreaSolid.SweptArea shall be IfcRectangleProfileDef

subject: IfcMaterialLayerSetUsage
rule: Material layers for walls shall only be used for standard (parallel) layering, and should not be adapted for complex internal structures like elemented or stub walls

subject: IfcOpeningElement
rule: Openings are not to be cut out from Brep wall body by further Boolean operations

subject: IfcOpeningElement
rule: The relationship to the element which is voided by the opening (IfcRelVoidsElement) is mandatory for each instance of IfcOpeningElement

subject: IfcOpeningElement
rule: The opening local placement shall be given relative to the local placement of the building element which is voided

subject: IfcOpeningElement
rule: IfcLocalPlacement.PlacementRelTo shall point to the local placement of the voided building element

subject: IfcShapeRepresentation
rule: When RepresentationType='Brep', only a single Item shall exist within the SET of IfcShapeRepresentation.Items

subject: IfcShapeRepresentation
rule: When RepresentationType='Brep', the datatype of Item[1] shall be IfcFacetedBrep

subject: IfcProfileDef
rule: The Position attribute of all parameterized subtypes of IfcProfileDef shall not be rotated, i.e. the IfcAxisPlacement2D.RefDirection is always [1.,0.] (or omitted, then it defaults to [1.,0.])

subject: IfcWall
rule: IfcWall and IfcSlab, but also IfcBeam, IfcColumn, IfcStairFlight, IfcRampFlight, IfcCovering and IfcBuildingElementProxy should be normally supported as elements that can be voided by openings

subject: IfcWindow
rule: Normally only IfcWindow and IfcDoor (as subtypes of IfcBuildingElement) are used as fillings

subject: IfcDoor
rule: Normally only IfcWindow and IfcDoor (as subtypes of IfcBuildingElement) are used as fillings

subject: IfcOpeningElement
rule: For straight walls with parallel reveals, IfcOpeningElement.ObjectType = 'Opening' indicates extrusion perpendicular to the wall face

subject: IfcOpeningElement
rule: For straight walls with non-parallel reveals, IfcOpeningElement.ObjectType = 'OpeningAdvanced' indicates extrusion parallel to the wall face

subject: IfcOpeningElement
rule: IfcOpeningElement representing a niche or recess should have ObjectType = 'Recess'

subject: IfcOpeningElement
rule: Openings with radial reveals need ObjectType = 'OpeningAdvanced' and extrusion profile of type IfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef positioned coplanar to the wall base

subject: IfcOpeningElement
rule: Non-rectangular openings with radial reveals must use B-rep geometry

subject: IfcOpeningElement
rule: Combined opening and recess shapes should use either a combination of opening and recess or an opening with BREP shape representation

subject: IfcOpeningElement
rule: IfcOpeningElement.ObjectType shall be used to differentiate the usage: 'Opening', 'OpeningAdvanced', or 'Recess'

subject: IfcDoor
rule: Each door within a wall requires the existence of an opening, in which it is placed

subject: IfcWindow
rule: Each window within a wall requires the existence of an opening, in which it is placed

subject: IfcDoor
rule: If an opening is exchanged with BREP shape representation, or as two recesses, and it has a door as a filling, the door geometry has to be exchanged with BREP shape representation as well

subject: IfcWindow
rule: If an opening is exchanged with BREP shape representation, or as two recesses, and it has a window as a filling, the window geometry has to be exchanged with BREP shape representation as well

subject: IfcDoor
rule: Each instance of IfcDoor has to have a link via IfcRelDefinesByType to IfcDoorStyle

subject: IfcDoor
rule: The local origin of the door placement shall be the insertion point of the door lining

subject: IfcDoor
rule: The x-axis shall point into the direction of the panel (when closed), parallel to the wall path or the tangent for curved walls in the middle of the opening

subject: IfcDoor
rule: The y-axis shall point into the direction of the door opening

subject: IfcDoor
rule: The z-axis shall point vertical

subject: IfcDoorStyle
rule: Use of IfcDoorStyle is mandatory for each occurrence of IfcDoor

subject: IfcWindow
rule: Each instance of IfcWindow must have a link to IfcWindowStyle via IfcRelDefinesByType

subject: IfcDoorStyle
rule: If the door type has two panels, two instances of IfcDoorPanelProperties need to be inserted

subject: IfcWindow
rule: The local origin of the window placement shall be the insertion point of the window lining

subject: IfcWindow
rule: The x-axis shall point into the direction of the panel (when closed), parallel to the wall path or the tangent for curved walls in the middle of the opening

subject: IfcWindow
rule: The y-axis shall point into the direction of the window opening

subject: IfcWindow
rule: The z-axis shall point vertical

subject: IfcSlab
rule: The use of PredefinedType is required, if no type object through IfcSlabType is assigned using the IsDefinedBy inverse relationship

subject: IfcSlab
rule: A slab must have a single body, it is not allowed to export a slab having two totally separated bodies

subject: IfcSlab
rule: If material information is attached using IfcMaterialLayerSetUsage, then the IfcMaterialLayerSet.TotalThickness attribute shall have the same value as IfcExtrudedAreaSolid.Depth

subject: IfcExtrudedAreaSolid
rule: The ExtrusionDirection for standard slabs needs to be perpendicular to the XY plane of the IfcExtrudedAreaSolid.Position

subject: IfcDistributionElement
rule: If the appropriate semantic classification exists in the IFC2x2 specification, then the building element should be exported by the appropriate subtype entity. If not, IfcDistributionElement entity should be used instead.

subject: IfcBuildingElementProxy
rule: The use of IfcBuildingElementProxy is not encouraged and might be limited to the current edition of IFC2x2.

subject: IfcDistributionElementType
rule: Each non-abstract subtype of IfcDistributionElementType adds a PredefinedType attribute.

subject: IfcDistributionFlowElement
rule: IfcDistributionFlowElement must have GlobalId, OwnerHistory attributes

subject: IfcDistributionFlowElement
rule: IfcDistributionFlowElement may have Name, Description, ObjectType, ObjectPlacement, Representation, Tag as OPTIONAL attributes

subject: IfcPerformanceHistory
rule: IfcPerformanceHistory must handle lifecycle phase using the IfcPerformanceHistory.LifeCyclePhase attribute

subject: IfcPerformanceHistory
rule: IfcPerformanceHistory must handle property sets using IfcObject.IsDefinedBy and the IfcRelDefines relationship

subject: IfcPerformanceHistory
rule: IfcPerformanceHistory must have type name as IfcObject.Name

subject: IfcPerformanceHistory
rule: IfcPerformanceHistory must have description as IfcObject.Description

subject: IfcDistributionFlowElement
rule: Property sets can be assigned directly through IfcRelAssignsByProperties to occurrences

subject: IfcDistributionFlowElement
rule: Property sets can be assigned through shared type via IfcRelDefinesByType

subject: IfcDistributionPort
rule: Use the IfcDistributionPort.Name attribute to define the sequential port number assigned to each element

subject: IfcFlowMovingDevice
rule: Flow moving devices are specified by type through a type entity

subject: IfcFlowMovingDevice
rule: The occurrence of IfcFlowMovingDevice is typed through an instance of IfcRelDefinesByType

subject: IfcFlowMovingDevice
rule: Pump aggregation must have the object that is the target of the aggregation as an IfcFlowMovingDevice

subject: IfcFlowMovingDevice
rule: Pumps can be identified as being elemental or complex through the property PumpComposition contained in Pset_FlowMovingDevicePump

subject: IfcPropertySet
rule: Pset_FlowMovingDevicePump is defined for pump occurrences and not for pump types

subject: IfcBoilerType
rule: IfcBoilerType can use Pset_BoilerTypeCommon property set attached at the type entity

subject: IfcFlowStorageDevice
rule: IfcFlowStorageDevice may be typed as a tank through an instance of the IfcRelDefinesByType relationship class

subject: IfcTankType
rule: IfcTankType has property set Pset_TankTypeCommon with properties: Type, AccessType, NominalLengthOrDiameter, NominalWidthOrDiameter, NominalDepth, NominalCapacity, EffectiveCapacity, OperatingWeight, Material, MaterialThickness

subject: IfcFlowStorageDevice
rule: IfcFlowStorageDevice occurrence can have property set Pset_FlowStorageDeviceTank with properties TankComposition, HasLadder, HasVisualIndicator

subject: IfcTankType
rule: Shape is defined as a property PatternType in Pset_TankTypePreformedTank

subject: IfcFlowStorageDevice
rule: TankComposition value PARTIAL indicates a compartment is an IfcFlowStorageDevice specified as a partial element

subject: IfcFlowStorageDevice
rule: TankComposition value ELEMENT indicates a tank is an IfcFlowStorageDevice specified as a complete element

subject: IfcTankType
rule: Multiple tanks acting together through interconnection are an instance of IfcTankType specified as COMPLEX via TankComposition

subject: IfcFlowStorageDevice
rule: Use IfcRelNests to connect compartments to tanks

subject: IfcSystem
rule: IfcSystem can only aggregate subtypes of IfcElement or other IfcSystem (subsystems)

subject: IfcSystem
rule: Objects intended for one purpose should not be mixed in a system with objects intended for a different purpose

subject: IfcSystem
rule: There is no enforcement of a connectivity requirement within IfcSystem

subject: IfcSystem
rule: Each system should be named or identified according to what it does

subject: IfcElement
rule: An element can participate in more than one IfcSystem through multiple IfcRelAssignsToGroup instances

subject: IfcSystem
rule: IfcSystem can nest other instances of IfcSystem

subject: IfcProduct
rule: If a Representation is given to the subtype of IfcProduct, the ObjectPlacement has to be inserted as well

subject: IfcObjectPlacement
rule: IfcObjectPlacement is abstract and only the two subtypes IfcLocalPlacement and IfcGridPlacement can be instantiated

subject: IfcSite
rule: IfcSite shall be placed absolutely within the world coordinate system established by the geometric representation context of the project

subject: IfcBuilding
rule: IfcBuilding shall be placed relative to the local placement of IfcSite

subject: IfcBuildingStorey
rule: IfcBuildingStorey shall be placed relative to the local placement of IfcBuilding

subject: IfcElement
rule: IfcElement shall be placed relative to the local placement of its container (normally to IfcBuildingStorey but possibly also to IfcSite, IfcBuilding)

subject: IfcElement
rule: IfcElement shall be placed relative to the local placement of the IfcElement to which it is tied by an element relationship

subject: IfcLocalPlacement
rule: The local relative placement and the referenced placement shall have the same type of axis placement (both 2D or both 3D)

subject: IfcLocalPlacement
rule: The referencing of parent placements has to be a-cyclic

subject: IfcProduct
rule: If the product has a product representation, it also has to have an object placement

subject: IfcVirtualGridIntersection
rule: IntersectingAxes shall point to exactly two IfcGridAxis

subject: IfcProduct
rule: For geometric representations, subtypes IfcProductDefinitionShape and IfcShapeRepresentation have to be used

subject: IfcProductRepresentation
rule: must have at least one IfcRepresentation (or subtype) assigned

subject: IfcProductDefinitionShape
rule: must have at least one IfcShapeRepresentation assigned

subject: IfcProduct
rule: must be the only subtype of IfcObject that can have a product representation

subject: IfcShapeRepresentation
rule: RepresentationType attribute is required

subject: IfcShapeRepresentation
rule: RepresentationIdentifier and RepresentationType must only carry attribute values described within the IFC 2x specification

subject: IfcRepresentation
rule: items for direct geometric representation must be all subtypes of IfcGeometricRepresentationItem

subject: IfcGeometricSet
rule: Elements must be either all 2D or all 3D but not a mixture of both

subject: IfcGeometricCurveSet
rule: All Elements must be either points or curves, but not surfaces

subject: IfcFaceBasedSurfaceModel
rule: Topological representation items cannot be immediately referenced by Items attribute of IfcShapeRepresentation; an intermediate geometric representation item must be used

subject: IfcShellBasedSurfaceModel
rule: Topological representation items cannot be immediately referenced by Items attribute of IfcShapeRepresentation; an intermediate geometric representation item must be used

subject: IfcOpenShell
rule: Must not be immediately referenced by Items attribute of IfcShapeRepresentation

subject: IfcClosedShell
rule: Must not be immediately referenced by Items attribute of IfcShapeRepresentation

subject: IfcConnectedFaceSet
rule: Must not be immediately referenced by Items attribute of IfcShapeRepresentation

subject: IfcShapeRepresentation
rule: For Curve2D representation, IfcBoundedCurve should be used as the only item of IfcShapeRepresentation.Items

subject: IfcShapeRepresentation
rule: For Curve2D multi-segmented path, IfcCompositeCurve shall be used

subject: IfcShapeRepresentation
rule: For GeometricSet representation, IfcGeometricSet should be used as the only item of IfcShapeRepresentation.Items

subject: IfcBooleanClippingResult
rule: FirstOperand must be of type IfcSweptAreaSolid or IfcBooleanClippingResult

subject: IfcBooleanClippingResult
rule: SecondOperand must be of type IfcHalfSpaceSolid

subject: IfcBooleanClippingResult
rule: Operator must be DIFFERENCE

subject: IfcSweptAreaSolid
rule: IfcSweptAreaSolid when referencing parameterized profile definitions is normally used as the preferred geometric representation for building elements

subject: IfcPresentationStyle
rule: IfcPresentationStyle must be abstract

subject: IfcProduct
rule: Geometric representation must be encapsulated within an IfcProduct definition

subject: IfcRepresentation
rule: Presentation information for semantic objects must be handled as styled representations included in the (subtype of) IfcProduct.Representation

subject: IfcProduct
rule: Each subtype of IfcProduct (except IfcAnnotation) must have at least one IfcShapeRepresentation within IfcProductDefinitionShape.Representations

subject: IfcAnnotation
rule: IfcAnnotation must not have typing or decomposition

subject: IfcCurveStyle
rule: If no significant name is available for IfcCurveStyle.Name, an empty string '' shall be exchanged

subject: IfcCurveStyle
rule: If curve font is set by layer settings, the IfcCurveStyle.CurveFont attribute shall be undetermined (nil)

subject: IfcCurveStyle
rule: If no value is given for IfcCurveStyle.CurveFont and no IfcPresentationLayerAssignmentWithStyle layer information is available, default 'continuous' shall be used

subject: IfcCurveStyle
rule: If curve colour is set by layer settings, the IfcCurveStyle.CurveColour attribute shall be undetermined (nil)

subject: IfcCurveStyle
rule: If no value is given for IfcCurveStyle.CurveFont and no IfcPresentationLayerAssignmentWithStyle layer information is available, default 'black' shall be used for curve colour

subject: IfcCurveStyle
rule: If curve width is set by layer settings, the IfcCurveStyle.CurveWidth attribute shall be undetermined (nil)

subject: IfcCurveStyle
rule: If no value is given for IfcCurveStyle.CurveFont and no IfcPresentationLayerAssignmentWithStyle layer information is available, a system default shall be used for curve width

subject: IfcStyledItem
rule: IfcStyledItem must have styles S[1:1] referencing IfcPresentationStyleAssignment

subject: IfcPresentationStyleAssignment
rule: IfcPresentationStyleAssignment must have Styles S[1:?] referencing IfcCurveStyle or IfcSurfaceStyle

subject: IfcSurfaceStyle
rule: IfcSurfaceStyle must have Styles S[1:5] referencing IfcSurfaceStyleShading

subject: IfcSurfaceStyle
rule: IfcSurfaceStyle must have Side attribute of type IfcSurfaceSide

subject: IfcSurfaceStyleShading
rule: IfcSurfaceStyleShading must have SurfaceColour referencing IfcColourRgb

subject: IfcPolyline
rule: IfcPolyline must have Point L[2:?] referencing IfcCartesianPoint

subject: IfcRelDefinesByProperties
rule: IfcRelDefinesByProperties must have RelatingPropertyDefinition referencing IfcPropertySetDefinition

subject: IfcRelDefinesByProperties
rule: IfcRelDefinesByProperties must have RelatedObjects S[1:?] referencing IfcObject

subject: IfcRelDefinesByType
rule: IfcRelDefinesByType must have RelatingType referencing IfcTypeObject

subject: IfcRelDefinesByType
rule: IfcRelDefinesByType must have RelatedObjects S[1:?] referencing IfcObject

subject: IfcTypeObject
rule: IfcTypeObject must have HasPropertySets L[1:?] referencing IfcPropertySetDefinition

subject: IfcFurniture
rule: IfcFurniture objects may share a reference to the same IfcPropertySetDefinition

subject: IfcCurveStyle
rule: IfcCurveStyle must have a Name attribute

subject: IfcPropertySet
rule: IfcPropertySet contains at least one property

subject: IfcPropertySet
rule: The Name attribute of all properties within the set must be different

subject: IfcTypeObject
rule: Each IfcTypeObject has a name (inherited from IfcRoot) that identifies it

subject: IfcPropertySet
rule: must contain at least one property

subject: IfcPropertySet
rule: all contained properties must have unique Name attribute values

subject: IfcProperty
rule: must never be instantiated directly

subject: IfcProperty
rule: must have a Name

subject: IfcPropertyEnumeratedValue
rule: if EnumerationReference is given, selected values must be within the list of values specified in IfcPropertyEnumeration

subject: IfcPropertyEnumeration
rule: must have a unique name

subject: IfcPropertyEnumeration
rule: cannot have values with different units

subject: IfcPropertyListValue
rule: if Unit is given, all entries within the list must be of the same measure type

subject: IfcComplexProperty
rule: must not assign more than one copy of identical complex properties within a property set

subject: IfcPropertyReferenceValue
rule: can only reference classes at the Resource layer

subject: IfcElement
rule: All subtypes of IfcElement except IfcOpeningElement can have an inverse relationship HasAssociations pointing to IfcRelAssociatesMaterial

subject: IfcOpeningElement
rule: IfcOpeningElement is excluded from having material association

subject: IfcWall
rule: IfcMaterialList is only allowed for arbitrary walls (instances of IfcWall which are not instances of IfcWallStandardCase)

subject: IfcMaterialLayerSet
rule: IfcMaterialLayerSet.TotalThickness shall be equal to the wall thickness (measured in Y dimension of extrusion coordinate system)

subject: IfcMaterialLayerSetUsage
rule: For a layered wall, LayerSetDirection shall be set to AXIS2

subject: IfcRelAssociatesMaterial
rule: RelatedObjects must have at least 1 item

subject: IfcMaterialList
rule: Materials must have at least 1 item

subject: IfcMaterialLayerSet
rule: MaterialLayers must have at least 1 item

subject: IfcElementQuantity
rule: Each instance of IfcElementQuantity must have a single defined MethodOfMeasurement attribute

subject: IfcElementQuantity
rule: All quantities contained by a single instance of IfcElementQuantity must conform to the same method of measurement

subject: IfcElementQuantity
rule: It is possible to make more than one relationship of IfcElementQuantity to an object if using different methods of measurement

subject: IfcPhysicalQuantity
rule: Each instance of IfcPhysicalQuantity must have a name that defines the context for its usage

subject: IfcPhysicalQuantity
rule: Each instance of IfcPhysicalQuantity may have a unit

subject: IfcPhysicalQuantity
rule: If the unit is given, the value for unit overrides the global setting of the project-wide units within IfcProject.UnitsInContext

subject: IfcPhysicalQuantity
rule: If the value for unit is omitted, the unit defined within UnitsInContext is used

subject: IfcRelDefinesByProperties
rule: There is no limiting rule that says one IfcElementQuantity can only be related to one type of IfcObject

subject: IfcRelAssociates
rule: relationships are prohibited from having external references or definitions

subject: IfcRelAssociatesClassification
rule: must be able to assign both contained and referenced classifications to an object by virtue of having multiple instances

subject: IfcRelAssociatesLibrary
rule: must have related objects that are instances of IfcRoot class

subject: IfcRelAssociatesLibrary
rule: must constrain the subtypes of IfcRoot that can have a library associated

subject: IfcCovering
rule: IfcCovering has predefined types including CLADDING, CEILING, FLOORING

subject: IfcSlab
rule: IfcSlab has predefined types including FLOOR, LANDING, ROOF, BASESLAB

subject: IfcDoor
rule: IfcDoor possesses an attribute OperationType describing the opening method

subject: IfcElement
rule: If the predefined type USERDEFINED is used, the element type must be customized and defined via ObjectType or ElementType

subject: IfcBuildingElementProxy
rule: It is recommended to avoid this class as much as possible and use the appropriate classes to define elements

subject: IfcBuildingElementProxy
rule: IfcBuildingElementProxy should be used sparingly and only for unspecified elements

subject: IfcWall
rule: IfcWall can be composed of several layers and materials can be specified via IfcMaterialLayerSet or IfcMaterialConstituentSet

subject: IfcRoof
rule: IfcRoof can be composed of several layers and materials can be specified via IfcMaterialLayerSet or IfcMaterialConstituentSet
